### 1.1 `6R-04` 目标

本分件必须把 failure、control、lease、orphan、reaper、cleanup、redline、reference、projection、derived、audit、relay、reconciliation 和 caller-safe view 从名称级骨架收敛为逐对象可落码契约。完成时每个对象必须只有一个 canonical section，并闭合 private fields、字段来源、factory、member method、状态、不变量、对象自有错误、中文 Rustdoc 和下游承接。

本分件不拥有 tools semantic execution、runtime agent loop、member lifecycle orchestration、artifact / evidence truth、observability store、investigation lifecycle、backend product lifecycle 或 policy definition。它只消费这些外部 owner 提供的 body-free typed ref、safe summary、committed observation 或 typed outcome。

## 3. Step 6 SOP 问题回答

| SOP 问题 | `6R-04 batch 6` 回答 |
|---|---|
| 是否已有骨架、批次和模块顺序 | 是。§10 固定七批，严格按 control -> failure/control -> lease/reaper -> cleanup/redline -> read/derived -> audit/relay/view/report -> closure audit 推进。 |
| 本分件 capability 是什么 | 收束执行失败与控制、保守管理 lease / orphan / cleanup / redline，并提供不反写核心 truth 的 reference / projection / derived / audit / relay / reconciliation 面。 |
| capability 输入是什么 | `6R-02/03` 已提交的 context、boundary、handle、run、capture、handoff truth；body-free lifecycle / investigation / publisher observation；clock、typed refs 和 committed cursors。 |
| capability 输出是什么 | Sandbox-owned failure / control / lifecycle / safety truth、只读 projection / report、append-only audit / relay record 和 caller-safe views。 |
| 哪些模块本分件闭口 | `domain` 对象、guard、marker relation和状态方法；`contracts` shared set / marker declaration、public view / report schema。 |
| 哪些内容留给 Step 7+ | repository / port / adapter callable 留 Step 7；protocol DTO 留 Step 8；UoW 调用顺序留 Step 9；状态矩阵展示留 Step 10；但这些步骤消费的对象方法必须先在本分件存在。 |
| 是否允许以 caller bool 或 status 文本代替 guard | 不允许。10 项 forward method 必须由 owning object 校验 exact refs、generation、status 和 evidence relation。 |
| read / derived 是否可修核心 truth | 不允许。projection、preview、comparison、reconciliation 和 query 只能读取、标记 stale / degraded 或生成 report。 |
| audit / relay 是否可升级 source truth | 不允许。它们只记录已提交 source fact；发布失败不回滚 source truth，发布成功也不提升其业务状态。 |
| 外部正文如何处理 | 只接受 `ExternalSourceRef`、`SafeSummaryRef`、digest、finite status 和 typed observation；raw output、artifact body、telemetry body、investigation body、SDK response 与错误文本不得入 domain truth。 |

## 5. 设计取舍与 owner 规则

| 取舍 | 决策 | 原因 |
|---|---|---|
| 一个全局 failure / cleanup 状态机 | 不采用 | failure、control、lease、orphan、cleanup 和 redline 是独立主语，不能互相推导状态。 |
| caller 传 `bool` 或比较 enum 证明 guard | 不采用 | 丢失 exact object relation、generation、evidence 和 safe reason owner。 |
| view 复制一套 `Visible*Status` | 不采用 | 形成 wire-only 第二真相；canonical status + degraded reason 已足够。 |
| audit / relay 共用一个 mutable record | 不采用 | audit linkage 与 event delivery lifecycle 独立，relay failure不得污染 audit truth。 |
| report / projection 作为修复入口 | 不采用 | read-side 只能 no-write / rebuild / report，不得 silent repair。 |
| shared marker / set 声明位置 | 使用既有 `crates/contracts/src/refs.rs` | Step 4 已固定 shared finite enum / marker owner；domain 校验其业务 relation，但不复制 wrapper。 |
| guard 文件位置 | 与 owning truth 同文件 | `ControlConflictGuard -> control.rs`、cleanup guards -> `cleanup.rs`、redline guard -> `redline.rs`、derived guard -> `projection.rs`，避免 generic `policies.rs` 成为第二对象仓。 |
| object error | 与对象 canonical section 同批闭口 | `ContractError` 只承接 shared carrier shape；lineage、transition、status和evidence错误由对象自有 error 承接。 |

`S6T-04-014` 的 `domain` 分类表示 marker 的业务语义由 domain flow 产生和校验，不表示新增 domain-local declaration。三个 marker 的 Rust declaration仍唯一位于既有 `contracts::refs`；该澄清不新增 `markers.rs`，也不允许 domain 同名 wrapper。

## 6. Capability 到 canonical object owner

| capability | exact input class | canonical owner | 输出 / 禁止边界 |
|---|---|---|---|
| stable failure classification | policy / backend / resource / capture / handoff / orphan / redline basis | `FailureClassification` | stable failure fact；不解析 raw adapter error |
| control intake and conflict closure | typed control intent、current run / cleanup / redline refs | `ControlConflictGuard`;`ControlFact` | accepted / duplicate / conflicted control truth；不做 business replay |
| lease and orphan suspicion | active handle、generation、checked time、backend lifecycle summary | `LeaseRecord`;`ReaperEligibilityMarker`;`OrphanRecoveryRecord` | lease / recovery truth；不拥有 backend lifecycle |
| cleanup readiness and completion | capture、handoff、audit、investigation、redline evidence | `CleanupSafetyGuard`;`CleanupGuard` | exact permission / block；不拥有 artifact retention |
| security redline containment | detected redline、boundary / handle / run relation、investigation summary | `RedlineContainmentGuard`;`RedlineContainment` | fail-closed containment truth；不得 advisory-only |
| caller-safe safety reads | committed failure / control / cleanup / redline source snapshots | `FailureControlStatusView`;`CleanupReadinessView`;`RedlineContainmentView` | no-write view；缺失以 degraded 显式化 |
| long-lived reference refresh | external refs、safe summaries、reference cursor | `ReferenceRefreshMarker`;`ReferenceResolutionState` | freshness tracking；不决定首次 intake success |
| derived no-write maintenance | truth refs、body-free summaries、derived cursor | `DerivedSourceRefSet`;`DerivedRebuildMarker`;`DerivedReadOnlyGuard`;`DerivedInspectPreviewTrendState` | stale / rebuild / failure state；不形成核心 failure |
| sandbox read projection | committed status view refs、truth cursor | `SandboxStatusViewRefSet`;`SandboxReadProjection` | rebuildable read identity；不成为 truth source |
| append-only trace and relay | typed trace subject / source fact、committed cursor | `SandboxAuditTrace`;`SandboxEventRelayRecord` | linkage / delivery record；不回滚或升级 source fact |
| comparison and reconciliation | truth / projection refs、capability / boundary summaries | `SandboxTruthRefSet`;`SandboxProjectionRefSet`;两个 derived views；`SandboxReconciliationReport` | body-free comparison / findings；不选择 backend、不自动修复 |

`VisibleFailureStatus`、`VisibleControlStatus`、`VisibleCleanupStatus`、`VisibleRedlineStatus`、`DerivedVisibleStatus`不进入support inventory，它们已判定为第二状态owner。`PolicySimulationMarkerSet`也不自动继承：backend comparison只能消费已提交policy / boundary / capability refs与body-free summary；若未来确有simulation输入，必须先由policy owner形成正式typed source，而不能在view内自造marker。

Inventory总计为`28 named types + 13 support families = 41 review units`。support family中的候选名称只是必须处置的上游输入：owning section必须选择“exact canonical type”或“显式复用 / 失效”，不能原样漏过；batch 7将对所有候选逐项做current / invalidated差集。

## 12. Batch 2: Failure / Control exact object contract

### 12.1 `FailureClassification`

#### 12.1.1 Capability、对象能力与字段来源

`FailureClassification` 只把 Sandbox 已经能够证明的 policy refusal、backend / resource / timeout observation、capture / handoff failure、orphan 或 redline 收束为稳定 failure truth。它不解析 adapter error text，不接收 caller 选择的 `SandboxFailureKind`，也不把 runtime agent loop、tool semantic result、artifact truth 或 observability store 状态搬入 Sandbox。

| capability | exact input | owning type / method | output | forbidden substitute |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| source normalization | committed owner 或 typed body-free observation | `FailureSourceMarker::*` factory | one typed source marker | `SandboxOpaqueRef`、raw error、generic reason |
| source-set closure | same-context markers | `FailureSourceMarkerSet::try_for_context` | ordered-unique set + unified optional lineage | caller `Vec<ref>`、latest truth scan |
| stable classification | non-empty closed marker set | `FailureClassification::classify` | `Classified` truth | caller-selected kind / impact |
| pending closure | no stable marker yet | `FailureClassification::pending` / `classify_pending` | `PendingInput -> Classified` | unknown-as-success |
| boundary failure proof | stable boundary-blocking source | `blocks_boundary_for` | object-owned pure boolean | kind comparison outside object |
| run failure proof | stable run-terminal source + exact lineage | `require_run_failure_basis` | owned `FailureRunBasis` with checked lineage / kind / impact / reason | adapter error / caller reason |
| explanation supersession | matching terminal control / redline truth | `supersede_by_control` / `supersede_by_redline` | `Superseded` | overwrite kind or delete old source |

字段来源固定如下：

| field group | exact source | required relation | missing / conflict behavior |
|---|---|---|---|
| `failure_ref` | current UoW pre-generated `FailureClassificationRef` | one ref creates at most one fact | repository uniqueness remains Step 7 / 11 obligation |
| `context_ref` | explicit accepted `ControlledExecutionContext` | all markers must equal this context | factory returns `FailureContextMismatch` |
| run / boundary / handle / generation | marker set mechanically unifies exact owner lineage | each present value must be unique across the set | conflict rejects the entire set |
| kind / impact | fixed marker precedence and marker-owned mapping | caller supplies neither value | unknown / invalid mapping cannot create stable fact |
| reason | dominant marker owner safe reason | never parsed to derive kind / status | missing source reason rejects stable classification |
| status / supersession refs | object factory / transition only | exact status-field matrix below | invalid relation returns object error |
| time / audit | application clock + pre-generated audit ref | monotonic and not earlier than source observation | rollback; no partial fact |

#### 12.1.2 Typed failure observation support

`SandboxFailureObservation` is an embedded domain input mapped by a Step 7 adapter from a typed outcome. It is not a repository truth, protocol payload, backend lifecycle owner or raw diagnostic container.

```rust
/// 穷尽可以为 Sandbox failure 提供输入的 body-free adapter observation。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum SandboxFailureObservationKind {
    /// isolation backend 在已存在 run ref 后拒绝或执行 launch 失败。
    BackendLaunchFailed,
    /// controlled run 处于 active 期间，isolation backend 报告执行失败。
    BackendRunFailed,
    /// 已校验的 backend lifecycle observation 与 owning handle relation 冲突。
    BackendLifecycleConflicted,
    /// owning run 与 handle 触发了一个明确的 resource boundary。
    ResourceLimitExceeded {
        /// 被触发的 coherent boundary 精确维度。
        boundary_kind: BoundaryLimitKind,
    },
    /// owning controlled run 超过显式 wall-clock boundary。
    RunTimedOut,
    /// run 结束后的 Sandbox maintenance action 超过显式时间 boundary。
    MaintenanceTimedOut,
}

/// trusted Sandbox adapter 产生的 typed、body-free failure observation。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct SandboxFailureObservation {
    /// 产生 observation 的稳定外部来源。
    source_ref: ExternalSourceRef,
    /// typed observation 的 safe summary；绝不保存 adapter response body。
    summary_ref: SafeSummaryRef,
    /// 从已加载 context / identity / boundary / handle / run 校验出的完整 lineage。
    lineage: FailureLineage,
    /// 有限 adapter observation kind。
    observation_kind: SandboxFailureObservationKind,
    /// typed adapter mapper 提供的已脱敏 caller-safe reason。
    reason: SandboxReason,
    /// application clock 接受该 adapter observation 的时间。
    observed_at: Timestamp,
}

impl SandboxFailureObservation {
    /// 为 exact controlled run 构造 typed observation，并校验完整 owner relation。
    pub fn try_for_run(
        source_ref: ExternalSourceRef,
        summary_ref: SafeSummaryRef,
        context: &ControlledExecutionContext,
        identity: &ExecutionEnvironmentIdentity,
        boundary: &CoherentBoundary,
        handle: &IsolationEnvironmentHandle,
        run: &ControlledExecutionRun,
        observation_kind: SandboxFailureObservationKind,
        reason: SandboxReason,
        observed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, FailureClassificationError>;

    /// 为 exact boundary / handle maintenance path构造无 run observation。
    pub fn try_for_boundary(
        source_ref: ExternalSourceRef,
        summary_ref: SafeSummaryRef,
        context: &ControlledExecutionContext,
        identity: &ExecutionEnvironmentIdentity,
        boundary: &CoherentBoundary,
        handle: &IsolationEnvironmentHandle,
        observation_kind: SandboxFailureObservationKind,
        reason: SandboxReason,
        observed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, FailureClassificationError>;

    /// 返回外部 source ref，不暴露 source body。
    pub fn source_ref(&self) -> &ExternalSourceRef;
    /// 返回 body-free observation summary ref。
    pub fn summary_ref(&self) -> &SafeSummaryRef;
    /// 返回 owning controlled execution context ref。
    pub fn context_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionContextRef {
        self.lineage.context_ref()
    }
    /// 返回 optional owning controlled run ref。
    pub fn run_ref(&self) -> Option<&ControlledExecutionRunRef> {
        self.lineage.run_ref()
    }
    /// 返回 optional coherent boundary ref。
    pub fn boundary_ref(&self) -> Option<&CoherentBoundaryRef> {
        self.lineage.boundary_ref()
    }
    /// 返回 optional isolation handle ref。
    pub fn handle_ref(&self) -> Option<&IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef> {
        self.lineage.handle_ref()
    }
    /// 返回 optional canonical generation ref。
    pub fn generation_ref(&self) -> Option<&ResourceRef> {
        self.lineage.generation_ref()
    }
    /// 返回有限 typed observation kind。
    pub fn observation_kind(&self) -> SandboxFailureObservationKind;
    /// 返回已脱敏 caller-safe source reason。
    pub fn reason(&self) -> &SandboxReason;
    /// 返回 observation 被接受的时间。
    pub fn observed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
    /// 返回 observation 所属的 execution environment identity ref。
    pub fn environment_identity_ref(&self) -> &ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef {
        self.lineage.environment_identity_ref()
    }
    /// 返回完整 checked lineage。
    pub fn lineage(&self) -> &FailureLineage;
}
```

Observation matrix is closed:

| observation kind | allowed external source | required lineage | derived failure kind | derived impact |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `BackendLaunchFailed` | `IsolationBackend | Runner` | context + run + boundary + handle + generation | `BackendFailure` | `RunTerminal` |
| `BackendRunFailed` | `IsolationBackend | Runner` | context + run + boundary + handle + generation | `BackendFailure` | `RunTerminal` |
| `BackendLifecycleConflicted` | `IsolationBackend` | context + optional run + boundary + handle + generation | `BackendFailure` | `BoundaryAndRun` when run exists, otherwise `BoundaryOnly` |
| `ResourceLimitExceeded` | `IsolationBackend | Runner` | context + run + boundary + handle + generation | `ResourceExceeded` | `BoundaryAndRun` |
| `RunTimedOut` | `IsolationBackend | Runner` | context + run + boundary + handle + generation | `Timeout` | `RunTerminal` |
| `MaintenanceTimedOut` | `IsolationBackend | Runner | Investigation` | context + boundary + handle + generation; run must be absent | `Timeout` | `PostRunClosure` |

`try_for_run` 必须逐项验证 context 为 `Accepted`，identity 对该 context 为 `Active`，boundary / handle / run 的 context、identity、boundary、handle 与 generation refs 全部相等；只接受 `BackendLaunchFailed | BackendRunFailed | BackendLifecycleConflicted | ResourceLimitExceeded | RunTimedOut`。`try_for_boundary` 执行同一 owner relation校验，但只接受 `BackendLifecycleConflicted | MaintenanceTimedOut`。`source_ref.source_kind()` 必须等于 `summary_ref.source_kind()`。当前没有任何 variant 允许缺少 boundary、handle、generation 或 execution environment identity。`MaintenanceTimedOut` 是唯一不带 run 的当前 variant，因此不能传给 `ControlledExecutionRun::mark_failed`。`Runner` 只能提供已映射的 typed outcome，不能直接把 runner product 状态作为 observation。

#### 12.1.3 Failure source marker and impact contract

```rust
/// 描述稳定 failure 在不暴露 source body 时允许阻断的边界。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum FailureImpact {
    /// 阻断 launch 或 policy continuation，但不修改既有 run 或 boundary。
    PreLaunchBlock,
    /// 可使 exact owning run 进入 `Failed`，但不使 boundary 失效。
    RunTerminal,
    /// 使 exact boundary 失效，并可同时使 exact owning run 失败。
    BoundaryAndRun,
    /// 使 exact boundary 失效，但 exact active run 必须由 control / redline owner 进入 `Terminated`。
    BoundaryAndTerminatedRun,
    /// 使 exact boundary 失效，但保留已终态 run 的原 terminal owner。
    BoundaryAndPostRun,
    /// 在没有 run relation 时使 exact boundary 失效。
    BoundaryOnly,
    /// 记录 run 终态后的 capture、handoff 或 maintenance closure failure。
    PostRunClosure,
}

/// 保存已由 source owner 校验的 failure kind、impact、lineage 与 safe reason 快照。
///
/// 该对象是 immutable embedded value，不是 repository truth，也不得脱离 source owner factory 构造。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct FailureSourceMarker {
    /// marker 唯一绑定的 typed source identity 或 observation。
    source: FailureSource,
    /// source owner 已校验的完整 execution lineage。
    lineage: FailureLineage,
    /// 只从 typed source status / kind 映射出的 canonical failure kind。
    failure_kind: SandboxFailureKind,
    /// 只从 typed source relation 映射出的 canonical failure impact。
    failure_impact: FailureImpact,
    /// source owner 提供的已脱敏 caller-safe reason。
    reason: SandboxReason,
    /// source owner 的 canonical decision / observation time。
    source_time: Timestamp,
}

/// 用于 failure marker ordered-unique 去重的封闭 source key。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum FailureSourceKey {
    /// policy decision source key。
    Policy(PolicyExecutionDecisionRef),
    /// external typed observation source key；source、summary 与 finite kind共同标识一次观察。
    ExternalObservation {
        /// external observation source ref。
        source_ref: ExternalSourceRef,
        /// body-free observation summary ref。
        summary_ref: SafeSummaryRef,
        /// finite observation kind。
        observation_kind: SandboxFailureObservationKind,
    },
    /// capture fact source key。
    Capture(CaptureFactRef),
    /// handoff fact source key。
    Handoff(HandoffFactRef),
    /// orphan recovery source key。
    Orphan(OrphanRecoveryRecordRef),
    /// redline containment source key。
    Redline(RedlineContainmentRef),
}

/// 穷尽 failure marker 允许引用的 typed source owner。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum FailureSource {
    /// 正式 non-accepted policy decision identity。
    Policy(PolicyExecutionDecisionRef),
    /// typed backend、resource 或 timeout observation。
    Observation(SandboxFailureObservation),
    /// committed failed / unavailable capture fact identity。
    Capture(CaptureFactRef),
    /// committed failed material / observability handoff fact identity。
    Handoff(HandoffFactRef),
    /// 已证明 orphan classification 输入的 committed orphan recovery record identity。
    Orphan(OrphanRecoveryRecordRef),
    /// 已证明 security failure 输入的 committed redline containment identity。
    Redline(RedlineContainmentRef),
}

impl FailureSourceMarker {
    /// 从明确要求 failure classification 的 policy decision 构造 marker。
    pub fn from_policy_decision(
        decision: &PolicyExecutionDecision,
    ) -> Result<Self, FailureClassificationError>;

    /// 从已经通过 source / lineage 校验的 typed observation 构造 marker。
    pub fn from_observation(
        observation: SandboxFailureObservation,
    ) -> Result<Self, FailureClassificationError>;

    /// 只从 `Failed | Unavailable` capture fact 构造 marker。
    pub fn from_capture(capture: &CaptureFact) -> Result<Self, FailureClassificationError>;

    /// 只从 terminal failed handoff fact 构造 marker，不接受 retryable progress。
    pub fn from_handoff(handoff: &HandoffFact) -> Result<Self, FailureClassificationError>;

    /// 从 §13.3 允许分类的 orphan record 构造 marker。
    pub fn from_orphan(
        orphan: &OrphanRecoveryRecord,
    ) -> Result<Self, FailureClassificationError>;

    /// 从 detected、contained、handoff-pending 或 terminal redline truth 构造 marker。
    pub fn from_redline(
        redline: &RedlineContainment,
    ) -> Result<Self, FailureClassificationError>;

    /// 返回 marker 的 typed source owner。
    pub fn source(&self) -> &FailureSource;
    /// 返回 exact owning controlled execution context ref。
    pub fn context_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionContextRef {
        self.lineage.context_ref()
    }
    /// 返回 optional exact controlled run ref。
    pub fn run_ref(&self) -> Option<&ControlledExecutionRunRef> {
        self.lineage.run_ref()
    }
    /// 返回 execution environment identity ref。
    pub fn environment_identity_ref(&self) -> &ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef {
        self.lineage.environment_identity_ref()
    }
    /// 返回 optional exact coherent boundary ref。
    pub fn boundary_ref(&self) -> Option<&CoherentBoundaryRef> {
        self.lineage.boundary_ref()
    }
    /// 返回 optional exact isolation handle ref。
    pub fn handle_ref(&self) -> Option<&IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef> {
        self.lineage.handle_ref()
    }
    /// 返回 optional canonical generation ref。
    pub fn generation_ref(&self) -> Option<&ResourceRef> {
        self.lineage.generation_ref()
    }
    /// 返回完整 typed source lineage。
    pub fn lineage(&self) -> &FailureLineage;
    /// 返回用于 ordered-unique 去重的 typed source key。
    pub fn source_key(&self) -> FailureSourceKey;
    /// 返回从 typed source status 派生的 kind，绝不解析 reason 字符串。
    pub fn failure_kind(&self) -> SandboxFailureKind;
    /// 返回从 typed source relation 派生的 impact。
    pub fn failure_impact(&self) -> FailureImpact;
    /// 返回 source owner 的 caller-safe reason。
    pub fn reason(&self) -> &SandboxReason;
    /// 返回 source owner 的 canonical observation / decision time。
    pub fn source_time(&self) -> &Timestamp;
}
```

`from_orphan` 与 `from_redline` 的 callable shape、typed owner input、输出 marker role 和禁止 raw ref / caller kind 的边界在本批固定；但它们消费的 source-status、terminal relation、lineage completeness 与 safe-reason mapping 必须分别在 batch 3 `OrphanRecoveryRecord` 和 batch 4 `RedlineContainment` 正文闭合后做一次反向重验。反向重验只能确认或收紧本节映射；若后续 source object 无法提供本节要求的 relation，必须重开本节并登记 blocker，不得由 adapter、Step 7 flow 或 caller bool 补造。该义务不把尚未完成的 orphan / redline 对象正文伪记为 batch 2 已关闭。

`PolicyExecutionDecisionStatus::Rejected | Blocked | FailClosed` 全部映射为当前 canonical umbrella `SandboxFailureKind::PolicyDeny`；`Accepted | Pending` 不能创建 marker。该映射刻意保持 `6R-01` 已闭口的 shared enum。`6R-03` 中点名不存在的 `PolicyDenied` / `PolicyFailClosed` variant 的句子只作为 historical conflict input，不形成第二 enum owner。`CaptureFactStatus::Failed | Unavailable` 映射为 `CaptureFailure`；`HandoffFactStatus::Failed` 映射为 `HandoffFailure`；`Retryable | BlockedByCleanupGuard` 不创建 stable failure marker。

source factory 的 kind / impact 映射必须按下表机械实现：

| source | stable kind | impact when full run lineage exists | impact when no run exists | safe reason source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| non-accepted `PolicyExecutionDecision` | `PolicyDeny` | `RunTerminal` | `PreLaunchBlock` | decision reason；为空则 object error |
| `SandboxFailureObservation` | observation matrix中的 kind | observation matrix中的 impact | observation matrix中的 boundary / post-run impact | observation reason |
| `CaptureFact(Failed | Unavailable)` | `CaptureFailure` | `PostRunClosure` | invalid source relation | capture status / source reason |
| `HandoffFact(Failed)` | `HandoffFailure` | `PostRunClosure` | invalid source relation | handoff status reason |
| `OrphanRecoveryRecord` classifiable state | `Orphan` | `BoundaryAndRun` | `BoundaryOnly` | orphan owner reason |
| `RedlineContainment` active-run detected / contained / handoff-pending / terminal | `Redline` | `BoundaryAndTerminatedRun` | `BoundaryOnly` | redline containment reason |
| `RedlineContainment` post-run detected / contained / handoff-pending / terminal | `Redline` | `BoundaryAndPostRun` | not applicable | redline containment reason |

一个 marker 不允许同时携带两个 impact；同一 source 若需要从 pre-launch 变为 run-terminal，必须由新的 exact source lineage 创建新 marker，不得原地改写。

#### 12.1.4 `FailureLineage` 与 `FailureSourceMarkerSet`

```rust
/// 绑定 failure source 与 Sandbox execution boundary 的最小 typed lineage。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct FailureLineage {
    /// failure source 所属的 accepted controlled execution context。
    context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
    /// failure source 所属的 active execution environment identity。
    environment_identity_ref: ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef,
    /// 可选的 exact controlled run；maintenance-only failure 不携带该值。
    run_ref: Option<ControlledExecutionRunRef>,
    /// 可选的 exact coherent boundary；当前 stable source 必须携带该值。
    boundary_ref: Option<CoherentBoundaryRef>,
    /// 可选的 exact isolation environment handle；当前 stable source 必须携带该值。
    handle_ref: Option<IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef>,
    /// 与 boundary / handle 共用的 canonical generation。
    generation_ref: Option<ResourceRef>,
}

impl FailureLineage {
    /// 从 source owner 的显式 refs 构造 lineage；不会从 ref 文本推导任何关系。
    pub fn try_new(
        context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
        environment_identity_ref: ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef,
        run_ref: Option<ControlledExecutionRunRef>,
        boundary_ref: Option<CoherentBoundaryRef>,
        handle_ref: Option<IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef>,
        generation_ref: Option<ResourceRef>,
    ) -> Result<Self, FailureClassificationError>;

    /// 返回 owning controlled execution context ref。
    pub fn context_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionContextRef;
    /// 返回 owning execution environment identity ref。
    pub fn environment_identity_ref(&self) -> &ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef;
    /// 返回 optional controlled run ref。
    pub fn run_ref(&self) -> Option<&ControlledExecutionRunRef>;
    /// 返回 optional coherent boundary ref。
    pub fn boundary_ref(&self) -> Option<&CoherentBoundaryRef>;
    /// 返回 optional isolation environment handle ref。
    pub fn handle_ref(&self) -> Option<&IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef>;
    /// 返回 optional canonical generation ref。
    pub fn generation_ref(&self) -> Option<&ResourceRef>;

    /// 判断两个 lineage 是否可以证明属于同一个 failure aggregate。
    pub fn is_compatible_with(&self, other: &Self) -> bool;
}

/// 保存同一 context 下 ordered-unique 的 failure source markers。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct FailureSourceMarkerSet {
    /// 按 canonical source order 保存的 marker 列表。
    markers: Vec<FailureSourceMarker>,
    /// 所有 marker 共同承接的 context lineage。
    lineage: Option<FailureLineage>,
}

impl FailureSourceMarkerSet {
    /// 创建空 pending-input marker set；空集合只能被 `FailureClassification::pending` 使用。
    pub fn empty_for_context(
        context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
        environment_identity_ref: ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef,
    ) -> Result<Self, FailureClassificationError>;

    /// 构造非空 ordered-unique marker set，并合并 exact lineage。
    pub fn try_for_context(
        expected_context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
        markers: Vec<FailureSourceMarker>,
    ) -> Result<Self, FailureClassificationError>;

    /// 返回只读 marker 切片；调用方不能绕过集合不变量修改顺序或成员。
    pub fn as_slice(&self) -> &[FailureSourceMarker];
    /// 返回集合是否为空。
    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool;
    /// 返回集合的 optional unified lineage。
    pub fn lineage(&self) -> Option<&FailureLineage>;
    /// 返回集合是否包含指定 canonical failure kind。
    pub fn contains_kind(&self, kind: SandboxFailureKind) -> bool;
    /// 返回集合是否包含至少一个 boundary-blocking marker。
    pub fn has_boundary_blocking_marker(&self) -> bool;
    /// 返回集合是否包含至少一个 run-terminal marker。
    pub fn has_run_terminal_marker(&self) -> bool;
    /// 按固定安全优先级返回 dominant marker；同级冲突时返回 typed error。
    pub fn dominant_marker(&self) -> Result<&FailureSourceMarker, FailureClassificationError>;
}
```

`FailureLineage::try_new` 的闭合矩阵如下：`context_ref` 与 `environment_identity_ref` 必须同时存在；`boundary_ref`、`handle_ref`、`generation_ref` 要么全部存在，要么全部缺失；如果 `run_ref` 存在，则后三者必须全部存在。当前 `FailureSourceMarker` factory 对所有 stable source 要求后三者存在，因此只有 `FailureClassification::pending` 可以使用无 boundary lineage 的空集合。`is_compatible_with` 只比较显式 typed refs；它不比较 source reason、digest、时间或 ref 字符串。

marker set 的规范化规则：

| 规则 | 约束 | 失败结果 |
|---|---|---|
| context | 每个 marker 的 `lineage.context_ref` 等于 expected context | `MarkerContextMismatch` |
| identity | 每个 marker 的 environment identity 相等 | `MarkerLineageMismatch` |
| optional lineage | 所有非 `None` 的 run / boundary / handle / generation 必须一致 | `MarkerLineageMismatch` |
| duplicate | 以 `FailureSourceMarker::source_key()` 识别同一 source；同源重复禁止 | `DuplicateFailureSourceMarker` |
| kind / impact | marker 自身的 typed mapping 必须与 source variant 一致 | `MarkerKindImpactMismatch` |
| dominant tie | 最高安全优先级的多个 marker 必须具有相同 kind、impact 和 safe reason | `AmbiguousDominantFailureMarker` |
| order | 由固定 source priority 规范化；不接受 caller 以顺序改变安全结论 | `MarkerOrderingInvalid` |

source priority 固定为 `Redline > Orphan > PolicyDeny > ResourceExceeded > Timeout > BackendFailure > CaptureFailure > HandoffFailure`。同一 source family 的多个 marker 不能靠最后写入者覆盖；如果其 safe reason 不一致，必须显式返回 `AmbiguousDominantFailureMarker`。`Unknown` 只能存在于 pending fact，不得成为 stable marker。

#### 12.1.5 `FailureRunBasis`

```rust
/// 由 `FailureClassification` 返回给 run lifecycle 的 checked failure basis。
///
/// 该值是 transient proof，不是新的 truth、ref 或 protocol DTO；它只能由 owning method 生成。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct FailureRunBasis {
    /// 已提交或同 UoW staged 的 failure classification ref。
    failure_ref: FailureClassificationRef,
    /// exact run owner context ref。
    context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
    /// exact failed run ref。
    run_ref: ControlledExecutionRunRef,
    /// exact failed boundary ref。
    boundary_ref: CoherentBoundaryRef,
    /// exact failed isolation handle ref。
    handle_ref: IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef,
    /// failure 与 run 共用的 canonical generation。
    generation_ref: ResourceRef,
    /// source-derived canonical failure kind。
    failure_kind: SandboxFailureKind,
    /// source-derived impact。
    failure_impact: FailureImpact,
    /// owner-provided caller-safe reason。
    reason: SandboxReason,
    /// source classification status。
    classification_status: FailureClassificationStatus,
    /// failure fact 最近一次 transition 的 audit trace ref。
    audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
}

impl FailureRunBasis {
    /// 返回 failure classification ref。
    pub fn failure_ref(&self) -> &FailureClassificationRef;
    /// 返回 context ref。
    pub fn context_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionContextRef;
    /// 返回 run ref。
    pub fn run_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionRunRef;
    /// 返回 boundary ref。
    pub fn boundary_ref(&self) -> &CoherentBoundaryRef;
    /// 返回 isolation handle ref。
    pub fn handle_ref(&self) -> &IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef;
    /// 返回 canonical generation ref。
    pub fn generation_ref(&self) -> &ResourceRef;
    /// 返回 canonical failure kind。
    pub fn failure_kind(&self) -> SandboxFailureKind;
    /// 返回 source-derived failure impact。
    pub fn failure_impact(&self) -> FailureImpact;
    /// 返回 caller-safe failure reason。
    pub fn reason(&self) -> &SandboxReason;
    /// 返回 failure classification status。
    pub fn classification_status(&self) -> FailureClassificationStatus;
    /// 返回 failure fact audit trace ref。
    pub fn audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;
}
```

`FailureRunBasis` 只能在 failure status 为 `Classified | Terminal` 且 impact 为 `RunTerminal | BoundaryAndRun` 时产生。`PendingInput`、`Superseded`、`PreLaunchBlock`、`BoundaryAndTerminatedRun`、`BoundaryAndPostRun` 和 `PostRunClosure` 均不能驱动 `ControlledExecutionRun::mark_failed`；active redline 必须使用 `RedlineRunBasis`，`Superseded` 必须先由新的 control / redline owner 产生新的 terminal basis。

#### 12.1.6 `FailureClassification` exact fields、factory 与 transitions

```rust
/// Sandbox 对一次已验证失败来源形成的 immutable / monotonic failure classification truth。
///
/// 对象维护 source marker、execution lineage、稳定 kind、阻断 impact 和 terminal proof；
/// 它不拥有 adapter、runtime、tool、artifact、observability store 或 investigation 正文。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct FailureClassification {
    /// 本 failure fact 的 typed identity。
    failure_ref: FailureClassificationRef,
    /// failure 所属的 accepted controlled execution context。
    context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
    /// failure 所属的 execution environment identity。
    environment_identity_ref: ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef,
    /// source marker 统一出的 optional controlled run。
    run_ref: Option<ControlledExecutionRunRef>,
    /// source marker 统一出的 exact coherent boundary。
    boundary_ref: Option<CoherentBoundaryRef>,
    /// source marker 统一出的 exact isolation environment handle。
    handle_ref: Option<IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef>,
    /// source marker 统一出的 canonical generation。
    generation_ref: Option<ResourceRef>,
    /// source markers 的 immutable ordered-unique set。
    source_markers: FailureSourceMarkerSet,
    /// source-derived canonical failure kind。
    failure_kind: SandboxFailureKind,
    /// source-derived impact，决定 boundary / run / post-run 作用面。
    failure_impact: FailureImpact,
    /// failure classification 的 canonical status。
    failure_status: FailureClassificationStatus,
    /// pending / classified / superseded / terminal 的 caller-safe reason。
    status_reason: Option<SandboxReason>,
    /// superseding control fact ref；仅 `Superseded` 时存在。
    superseded_by_control_ref: Option<ControlFactRef>,
    /// superseding redline containment ref；仅 `Superseded` 时存在。
    superseded_by_redline_ref: Option<RedlineContainmentRef>,
    /// failure fact 首次创建的时间。
    created_at: Timestamp,
    /// 首次形成 stable classification 的时间；pending fact 为 `None`。
    classified_at: Option<Timestamp>,
    /// 当前 status 生效时间，必须单调不回退。
    status_changed_at: Timestamp,
    /// 最近一次 failure transition 的 audit trace ref。
    last_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
}

impl FailureClassification {
    /// 创建没有稳定 source 的 `PendingInput` fact；该 fact 不代表 success。
    pub fn pending(
        failure_ref: FailureClassificationRef,
        context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
        environment_identity_ref: ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef,
        pending_reason: SandboxReason,
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        pending_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, FailureClassificationError>;

    /// 从非空、已规范化 marker set 创建 `Classified` fact。
    pub fn classify(
        failure_ref: FailureClassificationRef,
        markers: FailureSourceMarkerSet,
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        classified_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, FailureClassificationError>;

    /// 从 non-accepted policy decision创建 canonical `PolicyDeny` classification。
    pub fn from_policy_decision(
        failure_ref: FailureClassificationRef,
        decision: &PolicyExecutionDecision,
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        classified_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, FailureClassificationError>;

    /// 从 `Failed | Unavailable` capture fact 创建 `CaptureFailure` classification。
    pub fn from_capture(
        failure_ref: FailureClassificationRef,
        capture: &CaptureFact,
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        classified_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, FailureClassificationError>;

    /// 为 pending fact 消费同 context 的 stable marker set并进入 `Classified`。
    pub fn classify_pending(
        &mut self,
        markers: FailureSourceMarkerSet,
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        changed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), FailureClassificationError>;

    /// 将 `Classified` failure 定格为 `Terminal`；不改变 source kind 或 lineage。
    pub fn mark_terminal(
        &mut self,
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        changed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), FailureClassificationError>;

    /// 用 matching terminal control fact supersede旧解释；旧 marker 永不删除或重写。
    pub fn supersede_by_control(
        &mut self,
        control: &ControlFact,
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        changed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), FailureClassificationError>;

    /// 用 matching redline containment supersede旧解释；redline body由§14.4定义。
    pub fn supersede_by_redline(
        &mut self,
        redline: &RedlineContainment,
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        changed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), FailureClassificationError>;

    /// 返回 failure fact identity。
    pub fn failure_ref(&self) -> &FailureClassificationRef;
    /// 返回 owning context ref。
    pub fn context_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionContextRef;
    /// 返回 owning environment identity ref。
    pub fn environment_identity_ref(&self) -> &ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef;
    /// 返回 optional controlled run ref。
    pub fn run_ref(&self) -> Option<&ControlledExecutionRunRef>;
    /// 返回 optional coherent boundary ref。
    pub fn boundary_ref(&self) -> Option<&CoherentBoundaryRef>;
    /// 返回 optional isolation handle ref。
    pub fn handle_ref(&self) -> Option<&IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef>;
    /// 返回 optional canonical generation ref。
    pub fn generation_ref(&self) -> Option<&ResourceRef>;
    /// 返回 immutable source marker set。
    pub fn source_markers(&self) -> &FailureSourceMarkerSet;
    /// 返回 canonical failure kind。
    pub fn failure_kind(&self) -> SandboxFailureKind;
    /// 返回 failure impact。
    pub fn failure_impact(&self) -> FailureImpact;
    /// 返回 canonical failure status。
    pub fn failure_status(&self) -> FailureClassificationStatus;
    /// 返回 status-specific caller-safe reason。
    pub fn status_reason(&self) -> Option<&SandboxReason>;
    /// 返回 optional control supersession ref。
    pub fn superseded_by_control_ref(&self) -> Option<&ControlFactRef>;
    /// 返回 optional redline supersession ref。
    pub fn superseded_by_redline_ref(&self) -> Option<&RedlineContainmentRef>;
    /// 返回 failure fact 创建时间。
    pub fn created_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
    /// 返回首次 stable classification 时间。
    pub fn classified_at(&self) -> Option<&Timestamp>;
    /// 返回 current status change time。
    pub fn status_changed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
    /// 返回 latest transition audit trace ref。
    pub fn last_audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;

    /// 判断该 fact 是否能阻断指定 boundary / handle；关系不匹配时安全返回 false。
    pub fn blocks_boundary_for(
        &self,
        boundary_ref: &CoherentBoundaryRef,
        handle_ref: &IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef,
    ) -> bool;

    /// 为 exact run / context / boundary / handle 生成 checked failure basis。
    pub fn require_run_failure_basis(
        &self,
        run_ref: &ControlledExecutionRunRef,
        context_ref: &ControlledExecutionContextRef,
        boundary_ref: &CoherentBoundaryRef,
        handle_ref: &IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef,
    ) -> Result<FailureRunBasis, FailureClassificationError>;

    /// 判断当前 classification 是否已进入不可继续执行的 terminal status。
    pub fn is_terminal(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断当前 failure 是否要求 cleanup guard 保留 environment / material。
    pub fn requires_cleanup_guard(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断当前 source 是否已达到 redline containment 触发条件。
    pub fn requires_redline_containment(&self) -> bool;
}
```

字段关系矩阵：

| status | marker set | kind | impact | lineage | reason | supersession |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PendingInput` | empty | `Unknown` | `PreLaunchBlock` | context + identity only | required fixed pending reason | both `None` |
| `Classified` | non-empty | dominant marker kind | dominant marker impact | exact unified marker lineage | dominant marker reason | both `None` |
| `Superseded` | non-empty, immutable | original kind retained | original impact retained | unchanged | superseding owner safe reason | exactly one ref |
| `Terminal` | non-empty | dominant marker kind | non-unknown | exact unified marker lineage | dominant marker reason | both `None` |

合法 transition 固定为：

```text
pending -> PendingInput
PendingInput -> Classified
Classified -> Terminal | Superseded
Terminal -> Superseded
Superseded = terminal / immutable; no outgoing transition
```

`classify_pending` 只能消费同 context、同 identity 且非空的 marker set；`mark_terminal` 不能从 `PendingInput` 直接跳转；`supersede_by_control` / `supersede_by_redline` 只接受 matching lineage 的正式 owner truth，并且只写 superseding ref / status / reason / audit / timestamp。它们不得修改旧 `failure_kind`、`failure_impact` 或 marker set。`blocks_boundary_for` 只有在 status 为 `Classified | Terminal`、impact 为 `BoundaryAndRun | BoundaryAndTerminatedRun | BoundaryAndPostRun | BoundaryOnly`、且 self 的 boundary / handle 与入参 exact equal 时返回 true；`Superseded` 返回 false，迫使 caller 使用新的 control / redline terminal basis。`require_run_failure_basis` 还要求 self 的 run、context、boundary、handle、environment identity 与 generation 均等于入参对应的已加载 owner group；`BoundaryAndTerminatedRun | BoundaryAndPostRun` 明确返回 `RunFailureBasisUnavailable`，不把 redline termination 写成 failure，也不改写已终态 run。

#### 12.1.7 `FailureClassificationError`

```rust
/// failure observation、marker set、lineage、classification 或 terminal basis 不变量失败。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum FailureClassificationError {
    /// observation source 与 safe summary 的 source kind 不一致。
    ObservationSourceSummaryKindMismatch,
    /// observation source kind 不允许承接该 observation kind。
    ObservationSourceKindInvalid {
        /// 实际收到的 external source kind。
        actual: ExternalSourceKind,
    },
    /// observation kind 的 run / boundary / handle / generation / identity relation 不完整。
    ObservationLineageIncomplete,
    /// observation 的 explicit refs 彼此不属于同一 generation / identity lineage。
    ObservationLineageMismatch,
    /// observation kind 与 reason / time relation 不合法。
    ObservationFieldRelationInvalid,
    /// policy decision 当前不能形成 failure classification。
    PolicyDecisionWasNotClassifiable {
        /// 实际 policy execution status。
        actual: PolicyExecutionDecisionStatus,
    },
    /// capture fact 当前不是 `Failed | Unavailable`。
    CaptureWasNotClassifiable {
        /// 实际 capture fact status。
        actual: CaptureFactStatus,
    },
    /// handoff fact 当前不是 terminal `Failed`。
    HandoffWasNotClassifiable {
        /// 实际 handoff fact status。
        actual: HandoffFactStatus,
    },
    /// source marker 缺少必须的 context / identity / boundary lineage。
    MarkerLineageIncomplete,
    /// marker 与 expected context 不一致。
    MarkerContextMismatch,
    /// marker 与其他 marker 的 lineage 不一致。
    MarkerLineageMismatch,
    /// 同一 typed source 在一个 marker set 中重复出现。
    DuplicateFailureSourceMarker,
    /// marker 的 kind / impact 与 source owner 映射不一致。
    MarkerKindImpactMismatch,
    /// marker set 的 dominant source 存在不可安全合并的同级冲突。
    AmbiguousDominantFailureMarker,
    /// marker set 未按固定 source priority 规范化。
    MarkerOrderingInvalid,
    /// stable classification 收到空 marker set。
    EmptyFailureSourceMarkerSet,
    /// pending factory 的 context / identity relation 不完整。
    PendingLineageIncomplete,
    /// failure status 与 fields / marker set / supersession refs 不一致。
    FailureStatusFieldRelationInvalid {
        /// 关系失败时的 canonical failure status。
        status: FailureClassificationStatus,
    },
    /// failure transition 不在 closed graph 中。
    FailureTransitionNotAllowed {
        /// 发生失败的 failure ref。
        failure_ref: FailureClassificationRef,
        /// transition 前状态。
        from: FailureClassificationStatus,
        /// caller 请求的目标状态。
        to: FailureClassificationStatus,
    },
    /// status change time 早于已有 failure time。
    FailureTimestampMovedBackwards,
    /// failure ref 与新 source / owner identity 不一致。
    FailureRefOrOwnerMismatch,
    /// control supersession 不是 matching terminal control。
    ControlSupersessionNotAllowed,
    /// redline supersession 不是 matching containment truth。
    RedlineSupersessionNotAllowed,
    /// orphan source 未满足 batch 3 定义的 typed relation。
    OrphanSourceRelationInvalid {
        /// 关系校验失败的 orphan recovery record ref。
        orphan_ref: OrphanRecoveryRecordRef,
    },
    /// redline source 未满足 batch 4 定义的 typed relation。
    RedlineSourceRelationInvalid {
        /// 关系校验失败的 redline containment ref。
        redline_ref: RedlineContainmentRef,
    },
    /// failure 已经有 supersession owner，不能再写第二个。
    DuplicateFailureSupersession,
    /// failure 与 requested boundary / handle relation 不一致。
    FailureBoundaryOrHandleMismatch,
    /// failure status / impact / lineage 不能形成 run failure basis。
    RunFailureBasisUnavailable,
    /// requested run / context / boundary / handle 与 failure relation 不一致。
    RunFailureBasisLineageMismatch,
    /// terminal basis 缺少 caller-safe reason。
    TerminalBasisReasonMissing,
}
```

对象错误必须由 failure owner 直接返回；Step 7 只能做 typed mapping，不得将上述 variant 折叠为 `DomainError::InvalidStateTransition`，更不得以 `SandboxReason.as_str()` 重新解析 kind 或 lineage。

#### 12.1.8 Failure object self-review 与 downstream revalidation

| 审查项 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| capability 是否有唯一 object owner | pass；source normalization / set closure / classification / basis 均归 `failure.rs` |
| 每个必填字段是否有 factory source | pass；pending 与 classified 两条 factory path均覆盖字段 |
| stable kind 是否由 typed source 派生 | pass；caller不能传 `SandboxFailureKind`，reason不参与解析 |
| boundary / run relation 是否 exact | pass；`FailureLineage`、`blocks_boundary_for`、`FailureRunBasis`均比较 named refs |
| source body 是否越界 | pass；只保存 named ref、external ref、safe summary、digest、reason和typed status |
| status 是否形成第二 owner | pass；只复用 shared `FailureClassificationStatus` |
| terminal / supersession 是否可重写旧事实 | pass；supersession只追加 owner ref并保留旧 marker / kind / impact |
| negative cuts | pass；禁止 raw adapter error、caller bool、generic reason、latest scan、runtime/tool/artifact truth、query view和control kind比较 |

Step 7~10 必须在回归时完成以下反查：

| downstream | 必须重新读取 / 替换的内容 | 当前历史冲突 |
|---|---|---|
| Step 7 | `FailureSourceMarker` factories、`FailureClassification::classify`、`require_run_failure_basis` 的 exact repository / UoW input | 旧 port 接受 `Vec<SandboxOpaqueRef>`，必须替换为 typed marker construction path |
| Step 8 | failure command request/result 只能传 typed source refs / observations；status复用 `FailureClassificationStatus` | 旧 `failure_source_markers: Vec<SandboxOpaqueRef>` 与 `PolicyDenied` 非现有 variant失效 |
| Step 9 | classify / pending / run-mark-failed 的调用顺序和 no-backend-side-effect 分支 | 旧 flow 允许 adapter error 直接形成 failure，必须改为 typed observation或pending |
| Step 10 | `PendingInput / Classified / Superseded / Terminal` 及 trigger / forbidden matrix | 旧状态矩阵若使用 `Failed` 或 generic `Unknown`，必须删除而非 alias |

failure support family #29 和 `S6T-04-001` 的 `FailureClassification` 对象正文已闭合；control support尚待本分件后续章节。

### 12.2 `ControlConflictGuard` 与 control support

#### 12.2.1 Control target、source 与 effect support

control 不能只由 `SandboxControlKind` 表示。guard 必须同时看到 exact target lineage、source context 和现有正式 control，才能区分 duplicate、conflict 与 terminal override。下面的 support values 都是 domain transient / embedded values，不创建独立 repository truth 或 named ref。

```rust
/// 一个 control intent 能够影响的 Sandbox execution lineage。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct ControlTargetLineage {
    /// control 所属的 accepted controlled execution context。
    context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
    /// control 所属的 execution environment identity。
    environment_identity_ref: ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef,
    /// 可选 controlled run；没有 run 时表示 pre-launch 或 context-level control。
    run_ref: Option<ControlledExecutionRunRef>,
    /// 可选 coherent boundary；存在 run 或 handle 时必须有值。
    boundary_ref: Option<CoherentBoundaryRef>,
    /// 可选 isolation environment handle；存在 run 时必须有值。
    handle_ref: Option<IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef>,
    /// 与 boundary / handle / run 共用的 canonical generation。
    generation_ref: Option<ResourceRef>,
}

impl ControlTargetLineage {
    /// 从显式 named refs 构造 target lineage；不从 ref 文本推导关系。
    pub fn try_new(
        context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
        environment_identity_ref: ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef,
        run_ref: Option<ControlledExecutionRunRef>,
        boundary_ref: Option<CoherentBoundaryRef>,
        handle_ref: Option<IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef>,
        generation_ref: Option<ResourceRef>,
    ) -> Result<Self, ControlConflictGuardError>;

    /// 从 exact run owner group构造完整 target，并逐项验证 refs / generation。
    pub fn try_for_run(
        context: &ControlledExecutionContext,
        identity: &ExecutionEnvironmentIdentity,
        boundary: &CoherentBoundary,
        handle: &IsolationEnvironmentHandle,
        run: &ControlledExecutionRun,
    ) -> Result<Self, ControlConflictGuardError>;

    /// 从 exact boundary / handle owner group构造无 run target。
    pub fn try_for_boundary(
        context: &ControlledExecutionContext,
        identity: &ExecutionEnvironmentIdentity,
        boundary: &CoherentBoundary,
        handle: &IsolationEnvironmentHandle,
    ) -> Result<Self, ControlConflictGuardError>;

    /// 从 accepted context / active identity构造 pre-boundary target。
    pub fn try_for_context(
        context: &ControlledExecutionContext,
        identity: &ExecutionEnvironmentIdentity,
    ) -> Result<Self, ControlConflictGuardError>;

    /// 返回 context ref。
    pub fn context_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionContextRef;
    /// 返回 environment identity ref。
    pub fn environment_identity_ref(&self) -> &ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef;
    /// 返回 optional run ref。
    pub fn run_ref(&self) -> Option<&ControlledExecutionRunRef>;
    /// 返回 optional boundary ref。
    pub fn boundary_ref(&self) -> Option<&CoherentBoundaryRef>;
    /// 返回 optional handle ref。
    pub fn handle_ref(&self) -> Option<&IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef>;
    /// 返回 optional generation ref。
    pub fn generation_ref(&self) -> Option<&ResourceRef>;

    /// 判断两个 target 是否是同一 exact control subject。
    pub fn is_exact_match(&self, other: &Self) -> bool;
    /// 判断两个 target 是否共享足以形成冲突的 context / run scope。
    pub fn conflicts_with(&self, other: &Self) -> bool;
}

/// control request 的来源摘要；不保存 request body 或 operator note。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct ControlSourceContext {
    /// 可选外部来源；system-generated control 可以没有外部 source ref。
    source_ref: Option<ExternalSourceRef>,
    /// 已脱敏的 source reason；`Other` 和 system control 必须有值。
    reason: Option<SandboxReason>,
    /// duplicate / equivalent-effect 判断使用的稳定 source key。
    source_key: ControlSourceKey,
    /// 跨同步 / 异步边界复用的 trace identity。
    trace_context: SandboxTraceContext,
}

/// control source 的稳定、body-free identity key。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum ControlSourceKey {
    /// external source 的 kind + stable resource identity；version / digest 不参与 identity。
    External {
        /// external source kind。
        source_kind: ExternalSourceKind,
        /// external stable resource identity。
        resource_ref: ResourceRef,
    },
    /// system-generated control 使用 trace context 中的 non-empty request id。
    SystemRequest(RequestId),
}

impl ControlSourceContext {
    /// 从 external source 构造 control source；source kind 与 control kind 的匹配由 guard 校验。
    pub fn from_external(
        source_ref: ExternalSourceRef,
        reason: Option<SandboxReason>,
        trace_context: SandboxTraceContext,
    ) -> Result<Self, ControlConflictGuardError>;

    /// 构造 system-generated control；必须提供已脱敏 reason，不能伪造 external source。
    pub fn from_system(
        reason: SandboxReason,
        trace_context: SandboxTraceContext,
    ) -> Result<Self, ControlConflictGuardError>;

    /// 返回 optional external source ref。
    pub fn source_ref(&self) -> Option<&ExternalSourceRef>;
    /// 返回 optional caller-safe reason。
    pub fn reason(&self) -> Option<&SandboxReason>;
    /// 返回 stable source key。
    pub fn source_key(&self) -> &ControlSourceKey;
    /// 返回 trace context。
    pub fn trace_context(&self) -> &SandboxTraceContext;
}

/// 由 control kind 派生的 Sandbox-side effect，不表达 runtime 或工具语义。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum ControlEffect {
    /// 使 exact run 不再允许继续执行。
    TerminateRun,
    /// 只请求 cleanup / release guard 评估，不直接释放环境。
    CleanupOnly,
    /// 只请求 investigation / containment handoff，不直接终止 runtime。
    InvestigationOnly,
    /// 已验证但没有当前安全 effect；严格 guard 不允许其进入 accepted fact。
    Unsupported,
}

/// control side effect adapter / maintenance owner 返回的 finite outcome。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum ControlEffectOutcomeKind {
    /// requested Sandbox-side effect 已被 matching owner确认完成。
    Completed,
    /// effect 未完成且当前是 terminal failure。
    Failed,
}

/// body-free typed control effect observation；不保存 adapter response 或 runtime body。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct ControlEffectObservation {
    /// observation 唯一描述的 control fact ref。
    control_ref: ControlFactRef,
    /// observation 唯一适用的 exact target lineage。
    target: ControlTargetLineage,
    /// observed effect；必须等于 control fact effect。
    effect: ControlEffect,
    /// finite outcome kind。
    outcome_kind: ControlEffectOutcomeKind,
    /// body-free outcome summary。
    summary_ref: SafeSummaryRef,
    /// failed outcome 必有的 caller-safe reason。
    failure_reason: Option<SandboxReason>,
    /// adapter / maintenance owner observation time。
    observed_at: Timestamp,
}

impl ControlEffectObservation {
    /// 从 trusted typed outcome构造 observation并执行 status / reason relation校验。
    pub fn try_new(
        control: &ControlFact,
        effect: ControlEffect,
        outcome_kind: ControlEffectOutcomeKind,
        summary_ref: SafeSummaryRef,
        failure_reason: Option<SandboxReason>,
        observed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, ControlFactError>;

    /// 返回 target control ref。
    pub fn control_ref(&self) -> &ControlFactRef;
    /// 返回 exact target lineage。
    pub fn target(&self) -> &ControlTargetLineage;
    /// 返回 observed effect。
    pub fn effect(&self) -> ControlEffect;
    /// 返回 finite outcome kind。
    pub fn outcome_kind(&self) -> ControlEffectOutcomeKind;
    /// 返回 body-free summary ref。
    pub fn summary_ref(&self) -> &SafeSummaryRef;
    /// 返回 optional failure reason。
    pub fn failure_reason(&self) -> Option<&SandboxReason>;
    /// 返回 observation time。
    pub fn observed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
}

/// 将 control intent 与 existing control 比较后产生的 transient disposition。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum ControlConflictDisposition {
    /// incoming control 可以形成新的 accepted fact。
    Accept,
    /// incoming control 与同一 target、同一 kind 的 existing fact 重复。
    Duplicate,
    /// incoming control 与 existing fact 发生不可安全合并的冲突。
    Conflict,
    /// terminal incoming control 覆盖尚未终止的 non-terminal control。
    TerminalOverride,
}

/// 用于比较 control intent 的短生命周期输入值。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct ControlIntent {
    /// 本次 intent 预生成的 control fact ref。
    control_ref: ControlFactRef,
    /// exact target lineage。
    target: ControlTargetLineage,
    /// finite control kind。
    control_kind: SandboxControlKind,
    /// control source context。
    source_context: ControlSourceContext,
    /// application clock 接受 intent 的时间。
    requested_at: Timestamp,
}

impl ControlIntent {
    /// 创建 intent；严格校验 control kind 与 target / source 的最小关系。
    pub fn try_new(
        control_ref: ControlFactRef,
        target: ControlTargetLineage,
        control_kind: SandboxControlKind,
        source_context: ControlSourceContext,
        requested_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, ControlConflictGuardError>;

    /// 返回 control fact ref。
    pub fn control_ref(&self) -> &ControlFactRef;
    /// 返回 target lineage。
    pub fn target(&self) -> &ControlTargetLineage;
    /// 返回 finite control kind。
    pub fn control_kind(&self) -> SandboxControlKind;
    /// 返回 source context。
    pub fn source_context(&self) -> &ControlSourceContext;
    /// 返回 request time。
    pub fn requested_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
}

/// ControlConflictGuard evaluate 产生的已校验决策；不是 control truth。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct ControlConflictDecision {
    /// 产生本 decision 的 immutable strict guard ref。
    guard_ref: ControlConflictGuardRef,
    /// incoming intent 的 control ref。
    incoming_control_ref: ControlFactRef,
    /// incoming intent 的 exact target lineage。
    target: ControlTargetLineage,
    /// incoming control kind。
    control_kind: SandboxControlKind,
    /// 从 kind 派生的 control effect。
    effect: ControlEffect,
    /// compare 时观察到的全部 relevant existing control refs；非 `Accept` 必须非空。
    existing_control_refs: ControlFactRefSet,
    /// guard 计算出的 disposition。
    disposition: ControlConflictDisposition,
    /// guard 或 source owner 给出的 caller-safe reason；不得用于反向解析 kind / disposition。
    decision_reason: SandboxReason,
    /// guard evaluation time。
    evaluated_at: Timestamp,
}

impl ControlConflictDecision {
    /// 返回产生本 decision 的 strict guard ref。
    pub fn guard_ref(&self) -> &ControlConflictGuardRef;
    /// 返回 incoming control ref。
    pub fn incoming_control_ref(&self) -> &ControlFactRef;
    /// 返回 exact target lineage。
    pub fn target(&self) -> &ControlTargetLineage;
    /// 返回 control kind。
    pub fn control_kind(&self) -> SandboxControlKind;
    /// 返回 derived control effect。
    pub fn effect(&self) -> ControlEffect;
    /// 返回全部 relevant existing control refs。
    pub fn existing_control_refs(&self) -> &ControlFactRefSet;
    /// 返回 conflict disposition。
    pub fn disposition(&self) -> ControlConflictDisposition;
    /// 返回 decision safe reason。
    pub fn decision_reason(&self) -> &SandboxReason;
    /// 返回 evaluation time。
    pub fn evaluated_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
}
```

`ControlSourceContext::from_system` 必须从 `trace_context.request_id()` 取得已由 shared carrier 校验为 non-empty 的 `RequestId`，并复制成 `ControlSourceKey::SystemRequest`；request id 缺失时精确返回 `SystemControlRequestIdMissing`，不能退化成随机 key、trace id、clock time或泛化 `ControlSourceReasonMissing`。`from_external` 则必须从 `ExternalSourceRef` 的 `(source_kind, resource_ref)` 形成 `ControlSourceKey::External`，不得把 version / digest、reason 或 request body并入 source identity。

`ControlEffectObservation::try_new` 的 summary source-kind矩阵固定如下：

| `ControlEffect` | allowed `SafeSummaryRef.source_kind` | required target relation | outcome / reason relation | forbidden source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `TerminateRun` | `IsolationBackend | Runner` | full context + identity + run + boundary + handle + generation | `Completed` -> no failure reason；`Failed` -> non-empty safe reason | `Runtime` product truth、tool result、member host body |
| `CleanupOnly` | `IsolationBackend | Investigation` | context + identity + boundary + handle + generation；run optional but must match when present | `Completed` -> no failure reason；`Failed` -> non-empty safe reason | artifact deletion receipt、operator note、cleanup caller bool |
| `InvestigationOnly` | `Investigation` | context + identity；optional run / boundary group必须完整且匹配 | `Completed` -> no failure reason；`Failed` -> non-empty safe reason | observability store body、member lifecycle、runtime recovery |
| `Unsupported` | none | none | constructor always rejects | every source kind |

constructor 必须同时验证：control status 为 `Accepted`；`control_ref`、target 与 effect 全等于 owning fact；`observed_at >= control.recorded_at()` 且不早于当前 `status_changed_at`；summary source kind落在上表 closed set；`Completed` 的 `failure_reason` 为 `None`，`Failed` 的 reason 为 `Some`。任一 source-kind错误返回携带 actual kind和effect的 `CompletionSummarySourceKindInvalid`；任一 outcome / reason / time relation错误返回 object-owned typed error。`Runner` 只允许提供已映射的 body-free effect outcome，不允许把 runtime agent-loop、工具语义成功或 runner产品状态写入 observation。

target relation matrix：

| `SandboxControlKind` | effect | required target refs | source rule | run termination allowed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Kill` | `TerminateRun` | context + identity + run + boundary + handle + generation | external or system source; reason optional only for external | yes |
| `Cancel` | `TerminateRun` | context + identity + run + boundary + handle + generation | external or system source | yes |
| `Deny` | `TerminateRun` when run exists, otherwise `Unsupported` pre-launch block | context + identity; run path requires full group | source reason required when system-generated | only when run exists |
| `Timeout` | `TerminateRun` | context + identity + run + boundary + handle + generation | system or typed `IsolationBackend` source | yes |
| `Cleanup` | `CleanupOnly` | context + identity + boundary + handle + generation | system or trusted maintenance source | no |
| `Investigation` | `InvestigationOnly` | context + identity; optional full target group | system or `Investigation` source | no |
| `Other` | `Unsupported` | context + identity | source and reason required | no; strict guard rejects |

`ControlTargetLineage::try_new` 仅供 persistence rehydration / typed protocol mapper 使用，并强制 optional refs 成组：`boundary_ref`、`handle_ref`、`generation_ref` 要么全部存在要么全部缺失；`run_ref` 存在时三者必须存在；`handle_ref` 存在时 boundary 和 generation 必须存在。新 command / consumer path 必须使用三个 `try_for_*` object-based factory：它们逐项检查 accepted context、active identity、established / failed-with-handle boundary、matching handle、optional run与generation，不能直接拼 ref。rehydration 后 repository mapper还必须重新执行 status-field relation validator；`try_new` 不是 caller 绕过 owner load 的入口。

#### 12.2.2 Conflict rule set 与 terminal control set

```rust
/// 严格 control conflict 规则的封闭成员。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum ControlConflictRule {
    /// 同一 exact target 的同一 control kind 只能形成一次 effect；source key只区分exact / equivalent duplicate。
    SameTargetSameKindIsDuplicate,
    /// 两个不同 terminal control kind 不能互相覆盖。
    DistinctTerminalKindsConflict,
    /// terminal control 可以覆盖尚未 terminal 的 non-terminal control。
    TerminalOverridesNonTerminal,
    /// cleanup / investigation 可以与已 terminal control 共存，但不能改写其 run effect。
    SafetyControlCoexistsWithTerminal,
    /// unsupported control 必须 fail closed，不能由配置或 caller 转成 accepted effect。
    UnsupportedControlFailsClosed,
}

/// 保存 immutable 严格冲突规则；不允许配置成 permissive allowlist。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct ControlConflictRuleSet {
    /// 固定顺序且不重复的 closed rule list。
    rules: Vec<ControlConflictRule>,
}

impl ControlConflictRuleSet {
    /// 返回本设计唯一允许的 strict default rule set。
    pub fn strict_default() -> Self;
    /// 从显式 list 构造规则；缺少或增加任一 closed rule 都拒绝。
    pub fn try_new(rules: Vec<ControlConflictRule>) -> Result<Self, ControlConflictGuardError>;
    /// 返回只读规则切片。
    pub fn as_slice(&self) -> &[ControlConflictRule];
}

/// control 终止 run 的 closed kind 集合。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct TerminalControlKindSet {
    /// 按 canonical kind order 保存且不重复的 terminal kinds。
    kinds: Vec<SandboxControlKind>,
}

impl TerminalControlKindSet {
    /// 返回唯一 strict terminal set：`Kill | Cancel | Deny | Timeout`。
    pub fn strict_default() -> Self;
    /// 构造 closed terminal set；不得遗漏或加入 `Cleanup | Investigation | Other`。
    pub fn try_new(kinds: Vec<SandboxControlKind>) -> Result<Self, ControlConflictGuardError>;
    /// 返回只读 kind 切片。
    pub fn as_slice(&self) -> &[SandboxControlKind];
    /// 判断 kind 是否属于 terminal set。
    pub fn contains(&self, kind: SandboxControlKind) -> bool;
}

/// 保存一个 context / target scope 内 ordered-unique 的 control fact refs。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct ControlFactRefSet {
    /// 按提交顺序保存的 control fact refs。
    refs: Vec<ControlFactRef>,
}

impl ControlFactRefSet {
    /// 构造 ordered-unique ref set；重复 ref 必须显式拒绝。
    pub fn try_new(refs: Vec<ControlFactRef>) -> Result<Self, ControlConflictGuardError>;
    /// 返回只读 ref 切片。
    pub fn as_slice(&self) -> &[ControlFactRef];
    /// 返回集合是否包含指定 control ref。
    pub fn contains(&self, control_ref: &ControlFactRef) -> bool;
}
```

strict default 的具体集合是对象契约的一部分，不是配置设计：

```text
rules = SameTargetSameKindIsDuplicate
       + DistinctTerminalKindsConflict
       + TerminalOverridesNonTerminal
       + SafetyControlCoexistsWithTerminal
       + UnsupportedControlFailsClosed
terminal_control_kinds = Kill | Cancel | Deny | Timeout
```

任何缺失、重复或新增 rule / terminal kind 都返回 typed error。这样 `Other` 不能因为配置或 caller flag 变成 accepted effect；若未来要新增 control kind，必须先回到 shared kind registry、rule set、protocol、state matrix 和 acceptance trace 做完整差集。

#### 12.2.3 `ControlConflictGuard` exact contract

```rust
/// 对同一 control target 的 incoming intent 与既有 control facts 执行 immutable strict conflict evaluation。
///
/// guard 只产生 checked decision；它不创建、更新或删除 `ControlFact`，也不触发 runtime、cleanup 或 recovery。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct ControlConflictGuard {
    /// 本 guard 的 typed identity。
    guard_ref: ControlConflictGuardRef,
    /// immutable strict rule set。
    conflict_rules: ControlConflictRuleSet,
    /// immutable terminal control kind set。
    terminal_control_kinds: TerminalControlKindSet,
    /// guard 生效时间。
    activated_at: Timestamp,
}

impl ControlConflictGuard {
    /// 用 strict default 规则创建 guard；不接受 permissive config 或 caller override。
    pub fn strict(
        guard_ref: ControlConflictGuardRef,
        activated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, ControlConflictGuardError>;

    /// 用已核验的 strict rule / terminal set创建 guard；两组必须等于 strict default。
    pub fn bind_strict(
        guard_ref: ControlConflictGuardRef,
        conflict_rules: ControlConflictRuleSet,
        terminal_control_kinds: TerminalControlKindSet,
        activated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, ControlConflictGuardError>;

    /// 比较 incoming intent 与 exact existing facts，返回带完整 source relation 的 checked decision。
    pub fn evaluate(
        &self,
        incoming: &ControlIntent,
        existing_controls: &[ControlFact],
        evaluated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<ControlConflictDecision, ControlConflictGuardError>;

    /// 返回 guard identity。
    pub fn guard_ref(&self) -> &ControlConflictGuardRef;
    /// 返回 immutable conflict rules。
    pub fn conflict_rules(&self) -> &ControlConflictRuleSet;
    /// 返回 immutable terminal control kinds。
    pub fn terminal_control_kinds(&self) -> &TerminalControlKindSet;
    /// 返回 guard activation time。
    pub fn activated_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
}
```

`evaluate` 的固定算法：

```text
1. 校验 evaluated_at >= activated_at，并逐项校验 incoming target shape、source rule 与 kind effect。
2. 过滤 existing_controls：只保留与 incoming target `conflicts_with` 的 facts；过滤在 guard 内完成。
3. 对 relevant facts 按 canonical control sequence / submitted time 排序；caller slice 顺序不影响结果。
4. 若同一 target + same kind 已有 accepted / completed / failed / conflicted / duplicate fact，返回 Duplicate；source key相等表示exact duplicate，不相等表示equivalent-effect duplicate，二者都不得执行第二次effect。
5. 若 incoming 与已有 terminal kind 不同，返回 Conflict；不能通过“更晚时间”覆盖。
6. 若 incoming 是 terminal kind 且已有 non-terminal fact，返回 TerminalOverride。
7. 若 incoming 是 `Cleanup | Investigation` 且已有 terminal fact，返回 Accept并保留这些non-conflicting related refs；它们只能推进各自 safety flow，不能改写 terminal run effect。
8. `Other` 或无法映射 effect 的 intent 在步骤1直接typed reject；其他无冲突的 relevant / empty set返回 Accept，ControlFact factory再消费decision。
```

decision relation matrix：

| disposition | relevant refs | allowed incoming status seed | `effect` | downstream owner |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Accept` | empty，或 post-terminal safety coexistence 的 non-conflicting refs | `Accepted` | kind-derived | `ControlFact::accept` |
| `Duplicate` | one or more same-kind exact duplicates | `IgnoredDuplicate` | kind-derived | `ControlFact::duplicate` |
| `Conflict` | one or more incompatible facts | `Conflicted` | supported kind-derived；`Unsupported`在前置校验已被拒绝 | `ControlFact::conflict` |
| `TerminalOverride` | one or more non-terminal facts | `Accepted` | terminal kind-derived | `ControlFact::accept` with `TerminalOverride` decision |

guard 不以 `ControlFactStatus` 文本、reason、source role 或 list position 推导 disposition；它消费 existing fact 的 canonical kind、target lineage、terminal classification 和 typed sequence。`Conflicted` 的 decision 不能被 `ControlFact::complete` 伪装为成功；`Duplicate` 必须保留 relevant refs 以便 stored result replay。`evaluate` 是纯函数，不保存 existing snapshot，不修改 control fact。

#### 12.2.4 `ControlConflictGuardError`

```rust
/// control target、source、规则集、比较输入或 guard decision relation 失败。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum ControlConflictGuardError {
    /// target context / identity relation 不完整。
    TargetLineageIncomplete,
    /// run 存在但 boundary / handle / generation 不完整。
    TargetRunLineageIncomplete,
    /// boundary / handle / generation 只出现部分成员。
    TargetBoundaryGroupIncomplete,
    /// incoming control ref 与 target / source identity 冲突。
    IncomingControlIdentityMismatch,
    /// control kind 与 target shape 或 source kind 不匹配。
    ControlKindTargetRelationInvalid,
    /// system-generated control 的 trace context 缺少 non-empty request id。
    SystemControlRequestIdMissing,
    /// `Other` 或 system control 缺少必要的 safe reason / source。
    ControlSourceReasonMissing,
    /// external source kind 不允许承接该 control kind。
    ControlSourceKindInvalid {
        /// 实际 source kind。
        actual: ExternalSourceKind,
    },
    /// control source 中出现 forbidden body 或 raw diagnostic carrier。
    ControlSourceBodyForbidden,
    /// rule set 缺少、重复或新增 closed rule。
    ConflictRuleSetNotStrict,
    /// terminal kind set 不等于 strict closed set。
    TerminalControlKindSetNotStrict,
    /// rule / terminal set 中存在重复项。
    DuplicateRuleOrTerminalKind,
    /// guard activation / evaluation timestamp 不合法。
    GuardTimestampInvalid,
    /// existing control 的 target lineage 与其 own context / identity 不一致。
    ExistingControlLineageInvalid,
    /// existing control ref set 中存在重复或不稳定顺序。
    ExistingControlSetInvalid,
    /// incoming / existing control 不属于同一 comparable target。
    ComparableTargetMismatch,
    /// incoming control 与 existing control 的 terminal relation 无法安全裁定。
    TerminalRelationAmbiguous,
    /// decision 中的 existing refs 与实际 relevant facts 不一致。
    DecisionExistingRefMismatch,
    /// disposition 与 effect / existing-ref / status seed relation 不一致。
    DecisionFieldRelationInvalid,
}
```

object-owned error 必须保留实际 finite kind / ref relation，不能只返回 `InvalidControl`。Step 8 可把它映射成 public `Validation`、`Conflict` 或 `FailClosed`，但不得在协议层重新判断 duplicate / conflict。

#### 12.2.5 Guard self-review 与 downstream revalidation

| 审查项 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| guard 是否拥有唯一规则真相 | pass；`control.rs` 同时拥有 rule set、terminal set、evaluate 与 error |
| existing controls 是否可重复计算 | pass；guard按 exact target过滤并规范化顺序 |
| duplicate / conflict 是否有可重放依据 | pass；decision保留完整 relevant `ControlFactRefSet` |
| caller 是否可绕过 guard | pass；ControlFact factory只接受 `ControlConflictDecision` |
| 是否允许 runtime / business replay | no；control effect仅为 Sandbox-side effect |
| 是否可用 bool / status text 代替 | no；disposition由typed relation和strict rules产生 |

Step 7~10 反查要求：

| downstream | 必须承接 | 当前历史冲突 |
|---|---|---|
| Step 7 | `ControlConflictGuard::evaluate` 的 existing fact load、ordering、typed decision输入及 `ControlFact` factory boundary | 旧 port 只接 `ControlConflictGuardRef`，必须删除 opaque-ref-only path |
| Step 8 | control request 传 `ControlTargetLineage` 可构造所需 named refs / source context；result 传 `ControlFactRefSet` / canonical status | 旧 `expected_context_version_ref: SandboxOpaqueRef` 只能作 historical input |
| Step 9 | duplicate / conflict / terminal override 的独立分支与单 UoW save order | 旧 flow 以 `conflicts_with` 简化为一行，粒度不足 |
| Step 10 | `Accepted / IgnoredDuplicate / Conflicted / Completed / Failed` 的 trigger 和禁止迁移 | terminal override 不得被写成一种新 status |

本节完成 support family #30 的 control source / conflict rule 部分；`ControlFactRefSet` 已闭合，`ControlFact` 本体在 §12.3 闭合。

### 12.3 `ControlFact`

#### 12.3.1 Control fact fields、factory 与 status relation

`ControlFact` 是 Sandbox 对 control intent 的 append-once domain truth。它记录 control 是否被受理、重复收束、冲突、完成或失败；它不执行 kill/cancel，不调用 backend，不推进 runtime recovery，也不拥有 cleanup / redline 的后续 lifecycle。所有 effect 必须由后续 application flow 消费正式 fact，并继续通过对应 guard。

```rust
/// Sandbox 对一次 control intent 形成的 immutable-source、monotonic control fact。
///
/// 对象维护 target lineage、control kind、source context、guard decision 和 status；
/// 它不拥有 backend side effect、runtime loop、business replay、cleanup truth 或 redline truth。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct ControlFact {
    /// control fact 的 typed identity。
    control_ref: ControlFactRef,
    /// 产生本 fact 的 strict conflict guard ref。
    conflict_guard_ref: ControlConflictGuardRef,
    /// exact target lineage。
    target: ControlTargetLineage,
    /// finite control kind。
    control_kind: SandboxControlKind,
    /// control kind 派生的 Sandbox-side effect。
    effect: ControlEffect,
    /// 不可变 source context snapshot。
    source_context: ControlSourceContext,
    /// duplicate / conflict 时关联的 existing control refs。
    related_control_refs: ControlFactRefSet,
    /// strict guard decision 派生的 disposition；保留 `Accept` 与 `TerminalOverride` 的区别。
    disposition: ControlConflictDisposition,
    /// strict guard 给出的 immutable caller-safe decision reason。
    decision_reason: SandboxReason,
    /// strict guard 形成 decision 的时间。
    decision_evaluated_at: Timestamp,
    /// 可选 matching failure classification ref；control 本身不创建 failure body。
    failure_ref: Option<FailureClassificationRef>,
    /// canonical control fact status。
    control_status: ControlFactStatus,
    /// 非 normal success 的 caller-safe status reason。
    status_reason: Option<SandboxReason>,
    /// `Completed` 或 `Failed` effect application 的 typed outcome summary。
    completion_summary_ref: Option<SafeSummaryRef>,
    /// control fact 创建并记录的时间；适用于 accepted、duplicate 与 conflict disposition。
    recorded_at: Timestamp,
    /// 当前 status 生效时间，必须单调不回退。
    status_changed_at: Timestamp,
    /// 最近一次 control transition 的 audit trace ref。
    last_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
}

impl ControlFact {
    /// 从 `Accept` 或 `TerminalOverride` decision 创建 `Accepted` fact。
    pub fn accept(
        intent: &ControlIntent,
        decision: &ControlConflictDecision,
        conflict_guard: &ControlConflictGuard,
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        recorded_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, ControlFactError>;

    /// 从 `Duplicate` decision 创建显式 `IgnoredDuplicate` fact；不得重跑 effect。
    pub fn duplicate(
        intent: &ControlIntent,
        decision: &ControlConflictDecision,
        conflict_guard: &ControlConflictGuard,
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        recorded_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, ControlFactError>;

    /// 从 `Conflict` decision 创建显式 `Conflicted` fact；不得静默丢弃 incoming intent。
    pub fn conflict(
        intent: &ControlIntent,
        decision: &ControlConflictDecision,
        conflict_guard: &ControlConflictGuard,
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        recorded_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, ControlFactError>;

    /// 只在 accepted control 的 Sandbox-side effect 已由后续 typed outcome 证明后进入 `Completed`。
    pub fn mark_completed(
        &mut self,
        observation: ControlEffectObservation,
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        completed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), ControlFactError>;

    /// 记录 effect 未完成的 typed failure；不接受 raw adapter error 或 caller reason。
    pub fn mark_failed(
        &mut self,
        observation: ControlEffectObservation,
        failure: Option<&FailureClassification>,
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        failed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), ControlFactError>;

    /// 将 matching failure classification 绑定到accepted / failed control；同ref幂等，不同ref拒绝。
    pub fn attach_failure(
        &mut self,
        failure: &FailureClassification,
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        changed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), ControlFactError>;

    /// 返回 control fact identity。
    pub fn control_ref(&self) -> &ControlFactRef;
    /// 返回产生本 fact 的 conflict guard ref。
    pub fn conflict_guard_ref(&self) -> &ControlConflictGuardRef;
    /// 返回 exact target lineage。
    pub fn target(&self) -> &ControlTargetLineage;
    /// 返回 owning context ref。
    pub fn context_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionContextRef;
    /// 返回 environment identity ref。
    pub fn environment_identity_ref(&self) -> &ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef;
    /// 返回 optional run ref。
    pub fn run_ref(&self) -> Option<&ControlledExecutionRunRef>;
    /// 返回 optional boundary ref。
    pub fn boundary_ref(&self) -> Option<&CoherentBoundaryRef>;
    /// 返回 optional handle ref。
    pub fn handle_ref(&self) -> Option<&IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef>;
    /// 返回 optional generation ref。
    pub fn generation_ref(&self) -> Option<&ResourceRef>;
    /// 返回 finite control kind。
    pub fn control_kind(&self) -> SandboxControlKind;
    /// 返回 control kind 派生的 Sandbox-side effect。
    pub fn effect(&self) -> ControlEffect;
    /// 返回 immutable source context。
    pub fn source_context(&self) -> &ControlSourceContext;
    /// 返回 related existing control refs。
    pub fn related_control_refs(&self) -> &ControlFactRefSet;
    /// 返回 guard decision 派生的 control disposition。
    pub fn disposition(&self) -> ControlConflictDisposition;
    /// 返回 guard decision 的 immutable caller-safe reason。
    pub fn decision_reason(&self) -> &SandboxReason;
    /// 返回 guard decision 的 evaluation time。
    pub fn decision_evaluated_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
    /// 返回 optional matching failure ref。
    pub fn failure_ref(&self) -> Option<&FailureClassificationRef>;
    /// 返回 canonical control status。
    pub fn control_status(&self) -> ControlFactStatus;
    /// 返回 status-specific caller-safe reason。
    pub fn status_reason(&self) -> Option<&SandboxReason>;
    /// 返回 completion / failure safe summary ref。
    pub fn completion_summary_ref(&self) -> Option<&SafeSummaryRef>;
    /// 返回 fact 创建并记录的时间。
    pub fn recorded_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
    /// 返回当前 status 生效时间。
    pub fn status_changed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
    /// 返回最近一次 transition audit trace ref。
    pub fn last_audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;

    /// 判断本 fact 是否为 terminal control kind。
    pub fn requires_termination(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断本 fact 是否只请求 cleanup guard 评估。
    pub fn requires_cleanup_guard(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断本 fact 是否只请求 investigation / containment handoff。
    pub fn requires_investigation_handoff(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断该 fact 是否已完成或失败收束。
    pub fn is_terminal(&self) -> bool;

    /// 为 exact run / context / handle 生成 checked termination basis。
    pub fn require_run_termination_basis(
        &self,
        run_ref: &ControlledExecutionRunRef,
        context_ref: &ControlledExecutionContextRef,
        handle_ref: &IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef,
    ) -> Result<ControlTerminationBasis, ControlFactError>;
}

/// 由 ControlFact 返回给 run lifecycle 的 checked termination basis。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct ControlTerminationBasis {
    /// matching control fact ref。
    control_ref: ControlFactRef,
    /// exact context ref。
    context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
    /// exact run ref。
    run_ref: ControlledExecutionRunRef,
    /// exact handle ref。
    handle_ref: IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef,
    /// terminal control kind。
    control_kind: SandboxControlKind,
    /// Sandbox-side effect。
    effect: ControlEffect,
    /// owner-provided safe reason。
    reason: SandboxReason,
    /// basis 使用的 immutable control source key。
    source_key: ControlSourceKey,
    /// control fact 创建时由 guard decision 固定的 disposition。
    disposition: ControlConflictDisposition,
    /// control fact 创建时由 guard decision 固定的 caller-safe reason。
    decision_reason: SandboxReason,
    /// current control fact status。
    control_status: ControlFactStatus,
    /// latest control audit trace ref。
    audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
}

impl ControlTerminationBasis {
    /// 返回 control fact ref。
    pub fn control_ref(&self) -> &ControlFactRef;
    /// 返回 context ref。
    pub fn context_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionContextRef;
    /// 返回 run ref。
    pub fn run_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionRunRef;
    /// 返回 handle ref。
    pub fn handle_ref(&self) -> &IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef;
    /// 返回 terminal control kind。
    pub fn control_kind(&self) -> SandboxControlKind;
    /// 返回 Sandbox-side effect。
    pub fn effect(&self) -> ControlEffect;
    /// 返回 safe reason。
    pub fn reason(&self) -> &SandboxReason;
    /// 返回 immutable control source key。
    pub fn source_key(&self) -> &ControlSourceKey;
    /// 返回 control fact 的 guard-derived disposition。
    pub fn disposition(&self) -> ControlConflictDisposition;
    /// 返回 control fact 的 guard-derived decision reason。
```
