```rust
    pub fn decision_reason(&self) -> &SandboxReason;
    /// 返回 control status。
    pub fn control_status(&self) -> ControlFactStatus;
    /// 返回 audit trace ref。
    pub fn audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;
}
```

factory 的输入闭环：

| factory | required proof | initial status | required fields | forbidden shortcut |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `accept` | decision=`Accept | TerminalOverride`；decision guard ref等于guard ref；intent refs / kind / source全等 | `Accepted` | exact target、effect、source、related refs、guard ref、timestamps | caller传 status / effect / reason |
| `duplicate` | decision=`Duplicate`；related refs非空且至少一个 same-kind exact target | `IgnoredDuplicate` | complete relevant refs、source、reason | 直接返回既有 fact ref而不建 receipt fact |
| `conflict` | decision=`Conflict`；related refs非空 | `Conflicted` | complete relevant refs、safe conflict reason | 静默 reject、覆盖既有 control |

`ControlFact` factory 必须验证：

1. `decision.incoming_control_ref == intent.control_ref`，`decision.guard_ref == conflict_guard.guard_ref`，且 fact 的 `disposition`、`decision_reason` 与 `decision_evaluated_at` 只复制 matching decision，不允许 caller重算或替换。
2. decision target、kind、effect 与 intent 完全相等；`ControlFact` 不接收独立 effect 参数。
3. `ControlTargetLineage` 与已加载 context / identity / boundary / handle 的 object relation相等；不得只比较 ref kind。
4. `related_control_refs` 与 decision 完全相等，且 `Duplicate / Conflict / TerminalOverride` 不允许为空。
5. `Accepted` 的 transition `status_reason` 为空，但 `decision_reason` 与 `decision_evaluated_at` 必须始终保存；`IgnoredDuplicate / Conflicted` 还必须把该 decision reason复制为 status reason。
6. `recorded_at >= decision.evaluated_at`，所有 factory 不论产生 `Accepted`、`IgnoredDuplicate` 或 `Conflicted` 都写同一语义的创建时间；时间不得早于 guard activation，回退返回 typed error。
7. `failure_ref`在三个factory中固定为`None`。`attach_failure`只允许当前status为`Accepted | Failed`：
   failure status必须为`Classified | Terminal`；`PendingInput | Superseded`拒绝。当前为空时验证
   context / identity / optional run / boundary / handle / generation后写入；
   当前为同一ref时幂等且不改audit/time；当前为不同ref时返回`AttachedFailureRefConflict`。
8. `mark_failed` 的 optional failure 输入必须是已加载的 `FailureClassification` 对象。存在时执行与
   `attach_failure`相同的relation与single-ref检查；不得接收裸`Option<FailureClassificationRef>`绕过校验。
   输入为`None`时保留Accepted阶段已经附着的ref，不得清除。
9. `mark_completed`从`Accepted`迁移时原样保留optional `failure_ref`；它不能新建、替换或清除linkage。
   `Completed`后不允许调用`attach_failure`。failure linkage表示control与failure的committed关系，不表示
   Sandbox-side effect失败，因此effect完成不能抹除该关系。

状态与字段关系：

| status | stored disposition | related refs | effect | failure ref | completion summary | status reason | terminal |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Accepted` | `Accept | TerminalOverride` | empty or exact override refs | kind-derived；`TerminateRun` requires full run group | optional matching ref；可在本status attach | `None` | transition reason `None`; decision reason必有 | no |
| `IgnoredDuplicate` | `Duplicate` | non-empty | kind-derived but no second effect | `None` | `Some` guard receipt summary or `None` before receipt materialization | `Some` guard-derived duplicate reason | yes for duplicate record |
| `Conflicted` | `Conflict` | non-empty | supported kind-derived | `None` | `None` | decision reason复制为`Some` | yes |
| `Completed` | preserved `Accept | TerminalOverride` | preserved | unchanged | preserve Accepted optional ref；不得新attach / replace / clear | `Some` required | transition reason `None`; decision reason必有 | yes |
| `Failed` | preserved `Accept | TerminalOverride` | preserved | unchanged | optional matching ref；可由transition或本status attach | `None` or safe failure summary | failure reason `Some`; decision reason必有 | yes |

`IgnoredDuplicate` 是本次 control fact 的 terminal disposition，但不代表既有 control 已完成，也不触发第二次 runtime effect。`Completed` / `Failed` 只允许从 `Accepted` 进入；`IgnoredDuplicate`、`Conflicted`、`Completed`、`Failed` 不可再次迁移。`ControlFact` 不提供 `terminate()`、`cleanup()` 或 `recover()`，避免 domain fact越权执行副作用。

#### 12.3.2 `ControlFactError`

```rust
/// control fact factory、lineage、status transition 或 run termination basis 不变量失败。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum ControlFactError {
    /// incoming intent 与 conflict decision 不属于同一 control ref。
    IntentDecisionRefMismatch,
    /// decision 不是 factory 所需的 disposition。
    DecisionDispositionMismatch {
        /// 实际收到的 disposition。
        actual: ControlConflictDisposition,
    },
    /// decision 使用的 guard ref 与实际 guard 不一致。
    ConflictGuardRefMismatch,
    /// decision target / kind / effect 与 intent 不一致。
    DecisionTargetOrKindMismatch,
    /// target 与已加载 context / identity / boundary / handle relation 不一致。
    ControlTargetLineageMismatch,
    /// duplicate / conflict decision 缺少 relevant control refs。
    RelatedControlRefsMissing,
    /// related control refs 存在重复或与 decision 不一致。
    RelatedControlRefsMismatch,
    /// status / reason / summary / effect 字段关系不合法。
    ControlStatusFieldRelationInvalid {
        /// 关系失败的 canonical control status。
        status: ControlFactStatus,
    },
    /// persisted disposition 与 guard decision / control status relation 不合法。
    ControlDispositionFieldRelationInvalid {
        /// 关系失败的 canonical control status。
        status: ControlFactStatus,
        /// 实际保存的 disposition。
        disposition: ControlConflictDisposition,
    },
    /// decision reason / evaluation time 未与 guard decision 一致。
    ControlDecisionSnapshotMismatch,
    /// control source context 缺少必须的 safe source reason。
    ControlSourceContextInvalid,
    /// control effect observation 指向另一 control、target 或 effect。
    ControlEffectObservationMismatch,
    /// control effect observation outcome kind 不满足目标 transition。
    ControlEffectOutcomeKindMismatch {
        /// 实际 finite outcome kind。
        actual: ControlEffectOutcomeKind,
    },
    /// completion summary source kind 不允许承接指定 control effect outcome。
    CompletionSummarySourceKindInvalid {
        /// observation 声明的 Sandbox-side effect。
        effect: ControlEffect,
        /// 实际收到的 safe summary external source kind。
        actual: ExternalSourceKind,
    },
    /// control effect observation 的 outcome / reason / summary relation 不合法。
    ControlEffectObservationFieldRelationInvalid,
    /// failed observation缺少safe reason，或声明的failure relation无法形成checked attachment basis。
    ControlFailureBasisMissing,
    /// control fact transition 不在 closed graph 中。
    ControlTransitionNotAllowed {
        /// 被拒绝 transition 的 control ref。
        control_ref: ControlFactRef,
        /// transition 前状态。
        from: ControlFactStatus,
        /// caller 请求的目标状态。
        to: ControlFactStatus,
    },
    /// control status change time 早于既有时间。
    ControlTimestampMovedBackwards,
    /// control ref / target owner与现有 fact发生 identity collision。
    ControlRefOrOwnerMismatch,
    /// failure classification 与 control target / context 不匹配。
    AttachedFailureLineageMismatch,
    /// failure classification 不允许附着到该 control status / effect。
    AttachedFailureNotAllowed,
    /// control已绑定另一matching failure ref，不能last-writer-wins替换。
    AttachedFailureRefConflict {
        /// control当前已保存的failure ref。
        existing: FailureClassificationRef,
        /// 本次尝试附着的failure ref。
        incoming: FailureClassificationRef,
    },
    /// requested run / context / handle 与 control fact不一致。
    RunTerminationBasisLineageMismatch,
    /// control 不是 terminal kind或尚未达到可终止状态。
    RunTerminationBasisUnavailable,
    /// termination basis 缺少 owner-safe reason。
    RunTerminationReasonMissing,
}
```

#### 12.3.3 `ControlTerminationBasis` consumer closure

`ControlFact::require_run_termination_basis` 只能在以下条件全部成立时返回 `Ok(ControlTerminationBasis)`：

1. `control_status` 为 `Accepted | Completed | Failed`，且 `disposition` 为 `Accept | TerminalOverride`，`control_kind` 属于 `TerminalControlKindSet::strict_default()`；`IgnoredDuplicate`、`Conflicted` 和 `Other` 一律拒绝。
2. `effect == TerminateRun`，并且 target 的 context、identity、run、boundary、handle、generation 与入参和已提交 lineage 完全相等。
3. `run_ref`、`context_ref`、`handle_ref` 三个入参均为 named refs；方法内部不从 `SandboxControlKind` 或 status 文本猜测缺失对象。
4. status 为 `Accepted` 时，允许 run flow把 control fact作为 staged terminal basis；status 为 `Completed | Failed` 时，允许 run flow消费已经有 effect outcome 的同一 fact。basis reason 固定取 transition `status_reason`，否则取持久化的 `decision_reason`；不得由 caller补 reason。外部 source 缺少 operator reason 不影响 basis，因为 guard decision reason是必须的 typed snapshot。
5. 返回值中的 `control_ref`、kind、effect、disposition、reason、status 和 audit ref 只能复制当前 fact；不得由 caller 传入或重算。

该方法是 `ControlledExecutionRun::terminate_by_control` 的唯一 control proof。run consumer 不得写成 `control.control_kind() == Kill`、`control.control_status() == Accepted` 或 `is_terminal: bool` 的组合判断。

#### 12.3.4 Control object self-review 与 downstream revalidation

| 审查项 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| control source / target / guard 是否闭合 | pass；`ControlIntent`、`ControlTargetLineage`、`ControlConflictDecision`、`ControlFact` 形成完整链 |
| control status 是否只有 shared owner | pass；复用 `ControlFactStatus`，没有 `VisibleControlStatus` |
| duplicate / conflict / terminal override 是否保留证据 | pass；`related_control_refs`、guard ref、guard-derived disposition、decision reason与evaluation time持久化在 fact |
| run termination 是否由 object proof 提供 | pass；`ControlTerminationBasis` 是唯一返回值 |
| runtime / tools / member lifecycle 是否越界 | pass；只记录 Sandbox-side control effect |
| negative cuts | pass；禁止 control kind比较、caller bool、opaque guard ref、raw reason、业务 replay和runtime recovery |

Step 7~10 必须反查：

| downstream | 必须承接 | 历史内容处置 |
|---|---|---|

## 13. Batch 3: Lease / Orphan / Reaper exact object contract

### 13.1 `ReaperEligibilityMarker` 与 backend lifecycle / orphan support

本节是 `S6T-04-014` 中 `ReaperEligibilityMarker` 的唯一业务使用契约。marker 的 Rust declaration 仍归既有 `crates/contracts/src/refs.rs`；本节定义其字段语义、构造入口和 domain 消费规则，不新增 `markers.rs`、domain wrapper 或第二个 marker kind。marker 是 copy-only maintenance input，不是 lease、handle 或 backend lifecycle truth，也不授予 release 权限。

#### 13.1.1 Capability、边界与 support family #31

| capability | typed input | canonical output | owner / 禁止边界 |
|---|---|---|---|
| reaper candidate selection | exact `LeaseRecordRef` + checked lease position + owner reason | `ReaperEligibilityMarker` | marker 只说明应检查；不能直接变更 lease / handle。 |
| backend lifecycle observation | exact handle / generation relation + body-free backend summary | `BackendLifecycleSummary` | 只保存 adapter 已映射的 source / summary / status；不拥有 backend truth。 |
| exact lease relation | handle、context、identity、boundary、generation 和 lease refs | `LeaseHandleRelation` | relation 由 domain owner 校验；caller 不传 bool。 |

support family #31 current只包含以下 embedded carriers：

1. `BackendLifecycleSummary`：adapter 已验证的 body-free lifecycle observation。
2. `LeaseHandleRelation`：lease 与 handle 的 exact context / identity / boundary / generation relation。

historical `OrphanRecoveryFailureReason`候选在batch 4失效：normal cleanup与orphan cleanup必须共享§14.2.2 `CleanupReleaseFailureObservation` / `CleanupReleaseFailureBasis`，不能对同一release attempt各自定义failure kind。以上current carriers没有独立 repository identity，不生成 `*Ref`、DTO、event subject 或 application 私有替代类型。若未来需要独立持久化 observation，必须先回到 `S6T-04-*` registry 登记，不能把字段追加到 marker 或借用 orphan record。

#### 13.1.2 `ReaperEligibilityMarker` exact contract

```rust
use core_contracts::metadata::{ResourceRef, Timestamp};

/// 标记一个已经由 Sandbox truth owner 判定需要 reaper 检查的 lease。
///
/// 该 marker 是 body-free、copy-only 的维护输入；它不表示 backend 已确认 orphan，
/// 不表示 cleanup guard 已允许 release，也不改变任何生命周期状态。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct ReaperEligibilityMarker {
    /// marker 所属的 exact lease record。
    lease_ref: LeaseRecordRef,
    /// marker 所属的 exact isolation environment handle。
    isolation_handle_ref: IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef,
    /// marker 与 handle / lease 共用的 execution generation。
    generation_ref: ResourceRef,
    /// 触发 reaper 选择的有限原因类别。
    trigger: ReaperEligibilityTrigger,
    /// owner 提供的非空、已脱敏安全原因。
    reason: SandboxReason,
    /// owner 形成 marker 时使用的 checked logical time。
    marked_at: Timestamp,
}

/// reaper eligibility marker 的有限触发类别。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum ReaperEligibilityTrigger {
    /// lease 已进入 expiring 区间，需要检查但尚未到期。
    LeaseExpiring,
    /// checked elapsed time 已达到 lease expiry。
    LeaseExpired,
    /// lease / handle / backend lifecycle 已出现需要检查的不一致。
    LifecycleConflict,
}

impl ReaperEligibilityMarker {
    /// 从已校验的 typed fields 创建 marker；lease / handle / generation 的业务关系
    /// 由 `LeaseRecord` transition 再次校验，不由 contracts carrier 猜测。
    pub fn try_new(
        lease_ref: LeaseRecordRef,
        isolation_handle_ref: IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef,
        generation_ref: ResourceRef,
        trigger: ReaperEligibilityTrigger,
        reason: SandboxReason,
        marked_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, ReaperEligibilityMarkerError>;

    /// 返回 marker 绑定的 exact lease ref。
    pub fn lease_ref(&self) -> &LeaseRecordRef;
    /// 返回 marker 绑定的 exact isolation handle ref。
    pub fn isolation_handle_ref(&self) -> &IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef;
    /// 返回 marker 绑定的 canonical generation。
    pub fn generation_ref(&self) -> &ResourceRef;
    /// 返回有限触发类别。
    pub fn trigger(&self) -> ReaperEligibilityTrigger;
    /// 返回 owner 提供的 caller-safe reason。
    pub fn reason(&self) -> &SandboxReason;
    /// 返回 marker 的 checked logical time。
    pub fn marked_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
}

/// reaper marker 的构造或 relation 校验失败。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum ReaperEligibilityMarkerError {
    /// generation ref 为空；实际 resource ref 不回显。
    GenerationRefEmpty,
    /// marker time 为空或不满足 canonical timestamp contract。
    MarkerTimeInvalid,
}
```

`ReaperEligibilityMarker::try_new` 只接受已经构造的 `SandboxReason`，因此不再声明一个不可触发的 `EmptyReason`；它也不解析 reason 文本来决定 trigger。`trigger` 不是状态：它不能被序列化为 `LeaseRecordStatus` 或 `OrphanRecoveryRecordStatus`，也不能单独驱动 release。marker 的 lease / handle / generation equality、trigger 与 checked position 的关系由 `LeaseRecord` transition 校验；marker 只可由该 owner 生成，job 只能 copy 和筛选已提交 marker。

#### 13.1.3 `BackendLifecycleSummary` exact support carrier

```rust
use core_contracts::metadata::{ResourceRef, Timestamp};

/// adapter 对 isolation backend lifecycle 的 body-free、有限观察摘要。
///
/// 该值只记录 Sandbox 能验证的外部关系；不保存 SDK response、host、container、
/// process、path、credential 或 backend 产品生命周期正文。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct BackendLifecycleSummary {
    /// 被观察的 backend environment opaque source ref。
    backend_handle_ref: ExternalSourceRef,
    /// body-free lifecycle observation summary ref。
    lifecycle_summary_ref: SafeSummaryRef,
    /// backend observation 所属的 canonical generation。
    generation_ref: ResourceRef,
    /// 有限 lifecycle 观察类别。
    observation_kind: BackendLifecycleObservationKind,
    /// 观察结果的非空安全原因；明确 released observation 可为空。
    reason: Option<SandboxReason>,
    /// adapter observation 的 canonical logical time。
    observed_at: Timestamp,
}

/// backend lifecycle summary 的有限观察类别。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum BackendLifecycleObservationKind {
    /// backend 明确观察到 environment 仍存在或仍可访问。
    Present,
    /// backend 明确确认 environment 已释放。
    Released,
    /// backend 当前不可用，不能证明已释放。
    Unavailable,
    /// backend observation 与 Sandbox handle / lease lineage 冲突。
    Conflicted,
}

impl BackendLifecycleSummary {
    /// 从 adapter 已映射的 source / summary / generation 构造 body-free observation。
    pub fn try_new(
        backend_handle_ref: ExternalSourceRef,
        lifecycle_summary_ref: SafeSummaryRef,
        generation_ref: ResourceRef,
        observation_kind: BackendLifecycleObservationKind,
        reason: Option<SandboxReason>,
        observed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, BackendLifecycleSummaryError>;

    /// 返回 backend environment source ref。
    pub fn backend_handle_ref(&self) -> &ExternalSourceRef;
    /// 返回 body-free lifecycle summary ref。
    pub fn lifecycle_summary_ref(&self) -> &SafeSummaryRef;
    /// 返回 canonical generation。
    pub fn generation_ref(&self) -> &ResourceRef;
    /// 返回有限 observation kind。
    pub fn observation_kind(&self) -> BackendLifecycleObservationKind;
    /// 返回可选 caller-safe reason。
    pub fn reason(&self) -> Option<&SandboxReason>;
    /// 返回 observation time。
    pub fn observed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
}

/// backend lifecycle summary 的 source、reason 或 relation 校验失败。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum BackendLifecycleSummaryError {
    /// backend handle ref 不是 `ExternalSourceKind::IsolationBackend`。
    BackendHandleSourceKindInvalid {
        /// 实际 source kind。
        actual: ExternalSourceKind,
    },
    /// lifecycle summary 不是 `ExternalSourceKind::IsolationBackend` summary。
    LifecycleSummarySourceKindInvalid {
        /// 实际 source kind。
        actual: ExternalSourceKind,
    },
    /// backend handle source version 与显式 generation 不一致。
    GenerationMismatch,
    /// `Released` observation 不允许携带 reason。
    ReleasedReasonMustBeAbsent,
    /// 非 `Released` observation 必须携带 reason。
    NonReleasedReasonMissing,
    /// observation time 不满足 canonical timestamp contract。
    InvalidObservedAt,
}
```

该 carrier 与 `6R-02` 的 `IsolationEnvironmentLifecycleObservation` 共享 external source、safe summary、generation 和 reason 语义，但不复制其 declaration。若 adapter 已返回 `IsolationEnvironmentLifecycleObservation`，必须由唯一 mapper 形成 `BackendLifecycleSummary`；不得在 `cleanup.rs` 保存 raw observation 或再定义同名字段集合。

#### 13.1.4 `LeaseHandleRelation` exact support carrier

```rust
use core_contracts::metadata::ResourceRef;

/// 保存 lease 与 isolation handle 之间可机械复核的完整 Sandbox lineage。
///
/// 该 carrier 是 transient / embedded value；它不拥有 lease 或 handle lifecycle。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct LeaseHandleRelation {
    /// exact lease identity。
    lease_ref: LeaseRecordRef,
    /// exact isolation handle identity。
    isolation_handle_ref: IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef,
    /// accepted execution context identity。
    context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
    /// active execution environment identity。
    environment_identity_ref: ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef,
    /// coherent boundary identity。
    boundary_ref: CoherentBoundaryRef,
    /// canonical execution generation。
    generation_ref: ResourceRef,
}

impl LeaseHandleRelation {
    /// 从已加载的 handle、context、identity、boundary 和 lease ref 构造完整 relation。
    pub fn try_new(
        lease_ref: LeaseRecordRef,
        handle: &IsolationEnvironmentHandle,
        context: &ControlledExecutionContext,
        identity: &ExecutionEnvironmentIdentity,
        boundary: &CoherentBoundary,
    ) -> Result<Self, LeaseHandleRelationError>;

    /// 返回 exact lease ref。
    pub fn lease_ref(&self) -> &LeaseRecordRef;
    /// 返回 exact handle ref。
    pub fn isolation_handle_ref(&self) -> &IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef;
    /// 返回 context ref。
    pub fn context_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionContextRef;
    /// 返回 environment identity ref。
    pub fn environment_identity_ref(&self) -> &ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef;
    /// 返回 boundary ref。
    pub fn boundary_ref(&self) -> &CoherentBoundaryRef;
    /// 返回 generation ref。
    pub fn generation_ref(&self) -> &ResourceRef;
}

/// lease / handle relation 构造失败。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum LeaseHandleRelationError {
    /// handle 的预绑定 lease ref 与输入 lease ref 不一致。
    LeaseRefMismatch,
    /// context 与 handle 不属于同一 accepted lineage。
    ContextMismatch,
    /// identity 与 context / handle 不属于同一 active lineage。
    IdentityMismatch,
    /// boundary 与 handle 不属于同一 established relation。
    BoundaryMismatch,
    /// generation 在 handle、boundary 或 owner 中不一致。
    GenerationMismatch,
    /// handle status 不允许作为 lease relation source。
    HandleStatusNotEligible,
}
```

relation 的 equality 只比较 typed refs；status eligibility 由 relation factory / owning transition 单独校验，不比较 source reason、summary digest、timestamp 或 ref 的字符串表示。`LeaseRecord::supports_orphan_suspicion_for` 因其既定签名只接收 handle ref，只能完成 exact handle-ref、marker 和自身 lease status 的纯判断；`IsolationEnvironmentHandle::suspect_orphan` 仍必须消费完整 `LeaseHandleRelation`、`BackendLifecycleSummary` 和 lease owner proof，不能把该 bool 当作完整 lineage proof。

#### 13.1.5 support family #31 relation matrix

| relation | required rule | owner | invalid action |
|---|---|---|---|
| lease -> handle | `lease_ref` 等于 `handle.lease_ref()` 且 `isolation_handle_ref` 相等 | `LeaseHandleRelation` / `LeaseRecord` | typed reject；不得从 handle ref 文本恢复 lease。 |
| context / identity | context 为 `Accepted`，identity 为 `Active`，且两者与 handle / boundary 同 lineage | relation factory | 不只比较 context ref，不接受 actor / runtime ref 替代。 |
| boundary | boundary 为 `Established`，并与 handle 的 requirement / capability / generation 关系一致 | relation factory | 不从 requirement 或 policy ref 推导 boundary。 |
| generation | lease、handle、boundary、backend summary 的 generation 完全相等 | owner factory / transition | 不接受 current config generation、summary digest 或 latest scan。 |
| checked time | domain 只消费 clock 已计算的 `checked_age_millis` | `LeaseWindow` / `LeaseRecord` | 不解析 timestamp 字符串，不接受 caller freshness bool。 |
| marker source | marker 必须来自 lease 的 expiring / expired / conflict transition；orphan proof 只允许 `LeaseExpired` 或 `LifecycleConflict` marker | `LeaseRecord` | job 不扫描 backend body，不自行生成业务理由。 |
| external body | backend handle / summary 只能是 external ref、safe summary、finite kind、safe reason | adapter mapper / carrier | raw SDK、host、path、credential、process body进入 domain 时 fail closed。 |

`BackendLifecycleObservationKind::Released` 只说明外部 observation；它不能单独迁移 lease、handle 或 orphan。对应 owner transition 仍须验证 exact backend source、generation、当前状态和 batch 4 提供的 cleanup permission。

### 13.2 `LeaseRecord`

#### 13.2.1 Capability 与字段来源

`LeaseRecord` 是 Sandbox 对一条 isolation lease window 的 lifecycle truth owner。它记录 Sandbox 生成的租约边界、exact handle relation、reaper eligibility 和已校验状态；它不代表 backend lifecycle truth，不拥有续租策略，不执行 release，不调用 clock / repository / adapter，也不保存外部正文。

```rust
use core_contracts::metadata::{ResourceRef, Timestamp};
use std::num::NonZeroU64;

/// 记录一个 isolation environment 的 Sandbox-owned lease lifecycle truth。
///
/// 对象维护 lease window、handle / context / generation 关系和 reaper marker；
/// 它不维护 backend lifecycle，也不能绕过 cleanup guard 释放环境。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct LeaseRecord {
    /// lease record 的 Sandbox-local typed identity。
    lease_ref: LeaseRecordRef,
    /// lease 唯一绑定的 isolation environment handle。
    isolation_handle_ref: IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef,
    /// lease 所属的 accepted controlled execution context。
    context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
    /// lease 所属的 active execution environment identity。
    environment_identity_ref: ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef,
    /// lease 绑定的 coherent boundary。
    boundary_ref: CoherentBoundaryRef,
    /// lease 与 handle / boundary 共用的 canonical generation。
    generation_ref: ResourceRef,
    /// immutable lease window；具体 expiry 由 checked elapsed 判定。
    lease_window: LeaseWindow,
    /// lease 的 canonical lifecycle status。
    lease_status: LeaseRecordStatus,
    /// reaper selection marker；未进入选择条件时为空。
    reaper_marker: Option<ReaperEligibilityMarker>,
    /// lease record 首次创建时间。
    created_at: Timestamp,
    /// 当前 lease status 生效时间，必须单调不回退。
    status_changed_at: Timestamp,
    /// 最近一次 lease transition 的 audit trace ref。
    last_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
}

impl LeaseRecord {
    /// 从 exact active handle、完整 lineage 和已验证 lease window 创建 `Active` record。
    pub fn open(
        lease_ref: LeaseRecordRef,
        handle: &IsolationEnvironmentHandle,
        context: &ControlledExecutionContext,
        identity: &ExecutionEnvironmentIdentity,
        boundary: &CoherentBoundary,
        lease_window: LeaseWindow,
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        opened_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, LeaseRecordError>;

    /// 返回当前 checked elapsed time 对应的 immutable lease window position。
    pub fn position_at_elapsed(
        &self,
        checked_age_millis: u64,
    ) -> LeaseWindowPosition;

    /// 消费 `RenewalClosed` position，将 `Active` lease 标记为 `Expiring`。
    pub fn mark_expiring(
        &mut self,
        checked_age_millis: u64,
        reaper_marker: ReaperEligibilityMarker,
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        expiring_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), LeaseRecordError>;

    /// 消费 `Expired` position；expiry equality 也必须将 lease 标记为 `Expired`。
    pub fn mark_expired(
        &mut self,
        checked_age_millis: u64,
        reaper_marker: ReaperEligibilityMarker,
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        expired_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), LeaseRecordError>;

    /// 在 exact non-released lifecycle observation 下将 `Expired` lease 标记为
    /// `OrphanSuspected`；该状态只表示需要保守恢复，不表示 orphan 已确认。
    pub fn mark_orphan_suspected(
        &mut self,
        handle: &IsolationEnvironmentHandle,
        lifecycle_summary: &BackendLifecycleSummary,
        reaper_marker: ReaperEligibilityMarker,
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        suspected_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), LeaseRecordError>;

    /// 消费matching cleanup completion basis，将现有lease row原子收束为`Released`。
    pub fn mark_released(
        &mut self,
        completion_basis: &CleanupCompletionBasis,
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        released_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), LeaseRecordError>;

    /// 校验当前 record 是 exact handle 的 active、未过期 lease，并返回剩余正窗口。
    pub fn require_active_for_handle(
        &self,
        handle: &IsolationEnvironmentHandle,
        checked_age_millis: u64,
    ) -> Result<NonZeroU64, LeaseRecordError>;

    /// 判断该 lease 是否可以为指定 handle 建立 orphan suspicion；关系不匹配时返回 false。
    pub fn supports_orphan_suspicion_for(
        &self,
        handle_ref: &IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef,
    ) -> bool;

    /// 返回 lease record identity。
    pub fn lease_ref(&self) -> &LeaseRecordRef;
    /// 返回 exact isolation handle ref。
    pub fn isolation_handle_ref(&self) -> &IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef;
    /// 返回 owning context ref。
    pub fn context_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionContextRef;
    /// 返回 owning environment identity ref。
    pub fn environment_identity_ref(&self) -> &ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef;
    /// 返回 owning boundary ref。
    pub fn boundary_ref(&self) -> &CoherentBoundaryRef;
    /// 返回 canonical generation ref。
    pub fn generation_ref(&self) -> &ResourceRef;
    /// 返回 immutable lease window。
    pub fn lease_window(&self) -> &LeaseWindow;
    /// 返回 canonical lease status。
    pub fn lease_status(&self) -> LeaseRecordStatus;
    /// 返回 optional reaper eligibility marker。
    pub fn reaper_marker(&self) -> Option<&ReaperEligibilityMarker>;
    /// 返回 lease creation time。
    pub fn created_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
    /// 返回 status change time。
    pub fn status_changed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
    /// 返回 latest lease transition audit ref。
    pub fn last_audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;
}
```

#### 13.2.2 `LeaseRecord` 字段矩阵与 factory 规则

| 字段 | exact source | 必填 / 可选 | invariant / 禁止替代 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `lease_ref` | `SandboxIdGeneratorPort::next_lease_ref()` 的 named ref | 必填 | 不从 handle ref、时间或 storage row id 拼接。 |
| `isolation_handle_ref` | `handle.isolation_handle_ref()` | 必填 | 必须与 `handle.lease_ref() == lease_ref` 一致。 |
| `context_ref` / `environment_identity_ref` | handle + 显式 loaded owners | 必填 | context 必须 `Accepted`，identity 必须 `Active` 且同 lineage。 |
| `boundary_ref` | handle / boundary exact relation | 必填 | boundary 必须 `Established`；不从 requirement 或 policy ref 推导。 |
| `generation_ref` | handle、boundary、requirement 的同代 relation | 必填 | 不接受 current config generation、backend profile 字符串或 summary digest。 |
| `lease_window` | `handle.lease_window()` 的 immutable copy | 必填 | `open` 的显式输入必须与 handle window 完全相等；两份值是同一原子建立结果的镜像，不得独立修改、重算或从 current config 替换。 |
| `lease_status` | `open` factory 固定为 `Active` | 必填 | 不允许 factory 直接创建 `Expiring` / `Expired` / `OrphanSuspected`。 |
| `reaper_marker` | `mark_expiring` / `mark_expired` / orphan transition | 可选 | marker 的 lease / handle / generation 必须 exact match；不由 job 预填。 |
| `created_at` / `status_changed_at` | application clock | 必填 | status time 不得早于 created / 当前 status time。 |
| `last_audit_trace_ref` | owning transition 的 audit append | 必填 | 不由 backend timestamp 或 query 生成。 |

`LeaseRecord::open` 只创建 `Active`，且必须消费已 `Active` 的 handle；它必须先验证显式 `lease_window == handle.lease_window()`，再复制该 immutable window。两份 window 不是两个可修改真相。`open` 不得把 `LeaseWindowPosition` 直接写成 status。`position_at_elapsed` 只读取 immutable window：`Renewable` 表示尚未进入 reaper cutoff，`RenewalClosed` 表示应进入 `Expiring`，`Expired` 表示 elapsed 已达到或超过 duration。`checked_age_millis == duration_millis` 必须按 `Expired` 处理，不能留在 `Expiring`。

`mark_expiring` 只能从 `Active` 消费 `RenewalClosed`；marker trigger 必须是 `LeaseExpiring`。`mark_expired` 只能从 `Active | Expiring` 消费 `Expired`；marker trigger 必须是 `LeaseExpired`。两个 transition 都必须校验 marker 的 lease / handle / generation 与 record 完全相等，并以 `expiring_at` / `expired_at` 更新 `status_changed_at` 与 audit ref。

`mark_orphan_suspected` 只允许从 `Expired` 消费 `LifecycleConflict` marker，并要求 backend summary 为 `Present | Unavailable | Conflicted` 且与 handle / generation / backend source exact match；它不能消费 `LeaseExpiring` 或 `LeaseExpired` marker，也不能把 `Released` observation 解释为 orphan suspicion。lease status 进入 `OrphanSuspected` 后，后续 recovery record 必须沿用该 `LifecycleConflict` marker lineage。

#### 13.2.3 `LeaseRecord` status / transition matrix

```text
[LeaseRecord]
factory -> Active
Active --mark_expiring(RenewalClosed)----> Expiring
Active --mark_expired(Expired)------------> Expired
Expiring --mark_expired(Expired)----------> Expired
Expired --mark_orphan_suspected(conflict)-> OrphanSuspected
Active | Expiring | Expired | OrphanSuspected
  --mark_released(exact completion basis)-> Released
```

| status | marker | 当前允许动作 | 终态 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Active` | `None` | run preflight、position evaluation、进入 expiring / expired | 否 |
| `Expiring` | `Some(LeaseExpiring)` | 不可新建 launch；expiry evaluation、lifecycle inspect | 否 |
| `Expired` | `Some(LeaseExpired)` | 不可新建 launch；orphan inspect、等待 guarded release | 否 |
| `OrphanSuspected` | `Some(LifecycleConflict)` | 不可新建 launch；创建 / 更新 orphan recovery、等待 guarded release | 否 |
| `Released` | 保留最后 marker | 只读 / audit；不得重新激活 | 是；只由exact completion basis进入 |

batch 3最初开放 `Active -> Expiring`、`Active -> Expired`、`Expiring -> Expired` 和 `Expired -> OrphanSuspected` 四条 lease-side transition；batch 4在同一canonical object上激活到`Released`的唯一transition。前三条由checked lease position驱动，orphan suspicion必须同时有`LifecycleConflict` marker与non-released backend lifecycle summary；release必须消费§14.2.2的exact `CleanupCompletionBasis`。任何query、job report、marker文本、guard ref或caller bool都不能直接写status。

禁止迁移：`Released -> *`；`Active -> OrphanSuspected` 若没有 exact lifecycle summary；`Active/Expiring -> Expired` 若 checked position 未到期；`OrphanSuspected -> Active`。`Expiring` 不是 backend warning，也不是 release permission；`Released` 不证明 orphan record 已 `Recovered`。

#### 13.2.4 `LeaseRecord` exact error contract

```rust
/// lease record 的 relation、时间、状态或 marker 不变量失败。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum LeaseRecordError {
    /// lease ref 与 handle 的预绑定 lease ref 不一致。
    LeaseHandleRelationMismatch,
    /// context / identity / boundary 与 handle lineage 不一致。
    LineageMismatch,
    /// boundary 未处于 `Established`，不能创建 active lease。
    BoundaryWasNotEstablished {
        /// 实际 boundary status。
        actual: CoherentBoundaryStatus,
    },
    /// handle 未处于允许的 lease relation status。
    HandleStatusNotEligible {
        /// 实际 handle status。
        actual: IsolationEnvironmentHandleStatus,
    },
    /// lease window 自身或其 lifecycle requirement relation 无效。
    LeaseWindowInvalid {
        /// 保留 window owner 的 exact error。
        source: LeaseWindowError,
    },
    /// 显式输入的 lease window 与 handle 原子保存的 window 不一致。
    LeaseWindowMismatch,
    /// marker 未绑定当前 lease / handle。
    MarkerLeaseRelationMismatch,
    /// marker generation 与 record generation 不一致。
    MarkerGenerationMismatch,
    /// marker trigger 与 checked lease position 不一致。
    MarkerTriggerMismatch,
    /// checked age 已达到或超过 lease expiry。
    LeaseExpired {
        /// lease identity。
        lease_ref: LeaseRecordRef,
        /// 本次 clock 检查的 elapsed milliseconds。
        checked_age_millis: u64,
        /// lease window duration milliseconds。
        duration_millis: NonZeroU64,
    },
    /// 当前状态不允许 requested transition。
    TransitionNotAllowed {
        /// lease identity。
        lease_ref: LeaseRecordRef,
        /// transition 前状态。
        from: LeaseRecordStatus,
        /// 请求的目标状态。
        to: LeaseRecordStatus,
    },
    /// status change time 早于当前 status time 或 creation time。
    StatusTimestampMovedBackwards,
    /// lease 不是 exact active、未过期 handle lease。
    LeaseWasNotActiveForHandle,
    /// orphan suspicion 所需的 backend lifecycle relation 未满足。
    OrphanSuspicionEvidenceMissing,
    /// lifecycle summary 与 handle / generation / backend source 不匹配。
    LifecycleSummaryMismatch,
    /// cleanup completion basis未声明或未绑定当前persisted lease row。
    CleanupCompletionBasisLeaseMismatch,
    /// cleanup completion basis未证明matching release confirmation。
    CleanupCompletionBasisNotConfirmed,
}
```

`position_at_elapsed` 不返回错误：`u64` 已经是非负的 checked elapsed 输入，所有数值都映射到 `Renewable`、`RenewalClosed` 或 `Expired`；expiry 不能被当作普通 validation failure。`require_active_for_handle` 的成功返回是 `NonZeroU64`：`duration_millis - checked_age_millis`，严格大于零。该方法必须依次验证 lease status 为 `Active`、`handle.handle_status() == Active`、lease / handle / context / identity / boundary / generation / lease ref 全相等，再调用 `LeaseWindow::position_at_elapsed`；`RenewalClosed` 返回 `LeaseWasNotActiveForHandle`，`Expired` 或 `checked_age_millis >= duration` 返回 `LeaseExpired`，关系不匹配返回对应 typed relation error。它不修改 `LeaseRecord`，不续租，不刷新，不调用 backend，不扫描 latest lease。

`supports_orphan_suspicion_for` 是唯一供 `IsolationEnvironmentHandle::suspect_orphan` 使用的 forward method。它只能依据 self 的 exact `lease_ref` / `isolation_handle_ref` relation、status (`Expired | OrphanSuspected`) 和匹配的 reaper marker 返回纯 `bool`：`Expired` 必须带 `LeaseExpired` marker，`OrphanSuspected` 必须带 `LifecycleConflict` marker。普通 `Expiring` 不构成 orphan proof。它不接受 caller status、checked time 或外部 `orphan: bool`。关系不匹配、`Active | Expiring`、`Released` 或缺少对应 marker 均返回 `false`。完整 backend summary、generation 和 safe reason 仍由 `mark_orphan_suspected` 再次校验，不能由该 bool 代替。

#### 13.2.5 `LeaseRecord` forward dependency closure

| forward method | exact consumer | success output | relation check | consumer 禁止行为 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `supports_orphan_suspicion_for(&IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef) -> bool` | `IsolationEnvironmentHandle::suspect_orphan` | owner-computed pure eligibility | exact handle ref、lease status、reaper evidence | 不比较 status 文本、不传 caller bool、不从 marker reason 推导。 |
| `require_active_for_handle(&IsolationEnvironmentHandle, u64) -> Result<NonZeroU64, LeaseRecordError>` | `ControlledExecutionRun::prepare` / `authorize_launch` | checked remaining positive lease window | active status + exact handle / context / identity / boundary / generation / lease relation | 不传 `lease_active: bool`、不重算 current config / window、不从 repository latest 读取。 |

#### 13.2.6 Batch 4 release surface activation

batch 4已在本节canonical `impl LeaseRecord`和`LeaseRecordError`中激活`mark_released`。它只允许from status为`Active | Expiring | Expired | OrphanSuspected`，并要求completion basis声明`lease_record_present = true`，且lease、handle、context、identity、boundary、generation全部匹配；basis的matching backend confirmation已经由`CleanupGuard`验证，lease不再读取adapter。成功后写`lease_status = Released`、保留最后reaper marker、更新time / audit。`Released`重复请求由application按stored result幂等replay；domain transition本身返回`TransitionNotAllowed`，禁止复活或覆盖历史audit。

实现者不得自行用`CleanupGuardRef`、`CleanupGuardStatus::Allowed`、adapter success bool、job disposition或marker存在性替代`CleanupCompletionBasis`。本段激活不改变batch 3历史审查事实；§13A继续作为当时reserved状态的historical snapshot，current implementation contract以本节和§14.2为准。

#### 13.2.7 Lease object self-review

| 审查项 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| unique owner / planned path | pass；唯一 owner 为 `crates/domain/src/cleanup.rs`，未新增文件。 |
| field-source closure | pass；12 个字段均有 exact source、requiredness 和禁止替代。 |
| status owner | pass；只复用 shared `LeaseRecordStatus`，不使用历史 `LeaseStatus`。 |
| time closure | pass；只消费 `checked_age_millis`，expiry equality 明确。 |
| handle / generation relation | pass；handle 预绑定 lease ref 与 generation 全部参与校验。 |
| forward methods | pass；#1 与 #5 exact signature / consumer / negative cut 已闭合。 |
| release boundary | reserved；batch 4 提供 checked release basis，当前不调用。 |
| backend / body boundary | pass；不拥有 backend truth，不保存 raw adapter material。 |

`LeaseRecord` 现在可供 §13.3 `OrphanRecoveryRecord` 消费；本批仍不得提前写 cleanup guard、redline、reaper job flow 或 Step 7 port。

### 13.3 `OrphanRecoveryRecord`

#### 13.3.1 Capability、source boundary 与完整 lineage

`OrphanRecoveryRecord` 记录 Sandbox 对一个疑似孤儿 isolation environment 的发现、确认和保守收束。它不是 backend lifecycle history，也不是 runtime / member recovery record；它只保存 Sandbox-owned recovery truth、body-free backend observation、cleanup relation 和 failure-safe reason。

为满足 `FailureSourceMarker::from_orphan` 的反向关系要求，record 必须保存完整的 execution lineage。可选 `run_ref` 不能从 handle、boundary 或 lease ref 字符串推导；存在时必须由显式 loaded `ControlledExecutionRun` 验证 context、identity、boundary、handle、generation 全相等。

```rust
use core_contracts::metadata::{ResourceRef, Timestamp};

/// 保存一个 isolation environment orphan incident 的 Sandbox-owned recovery truth。
///
/// 对象维护完整 execution lineage、reaper marker、body-free lifecycle observation、
/// recovery status 和安全原因；它不重写 backend、runtime、member 或 artifact truth。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct OrphanRecoveryRecord {
    /// orphan recovery record 的 Sandbox-local typed identity。
    orphan_record_ref: OrphanRecoveryRecordRef,
    /// exact lease source identity。
    lease_ref: LeaseRecordRef,
    /// exact isolation environment handle identity。
    isolation_handle_ref: IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef,
    /// accepted execution context identity。
    context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
    /// active execution environment identity。
    environment_identity_ref: ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef,
    /// optional exact controlled run；无 run 表示 boundary-only orphan relation。
    run_ref: Option<ControlledExecutionRunRef>,
    /// exact coherent boundary identity。
    boundary_ref: CoherentBoundaryRef,
    /// lease / handle / boundary 共用的 canonical generation。
    generation_ref: ResourceRef,
    /// 触发本次 recovery record 的 immutable reaper marker。
    reaper_marker: ReaperEligibilityMarker,
    /// 最近一次 body-free backend lifecycle observation。
    backend_lifecycle_summary: BackendLifecycleSummary,
    /// orphan recovery 的 canonical status。
    orphan_status: OrphanRecoveryRecordStatus,
    /// 当前 status 的非空、caller-safe reason。
    status_reason: SandboxReason,
    /// backend observation 已足以确认 orphan 的时间；未确认时为空。
    confirmed_at: Option<Timestamp>,
    /// `Recovering | Recovered | Failed` 保存的 exact cleanup release authorization；其它状态为空。
    recovery_release_basis: Option<CleanupReleaseBasis>,
    /// `Failed`终态保存的exact cleanup release failure proof；其它状态为空。
    recovery_failure_basis: Option<CleanupReleaseFailureBasis>,
    /// record 创建时间。
    created_at: Timestamp,
    /// 当前 status 生效时间，必须单调不回退。
    status_changed_at: Timestamp,
    /// 最近一次 recovery transition 的 audit trace ref。
    last_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
}

impl OrphanRecoveryRecord {
    /// 从 expired / orphan-suspected lease、matching handle lineage、reaper marker
    /// 和非 released lifecycle observation 创建 `Suspected` record。
    pub fn suspect(
        orphan_record_ref: OrphanRecoveryRecordRef,
        lease: &LeaseRecord,
        handle: &IsolationEnvironmentHandle,
        context: &ControlledExecutionContext,
        identity: &ExecutionEnvironmentIdentity,
        boundary: &CoherentBoundary,
        run: Option<&ControlledExecutionRun>,
        reaper_marker: ReaperEligibilityMarker,
        backend_lifecycle_summary: BackendLifecycleSummary,
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        suspected_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, OrphanRecoveryRecordError>;

    /// 消费足以确认 orphan 的 body-free lifecycle observation，进入 `Confirmed`。
    pub fn confirm(
        &mut self,
        backend_lifecycle_summary: BackendLifecycleSummary,
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        confirmed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), OrphanRecoveryRecordError>;

    /// 消费matching persisted release authorization进入`Recovering`。
    pub fn mark_recovering(
        &mut self,
        release_basis: &CleanupReleaseBasis,
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        changed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), OrphanRecoveryRecordError>;

    /// 消费matching release confirmation completion basis进入`Recovered`。
    pub fn mark_recovered(
        &mut self,
        completion_basis: &CleanupCompletionBasis,
        lifecycle_summary: BackendLifecycleSummary,
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        recovered_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), OrphanRecoveryRecordError>;

    /// 将正在执行的 recovery attempt 定格为`Failed`，并重验同一release authorization。
    pub fn mark_failed(
        &mut self,
        failure_basis: &CleanupReleaseFailureBasis,
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        failed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), OrphanRecoveryRecordError>;

    /// 判断当前 record 是否满足稳定 orphan failure marker 的 source contract。
    pub fn can_classify_as_failure_source(&self) -> bool;

    /// 返回 orphan record identity。
    pub fn orphan_record_ref(&self) -> &OrphanRecoveryRecordRef;
    /// 返回 exact lease ref。
    pub fn lease_ref(&self) -> &LeaseRecordRef;
    /// 返回 exact isolation handle ref。
    pub fn isolation_handle_ref(&self) -> &IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef;
    /// 返回 owning context ref。
    pub fn context_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionContextRef;
    /// 返回 owning environment identity ref。
    pub fn environment_identity_ref(&self) -> &ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef;
    /// 返回 optional exact controlled run ref。
    pub fn run_ref(&self) -> Option<&ControlledExecutionRunRef>;
    /// 返回 exact coherent boundary ref。
    pub fn boundary_ref(&self) -> &CoherentBoundaryRef;
    /// 返回 canonical generation ref。
    pub fn generation_ref(&self) -> &ResourceRef;
    /// 返回 immutable reaper eligibility marker。
    pub fn reaper_marker(&self) -> &ReaperEligibilityMarker;
    /// 返回最近一次 backend lifecycle summary。
    pub fn backend_lifecycle_summary(&self) -> &BackendLifecycleSummary;
    /// 返回 canonical orphan recovery status。
    pub fn orphan_status(&self) -> OrphanRecoveryRecordStatus;
    /// 返回当前 status 的 safe reason。
    pub fn status_reason(&self) -> &SandboxReason;
    /// 返回 orphan 被 body-free observation 确认的时间。
    pub fn confirmed_at(&self) -> Option<&Timestamp>;
    /// 返回 optional exact recovery release authorization。
    pub fn recovery_release_basis(&self) -> Option<&CleanupReleaseBasis>;
    /// 返回 optional exact cleanup release failure proof。
    pub fn recovery_failure_basis(&self) -> Option<&CleanupReleaseFailureBasis>;
    /// 返回 record creation time。
    pub fn created_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
    /// 返回 status change time。
    pub fn status_changed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
    /// 返回 latest transition audit ref。
    pub fn last_audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;
}
```

#### 13.3.2 Recovery failure support handoff

orphan recovery不再拥有第二套adapter failure schema。`Recovering -> Failed`唯一消费§14.2.2的`CleanupReleaseFailureBasis`，并从其中读取exact authorization、finite failure observation、safe reason、source time与audit identity。historical `OrphanRecoveryFailureReason` / `OrphanRecoveryFailureKind`候选在current schema中失效；否则normal cleanup与orphan cleanup会各自解释同一次release failure。

本节只固定orphan-side cardinality：failure basis必须显式携带`orphan_record_ref == self.orphan_record_ref`，其release basis必须等于`recovery_release_basis`，且cleanup guard已经原子进入`Blocked`。retryable、dependency unavailable、transport timeout、unknown或commit unknown均没有failure basis，orphan保持`Recovering`并沿同一authorization恢复。

#### 13.3.3 Factory field-source closure

| 字段 | exact source | 必填 / 可选 | invariant / 禁止替代 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `orphan_record_ref` | `SandboxIdGeneratorPort::next_orphan_recovery_ref()` | 必填 | 不从 lease ref / handle ref 拼接。 |
| lease / handle refs | `LeaseRecord` + `IsolationEnvironmentHandle` exact getters | 必填 | lease ref、handle ref 和 handle 预绑定 lease ref 必须相等。 |
| context / identity / boundary / generation | loaded owner group + `LeaseHandleRelation` | 必填 | accepted context、active identity、established boundary；全 lineage 相等。 |
| `run_ref` | optional loaded `ControlledExecutionRun` | 可选 | 有值时必须验证 run 与上述五类 refs、generation 全相等；不能从 handle 或 status 推导。 |
| `reaper_marker` | committed `LeaseRecord` marker | 必填 | marker lease / handle / generation 与 record 相等；不能由 job 新建。 |
| `backend_lifecycle_summary` | `BackendLifecycleInspectionPort` typed outcome | 必填 | source kind / summary kind / generation 与 handle 相符；`Released` 不得创建 active orphan record。 |
| `orphan_status` | `suspect` factory固定 `Suspected`；其余状态只由本对象exact transition写入 | 必填 | 不允许 factory 直接创建 `Confirmed` / `Recovering` / `Recovered` / `Failed`；`Recovering | Recovered | Failed` 的唯一callable与basis relation见§13.3.1、§14.2.6。 |
| `status_reason` | reaper marker / lifecycle summary 的 safe reason | 必填 | 非空；不从 status label 或 audit 文本拼接。 |
| `confirmed_at` | `confirm` 的 application timestamp | 可选 | 只有 `Confirmed`、以及后续已确认基础上的 batch 4 状态才有值；`Suspected` 必须为 `None`。 |
| `recovery_release_basis` | §14.2.6 `mark_recovering` 消费的 exact `CleanupReleaseBasis` | 可选 | `Recovering | Recovered` 必须为`Some`；由`Recovering -> Failed`形成的`Failed`也必须保留`Some`，其余状态为`None`。basis的orphan ref与backend target必须显式等于本attempt，不能只比较execution lineage。 |
| `recovery_failure_basis` | §14.2.2 guard-owned `CleanupReleaseFailureBasis` | 可选 | 只有`Failed`时为`Some`；其它状态为`None`。basis必须显式绑定本orphan attempt与persisted release authorization，且cleanup guard已进入`Blocked`。 |
| times / audit | application clock + append-only audit owner | 必填 | status time 单调且不早于 created time。 |

`suspect` 的 active input closure：lease status 必须为 `Expired | OrphanSuspected`，handle status 只允许 `Active | OrphanSuspected`。`Created` partial handle、`ReleasePending` handle 与当前 `LeaseRecord::open` 的 active lease contract 不相容，必须留在 batch 4 cleanup path，不能在本 record 中伪造 active lease lineage。backend summary 只允许 `Present | Unavailable | Conflicted`；`Released` 必须走 batch 4 的 release / no-orphan closure，不得创建本 record。

#### 13.3.4 `OrphanRecoveryRecord` status / transition matrix

```text
[OrphanRecoveryRecord]
factory -> Suspected
Suspected --confirm(Present | Conflicted)----------> Confirmed
Confirmed --mark_recovering(exact release basis)---> Recovering
Recovering --mark_recovered(exact completion basis)-> Recovered
Recovering --mark_failed(exact release-failure basis)--------------> Failed
```

| status | backend summary | `confirmed_at` | recovery release basis | recovery failure basis | status reason | failure marker eligibility | 终态 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Suspected` | `Present | Unavailable | Conflicted` | `None` | `None` | `None` | lifecycle summary reason；不得用 marker trigger label | 否；不直接形成 stable failure marker | 否 |
| `Confirmed` | `Present | Conflicted` | `Some` | `None` | `None` | confirmation summary reason | 是；可形成 `SandboxFailureKind::Orphan` | 否 |
| `Recovering` | 保留confirmed non-released summary | `Some` | `Some(exact CleanupReleaseBasis)` | `None` | release authorization reason | 是；active orphan仍可形成稳定failure source | 否 |
| `Recovered` | matching `Released` summary | `Some` | `Some(same CleanupReleaseBasis)` | `None` | completion reason | 否；不得新建 active blocking marker | 是 |
| `Failed` | 最后一次non-released summary | `Some` | `Some(same CleanupReleaseBasis)` | `Some(exact CleanupReleaseFailureBasis)` | failure observation 的 safe reason | 是；必须同时满足confirmation、release和failure basis relation | 是 |

current active transition由本节与§14.2.6共同闭合。`Suspected` 收到 `Unavailable` observation 时保持 `Suspected`，不能把“不确定”升级为 `Confirmed`；收到 `Released` observation 时不能直接修改为 `Recovered`，必须走 guarded completion closure。`Confirmed -> Recovering`与`Recovering -> Recovered`必须消费§14.2.6 exact basis；`Recovering -> Failed`只接受明确、已归属同一authorization attempt的terminal failure，不把transport timeout、commit unknown或尚可沿同一idempotent operation恢复的unknown outcome写成`Failed`。

`suspect`、`confirm`保持`recovery_release_basis = None`且`recovery_failure_basis = None`。`confirm`成功时必须同时写入`confirmed_at`、更新`status_changed_at`和audit ref。`mark_failed`只允许current status为`Recovering`，要求`failure_basis.release_basis()`与persisted `recovery_release_basis`完全相等，并显式绑定本`orphan_record_ref`和同一backend target；failure observation的backend target / generation必须同时等于persisted authorization，且`failed_at >= failure_basis.failed_at >= failure_observation.observed_at >= release_basis.authorized_at`并不得早于current status time；`Suspected | Confirmed | Recovered | Failed`一律拒绝。成功时保留`confirmed_at`和exact `recovery_release_basis`供audit / reconciliation，保存exact `recovery_failure_basis`并以其safe reason更新status / time / audit。`can_classify_as_failure_source()`在`Confirmed | Recovering`且`confirmed_at.is_some()`时返回true；`Failed`仅在`confirmed_at.is_some()`且保留完整lineage、non-released summary、非空`status_reason`、matching release basis和matching failure basis时返回true。`Suspected`和`Recovered`返回false。

#### 13.3.5 `OrphanRecoveryRecord` exact error contract

```rust
/// orphan recovery record 的 lineage、observation、状态或安全原因不变量失败。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum OrphanRecoveryRecordError {
    /// lease status 不在 orphan record factory 允许范围。
    LeaseStatusNotEligible {
        /// lease 实际状态。
        actual: LeaseRecordStatus,
    },
    /// handle status 与 lease / orphan source 不匹配。
    HandleStatusNotEligible {
        /// handle 实际状态。
        actual: IsolationEnvironmentHandleStatus,
    },
    /// lease、handle、context、identity、boundary 或 generation relation 不一致。
    LineageMismatch,
    /// optional run 与 execution lineage 不一致。
    RunLineageMismatch,
    /// reaper marker 未绑定当前 lease / handle / generation。
    MarkerRelationMismatch,
    /// backend lifecycle summary 未绑定当前 handle / generation。
    LifecycleSummaryMismatch,
    /// released observation 不能作为 active orphan source。
    ReleasedObservationNotClassifiable,
    /// unavailable observation 不能直接确认 orphan。
    ConfirmationEvidenceInsufficient,
    /// 当前 status 不允许 requested transition。
    TransitionNotAllowed {
        /// orphan record identity。
        orphan_record_ref: OrphanRecoveryRecordRef,
        /// transition 前状态。
        from: OrphanRecoveryRecordStatus,
        /// 请求的目标状态。
        to: OrphanRecoveryRecordStatus,
    },
    /// confirmed / failed 状态缺少非空 safe reason。
    StatusReasonMissing,
    /// `Failed`状态缺少exact recovery failure basis，或其它状态错误携带该basis。
    RecoveryFailureBasisCardinalityInvalid,
    /// checked failure basis没有绑定persisted release authorization的backend target / generation / time。
    RecoveryFailureBasisMismatch,
    /// cleanup release authorization没有显式绑定当前 orphan recovery attempt。
    CleanupReleaseBasisOrphanAttemptMismatch,
    /// cleanup release authorization与当前 orphan record execution lineage不一致。
    CleanupReleaseBasisOrphanLineageMismatch,
    /// recovering record缺少前序release authorization，或保存的basis被替换。
    PersistedRecoveryReleaseBasisMismatch,
    /// cleanup completion proof没有显式绑定当前 orphan recovery attempt。
    CleanupCompletionBasisOrphanAttemptMismatch,
    /// cleanup completion proof没有延续persisted release authorization或record lineage。
    CleanupCompletionBasisOrphanLineageMismatch,
    /// cleanup release failure proof没有显式绑定当前orphan attempt或persisted authorization。
    CleanupReleaseFailureBasisOrphanMismatch,
    /// recovered transition没有matching `Released` backend lifecycle summary。
    RecoveryReleaseConfirmationInvalid,
    /// status change time 早于当前 status time 或 creation time。
    StatusTimestampMovedBackwards,
    /// record 已经是 immutable terminal state，不能被重写。
    TerminalRecordImmutable,
}
```

错误 payload 只携带 typed ref、canonical status、finite kind 或 safe reason；不得携带 raw backend response、SDK error、host path、secret、runtime loop body、artifact body 或 investigation note。`TerminalRecordImmutable` 适用于 `Recovered | Failed`；后续 incident 必须创建新的 `OrphanRecoveryRecordRef`，不能覆盖历史 recovery record。

#### 13.3.6 `FailureSourceMarker::from_orphan` 反向重验

`FailureSourceMarker::from_orphan` 的 callable shape 由 batch 2 固定为：

```rust
impl FailureSourceMarker {
    /// 从满足 orphan source contract 的 recovery record 构造 Orphan marker。
    pub fn from_orphan(
        orphan: &OrphanRecoveryRecord,
    ) -> Result<Self, FailureClassificationError>;
}
```

本批完成后，该 factory 的 reverse-validation 矩阵如下：

| 检查项 | exact source / rule | 不满足时的结果 |
|---|---|---|
| source status | 接受`Confirmed | Recovering`，或`Failed`且`confirmed_at.is_some()`；`Suspected`、未确认的`Failed`与`Recovered`拒绝。`Recovering`必须同时有matching persisted recovery release basis。 | 返回 `OrphanSourceRelationInvalid { orphan_ref }`；不得由 caller 补 status / basis。 |
| context / identity | record getters给出 context + environment identity；context 必须是 accepted lineage，identity 必须是 active lineage source | `OrphanSourceRelationInvalid`；不得从 lease / handle ref 推导。 |
| boundary / handle / generation | record 的三类 refs 完整且互相相等；handle 的 lease ref 与 record lease ref相等 | `OrphanSourceRelationInvalid`；不得用 marker 或 summary digest 替代。 |
| optional run | `Some(run_ref)` 时必须与 record context / identity / boundary / handle / generation 全相等；`None` 映射为 boundary-only | `OrphanSourceRelationInvalid`；不得扫描 latest run。 |
| stable kind / impact | kind 固定 `SandboxFailureKind::Orphan`；有 run 为 `FailureImpact::BoundaryAndRun`，无 run 为 `BoundaryOnly` | `OrphanSourceRelationInvalid`；不得由 caller传 kind / impact。 |
| safe reason | `Confirmed | Recovering`使用current `status_reason`；`Failed`使用`recovery_failure_basis().failure_observation().reason()`；均必须非空且与current status reason一致 | `OrphanSourceRelationInvalid`；不得解析错误文本。 |
| source time | 使用 record `status_changed_at()` 作为 source time；不得使用 backend `observed_at` 代替 | `OrphanSourceRelationInvalid`；不得用当前 clock 重写历史。 |
| external body | marker 只复制 record ref、typed lineage、finite kind / impact、safe reason、source time | raw summary / adapter body 进入 marker 时 typed reject。 |

因此，`from_orphan` 的稳定映射固定为：

```text
Confirmed or Recovering with exact persisted release basis
  or Failed when confirmed_at is Some
  -> FailureSource::Orphan(orphan_record_ref)
  -> SandboxFailureKind::Orphan
  -> FailureImpact::BoundaryAndRun when run_ref is Some
  -> FailureImpact::BoundaryOnly when run_ref is None
  -> non-empty owner safe reason
```

反向重验结论：`OrphanRecoveryRecord` 现在提供了 batch 2 marker factory 所需的完整 source status、confirmation gate、lineage、optional run relation、kind / impact mapping、safe reason 和 source time；不需要由 Step 7、adapter 或 caller 补字段。若未来 batch 4 修改 orphan status eligibility、lineage或reason owner，必须先重开本节和 §12.1，不得静默扩展 `from_orphan`。

| `ReaperEligibilityMarker` | `lease_ref`、`isolation_handle_ref`、`generation_ref`、`trigger`、`reason`、`marked_at` | 6 个字段全部为 typed / safe value；generation、reason、time 的本地校验由 marker factory 完成，跨对象 relation 由 lease transition 完成 | pass |
| `BackendLifecycleSummary` | backend source、safe summary、generation、observation kind、optional reason、observed time | 6 个字段全部有 source-kind、generation、reason cardinality 和 time 规则；`Released` 的 reason 关系显式闭合 | pass |

cardinality 与 optionality 结论：marker 的 `reason` 必填且非空；backend summary 的 `reason` 仅在 `Released` 时必须为空、其它 observation 必须存在；lease marker 按状态为 `None` 或 exact one；orphan `confirmed_at` 只在 confirmed lineage 后存在，`failure_reason` 只在 `Failed` 存在；`run_ref = None` 是明确的 boundary-only 分支，不是缺失数据的隐式降级。

### 13A.4 Status 与 transition closure

#### Lease status

```text
Active --RenewalClosed + LeaseExpiring--> Expiring
Active --Expired + LeaseExpired-------> Expired
Expiring --Expired + LeaseExpired------> Expired
Expired --LifecycleConflict------------> OrphanSuspected
```

| status rule | result |
|---|---|
| expiry equality enters `Expired` | pass |
| `Expiring` is not orphan proof | pass |
| `Released` is shared terminal value but release callable reserved to batch 4 | pass |
| no `Released -> *` or `OrphanSuspected -> Active` | pass |
| no query / job / bool direct status write | pass |

#### Orphan recovery status

```text
Suspected --Present/Conflicted confirmation--> Confirmed
Suspected --typed failure reason--------------> Failed
Confirmed --typed failure reason--------------> Failed
```

`Recovering` 与 `Recovered` 仍是 shared status registry 中的 batch 4 reserved value。本批不提供构造器、transition、release permission 或 mapper 将 record 写入这两个值；它们不会被误计入当前 active flow。`Failed` 从 `Suspected` 进入时 `confirmed_at` 必须保持 `None`，从 `Confirmed` 进入时必须保留既有确认时间，因此“失败”与“已确认失败来源”不是同义状态。

### 13A.5 Two forward methods closure

| `LeaseRecord::supports_orphan_suspicion_for(&IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef) -> bool` | `IsolationEnvironmentHandle::suspect_orphan` | owner-computed eligibility bool | exact handle relation + `Expired`/`OrphanSuspected` status + matching marker trigger | 不比较文本状态；不接受 caller bool；`Expiring`、`Active`、`Released`均不能证明 orphan | closed |
| `LeaseRecord::require_active_for_handle(&IsolationEnvironmentHandle, u64) -> Result<NonZeroU64, LeaseRecordError>` | `ControlledExecutionRun::prepare` / `authorize_launch` | strictly positive remaining lease window | active status、active handle、exact six-way lineage、checked age and window position | 不接受 `lease_active` bool；不使用 current config；expiry equality typed reject | closed |

两个方法均为 domain owner computation。第一个返回 `bool` 只表示是否具备进入后续完整 orphan inspection 的最低资格，第二个返回 `NonZeroU64` 只表示本次 checked age 下的正窗口；二者都不授予 launch、release、backend调用或 recovery权限。
