## 14. Batch 4: Cleanup / Redline exact object contract

batch 4 只闭合 cleanup readiness / completion 与 security redline containment。cleanup 不执行 backend release，也不删除 captured material；redline 不拥有 security investigation lifecycle，也不把 containment 降格为告警。两条主线只形成可被后续 application / adapter flow 消费的 typed truth、checked basis 与 permission。

### 14.0 多 redline coverage 与 cleanup 竞态定向回写

`§16.7` 回查确认同一个 execution lineage 可以先后或并发形成多条 `RedlineContainment` truth。原
`§14.1~§14.2`、`§15.7~§15.8`、`§16.6` 和 `6R-02 §20.2/§21.2` 中“一个 context / cleanup guard
至多关联一条 optional redline”的口径会遗漏另一条仍为 `Detected | Contained | HandoffPending | Terminal` 的
containment，并可能错误授权 backend release、context closure或success projection。该口径从本回写起失效，不提供
single-redline兼容分支。

本回写不把 audit / view 提升为安全真相源。多 redline 的 canonical lifecycle 仍逐条由
`RedlineContainment` 拥有；这里新增的 set / coverage 只证明“一个 committed safety snapshot 完整读到了哪些 exact
containment refs”，供 cleanup guard、execution projection和read view做完整性校验。

```rust
/// 一个 execution lineage 下按 committed index 顺序保存的 redline containment identity 闭集。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq, Serialize)]
pub struct RedlineContainmentRefSet {
    /// 已校验、ordered-unique 的 exact containment refs；完整无 redline 时允许为空。
    refs: Vec<RedlineContainmentRef>,
}

impl<'de> Deserialize<'de> for RedlineContainmentRefSet {
    fn deserialize<D>(deserializer: D) -> Result<Self, D::Error>
    where
        D: serde::Deserializer<'de>,
    {
        let refs = Vec::<RedlineContainmentRef>::deserialize(deserializer)?;
        Self::try_new(refs)
            .map_err(|_| serde::de::Error::custom("invalid redline containment ref set"))
    }
}

impl RedlineContainmentRefSet {
    /// 构造保持输入顺序的 exact ref 集合；重复 identity 必须拒绝，空集合表示已证明数量为零。
    pub fn try_new(
        refs: Vec<RedlineContainmentRef>,
    ) -> Result<Self, RedlineContainmentCoverageError>;

    /// 返回 committed index 给出的稳定顺序；不得按 ref、time、kind或status重排。
    pub fn as_slice(&self) -> &[RedlineContainmentRef];
    /// 返回 containment ref 数量。
    pub fn len(&self) -> usize;
    /// 判断完整集合是否为空。
    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断是否包含一个 exact containment ref。
    pub fn contains(&self, redline_ref: &RedlineContainmentRef) -> bool;
    /// 判断本集合是否为另一集合的 identity 子集；不比较 cursor / scope。
    pub fn is_subset_of(&self, other: &Self) -> bool;
}

/// committed redline lineage index的一次完整、body-free coverage snapshot。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct RedlineContainmentCoverageSnapshot {
    /// exact owning context。
    context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
    /// exact execution environment identity。
    environment_identity_ref: ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef,
    /// exact coherent boundary。
    boundary_ref: CoherentBoundaryRef,
    /// exact isolation handle。
    isolation_handle_ref: IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef,
    /// 全组共用的canonical generation。
    generation_ref: ResourceRef,
    /// 完整index read得到的ordered-unique containment refs。
    redline_refs: RedlineContainmentRefSet,
    /// index在该snapshot返回的总行数；必须等于`redline_refs.len()`。
    indexed_ref_count: u64,
    /// index完整覆盖到的committed truth watermark。
    truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
    /// source snapshot已有的audit linkage；不是query临时audit。
    source_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    /// same-snapshot index observation time。
    observed_at: Timestamp,
}

impl RedlineContainmentCoverageSnapshot {
    /// 从exact lineage index的一次完整read构造coverage；不接受partial page或caller声明的complete bool。
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    pub fn try_from_committed_lineage_index(
        context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
        environment_identity_ref: ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef,
        boundary_ref: CoherentBoundaryRef,
        isolation_handle_ref: IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef,
        generation_ref: ResourceRef,
        redline_refs: RedlineContainmentRefSet,
        indexed_ref_count: u64,
        truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
        source_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        observed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, RedlineContainmentCoverageError>;

    /// 返回exact owning context。
    pub fn context_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionContextRef;
    /// 返回exact environment identity。
    pub fn environment_identity_ref(&self) -> &ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef;
    /// 返回exact coherent boundary。
    pub fn boundary_ref(&self) -> &CoherentBoundaryRef;
    /// 返回exact isolation handle。
    pub fn isolation_handle_ref(&self) -> &IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef;
    /// 返回canonical generation。
    pub fn generation_ref(&self) -> &ResourceRef;
    /// 返回完整ordered-unique containment ref set。
    pub fn redline_refs(&self) -> &RedlineContainmentRefSet;
    /// 返回index声明的完整行数。
    pub fn indexed_ref_count(&self) -> u64;
    /// 返回coverage truth watermark。
    pub fn truth_cursor(&self) -> SandboxTruthCursor;
    /// 返回source audit linkage。
    pub fn source_audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;
    /// 返回index observation time。
    pub fn observed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
}

/// redline ref集合或lineage coverage不满足完整性约束。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum RedlineContainmentCoverageError {
    /// set中出现完全相同的containment identity。
    DuplicateRedlineContainmentRef,
    /// 任一scope ref、generation、cursor或audit identity无效。
    InvalidRedlineCoverageIdentity,
    /// index总行数与返回的exact ref set数量不同，说明read不完整或发生重复。
    RedlineCoverageCountMismatch,
    /// coverage中的containment不属于同一context / identity / boundary / handle / generation。
    RedlineCoverageLineageMismatch,
    /// loaded containment rows与coverage ref set不是exact同构集合。
    RedlineCoverageLoadedSetMismatch,
    /// coverage cursor / observation time早于已消费source或发生回退。
    RedlineCoverageMovedBackwards,
    /// caller试图用partial page、latest row、status筛选或缺失index构造完整coverage。
    RedlineCoverageWasNotComplete,
}
```

`RedlineContainmentRefSet` 与 coverage carrier唯一声明于既有 `crates/contracts/src/refs.rs`，登记在
`S6T-04-015`，不新增planned文件、object kind、repository truth或状态机。constructor只能校验结构与显式count；
“确为完整index read”必须由Step 7 source reader / repository contract保证，并由fake与durable contract test共同验证。
无index、partial page、repository unavailable和cursor gap不能构造空coverage，更不能把空集合解释为cleanup safe。

cleanup与release对coverage的current规则如下：

1. `CleanupSafetyGuard::evaluate` 必须同时接收完整coverage与按该set逐项加载的
   `&[RedlineContainment]`；二者ref集合必须exact同构，每条lineage必须等于evidence。guard逐条生成blocker，不能只选
   severity最高、时间最新或第一条redline。
2. `CleanupSafetyDecision`、`CleanupGuard` 与 `CleanupReleaseBasis` 保存的是本次evaluation / authorization消费的
   exact coverage snapshot，而不是“当前唯一redline”。授权release时coverage内每条containment都必须为`Released`；
   `Terminal`永远不是Released。
3. cleanup authorization commit与redline detection commit必须更新同一个lineage safety group，并分别使用repository
   返回的`Versioned<SafetyGroup>` expected version。repository version不进入本coverage或domain truth。二者以
   compare-and-set形成唯一线性化顺序：redline先提交时authorization发生version conflict并fresh-read重评；authorization
   先提交且handle原子进入`ReleasePending`时，该basis已经取得对exact backend target发起或恢复幂等teardown的权利，
   后到redline不得伪装成可撤销外部调用。
4. authorization之后新检测到的redline仍必须创建formal containment truth。committed handle保持`ReleasePending`时，
   它阻断任何新的use并保留材料；即使adapter已经返回release confirmation，只要owner completion UoW尚未提交，source
   factory仍按committed `ReleasePending`处理。已授权teardown可以完成，但context closure、material disposal和
   “cleanup fully safe”声明必须重新读取current complete coverage，并要求所有current redline都为`Released`。已经
   committed `Released` / closed owner之后才收到的外部安全事件不属于本cleanup竞态；它必须进入后续incident intake，
   不能把closed owner原地复活或伪造为本lineage的late containment。
5. completion source必须证明authorization coverage是completion-time current coverage的identity子集。新增ref必须
   有`detected_at > authorized_at`且被显式记录为late-redline set；缺行、旧cursor或无法分类的新增ref都是integrity error。
   late `Terminal`不撤销已授权teardown，但持续阻断context / material closure。
6. `CleanupGuard::permits_context_closure_for` 的旧单参数签名失效；current方法必须消费current complete coverage与其
   exact loaded containment rows。read view、empty set、absence proof、audit log、metric或caller bool均无mutation authority。

该回写解决的是L4-sandbox内部安全基数与竞态，不是新增L1/L2 blocker。旧Step 11 / 13的`save_safety_group`、单条
redline index与cleanup/redline race描述登记为`downstream_revalidation_pending`，当前不能反向覆盖本节。

### 14.1 `CleanupSafetyGuard`

#### 14.1.1 Capability、边界与 support family #32

`CleanupSafetyGuard` 是不可变、不可配置关闭的 strict rule snapshot。它判断一组已加载 Sandbox truth 是否满足 cleanup 的最低安全前置，但不保存某次 cleanup readiness truth，不调用 backend，不更新 handoff，不推进 lease / orphan / boundary / handle，也不拥有 artifact retention 或 investigation case。

support family #32 在 §14.1~§14.2 只包含以下 embedded / transient carrier：

| carrier | owner | 作用 | identity / persistence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `InvestigationHandoffDisposition` | `cleanup.rs` | 穷尽 external investigation handoff 的有限处置 | embedded enum；无独立 lifecycle |
| `InvestigationHandoffSummary` | `cleanup.rs` | 保存 investigation target 的 body-free checked observation | embedded snapshot；无独立 Sandbox ref |
| `CleanupHandoffEvidenceStatus` | `cleanup.rs` | 保存 source handoff 对 cleanup 的有限证据状态 | embedded enum；不替代 handoff truth |
| `CleanupEvidenceSourceBasis` | `cleanup.rs` | 区分 completed-run、terminal-run、boundary-only initial与partial-handle release-failure recovery source | evidence snapshot embedded union |
| `CleanupEvidenceSnapshot` | `cleanup.rs` | 统一四类cleanup source并保存exact lineage / recovery proof | embedded immutable snapshot |
| `CleanupSafetyRule`;`CleanupSafetyRuleSet` | `cleanup.rs` | 固定不可删减的 cleanup hard-rule 闭集 | guard-owned immutable values |
| `CleanupSafetyReasonCatalog` | `cleanup.rs` | 保存 pending / blocked / allowed / completed 固定 safe reason | guard / decision / truth embedded value |
| `CleanupBlockingReasonKind`;`CleanupBlockingSubject` | `cleanup.rs` | 穷尽 blocker 类别与 exact blocking subject | embedded finite enums |
| `CleanupBlockingReason` | `cleanup.rs` | 绑定 blocker kind、subject 与 caller-safe reason | decision / truth embedded value |
| `CleanupBlockingReasonSet` | `cleanup.rs` | 保存 guard 机械生成的 ordered-unique blocker | decision / truth embedded value |
| `CleanupSafetyDecision` | `cleanup.rs` | 保存一次 pure evaluation 的 exact status 建议与 blocker | transient checked output |
| `CleanupReleaseBasis` | `cleanup.rs` | 允许 application 调用 release adapter 的 checked basis | guard-embedded immutable proof；§14.2 闭合 |
| `CleanupCompletionBasis` | `cleanup.rs` | backend release confirmation 后的 completion proof | guard-embedded immutable proof；§14.2 闭合 |
| `CleanupReleaseFailureObservation`;`CleanupReleaseFailureBasis` | `cleanup.rs` | 保存definitive non-retryable release failure及其exact authorization relation | observation为checked transient input；basis为guard-embedded persisted proof；§14.2闭合 |
| `HandoffCleanupBlockObservation` | `cleanup.rs` | 供 `HandoffFact` 消费的 exact active block | transient proof；§14.2 闭合 |

historical `RequiredHandoffStatusSet` 不进入 current schema。`HandoffFactStatus::BlockedByCleanupGuard` 会覆盖 aggregate display，但不改变 per-target progress；若 strict rule 只接受一个 status set，会使 guard 自己建立的 block 无法解除。current rule 因此直接验证 exact target progress、observability material delivery 和 active cleanup block relation。historical `RequiredInvestigationStatusSet` 同样失效，统一由 `InvestigationHandoffSummary` 的 closed disposition 与 guard-owned requirement rule承接。

#### 14.1.2 `InvestigationHandoffSummary`

```rust
/// 外部 investigation owner 对一次 handoff / retention 请求给出的 body-free disposition。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum InvestigationHandoffDisposition {
    /// 当前 cleanup source 不要求 investigation handoff；是否真的不要求仍由 guard 判断。
    NotRequired,
    /// 已有 investigation target，但尚未形成可验证接收。
    Pending,
    /// investigation owner 已确认接收 refs / safe summary；不表示调查完成或允许解除 containment。
    Accepted,
    /// investigation owner 明确要求保留现场并阻断 cleanup。
    Blocked,
    /// handoff attempt 失败，且当前没有可证明的安全接收。
    Failed,
}

/// 保存 investigation handoff 的 typed target、safe summary 与有限 disposition。
///
/// 该 carrier 不保存 case body、operator note、ticket content、security response、
/// evidence alias 或验收身份，也不拥有外部 investigation lifecycle。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct InvestigationHandoffSummary {
    /// 非 `NotRequired` 时必有的 investigation target ref。
    target_ref: Option<ExternalSourceRef>,
    /// 非 `NotRequired` 时必有的 body-free investigation status summary ref。
    summary_ref: Option<SafeSummaryRef>,
    /// 外部 observation 的有限 disposition。
    disposition: InvestigationHandoffDisposition,
    /// `Pending | Blocked | Failed` 必有的 caller-safe reason；其它 disposition 为空。
    reason: Option<SandboxReason>,
    /// trusted consumer / adapter 记录 observation 的 canonical time。
    observed_at: Timestamp,
}

impl InvestigationHandoffSummary {
    /// 创建无外部 investigation observation 的 `NotRequired` carrier。
    ///
    /// 该值不能覆盖 guard 对 redline、confirmed orphan 或 terminal safety source 的强制要求。
    pub fn not_required(observed_at: Timestamp) -> Self;

    /// 从 investigation owner 的 body-free typed observation 构造 summary。
    pub fn from_observation(
        target_ref: ExternalSourceRef,
        summary_ref: SafeSummaryRef,
        disposition: InvestigationHandoffDisposition,
        reason: Option<SandboxReason>,
        observed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, CleanupSafetyGuardError>;

    /// 返回 optional investigation target ref。
    pub fn target_ref(&self) -> Option<&ExternalSourceRef>;
    /// 返回 optional body-free summary ref。
    pub fn summary_ref(&self) -> Option<&SafeSummaryRef>;
    /// 返回有限 disposition。
    pub fn disposition(&self) -> InvestigationHandoffDisposition;
    /// 返回 pending / blocked / failed 的 caller-safe reason。
    pub fn reason(&self) -> Option<&SandboxReason>;
    /// 返回 observation time。
    pub fn observed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;

    /// 只在 investigation owner 已确认接收时返回 true。
    pub fn is_accepted(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断该 summary 是否明确要求保持 cleanup block。
    pub fn blocks_cleanup(&self) -> bool;
}
```

cardinality 与 source-kind 规则固定如下：

| disposition | target / summary | reason | cleanup 含义 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `NotRequired` | `None / None` | `None` | 只是“未提供 investigation 输入”；guard 仍可因 redline / orphan / terminal source 判为 pending |
| `Pending` | `Some / Some` | `Some` | `PendingInvestigation` |
| `Accepted` | `Some / Some` | `None` | 仅证明 external handoff 已接收；不证明 investigation closed |
| `Blocked` | `Some / Some` | `Some` | hard `Blocked`；不得配置覆盖 |
| `Failed` | `Some / Some` | `Some` | hard `Blocked`；后续新 observation 可重评，不原地改写 summary |

`target_ref.source_kind()` 与 `summary_ref.source_kind()` 必须都为 `ExternalSourceKind::Investigation`。`Accepted` 不能携带自由文本 reason；需要解释的外部状态必须落在 body-free summary owner。`NotRequired` 由 application 表达“本次没有 external summary”，但 guard 决定是否允许该 absence，caller 不能用它关闭 mandatory investigation。

#### 14.1.3 `CleanupEvidenceSnapshot` source basis

```rust
/// 从 exact handoff target progress 派生的 cleanup evidence position，不是第二状态机。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum CleanupHandoffEvidenceStatus {
    /// required handoff batch 尚未打开，必须保持cleanup pending。
    NotOpened,
    /// 至少一个 required target 尚未完成，且当前没有 failed / retryable target。
    Pending,
    /// 全部 required target progress 均为 `Delivered`。
    Delivered,
    /// 没有 failed target，且至少一个 target 可安全重试。
    Retryable,
    /// 至少一个 required target 已进入 terminal failed。
    Failed,
}

/// 区分 cleanup safety evaluation 允许消费的四类 committed source basis。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum CleanupEvidenceSourceBasis {
    /// completed run 已形成 immutable capture、observability material 和 handoff truth。
    CompletedRunCapture {
        /// exact immutable capture fact ref。
        capture_ref: CaptureFactRef,
        /// capture owner 已定格的 canonical status；`Partial | Failed | Unavailable` 不得伪装成功。
        capture_status: CaptureFactStatus,
        /// 与 capture 同批形成的 observability material ref。
        observability_material_ref: ObservabilityMaterialRef,
        /// 覆盖 captured / observability source 的 handoff batch；尚未打开时为`None`。
        handoff_ref: Option<HandoffFactRef>,
        /// observability material 当前 lifecycle status。
        observability_status: ObservabilityMaterialStatus,
        /// handoff 当前 canonical aggregate status；未打开时为`None`。
        handoff_status: Option<HandoffFactStatus>,
        /// 从 exact per-target progress 机械派生的 cleanup evidence position。
        handoff_evidence_status: CleanupHandoffEvidenceStatus,
        /// aggregate cleanup override；有值时必须等于当前被评估的 cleanup guard ref。
        handoff_cleanup_guard_ref: Option<CleanupGuardRef>,
        /// capture owner 保存的 forbidden-body marker；非空时强制 investigation handoff。
        forbidden_body_markers: ForbiddenExternalBodyMarkerSet,
    },
    /// failed / terminated run 没有适用 capture，但有 formal terminal owner 和 observability handoff。
    TerminalRun {
        /// exact terminal run status，只允许 `Failed | Terminated`。
        run_status: ControlledExecutionRunStatus,
        /// run 已持久化且与 status 匹配的 formal terminal basis。
        terminal_basis: ControlledRunTerminalBasis,
        /// terminal source 形成的 observability material ref。
        observability_material_ref: ObservabilityMaterialRef,
        /// 覆盖 observability target 的 handoff ref；尚未打开时为`None`。
        handoff_ref: Option<HandoffFactRef>,
        /// terminal-run observability material 当前 lifecycle status。
        observability_status: ObservabilityMaterialStatus,
        /// handoff 当前 canonical aggregate status；未打开时为`None`。
        handoff_status: Option<HandoffFactStatus>,
        /// 从 exact per-target progress 机械派生的 cleanup evidence position。
        handoff_evidence_status: CleanupHandoffEvidenceStatus,
        /// aggregate cleanup override；有值时必须等于当前被评估的 cleanup guard ref。
        handoff_cleanup_guard_ref: Option<CleanupGuardRef>,
    },
    /// boundary establishment partial handle 或从未启动 run 的 environment cleanup source。
    BoundaryOnly {
        /// source boundary 当前 canonical status。
        boundary_status: CoherentBoundaryStatus,
        /// source handle 在 safety evaluation 时的 canonical status。
        handle_status: IsolationEnvironmentHandleStatus,
        /// boundary 最近一次 transition 的 audit ref。
        boundary_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        /// handle 最近一次 transition 的 audit ref。
        handle_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    },
    /// 没有persisted lease row的partial handle在definitive release failure后的fresh recovery source。
    BoundaryOnlyReleaseFailureRecovery {
        /// source boundary必须保持`Failed`。
        boundary_status: CoherentBoundaryStatus,
        /// partial handle必须保持前次authorization写入的`ReleasePending`。
        handle_status: IsolationEnvironmentHandleStatus,
        /// immediately preceding blocked cleanup guard保存的exact terminal release-failure proof。
        prior_release_failure_basis: CleanupReleaseFailureBasis,
        /// 同一backend target在旧failure observation之后形成的fresh body-free lifecycle summary。
        fresh_lifecycle_summary: BackendLifecycleSummary,
        /// boundary最近一次transition的audit ref。
        boundary_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        /// handle最近一次transition的audit ref。
        handle_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    },
}

/// 为 cleanup guard 固定 exact execution lineage 和 source evidence；不保存任何外部正文。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct CleanupEvidenceSnapshot {
    /// owning accepted controlled execution context ref。
    context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
    /// owning execution environment identity ref。
    environment_identity_ref: ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef,
    /// completed / terminal source 的 exact run；boundary-only 为 `None`。
    run_ref: Option<ControlledExecutionRunRef>,
    /// exact coherent boundary ref。
    boundary_ref: CoherentBoundaryRef,
    /// exact isolation handle ref。
    isolation_handle_ref: IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef,
    /// handle 预绑定的 lease ref；partial handle 可以尚无 `LeaseRecord` row。
    lease_ref: LeaseRecordRef,
    /// 已存在 lease row 的 status；partial `Created` handle cleanup 可为 `None`。
    lease_status: Option<LeaseRecordStatus>,
    /// context / identity / boundary / handle / lease 共用的 canonical generation。
    generation_ref: ResourceRef,
    /// 四类互斥 source basis 之一。
    source_basis: CleanupEvidenceSourceBasis,
    /// snapshot 组装时间；只用于 ordering，不替代 owner observation time。
    assembled_at: Timestamp,
}

impl CleanupEvidenceSnapshot {
    /// 从 completed run 的 immutable capture / observability / handoff group 构造 evidence。
    pub fn from_completed_run(
        context: &ControlledExecutionContext,
        identity: &ExecutionEnvironmentIdentity,
        boundary: &CoherentBoundary,
        handle: &IsolationEnvironmentHandle,
        lease: &LeaseRecord,
        run: &ControlledExecutionRun,
        capture: &CaptureFact,
        observability_material: &ObservabilityMaterial,
        handoff: Option<&HandoffFact>,
        assembled_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, CleanupSafetyGuardError>;

    /// 从 failed / terminated run 的 formal terminal basis 与 observability handoff 构造 evidence。
    pub fn from_terminal_run(
        context: &ControlledExecutionContext,
        identity: &ExecutionEnvironmentIdentity,
        boundary: &CoherentBoundary,
        handle: &IsolationEnvironmentHandle,
        lease: &LeaseRecord,
        run: &ControlledExecutionRun,
        observability_material: &ObservabilityMaterial,
        handoff: Option<&HandoffFact>,
        assembled_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, CleanupSafetyGuardError>;

    /// 从未产生 run 的 boundary / partial handle cleanup obligation 构造 evidence。
    pub fn from_boundary_only(
        context: &ControlledExecutionContext,
        identity: &ExecutionEnvironmentIdentity,
        boundary: &CoherentBoundary,
        handle: &IsolationEnvironmentHandle,
        lease: Option<&LeaseRecord>,
        assembled_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, CleanupSafetyGuardError>;

    /// 从blocked partial-handle release attempt与fresh lifecycle inspection构造新guard evidence。
    pub fn from_boundary_only_release_failure(
        context: &ControlledExecutionContext,
        identity: &ExecutionEnvironmentIdentity,
        boundary: &CoherentBoundary,
        handle: &IsolationEnvironmentHandle,
        prior_cleanup_guard: &CleanupGuard,
        fresh_lifecycle_summary: BackendLifecycleSummary,
        assembled_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, CleanupSafetyGuardError>;

    /// 返回 owning context ref。
    pub fn context_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionContextRef;
    /// 返回 owning environment identity ref。
    pub fn environment_identity_ref(&self) -> &ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef;
    /// 返回 optional exact run ref。
    pub fn run_ref(&self) -> Option<&ControlledExecutionRunRef>;
    /// 返回 exact boundary ref。
    pub fn boundary_ref(&self) -> &CoherentBoundaryRef;
    /// 返回 exact isolation handle ref。
    pub fn isolation_handle_ref(&self) -> &IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef;
    /// 返回 handle 预绑定 lease ref。
    pub fn lease_ref(&self) -> &LeaseRecordRef;
    /// 返回 optional persisted lease status。
    pub fn lease_status(&self) -> Option<LeaseRecordStatus>;
    /// 返回 canonical generation ref。
    pub fn generation_ref(&self) -> &ResourceRef;
    /// 返回四类互斥 source basis。
    pub fn source_basis(&self) -> &CleanupEvidenceSourceBasis;
    /// 返回 snapshot assembly time。
    pub fn assembled_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;

    /// 判断本 evidence 是否来自 failed / terminated run。
    pub fn is_terminal_run_source(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断本 evidence 是否因 forbidden-body marker 强制 investigation。
    pub fn requires_investigation_for_body_boundary(&self) -> bool;
}
```

四个 factory 的 relation 必须按下表机械验证：

| source | exact owner relation | handoff / observability rule | lease / handle rule |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CompletedRunCapture` | context `Accepted`、identity `Active`、run `Completed`；run / capture / observability以及optional handoff的context、identity、boundary、handle、generation全相等；capture ref和observability ref逐项相等 | handoff为`None`时派生`NotOpened`；有值时source必须是该capture / observability group，并只按progress的`Failed > Retryable > all Delivered > Pending`派生 | lease row必有，ref与handle预绑定ref相等；status允许`Active | Expiring | Expired | OrphanSuspected`，不得已`Released` |
| `TerminalRun` | run只允许`Failed | Terminated`且`terminal_basis`必有；observability source basis必须复制该 exact terminal owner；optional handoff有值时必须覆盖observability ref和terminal rule要求的targets | handoff为`None`时派生`NotOpened`；`BlockedByCleanupGuard`不抹掉underlying progress；failed / retryable / pending分别保留 | lease row必有；handle允许`Active | ReleasePending | OrphanSuspected`；`Created`只走boundary-only；`Released`不能创建pre-release evidence |
| `BoundaryOnly` | run ref必须为空；boundary只允许`Failed | Established`且必须保存matching handle；`Established`表示环境已创建但从未形成run，`Failed`可承接partial handle | 不创建capture / observability / handoff ref；audit linkage必须来自boundary和handle owner | `lease = None`只允许`boundary Failed + handle Created`的partial-handle组合；其它组合必须有matching lease row；handle允许`Created | Active | OrphanSuspected` |
| `BoundaryOnlyReleaseFailureRecovery` | run ref、lease row与orphan ref必须为空；boundary固定`Failed`、handle固定`ReleasePending`；prior guard必须`Blocked`且保存exact release + failure basis，basis的context / identity / boundary / handle / lease ref / generation / backend target全部等于current owners | 不创建capture / observability / handoff ref；fresh summary必须由同一次typed mapper绑定current backend target / generation，且`observed_at`严格晚于prior failure observation；prior guard source可为初始`BoundaryOnly`或前一条同类recovery source，从而支持有限attempt链 | prior release basis必须`lease_record_present = false`、`run_ref = None`、`orphan_record_ref = None`；fresh `Present | Unavailable | Conflicted`可形成evidence，但`Unavailable`必须在evaluation生成`ReleaseRecoveryInspectionPending`，不得授权新release；`Released`必须转late-confirmation reconciliation，不能创建新guard evidence |

所有 factory 都必须校验 context、identity、boundary、handle、optional lease 和 generation 的 exact typed equality。`from_boundary_only_release_failure`还必须加载prior cleanup guard本体，验证其current blocker set只有matching `ReleaseFailureTerminal`，而不是只相信caller传入的failure basis；variant只clone exact basis，不嵌入旧guard row。`assembled_at` 不得早于所复制 owner 的最近 status / observation time；具体比较必须消费 Step 7 clock port 提供的 canonical ordering，不得用 `Timestamp` 字符串词法比较。relation 失败返回 `Err`，不能降格为 `PendingEvidence`，因为错误 lineage 不是可等待的业务状态。

`handoff = None` 是明确的 `NotOpened` pending evidence，不是 malformed relation。`HandoffFactStatus::Delivered` 不能单独证明 cleanup safe；只有 exact `target_progress.all_delivered()` 才派生 `CleanupHandoffEvidenceStatus::Delivered`。反之，当 aggregate 因同一 cleanup guard显示 `BlockedByCleanupGuard`，但 underlying target progress 已全部 delivered 时，evidence仍为`Delivered`，使 guard可以在其它条件满足后解除自己的block；这不重放receipt，也不改写target progress。

#### 14.1.4 Strict rule、reason catalog 与 blocker set

```rust
/// cleanup safety guard 永远启用且不可删减的 hard rule。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum CleanupSafetyRule {
    /// 所有 source 必须具有 exact context / identity / boundary / handle / lease / generation relation。
    RequireExactExecutionLineage,
    /// completed run 必须保留 immutable capture fact 与其真实 status。
    PreserveCaptureTruth,
    /// required captured / observability / investigation targets 必须按 exact progress 安全交接。
    RequireDeliveredHandoffEvidence,
    /// failed / terminated run 必须存在 formal terminal owner 和 body-free observability material。
    RequireFormalTerminalMaterial,
    /// incomplete / forbidden / terminal / orphan / redline source 必须满足 investigation handoff。
    RequireInvestigationWhenUnsafe,
    /// active redline containment 永远优先于 cleanup / release。
    RespectRedlineContainment,
    /// confirmed orphan 只能在 guard 允许下进入 recovering / recovered。
    GuardOrphanRecovery,
    /// backend release confirmation 是 cleanup completion 的必需输入。
    RequireReleaseConfirmation,
    /// 每次 readiness / completion transition 必须保留 append-only audit linkage。
    PreserveAuditLinkage,
}

/// 保存完整、canonical 排序且不可配置删减的 cleanup safety rule set。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct CleanupSafetyRuleSet(Vec<CleanupSafetyRule>);

impl CleanupSafetyRuleSet {
    /// 构造包含全部九条 hard rule 的严格默认集合。
    pub fn strict_default() -> Self;
    /// 只接受完整九条 rule 的重建输入；缺失、重复或额外值均拒绝。
    pub fn try_strict(
        rules: Vec<CleanupSafetyRule>,
    ) -> Result<Self, CleanupSafetyGuardError>;
    /// 返回 canonical rule sequence。
    pub fn as_slice(&self) -> &[CleanupSafetyRule];
    /// 判断 exact hard rule 是否存在；strict set 对九项都必须返回 true。
    pub fn contains(&self, rule: CleanupSafetyRule) -> bool;
}

/// cleanup guard 生成稳定 caller-safe reason 所需的固定 catalog。
///
/// catalog 只改变安全文案，不改变 rule、状态映射或 permission；不得由 runtime config 覆盖。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct CleanupSafetyReasonCatalog {
    /// handoff / observability 尚未完成的原因。
    pending_evidence: SandboxReason,
    /// handoff 可重试但尚未安全交接的原因。
    retryable_evidence: SandboxReason,
    /// handoff / observability 已 terminal failed 的原因。
    failed_evidence: SandboxReason,
    /// mandatory investigation 尚未提供或仍 pending 的原因。
    pending_investigation: SandboxReason,
    /// investigation / orphan / redline 明确阻断 cleanup 的原因。
    safety_source_blocked: SandboxReason,
    /// 所有 strict rule 满足、允许进入 release attempt 的原因。
    cleanup_allowed: SandboxReason,
    /// release confirmation 已验证、cleanup truth 可完成的原因。
    cleanup_completed: SandboxReason,
}

impl CleanupSafetyReasonCatalog {
    /// 从七个已验证caller-safe reason构造固定catalog。
    pub fn new(
        pending_evidence: SandboxReason,
        retryable_evidence: SandboxReason,
        failed_evidence: SandboxReason,
        pending_investigation: SandboxReason,
        safety_source_blocked: SandboxReason,
        cleanup_allowed: SandboxReason,
        cleanup_completed: SandboxReason,
    ) -> Self;

    /// 返回handoff / observability尚未完成的reason。
    pub fn pending_evidence(&self) -> &SandboxReason;
    /// 返回handoff retryable的reason。
    pub fn retryable_evidence(&self) -> &SandboxReason;
    /// 返回handoff / observability failed的reason。
    pub fn failed_evidence(&self) -> &SandboxReason;
    /// 返回mandatory investigation pending的reason。
    pub fn pending_investigation(&self) -> &SandboxReason;
    /// 返回hard safety source block的reason。
    pub fn safety_source_blocked(&self) -> &SandboxReason;
    /// 返回cleanup allowed的reason。
    pub fn cleanup_allowed(&self) -> &SandboxReason;
    /// 返回cleanup completed的reason。
    pub fn cleanup_completed(&self) -> &SandboxReason;
}

/// cleanup 被等待或阻断的有限原因类别。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum CleanupBlockingReasonKind {
    /// required handoff尚未打开或target尚未delivered。
    HandoffPending,
    /// required handoff target处于retryable，尚不能release。
    HandoffRetryable,
    /// required handoff target已terminal failed。
    HandoffFailed,
    /// observability material尚未记录handoff。
    ObservabilityPending,
    /// observability materialhandoff已失败。
    ObservabilityFailed,
    /// current source强制investigation，但summary为`NotRequired`。
    InvestigationRequired,
    /// investigation handoff仍pending。
    InvestigationPending,
    /// investigation owner明确block或handoff失败。
    InvestigationBlocked,
    /// orphan仍在suspected，尚未形成可操作confirmation。
    OrphanConfirmationPending,
    /// partial-handle failure recovery的fresh lifecycle inspection当前不可用，尚不能授权新release。
    ReleaseRecoveryInspectionPending,
    /// orphan recovery已failed。
    OrphanRecoveryFailed,
    /// 已持久化release authorization收到definitive non-retryable failure。
    ReleaseFailureTerminal,
    /// redline仍处于detected / contained，cleanup必须fail-closed。
    RedlineContainmentActive,
    /// redline等待investigation handoff。
    RedlineHandoffPending,
    /// redline已进入不可释放的terminal containment。
    RedlineTerminal,
    /// forbidden external body marker要求保留现场并完成investigation handoff。
    ForbiddenBodyPreservationRequired,
}

/// 标识 blocker 归属的 exact typed subject，不保存 query label 或 free-form key。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum CleanupBlockingSubject {
    /// 整个 cleanup evidence group。
    Evidence,
    /// exact handoff batch。
    Handoff(HandoffFactRef),
    /// external investigation target；未提供target时使用`Evidence`。
    Investigation(ExternalSourceRef),
    /// exact orphan recovery record。
    Orphan(OrphanRecoveryRecordRef),
    /// exact isolation handle release target。
    ReleaseTarget(IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef),
    /// exact redline containment truth。
    Redline(RedlineContainmentRef),
}

/// guard 机械生成的一项 typed cleanup blocker。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct CleanupBlockingReason {
    /// 有限 blocker kind。
    kind: CleanupBlockingReasonKind,
    /// blocker 的 exact typed subject。
    subject: CleanupBlockingSubject,
    /// owner reason 或 guard catalog 提供的 caller-safe reason。
    reason: SandboxReason,
}

impl CleanupBlockingReason {
    /// 返回finite blocker kind。
    pub fn kind(&self) -> CleanupBlockingReasonKind;
    /// 返回exact typed blocker subject。
    pub fn subject(&self) -> &CleanupBlockingSubject;
    /// 返回owner / catalog提供的caller-safe reason。
    pub fn reason(&self) -> &SandboxReason;
}

/// 保存按 severity / kind / subject canonical 排序且不重复的 cleanup blocker。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct CleanupBlockingReasonSet(Vec<CleanupBlockingReason>);

impl CleanupBlockingReasonSet {
    /// 只供 `CleanupSafetyGuard` 从已验证 blocker 构造 canonical set。
    fn from_guard(
        reasons: Vec<CleanupBlockingReason>,
    ) -> Result<Self, CleanupSafetyGuardError>;
    /// 只供`CleanupGuard::record_release_failure`形成唯一terminal release blocker。
    fn from_release_failure(
        reason: CleanupBlockingReason,
    ) -> Result<Self, CleanupGuardError>;
    /// 返回 canonical blocker sequence。
    pub fn as_slice(&self) -> &[CleanupBlockingReason];
    /// 判断集合是否为空。
    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool;
    /// 返回 blocker 数量。
    pub fn len(&self) -> usize;
    /// 返回 canonical priority最高的caller-safe reason。
    pub fn dominant_reason(&self) -> Option<&SandboxReason>;
    /// 按closed blocker kind机械派生 readiness status；空集合返回`Allowed`。
    pub fn derive_status(&self) -> CleanupGuardStatus;
}
```

`derive_status` 固定按以下优先级，不能由 vector 插入顺序、最后一条 reason 或 caller flag决定：

```text
any HandoffFailed / ObservabilityFailed / InvestigationBlocked /
    OrphanRecoveryFailed / ReleaseFailureTerminal /
    RedlineContainmentActive / RedlineTerminal
    -> Blocked
else any InvestigationRequired / InvestigationPending /
         RedlineHandoffPending / ForbiddenBodyPreservationRequired
    -> PendingInvestigation
else any HandoffPending / HandoffRetryable / ObservabilityPending /
         OrphanConfirmationPending / ReleaseRecoveryInspectionPending
    -> PendingEvidence
else
    -> Allowed
```

同一 `(kind, subject)` 只能出现一次。`dominant_reason` 使用上述 status优先级，再按 enum canonical order和typed subject canonical order选择第一项；不得把多条reason拼成自由文本。`ForbiddenBodyPreservationRequired` 在 investigation summary 为 `Blocked | Failed` 时还必须同时生成 `InvestigationBlocked`，因此最终 status 为 `Blocked` 而非 pending。

#### 14.1.5 `CleanupSafetyDecision` 与 guard exact contract

```rust
/// strict cleanup evaluation 对一份 exact evidence snapshot 形成的 immutable checked output。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct CleanupSafetyDecision {
    /// 形成决定的 cleanup safety guard ref。
    safety_guard_ref: CleanupSafetyGuardRef,
    /// exact evidence lineage，供 `CleanupGuard` factory 防止 decision 重放到另一环境。
    context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
    /// exact owning execution environment identity ref。
    environment_identity_ref: ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef,
    /// exact optional run ref。
    run_ref: Option<ControlledExecutionRunRef>,
    /// exact boundary ref。
    boundary_ref: CoherentBoundaryRef,
    /// exact isolation handle ref。
    isolation_handle_ref: IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef,
    /// exact pre-bound lease ref。
    lease_ref: LeaseRecordRef,
    /// canonical generation ref。
    generation_ref: ResourceRef,
    /// optional matching orphan recovery record ref。
    orphan_record_ref: Option<OrphanRecoveryRecordRef>,
    /// 本次pure evaluation完整消费的exact redline lineage coverage。
    redline_coverage: RedlineContainmentCoverageSnapshot,
    /// evidence snapshot观察到的active cleanup handoff override。
    observed_handoff_cleanup_guard_ref: Option<CleanupGuardRef>,
    /// 只能是`PendingEvidence | PendingInvestigation | Blocked | Allowed`。
    guard_status: CleanupGuardStatus,
    /// exact ordered blockers；`Allowed`时必须为空。
    blocking_reasons: CleanupBlockingReasonSet,
    /// dominant blocker或catalog allowed reason。
    decision_reason: SandboxReason,
    /// pure evaluation time。
    evaluated_at: Timestamp,
}

impl CleanupSafetyDecision {
    /// 返回形成决定的safety guard ref。
    pub fn safety_guard_ref(&self) -> &CleanupSafetyGuardRef;
    /// 返回exact context ref。
    pub fn context_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionContextRef;
    /// 返回exact environment identity ref。
    pub fn environment_identity_ref(&self) -> &ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef;
    /// 返回optional exact run ref。
    pub fn run_ref(&self) -> Option<&ControlledExecutionRunRef>;
    /// 返回exact boundary ref。
    pub fn boundary_ref(&self) -> &CoherentBoundaryRef;
    /// 返回exact isolation handle ref。
    pub fn isolation_handle_ref(&self) -> &IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef;
    /// 返回exact lease ref。
    pub fn lease_ref(&self) -> &LeaseRecordRef;
    /// 返回canonical generation ref。
    pub fn generation_ref(&self) -> &ResourceRef;
    /// 返回optional orphan recovery ref。
    pub fn orphan_record_ref(&self) -> Option<&OrphanRecoveryRecordRef>;
    /// 返回本次pure evaluation完整消费的redline coverage。
    pub fn redline_coverage(&self) -> &RedlineContainmentCoverageSnapshot;
    /// 返回evidence中观察到的active cleanup handoff override。
    pub fn observed_handoff_cleanup_guard_ref(&self) -> Option<&CleanupGuardRef>;
    /// 返回本次建议的canonical cleanup status。
    pub fn guard_status(&self) -> CleanupGuardStatus;
    /// 返回exact blocker set。
    pub fn blocking_reasons(&self) -> &CleanupBlockingReasonSet;
    /// 返回dominant blocker或allowed reason。
    pub fn decision_reason(&self) -> &SandboxReason;
    /// 返回pure evaluation time。
    pub fn evaluated_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
}

/// 不可配置绕过的 cleanup safety rule snapshot。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct CleanupSafetyGuard {
    /// immutable guard identity。
    guard_ref: CleanupSafetyGuardRef,
    /// 固定九条 hard rule。
    safety_rules: CleanupSafetyRuleSet,
    /// 只影响caller-safe wording的固定reason catalog。
    reason_catalog: CleanupSafetyReasonCatalog,
    /// guard在当前design generation内激活的canonical time。
    activated_at: Timestamp,
}

impl CleanupSafetyGuard {
    /// 创建完整strict rule snapshot；不接收enable flag或rule override。
    pub fn strict(
        guard_ref: CleanupSafetyGuardRef,
        reason_catalog: CleanupSafetyReasonCatalog,
        activated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, CleanupSafetyGuardError>;

    /// 对exact evidence、optional orphan、完整redline coverage和investigation summary做pure evaluation。
    pub fn evaluate(
        &self,
        evidence: &CleanupEvidenceSnapshot,
        orphan: Option<&OrphanRecoveryRecord>,
        redline_coverage: &RedlineContainmentCoverageSnapshot,
        redlines: &[RedlineContainment],
        investigation: &InvestigationHandoffSummary,
        evaluated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<CleanupSafetyDecision, CleanupSafetyGuardError>;

    /// 返回immutable guard ref。
    pub fn guard_ref(&self) -> &CleanupSafetyGuardRef;
    /// 返回完整strict rule set。
    pub fn safety_rules(&self) -> &CleanupSafetyRuleSet;
    /// 返回固定reason catalog。
    pub fn reason_catalog(&self) -> &CleanupSafetyReasonCatalog;
    /// 返回guard activation time。
    pub fn activated_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
}
```

guard evaluation 必须先完成 relation validation，再按 source 生成 blocker。relation error 与业务 blocker 不得混淆：wrong lineage / malformed summary 返回 `Err`；同 lineage 下 evidence pending / failed / blocked 返回 `Ok(CleanupSafetyDecision)`，使状态和原因可持久化、审计与重评。

redline输入必须先执行coverage校验：coverage的context / identity / boundary / handle / generation与evidence逐项相等，
`indexed_ref_count == redline_refs.len()`，且`redlines`按coverage顺序逐项同构，不能多、少、重复或换序。空coverage只有在
完整index明确返回零行时合法。每条containment分别应用下表；多个blocker全部进入
`CleanupBlockingReasonSet`，唯一键仍是`(kind, Redline(exact_ref))`，因此不同redline不能互相覆盖。只要任一条active或
Terminal，decision就不能为Allowed；只有集合为空或每一条都为Released，才继续判断其它cleanup prerequisite。

| evaluation source | mandatory investigation | blocker 生成规则 |
|---|---|---|
| completed capture `Complete` | 只有 forbidden marker、matching active redline 或显式 investigation summary非`NotRequired`时要求 | handoff `NotOpened / Pending / Retryable / Failed`分别生成对应blocker；observability非`HandoffRecorded`补observability blocker；全部delivered且无其它source blocker才`Allowed` |
| completed capture `Partial | Failed | Unavailable` | 是 | 除handoff / observability blocker外，`NotRequired`生成`InvestigationRequired`；`Pending`生成`InvestigationPending`；`Blocked | Failed`生成`InvestigationBlocked` |
| terminal run `Failed | Terminated` | 是 | formal terminal basis / observability / handoff relation已由snapshot factory验证；investigation按上述closed matrix生成blocker |
| boundary-only `Created | Active` | 默认否；若matching failure / redline / forbidden-body source在后续flow显式关联则由新evidence重评 | 无handoff blocker；只在invalid source relation时报错，不因“没有capture”生成伪pending |
| boundary-only release-failure recovery `ReleasePending` | 是；每次definitive failure后都必须形成fresh external responsibility / observation handoff | prior failure与fresh lifecycle relation已由snapshot factory验证；fresh lifecycle为`Unavailable`时，无论investigation是否`Accepted`，都必须生成`ReleaseRecoveryInspectionPending + ReleaseTarget(handle_ref) + reason_catalog.pending_evidence`；`NotRequired`生成`InvestigationRequired`，`Pending`生成`InvestigationPending`，`Blocked | Failed`生成`InvestigationBlocked`；只有fresh lifecycle非`Unavailable`、investigation为`Accepted`且完整redline coverage为空或全部Released时才可形成new `Allowed` decision |
| matching orphan `Suspected` | 未确认前不要求外部investigation，但不能release | 生成`OrphanConfirmationPending` |
| matching orphan `Confirmed | Recovering` | 是 | investigation非Accepted时生成对应blocker；`Recovering`仍可保持`Allowed` permission，但不能跳过backend confirmation完成 |
| matching orphan `Recovered` | 否 | 不生成active orphan blocker；仍必须满足其它evidence / redline rule |
| matching orphan `Failed` | 是且hard blocked | 生成`OrphanRecoveryFailed`，即使investigation已Accepted也保持`Blocked` |
| coverage中每条 redline `Detected | Contained` | 是且hard blocked | 为该exact ref生成`RedlineContainmentActive`；investigation另按summary生成blocker |
| coverage中每条 redline `HandoffPending` | 是 | 为该exact ref生成`RedlineHandoffPending`；即使external summary已Accepted，也必须由该redline owner先推进到`Released | Terminal` |
| coverage中每条 redline `Released` | 否 | 该ref不生成active blocker；只表示该containment owner允许cleanup继续判断，不代表其它ref或cleanup完成 |
| coverage中每条 redline `Terminal` | 是且hard blocked | 为该exact ref生成`RedlineTerminal`；只能保留/contain，不允许normal release permission |

`InvestigationHandoffSummary::Accepted` 只是 handoff acceptance，不是“调查已完成”。它能满足 cleanup 的 external handoff prerequisite，是因为 cleanup 只要求材料和责任已安全移交；redline 是否可以从 `HandoffPending` 进入 `Released | Terminal` 仍由 §14.3~§14.4 的独立 guard / truth 决定。

`BoundaryOnlyReleaseFailureRecovery` 的 `Unavailable` 只证明本次fresh inspection调用无法给出当前lifecycle结论，不证明backend target仍可安全重试，更不证明已释放。snapshot factory允许保存该body-free observation以建立恢复点，但guard必须以exact `ReleaseTarget(handle_ref)`形成`ReleaseRecoveryInspectionPending`，状态固定为`PendingEvidence`；后续只能用更晚的fresh lifecycle summary创建新的evidence / decision，caller不得以已`Accepted`的investigation summary清除此blocker。

#### 14.1.6 `CleanupSafetyGuardError`

```rust
/// cleanup evidence、investigation summary、strict rule或pure decision relation失败。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum CleanupSafetyGuardError {
    /// strict rule set缺少、重复或加入非canonical rule。
    CleanupSafetyRuleSetInvalid,
    /// reason catalog没有形成完整七项caller-safe reason。
    CleanupSafetyReasonCatalogInvalid,
    /// investigation target或summary source kind不是`Investigation`。
    InvestigationSourceKindInvalid,
    /// investigation disposition与target / summary / reason cardinality不一致。
    InvestigationSummaryRelationInvalid {
        /// relation无法成立的finite disposition。
        disposition: InvestigationHandoffDisposition,
    },
    /// context / identity / boundary / handle / lease / generation关系不一致。
    CleanupEvidenceLineageMismatch,
    /// completed-run factory收到非`Completed` run。
    CompletedEvidenceRunStatusInvalid {
        /// factory观察到的canonical run status。
        actual: ControlledExecutionRunStatus,
    },
    /// terminal-run factory收到非`Failed | Terminated` run或缺formal terminal basis。
    TerminalEvidenceRunBasisInvalid,
    /// boundary-only factory收到run-bearing或不允许的boundary / handle组合。
    BoundaryOnlyEvidenceRelationInvalid,
    /// partial-handle release-failure recovery没有绑定blocked prior guard、matching failure basis或fresh lifecycle source。
    BoundaryOnlyReleaseFailureRecoveryInvalid,
    /// partial handle absence/presence与lease row规则不一致。
    CleanupEvidenceLeasePresenceInvalid,
    /// capture、observability material或handoff source refs不属于同一exact source group。
    CleanupEvidenceSourceMismatch,
    /// handoff target progress与target plan不一致，无法机械派生evidence status。
    CleanupHandoffProgressRelationInvalid,
    /// handoff aggregate status与underlying progress / cleanup override不一致。
    CleanupHandoffAggregateRelationInvalid,
    /// evidence snapshot时间早于任一owner状态时间或不满足canonical time contract。
    CleanupEvidenceTimestampInvalid,
    /// optional orphan record与cleanup evidence lineage不一致。
    CleanupOrphanLineageMismatch,
    /// redline coverage或其任一containment与cleanup evidence lineage不一致。
    CleanupRedlineLineageMismatch,
    /// redline coverage ref set与loaded containment rows不是exact同构集合。
    CleanupRedlineCoverageIncomplete,
    /// blocker set出现重复kind / subject或非canonical排序。
    CleanupBlockingReasonSetInvalid,
    /// decision status、blocker set和decision reason不满足closed derive规则。
    CleanupSafetyDecisionRelationInvalid {
        /// relation无法成立的canonical cleanup status。
        status: CleanupGuardStatus,
    },
    /// evaluation time早于guard activation、evidence assembly或external observation。
    CleanupSafetyEvaluationTimestampInvalid,
}
```

error payload 只携带 canonical enum 或 typed ref；不得携带 raw capture material、locator body、backend response、investigation note、secret、host / container / process detail或外部错误文本。`CleanupSafetyReasonCatalog::new`接收的是已通过`SandboxReason` contract的值，因此构造本身infallible；catalog invalid只用于repository rehydration / corruption validator，不得增加不可触发的`EmptyReason`。

#### 14.1.7 Guard self-review 与 downstream revalidation

| 审查项 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| unique owner / planned path | pass；唯一 owner为`crates/domain/src/cleanup.rs`，未新增source path。 |
| immutable strict rule | pass；九条rule完整且无enable / override / config输入。 |
| source coverage | pass；completed-run、terminal-run、boundary-only initial、partial-handle release-failure recovery四类source均有exact factory。 |
| unavailable recovery inspection | pass；partial-handle fresh lifecycle为`Unavailable`时固定生成typed pending blocker，不能因investigation `Accepted`进入`Allowed`。 |
| completed vs terminal capture | pass；terminal source不创建伪`CaptureFact`；completed source不隐藏非complete capture。 |
| handoff proof | pass；从per-target progress派生，不信任aggregate `Delivered`文本；self-block可解除。 |
| investigation boundary | pass；只保存typed target / safe summary / disposition，不拥有case lifecycle或body。 |
| redline / orphan precedence | pass；active / failed / terminal source机械生成blocker，caller不能省略。 |
| status owner | pass；decision只复用shared `CleanupGuardStatus`，且不构造`Completed`。 |
| external body exclusion | pass；forbidden marker只触发preservation / investigation，不保存正文。 |
| implementation boundary | pass；不调用backend、repository、port或adapter，不产生run / evidence / test事实。 |

Step 7~10 必须定向替换 historical `CleanupGuard.evaluate(capture, handoff, investigation)`：Step 7 service必须先按source factory组装`CleanupEvidenceSnapshot`；Step 8 protocol不得传caller bool或 raw investigation status；Step 9 flow必须区分 completed / terminal / boundary-only；Step 10 matrix只允许`CleanupGuard` truth拥有状态迁移，`CleanupSafetyDecision`不是状态机。

### 14.2 `CleanupGuard`

#### 14.2.1 Capability、fields 与 factory

`CleanupGuard` 是一组 exact context / optional run / boundary / handle / lease 的 cleanup readiness 与 completion truth。它唯一拥有 `CleanupGuardStatus` 状态迁移和 release / context closure / handoff block permission；它不执行 release adapter、不删除 material、不关闭 context、不推进外部 investigation，也不把 `Allowed` 写成 `Completed`。

```rust
/// 记录一组 exact execution lineage 的 cleanup readiness、blocker和completion truth。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct CleanupGuard {
    /// cleanup truth 的 Sandbox-local typed identity。
    cleanup_guard_ref: CleanupGuardRef,
    /// 形成当前decision的immutable safety guard ref。
    safety_guard_ref: CleanupSafetyGuardRef,
    /// owning controlled execution context ref。
    context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
    /// owning execution environment identity ref。
    environment_identity_ref: ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef,
    /// completed / terminal source的exact run；boundary-only为`None`。
    run_ref: Option<ControlledExecutionRunRef>,
    /// exact coherent boundary ref。
    boundary_ref: CoherentBoundaryRef,
    /// exact isolation environment handle ref。
    isolation_handle_ref: IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef,
    /// handle预绑定的exact lease ref；partial handle也必须有该ref。
    lease_ref: LeaseRecordRef,
    /// context / boundary / handle / lease共用的canonical generation。
    generation_ref: ResourceRef,
    /// 最近一次accepted evaluation使用的body-free evidence snapshot。
    evidence_snapshot: CleanupEvidenceSnapshot,
    /// 最近一次accepted investigation handoff summary。
    investigation_summary: InvestigationHandoffSummary,
    /// optional matching orphan recovery record ref。
    orphan_record_ref: Option<OrphanRecoveryRecordRef>,
    /// 最近一次accepted evaluation完整消费的redline lineage coverage。
    redline_coverage: RedlineContainmentCoverageSnapshot,
    /// cleanup readiness / completion的canonical status。
    guard_status: CleanupGuardStatus,
    /// current pending / blocked reason set；`Allowed | Completed`必须为空。
    blocking_reasons: CleanupBlockingReasonSet,
    /// current status的caller-safe owner reason。
    status_reason: SandboxReason,
    /// safety guard fixed catalog提供的completed reason；只在完成时写入status reason。
    completion_reason: SandboxReason,
    /// 首次release authorization后保存的immutable checked basis；未授权时为空。
    release_basis: Option<CleanupReleaseBasis>,
    /// matching backend release confirmation形成的immutable completion basis；未确认时为空。
    completion_basis: Option<CleanupCompletionBasis>,
    /// backend teardown已确认但late redline仍阻断closure时保存的exact blocker set。
    post_release_redline_blocks: CleanupBlockingReasonSet,
    /// definitive non-retryable release failure形成的immutable blocked proof；未失败时为空。
    release_failure_basis: Option<CleanupReleaseFailureBasis>,
    /// guard truth首次打开时间。
    opened_at: Timestamp,
    /// 最近一次pure safety evaluation time。
    evaluated_at: Timestamp,
    /// 当前或最近一次进入`Allowed`的时间；从未allowed时为空。
    allowed_at: Option<Timestamp>,
    /// backend release及owner closure全部验证完成的时间；非`Completed`为空。
    completed_at: Option<Timestamp>,
    /// current status生效时间，必须单调不回退。
    status_changed_at: Timestamp,
    /// 最近一次truth transition的audit trace ref。
    last_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
}

impl CleanupGuard {
    /// 从exact evidence、safety decision与audit创建初始readiness truth。
    pub fn open(
        cleanup_guard_ref: CleanupGuardRef,
        safety_guard: &CleanupSafetyGuard,
        evidence: CleanupEvidenceSnapshot,
        investigation: InvestigationHandoffSummary,
        decision: CleanupSafetyDecision,
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        opened_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, CleanupGuardError>;

    /// 授权前应用完整新decision，或在release确认后仅重评fresh完整redline coverage。
    pub fn apply_decision(
        &mut self,
        safety_guard: &CleanupSafetyGuard,
        evidence: CleanupEvidenceSnapshot,
        investigation: InvestigationHandoffSummary,
        decision: CleanupSafetyDecision,
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        changed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), CleanupGuardError>;

    /// 为exact release target生成并保存checked basis；重复授权只能返回同一basis。
    pub fn authorize_release_for(
        &mut self,
        context: &ControlledExecutionContext,
        boundary: &CoherentBoundary,
        handle: &IsolationEnvironmentHandle,
        lease: Option<&LeaseRecord>,
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        authorized_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<CleanupReleaseBasis, CleanupGuardError>;

    /// 从matching release basis与typed backend confirmation生成completion basis。
    pub fn require_completion_basis(
        &self,
        release_basis: &CleanupReleaseBasis,
        handle: &IsolationEnvironmentHandle,
        release_observation: &IsolationEnvironmentLifecycleObservation,
        lifecycle_summary: BackendLifecycleSummary,
        current_redline_coverage: &RedlineContainmentCoverageSnapshot,
        current_redlines: &[RedlineContainment],
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        confirmed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<CleanupCompletionBasis, CleanupGuardError>;

    /// 消费matching definitive release failure，将已授权guard原子收束为`Blocked`。
    pub fn record_release_failure(
        &mut self,
        release_basis: &CleanupReleaseBasis,
        failure_observation: CleanupReleaseFailureObservation,
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        recorded_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<CleanupReleaseFailureBasis, CleanupGuardError>;

    /// 在owner均消费同一confirmation后，按fresh完整redline coverage收束为Completed或post-release safety hold。
    pub fn settle_release_confirmation(
        &mut self,
        completion_basis: &CleanupCompletionBasis,
        boundary: &CoherentBoundary,
        handle: &IsolationEnvironmentHandle,
        lease: Option<&LeaseRecord>,
        orphan: Option<&OrphanRecoveryRecord>,
        current_redline_coverage: RedlineContainmentCoverageSnapshot,
        current_redlines: &[RedlineContainment],
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        settled_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<CleanupGuardStatus, CleanupGuardError>;

    /// 判断当前guard是否允许exact target发起或恢复同一authorization的release。
    pub fn permits_release_for(
        &self,
        context_ref: &ControlledExecutionContextRef,
        boundary_ref: &CoherentBoundaryRef,
        handle_ref: &IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef,
        lease_ref: &LeaseRecordRef,
    ) -> bool;

    /// 判断当前guard是否已完成，且current完整redline coverage允许exact context进入closure。
    pub fn permits_context_closure_for(
        &self,
        context_ref: &ControlledExecutionContextRef,
        current_redline_coverage: &RedlineContainmentCoverageSnapshot,
        current_redlines: &[RedlineContainment],
    ) -> Result<bool, CleanupGuardError>;

    /// 为exact handoff / context / run生成active cleanup block observation。
    pub fn require_handoff_block(
        &self,
        handoff_ref: &HandoffFactRef,
        context_ref: &ControlledExecutionContextRef,
        run_ref: &ControlledExecutionRunRef,
    ) -> Result<HandoffCleanupBlockObservation, CleanupGuardError>;

    /// 证明exact handoff / context / run已不再被本guard阻断。
    pub fn require_handoff_unblocked(
        &self,
        handoff_ref: &HandoffFactRef,
        context_ref: &ControlledExecutionContextRef,
        run_ref: &ControlledExecutionRunRef,
    ) -> Result<(), CleanupGuardError>;

    /// 返回cleanup guard identity。
    pub fn cleanup_guard_ref(&self) -> &CleanupGuardRef;
    /// 返回immutable safety guard ref。
    pub fn safety_guard_ref(&self) -> &CleanupSafetyGuardRef;
    /// 返回owning context ref。
    pub fn context_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionContextRef;
    /// 返回owning environment identity ref。
    pub fn environment_identity_ref(&self) -> &ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef;
    /// 返回optional exact run ref。
    pub fn run_ref(&self) -> Option<&ControlledExecutionRunRef>;
    /// 返回exact boundary ref。
    pub fn boundary_ref(&self) -> &CoherentBoundaryRef;
    /// 返回exact handle ref。
    pub fn isolation_handle_ref(&self) -> &IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef;
    /// 返回exact lease ref。
    pub fn lease_ref(&self) -> &LeaseRecordRef;
    /// 返回canonical generation ref。
    pub fn generation_ref(&self) -> &ResourceRef;
    /// 返回最近一次accepted evidence snapshot。
    pub fn evidence_snapshot(&self) -> &CleanupEvidenceSnapshot;
    /// 返回最近一次accepted investigation summary。
    pub fn investigation_summary(&self) -> &InvestigationHandoffSummary;
    /// 返回optional orphan recovery ref。
    pub fn orphan_record_ref(&self) -> Option<&OrphanRecoveryRecordRef>;
    /// 返回最近一次accepted evaluation完整消费的redline coverage。
    pub fn redline_coverage(&self) -> &RedlineContainmentCoverageSnapshot;
    /// 返回canonical cleanup status。
    pub fn guard_status(&self) -> CleanupGuardStatus;
    /// 返回current blocker set。
    pub fn blocking_reasons(&self) -> &CleanupBlockingReasonSet;
    /// 返回current caller-safe status reason。
    pub fn status_reason(&self) -> &SandboxReason;
    /// 返回fixed cleanup completion reason。
    pub fn completion_reason(&self) -> &SandboxReason;
    /// 返回optional persisted release authorization basis。
    pub fn release_basis(&self) -> Option<&CleanupReleaseBasis>;
    /// 返回optional persisted release completion basis。
    pub fn completion_basis(&self) -> Option<&CleanupCompletionBasis>;
    /// 返回teardown confirmation后仍阻断closure的exact redline blockers。
    pub fn post_release_redline_blocks(&self) -> &CleanupBlockingReasonSet;
    /// 返回optional persisted definitive release failure basis。
    pub fn release_failure_basis(&self) -> Option<&CleanupReleaseFailureBasis>;
    /// 返回guard open time。
    pub fn opened_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
    /// 返回latest pure evaluation time。
    pub fn evaluated_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
    /// 返回optional allowed time。
    pub fn allowed_at(&self) -> Option<&Timestamp>;
    /// 返回optional completion time。
    pub fn completed_at(&self) -> Option<&Timestamp>;
    /// 返回current status change time。
    pub fn status_changed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
    /// 返回latest transition audit ref。
    pub fn last_audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;

    /// 判断当前status是否要求handoff / material retention block。
    pub fn blocks_cleanup(&self) -> bool;
}
```

#### 14.2.2 Release、completion 与 handoff checked carrier
