```rust
/// 已授权release attempt可被Sandbox接受为terminal failure的有限类别。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum CleanupReleaseFailureKind {
    /// matching release operation明确返回non-retryable failed outcome。
    ReleaseAttemptFailed,
    /// release authorization后的typed lifecycle inspection返回non-retryable terminal failure。
    LifecycleInspectionFailed,
    /// matching backend target / generation返回definitive lifecycle conflict。
    BackendLifecycleConflict,
}

/// adapter / inspection mapper对exact release target形成的body-free definitive failure observation。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct CleanupReleaseFailureObservation {
    /// finite non-retryable failure kind。
    failure_kind: CleanupReleaseFailureKind,
    /// exact stable backend environment source ref。
    backend_handle_ref: ExternalSourceRef,
    /// body-free failure summary ref。
    failure_summary_ref: SafeSummaryRef,
    /// observation所属的canonical generation。
    generation_ref: ResourceRef,
    /// owner-provided caller-safe failure reason。
    reason: SandboxReason,
    /// typed failure observation time。
    observed_at: Timestamp,
}

impl CleanupReleaseFailureObservation {
    /// 从finite kind、exact backend target和body-free summary构造checked observation。
    pub fn try_new(
        failure_kind: CleanupReleaseFailureKind,
        backend_handle_ref: ExternalSourceRef,
        failure_summary_ref: SafeSummaryRef,
        generation_ref: ResourceRef,
        reason: SandboxReason,
        observed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, CleanupReleaseFailureObservationError>;

    /// 返回finite failure kind。
    pub fn failure_kind(&self) -> CleanupReleaseFailureKind;
    /// 返回exact backend environment source ref。
    pub fn backend_handle_ref(&self) -> &ExternalSourceRef;
    /// 返回body-free failure summary ref。
    pub fn failure_summary_ref(&self) -> &SafeSummaryRef;
    /// 返回canonical generation ref。
    pub fn generation_ref(&self) -> &ResourceRef;
    /// 返回caller-safe failure reason。
    pub fn reason(&self) -> &SandboxReason;
    /// 返回typed observation time。
    pub fn observed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
}

/// definitive release failure observation的source、generation或time校验失败。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum CleanupReleaseFailureObservationError {
    /// backend target不是isolation backend source。
    BackendHandleSourceKindInvalid {
        /// 实际external source kind。
        actual: ExternalSourceKind,
    },
    /// failure summary不是isolation backend safe summary。
    FailureSummarySourceKindInvalid {
        /// 实际summary source kind。
        actual: ExternalSourceKind,
    },
    /// backend target source version与显式generation不一致。
    GenerationMismatch,
    /// observation time不满足canonical timestamp contract。
    InvalidObservedAt,
}

/// `CleanupGuard`对persisted authorization形成的immutable terminal release-failure proof。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct CleanupReleaseFailureBasis {
    /// owning cleanup guard ref。
    cleanup_guard_ref: CleanupGuardRef,
    /// exact persisted release authorization。
    release_basis: CleanupReleaseBasis,
    /// exact definitive failure observation。
    failure_observation: CleanupReleaseFailureObservation,
    /// optional exact orphan attempt；必须等于release basis中的值。
    orphan_record_ref: Option<OrphanRecoveryRecordRef>,
    /// failure transition audit ref。
    audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    /// guard将authorization收束为blocked的time。
    failed_at: Timestamp,
}

impl CleanupReleaseFailureBasis {
    /// 返回owning cleanup guard ref。
    pub fn cleanup_guard_ref(&self) -> &CleanupGuardRef;
    /// 返回exact release authorization。
    pub fn release_basis(&self) -> &CleanupReleaseBasis;
    /// 返回exact definitive failure observation。
    pub fn failure_observation(&self) -> &CleanupReleaseFailureObservation;
    /// 返回optional exact orphan recovery attempt ref。
    pub fn orphan_record_ref(&self) -> Option<&OrphanRecoveryRecordRef>;
    /// 返回failure transition audit ref。
    pub fn audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;
    /// 返回guard blocked time。
    pub fn failed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
}

/// cleanup guard对一个exact handoff batch形成的只读blocking observation。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct HandoffCleanupBlockObservation {
    /// observation唯一适用的handoff batch ref。
    handoff_ref: HandoffFactRef,
    /// owning cleanup guard ref。
    cleanup_guard_ref: CleanupGuardRef,
    /// guard明确给出的caller-safe blocking reason。
    blocking_reason: SandboxReason,
    /// guard evaluation / change的canonical time。
    observed_at: Timestamp,
}

impl HandoffCleanupBlockObservation {
    /// 返回observation唯一适用的handoff ref。
    pub fn handoff_ref(&self) -> &HandoffFactRef;
    /// 返回owning cleanup guard ref。
    pub fn cleanup_guard_ref(&self) -> &CleanupGuardRef;
    /// 返回caller-safe blocking reason。
    pub fn blocking_reason(&self) -> &SandboxReason;
    /// 返回guard observation time。
    pub fn observed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
}
```

`HandoffCleanupBlockObservation` 的 canonical schema 由本节唯一拥有；`6R-03` §22.1只保留consumer引用，不能再定义constructor或第二套字段。该carrier只能由`CleanupGuard::require_handoff_block`返回，不进入public DTO、repository主键或event payload，也不能修改target progress。

`CleanupReleaseBasis`、`CleanupCompletionBasis` 和 `CleanupReleaseFailureBasis` 都是 guard row 的embedded immutable proof。它们没有独立typed ref，也不形成第二状态机。completion / failure basis必须延续同一个release authorization、optional orphan attempt ref、authorization redline coverage和exact backend handle source；completion basis还必须保存completion-time current coverage与late-ref差集，failure basis直接嵌入完整authorization，不能只靠timestamp或execution lineage猜测前序attempt。application必须在调用外部 release adapter前原子保存release basis；adapter只能对basis中的`backend_handle_ref`发起幂等release。crash恢复只能读取同一basis和同一backend target，不得重新计算新的`Allowed`、扫描latest handle或改用新source后盲调adapter。matching confirmation与definitive failure分别形成互斥的completion / failure proof；commit未知的处置留Step 11~13，但不得丢失已持久化proof。

#### 14.2.3 Factory、decision application 与 status closure

`open` 与 `apply_decision` 必须验证 decision 的 safety guard、context、identity、run、boundary、handle、lease、generation、orphan、redline和observed handoff cleanup override全部等于输入 evidence / current guard。decision的`guard_status`只能是`PendingEvidence | PendingInvestigation | Blocked | Allowed`；`Completed`作为pure evaluation输出必须typed reject。

`open` 逐项写入：

1. guard identity不得与safety guard、context、boundary、handle、lease底层resource identity碰撞；
2. evidence、investigation和decision必须来自同一次或更早observation，`opened_at >= decision.evaluated_at >= evidence.assembled_at`；
3. `guard_status`、blocker set和status reason直接复制decision，不允许application覆盖；
4. `completion_reason`复制`CleanupSafetyReasonCatalog::cleanup_completed()`；
5. `allowed_at = Some(opened_at)`仅当decision为`Allowed`，其它为`None`；`release_basis`、`completion_basis`、`release_failure_basis`、`completed_at`均为`None`，`post_release_redline_blocks`为空；
6. optional orphan ref与完整redline coverage只来自decision，不接收caller额外ref、单条latest redline或
   `no_redline: bool`。

`apply_decision` 有且只有以下两个合法模式。caller不能只凭status选择模式，method必须从三类persisted basis的
cardinality、current status与decision relation机械判定：

1. **pre-authorization full re-evaluation**：要求`release_basis / completion_basis /
   release_failure_basis`全部为`None`，允许按新的committed evidence、investigation、optional orphan与完整redline
   coverage重评；
2. **post-release redline-only re-evaluation**：要求`release_basis / completion_basis`均为`Some`、
   `release_failure_basis=None`，current status只能是post-release `PendingInvestigation | Blocked`。输入evidence、
   investigation、orphan与所有非redline source字段必须和guard保存值完全相等；唯一允许前进的source是同lineage、
   更晚或相等cursor的完整redline coverage及其exact rows。owner closure由紧随其后的settlement再次验证。coverage不得
   丢失旧ref，新增ref必须有晚于前一coverage observation的formal detection relation；decision blocker只能是
   `RedlineHandoffPending | RedlineContainmentActive | RedlineTerminal`。任何capture、handoff、observability、orphan、
   release failure或自由文本blocker变化均返回typed relation error，不得借此重开teardown或修改已Released owner。

pre-authorization模式允许的状态图为：

```text
PendingEvidence <-> PendingInvestigation
PendingEvidence <-> Blocked
PendingInvestigation <-> Blocked
PendingEvidence | PendingInvestigation | Blocked -> Allowed
Allowed -> PendingEvidence | PendingInvestigation | Blocked
Allowed -> Allowed (new equal-lineage decision refresh)
```

该图不是允许任意caller写status：每次transition都必须由`CleanupSafetyGuard::evaluate`生成matching decision。
`Allowed -> pending / blocked`只用于release尚未授权时的新证据或新redline先到。一旦`authorize_release_for`持久化
basis，full re-evaluation固定返回`ReleaseAuthorizationAlreadyPersisted`；只有上面的post-release redline-only模式可在
matching confirmation及owner closure后继续。该模式只能把hold保持在`PendingInvestigation | Blocked`，或在全部current
redline均`Released`时形成transaction-local `Allowed`。后者必须在同一UoW立即调用
`settle_release_confirmation`进入`Completed`，不得flush、commit、materialize或被query观察为
`Allowed + completion_basis Some`。同一UoW的redline-vs-release single-winner、外部release idempotency和
commit-unknown恢复由Step 11~13展开；设计上禁止新decision静默覆盖已发出的authorization。

`authorize_release_for` 必须满足：

| check | exact rule |
|---|---|
| status / blocker | `guard_status == Allowed`、blocker set为空、completion / failure basis均为空；`Completed`或已finalized outcome不重新授权 |
| target lineage | context / identity / boundary / handle / backend handle / lease ref / generation与guard及loaded handle完全相等；backend source kind必须为`IsolationBackend` |
| partial handle | `lease = None`只允许boundary `Failed`且snapshot `lease_status = None`；initial `BoundaryOnly`要求handle `Created`，`BoundaryOnlyReleaseFailureRecovery`要求handle `ReleasePending`并保留matching prior failure basis |
| normal handle | `lease = Some`时lease row ref / handle / context / identity / boundary / generation全部匹配，且lease未`Released` |
| existing basis | `None`时创建并保存；basis必须从loaded handle复制exact backend target、从guard复制optional orphan ref与完整redline coverage；coverage中每条都必须为`Released`。`Some`且target、owner refs、coverage、reason、audit与time完全相等时返回clone作idempotent replay；任一字段不等时报错。新guard的recovery basis必须使用新的audit / time，且不能复制prior authorization identity。 |
| side effect | method本身不调用adapter；application只能在basis与audit同UoW提交后调用external release port |

`require_completion_basis` 不修改self。它首先要求`release_failure_basis.is_none()`；一旦definitive failure已经终结当前authorization，即使backend target、generation或调用参数相同也必须返回`CleanupReleaseOutcomeAlreadyFinalized`，不能从旧guard形成completion proof。随后要求self已保存与入参完全相等的release basis，handle当前为`ReleasePending`，且`basis.backend_handle_ref == handle.backend_handle_ref`。release observation必须为`ReleaseConfirmed`，其backend handle / generation必须同时等于basis与handle；传入`BackendLifecycleSummary`必须为`Released`，且其`backend_handle_ref`、summary、generation和observation time与同一release observation完全一致。`confirmed_at`不得早于authorization或observation。

本method还必须接收completion UoW fresh-read的`RedlineContainmentCoverageSnapshot`与exact loaded
containment rows：authorization coverage必须是current coverage的identity子集；共有ref的lineage不可变化；差集只能包含
`detected_at > release_basis.authorized_at`的late redline。current coverage中存在
`Detected | Contained | HandoffPending | Terminal`时，method仍可形成“matching backend teardown已确认”的completion
basis，但该basis必须保存current coverage与late ref set，后续`settle_release_confirmation`不得把它解释为context
closure permission。
coverage不完整、旧cursor、ref消失、非late新增或loaded set不一致必须返回typed error，不得用旧authorization coverage
继续。success复制exact lineage、backend target、optional orphan ref、两次coverage、late refs、release authorization time +
audit identity、summary ref、fixed completion reason和completion audit linkage。

`CleanupCompletionBasis` 不能通过独立confirmation recorder写入guard；该历史中间方法失效。
application在matching confirmation UoW内先让handle、optional lease / orphan和boundary消费同一basis，再只调用
`settle_release_confirmation`。repository禁止把`Allowed + completion_basis Some`单独flush、commit、materialize或暴露
给reader。若任一owner closure或settlement失败，整个UoW回滚，已确认外部side effect只通过同一authorization的
operation recovery处理，不保存half-committed guard row。

`settle_release_confirmation`先验证owner rows已按同一basis进入`Released / Recovered`，再验证传入current coverage与
basis的completion coverage完全相等、loaded redline set同构。其唯一三类结果为：

| current complete redline coverage | guard结果 | exact effect |
|---|---|---|
| 空，或全部`Released` | `Completed` | 保存completion basis，blockers为空，写completed time；允许后续context closure。 |
| 至少一条`HandoffPending`且其余均`Released` | `PendingInvestigation` | 保存completion basis；按exact ref生成`RedlineHandoffPending` blockers并保存current coverage；`completed_at=None`，不得关闭context或处置材料。 |
| 任一`Detected | Contained | Terminal` | `Blocked` | 保存completion basis；按exact ref生成`RedlineContainmentActive | RedlineTerminal` blockers并保存current coverage；`completed_at=None`，不得关闭context或处置材料。 |

post-release safety hold并不重新调用backend，也不把Released owner复活。后续`apply_decision`必须遵守上述
redline-only模式：保留release / completion basis和全部非redline snapshot，只接受fresh完整coverage，按每条exact ref
重建redline blocker。所有redline变为Released后，application必须在同一UoW继续调用原
`settle_release_confirmation`，在不重放adapter或owner transition的前提下把guard推进到Completed；Terminal则持续
Blocked。重复完全相等settlement幂等，不同confirmation basis、coverage ref消失、cursor回退或非redline字段变化返回
collision / coverage error。

`record_release_failure`的检查顺序固定，不能先按current status拒绝幂等重放：

1. 若`release_failure_basis = Some(persisted)`，先比较入参release basis、failure observation、audit ref和`recorded_at`是否可机械重建出完全相等的persisted basis；完全相等时立即返回clone，即使current status已经是`Blocked`；任一字段不同返回`CleanupReleaseFailureBasisCollision`。
2. 只有当前不存在failure basis时，才要求persisted release basis与入参完全相等、`guard_status == Allowed`、blocker set为空且`completion_basis.is_none()`；已有completion（包括post-release safety hold）时返回`CleanupReleaseOutcomeAlreadyFinalized`。
3. failure observation的backend handle / generation必须等于release basis，`observed_at >= authorized_at`，`recorded_at >= observed_at`。success机械创建`CleanupReleaseFailureBasis`，以`ReleaseFailureTerminal + ReleaseTarget(handle_ref) + observation.reason`构造唯一blocker set，写`guard_status = Blocked`、`status_reason = observation.reason`、`release_failure_basis = Some`、status time / audit，并保留原release basis。

method不把failure映射为retryable：只有Step 7 adapter已经明确给出本节三类non-retryable typed observation时才能调用；unavailable、timeout、retryable、unknown和commit unknown保持`Allowed + release_basis Some`，沿同一operation恢复。failure basis一旦存在，同一guard不得`apply_decision`、重新授权、形成completion或调用`settle_release_confirmation`；后续处置必须创建新的cleanup guard和新的orphan recovery attempt，并显式关联旧failure basis，不能把旧guard从`Blocked`改回`Allowed`。

`settle_release_confirmation`只有在所有适用owner都已消费同一completion basis后才可判断最终guard状态：

| owner | required completed relation |
|---|---|
| handle | status `Released`；latest lifecycle summary等于completion summary；ref / generation相等 |
| lease | `lease_record_present = true`时必须`Some`且status `Released`；partial handle时必须`None` |
| orphan | guard有orphan ref时必须`Some`且status `Recovered`；无ref时必须`None` |
| boundary | status `Released`且handle ref等于guard handle |
| guard | `release_failure_basis = None`；persisted completion basis为空或与入参相等；current coverage完整；settlement time不回退 |

`settle_release_confirmation`在检查owner rows前必须先拒绝`release_failure_basis.is_some()`；失败authorization无论其它owner当前状态如何都不能完成旧guard。只有current coverage全部Released时才写`guard_status = Completed`、`status_reason = completion_reason`、`completed_at / status_changed_at / audit`；存在late active/terminal redline时按上表保存pending/blocked blockers和coverage，并保持`completed_at=None`。所有分支保留evidence、investigation、release / completion basis和全部lineage。`Completed`终态不可重开；已关闭后的新incident必须进入新incident truth，不能覆盖历史guard。

exact status / field relation：

| status | blockers | `allowed_at` | release basis | completion basis | release failure basis | `completed_at` | permission |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PendingEvidence` | non-empty，仅pending evidence kinds | `None`或保留历史allowed time | `None` | `None` | `None` | `None` | block handoff/release |
| `PendingInvestigation` pre-authorization | non-empty，至少一项investigation pending kind | `None`或保留历史allowed time | `None` | `None` | `None` | `None` | block handoff/release |
| `PendingInvestigation` post-release redline hold | non-empty，全部为exact `RedlineHandoffPending` | 保留历史allowed time | `Some` | `Some` | `None` | `None` | teardown已确认；只等待redline release，禁止context/material closure |
| `Blocked` pre-authorization | non-empty，至少一项hard blocker | `None`或保留历史allowed time | `None` | `None` | `None` | `None` | block handoff/release |
| `Blocked` post-release redline hold | non-empty，仅`RedlineContainmentActive | RedlineTerminal` | 保留历史allowed time | `Some` | `Some` | `None` | teardown已确认；持续阻断context/material closure |
| `Blocked` release-failed | exactly one `ReleaseFailureTerminal` | 保留历史allowed time | `Some` | `None` | `Some` | `None` | terminal block；same guard不可重授权 |
| `Allowed` pre-authorization | empty | `Some` | `None` | `None` | `None` | `None` | 可生成release basis |
| `Allowed` authorized in-flight | empty | `Some` | `Some` | `None` | `None` | `None` | 只允许同basis adapter release / typed inspection / confirmation recovery |
| `Allowed` release-confirmed, transaction-local only | empty | `Some` | `Some` | `Some` | `None` | `None` | 只允许same completion UoW内推进owner closure与`settle_release_confirmation`；不得flush / commit / materialize、再调adapter或重授权 |
| `Completed` | empty | `Some` | `Some` | `Some` | `None` | `Some` | 允许context closure，不再调用release |

`allowed_at`记录首次或最近一次进入`Allowed`的时间；从Allowed回到pending/blocked时保留历史值只用于audit，不构成permission。permission永远以current status、exact refs和basis relation判断，不能以`allowed_at.is_some()`判断。

#### 14.2.4 Four forward methods exact semantics

| method | success condition | negative cut |
|---|---|---|
| `permits_release_for` | current status `Allowed`、blockers empty、completion / failure basis均为空、exact四refs相等；没有release basis时允许首次authorization，有matching release basis时只允许恢复同一backend target | 不接收optional lease row、不比较status字符串、不读取config/operator flag、不扫描latest guard；completion basis存在后固定false，boundary / lease / orphan closure直接消费matching basis |
| `permits_context_closure_for` | current status `Completed`、exact context相等、completion basis存在且其context相等；current complete coverage与loaded rows exact同构、cursor不早于guard coverage且每条status均为Released | 单参数旧签名、`Allowed`、post-release hold、空但无coverage proof、handle / lease / boundary Released任一单项都不足以关闭context |
| `require_handoff_block` | guard有run ref且入参全部匹配；current status为`PendingEvidence | PendingInvestigation | Blocked`；evidence source handoff ref等于入参；返回dominant blocker reason | boundary-only无handoff时拒绝；`Allowed | Completed`拒绝；不接受caller reason或`cleanup_blocked: bool` |
| `require_handoff_unblocked` | guard有run ref且全部匹配；current status为`Allowed | Completed`；blocker set为空；evidence source handoff ref等于入参 | query view、job disposition、handoff aggregate label或仅有guard ref均不能解除block |

`require_handoff_block` 返回的`observed_at`使用guard `status_changed_at`，不是current clock；`require_handoff_unblocked`只返回`Ok(())`，由`HandoffFact::clear_cleanup_guard_block`删除exact matching override后按原progress重算aggregate。两方法都不修改guard或handoff，也不重放delivery receipt。

#### 14.2.5 `CleanupGuardError`

```rust
/// cleanup truth factory、decision、release basis、handoff relation或completion不变量失败。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum CleanupGuardError {
    /// cleanup guard identity与任一owning identity发生底层碰撞。
    CleanupIdentityCollision,
    /// safety guard ref与decision / current guard不一致。
    CleanupSafetyGuardMismatch,
    /// decision与evidence / investigation / orphan / redline / generation关系不一致。
    CleanupDecisionSourceMismatch,
    /// decision尝试构造`Completed`或status / blockers / reason relation无效。
    CleanupDecisionStatusRelationInvalid {
        /// relation无法成立的canonical cleanup status。
        status: CleanupGuardStatus,
    },
    /// current guard与context / identity / run / boundary / handle / lease lineage不一致。
    CleanupLineageMismatch,
    /// open / apply / authorization / confirmation / completion时间发生回退。
    CleanupTimestampMovedBackwards,
    /// current status不允许requested transition。
    CleanupTransitionNotAllowed {
        /// cleanup guard identity。
        cleanup_guard_ref: CleanupGuardRef,
        /// transition前canonical status。
        from: CleanupGuardStatus,
        /// caller请求的目标status。
        to: CleanupGuardStatus,
    },
    /// release authorization已经持久化，禁止以新decision替换snapshot。
    ReleaseAuthorizationAlreadyPersisted,
    /// current guard不是`Allowed`或仍有blocker，不能授权release。
    CleanupReleaseNotAllowed {
        /// authorization时观察到的canonical status。
        actual: CleanupGuardStatus,
    },
    /// partial handle与optional lease row presence不满足boundary-only规则。
    CleanupReleaseLeasePresenceInvalid,
    /// 已有release basis与本次target / audit / time不一致。
    CleanupReleaseBasisCollision,
    /// release basis不属于current guard或target lineage不一致。
    CleanupReleaseBasisMismatch,
    /// release authorization的backend target不是loaded handle保存的exact source。
    CleanupReleaseBackendTargetMismatch,
    /// handle尚未进入`ReleasePending`，不能形成completion basis。
    CleanupHandleWasNotReleasePending {
        /// handle实际canonical status。
        actual: IsolationEnvironmentHandleStatus,
    },
    /// release observation不是matching `ReleaseConfirmed`。
    CleanupReleaseObservationInvalid,
    /// `BackendLifecycleSummary`不是matching `Released` summary。
    CleanupReleaseSummaryInvalid,
    /// completion basis已经存在但与新confirmation不一致。
    CleanupCompletionBasisCollision,
    /// completion basis与current guard / release basis relation不一致。
    CleanupCompletionBasisMismatch,
    /// authorization与completion redline coverage不是合法的subset / late-ref关系。
    CleanupCompletionRedlineCoverageMismatch,
    /// current complete coverage与loaded redline rows不是exact同构，不能完成或关闭context。
    CleanupCurrentRedlineCoverageIncomplete,
    /// authorization后新增redline不满足strictly-late detection time或lineage relation。
    CleanupLateRedlineRelationInvalid,
    /// completion已确认但post-release redline blocker set与current coverage不一致。
    CleanupPostReleaseRedlineBlockerMismatch,
    /// completion proof、release observation、lifecycle summary与authorization backend target不一致。
    CleanupCompletionBackendTargetMismatch,
    /// definitive release failure observation与persisted authorization target / generation / time不一致。
    CleanupReleaseFailureObservationMismatch,
    /// release failure basis已经存在但与新observation / audit / time不一致。
    CleanupReleaseFailureBasisCollision,
    /// release已经确认completion，不能再记录failure；或failure已终结authorization，不能再记录completion。
    CleanupReleaseOutcomeAlreadyFinalized,
    /// completion时handle未确认`Released`。
    CleanupHandleWasNotReleased {
        /// handle实际canonical status。
        actual: IsolationEnvironmentHandleStatus,
    },
    /// persisted lease row未进入`Released`或presence错误。
    CleanupLeaseWasNotReleased,
    /// matching orphan record未进入`Recovered`或presence错误。
    CleanupOrphanWasNotRecovered,
    /// matching boundary未进入`Released`。
    CleanupBoundaryWasNotReleased {
        /// boundary实际canonical status。
        actual: CoherentBoundaryStatus,
    },
    /// handoff / context / run与guard保存的source relation不一致。
    CleanupHandoffLineageMismatch,
    /// boundary-only cleanup没有handoff source却请求handoff observation。
    CleanupHandoffWasNotApplicable,
    /// current guard状态不要求active handoff block。
    CleanupHandoffBlockNotRequired {
        /// guard当前canonical status。
        actual: CleanupGuardStatus,
    },
    /// current guard尚未达到可解除handoff block的状态。
    CleanupHandoffStillBlocked {
        /// guard当前canonical status。
        actual: CleanupGuardStatus,
    },
    /// current blocker set缺少dominant caller-safe reason。
    CleanupBlockingReasonMissing,
    /// `Completed` guard被请求重新评估、授权或改写。
    CompletedCleanupGuardImmutable,
}
```

`CleanupGuardError`不包装adapter raw error。Step 7 port必须把外部结果分成matching `ReleaseConfirmed`、本节三类definitive `CleanupReleaseFailureObservation`，以及retryable / unavailable / unknown；最后一组不得调用completion或failure transition。只有matching confirmation才能形成completion basis，只有matching definitive observation才能形成failure basis。`CleanupReleaseNotAllowed`、`CleanupHandoffStillBlocked`等错误只能携带canonical status，不能回显blocker文本集合或external summary body。

#### 14.2.6 Batch 3 reserved lease / orphan release extension

batch 3在§13.2 / §13.3保留的release / recovery surface现已由batch 4激活。`LeaseRecord::mark_released`、`OrphanRecoveryRecord::{mark_recovering, mark_recovered, mark_failed}`及对应error variants的唯一canonical声明已经并回各自owner section；本节只固定跨对象basis relation和Step 9顺序，不形成第二套Rust签名或error enum片段。

`mark_recovering`只允许`Confirmed -> Recovering`，且current `recovery_release_basis`与`recovery_failure_basis`必须都为`None`。它必须先验证`release_basis.orphan_record_ref() == Some(self.orphan_record_ref())`，再验证basis的cleanup guard、lease / handle / context / identity / optional run / boundary / generation与本record完全一致，并要求`release_basis.backend_handle_ref() == self.backend_lifecycle_summary.backend_handle_ref()`；仅有相同execution lineage而orphan attempt ref缺失、指向另一条record或backend target不同均必须拒绝。`changed_at`不得早于current status time或basis authorization time。成功后clone并持久化exact `CleanupReleaseBasis`到`recovery_release_basis`，保留`confirmed_at`和原confirmation evidence，保持`recovery_failure_basis = None`，以release authorization reason更新`status_reason`、status time和audit；method不调用backend。

`mark_recovered`只允许`Recovering -> Recovered`，且必须已经保存exact `recovery_release_basis`并保持`recovery_failure_basis = None`。它必须验证`completion_basis.orphan_record_ref() == Some(self.orphan_record_ref())`，并按cleanup guard ref、release authorization time + audit identity、lease presence、lease / handle / backend handle / context / identity / optional run / boundary / generation逐项证明completion延续persisted release basis；不能只比较lineage或相信调用顺序。随后要求`lifecycle_summary.observation_kind() == Released`，且backend handle / summary / generation / observation time与completion basis相等。成功后保留同一`recovery_release_basis`、保存released summary、继续保持`recovery_failure_basis = None`、保留`confirmed_at`，以completion reason更新status / time / audit。`Recovered`终态不再可作为new failure source。

`mark_failed`只允许`Recovering -> Failed`。failure basis的`orphan_record_ref`必须为`Some(self.orphan_record_ref)`，其embedded release basis必须与persisted `recovery_release_basis`完全相等，cleanup guard ref / backend target / generation / authorization audit / time均不得变化；`failed_at`不得早于basis failure time或current status time。success保存clone到`recovery_failure_basis`，保留release basis和confirmed time，以failure observation reason更新status / time / audit。retryable、unavailable、unknown或commit unknown没有failure basis，因此不能调用本method。

batch 4 不开放`Failed -> Recovering`重试。一次recovery attempt失败后必须新建`OrphanRecoveryRecordRef`，以旧record作为related source而不是原地复活；该规则保持§13.3的terminal immutability。

#### 14.2.7 Owner-group release ordering 与 self-review

推荐的Step 9 transaction / external-call承接顺序固定为：

```text
load exact cleanup group
  -> CleanupSafetyGuard::evaluate(...)
  -> CleanupGuard::open / apply_decision
  -> if Allowed: cleanup.authorize_release_for(...)
  -> initial source: handle.mark_release_pending(&cleanup, ...)
  -> boundary-only release-failure recovery: verify same handle already ReleasePending; no handle transition
  -> orphan.mark_recovering(&release_basis, ...) when orphan ref exists
  -> stage guard release basis + handle/orphan transitions + audit + stored result
  -> commit authorization before external call
  -> call isolation release port idempotently with persisted basis identity
  -> classify typed release outcome
     -> confirmed branch:
        fresh-read complete redline coverage + exact containment rows
        cleanup.require_completion_basis(...fresh coverage...)
        handle.mark_released(...existing observation...)
        lease.mark_released(&completion_basis) when row exists
        orphan.mark_recovered(&completion_basis, summary) when ref exists
        boundary.mark_released(&handle, &completion_basis, ...)
        cleanup.settle_release_confirmation(...owners + fresh coverage...)
        if cleanup is Completed:
          fresh-read complete redline coverage again
          context.close(&cleanup, coverage, same completion reason)
          identity.close(&context, same completion reason)
        else:
          retain post-release redline safety hold; do not close context / identity / material
        stage all owner rows + audit + stored result
        commit one completion UoW
     -> definitive non-retryable failure branch:
        cleanup.record_release_failure(&persisted_release_basis, ...)
        orphan.mark_failed(&release_failure_basis, ...) when orphan ref exists
        stage blocked cleanup + optional failed orphan + audit + stored result
        commit one failure UoW
     -> retryable / unavailable / timeout / unknown / commit-unknown branch:
        keep persisted authorization state unchanged
        recover or inspect only with the same release basis identity
```

initial source的`handle.mark_release_pending(&cleanup, ...)`与optional `orphan.mark_recovering(&release_basis, ...)`必须在authorization commit前同一UoW调用，使handle进入`ReleasePending`、matching orphan attempt保存exact authorization并进入`Recovering`。`BoundaryOnlyReleaseFailureRecovery`的partial handle已经由prior authorization保持`ReleasePending`，新guard不得再次调用该transition；authorization UoW只保存new guard basis、audit和stored result，并验证handle version未变化。`CleanupGuard::permits_release_for`只授权initial handle transition或同一authorization的幂等release恢复；completion-stage boundary closure直接消费matching `CleanupCompletionBasis`。release confirmation后handle继续消费原`IsolationEnvironmentLifecycleObservation`；completion basis让lease / orphan / boundary / guard验证同一confirmation，不替代handle自己的backend source check。

matching confirmation分支必须把completion basis、handle / lease / optional orphan / boundary / cleanup settlement及stored result放入同一UoW；不得先提交`Released` handle再best-effort补guard settlement。只有fresh complete coverage为空或全部Released时，context / identity closure才能进入该UoW；存在late active / terminal redline时，owner teardown与post-release safety hold必须原子提交，而context / identity / material保持未关闭。definitive non-retryable failure分支必须先由`cleanup.record_release_failure`形成exact basis，再把该basis传给matching orphan；两项以及audit / stored result在同一UoW提交。failure commit成功后handle保持`ReleasePending`、lease保持原`Active | Expiring | Expired | OrphanSuspected`、boundary保持原`Established | Failed`、cleanup固定`Blocked`，optional orphan固定`Failed`；任何owner都不得被误写成`Released | Recovered | Completed`。

若authorization commit成功但external call为retryable / unavailable / timeout / unknown，或side effect / transaction outcome为commit unknown，guard保持`Allowed + release_basis Some + completion_basis None + release_failure_basis None`，handle保持`ReleasePending`，orphan若存在保持`Recovering`；不得回退到pending、创建新basis或宣称completed。恢复只能先读取persisted basis与stored operation result，再对同一`backend_handle_ref`做typed lifecycle inspection或幂等release。只有matching confirmation进入completion分支，只有明确属于同一authorization的non-retryable typed failure进入failure分支。

definitive failure提交后旧guard与旧orphan attempt均不可复活。后续处置必须满足以下fresh recovery gate：

1. 重新加载旧`CleanupReleaseFailureBasis`、handle、lease、boundary及optional failed orphan，确认旧guard仍`Blocked`且basis中的cleanup / orphan / backend target / generation未变化；
2. 通过`BackendLifecycleInspectionPort`取得晚于旧failure observation的fresh body-free lifecycle observation。唯一mapper必须从同一source / summary / generation / reason / observed time形成handle消费的`IsolationEnvironmentLifecycleObservation`和orphan消费的`BackendLifecycleSummary`；禁止分别调用backend后拼接两份观察、复用导致旧failure的observation或扫描latest handle替代exact target；
3. 若summary已为matching `Released`，进入Step 11~13的late-confirmation reconciliation，不能让旧guard完成，也不能伪造第二次release；
4. 若summary仍为non-released且存在lease row，lease必须已经`Expired | OrphanSuspected`；`ReleasePending` handle先用fresh non-released observation和owner proof进入`OrphanSuspected`，再以新的`OrphanRecoveryRecordRef`执行`suspect -> confirm`。若lease尚未满足orphan eligibility，则保持旧failure终态并等待合法lease/lifecycle推进，不创建伪orphan；
5. partial handle没有persisted lease row时，不创建`OrphanRecoveryRecord`；由`CleanupEvidenceSnapshot::from_boundary_only_release_failure`以旧blocked guard / failure basis、fresh lifecycle summary和current `ReleasePending` handle形成exact evidence，再由新的`CleanupGuardRef`形成boundary-only recovery operation；
6. 新cleanup guard必须从fresh evidence / investigation /完整redline coverage重新evaluate，并使用新的`CleanupGuardRef`。Step 9 / 11~13必须在audit / operation truth中显式关联旧failure basis与新orphan attempt或boundary-only recovery；禁止复制旧guard的`Allowed`、修改旧basis、复用旧orphan ref或跳过fresh inspection。

若redline在authorization前赢得写入，则fresh evaluation阻断release；若与authorization并发，二者必须在同一lineage
safety group上使用expected-version compare-and-set，不能由“最后写入状态”决定。具体repository callable、retry和
commit-unknown仍由Step 7 / 11~13重验，但不得改变本节single-winner语义。authorization提交后到completion提交前的
redline按本节post-release safety hold处理，不允许丢失或覆盖。

| 审查项 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| unique owner / path | pass；`CleanupGuard`与support family #32唯一在`cleanup.rs`，无新path。 |
| state owner | pass；只复用shared 5-value `CleanupGuardStatus`；decision不构造Completed。 |
| four forward methods | pass；exact signature、success relation、typed error和negative cut均闭合。 |
| partial handle | pass；lease ref必有但lease row可无，不伪造`LeaseRecord`。 |
| crash recovery | pass；release / completion basis及两次redline coverage持久化embedded，不依赖call stack bool。 |
| definitive failure | pass；cleanup block与optional orphan failure同UoW，handle保持未释放；timeout / unknown不伪造terminal failure。 |
| fresh retry gate | pass；旧guard / orphan不可复活；必须fresh lifecycle inspection、新guard，以及适用时新的orphan attempt。 |
| external call boundary | pass；domain只授权 / 验证typed confirmation，不实现backend release。 |
| orphan reserved states | pass；`Confirmed -> Recovering -> Recovered`有exact checked basis；Failed不复活。 |
| evidence / investigation | pass；body-free refs / finite disposition，no raw body。 |
| redline cardinality / race | pass；完整coverage逐条阻断；authorization / detection single-winner；late redline进入post-release hold。 |
| context closure | pass；只有`Completed`、exact context与fresh complete all-Released coverage才允许，`Allowed`或owner Released不足。 |
| historical ghost method | pass；不存在`cleanup_guard_ref`-only transition、single optional redline、独立confirmation recorder half-commit或caller-computed release bool。 |

本句是§14.2完成时的局部写作检查点：其后§14.3~§14.4已闭合redline guard / truth、`RedlineRunBasis`、forward #8和`FailureSourceMarker::from_redline`反向重验，batch 4 current closure以§14A为准。

### 14.3 `RedlineContainmentGuard`

#### 14.3.1 Capability、不可绕过边界与 support family #33

`RedlineContainmentGuard` 是安全红线的不可变 strict rule snapshot。它只消费已完成 typed lineage 和 body-free source validation 的 `RedlineSignal`，机械生成一次 containment decision；它不查 repository、不调 backend、不终止 run、不删除 material、不推进 investigation lifecycle，也不接受 enable flag、allowlist、severity threshold、backend profile 或 caller override。

support family #33 在 §14.3~§14.4 仅包含以下 embedded / transient carrier：

| carrier | owner | 作用 | identity / persistence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `RedlineImpact` | `redline.rs` | 区分 active-run、post-run 与 boundary-only containment | signal / decision / truth embedded enum |
| `BoundaryRedlineObservationKind` | `redline.rs` | 为 trusted boundary source保存可重验的有限 discriminator | signal-source embedded enum |
| `RedlineSignalSource` | `redline.rs` | 穷尽 boundary、high-risk 与 forbidden-body source | signal / truth embedded union |
| `RedlineSignal` | `redline.rs` | 绑定 redline kind、typed source、execution lineage 与 safe reason | transient checked input；不独立持久化 |
| `SecurityRedlineRule`;`SecurityRedlineRuleSet` | `redline.rs` | 保存八类 `RedlineKind` 都必须执行的不可删减规则 | guard-owned immutable values |
| `ContainmentRequirement`;`ContainmentRequirementSet` | `redline.rs` | 保存 stop-new-use / terminate / preserve / block-cleanup / handoff / audit 要求 | decision / truth embedded values |
| `InvestigationRequirement`;`InvestigationRequirementSet` | `redline.rs` | 保存 investigation target、safe summary 和 acceptance 门禁 | decision / truth embedded values |
| `RedlineSafetyMarker`;`RedlineSafetyMarkerSet` | `redline.rs` | 保存机械派生的安全处置 marker | decision / truth embedded values |
| `RedlineReasonCatalog` | `redline.rs` | 保存 contained / pending / terminal / released 固定 safe reason | guard / decision / truth embedded value |
| `RedlineContainmentDecision` | `redline.rs` | 保存一次 pure detection / containment 决策 | transient checked output |
| `RedlineReleaseDisposition` | `redline.rs` | 穷尽 keep-pending / terminal / release 三类 guard结果 | transient decision enum |
| `RedlinePreservationBasis` | `redline.rs` | 区分 run material、post-run material 与 boundary signal | snapshot embedded union |
| `RedlinePreservationSnapshot` | `redline.rs` | 统一 run-material、post-run material与boundary-signal preservation source | containment-embedded persisted recovery snapshot；无独立ref / repository identity |
| `RedlineInvestigationHandoffObservation` | `redline.rs` | 绑定 preservation snapshot、investigation target / receipt 和 finite disposition | containment-embedded latest persisted observation；release basis复制exact value，无独立ref |
| `RedlineReleaseDecision` | `redline.rs` | 保存 containment owner 对 cleanup block 的有限解除裁定 | transient checked output |
| `RedlineContainmentBasis` | `redline.rs` | 保存 stop-new-use、matching failure 与 optional run result proof | `RedlineContainment` embedded proof |
| `RedlineReleaseBasis` | `redline.rs` | `Released` 状态保留的 immutable release proof | `RedlineContainment` embedded proof |
| `RedlineRunBasis` | `redline.rs` | 供 exact run 终止消费的 typed proof | transient proof；§14.4 闭合 |

historical `SecurityRedlineKind` 、`InvestigationHandoffRef` 和 `RedlineReleaseSummary` 不进入 current schema。kind 只复用 shared canonical `RedlineKind`；investigation 只复用 §14.1 的 `InvestigationHandoffSummary`；release 必须由 guard 根据 exact containment、preservation snapshot 和 investigation relation 产生 checked decision，不接收 caller 传入的 release bool 或文本说明。

本表中的`embedded persisted`表示value随`RedlineContainment` aggregate row原子保存并由repository rehydration重验，不表示新增独立repository或typed ref。`RedlinePreservationSnapshot`是external handoff前的durable recovery point；`RedlineInvestigationHandoffObservation`保存current snapshot对应的latest body-free observation。refresh使旧observation失效时只清空aggregate内latest slot，append-only audit / operation history仍保留，不能把两类carrier实现成仅存在于call stack的临时值。

#### 14.3.2 Typed redline signal / source

```rust
/// 区分 redline detection 对 run / boundary 的 exact 影响面。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum RedlineImpact {
    /// detection 时 run 为 `Preparing | Running`，必须终止 run 并使 boundary 停止新使用。
    ActiveRunAndBoundary,
    /// detection 时没有 run，只需收紧 boundary / handle 并交接 typed signal。
    BoundaryOnly,
    /// detection 时 run 已是 `Completed | Failed | Terminated`，不改写既有终态，只保留材料并收紧 boundary。
    PostRunPreservation,
}

/// trusted boundary observer 可提交的有限安全红线观察类别。
///
/// 该 enum 是 adapter 到 domain 的 typed discriminator；不得由 reason、
/// backend status code、source ref 文本或 caller 提供的 `RedlineKind` 反推。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum BoundaryRedlineObservationKind {
    /// 文件系统、workspace 或 mount 边界已被越过。
    FilesystemBoundaryViolated,
    /// network boundary 外的连接或出口已被观察到。
    NetworkBoundaryViolated,
    /// process、namespace、signal 或 child-process 边界已被越过。
    ProcessBoundaryViolated,
    /// 未授权宿主资源或宿主路径访问已被观察到。
    UnauthorizedHostAccessObserved,
    /// host-run、local-process 或其它旁路执行已冒充受控执行。
    HostExecutionBypassObserved,
    /// trusted boundary observer 已确认 secret material 暴露。
    SecretExposureObserved,
    /// trusted boundary observer 已确认未授权高风险动作尝试。
    UnauthorizedHighRiskActionObserved,
    /// 已确认存在安全红线，但无法归入前七类。
    OtherSecurityBoundaryViolation,
}

impl BoundaryRedlineObservationKind {
    /// 穷尽映射为 shared canonical redline kind。
    pub fn redline_kind(self) -> RedlineKind;
}

/// 区分 redline signal 唯一允许的 typed owner source。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum RedlineSignalSource {
    /// isolation backend / trusted boundary observer 提供的 body-free 红线观察。
    BoundaryObservation {
        /// adapter 已完成 typed mapping 的有限 boundary observation kind。
        observation_kind: BoundaryRedlineObservationKind,
        /// source kind 必须为 `IsolationBackend | Runner`。
        source_ref: ExternalSourceRef,
        /// 与 source kind 一致的 body-free safe summary ref。
        summary_ref: SafeSummaryRef,
    },
    /// 运行期已观察到且 non-allowed 的 high-risk action decision。
    HighRiskDecision {
        /// exact immutable high-risk action decision ref。
        action_decision_ref: HighRiskActionDecisionRef,
        /// decision 从 observed marker原样保留的 exact active run ref。
        observed_run_ref: ControlledExecutionRunRef,
        /// decision 从 marker 原样保留的 canonical high-risk action kind。
        action_kind: HighRiskActionKind,
        /// decision 形成时的 canonical non-allowed status。
        action_status: HighRiskActionDecisionStatus,
    },
    /// forbidden external body marker 已命中安全红线处置。
    ForbiddenBody {
        /// 发现 forbidden-body breach 的 stable body-free source ref。
        source_ref: ExternalSourceRef,
        /// non-empty ordered-unique forbidden-body marker set。
        markers: ForbiddenExternalBodyMarkerSet,
        /// 发现 marker 的 body-free owner summary。
        summary_ref: SafeSummaryRef,
    },
}

/// 一次已通过 typed source / execution lineage 校验的安全红线输入。
///
/// signal 不保存 host path、network destination、process command、secret、
/// tool invocation、runtime loop、backend response 或 investigation body。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct RedlineSignal {
    /// 共享 canonical 安全红线类别。
    redline_kind: RedlineKind,
    /// 从 optional run detection status 机械派生的影响面。
    redline_impact: RedlineImpact,
    /// exact accepted controlled execution context ref。
    context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
    /// exact execution environment identity ref。
    environment_identity_ref: ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef,
    /// 可选 exact run；运行前 / boundary-only detection 为 `None`。
    run_ref: Option<ControlledExecutionRunRef>,
    /// exact coherent boundary ref。
    boundary_ref: CoherentBoundaryRef,
    /// exact isolation environment handle ref。
    isolation_handle_ref: IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef,
    /// boundary / handle / optional run 共用的 canonical generation。
    generation_ref: ResourceRef,
    /// detection 时 boundary 的 canonical status。
    detected_boundary_status: CoherentBoundaryStatus,
    /// detection 时 handle 的 canonical status。
    detected_handle_status: IsolationEnvironmentHandleStatus,
    /// run 存在时 detection 时的 canonical run status。
    detected_run_status: Option<ControlledExecutionRunStatus>,
    /// 红线的 typed source owner。
    source: RedlineSignalSource,
    /// source owner 提供的 caller-safe reason。
    reason: SandboxReason,
    /// source owner 观察到红线的 canonical time。
    detected_at: Timestamp,
}

impl RedlineSignal {
    /// 从 matching context / identity / boundary / handle 和 typed backend observation 构造 signal。
    pub fn from_boundary_observation(
        observation_kind: BoundaryRedlineObservationKind,
        context: &ControlledExecutionContext,
        identity: &ExecutionEnvironmentIdentity,
        run: Option<&ControlledExecutionRun>,
        boundary: &CoherentBoundary,
        handle: &IsolationEnvironmentHandle,
        source_ref: ExternalSourceRef,
        summary_ref: SafeSummaryRef,
        reason: SandboxReason,
        detected_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, RedlineContainmentGuardError>;

    /// 从运行期 `ObservedAttempt + non-Allowed` high-risk decision 机械构造 signal。
    pub fn from_high_risk_decision(
        context: &ControlledExecutionContext,
        identity: &ExecutionEnvironmentIdentity,
        run: &ControlledExecutionRun,
        boundary: &CoherentBoundary,
        handle: &IsolationEnvironmentHandle,
        decision: &HighRiskActionDecision,
        detected_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, RedlineContainmentGuardError>;

    /// 从非空 forbidden-body marker 和 matching safe summary 构造 signal。
    pub fn from_forbidden_body(
        context: &ControlledExecutionContext,
        identity: &ExecutionEnvironmentIdentity,
        run: Option<&ControlledExecutionRun>,
        boundary: &CoherentBoundary,
        handle: &IsolationEnvironmentHandle,
        source_ref: ExternalSourceRef,
        markers: ForbiddenExternalBodyMarkerSet,
        summary_ref: SafeSummaryRef,
        reason: SandboxReason,
        detected_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, RedlineContainmentGuardError>;

    /// 返回 canonical redline kind。
    pub fn redline_kind(&self) -> RedlineKind;
    /// 返回 source-derived redline impact。
    pub fn redline_impact(&self) -> RedlineImpact;
    /// 返回 exact context ref。
    pub fn context_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionContextRef;
    /// 返回 exact environment identity ref。
    pub fn environment_identity_ref(&self) -> &ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef;
    /// 返回 optional exact run ref。
    pub fn run_ref(&self) -> Option<&ControlledExecutionRunRef>;
    /// 返回 exact boundary ref。
    pub fn boundary_ref(&self) -> &CoherentBoundaryRef;
    /// 返回 exact isolation handle ref。
    pub fn isolation_handle_ref(&self) -> &IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef;
    /// 返回 canonical generation ref。
    pub fn generation_ref(&self) -> &ResourceRef;
    /// 返回 detection 时 boundary status。
    pub fn detected_boundary_status(&self) -> CoherentBoundaryStatus;
    /// 返回 detection 时 handle status。
    pub fn detected_handle_status(&self) -> IsolationEnvironmentHandleStatus;
    /// 返回 optional detection-time run status。
    pub fn detected_run_status(&self) -> Option<ControlledExecutionRunStatus>;
    /// 返回 typed source owner。
    pub fn source(&self) -> &RedlineSignalSource;
    /// 返回 caller-safe reason。
    pub fn reason(&self) -> &SandboxReason;
    /// 返回 source detection time。
    pub fn detected_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
}
```

factory relation 固定如下：

| source | exact acceptance rule | kind mapping rule | forbidden fallback |
|---|---|---|---|
| boundary observation | source / summary kind 必须相等且只能为 `IsolationBackend | Runner`；context `Accepted`、identity `Active`；normal path为boundary `Established | Failed` + handle `Created | Active | OrphanSuspected`；cleanup-race path只允许boundary `Failed` + handle `ReleasePending`，且optional run只能为`None`或`Completed | Failed | Terminated`；optional run存在时全 lineage 相等；source保存exact `BoundaryRedlineObservationKind` | factory只调用`observation_kind.redline_kind()`；caller不提供`RedlineKind`，guard对保存的kind再执行同一穷尽映射 | raw backend event、status code、host path、network address、process command、caller-supplied redline kind、`ReleasePending`上的active run |
| high-risk decision | decision 必须为 `ObservedAttempt`，`requires_redline_containment() == true`，status 只允许 `Blocked | PendingAuthorization | Unsupported`；`decision.observed_run_ref == run.run_ref`且不为空，decision / run / boundary / handle / generation 全相等；run detection status只允许`Preparing | Running`；signal source复制同一`observed_run_ref`、`action_kind`与status | `FilesystemExpansion -> FilesystemBoundaryBreach`；`NetworkEgress -> NetworkBoundaryBreach`；`ProcessEscape -> ProcessBoundaryBreach`；`SecretExposure -> SecretExposure`；`ResourceExpansion | Unknown -> UnauthorizedHighRiskAction`；factory与guard都从保存的`action_kind`穷尽派生 | `Requested` decision、missing / mismatched observed run、boundary latest-run scan、`Allowed`、aggregate policy status、marker reason 文本解析、caller-supplied redline kind |
| forbidden body | marker set 非空且必须包含 `SecretMaterial`；summary kind 只能为 source owner 的 `IsolationBackend | Runner | Policy | Investigation`；lineage 全相等；normal path optional run可为active或terminal；cleanup-race path只允许boundary `Failed` + handle `ReleasePending`且run absent或terminal | factory固定派生`SecretExposure`，guard以保存的`SecretMaterial` marker重验；caller不提供kind | marker body、raw investigation note、仅根据其它marker enum猜测host / filesystem / network / process语义、caller-supplied redline kind、release-pending active run |

boundary observation 的穷尽映射固定如下；新增 `BoundaryRedlineObservationKind` variant 时必须编译失败并回到本表，不允许 wildcard 落入 `Other`：

| boundary observation kind | exact `RedlineKind` |
|---|---|
| `FilesystemBoundaryViolated` | `FilesystemBoundaryBreach` |
| `NetworkBoundaryViolated` | `NetworkBoundaryBreach` |
| `ProcessBoundaryViolated` | `ProcessBoundaryBreach` |
| `UnauthorizedHostAccessObserved` | `UnauthorizedHostAccess` |
| `HostExecutionBypassObserved` | `HostExecutionBypass` |
| `SecretExposureObserved` | `SecretExposure` |
| `UnauthorizedHighRiskActionObserved` | `UnauthorizedHighRiskAction` |
| `OtherSecurityBoundaryViolation` | `Other` |

impact 映射不允许 caller 选择：`run_ref == None -> BoundaryOnly`；`detected_run_status == Preparing | Running -> ActiveRunAndBoundary`；`Completed | Failed | Terminated -> PostRunPreservation`。run ref / status option 不成对、active run 与 boundary / handle lineage 不一致或 caller 尝试修改 impact 时必须 typed reject。

`ReleasePending` 不是一般新增允许状态。它只承接“release authorization已提交、teardown进行中时收到trusted
boundary / forbidden-body signal”的cleanup race：boundary必须已经`Failed`，run不得active，且后续
`mark_contained`必须消费matching persisted `CleanupReleaseBasis`形成§14.4的
`AlreadyFailedDuringAuthorizedRelease` proof。high-risk decision factory仍只接受active run与active handle；它不能把
release-pending observation补造成运行期action decision。`Released` handle不进入本factory；如果redline ingestion晚到
该终态，必须走后续security incident intake，不能原地复活closed owner或伪造本cleanup race。

`RedlineKind::Other` 不是 unknown-success 或兼容桶。只有 trusted adapter 已能证明“存在安全红线，但当前八项中的前七项无法进一步细分”并显式提交 `BoundaryRedlineObservationKind::OtherSecurityBoundaryViolation` 时才能派生，仍必须走完全量 containment、preservation、investigation 和 audit 规则。

#### 14.3.3 Strict rule / requirement / safety marker closed sets

```rust
/// 不可配置删减的 security redline hard rule。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum SecurityRedlineRule {
    /// 所有八类 redline 都必须形成 formal containment truth。
    RequireFormalContainmentTruth,
    /// redline 不得只记录 warning / log / metric / UI marker。
    ForbidAdvisoryOnlyHandling,
    /// detection 后立即停止 exact boundary / handle 的新 launch 和新 use。
    StopNewBoundaryUse,
    /// 存在 exact preparing / running run 时必须形成 typed termination basis。
    TerminateActiveRun,
    /// 必须保存 body-free observability / investigation material 及 source linkage。
    PreserveSecurityMaterial,
    /// containment owner 解除前 cleanup / release 必须被阻断。
    BlockCleanupUntilDisposition,
    /// 必须进行 security investigation handoff，且 Sandbox 不冒充调查完成。
    RequireInvestigationHandoff,
    /// 每次状态迁移必须保留 append-only audit linkage。
    PreserveAuditLinkage,
    /// `Released` 不得恢复 run、boundary 或 handle 的新使用。
    ForbidExecutionResumption,
}

/// 保存九条完整 hard rule 的 canonical strict set。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct SecurityRedlineRuleSet(Vec<SecurityRedlineRule>);

impl SecurityRedlineRuleSet {
    /// 返回本设计唯一允许的九条 strict default。
    pub fn strict_default() -> Self;
    /// 构造完整规则集；缺失、重复或新增任一成员都拒绝。
    pub fn try_new(
        rules: Vec<SecurityRedlineRule>,
    ) -> Result<Self, RedlineContainmentGuardError>;
    /// 返回 canonical rule sequence。
    pub fn as_slice(&self) -> &[SecurityRedlineRule];
    /// 判断 exact rule 是否存在；checked set 对全部九项恒为 true。
    pub fn contains(&self, rule: SecurityRedlineRule) -> bool;
}

/// containment 必须执行的 Sandbox-side 有限要求。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum ContainmentRequirement {
    /// 立即阻止 exact boundary / handle 的新 launch 与新 use。
    StopNewUse,
    /// 有 exact active run 时必须终止该 run。
    TerminateRun,
    /// 保留 body-free observability material。
    PreserveObservabilityMaterial,
    /// 保留 investigation handoff 所需 refs / safe summary。
    PreserveInvestigationMaterial,
    /// containment owner 未解除前阻断 cleanup / release。
    BlockCleanup,
    /// 打开或继续 security investigation handoff。
    OpenInvestigationHandoff,
    /// 将 detection / transition 关联到 Sandbox audit trace。
    AppendAuditLinkage,
}

/// 一次 redline decision 的 non-empty canonical containment requirement set。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct ContainmentRequirementSet(Vec<ContainmentRequirement>);

impl ContainmentRequirementSet {
    /// 按 signal 是否带 exact active run 机械构造完整要求集。
    pub fn strict_for_signal(signal: &RedlineSignal) -> Self;
    /// 仅供 rehydration validator 构造；必须与 strict signal relation 完全一致。
    pub fn try_for_signal(
        signal: &RedlineSignal,
        requirements: Vec<ContainmentRequirement>,
    ) -> Result<Self, RedlineContainmentGuardError>;
    /// 返回 canonical requirement sequence。
    pub fn as_slice(&self) -> &[ContainmentRequirement];
    /// 判断是否包含 exact requirement。
    pub fn contains(&self, requirement: ContainmentRequirement) -> bool;
}

/// security investigation handoff 必须满足的有限要求。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum InvestigationRequirement {
    /// 必须存在 typed investigation target ref。
    RequireTypedTarget,
    /// 必须存在 body-free investigation safe summary ref。
    RequireSafeSummary,
    /// 必须对 observability / investigation material 形成可验证 handoff acceptance。
    RequireAcceptedHandoff,
    /// 外部 owner 明确 block / fail 时必须保持 containment。
    RespectExternalBlock,
    /// 不得保存 investigation case / note / response body。
    ExcludeInvestigationBody,
}

/// 五条 investigation 要求的完整 canonical set。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct InvestigationRequirementSet(Vec<InvestigationRequirement>);

impl InvestigationRequirementSet {
    /// 返回所有 redline kind 共用的 strict investigation requirement set。
    pub fn strict_default() -> Self;
    /// 构造完整五项 set；缺失、重复或额外成员都拒绝。
    pub fn try_new(
        requirements: Vec<InvestigationRequirement>,
    ) -> Result<Self, RedlineContainmentGuardError>;
    /// 返回 canonical requirement sequence。
    pub fn as_slice(&self) -> &[InvestigationRequirement];
}

/// 安全审查与 read model 可复用的有限 marker。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum RedlineSafetyMarker {
    /// exact execution lineage 已通过 typed validation。
    LineageValidated,
    /// 新 launch / use 必须立即停止。
    NewUseBlocked,
    /// exact active run 需要终止。
    RunTerminationRequired,
    /// body-free security material 必须保留。
    MaterialPreservationRequired,
    /// cleanup / release 必须保持阻断。
    CleanupBlockRequired,
    /// security investigation handoff 必须完成 acceptance。
    InvestigationHandoffRequired,
    /// append-only audit linkage 必须保留。
    AuditLinkageRequired,
    /// 该 redline 已被安全终态化，不得 normal release。
    TerminalContainmentRequired,
}

/// 按 canonical order 保存且不重复的 redline safety marker set。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct RedlineSafetyMarkerSet(Vec<RedlineSafetyMarker>);

impl RedlineSafetyMarkerSet {
    /// 从 signal 和 containment requirements 机械派生 marker set。
    pub fn from_requirements(
        signal: &RedlineSignal,
        requirements: &ContainmentRequirementSet,
    ) -> Result<Self, RedlineContainmentGuardError>;
    /// 返回 canonical marker sequence。
    pub fn as_slice(&self) -> &[RedlineSafetyMarker];
    /// 判断 marker set 是否包含 exact marker。
    pub fn contains(&self, marker: RedlineSafetyMarker) -> bool;

    /// 仅供 `RedlineContainment::mark_terminal` 在完成 exact terminal decision 校验后重建 marker set。
    fn with_terminal_containment_required(
        &self,
    ) -> Result<Self, RedlineContainmentError>;
}

/// redline guard 和 truth 共用的四项 caller-safe 固定 reason catalog。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct RedlineReasonCatalog {
    /// stop-new-use / optional run termination 已证明的 reason。
    contained: SandboxReason,
    /// 等待 preservation / investigation handoff 的 reason。
    handoff_pending: SandboxReason,
    /// external block / failed 后进入 terminal containment 的 reason。
    terminal: SandboxReason,
    /// 解除 redline owner cleanup block 的 reason。
    released: SandboxReason,
}

impl RedlineReasonCatalog {
    /// 从四个已验证 `SandboxReason` 构造 immutable catalog。
    pub fn new(
        contained: SandboxReason,
        handoff_pending: SandboxReason,
        terminal: SandboxReason,
        released: SandboxReason,
    ) -> Self;
    /// 返回 contained reason。
    pub fn contained(&self) -> &SandboxReason;
    /// 返回 handoff-pending reason。
    pub fn handoff_pending(&self) -> &SandboxReason;
    /// 返回 terminal containment reason。
    pub fn terminal(&self) -> &SandboxReason;
    /// 返回 cleanup-block released reason。
    pub fn released(&self) -> &SandboxReason;
}
```

`ContainmentRequirementSet::strict_for_signal` 总是包含 `StopNewUse + PreserveObservabilityMaterial + PreserveInvestigationMaterial + BlockCleanup + OpenInvestigationHandoff + AppendAuditLinkage`；只在 signal 的 `detected_run_status == Some(Preparing | Running)` 时再必须包含 `TerminateRun`。已终态 run 仍保留 redline lineage、material preservation、investigation 和 audit 要求，但不能被二次终止或改写 terminal owner。backend 不可用或 material handoff 尚未打开也不能删除其它 hard requirement。

`RedlineSafetyMarkerSet` 不是第二状态机，不作 repository key，不单独发 event。`RunTerminationRequired` 只在 signal detection 时 run 为 `Preparing | Running` 时出现；`TerminalContainmentRequired` 只能在 §14.4 已选择 terminal disposition 的 truth 中附加，initial guard decision 不得猜测外部调查结论。`with_terminal_containment_required` 是同模块 private rebuild helper：输入必须是完整 initial marker set且尚无 terminal marker，输出只按 canonical order追加一次 `TerminalContainmentRequired`；重复追加、缺失 initial required marker或从非 terminal transition 调用都返回 `RedlineTerminalMarkerTransitionInvalid`，不得暴露给 application、DTO、repository mapper或 caller直接调用。

#### 14.3.4 Guard decision、release decision 与 exact evaluation

```rust
/// strict redline guard 对一个 checked signal 形成的 immutable containment decision。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct RedlineContainmentDecision {
    /// 形成 decision 的 guard ref。
    guard_ref: RedlineContainmentGuardRef,

    redline_kind: RedlineKind,
    /// signal-derived redline impact。
    redline_impact: RedlineImpact,
    /// exact context ref。
    context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
    /// exact environment identity ref。
    environment_identity_ref: ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef,
    /// optional exact run ref。
    run_ref: Option<ControlledExecutionRunRef>,
    /// exact boundary ref。
    boundary_ref: CoherentBoundaryRef,
    /// exact isolation handle ref。
    isolation_handle_ref: IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef,
    /// canonical generation ref。
    generation_ref: ResourceRef,
    /// 本 decision 唯一绑定的 typed signal source。
    signal_source: RedlineSignalSource,

    containment_requirements: ContainmentRequirementSet,
    /// 不可删减的 investigation requirements。
    investigation_requirements: InvestigationRequirementSet,

    safety_markers: RedlineSafetyMarkerSet,
    /// source owner 提供的 caller-safe detection reason。

    reason_catalog: RedlineReasonCatalog,

}

impl RedlineContainmentDecision {
    /// 返回 guard ref。

    /// 返回 canonical redline kind。
    pub fn redline_kind(&self) -> RedlineKind;
    /// 返回 source-derived redline impact。
    pub fn redline_impact(&self) -> RedlineImpact;
    /// 返回 exact context ref。
    pub fn context_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionContextRef;
    /// 返回 exact environment identity ref。
    pub fn environment_identity_ref(&self) -> &ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef;
    /// 返回 optional exact run ref。
    pub fn run_ref(&self) -> Option<&ControlledExecutionRunRef>;
    /// 返回 exact boundary ref。
    pub fn boundary_ref(&self) -> &CoherentBoundaryRef;
    /// 返回 exact handle ref。
    pub fn isolation_handle_ref(&self) -> &IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef;
    /// 返回 canonical generation ref。
    pub fn generation_ref(&self) -> &ResourceRef;
    /// 返回 typed signal source。
    pub fn signal_source(&self) -> &RedlineSignalSource;
    /// 返回 complete containment requirements。
    pub fn containment_requirements(&self) -> &ContainmentRequirementSet;
    /// 返回 complete investigation requirements。
    pub fn investigation_requirements(&self) -> &InvestigationRequirementSet;
    /// 返回 safety markers。
    pub fn safety_markers(&self) -> &RedlineSafetyMarkerSet;
    /// 返回 caller-safe decision reason。
    pub fn decision_reason(&self) -> &SandboxReason;
    /// 返回 immutable lifecycle reason catalog。
    pub fn reason_catalog(&self) -> &RedlineReasonCatalog;
    /// 返回 guard evaluation time。

}

/// guard 对 containment owner 是否可解除 cleanup block 形成的有限裁定。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum RedlineReleaseDisposition {
    /// material / investigation 证据尚未安全交接，继续保持 `HandoffPending`。
    KeepPending,
    /// external owner明确block / fail，或material终态失败且责任交接已收束，进入`Terminal`。
    MakeTerminal,
    /// 所有 release prerequisites 已满足，解除 redline owner 对 cleanup 的 block。
    ReleaseCleanupBlock,
}

/// 区分 redline release evaluation 允许消费的三类 body-free preservation source。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum RedlinePreservationBasis {
    /// active run 终止后形成的 exact redline observability material。
    RunMaterial {
        /// exact redline observability material ref。
        observability_material_ref: ObservabilityMaterialRef,
        /// material 已经由其唯一 owner 记录的 handoff status。
        material_status: ObservabilityMaterialStatus,
        /// `Prepared` 时为 `None`；其余三态为 owner 保存的 exact material handoff ref。
        observability_handoff_ref: Option<HandoffFactRef>,
    },
    /// post-run redline 不改写既有 terminal owner，但保留 exact existing material 与 redline signal。
    PostRunMaterial {
        /// exact existing observability material ref。
        observability_material_ref: ObservabilityMaterialRef,
        /// existing material 的 canonical handoff status。
        material_status: ObservabilityMaterialStatus,
        /// `Prepared` 时为 `None`；其余三态为 owner 保存的 exact material handoff ref。
        observability_handoff_ref: Option<HandoffFactRef>,
        /// 必须被 redline-specific investigation observation 显式接收的 typed signal source。
        signal_source: RedlineSignalSource,
    },
    /// pre-launch / boundary-only redline 没有 run material，只保留 exact typed signal source。
    BoundarySignal {
        /// high-risk source 不能走 boundary-only；其它 source 必须与 containment saved signal 相等。
        signal_source: RedlineSignalSource,
    },
}

/// 为 release evaluation 固定 exact containment lineage 和 preservation source。

    assembled_at: Timestamp,
}

    /// 返回 exact containment ref。

    /// 返回 optional exact run ref。

    /// 完整九条 security hard rule。
```
