```rust
    /// 完整五条 investigation hard requirement。
    investigation_requirements: InvestigationRequirementSet,
    /// contained / pending / terminal / released 的 immutable safe reason catalog。
    reason_catalog: RedlineReasonCatalog,
    /// guard activation time。
    activated_at: Timestamp,
}

impl RedlineContainmentGuard {
    /// 用完整 strict default 创建 guard；不接受 enable / override / severity config。
    pub fn strict(
        guard_ref: RedlineContainmentGuardRef,
        reason_catalog: RedlineReasonCatalog,
        activated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, RedlineContainmentGuardError>;

    /// 仅用于 rehydration / fixture validation；rule 与 requirement 必须等于 strict default。
    pub fn bind_strict(
        guard_ref: RedlineContainmentGuardRef,
        redline_rules: SecurityRedlineRuleSet,
        investigation_requirements: InvestigationRequirementSet,
        reason_catalog: RedlineReasonCatalog,
        activated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, RedlineContainmentGuardError>;

    /// 对一个 checked signal 形成 pure containment decision。
    pub fn evaluate_signal(
        &self,
        signal: &RedlineSignal,
        evaluated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<RedlineContainmentDecision, RedlineContainmentGuardError>;

    /// 对 `HandoffPending` truth 与 exact preservation / investigation 形成 release decision。
    pub fn evaluate_release(
        &self,
        containment: &RedlineContainment,
        observation: &RedlineInvestigationHandoffObservation,
        evaluated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<RedlineReleaseDecision, RedlineContainmentGuardError>;

    /// 返回 immutable guard ref。
    pub fn guard_ref(&self) -> &RedlineContainmentGuardRef;
    /// 返回 complete security redline rules。
    pub fn redline_rules(&self) -> &SecurityRedlineRuleSet;
    /// 返回 complete investigation requirements。
    pub fn investigation_requirements(&self) -> &InvestigationRequirementSet;
    /// 返回 guard activation time。
    pub fn activated_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
}
```

`evaluate_signal` 必须先重验 signal factory 的 source-kind、lineage、kind mapping、reason 和 time relation，然后生成 strict requirement / marker set。kind重验只能使用source保存的typed discriminator：`BoundaryObservation.observation_kind.redline_kind()`、`HighRiskDecision.action_kind`穷尽映射，或`ForbiddenBody.markers`中必有的`SecretMaterial -> SecretExposure`；不得从reason、summary ref、source ref、status文本或外部body重建。decision 不允许“不需 containment”或“advisory only”分支；任一合法 signal 都只能创建 `Detected` truth。

`evaluate_release` 只允许 current status 为 `HandoffPending`。`Contained` 必须先通过 §14.4 持久化 exact preservation snapshot 并进入 `HandoffPending`，再发起外部 investigation call；这个恢复点防止 side effect 先发生而 truth 仍留在 `Contained`。evaluation 必须验证：

1. observation 的 redline ref 与 containment 相等，其 preservation snapshot 的 context / identity / optional run / boundary / handle / generation 与 containment 完全相等；
2. `RunMaterial` 只允许 impact 为 `ActiveRunAndBoundary`；material 的 terminal source basis 必须引用 exact `ControlledRunTerminalBasis::Redline(redline_ref)`；material status允许`Prepared | HandoffPending | HandoffRecorded | HandoffFailed`，且必须从owner原样复制status / handoff ref；
3. `PostRunMaterial` 只允许 impact 为 `PostRunPreservation`；material 必须属于 exact existing terminal / completed run，不要求其 terminal basis 改为 redline；material status / handoff ref 必须与 owner truth 一致，snapshot 还必须复制 exact redline signal source；
4. `BoundarySignal` 只允许 impact 为 `BoundaryOnly`，signal source 只能是 `BoundaryObservation` 或 `ForbiddenBody(SecretMaterial)`，并必须与 containment 保存的 exact signal source 相等；该路径不伪造 `ObservabilityMaterial` 或 `HandoffFact`；
5. observation target / receipt summary / generic handoff summary 必须同为 body-free `Investigation` source；`InvestigationHandoffDisposition::NotRequired` 对 redline strict requirement 非法，constructor / guard必须返回typed observation error；external owner 必须对 exact preservation snapshot 形成 `Pending | Accepted | Blocked | Failed` observation；
6. `evaluated_at` 不早于 guard activation、containment status time、snapshot assembly time、observation time 和 generic investigation summary observation time。

release disposition 机械矩阵：

| preservation basis | investigation disposition | result | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `RunMaterial | PostRunMaterial`；material status 为 `Prepared | HandoffPending` | observation summary `Pending | Accepted` | `KeepPending` | 尚未打开或尚未完成 material handoff；investigation acceptance 不得替代 material owner truth |
| `RunMaterial | PostRunMaterial`；material status 为 `HandoffFailed` | observation summary `Pending` | `KeepPending` | material已终态失败，但仍须先完成external responsibility handoff的有限处置 |
| `RunMaterial | PostRunMaterial`；material status 为 `HandoffFailed` | observation summary `Accepted` | `MakeTerminal` | responsibility已接收，但material交接失败使normal release不可成立 |
| `RunMaterial`；material `HandoffRecorded`，exact snapshot 被 investigation owner 接收 | `Accepted` | `ReleaseCleanupBlock` | 只解除 redline owner 的 cleanup block |
| `PostRunMaterial`；existing material `HandoffRecorded`，exact material + redline signal snapshot 被 investigation owner 接收 | `Accepted` | `ReleaseCleanupBlock` | 保留原 run terminal owner，只解除 redline cleanup block |
| `BoundarySignal`；exact signal snapshot 被 investigation owner 接收 | `Accepted` | `ReleaseCleanupBlock` | 无 run 路径只交接 typed signal，不伪造 material truth |
| either basis | `Blocked | Failed` | `MakeTerminal` | external owner 已明确不允许 normal release |
| preservation 已完成 | `Pending` | `KeepPending` | redline 不允许 pending investigation 被 caller 关闭；absence时不调用guard，`NotRequired`为typed error |

`KeepPending` 只表示 pure guard evaluation 没有产生可执行 terminal transition。它可以被 application保存为 operation result / audit decision summary，随后保持现有 `HandoffPending` truth不变；它不得传给 `release_cleanup_block`、`mark_terminal`或任何新的 `keep_pending` domain method，也不得更新 `status_reason`、`status_changed_at`、latest observation、marker set或audit ref。只有先由 `record_investigation_observation` 持久化 matching observation，之后 guard返回 `ReleaseCleanupBlock | MakeTerminal`，才存在下一条状态迁移输入。

`ReleaseCleanupBlock` 不表示 backend environment 已释放、cleanup 已完成、boundary / context 已关闭、run 可恢复或 investigation 已结案。它只是 redline containment owner 已完成必需的阻断、保留和责任交接，允许 §14.1 cleanup guard 继续独立判断其它 evidence / orphan / release conditions。

material status / handoff ref cardinality必须与`ObservabilityMaterial` owner完全一致：

| material status | preservation snapshot handoff ref | release implication |
|---|---|---|
| `Prepared` | `None` | 可进入`HandoffPending`恢复点，但guard只能`KeepPending`；不得伪造尚未打开的handoff |
| `HandoffPending` | `Some(exact owner handoff_ref)` | guard只能`KeepPending`，等待同一batch推进 |
| `HandoffRecorded` | `Some(exact owner handoff_ref)` | 仅在exact investigation observation为`Accepted`时允许`ReleaseCleanupBlock` |
| `HandoffFailed` | `Some(exact owner handoff_ref)` | investigation仍`Pending`时`KeepPending`；`Accepted | Blocked | Failed`时`MakeTerminal` |

`from_run_material`与`from_post_run_material`必须调用 material getters 复制当前 committed status / optional handoff ref，不接收caller单独传入status或ref；二者不扫描latest handoff，也不因进入redline preservation而创建新handoff batch。snapshot是external call前恢复点，因此material仍为`Prepared | HandoffPending`是合法且必须可表达的中间态。

当material owner之后沿同一batch推进时，application必须先调用`RedlineContainment::refresh_preservation_snapshot`持久化新的exact snapshot，再为该snapshot取得新的investigation observation并调用`evaluate_release`。guard拒绝旧snapshot /旧observation；不得在guard内部加载material、扫描latest handoff或把`Accepted` observation套用到已变化的preservation source。

#### 14.3.5 `RedlineContainmentGuardError`

```rust
/// redline signal、strict rules、requirement、marker 或 release evaluation 不变量失败。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum RedlineContainmentGuardError {
    /// security hard rule set 缺失、重复或携带非 canonical rule。
    SecurityRedlineRuleSetInvalid,
    /// containment requirement set 与 signal 是否带 run 的 strict relation 不一致。
    ContainmentRequirementSetInvalid,
    /// investigation requirement set 不是完整五项 strict set。
    InvestigationRequirementSetInvalid,
    /// safety marker set 缺失、重复或与 requirement 关系不一致。
    RedlineSafetyMarkerSetInvalid,
    /// signal source / summary kind 不在 closed allowed set 或两者不一致。
    RedlineSignalSourceKindInvalid,
    /// signal 的 context / identity / optional run / boundary / handle / generation 不完整或不一致。
    RedlineSignalLineageMismatch,
    /// high-risk decision 不是 `ObservedAttempt + non-Allowed` 或不要求 containment。
    HighRiskDecisionWasNotContainable {
        /// 实际 high-risk action decision status。
        actual: HighRiskActionDecisionStatus,
    },
    /// signal 保存的 redline kind 不等于其 typed source discriminator 机械映射。
    RedlineKindSourceMismatch {
        /// signal 中无法由 source discriminator 重验的 canonical redline kind。
        actual: RedlineKind,
    },
    /// forbidden-body source 为空、summary kind 不允许或无法证明 exact redline kind。
    ForbiddenBodyRedlineRelationInvalid,
    /// signal reason、source、kind 或 detection time 不满足 canonical relation。
    RedlineSignalFieldRelationInvalid,
    /// signal / decision time 早于 guard activation 或 source owner time。
    RedlineEvaluationTimestampInvalid,
    /// containment decision 的 guard / signal / requirement / marker relation 不一致。
    RedlineContainmentDecisionRelationInvalid,
    /// release evaluation 收到不允许的 containment status。
    RedlineReleaseStatusInvalid {
        /// evaluation 观察到的 current status。
        actual: RedlineContainmentStatus,
    },
    /// preservation snapshot 与 containment execution lineage 不一致。
    RedlinePreservationLineageMismatch,
    /// run-material 不是 exact redline terminal source，或 boundary-signal 不等于 saved signal source。
    RedlinePreservationSourceMismatch,
    /// run-bearing containment 错用 boundary-signal，或 boundary-only containment 错用 run-material。
    RedlinePreservationBasisMismatch,
    /// observability material status / handoff ref cardinality 与 owner truth 不一致。
    RedlineObservabilityPreservationInvalid,
    /// investigation summary target / receipt summary 与 exact typed observation 不一致。
    RedlineInvestigationTargetMismatch,
    /// investigation observation 的 preservation / receipt / generic summary relation 不一致。
    RedlineInvestigationObservationInvalid,
    /// release decision 的 disposition、reason 或 checked refs 不满足 closed matrix。
    RedlineReleaseDecisionRelationInvalid,
}
```

error payload 只携带 canonical enum 或 typed ref，不携带 source URI、host / mount / process / network 细节、secret、tool / runtime / member body、backend response、investigation note 或 raw delivery receipt。guard 也不包装 adapter error；Step 7 port 必须先把外部 outcome 映射为 typed signal、handoff progress 或 investigation summary。

#### 14.3.6 Guard self-review 与 downstream revalidation

| 审查项 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| unique owner / planned path | pass；`RedlineContainmentGuard` 与 support family #33 唯一 owner 为 `crates/domain/src/redline.rs`，新增 planned path 0。 |
| canonical kind | pass；只复用 shared 八项 `RedlineKind`，未恢复 `SecurityRedlineKind`；三个factory均从typed source派生kind，不接收caller-supplied kind。 |
| strict / non-configurable | pass；九条 security rule 与五条 investigation requirement 不可删减，无 enable / override / severity input。 |
| source boundary | pass；boundary source保存有限observation kind，high-risk source保存exact action kind，forbidden-body固定由`SecretMaterial`派生；不解析raw body / reason。 |
| containment coverage | pass；stop-new-use、run termination、material preservation、cleanup block、investigation handoff、audit linkage 全量闭合。 |
| release semantics | pass；`ReleaseCleanupBlock` 只解除 redline owner block，不声明 backend release / cleanup complete / run resume / investigation close。 |
| circular dependency | pass；redline release 不等 cleanup `Allowed`，cleanup 只消费 redline `Released | Terminal`。 |
| implementation boundary | pass；guard pure evaluate，不读 repository、不调 backend / handoff / investigation port，不产生真实 evidence / test 事实。 |

Step 7~10 必须替换 historical `RedlineContainmentGuard::evaluate(containment)` 和 `blocks_release()` bool 拼接：Step 7 service 必须先组装 typed `RedlineSignal`；Step 8 command / consumer 不得传 `SecurityRedlineKind`、raw source body 或 release bool；Step 9 flow 必须分离 detection decision 与 release decision；Step 10 只允许 §14.4 truth 拥有五态迁移。

### 14.4 `RedlineContainment`

#### 14.4.1 Capability、exact fields 与 detection factory

`RedlineContainment` 是一个 exact execution boundary 的 canonical security containment truth。它唯一拥有 `RedlineContainmentStatus`、detection signal snapshot、containment proof、preservation / investigation handoff、cleanup-block release basis 和 audit linkage。它不执行 backend kill / release、不改写 tool / runtime / member truth、不保存 investigation body，也不允许 `Released` 恢复 run、boundary 或 handle 的新使用。

```rust
/// `Contained` 状态保留的 stop-new-use / optional run termination proof。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct RedlineContainmentBasis {
    /// exact containment truth ref。
    redline_ref: RedlineContainmentRef,
    /// 使 exact boundary 进入 `Failed` 的 matching redline-derived failure classification ref。
    failure_ref: FailureClassificationRef,
    /// exact boundary ref。
    boundary_ref: CoherentBoundaryRef,
    /// exact isolation handle ref。
    isolation_handle_ref: IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef,
    /// canonical generation ref。
    generation_ref: ResourceRef,
    /// 可选 exact run ref。
    run_ref: Option<ControlledExecutionRunRef>,
    /// active-run path 必须为 `Some(Terminated)`；boundary-only / post-run 保留 source status。
    resulting_run_status: Option<ControlledExecutionRunStatus>,
    /// stop-new-use 后 boundary 必须为 `Failed`。
    resulting_boundary_status: CoherentBoundaryStatus,
    /// boundary首次因本redline失败，或cleanup authorization后已处于Failed的互斥proof。
    boundary_failure_relation: RedlineBoundaryFailureRelation,
    /// containment proof 形成时的 caller-safe reason。
    reason: SandboxReason,
    /// containment proof 形成时的 audit trace ref。
    audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    /// proof time。
    contained_at: Timestamp,
}

impl RedlineContainmentBasis {
    /// 返回 exact containment ref。
    pub fn redline_ref(&self) -> &RedlineContainmentRef;
    /// 返回 matching redline-derived failure classification ref。
    pub fn failure_ref(&self) -> &FailureClassificationRef;
    /// 返回 exact boundary ref。
    pub fn boundary_ref(&self) -> &CoherentBoundaryRef;
    /// 返回 exact handle ref。
    pub fn isolation_handle_ref(&self) -> &IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef;
    /// 返回 canonical generation ref。
    pub fn generation_ref(&self) -> &ResourceRef;
    /// 返回 optional exact run ref。
    pub fn run_ref(&self) -> Option<&ControlledExecutionRunRef>;
    /// 返回 optional resulting run status。
    pub fn resulting_run_status(&self) -> Option<ControlledExecutionRunStatus>;
    /// 返回 resulting boundary status。
    pub fn resulting_boundary_status(&self) -> CoherentBoundaryStatus;
    /// 返回redline与boundary Failed状态的exact relation。
    pub fn boundary_failure_relation(&self) -> &RedlineBoundaryFailureRelation;
    /// 返回 caller-safe contained reason。
    pub fn reason(&self) -> &SandboxReason;
    /// 返回 containment proof audit trace ref。
    pub fn audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;
    /// 返回 containment proof time。
    pub fn contained_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
}

/// redline containment如何证明exact boundary已经停止新使用。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum RedlineBoundaryFailureRelation {
    /// 本redline-derived failure在同一UoW使Established boundary首次进入Failed。
    FailedByThisRedline {
        /// boundary保存的exact redline failure ref。
        boundary_failure_ref: FailureClassificationRef,
    },
    /// cleanup release已获授权，boundary已因既有failure保持Failed，redline不得覆盖原failure owner。
    AlreadyFailedDuringAuthorizedRelease {
        /// 已提交且使handle进入ReleasePending的exact cleanup release basis。
        cleanup_release_basis: CleanupReleaseBasis,
        /// boundary原样保留的prior formal failure ref；establishment partial failure可为None。
        prior_boundary_failure_ref: Option<FailureClassificationRef>,
    },
}

impl RedlineBoundaryFailureRelation {
    /// 返回本redline是否拥有boundary首次Failed transition。
    pub fn failed_by_this_redline(&self) -> bool;
    /// 返回cleanup-race path的optional exact release basis。
    pub fn cleanup_release_basis(&self) -> Option<&CleanupReleaseBasis>;
    /// 返回boundary进入containment前原有的optional failure ref。
    pub fn prior_boundary_failure_ref(&self) -> Option<&FailureClassificationRef>;
}

/// `Released` 状态保留的 cleanup-block release proof。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct RedlineReleaseBasis {
    /// exact containment truth ref。
    redline_ref: RedlineContainmentRef,
    /// exact preservation snapshot。
    preservation_snapshot: RedlinePreservationSnapshot,
    /// external investigation owner 对 exact preservation source 的 accepted observation。
    investigation_observation: RedlineInvestigationHandoffObservation,
    /// guard-owned released reason。
    reason: SandboxReason,
    /// release transition audit trace ref。
    audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    /// containment owner 解除 cleanup block 的 canonical time。
    released_at: Timestamp,
}

impl RedlineReleaseBasis {
    /// 返回 exact containment ref。
    pub fn redline_ref(&self) -> &RedlineContainmentRef;
    /// 返回 exact preservation snapshot。
    pub fn preservation_snapshot(&self) -> &RedlinePreservationSnapshot;
    /// 返回 accepted investigation observation。
    pub fn investigation_observation(&self) -> &RedlineInvestigationHandoffObservation;
    /// 返回 caller-safe released reason。
    pub fn reason(&self) -> &SandboxReason;
    /// 返回 release audit trace ref。
    pub fn audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;
    /// 返回 cleanup-block release time。
    pub fn released_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
}

/// Sandbox-owned security redline containment lifecycle truth。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct RedlineContainment {
    /// containment 的 Sandbox-local typed identity。
    redline_ref: RedlineContainmentRef,
    /// 形成 detection decision 的 immutable strict guard ref。
    guard_ref: RedlineContainmentGuardRef,
    /// canonical redline kind。
    redline_kind: RedlineKind,
    /// source-derived redline impact。
    redline_impact: RedlineImpact,
    /// exact accepted controlled execution context ref。
    context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
    /// exact execution environment identity ref。
    environment_identity_ref: ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef,
    /// optional exact controlled run ref。
    run_ref: Option<ControlledExecutionRunRef>,
    /// exact coherent boundary ref。
    boundary_ref: CoherentBoundaryRef,
    /// exact isolation environment handle ref。
    isolation_handle_ref: IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef,
    /// canonical generation ref。
    generation_ref: ResourceRef,
    /// immutable typed signal source snapshot。
    signal_source: RedlineSignalSource,
    /// detection 时 boundary status。
    detected_boundary_status: CoherentBoundaryStatus,
    /// detection 时 handle status。
    detected_handle_status: IsolationEnvironmentHandleStatus,
    /// detection 时 optional run status。
    detected_run_status: Option<ControlledExecutionRunStatus>,
    /// strict containment requirement set。
    containment_requirements: ContainmentRequirementSet,
    /// strict investigation requirement set。
    investigation_requirements: InvestigationRequirementSet,
    /// 当前 safety marker set；terminal transition 可追加 terminal marker。
    safety_markers: RedlineSafetyMarkerSet,
    /// source owner 的 caller-safe detection reason。
    detection_reason: SandboxReason,
    /// contained / pending / terminal / released 固定 reason catalog。
    reason_catalog: RedlineReasonCatalog,
    /// canonical containment status。
    containment_status: RedlineContainmentStatus,
    /// current status 的 caller-safe reason。
    status_reason: SandboxReason,
    /// `Contained | HandoffPending | Released | Terminal` 必有的 containment proof。
    containment_basis: Option<RedlineContainmentBasis>,
    /// `HandoffPending | Released | Terminal` 必有的 exact preservation snapshot。
    preservation_snapshot: Option<RedlinePreservationSnapshot>,
    /// latest body-free investigation observation。
    investigation_observation: Option<RedlineInvestigationHandoffObservation>,
    /// 只在 `Released` 存在的 cleanup-block release proof。
    release_basis: Option<RedlineReleaseBasis>,
    /// detection time。
    detected_at: Timestamp,
    /// 首次进入 `Contained` 的 time。
    contained_at: Option<Timestamp>,
    /// 首次进入 `HandoffPending` 的 time。
    handoff_pending_at: Option<Timestamp>,
    /// `Released` time。
    released_at: Option<Timestamp>,
    /// `Terminal` time。
    terminal_at: Option<Timestamp>,
    /// current status change time。
    status_changed_at: Timestamp,
    /// latest transition audit trace ref。
    last_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
}

impl RedlineContainment {
    /// 从 strict guard decision 创建 `Detected` truth；不接受 caller-selected status / requirement / reason。
    pub fn detect(
        redline_ref: RedlineContainmentRef,
        signal: &RedlineSignal,
        decision: RedlineContainmentDecision,
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        detected_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, RedlineContainmentError>;

    /// 对 active-run impact 生成 exact run termination proof。
    pub fn require_run_termination_basis(
        &self,
        run_ref: &ControlledExecutionRunRef,
        context_ref: &ControlledExecutionContextRef,
        boundary_ref: &CoherentBoundaryRef,
        handle_ref: &IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef,
    ) -> Result<RedlineRunBasis, RedlineContainmentError>;

    /// 验证boundary首次被本redline收紧，或已处于matching authorized-release failure relation后进入Contained。
    pub fn mark_contained(
        &mut self,
        failure: &FailureClassification,
        boundary: &CoherentBoundary,
        run: Option<&ControlledExecutionRun>,
        cleanup_release_basis: Option<&CleanupReleaseBasis>,
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        contained_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), RedlineContainmentError>;

    /// 持久化 exact preservation snapshot并进入 `HandoffPending`，形成 external call 前恢复点。
    pub fn mark_handoff_pending(
        &mut self,
        preservation_snapshot: RedlinePreservationSnapshot,
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        changed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), RedlineContainmentError>;

    /// 从同一 material owner 刷新单调推进的 preservation snapshot，并使旧 investigation observation失效。
    pub fn refresh_preservation_snapshot(
        &mut self,
        preservation_snapshot: RedlinePreservationSnapshot,
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        changed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), RedlineContainmentError>;

    /// 记录 latest matching investigation observation；不单独改变 status。
    pub fn record_investigation_observation(
        &mut self,
        observation: RedlineInvestigationHandoffObservation,
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        changed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), RedlineContainmentError>;

    /// 消费 guard `ReleaseCleanupBlock` decision 进入 `Released`。
    pub fn release_cleanup_block(
        &mut self,
        decision: RedlineReleaseDecision,
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        released_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), RedlineContainmentError>;

    /// 消费 guard `MakeTerminal` decision 进入不可 normal release 的 `Terminal`。
    pub fn mark_terminal(
        &mut self,
        decision: RedlineReleaseDecision,
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        terminal_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), RedlineContainmentError>;

    /// 返回 containment identity。
    pub fn redline_ref(&self) -> &RedlineContainmentRef;
    /// 返回 immutable strict guard ref。
    pub fn guard_ref(&self) -> &RedlineContainmentGuardRef;
    /// 返回 canonical redline kind。
    pub fn redline_kind(&self) -> RedlineKind;
    /// 返回 source-derived redline impact。
    pub fn redline_impact(&self) -> RedlineImpact;
    /// 返回 exact context ref。
    pub fn context_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionContextRef;
    /// 返回 exact environment identity ref。
    pub fn environment_identity_ref(&self) -> &ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef;
    /// 返回 optional exact run ref。
    pub fn run_ref(&self) -> Option<&ControlledExecutionRunRef>;
    /// 返回 exact boundary ref。
    pub fn boundary_ref(&self) -> &CoherentBoundaryRef;
    /// 返回 exact isolation handle ref。
    pub fn isolation_handle_ref(&self) -> &IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef;
    /// 返回 canonical generation ref。
    pub fn generation_ref(&self) -> &ResourceRef;
    /// 返回 immutable typed signal source。
    pub fn signal_source(&self) -> &RedlineSignalSource;
    /// 返回 detection-time boundary status。
    pub fn detected_boundary_status(&self) -> CoherentBoundaryStatus;
    /// 返回 detection-time handle status。
    pub fn detected_handle_status(&self) -> IsolationEnvironmentHandleStatus;
    /// 返回 optional detection-time run status。
    pub fn detected_run_status(&self) -> Option<ControlledExecutionRunStatus>;
    /// 返回 strict containment requirements。
    pub fn containment_requirements(&self) -> &ContainmentRequirementSet;
    /// 返回 strict investigation requirements。
    pub fn investigation_requirements(&self) -> &InvestigationRequirementSet;
    /// 返回 current safety markers。
    pub fn safety_markers(&self) -> &RedlineSafetyMarkerSet;
    /// 返回 source owner detection reason。
    pub fn detection_reason(&self) -> &SandboxReason;
    /// 返回 current canonical status。
    pub fn containment_status(&self) -> RedlineContainmentStatus;
    /// 返回 current status reason。
    pub fn status_reason(&self) -> &SandboxReason;
    /// 返回 optional containment proof。
    pub fn containment_basis(&self) -> Option<&RedlineContainmentBasis>;
    /// 返回 optional exact preservation snapshot。
    pub fn preservation_snapshot(&self) -> Option<&RedlinePreservationSnapshot>;
    /// 返回 optional latest investigation observation。
    pub fn investigation_observation(&self) -> Option<&RedlineInvestigationHandoffObservation>;
    /// 返回 optional cleanup-block release basis。
    pub fn release_basis(&self) -> Option<&RedlineReleaseBasis>;
    /// 返回 detection time。
    pub fn detected_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
    /// 返回 optional contained time。
    pub fn contained_at(&self) -> Option<&Timestamp>;
    /// 返回 optional handoff-pending time。
    pub fn handoff_pending_at(&self) -> Option<&Timestamp>;
    /// 返回 optional released time。
    pub fn released_at(&self) -> Option<&Timestamp>;
    /// 返回 optional terminal time。
    pub fn terminal_at(&self) -> Option<&Timestamp>;
    /// 返回 current status change time。
    pub fn status_changed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
    /// 返回 latest transition audit trace ref。
    pub fn last_audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;

    /// 判断 redline owner 是否仍阻断 cleanup / release。
    pub fn blocks_cleanup(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断 containment 是否仍需要 external investigation handoff。
    pub fn requires_investigation_handoff(&self) -> bool;
}
```

`detect` 必须验证 decision 的 guard ref、kind、impact、signal source、context / identity / optional run / boundary / handle / generation、requirements、markers、reason catalog 和 evaluation time全部等于 signal / guard output。`redline_ref` 不得与 guard、context、identity、run、boundary 或 handle 的底层 resource identity 碰撞。initial fields 固定为：

```text
containment_status = Detected
status_reason = detection_reason
containment_basis = None
preservation_snapshot = None
investigation_observation = None
release_basis = None
detected_at = status_changed_at = factory detected_at
contained_at / handoff_pending_at / released_at / terminal_at = None
```

#### 14.4.2 `RedlineRunBasis` 与 forward #8

```rust
/// `RedlineContainment` 返回给 controlled run lifecycle 的 checked termination basis。
///
/// 该值是 transient proof，不是独立 truth、DTO、event payload 或 repository row。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct RedlineRunBasis {
    /// matching containment truth ref。
    redline_ref: RedlineContainmentRef,
    /// exact context ref。
    context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
    /// exact run ref。
    run_ref: ControlledExecutionRunRef,
    /// exact boundary ref。
    boundary_ref: CoherentBoundaryRef,
    /// exact isolation handle ref。
    isolation_handle_ref: IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef,
    /// canonical generation ref。
    generation_ref: ResourceRef,
    /// canonical redline kind。
    redline_kind: RedlineKind,
    /// 必须为 `ActiveRunAndBoundary`。
    redline_impact: RedlineImpact,
    /// basis 形成时 containment 的 canonical status。
    containment_status: RedlineContainmentStatus,
    /// owner-provided caller-safe detection reason。
    reason: SandboxReason,
    /// containment detection audit trace ref。
    audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
}

impl RedlineRunBasis {
    /// 返回 containment ref。
    pub fn redline_ref(&self) -> &RedlineContainmentRef;
    /// 返回 context ref。
    pub fn context_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionContextRef;
    /// 返回 run ref。
    pub fn run_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionRunRef;
    /// 返回 boundary ref。
    pub fn boundary_ref(&self) -> &CoherentBoundaryRef;
    /// 返回 isolation handle ref。
    pub fn isolation_handle_ref(&self) -> &IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef;
    /// 返回 canonical generation ref。
    pub fn generation_ref(&self) -> &ResourceRef;
    /// 返回 canonical redline kind。
    pub fn redline_kind(&self) -> RedlineKind;
    /// 返回 source-derived redline impact。
    pub fn redline_impact(&self) -> RedlineImpact;
    /// 返回 basis 形成时 containment status。
    pub fn containment_status(&self) -> RedlineContainmentStatus;
    /// 返回 owner safe reason。
    pub fn reason(&self) -> &SandboxReason;
    /// 返回 containment audit trace ref。
    pub fn audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;
}
```

`require_run_termination_basis` 只在以下条件同时成立时成功：

1. current containment status 为 `Detected`；`Contained | HandoffPending | Released | Terminal` 都不再生成新 run basis；
2. `redline_impact == ActiveRunAndBoundary`，detected run status 为 `Preparing | Running`，requirements / markers 同时含 `TerminateRun` / `RunTerminationRequired`；
3. requested run / context / boundary / handle 与 self 完全相等，generation 已由 detection factory 验证；
4. detection reason 必须存在并从 typed source owner 复制，不从 kind / marker / status 文本生成；
5. 返回的 basis 必须包含 kind、impact、status、reason 和 audit，不能退化为 `&SandboxReason`。

`ControlledExecutionRun::terminate_by_redline` 必须改为消费 `RedlineRunBasis`：校验 basis 的 run / context / boundary / handle / generation 与 current run 完全相等，然后写 `terminal_basis = Redline(redline_ref)`、`status_reason = basis.reason`、`run_status = Terminated`。caller 不得在 run 内重新计算 kind / impact / status。

#### 14.4.3 Containment / preservation / release transitions

closed lifecycle：

```text
factory -> Detected
Detected -> Contained
Contained -> HandoffPending
HandoffPending -> HandoffPending (monotonic preservation refresh or new matching observation)
HandoffPending -> Released | Terminal
Released | Terminal -> terminal / immutable
```

`mark_contained` 必须先检查 boundary 已不再可 launch：boundary ref / context / identity / handle / generation 与 self 相等，status 为 `Failed`。显式输入的 `failure` 必须处于 `Classified | Terminal`，其 dominant source marker 必须是 `FailureSource::Redline(self.redline_ref)`，kind 为 `SandboxFailureKind::Redline`，impact 必须与 self 的三类 impact 映射一致，context / identity / optional run / boundary / handle / generation 与 self 完全相等，且 `failure.blocks_boundary_for(self.boundary_ref, self.isolation_handle_ref)` 为 true。仅重新调用 `FailureSourceMarker::from_redline(self)`、只比较 failure kind、只比较 `blocks_boundary_for` bool或由 caller传裸 failure ref都不足以证明 matching relation。

boundary relation按互斥路径校验：

| path | exact prerequisites | resulting relation |
|---|---|---|
| normal containment | detected handle为`Created | Active | OrphanSuspected`；`cleanup_release_basis=None`；boundary保存的failure ref等于本redline failure；active-run path还要求matching termination | `FailedByThisRedline { boundary_failure_ref }` |
| cleanup authorization race | detected handle为`ReleasePending`、boundary已`Failed`、impact只允许`BoundaryOnly | PostRunPreservation`；`cleanup_release_basis=Some`且basis context / identity / optional run / boundary / handle / generation / backend target与owners相等，`authorized_at <= detected_at`；boundary原failure ref保持原样 | `AlreadyFailedDuringAuthorizedRelease { cleanup_release_basis, prior_boundary_failure_ref }` |

cleanup-race path仍必须持久化matching redline `FailureClassification`，但不能再次调用
`CoherentBoundary::mark_failed`、覆盖boundary原failure ref、把terminal run改写为redline终态或撤销release basis。它的
containment proof是“boundary已因授权teardown停止新使用 + 本redline已成为正式独立failure / cleanup blocker”。
run relation按 impact分开：

| impact | required run input | exact containment proof |
|---|---|---|
| `ActiveRunAndBoundary` | `Some(run)`；run ref / lineage 相等，current status `Terminated`，terminal basis 必须 `Redline(self.redline_ref)` | basis `resulting_run_status = Some(Terminated)` |
| `PostRunPreservation` | `Some(run)`；run ref / lineage 相等，current status和detected status 均为同一 `Completed | Failed | Terminated`，terminal basis 不改写 | basis 保留 exact existing terminal / completed status |
| `BoundaryOnly` | `None`；self.run_ref / detected run status也必须为 `None` | basis `resulting_run_status = None` |

成功后写 `containment_status = Contained`、`status_reason = reason_catalog.contained`、embedded
`RedlineContainmentBasis { redline_ref, failure_ref, boundary_ref, isolation_handle_ref, generation_ref, run_ref,
resulting_run_status, resulting_boundary_status, boundary_failure_relation, reason, audit_trace_ref, contained_at }`、
`contained_at / status_changed_at / audit`。normal path的`Detected -> Contained` UoW必须同时保存matching failure、
boundary Failed，active-run时还保存run Terminated；cleanup-race path的UoW保存matching redline failure与containment，
并以expected-version验证boundary / handle / cleanup basis未变化，但不写它们。两条路径都不允许basis丢失exact failure ref
后由repository latest scan恢复。

`mark_handoff_pending` 只允许 `Contained -> HandoffPending`，snapshot 的 basis 必须与 impact 一致：

| impact | required preservation basis |
|---|---|
| `ActiveRunAndBoundary` | `RunMaterial`；material source basis 必须 exact redline terminal owner，material handoff status / ref 从 owner truth 复制 |
| `PostRunPreservation` | `PostRunMaterial`；保留 existing material owner并显式附加 exact redline signal source |
| `BoundaryOnly` | `BoundarySignal`；只交接 exact typed signal，不伪造 run material |

snapshot redline / lineage 必须与 self 完全相等，assembly time 不早于 contained time。成功后保存 snapshot，写 `HandoffPending`、`reason_catalog.handoff_pending`、time / audit。application 必须先提交该恢复点，才能调用 investigation / handoff port。

`refresh_preservation_snapshot` 只允许 current status `HandoffPending` 且 current basis 为 `RunMaterial | PostRunMaterial`。application必须重新加载 exact `ObservabilityMaterial`，调用同一个 `from_run_material` / `from_post_run_material` factory形成新snapshot；method不读repository，也不接受caller拆散的status / handoff ref。new snapshot必须保持redline / complete lineage、basis variant、material ref以及`PostRunMaterial.signal_source`完全相等，且assembly time不回退。material lifecycle只允许按以下闭图推进：

```text
Prepared(None) -> Prepared(None) | HandoffPending(Some H) | HandoffRecorded(Some H) | HandoffFailed(Some H)
HandoffPending(Some H) -> HandoffPending(Some H) | HandoffRecorded(Some H) | HandoffFailed(Some H)
HandoffRecorded(Some H) -> HandoffRecorded(Some H)
HandoffFailed(Some H) -> HandoffFailed(Some H)
```

一旦出现`Some H`，后续snapshot必须保持同一个handoff ref；不得从`HandoffRecorded | HandoffFailed`回退、在terminal status间切换、把ref改成`None`或换成第二个batch。完全相等snapshot为幂等；合法进展则替换persisted snapshot、清空latest `investigation_observation`、保持`containment_status = HandoffPending`与`status_reason`不变，并更新status time / audit。清空只表示embedded latest observation已被新snapshot失效；既有append-only audit / operation history不得删除。`BoundarySignal`是immutable typed signal，不允许调用refresh。

`record_investigation_observation` 只允许 current status `HandoffPending`，observation 的 redline ref / preservation snapshot 必须与 persisted snapshot 相等，time 不回退。重复完全相等 observation 幂等；同一 target 与 preservation 下更新的 finite observation 可覆盖 latest snapshot，但不删除 append-only audit / operation history。本 method 不根据 disposition 自行 release / terminal，必须再调 guard `evaluate_release`。

`release_cleanup_block` 只接受 `ReleaseCleanupBlock`；decision guard / redline / from-status / preservation / observation 必须与 self 完全相等，且 decision 必须与 current latest observation 对应。`KeepPending | MakeTerminal` 一律返回 typed disposition error，不改变任何字段。成功后写 embedded `RedlineReleaseBasis`、`containment_status = Released`、`status_reason = reason_catalog.released`、`released_at / status_changed_at / audit`，并保留 containment / preservation / investigation 全部链接。

`mark_terminal` 只接受 `MakeTerminal`，并执行同样 exact decision relation validation；`KeepPending | ReleaseCleanupBlock` 一律返回 typed disposition error。成功时必须调用 private `RedlineSafetyMarkerSet::with_terminal_containment_required`重建集合，再写 `containment_status = Terminal`、`status_reason = reason_catalog.terminal`、`terminal_at / status_changed_at / audit`，`release_basis`保持`None`。marker重建失败时整个transition失败且self不变。`Terminal`仍阻断cleanup的normal release，只允许后续保留 / investigation / operator disposition在新truth中另行处置，不原地复活。

status / field relation 固定如下：

| status | containment basis | preservation | investigation observation | release basis | terminal marker | cleanup meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Detected` | `None` | `None` | `None` | `None` | absent | hard blocked；等待 stop-new-use / run termination proof |
| `Contained` | `Some` | `None` | `None` | `None` | absent | hard blocked；等待持久化 preservation recovery point |
| `HandoffPending` | `Some` | `Some` | `None | Some` | `None` | absent | hard blocked；等待 exact preservation / investigation acceptance |
| `Released` | `Some` | `Some` | accepted `Some` | `Some` | absent | redline owner 不再阻断 cleanup；不表示 cleanup complete |
| `Terminal` | `Some` | `Some` | material `HandoffFailed` + investigation `Accepted`，或external `Blocked | Failed`的matching `Some` | `None` | present | normal cleanup / release 继续 hard blocked |

`blocks_cleanup()` 对 `Detected | Contained | HandoffPending | Terminal` 返回 true，只对 `Released` 返回 false。`requires_investigation_handoff()` 对 `Detected | Contained | HandoffPending` 返回 true，对 `Released | Terminal` 返回 false；`Terminal` 只表示本 containment attempt 的 external handoff 已以 blocked / failed 终态收束，不表示 investigation case 已完成。

#### 14.4.4 `FailureSourceMarker::from_redline` 反向重验

batch 2 固定的 callable 保持不变：

```rust
impl FailureSourceMarker {
    /// 从满足 redline source contract 的 containment truth 构造 Redline marker。
    pub fn from_redline(
        redline: &RedlineContainment,
    ) -> Result<Self, FailureClassificationError>;
}
```

reverse-validation matrix：

| check | exact source rule | failure disposition |
|---|---|---|
| source status | 只接受 `Detected | Contained | HandoffPending | Terminal`；`Released` 拒绝，因为 containment owner 已解除 cleanup block，不能成为新 stable failure source | `RedlineSourceRelationInvalid { redline_ref }` |
| context / identity / boundary / handle / generation | 全部由 redline getters 提供且成组完整；不从 signal / summary ref 文本推导 | same error |
| optional run / impact | `ActiveRunAndBoundary` 必须有 run，映射 `FailureImpact::BoundaryAndTerminatedRun`；`PostRunPreservation` 必须有已终态 run，映射 `BoundaryAndPostRun`；`BoundaryOnly` 必须无 run，映射 `BoundaryOnly` | same error；caller 不得传 impact |
| stable kind | 固定 `SandboxFailureKind::Redline`，不将 `RedlineKind` 拆成第二 failure enum | same error |
| safe reason | 复制 current `status_reason`；必须为 owner-provided non-empty `SandboxReason` | same error；不解析 kind / source summary |
| source time | 复制 `status_changed_at`，不使用 current clock 或 external raw event time | same error |
| terminal precedence | `Terminal` 仍是 stable boundary-blocking source；`Released` 不可 classifiable；post-run impact 不能生成 `FailureRunBasis` | same error |

因此稳定映射固定为：

```text
Detected | Contained | HandoffPending | Terminal
  -> FailureSource::Redline(redline_ref)
  -> SandboxFailureKind::Redline
  -> BoundaryAndTerminatedRun when impact = ActiveRunAndBoundary
  -> BoundaryAndPostRun   when impact = PostRunPreservation
  -> BoundaryOnly         when impact = BoundaryOnly
  -> current owner status_reason + status_changed_at

Released -> RedlineSourceRelationInvalid
```

反向重验结论：`RedlineContainment` 已提供 batch 2 marker factory 所需的 source status、complete lineage、impact、stable kind、safe reason 和 source time；无需由 Step 7、adapter 或 caller 补造。本次同步增加 `FailureImpact::BoundaryAndTerminatedRun` 和 `BoundaryAndPostRun`：前者表达“阻断 boundary，run 必须由 redline owner 进入 Terminated”，后者表达“阻断 boundary 但不改写已终态 run”。两者都可使 `blocks_boundary_for` 返回 true，但 `require_run_failure_basis` 必须返回 unavailable。

#### 14.4.5 `RedlineContainmentError`

```rust
/// redline truth factory、lineage、basis、transition、preservation 或 release 不变量失败。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum RedlineContainmentError {
    /// containment identity 与 guard / execution owner identity 发生底层碰撞。
    RedlineIdentityCollision,
    /// signal 与 guard decision 的 kind / impact / source / lineage / requirements / markers 不一致。
    RedlineDecisionSourceMismatch,
    /// detection / transition time 早于既有 source / status time。
    RedlineTimestampMovedBackwards,
    /// containment status 与 basis / snapshot / observation / release / timestamp 字段不一致。
    RedlineStatusFieldRelationInvalid {
        /// relation 无法成立的 canonical status。
        status: RedlineContainmentStatus,
    },
    /// requested transition 不在 closed lifecycle 中。
    RedlineTransitionNotAllowed {
        /// containment identity。
        redline_ref: RedlineContainmentRef,
        /// transition 前 status。
        from: RedlineContainmentStatus,
        /// requested target status。
        to: RedlineContainmentStatus,
    },
    /// current status / impact 不能为 exact run 生成 termination basis。
    RedlineRunBasisUnavailable,
    /// requested run / context / boundary / handle 与 containment lineage 不一致。
    RedlineRunBasisLineageMismatch,
    /// run basis 缺少 kind / impact / status / reason / audit 任一必需内容。
    RedlineRunBasisIncomplete,
    /// boundary 尚未进入 matching redline-derived `Failed` truth。
    RedlineBoundaryWasNotContained,
    /// cleanup-race path缺少matching persisted release basis，或normal path错误携带该basis。
    RedlineCleanupReleaseBasisRelationInvalid,
    /// ReleasePending detection错误携带active run或不属于authorized teardown lineage。
    RedlineReleasePendingSignalRelationInvalid,
    /// cleanup-race containment试图覆盖boundary既有failure ref或重复推进boundary transition。
    RedlinePriorBoundaryFailureWasModified,
    /// failure classification 不由本 containment 的 exact redline marker主导，或其status / impact / lineage不匹配。
    RedlineFailureRelationMismatch {
        /// relation无法证明的failure classification ref。
        failure_ref: FailureClassificationRef,
    },
    /// active-run impact 的 run 尚未以 exact redline basis 进入 `Terminated`。
    RedlineActiveRunWasNotTerminated,
    /// post-run impact 尝试改写原 terminal / completed status 或 terminal basis。
    RedlinePostRunStatusWasModified,
    /// boundary-only impact 错误携带 run。
    RedlineBoundaryOnlyRunPresent,
    /// containment basis 与 current redline / boundary / run result 不一致。
    RedlineContainmentBasisMismatch,
    /// preservation snapshot 与 current impact / lineage 不一致。
    RedlinePreservationSnapshotMismatch,
    /// material preservation refresh发生status回退、terminal切换、handoff ref替换或boundary-signal刷新。
    RedlinePreservationProgressInvalid {
        /// persisted snapshot中的material status；boundary-signal refresh在进入本error前直接拒绝。
        from: ObservabilityMaterialStatus,
        /// caller提交的新material status。
        to: ObservabilityMaterialStatus,
    },
    /// investigation observation 与 persisted preservation snapshot 不一致。
    RedlineInvestigationObservationMismatch,
    /// release / terminal decision 不属于 current guard / redline / status / observation。
    RedlineReleaseDecisionMismatch,
    /// `release_cleanup_block` 收到非 `ReleaseCleanupBlock` disposition。
    RedlineReleaseDispositionInvalid,
    /// `mark_terminal` 收到非 `MakeTerminal` disposition。
    RedlineTerminalDispositionInvalid,
    /// terminal transition无法从完整initial marker set安全追加唯一terminal marker。
    RedlineTerminalMarkerTransitionInvalid,
    /// release basis 已存在但与新 decision 不一致。
    RedlineReleaseBasisCollision,
    /// `Released | Terminal` truth 被请求原地重开或改写。
    TerminalRedlineContainmentImmutable,
}
```

`RedlineContainmentError` 不包装 backend / handoff / investigation adapter error，不携带 raw source body、host / network / process 细节、secret、tool / runtime / member body、receipt body 或 operator note。Step 7 application 只能将 typed domain error 映射为 caller-safe application / public error，不得折叠为 generic invalid transition。

#### 14.4.6 Object self-review、owner ordering 与 batch 4 局部结论

recommended Step 9 ordering 固定为：

```text
load exact context / identity / boundary / handle / optional run
  -> RedlineSignal factory
  -> RedlineContainmentGuard::evaluate_signal
  -> RedlineContainment::detect
  -> FailureSourceMarker::from_redline
  -> FailureClassification::classify
  -> if active run: containment.require_run_termination_basis -> run.terminate_by_redline
  -> normal path: boundary.mark_failed(matching redline failure)
  -> cleanup-race path: verify exact persisted release basis; do not rewrite boundary / handle
  -> containment.mark_contained(matching failure, boundary, optional run, optional release basis)
  -> commit containment + failure + applicable run/boundary writes + audit before external handoff
  -> assemble RedlinePreservationSnapshot by impact and existing observability owner status
  -> containment.mark_handoff_pending(snapshot)
  -> commit recovery point before handoff / investigation call
  -> when material owner advances: rebuild exact snapshot -> containment.refresh_preservation_snapshot -> commit
  -> map typed investigation outcome to RedlineInvestigationHandoffObservation
  -> containment.record_investigation_observation
  -> guard.evaluate_release(containment, observation)
  -> containment.release_cleanup_block or containment.mark_terminal
  -> cleanup guard independently reevaluates exact evidence
```

active-run path 中 `RedlineContainment::detect`、matching failure classification、run `Terminated`、boundary `Failed` 和 containment `Contained` 应在同一 UoW 提交，防止 run / boundary 仍可新使用。如果 backend termination side effect 必须在事务外调用，Step 9 / 11~13 必须以 persisted `Detected` truth + typed idempotent termination operation 作恢复点，但不得在未确认 run termination / boundary stop-new-use 前写 `Contained`。cleanup-race path则在同一lineage safety group expected-version下保存new redline + failure + containment，不重复写已`Failed` boundary / `ReleasePending` handle。commit-unknown 处置留给后续 Step 11~13，当前对象契约不伪造已执行 side effect。

| 审查项 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| unique owner / state | pass；`RedlineContainment` 唯一 owner `redline.rs`，只复用 shared 5-state enum。 |
| exact fields / factory | pass；kind、impact、lineage、source、requirements、markers、basis、times、audit 均有 source。 |
| stop-new-use | pass；normal path验证matching redline-derived Failed；cleanup-race path验证matching authorized teardown且不覆盖prior failure。 |
| active / post / boundary-only split | pass；active run typed terminate，post-run 不改写原终态，boundary-only 不伪造 run / material。 |
| forward #8 | pass；`RedlineRunBasis` 带完整 lineage / kind / impact / status / reason / audit，不再返回 borrowed reason。 |
| preservation / handoff | pass；external call 前持久化 snapshot recovery point，investigation observation 绑定 exact preservation source。 |
| cleanup cycle | pass；`Released`只解除该redline block；multi-redline coverage与authorization race由§14.0 / §14.2定向回写。 |
| stable failure source | pass；`Released` 不可新建marker，`Terminal` 仍作 boundary-blocking source，post-run 使用 `BoundaryAndPostRun`。 |
| body / semantic boundary | pass；无 raw external body、tools semantic execution、runtime loop、member lifecycle、artifact/evidence truth 或 investigation lifecycle。 |
| implementation facts | pass；本节未产生代码、run、test、evidence、acceptance、commit 或 sign-off 事实。 |

至此§14.3~§14.4、support family #33、forward #8 与 `FailureSourceMarker::from_redline` 反向重验局部闭合；跨对象与跨分件结果由下方§14A统一收束并形成用户停审门禁。

## 14A. Batch 4 closure audit 与停审门禁

### 14A.7 Owner-group ordering、failure classification 与 recovery gate

authorization UoW固定保存guard release basis、handle `ReleasePending`、optional orphan `Recovering`、audit和stored result，然后才允许external call。matching confirmation与definitive failure是互斥分支：

```text
ReleaseConfirmed
  -> fresh complete redline coverage + completion basis
  -> handle / lease / orphan / boundary closure
  -> cleanup Completed or post-release redline safety hold in same UoW

Definitive non-retryable failure
  -> cleanup.record_release_failure
  -> optional orphan.mark_failed
  -> blocked cleanup + failed orphan + audit + stored result UoW

Retryable | Unavailable | Timeout | Unknown | CommitUnknown
  -> no completion basis
  -> no failure basis
  -> keep same authorization and inspect / retry same backend target
```

独立confirmation recorder已失效；`Allowed + completion_basis Some`不得单独flush、commit或materialize。
matching confirmation UoW必须继续完成全部适用owner transition、`settle_release_confirmation`、completion relation rows、
audit、stored result与immutable cleanup view binding后一次提交。fresh coverage all-Released时可在同一UoW继续context /
identity closure；存在late redline时必须提交post-release hold并保持context / identity / material未关闭。任一步失败都回滚
Sandbox-side write set；read view永远不能触发这些动作。

definitive failure后handle保持未释放，旧guard与旧orphan attempt不可复活。新attempt必须先取得同一backend target的fresh lifecycle observation，并通过唯一mapper同时形成handle / orphan所需typed carrier；随后使用新的`CleanupGuardRef`，有persisted lease且满足orphan eligibility时再使用新的`OrphanRecoveryRecordRef`。partial handle由`BoundaryOnlyReleaseFailureRecovery`绑定旧blocked guard、old failure basis、fresh summary与current `ReleasePending` handle；fresh summary为`Unavailable`时新guard固定停在`PendingEvidence`，不得生成release basis。只有后续更晚的可判定summary重新形成evidence并通过strict evaluation，才可授权new attempt；该authorization不重复调用handle transition，也不伪造lease或orphan。late confirmation、single-winner version、commit-unknown与operation reconciliation必须在Step 9、11~13展开，但不得弱化本节basis relation。
