## 15. Batch 5 (historical snapshot): Reference / Projection / Derived exact object contract

> 本节及其 §15.9.7 尾部 gate 是 batch 5 完成时的历史停审快照。batch 5 已由用户确认并被当前 batch 6 消费；它不再表示本文件的 current recovery point。当前状态与新增契约从 §16 开始。

本节只闭合 `6R-04 batch 5` 的 8 个 named type 与 support family #34~#36。batch 4 的 cleanup / redline object contract 已获用户确认，本节不得修改其 release、failure、containment 或 recovery 语义。batch 6 的 public view、audit、relay、comparison 与 reconciliation report 仍保持冻结。

batch 5 使用两个严格隔离的 committed cursor：

| cursor | 唯一语义 | 本节可保存的位置 | 禁止替代 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SandboxTruthCursor` | 已提交 Sandbox core truth snapshot 的单调位置 | derived / projection source coverage、truth-triggered rebuild marker | reference change cursor、repository version、timestamp |
| `SandboxReferenceCursor` | 已提交 reference / projection marker mutation 的单调位置 | 已提交 reference change触发的 derived marker、application receipt / mutation envelope；不作为本次待提交对象的前置构造参数 | truth cursor、source version、event dedup key |

对象 contract 必须区分两种 cursor 时点：

1. domain factory / transition 可消费的 `source cursor` 已由更早事务提交，例如 committed truth cursor 或已提交 reference change cursor；
2. 当前 mutation 的 commit cursor 只能由 UoW 在 write set 已完整 staged 后分配，并保存到 repository mutation metadata、stored result、receipt 或后续 marker；
3. named object、marker或set不得要求 caller 在 stage 前传入“本次 mutation cursor”，也不得由 domain、repository mapper、clock、version或id generator预造 cursor；
4. 若当前 reference mutation 将触发 derived stale，必须先提交 reference mutation并取得 `SandboxReferenceCursor`，再以该已提交 cursor 构造后续 `DerivedRebuildMarker`；不得在同一未提交对象图里形成自引用 cursor。

### 15.1 `ReferenceRefreshMarker`

本节是 `S6T-04-014` 中 `ReferenceRefreshMarker` 的唯一业务契约。Rust declaration 仍位于既有 `crates/contracts/src/refs.rs`。marker 只表达“某个已跟踪 external source observation 需要重新解析”，不表达 resolver 已成功、不决定首次 intake、不携带外部正文，也不拥有本次 mutation 的 commit cursor。

#### 15.1.1 Trigger 与 exact marker schema

```rust
use core_contracts::metadata::Timestamp;

/// 穷尽长期 external reference 需要重新解析的触发类别。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum ReferenceRefreshTrigger {
    /// 外部 owner 提供的新 source version 与当前 observation 不同。
    SourceVersionAdvanced,
    /// 外部 owner 提供的新 source digest 与当前 observation 不同。
    SourceDigestChanged,
    /// safe summary 已被外部 owner 声明变化，需要重新绑定。
    SafeSummaryChanged,
    /// 外部 source availability 发生变化，需要重新确认 finite disposition。
    AvailabilityChanged,
    /// 维护策略要求对当前 observation 做显式重检，不假定 source 已变化。
    ScheduledRecheck,
}

/// 标记 exact tracked source observation 需要 refresh 的 body-free maintenance input。
///
/// marker 同时保存 transition 期望看到的旧 observation 与触发方提供的新 observation，
/// 以阻止 stale worker 覆盖较新的 reference state。它不保存 external body、resolver payload
/// 或当前 mutation 尚未分配的 `SandboxReferenceCursor`。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct ReferenceRefreshMarker {
    /// marker 唯一目标的 long-lived reference state。
    reference_state_ref: ReferenceResolutionStateRef,
    /// transition 必须在 current binding 中精确看到的旧 source observation。
    expected_source: ExternalSourceRef,
    /// inbound event、refresh selector或trusted source提供的新 body-free observation。
    observed_source: ExternalSourceRef,
    /// 触发 refresh 的有限类别。
    trigger: ReferenceRefreshTrigger,
    /// owner 提供的非空、已脱敏 refresh 原因。
    reason: SandboxReason,
    /// marker observation time；不充当 source version、cursor或repository version。
    marked_at: Timestamp,
}

impl ReferenceRefreshMarker {
    /// 从同一 external source identity 的 expected / observed observation构造marker。
    pub fn try_new(
        reference_state_ref: ReferenceResolutionStateRef,
        expected_source: ExternalSourceRef,
        observed_source: ExternalSourceRef,
        trigger: ReferenceRefreshTrigger,
        reason: SandboxReason,
        marked_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, ReferenceRefreshMarkerError>;

    /// 返回 marker 唯一目标的 reference state ref。
    pub fn reference_state_ref(&self) -> &ReferenceResolutionStateRef;
    /// 返回 transition 必须精确匹配的旧 source observation。
    pub fn expected_source(&self) -> &ExternalSourceRef;
    /// 返回触发方提供的新 source observation。
    pub fn observed_source(&self) -> &ExternalSourceRef;
    /// 返回有限 refresh trigger。
    pub fn trigger(&self) -> ReferenceRefreshTrigger;
    /// 返回 caller-safe refresh reason。
    pub fn reason(&self) -> &SandboxReason;
    /// 返回 marker observation time。
    pub fn marked_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
}

/// reference refresh marker 的构造失败。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum ReferenceRefreshMarkerError {
    /// expected 与 observed source 不是同一 `(source kind, resource ref)` identity。
    SourceIdentityMismatch,
    /// `SourceVersionAdvanced` 未提供两个不同的 non-empty source version refs。
    SourceVersionDidNotAdvance,
    /// `SourceDigestChanged` 未提供两个不同的 source digests。
    SourceDigestDidNotChange,
    /// marker time 不满足 canonical timestamp contract。
    MarkerTimestampInvalid,
}
```

#### 15.1.2 Constructor relation matrix

| trigger | expected / observed identity | version relation | digest relation | 结果 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `SourceVersionAdvanced` | `same_source = true` | 两侧必须 `Some` 且不相等 | 可相同或变化 | marker valid |
| `SourceDigestChanged` | `same_source = true` | 可相同或缺失 | 两侧必须 `Some` 且不相等 | marker valid |
| `SafeSummaryChanged` | `same_source = true` | 可相同；新summary尚未进入marker | 可相同 | marker valid，resolver结果后续形成checked binding |
| `AvailabilityChanged` | `same_source = true` | 可保留last-known version | 可保留last-known digest | marker valid，不提前选择`Unavailable | Resolved` |
| `ScheduledRecheck` | `same_source = true` | 可完全相同 | 可完全相同 | marker valid，不伪造source变化 |

`same_source` 只比较 `ExternalSourceKind + resource_ref`，因此 marker 不能把 Identity ref 改挂为 Work ref，也不能在同 kind 下替换另一 opaque resource。`SourceVersionAdvanced` 的“advanced”只表示 observation 不同，不解析 version 文本、不比较语义版本大小；顺序与新旧合法性由 external owner / resolver 保证。若 source 不提供版本但提供 digest，必须选择 `SourceDigestChanged`，不得拼造 version ref。

#### 15.1.3 Domain consumption 与 cursor boundary

`ReferenceRefreshMarker` 只能由 trusted consumer mapper、reference refresh selector 或已验证 maintenance input 创建。query、public DTO mapper、repository loader和projection reader不得创建 marker。domain owner 消费 marker 时必须再次检查：

1. `reference_state_ref` 与 loaded `ReferenceResolutionState` 完全相等；
2. current binding 的 `ExternalSourceRef` 与 `expected_source` 全字段相等，而不仅是 `same_source`；
3. marker `marked_at` 不早于 current binding `observed_at`；
4. target binding 当前不是 `Invalid` 的终止性 owner mismatch，除非后续明确提供新的合法 checked resolution observation；
5. 成功只把 exact binding 标为 `Stale`，不得同时调用 resolver、替换 safe summary、刷新 projection或改写core truth。

marker 自身不包含 `SandboxReferenceCursor`。application 顺序固定为：

```text
load Versioned<ReferenceResolutionState>
  -> state.mark_stale(marker, audit_ref, changed_at)
  -> stage updated state + audit/stored result/receipt
  -> UoW.assign_reference_marker_cursor()
  -> save assigned cursor in mutation metadata / receipt
  -> commit
  -> only then may downstream build DerivedRebuildMarker::from_reference_change(cursor, ...)
```

这条顺序同时禁止两个 historical pattern：一是把 upstream event dedup key / source version当作 `SandboxReferenceCursor`；二是要求 marker 在 state stage 前持有本次尚未提交的 reference cursor。

#### 15.1.4 Marker self-review

| check | current result |
|---|---|
| body-free | 只含typed refs、finite trigger、safe reason和time；无external body / raw error |
| exact target | state ref + expected full observation + observed same-source observation |
| lost-update guard | current binding必须全字段等于expected source |
| cursor cycle | marker不含本次mutation cursor；current cursor由UoW在stage后分配 |
| intake boundary | marker不能改变`ExecutionContextResolution`或`ContextReferenceResolution` |
| query boundary | query不得构造或消费marker产生写入 |
| owner path | `crates/contracts/src/refs.rs`；planned新增路径0 |

### 15.2 `ReferenceResolutionState`

`ReferenceResolutionState` 是一个 external source identity 的长期、body-free refresh state。它不复用 intake 的 `ContextReferenceResolution`，也不把多个 external refs 压进一个 aggregate 后按数组位置关联 safe summaries。每个 state 只拥有一个 `TrackedExternalRefBinding`；需要跟踪多个 external refs 时，repository 保存多个独立 `ReferenceResolutionStateRef`。

#### 15.2.1 Support family #34: checked binding 与 resolver observation

historical `TrackedExternalRefSet` 失效。`ExternalSourceRefSet` 与 `SafeSummaryRefSet` 仍可作为 resolver batch transport，但不得直接成为长期 state 的两个平行字段。current support family #34 使用以下逐项 relation carrier：

```rust
use core_contracts::metadata::Timestamp;

/// 一个 external source 与其 optional safe summary 的 checked、body-free长期绑定。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct TrackedExternalRefBinding {
    /// 当前跟踪的 exact external source observation。
    external_source: ExternalSourceRef,
    /// 当前 source observation对应的 optional safe summary ref。
    safe_summary: Option<SafeSummaryRef>,
    /// resolver确认本 binding 的时间；不充当source version或cursor。
    observed_at: Timestamp,
}

impl TrackedExternalRefBinding {
    /// 构造带 safe summary 的resolved binding；source kind必须相同。
    pub fn resolved(
        external_source: ExternalSourceRef,
        safe_summary: SafeSummaryRef,
        observed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, ReferenceResolutionStateError>;

    /// 构造当前没有safe summary的body-free binding，用于stale/unresolved/unavailable/invalid状态。
    pub fn without_summary(
        external_source: ExternalSourceRef,
        observed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, ReferenceResolutionStateError>;

    /// 返回 exact external source observation。
    pub fn external_source(&self) -> &ExternalSourceRef;
    /// 返回 optional safe summary ref。
    pub fn safe_summary(&self) -> Option<&SafeSummaryRef>;
    /// 返回 resolver observation time。
    pub fn observed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
    /// 判断 source与summary是否具有同一`ExternalSourceKind`且summary存在。
    pub fn has_compatible_summary(&self) -> bool;
}

/// resolver / trusted consumer 对一个 tracked source 给出的有限业务 disposition。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum ReferenceResolutionDisposition {
    /// source与safe summary均已body-free解析。
    Resolved,
    /// resolver确认source observation仍有效，但summary或source version已过期。
    Stale,
    /// source identity有效，但当前无法解析必需summary或owner relation。
    Unresolved,
    /// source格式、owner、scope或forbidden-body边界非法。
    Invalid,
    /// external owner或resolver暂不可用。
    Unavailable,
}

/// resolver完成一次body-free解析后交给domain state的checked observation。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct ReferenceResolutionObservation {
    /// observation唯一目标的reference state。
    reference_state_ref: ReferenceResolutionStateRef,
    /// resolver观察到的binding；`Resolved`时必须含safe summary。
    binding: TrackedExternalRefBinding,
    /// finite resolver disposition。
    disposition: ReferenceResolutionDisposition,
    /// non-resolved disposition的caller-safe原因。
    reason: Option<SandboxReason>,
    /// entry / resolver scanner提供的forbidden-body markers。
    forbidden_body_markers: ForbiddenExternalBodyMarkerSet,
}

impl ReferenceResolutionObservation {
    /// 构造resolved observation；summary必须存在且forbidden marker为空。
    pub fn resolved(
        reference_state_ref: ReferenceResolutionStateRef,
        binding: TrackedExternalRefBinding,
        forbidden_body_markers: ForbiddenExternalBodyMarkerSet,
    ) -> Result<Self, ReferenceResolutionStateError>;

    /// 构造stale observation并保留last-known body-free binding。
    pub fn stale(
        reference_state_ref: ReferenceResolutionStateRef,
        binding: TrackedExternalRefBinding,
        reason: SandboxReason,
        forbidden_body_markers: ForbiddenExternalBodyMarkerSet,
    ) -> Result<Self, ReferenceResolutionStateError>;

    /// 构造unresolved observation；不得把port error字符串当reason。
    pub fn unresolved(
        reference_state_ref: ReferenceResolutionStateRef,
        binding: TrackedExternalRefBinding,
        reason: SandboxReason,
        forbidden_body_markers: ForbiddenExternalBodyMarkerSet,
    ) -> Result<Self, ReferenceResolutionStateError>;

    /// 构造invalid observation；非空forbidden marker只能进入本分支。
    pub fn invalid(
        reference_state_ref: ReferenceResolutionStateRef,
        binding: TrackedExternalRefBinding,
        reason: SandboxReason,
        forbidden_body_markers: ForbiddenExternalBodyMarkerSet,
    ) -> Result<Self, ReferenceResolutionStateError>;

    /// 构造external owner暂不可用的observation。
    pub fn unavailable(
        reference_state_ref: ReferenceResolutionStateRef,
        binding: TrackedExternalRefBinding,
        reason: SandboxReason,
        forbidden_body_markers: ForbiddenExternalBodyMarkerSet,
    ) -> Result<Self, ReferenceResolutionStateError>;

    /// 返回target state ref。
    pub fn reference_state_ref(&self) -> &ReferenceResolutionStateRef;
    /// 返回checked binding。
    pub fn binding(&self) -> &TrackedExternalRefBinding;
    /// 返回finite disposition。
    pub fn disposition(&self) -> ReferenceResolutionDisposition;
    /// 返回non-resolved safe reason。
    pub fn reason(&self) -> Option<&SandboxReason>;
    /// 返回forbidden-body marker set。
    pub fn forbidden_body_markers(&self) -> &ForbiddenExternalBodyMarkerSet;
}
```

binding relation固定为：

| field relation | exact rule |
|---|---|
| external source identity | `ExternalSourceKind + resource_ref`；version / digest是observation属性 |
| safe summary source | `safe_summary.source_kind == external_source.source_kind` |
| source version | 只保存在`ExternalSourceRef.source_version_ref`，不得从summary ref、digest或时间推导 |
| summary version relation | summary owner通过resolver把summary绑定到当前external observation；Sandbox不解析summary body，也不要求summary opaque ref等于source ref |
| cardinality | one state = one external source + zero/one current safe summary；不存在parallel arrays |
| duplicate | 同一个repository scope中同一source identity只允许一个current state，由Step 7 unique lookup / versioned save承接 |

`ReferenceResolutionObservation` 是 finite business outcome，不是 port error wrapper。resolver port返回的 transport / timeout / repository failure必须由application error处理；只有adapter已经安全分类为external source unavailable时，才可构造 `unavailable` observation。query看到state缺失也不能创建`Unresolved` state。

#### 15.2.2 Exact state schema

```rust
/// 长期跟踪一个external source与safe summary binding的Sandbox-owned状态。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct ReferenceResolutionState {
    /// long-lived reference state的typed identity。
    reference_state_ref: ReferenceResolutionStateRef,
    /// current exact external source / optional safe summary binding。
    binding: TrackedExternalRefBinding,
    /// canonical long-lived resolution status。
    resolution_status: ReferenceResolutionStateStatus,
    /// non-resolved status的caller-safe原因。
    status_reason: Option<SandboxReason>,
    /// 使current state进入Stale的latest marker；其它status必须为空。
    refresh_marker: Option<ReferenceRefreshMarker>,
    /// current observation识别出的forbidden-body markers；只允许Invalid非空。
    forbidden_body_markers: ForbiddenExternalBodyMarkerSet,
    /// state首次建立时间。
    tracked_at: Timestamp,
    /// current status生效时间。
    status_changed_at: Timestamp,
    /// 最近一次reference state transition的audit trace ref。
    last_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
}

impl ReferenceResolutionState {
    /// 从resolved observation建立long-lived state；不影响任何既有intake decision。
    pub fn track_resolved(
        observation: ReferenceResolutionObservation,
        tracked_at: Timestamp,
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    ) -> Result<Self, ReferenceResolutionStateError>;

    /// 从non-resolved observation建立long-lived state。
    pub fn track_non_resolved(
        observation: ReferenceResolutionObservation,
        tracked_at: Timestamp,
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    ) -> Result<Self, ReferenceResolutionStateError>;

    /// 消费matching marker，把exact current binding标为Stale。
    pub fn mark_stale(
        &mut self,
        marker: ReferenceRefreshMarker,
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        changed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), ReferenceResolutionStateError>;

    /// 应用resolver对same source identity的checked observation。
    pub fn apply_resolution(
        &mut self,
        observation: ReferenceResolutionObservation,
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        changed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), ReferenceResolutionStateError>;

    /// 返回state identity。
    pub fn reference_state_ref(&self) -> &ReferenceResolutionStateRef;
    /// 返回current checked binding。
    pub fn binding(&self) -> &TrackedExternalRefBinding;
    /// 返回current external source observation。
    pub fn external_source(&self) -> &ExternalSourceRef;
    /// 返回current optional safe summary ref。
    pub fn safe_summary(&self) -> Option<&SafeSummaryRef>;
    /// 返回canonical status。
    pub fn resolution_status(&self) -> ReferenceResolutionStateStatus;
    /// 返回non-resolved safe reason。
    pub fn status_reason(&self) -> Option<&SandboxReason>;
    /// 返回latest stale marker。
    pub fn refresh_marker(&self) -> Option<&ReferenceRefreshMarker>;
    /// 返回current forbidden-body marker set。
    pub fn forbidden_body_markers(&self) -> &ForbiddenExternalBodyMarkerSet;
    /// 返回state首次建立时间。
    pub fn tracked_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
    /// 返回current status change time。
    pub fn status_changed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
    /// 返回latest audit trace ref。
    pub fn last_audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;

    /// 仅Resolved且summary relation完整、forbidden marker为空时支持只读派生。
    pub fn supports_read_derivation(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断state是否需要resolver refresh；不执行refresh。
    pub fn requires_refresh(&self) -> bool;
}
```

#### 15.2.3 Factory field-source closure

| field | exact source | invariant / forbidden substitute |
|---|---|---|
| `reference_state_ref` | `ReferenceResolutionObservation.reference_state_ref`，由application id generator预生成 | 不从external ref拼接；wrong kind reject |
| `binding` | typed resolver observation | one source + optional compatible summary；不从两个set按index zip |
| `resolution_status` | observation disposition唯一映射 | 不接受caller enum参数或reason解析 |
| `status_reason` | observation reason | `Resolved => None`；其它status `Some` |
| `refresh_marker` | `mark_stale` exact marker | 仅`Stale => Some`；apply resolution后清空 |
| `forbidden_body_markers` | resolver / scanner checked marker set | 只有`Invalid`允许非空；非空永不降级为warning |
| `tracked_at` | application clock首次建立时间 | 后续transition不改写 |
| `status_changed_at` | application transition time | 不早于binding observed time、marker time或previous change time |
| `last_audit_trace_ref` | 同UoW planned append-only audit identity | 不接受log line / trace text；batch 6定义audit body |

`track_resolved` 只接受 `Resolved` disposition。`track_non_resolved` 只接受 `Stale | Unresolved | Invalid | Unavailable`，并按 disposition 固定status。`track_non_resolved(Stale)` 不要求 `refresh_marker`，因为initial tracking可能已经收到stale resolver outcome而尚未经历marker transition；只有通过 `mark_stale` 进入的state才保存marker。两种来源必须可区分，不能为满足字段非空而伪造marker。

#### 15.2.4 Transition matrix

| current | method / input | target | exact checks | forbidden effect |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Resolved` | `mark_stale(marker)` | `Stale` | state ref、expected full binding、same-source observed input、time | 不调用resolver；不改intake/core truth |
| `Stale` | same `mark_stale(marker)` | `Stale` idempotent only | marker全字段与persisted marker相同则成功；冲突marker reject | 不覆盖更新marker |
| `Unresolved | Unavailable` | `mark_stale(marker)` | reject | 这些status已要求refresh，不接受stale降级覆盖原因 | 不丢失原status |
| `Invalid` | `mark_stale(marker)` | reject | invalid owner/scope不能由marker恢复 | 不把invalid变stale |
| any | `apply_resolution(resolved observation)` | `Resolved` | same state、same source identity、compatible summary、marker空、time单调 | 不重开intake、不授权launch |
| any | `apply_resolution(stale observation)` | `Stale` | same state/source、safe reason、marker empty allowed | 不伪造marker |
| any | `apply_resolution(unresolved observation)` | `Unresolved` | same state/source、safe reason、forbidden marker empty | 不将port error转业务outcome |
| any | `apply_resolution(unavailable observation)` | `Unavailable` | same state/source、safe reason、forbidden marker empty | 不把query missing转unavailable truth |
| any | `apply_resolution(invalid observation)` | `Invalid` | same state/source；body marker可非空 | 不保留不兼容summary |

`apply_resolution` 在 exact same status、binding、reason、marker set 且 observation / changed time均相同的duplicate replay上幂等；同一time但payload不同、observation time回退、source identity变化或state ref变化必须typed reject。`Resolved` observation会清空旧refresh marker和forbidden markers；`Invalid` observation可保留body-free external source identity，但若safe summary与invalid reason不再可信，binding必须使用`without_summary`，不得携带旧summary制造可读假象。

#### 15.2.5 Status cardinality and read support

| status | safe summary | status reason | refresh marker | forbidden markers | `supports_read_derivation` |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Resolved` | `Some` compatible | `None` | `None` | empty | true |
| `Stale` | `Some` last-known或`None` | `Some` | marker-driven时`Some`，resolver-driven时`None` | empty | false；query可显示last-known但必须degraded |
| `Unresolved` | `None` | `Some` | `None` | empty | false |
| `Invalid` | normally `None` | `Some` | `None` | empty或non-empty | false |
| `Unavailable` | `Some` last-known或`None` | `Some` | `None` | empty | false；不得伪装Resolved |

`requires_refresh()` 对 `Stale | Unresolved | Unavailable` 返回true，对`Resolved`返回false。`Invalid`返回false：invalid source需要新的formal intake / owner-correcting action，而不是maintenance job循环刷新。若后续允许修复invalid relation，必须通过显式resolver observation和Step 9 flow设计，不得让generic refresh scope自动尝试。

#### 15.2.6 `ReferenceResolutionStateError`

```rust
/// long-lived reference state 的构造、关系与transition错误。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum ReferenceResolutionStateError {
    /// binding中的safe summary source kind与external source kind不同。
    SafeSummarySourceKindMismatch,
    /// resolved binding缺少safe summary。
    ResolvedSummaryMissing,
    /// resolved observation携带status reason。
    ResolvedReasonPresent,
    /// non-resolved observation缺少caller-safe reason。
    NonResolvedReasonMissing,
    /// 非Invalid observation携带forbidden-body marker。
    ForbiddenBodyMarkerDispositionMismatch,
    /// observation target不是loaded reference state。
    ReferenceStateRefMismatch {
        /// loaded state ref。
        expected: ReferenceResolutionStateRef,
        /// observation或marker实际target。
        actual: ReferenceResolutionStateRef,
    },
    /// resolver observation替换了external source identity。
    ExternalSourceIdentityMismatch,
    /// stale marker的expected observation与current binding不完全相等。
    RefreshMarkerExpectedSourceMismatch,
    /// stale marker的新observation与current source identity不同。
    RefreshMarkerObservedSourceMismatch,
    /// current status不允许消费refresh marker。
    RefreshMarkerStatusInvalid {
        /// current canonical state status。
        status: ReferenceResolutionStateStatus,
    },
    /// duplicate replay与persisted marker / observation冲突。
    ConflictingReferenceReplay,
    /// factory收到与入口不匹配的resolver disposition。
    ResolutionDispositionInvalid,
    /// binding、marker或transition时间不满足canonical单调关系。
    ReferenceTimestampInvalid,
}
```

对象error不包含external resource ref文本、summary ref文本、raw resolver error或body marker来源正文。application mapper可把validation / conflict / unavailable分层映射到caller-safe surface，但不得用`_ => Internal`掩盖新增variant；Step 12回归时逐variant闭口。

#### 15.2.7 Object self-review 与 downstream revalidation

| check | current result |
|---|---|
| one state / one source | closed；多个external refs以多个state表达 |
| source-summary pairing | closed；逐项`TrackedExternalRefBinding`，不按两个set位置配对 |
| version owner | `ExternalSourceRef.source_version_ref`；不解析、不伪造 |
| body boundary | non-empty forbidden marker只能进入Invalid；任何status都不保存正文 |
| first intake | state不能改变已提交intake decision或context resolution |
| query no-write | query只读取state；缺失不创建Unresolved/Unavailable truth |
| failure boundary | resolver / repository technical error不形成`FailureClassification` |
| cursor boundary | object不保存本次mutation cursor；UoW stage后分配reference cursor |
| owner path | `crates/domain/src/reference_state.rs`；planned新增路径0 |

historical Step 7 `ContextReferenceResolutionOutcome` 仍以 `ExternalSourceRefSet + SafeSummaryRefSet + ReferenceResolutionStatus` 表达并混合intake / long-lived owner，必须在Step 7回归拆分：intake resolver outcome继续服务`ContextReferenceResolution`；tracked refresh outcome必须输出逐项 `ReferenceResolutionObservation`。historical `assign_reference_marker_cursor() -> SandboxTruthCursor` 必须改为 `SandboxReferenceCursor`。本批只登记这些 downstream revalidation，不修改Step 7正文。

### 15.3 `DerivedSourceRefSet`

`DerivedSourceRefSet` 是 inspect / preview / trend 派生状态可消费来源的唯一 closed typed set。它声明在既有 `crates/contracts/src/refs.rs`，不依赖 domain module，不把任何 source body复制进set。historical `ordered unique Vec<SandboxOpaqueRef>` 与不存在owner的 `usage ref` 均失效。

#### 15.3.1 Closed member union

```rust
/// inspect / preview / trend 可消费的body-free committed source identity。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum DerivedSourceRef {
    /// Sandbox-owned controlled execution context truth。
    ControlledExecutionContext(ControlledExecutionContextRef),
    /// Sandbox-owned execution environment identity truth。
    ExecutionEnvironmentIdentity(ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef),
    /// 一次intake整体resolution value。
    ExecutionContextResolution(ExecutionContextResolutionRef),
    /// 一次intake external reference boundary snapshot。
    ContextReferenceResolution(ContextReferenceResolutionRef),
    /// immutable coherent boundary requirement set。
    BoundaryRequirement(BoundaryRequirementSetRef),
    /// coherent boundary truth。
    CoherentBoundary(CoherentBoundaryRef),
    /// boundary establishment attempt decision。
    BoundaryDecision(BoundaryEstablishmentDecisionRef),
    /// body-free backend capability snapshot。
    BackendCapability(BackendCapabilitySummaryRef),
    /// Sandbox-managed isolation environment handle。
    IsolationHandle(IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef),
    /// given policy applicability snapshot。
    PolicyApplicability(PolicyApplicabilitySnapshotRef),
    /// formal policy execution decision。
    PolicyDecision(PolicyExecutionDecisionRef),
    /// one high-risk action decision。
    HighRiskActionDecision(HighRiskActionDecisionRef),
    /// Sandbox-owned controlled run truth。
    ControlledRun(ControlledExecutionRunRef),
    /// immutable capture fact。
    Capture(CaptureFactRef),
    /// capture group内一个stable material key；两字段共同构成identity。
    CapturedMaterial {
        /// owning capture fact ref。
        capture_ref: CaptureFactRef,
        /// capture group内stable material key。
        material_key: CapturedMaterialKey,
    },
    /// Sandbox-owned observability material lifecycle truth。
    ObservabilityMaterial(ObservabilityMaterialRef),
    /// Sandbox-owned material handoff truth。
    Handoff(HandoffFactRef),
    /// stable failure classification truth。
    Failure(FailureClassificationRef),
    /// accepted / duplicate / conflicted control truth。
    Control(ControlFactRef),
    /// isolation environment lease record。
    Lease(LeaseRecordRef),
    /// orphan recovery record。
    OrphanRecovery(OrphanRecoveryRecordRef),
    /// cleanup readiness / completion guard truth。
    CleanupGuard(CleanupGuardRef),
    /// security redline containment truth。
    RedlineContainment(RedlineContainmentRef),
    /// long-lived external source / safe summary tracking state。
    ReferenceResolutionState(ReferenceResolutionStateRef),
    /// rebuildable Sandbox read projection identity。
    ReadProjection(SandboxReadProjectionRef),
    /// external owner限定的body-free safe summary ref。
    SafeSummary(SafeSummaryRef),
}

impl DerivedSourceRef {
    /// 判断两个member是否表示完全相同的typed source identity。
    pub fn same_source(&self, other: &Self) -> bool;

    /// 判断member是否属于Sandbox core truth / lifecycle owner，而非summary或projection。
    pub fn is_local_truth(&self) -> bool;

    /// 判断member是否依赖reference / projection marker cursor。
    pub fn is_reference_side(&self) -> bool;

    /// 返回captured material member的owning capture ref；其它variant返回None。
    pub fn captured_material_owner(&self) -> Option<&CaptureFactRef>;
}

/// 保存插入顺序且不允许重复、空集合或local identity碰撞的derived source refs。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct DerivedSourceRefSet(Vec<DerivedSourceRef>);

impl DerivedSourceRefSet {
    /// 构造非空ordered-unique closed source set；不自动排序、去重或选择latest。
    pub fn try_new(
        source_refs: Vec<DerivedSourceRef>,
    ) -> Result<Self, DerivedSourceRefSetError>;

    /// 返回不可变source切片。
    pub fn as_slice(&self) -> &[DerivedSourceRef];
    /// 返回source数量；checked set必须大于零。
    pub fn len(&self) -> usize;
    /// 判断set是否包含exact typed source identity。
    pub fn contains(&self, source_ref: &DerivedSourceRef) -> bool;
    /// 判断self每个member是否都存在于other；不比较插入顺序。
    pub fn is_subset_of(&self, other: &Self) -> bool;
    /// 判断set是否含至少一个Sandbox local truth source。
    pub fn has_local_truth_source(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断set是否含至少一个reference state、safe summary或read projection source。
    pub fn has_reference_side_source(&self) -> bool;
}

/// derived source closed set 的shape错误。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum DerivedSourceRefSetError {
    /// derived state没有任何formal source identity。
    EmptyDerivedSourceSet,
    /// 同一typed source identity重复出现。
    DuplicateDerivedSource,
    /// 不同local named-ref variant复用了同一底层Sandbox object identity。
    LocalDerivedSourceIdentityCollision,
    /// captured material member的capture ref或material key不满足contracts carrier不变量。
    CapturedMaterialSourceInvalid,
}
```

#### 15.3.2 Variant boundary and identity rules

| member family | identity key | cursor family | body boundary |
|---|---|---|---|
| local named truth ref | named ref kind + underlying `ResourceRef` | `SandboxTruthCursor` | 只保存typed ref，不读取object body |
| `CapturedMaterial` | `capture_ref + CapturedMaterialKey` | `SandboxTruthCursor` | key只定位body-free material row；不保存output body |
| `ReferenceResolutionState` | named state ref | `SandboxReferenceCursor` | state body由repository另读；set不复制external ref |
| `ReadProjection` | named projection ref | `SandboxReferenceCursor` | projection是read source，不是truth source |
| `SafeSummary` | `source_kind + summary_ref` | `SandboxReferenceCursor` | 只保存summary pointer / optional digest，不保存summary body |

set保留 caller / committed snapshot 提供的插入顺序，用于 deterministic view assembly 和 report comparison；它不按opaque ref文本排序，也不把顺序解释为优先级。重复 exact member必须拒绝。对local named refs，如果两个不同variant包装同一底层Sandbox object identity，视为id generator / mapper碰撞并拒绝；external `SafeSummaryRef` 与local ref不跨namespace比较字符串。

`CapturedMaterial` 必须同时携带 owning `CaptureFactRef` 与 `CapturedMaterialKey`。只传material key无法证明capture group；只传capture ref无法选择material。set constructor只校验carrier shape和重复，material key是否真的属于capture由derived rebuild snapshot assembler从committed `CaptureFact` / material rows验证，不能由contracts set访问repository。

#### 15.3.3 Kind-specific minimum source rules

`DerivedSourceRefSet`本身不拥有derived kind，但`DerivedInspectPreviewTrendState`和batch 6 view factory必须应用以下最小规则：

| `DerivedMaterialKind` | minimum source | optional source | forbidden shortcut |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Inspect` | 至少一个local truth、captured material、reference state或read projection | safe summary | 只传scope string / query selector |
| `Preview` | 至少一个`Capture | CapturedMaterial | ObservabilityMaterial | Handoff | ReadProjection` | matching safe summary / reference state | raw stdout、file bytes、artifact body |
| `Trend` | 至少一个`ObservabilityMaterial | Capture | Handoff | Failure | Control | Lease | OrphanRecovery | ReadProjection` | safe summaries / reference states | invented usage ref、metric body、log query |
| `BackendComparison` | 本state不接受；batch 6 comparison owner自行验证capability / boundary refs | n/a | 借inspect/preview/trend state承载comparison lifecycle |
| `Reconciliation` | 本state不接受；batch 6 report owner使用truth / projection ref sets | n/a | 借derived state修复truth |

minimum source rule只证明输入类别，不证明数据完整或可见性。visibility、scope authorization、summary compatibility、material safety和projection freshness由各自owner / application flow继续校验。caller提供的optional filter不能替换repository正式加载出的full source set。

#### 15.3.4 Negative cuts and self-review

| forbidden pattern | current disposition |
|---|---|
| `Vec<SandboxOpaqueRef>` / `Vec<ResourceRef>` | historical invalid；无兼容constructor |
| `SandboxOpaqueRef` variant | 不存在；wrong-kind必须在named ref conversion处失败 |
| `UsageRef` / capacity row placeholder | 不创建；trend消费正式capture / observability / lifecycle refs |
| external source body ref直接作为preview | 不允许；必须先形成`ReferenceResolutionState`或`SafeSummaryRef` |
| audit / relay / reconciliation source提前进入本set | 不进入batch 5；batch 6有独立owner / sets |
| empty source set | reject；不能形成无来源derived material |
| repository latest scan补source | forbidden；source set来自formal lookup / committed snapshot |

owner path固定为`crates/contracts/src/refs.rs`，planned新增source path为0。Step 7 / 8 historical `scope_ref: SandboxOpaqueRef`、caller optional `DerivedSourceRefSet` filter和derived repository `SandboxOpaqueRef`返回值均待后续逐协议重验；本节不修改下游正文。

### 15.4 `DerivedRebuildMarker`

`DerivedRebuildMarker` 是一次已提交 source change 对某个 derived state 的 body-free maintenance marker。它只描述“哪个 derived state、因哪个已提交 source cursor、需要按什么原因重建”，不保存派生正文、builder output、query selector 或本次尚未提交的 derived mutation cursor。marker 的 source cursor 必须已经属于 committed snapshot；当前 derived state 的新版本由 UoW 在 write set staged 后分配，不能反向作为 marker 的输入。

#### 15.4.1 Exact marker schema

```rust
/// 触发 derived state 失效或显式重建的有限原因。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum DerivedRebuildTrigger {
    /// Sandbox core truth cursor 已前进。
    TruthCursorAdvanced,
    /// reference / projection marker cursor 已前进。
    ReferenceCursorAdvanced,
    /// source set 的 exact member coverage 发生变化。
    SourceSetChanged,
    /// derived builder 失败后请求按同一 source snapshot 重试。
    FailedRetry,
    /// operator-safe maintenance 请求显式重建，不假定 source 已变化。
    ScheduledRebuild,
}

/// 绑定一个已提交 source coverage 的 derived rebuild marker。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct DerivedRebuildMarker {
    /// marker 唯一目标的 derived state。
    derived_state_ref: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStateRef,
    /// marker 生成前已提交的 source ref coverage。
    source_refs: DerivedSourceRefSet,
    /// core truth source 的已提交位置；没有 core truth source 时为 None。
    source_truth_cursor: Option<SandboxTruthCursor>,
    /// reference / projection source 的已提交位置；没有 reference-side source 时为 None。
    source_reference_cursor: Option<SandboxReferenceCursor>,
    /// 触发重建的有限类别。
    trigger: DerivedRebuildTrigger,
    /// caller-safe、非空重建原因。
    reason: SandboxReason,
    /// marker observation time；不充当 cursor 或 repository version。
    marked_at: Timestamp,
}

impl DerivedRebuildMarker {
    /// 从已提交 source coverage 构造 marker；cursor 与 source set 必须形成一致关系。
    pub fn try_new(
        derived_state_ref: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStateRef,
        source_refs: DerivedSourceRefSet,
        source_truth_cursor: Option<SandboxTruthCursor>,
        source_reference_cursor: Option<SandboxReferenceCursor>,
        trigger: DerivedRebuildTrigger,
        reason: SandboxReason,
        marked_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, DerivedRebuildMarkerError>;

    /// 从已提交 Sandbox truth change 构造 marker；不携带当前 derived mutation cursor。
    pub fn from_truth_change(
        derived_state_ref: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStateRef,
        source_refs: DerivedSourceRefSet,
        source_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
        reason: SandboxReason,
        marked_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, DerivedRebuildMarkerError>;

    /// 从已提交 reference / projection marker change 构造 marker。
    pub fn from_reference_change(
        derived_state_ref: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStateRef,
        source_refs: DerivedSourceRefSet,
        source_reference_cursor: SandboxReferenceCursor,
        reason: SandboxReason,
        marked_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, DerivedRebuildMarkerError>;

    /// 返回 derived state target。
    pub fn derived_state_ref(&self) -> &DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStateRef;
    /// 返回 committed source coverage。
    pub fn source_refs(&self) -> &DerivedSourceRefSet;
    /// 返回 optional committed truth cursor。
    pub fn source_truth_cursor(&self) -> Option<SandboxTruthCursor>;
    /// 返回 optional committed reference cursor。
    pub fn source_reference_cursor(&self) -> Option<SandboxReferenceCursor>;
    /// 返回有限 rebuild trigger。
    pub fn trigger(&self) -> DerivedRebuildTrigger;
    /// 返回 caller-safe reason。
    pub fn reason(&self) -> &SandboxReason;
    /// 返回 marker observation time。
    pub fn marked_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
}

/// derived rebuild marker 的 source、cursor 或时间关系错误。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum DerivedRebuildMarkerError {
    /// source set为空，无法证明 derived 有正式来源。
    EmptySourceCoverage,
    /// local truth source存在但没有对应 committed truth cursor。
    TruthSourceCursorMissing,
    /// reference-side source存在但没有对应 committed reference cursor。
    ReferenceSourceCursorMissing,
    /// cursor存在但source set没有对应 source family。
    CursorWithoutMatchingSource,
    /// truth cursor与reference cursor同时存在，但触发器只允许单一来源。
    MixedCursorTriggerInvalid,
    /// failed retry未绑定已有 failed derived state，不能凭空重试。
    FailedRetrySourceInvalid,
    /// marker time不满足canonical timestamp contract。
    MarkerTimestampInvalid,
}
```

#### 15.4.2 Cursor and trigger matrix

| trigger | required source family | required cursor | optional cursor | exact rule |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `TruthCursorAdvanced` | 至少一个 local truth source | `Some(SandboxTruthCursor)` | 无 | 不接受 reference cursor；source set必须含 local truth |
| `ReferenceCursorAdvanced` | 至少一个 reference-side source | `Some(SandboxReferenceCursor)` | 无 | 不接受 truth cursor；source set必须含 reference state、safe summary或projection |
| `SourceSetChanged` | 任一正式 source | 与实际已提交 change 对应的单一 truth 或 reference cursor | 另一个 cursor必须为`None` | caller不能用旧 cursor冒充当前 source coverage；不得混用两类cursor |
| `FailedRetry` | 与 failed state 的 source set exact 相等 | 与失败前 committed source snapshot 相等 | 无 | 不得扩展或缩减 source set，不得改 kind |
| `ScheduledRebuild` | 任一正式 source | 至少一个 matching committed cursor | 无 | 只表示维护请求，不伪造 source change |

`DerivedSourceRefSet::has_local_truth_source()` 与 `has_reference_side_source()` 是 marker factory 唯一允许的 family 判定。对于`SourceSetChanged`，factory必须根据实际变更来源只填一个cursor；如果source set同时含两类成员，也只能先由对应source owner分别产生两个marker，不能在一个marker内把两个数字拼成跨类型顺序。factory 不从 ref 文本、timestamp、repository version 或 derived state body 推导 cursor。`source_truth_cursor` 与 `source_reference_cursor` 均表示更早已提交的输入；它们不是本次 `mark_stale` / `start_rebuild` mutation 的 commit cursor。

#### 15.4.3 Domain consumption and lost-update rule

`DerivedInspectPreviewTrendState::mark_stale` 消费 marker 时必须逐项检查：

1. marker target 与 state ref 完全相等；
2. marker source set 与 state 当前 source set 完全相等，或由 state owner 明确证明是允许的 source-set replacement；
3. marker cursor 不早于 state 已记录的 source cursor；旧 marker只能幂等返回，不得把较新的 state 覆盖为旧 snapshot；
4. `TruthCursorAdvanced` 只比较 truth cursor，`ReferenceCursorAdvanced` 只比较 reference cursor，不能把两个数字跨类型比较；
5. marker reason 只进入 derived maintenance history / current marker，不形成 `FailureClassification`、run failure或cleanup blocker。

application 顺序固定为：

```text
commit source truth or reference mutation
  -> obtain committed source cursor
  -> load Versioned<DerivedInspectPreviewTrendState>
  -> state.mark_stale(marker)
  -> stage derived state / maintenance result
  -> UoW assigns the derived mutation's own commit metadata
  -> commit
```

如果 source mutation 与 derived stale 需要跨事务衔接，source mutation先提交；不得在一个未提交 write set 中同时要求 source marker引用“本次 derived cursor”。

#### 15.4.4 Negative cuts

| historical / forbidden pattern | current disposition |
|---|---|
| `DerivedRebuildMarker { source_ref: SandboxOpaqueRef }` | historical invalid；必须使用 `DerivedSourceRefSet` |
| `marker_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor`承接所有变化 | invalid；reference-side change必须使用 `SandboxReferenceCursor` |
| 用 source version、repository version或timestamp生成 cursor | forbidden；cursor只能来自UoW committed sequence |
| marker保存preview、metric、log、artifact或external body | forbidden；只允许 refs、cursor、enum、safe reason和time |
| query / projection reader构造marker并写state | forbidden；marker creation与state mutation属于command / maintenance owner |
| `FailedRetry`不带既有 failed state proof | reject；不能把任意 stale state伪装成retry |

owner declaration仍为`crates/contracts/src/refs.rs`，planned新增source path为0；state transition owner为`crates/domain/src/projection.rs`。

### 15.5 `DerivedReadOnlyGuard`

`DerivedReadOnlyGuard` 是 inspect / preview / trend 维护路径的不可关闭 no-write guard。它证明的是“当前调用只允许读取已提交 source、生成 derived state / projection / report marker，禁止修改 Sandbox core truth”；它不替代 `CleanupSafetyGuard`、`RedlineContainmentGuard`、policy guard或application authorization，也不以 caller bool 表示结果。

#### 15.5.1 Support family #35

historical `AllowedDerivedReadKindSet` 与 `ForbiddenDerivedWriteMarkerSet` 只保留为输入诊断。current contract 使用 closed read-kind set加固定 `DerivedWriteTarget` union：写入目标本身由穷尽 enum 表达，不能通过漏配 marker list“放行”。

```rust
/// derived maintenance 允许读取的有限类别。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum DerivedReadKind {
    /// 读取已提交 Sandbox truth。
    SandboxTruth,
    /// 读取已提交 reference / safe summary state。
    ReferenceState,
    /// 读取已提交 Sandbox read projection。
    ReadProjection,
    /// 读取已提交 capture / handoff / observability material summary。
    MaterialSummary,
    /// 读取已提交 lifecycle / failure / control safety summary。
    SafetySummary,
}

/// derived path可能触及的写目标闭集；只有derived-owned surface可写。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum DerivedWriteTarget {
    /// 写入 derived state本身。
    DerivedState,
    /// 写入 read projection stale / rebuild state。
    ReadProjection,
    /// 写入 append-only maintenance marker / job result。
    MaintenanceRecord,
}

/// closed、ordered-unique derived read permission set。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct DerivedReadKindSet(Vec<DerivedReadKind>);

impl DerivedReadKindSet {
    /// 构造非空且覆盖指定调用需要的 read kinds 的集合；不自动排序或去重。
    pub fn try_new(kinds: Vec<DerivedReadKind>) -> Result<Self, DerivedReadKindSetError>;
    /// 返回不可变 read-kind 切片。
    pub fn as_slice(&self) -> &[DerivedReadKind];
    /// 判断集合是否允许指定 read kind。
    pub fn contains(&self, kind: DerivedReadKind) -> bool;
    /// 判断集合是否为空；checked instance恒为 false。
    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool;
}

/// derived read-kind set 的 shape错误。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum DerivedReadKindSetError {
    /// 集合为空，无法证明本次调用读取了正式来源。
    EmptyDerivedReadKindSet,
    /// 同一read kind重复出现；不自动去重。
    DuplicateDerivedReadKind,
}

/// 对一个 derived maintenance invocation 的 body-free source 读取授权。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct DerivedReadAuthorization {
    /// guard唯一绑定的 derived state ref。
    derived_state_ref: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStateRef,
    /// 本次调用声明的 read kinds。
    requested_read_kinds: DerivedReadKindSet,
    /// 本次调用允许写入的derived-owned目标；不能为空且不能含core truth。
    allowed_write_targets: Vec<DerivedWriteTarget>,
    /// application / job提供的evaluation time。
    evaluated_at: Timestamp,
}

impl DerivedReadAuthorization {
    /// 构造已通过guard检查的immutable authorization；不允许core truth写目标。
    pub fn try_new(
        derived_state_ref: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStateRef,
        requested_read_kinds: DerivedReadKindSet,
        allowed_write_targets: Vec<DerivedWriteTarget>,
        evaluated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, DerivedReadOnlyGuardError>;

    /// 返回绑定的 derived state ref。
    pub fn derived_state_ref(&self) -> &DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStateRef;
    /// 返回请求的read kinds。
    pub fn requested_read_kinds(&self) -> &DerivedReadKindSet;
    /// 返回derived-owned write targets。
    pub fn allowed_write_targets(&self) -> &[DerivedWriteTarget];
    /// 返回evaluation time。
    pub fn evaluated_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
}
```

`DerivedWriteTarget` 不包含 context、identity、boundary、policy、run、capture、handoff、failure、control、lease、orphan、cleanup或redline truth。`MaintenanceRecord` 只能保存 marker / job outcome / safe reason；它不是业务 truth，也不能反向触发 core transition。`DerivedReadKindSet` 的成员由调用方声明，但最终是否允许由 guard 对 exact source relation 再检查。

#### 15.5.2 Guard schema and pure evaluation

```rust
/// 对 derived maintenance 执行不可关闭 no-write 约束的 immutable guard。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct DerivedReadOnlyGuard {
    /// guard typed identity。
    guard_ref: DerivedReadOnlyGuardRef,
    /// guard固定允许读取的closed kind set。
    allowed_read_kinds: DerivedReadKindSet,
    /// guard激活时间。
    activated_at: Timestamp,
}

impl DerivedReadOnlyGuard {
    /// 构造 strict guard；必须至少允许 truth、reference或projection中的一种读取。
    pub fn strict(
        guard_ref: DerivedReadOnlyGuardRef,
        allowed_read_kinds: DerivedReadKindSet,
        activated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, DerivedReadOnlyGuardError>;

    /// 对一次调用声明和source relation作纯判断，不启动repository或UoW。
    pub fn evaluate(
        &self,
        authorization: DerivedReadAuthorization,
        source_refs: &DerivedSourceRefSet,
        target_derived_state_ref: &DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStateRef,
        derived_kind: DerivedMaterialKind,
        evaluated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DerivedReadOnlyGuardError>;

    /// 返回guard ref。
    pub fn guard_ref(&self) -> &DerivedReadOnlyGuardRef;
    /// 返回closed allowed read-kind set。
    pub fn allowed_read_kinds(&self) -> &DerivedReadKindSet;
    /// 返回guard activation time。
    pub fn activated_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
}

/// derived no-write guard 的规则、source、time或kind关系错误。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum DerivedReadOnlyGuardError {
    /// read-kind set为空或重复，不能形成strict guard。
    ReadKindSetInvalid,
    /// guard没有任何能读取正式 source的权限。
    ReadKindCoverageMissing,
    /// authorization绑定的derived ref与调用目标不一致。
    DerivedStateRefMismatch,
    /// authorization请求了guard未允许的read kind。
    RequestedReadKindNotAllowed {
        /// 未被guard允许的read kind。
        kind: DerivedReadKind,
    },
    /// source set为空或未覆盖requested read kind。
    SourceReadKindCoverageMismatch,
    /// write target set为空或出现重复项。
    WriteTargetSetInvalid,
    /// write target不是derived-owned闭集，或包含core truth。
    ForbiddenCoreTruthWriteTarget,
    /// comparison / reconciliation不属于本批derived state owner。
    UnsupportedDerivedKind,
    /// evaluation time早于guard activation或不满足canonical timestamp。
    EvaluationTimestampInvalid,
}
```

guard evaluation 固定执行以下顺序：

```text
1. 校验 evaluated_at >= activated_at，并核对 authorization.evaluated_at 与同一 checked clock observation。
2. 校验 authorization.derived_state_ref 与显式 target_derived_state_ref 完全相等，且 requested_read_kinds 是 guard allowed set 的子集。
3. 校验 source_refs 非空、source member kind 与 requested read kinds相符，并重新执行 closed source relation；不接受 caller 传入的“已验证”bool。
4. 校验 allowed_write_targets 只含 DerivedState / ReadProjection / MaintenanceRecord，且无重复；任何 core truth target 立即拒绝。
5. 只允许 `Inspect | Preview | Trend`；`BackendComparison | Reconciliation` 返回 `UnsupportedDerivedKind`，交给 batch 6 owner。
```

成功返回 `Ok(())` 只表示调用具备 derived no-write 资格，不表示 source fresh、derived result成功、projection可读或下游已接收。guard 不修改 source、state、projection、truth或UoW。

#### 15.5.3 No-write proof and negative cuts

| check | exact rule |
|---|---|
| core truth mutation | guard无任何 core truth write target；调用者必须另经对应 domain owner method |
| query path | query不得调用 `evaluate` 后开启UoW；query只消费已提交 state / projection |
| maintenance path | 只能写 derived state、projection marker或maintenance result；不写 context / boundary / policy / run / capture / failure / cleanup |
| config | 没有 permissive mode；配置只能选择已验证 read-kind subset，不能增加 write target |
| failure | guard拒绝是 typed error；不得转成 derived `Failed` 或 core failure |
| source body | source set只含 typed refs；guard不读取external body、metric、log或artifact |

owner path为`crates/domain/src/projection.rs`，support family #35 在本节闭合；`AllowedDerivedReadKindSet`、`ForbiddenDerivedWriteMarkerSet` 和 `forbids_truth_mutation(bool)` 均标记为 historical invalid，无兼容alias。

### 15.6 `DerivedInspectPreviewTrendState`

`DerivedInspectPreviewTrendState` 是 inspect / preview / trend 三类 body-free 派生材料的可重建状态。它记录上一次成功 materialization 所覆盖的来源集合和已提交 cursor，以及当前 rebuild marker；它不保存 preview 正文、trend samples、metric body、dashboard payload、artifact body或builder response。`DerivedMaterialKind::BackendComparison` 与 `DerivedMaterialKind::Reconciliation` 虽然保留在 shared enum 中，但在本对象的所有 factory / transition 中均 typed reject，由 batch 6 独立 owner 承接。

#### 15.6.1 Support family #35: failure 与 completion carrier

```rust
/// derived builder / source validation 的有限失败类别。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum DerivedFailureKind {
    /// source ref、cursor或cross-owner coverage不能形成合法输入。
    SourceCoverageInvalid,
    /// trusted builder拒绝当前已验证的source组合。
    BuilderRejected,
    /// builder输出不能通过body-free derived summary contract。
    DerivedOutputInvalid,
    /// 同一source snapshot的关系或版本检查发生冲突。
    ConsistencyConflict,
    /// 同一marker的重建已经达到维护策略规定的失败终点。
    RetryExhausted,
}

/// derived failed 状态保存的最小、脱敏、body-free失败摘要。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct DerivedFailureSummary {
    /// 本次失败的有限类别；不保存adapter或builder错误文本。
    failure_kind: DerivedFailureKind,
    /// 非空、已脱敏的失败原因。
    reason: SandboxReason,
    /// 失败尝试实际消费的已提交truth cursor。
    source_truth_cursor: Option<SandboxTruthCursor>,
    /// 失败尝试实际消费的已提交reference cursor。
    source_reference_cursor: Option<SandboxReferenceCursor>,
    /// 失败观察时间。
    failed_at: Timestamp,
}

impl DerivedFailureSummary {
    /// 构造body-free failure summary；至少要绑定一个source cursor。
    pub fn try_new(
        failure_kind: DerivedFailureKind,
        reason: SandboxReason,
        source_truth_cursor: Option<SandboxTruthCursor>,
        source_reference_cursor: Option<SandboxReferenceCursor>,
        failed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, DerivedFailureSummaryError>;

    /// 返回有限失败类别。
    pub fn failure_kind(&self) -> DerivedFailureKind;
    /// 返回caller-safe失败原因。
    pub fn reason(&self) -> &SandboxReason;
    /// 返回失败尝试的truth cursor。
    pub fn source_truth_cursor(&self) -> Option<SandboxTruthCursor>;
    /// 返回失败尝试的reference cursor。
    pub fn source_reference_cursor(&self) -> Option<SandboxReferenceCursor>;
    /// 返回失败观察时间。
    pub fn failed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
}

/// trusted derived builder完成一次body-free source materialization后交给state的carrier。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct DerivedRebuildCompletion {
    /// 完成后实际覆盖的source refs；不携带derived view正文。
    source_refs: DerivedSourceRefSet,
    /// 完成后覆盖的truth cursor；与source set按family校验。
    source_truth_cursor: Option<SandboxTruthCursor>,
    /// 完成后覆盖的reference cursor；与source set按family校验。
    source_reference_cursor: Option<SandboxReferenceCursor>,
    /// trusted builder完成时间。
    completed_at: Timestamp,
    /// 本次完成transition的audit trace ref。
    audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
}

impl DerivedRebuildCompletion {
    /// 构造成功完成carrier；不得接收preview、metric或raw builder output。
    pub fn try_new(
        source_refs: DerivedSourceRefSet,
        source_truth_cursor: Option<SandboxTruthCursor>,
        source_reference_cursor: Option<SandboxReferenceCursor>,
        completed_at: Timestamp,
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    ) -> Result<Self, DerivedRebuildCompletionError>;

    /// 返回完成后的source refs。
    pub fn source_refs(&self) -> &DerivedSourceRefSet;
    /// 返回完成后的truth cursor。
    pub fn source_truth_cursor(&self) -> Option<SandboxTruthCursor>;
    /// 返回完成后的reference cursor。
    pub fn source_reference_cursor(&self) -> Option<SandboxReferenceCursor>;
    /// 返回完成时间。
    pub fn completed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
    /// 返回完成transition audit ref。
    pub fn audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;
}

/// derived failure summary 的字段与cursor关系错误。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum DerivedFailureSummaryError {
    /// failure reason为空或未通过SandboxReason脱敏约束。
    FailureReasonInvalid,
    /// failure summary没有任何已提交source cursor。
    FailureSourceCursorMissing,
    /// cursor与失败source coverage不一致。
    FailureSourceCursorRelationInvalid,
    /// failed time不满足canonical timestamp contract。
    FailureTimestampInvalid,
}

/// derived rebuild completion 的source coverage、cursor或时间错误。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum DerivedRebuildCompletionError {
    /// completion source set为空。
    EmptyCompletionSourceSet,
    /// completion source set与cursor family不匹配。
    CompletionSourceCursorRelationInvalid,
    /// completion time不满足canonical timestamp contract。
    CompletionTimestampInvalid,
}
```

`DerivedFailureSummary` 只允许保存 finite kind、safe reason、已提交输入 cursor 和时间。`Unavailable` 不使用该 carrier：外部 source 暂不可用是 derived state 的 availability 状态，不应被误报为 builder failure。`DerivedRebuildCompletion` 的 audit ref只标识本地 transition linkage，不意味着审计记录已发布，也不携带完成正文。

#### 15.6.2 Exact state schema

```rust
/// inspect / preview / trend 派生状态；可由committed source refs重新构建。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct DerivedInspectPreviewTrendState {
    /// derived state的typed identity。
    derived_state_ref: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStateRef,
    /// 当前state声明的closed source coverage。
    source_refs: DerivedSourceRefSet,
    /// 本state唯一承接的三类derived material kind。
    derived_kind: DerivedMaterialKind,
    /// 相对当前source coverage的canonical derived status。
    freshness_status: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStatus,
    /// 最近一次成功materialization实际消费的source coverage；从未成功时为None。
    materialized_source_refs: Option<DerivedSourceRefSet>,
    /// 最近一次成功materialization覆盖的truth cursor；无此family时为None。
    materialized_truth_cursor: Option<SandboxTruthCursor>,
    /// 最近一次成功materialization覆盖的reference cursor；无此family时为None。
    materialized_reference_cursor: Option<SandboxReferenceCursor>,
    /// 当前stale / rebuilding / failed / unavailable lineage的latest marker。
    rebuild_marker: Option<DerivedRebuildMarker>,
    /// 仅Failed状态存在的builder / validation失败摘要。
    failure_summary: Option<DerivedFailureSummary>,
    /// 仅Unavailable状态存在的caller-safe availability reason。
    unavailable_reason: Option<SandboxReason>,
    /// state首次建立时间。
    created_at: Timestamp,
    /// 当前status生效时间。
    status_changed_at: Timestamp,
    /// 最近一次state transition的audit trace ref。
    last_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
}

impl DerivedInspectPreviewTrendState {
    /// 从已提交、完整的source snapshot建立Fresh state。
    pub fn from_sources(
        derived_state_ref: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStateRef,
        source_refs: DerivedSourceRefSet,
        derived_kind: DerivedMaterialKind,
        materialized_truth_cursor: Option<SandboxTruthCursor>,
        materialized_reference_cursor: Option<SandboxReferenceCursor>,
        created_at: Timestamp,
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    ) -> Result<Self, DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStateError>;

    /// 从已知formal target source建立尚无successful materialization的Unavailable state。
    pub fn unavailable_from_sources(
        derived_state_ref: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStateRef,
        source_refs: DerivedSourceRefSet,
        derived_kind: DerivedMaterialKind,
        reason: SandboxReason,
        created_at: Timestamp,
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    ) -> Result<Self, DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStateError>;

    /// 消费matching marker，把state置为Stale；不执行builder或repository read。
    pub fn mark_stale(
        &mut self,
        marker: DerivedRebuildMarker,
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        changed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStateError>;

    /// 从Stale / Failed / Unavailable开始一次matching marker的重建。
    pub fn start_rebuild(
        &mut self,
        marker: DerivedRebuildMarker,
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        started_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStateError>;

    /// 消费同一rebuild marker的成功completion并重新记录source coverage。
    pub fn finish_rebuild(
        &mut self,
        completion: DerivedRebuildCompletion,
    ) -> Result<(), DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStateError>;

    /// 记录同一rebuild marker的derived-only失败，不创建core failure。
    pub fn mark_failed(
        &mut self,
        failure: DerivedFailureSummary,
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    ) -> Result<(), DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStateError>;

    /// 在source暂不可用时保留marker并进入Unavailable；不把technical error写入reason。
    pub fn mark_unavailable(
        &mut self,
        reason: SandboxReason,
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        changed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStateError>;

    /// 返回derived state identity。
    pub fn derived_state_ref(&self) -> &DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStateRef;
    /// 返回当前source refs。
    pub fn source_refs(&self) -> &DerivedSourceRefSet;
    /// 返回derived kind；只能是Inspect / Preview / Trend。
    pub fn derived_kind(&self) -> DerivedMaterialKind;
    /// 返回canonical freshness status。
    pub fn freshness_status(&self) -> DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStatus;
    /// 返回最近成功materialization实际消费的source coverage。
    pub fn materialized_source_refs(&self) -> Option<&DerivedSourceRefSet>;
    /// 返回最近成功materialization的truth cursor。
    pub fn materialized_truth_cursor(&self) -> Option<SandboxTruthCursor>;
    /// 返回最近成功materialization的reference cursor。
    pub fn materialized_reference_cursor(&self) -> Option<SandboxReferenceCursor>;
    /// 返回latest rebuild marker。
    pub fn rebuild_marker(&self) -> Option<&DerivedRebuildMarker>;
    /// 返回Failed状态的failure summary。
    pub fn failure_summary(&self) -> Option<&DerivedFailureSummary>;
    /// 返回Unavailable状态的safe reason。
    pub fn unavailable_reason(&self) -> Option<&SandboxReason>;
    /// 返回state创建时间。
    pub fn created_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
    /// 返回当前status变更时间。
    pub fn status_changed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
    /// 返回最近transition audit ref。
    pub fn last_audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;
    /// 判断当前derived结果是否可按source snapshot读取。
    pub fn supports_read(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断当前状态是否需要rebuild或source recovery。
    pub fn requires_rebuild(&self) -> bool;
}

/// derived state 的kind、source、transition、cursor或字段关系错误。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStateError {
    /// BackendComparison / Reconciliation不能由本state承接。
    UnsupportedDerivedKind {
        /// 被拒绝的shared derived kind。
        kind: DerivedMaterialKind,
    },
    /// source set不满足当前derived kind的minimum source rule。
    DerivedSourceCoverageInvalid,
    /// source set与truth / reference cursor presence不一致。
    DerivedSourceCursorCoverageInvalid,
    /// last-success source coverage与materialized cursor、status或current source关系不一致。
    MaterializedSourceCoverageInvalid,
    /// derived state ref与marker target不一致。
    DerivedStateRefMismatch,
    /// marker source coverage与current state / rebuild attempt不一致。
    DerivedMarkerSourceMismatch,
    /// marker cursor早于已materialized cursor，可能覆盖新结果。
    DerivedMarkerOlderThanMaterialized,
    /// current status不允许requested transition。
    DerivedTransitionNotAllowed {
        /// transition前的canonical status。
        status: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStatus,
    },
    /// completion没有覆盖matching marker的source snapshot。
    DerivedCompletionSourceMismatch,
    /// completion cursor不是matching committed input或缺少required family。
    DerivedCompletionCursorMismatch,
    /// failure summary没有绑定当前rebuild marker或status relation非法。
    DerivedFailureSummaryMismatch,
    /// Failed状态之外携带failure summary。
    UnexpectedFailureSummary,
    /// Unavailable状态之外携带availability reason，或Unavailable没有reason。
    AvailabilityReasonRelationInvalid,
    /// current status / marker / cursor / reason组合不满足canonical矩阵。
    DerivedStatusFieldRelationInvalid {
        /// relation不合法的canonical status。
        status: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStatus,
    },
    /// transition time早于source observation、marker或previous status time。
    DerivedTimestampInvalid,
    /// audit trace ref或source snapshot relation不完整。
    DerivedAuditRelationInvalid,
}
```

#### 15.6.3 Source cursor and field relation

`source_refs` 是当前state准备materialize的正式target coverage；`materialized_source_refs`与
`materialized_*_cursor`共同保存上一次成功完成实际消费的committed snapshot。二者在Fresh时全等，在source
cursor前进或source-set replacement后可以不同。该分离是`§16.8`定向回写：没有last-success source set时，
Stale/Rebuilding/Failed view无法证明旧payload属于哪些refs，application mapper会被迫自行补造关系。

| status | current `source_refs` | last-success coverage / cursors | rebuild marker | failure summary | unavailable reason | read result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Fresh` | valid且满足kind minimum | `Some`且source refs、truth/reference cursor与current target全等 | `None` | `None` | `None` | current materialization可读 |
| `Stale` | matching marker声明的current target；同源变化可与last-success set相等 | 保留上次成功coverage/cursor且必须为Some | `Some` | `None` | `None` | last-known materialization可读，必须显式Stale |
| `Rebuilding` | current attempt target | 保留进入attempt前的last-success coverage/cursor；初始build时可全None | `Some`或初始attempt formal target | `None` | `None` | 有last-success则可读；否则status-only |
| `Failed` | 失败attempt对应target source | 保留上次成功coverage/cursor；初始build失败时可全None | `Some`或initial attempt marker relation | `Some` | `None` | 有last-success则可读；否则status-only failure |
| `Unavailable` | 最后已知formal target source | 保留上次成功coverage/cursor，或从未成功时全None | `Some`或初始无marker | `None` | `Some` | 有last-success则可读；否则status-only unavailable |

last-success coverage规则：`materialized_source_refs=None`时两类materialized cursor必须都是None；Some时，该set含
`is_local_truth()` member则truth cursor必须Some，否则None；含reference-side member则reference cursor必须Some，
否则None。两个cursor只能按各自类型比较，禁止转成一个数字或通用`Version`。`Fresh`强制
`materialized_source_refs=Some(source_refs.clone())`；`finish_rebuild`成功后同时替换current与last-success coverage。

`mark_stale`收到cursor advance marker时current set保持不变；收到合法`SourceSetChanged` marker时把
`source_refs`替换为marker target coverage，但必须保留旧`materialized_source_refs`与cursor。`start_rebuild`不清除
last-success字段；`mark_failed`、`mark_unavailable`也不得用失败attempt的不完整source覆盖last-success coverage。
`supports_read()`只判断last-success coverage是否存在，不宣称current target Fresh，也不替代repository对immutable
materialization row的完整读取。

#### 15.6.4 Transition matrix and fencing

```text
factory(successful source) -> Fresh
factory(unavailable source) -> Unavailable
Fresh | Failed | Unavailable --matching marker--> Stale
Stale --same marker--> Stale (idempotent)
Stale --matching marker--> Rebuilding
Failed --matching marker--> Rebuilding
Unavailable --matching marker--> Rebuilding
Rebuilding --matching completion--> Fresh
Rebuilding --matching failure--> Failed
Rebuilding --safe unavailable reason--> Unavailable
```

`from_sources`只用于builder已经成功且同一UoW还将提交immutable materialization的创建路径；它把
`materialized_source_refs`设为current source clone。`unavailable_from_sources`用于formal target source已知、但尚无
任何successful materialization的初始位置；它把last-success coverage/cursor全部设为None，并要求non-empty safe
availability reason。不得先`from_sources`伪造Fresh再立刻mark unavailable。

`mark_stale` 对相同 marker 只允许幂等成功；对更早 cursor返回`DerivedMarkerOlderThanMaterialized`，对更新 cursor必须保存最新 marker并保持 `Stale`。`start_rebuild`、`finish_rebuild`、`mark_failed` 都必须用 exact marker lineage 做 fencing：旧 job 的 completion / failure 不得覆盖后续 marker。`finish_rebuild` 只有在 completion source set和cursor coverage通过校验后，才将状态置为`Fresh`、同时替换current / last-success coverage并清空 marker、failure和unavailable reason；它不接收或保存任何 derived view body。

`mark_failed` 仅表示 derived builder / source validation 的维护结果，不能调用 `FailureClassification::from_*`，不能改变 context、boundary、policy、run、capture、handoff、cleanup或redline truth。`mark_unavailable` 只接受已分类的safe reason；repository、port、SDK或host错误文本必须在application mapper处丢弃或映射为固定reason后才能进入本对象。

#### 15.6.5 Self-review and historical cuts

| historical / forbidden pattern | current disposition |
|---|---|
| `DerivedFreshnessStatus` | historical invalid；唯一状态owner为`DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStatus` |
| `from_sources(..., BackendComparison | Reconciliation)` | typed reject；由batch 6独立对象承接 |
| `finish_rebuild(DerivedInspectPreviewTrendView)` | historical invalid；public view属于batch 6；state只消费`DerivedRebuildCompletion` |
| 只保存materialized cursor、不保存materialized source set | 已由§16.8定向回写失效；source-set replacement后必须保留last-success exact coverage |
| 先构造Fresh再用`mark_unavailable`表示initial build失败 | invalid；使用`unavailable_from_sources`且last-success字段全None |
| `failure_ref: SandboxOpaqueRef` | historical invalid；失败只保存`DerivedFailureSummary`，不增加failure truth ref |
| query将Stale / Failed改写为Fresh | forbidden；只能由matching rebuild transition改变 |
| derived failure升级为`FailureClassification` | forbidden；derived maintenance failure不属于core failure |
| 用source body、metric body或builder response填充state | forbidden；state始终body-free |

canonical owner为`crates/domain/src/projection.rs`；本节闭合 named type `S6T-04-007` 与 support family #35 的 state-side carriers。

### 15.7 `SandboxStatusViewRefSet`

`SandboxStatusViewRefSet` 是 `SandboxReadProjection` 能够承接的 status-view identity 闭集。它只保存已经由各自 view owner 提交的 typed view ref，不复制 view body、canonical status、degraded reason、audit body或任何 locator。它与 `DerivedSourceRefSet` 的语义不同：本 set 只描述一个 projection 的 status-view 组成，不允许混入 `DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStateRef`、`SandboxReadProjectionRef`、`SandboxOpaqueRef` 或任意 generic `ResourceRef`。

#### 15.7.1 Closed member union 与 cardinality

```rust
/// Sandbox read projection 可承接的八类 caller-safe status view identity。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum SandboxStatusViewRef {
    /// 以 controlled execution context 为主语的总览状态视图。
    Execution(SandboxExecutionStatusViewRef),
    /// 以 coherent boundary 为主语的边界状态视图。
    Boundary(BoundaryStatusViewRef),
    /// 以 policy execution decision 为主语的 policy 摘要视图。
    PolicyDecision(PolicyDecisionSummaryViewRef),
    /// 以 capture fact 为主语的 capture 摘要视图。
    Capture(CaptureSummaryViewRef),
    /// 以 handoff fact 为主语的 material handoff 状态视图。
    MaterialHandoff(MaterialHandoffStatusViewRef),
    /// 以 failure / control truth 为主语的安全状态视图。
    FailureControl(FailureControlStatusViewRef),
    /// 以 cleanup guard 为主语的 cleanup readiness 视图。
    CleanupReadiness(CleanupReadinessViewRef),
    /// 以 redline containment truth 为主语的安全红线视图。
    RedlineContainment(RedlineContainmentViewRef),
}

impl SandboxStatusViewRef {
    /// 从显式 generic object ref 解析 status-view member；错误 kind 不得降级为 unknown。
    pub fn try_from_object_ref(
        value: SandboxObjectRef,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxStatusViewRefError>;

    /// 返回 closed status-view kind；不返回字符串或可扩展标签。
    pub fn kind(&self) -> SandboxStatusViewKind;

    /// 判断 member 是否为 projection 必需的 execution view。
    pub fn is_execution(&self) -> bool;

    /// 返回 member 的底层 named view identity，用于 exact duplicate 检查。
    pub fn identity_key(&self) -> SandboxStatusViewIdentityKey;
}

/// status-view member 的有限类别；不得增加 `Other(String)`。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum SandboxStatusViewKind {
    /// execution status view kind。
    Execution,
    /// boundary status view kind。
    Boundary,
    /// policy decision summary view kind。
    PolicyDecision,
    /// capture summary view kind。
    Capture,
    /// material handoff status view kind。
    MaterialHandoff,
    /// failure / control status view kind。
    FailureControl,
    /// cleanup readiness view kind。
    CleanupReadiness,
    /// redline containment view kind。
    RedlineContainment,
}

/// 由 named view ref 与其 kind 组成的闭合去重键；不暴露底层字符串。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum SandboxStatusViewIdentityKey {
    /// execution view 的 typed identity。
    Execution(SandboxExecutionStatusViewRef),
    /// boundary view 的 typed identity。
    Boundary(BoundaryStatusViewRef),
    /// policy view 的 typed identity。
    PolicyDecision(PolicyDecisionSummaryViewRef),
    /// capture view 的 typed identity。
    Capture(CaptureSummaryViewRef),
    /// handoff view 的 typed identity。
    MaterialHandoff(MaterialHandoffStatusViewRef),
    /// failure / control view 的 typed identity。
    FailureControl(FailureControlStatusViewRef),
    /// cleanup view 的 typed identity。
    CleanupReadiness(CleanupReadinessViewRef),
    /// redline view 的 typed identity。
    RedlineContainment(RedlineContainmentViewRef),
}

/// 一个projection的canonical status-view identity集合；redline member允许按coverage顺序出现多项。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct SandboxStatusViewRefSet(Vec<SandboxStatusViewRef>);

impl SandboxStatusViewRefSet {
    /// 构造status-view ref set；execution恰好一个，六类optional singleton至多一个，redline为0..n。
    pub fn try_new(
        refs: Vec<SandboxStatusViewRef>,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxStatusViewRefSetError>;

    /// 返回canonical kind顺序；同kind的redline保持完整coverage index顺序。
    pub fn as_slice(&self) -> &[SandboxStatusViewRef];

    /// 返回 projection 必需的 execution view ref。
    pub fn execution_ref(&self) -> &SandboxExecutionStatusViewRef;

    /// 按closed singleton kind查找optional view；对redline kind固定返回typed error。
    pub fn get_singleton(
        &self,
        kind: SandboxStatusViewKind,
    ) -> Result<Option<&SandboxStatusViewRef>, SandboxStatusViewRefSetError>;

    /// 按coverage顺序迭代全部redline view refs；不选择latest、highest-severity或first。
    pub fn redline_view_refs(
        &self,
    ) -> impl ExactSizeIterator<Item = &RedlineContainmentViewRef> + '_;

    /// 判断 set 是否包含指定 exact member identity。
    pub fn contains(&self, member: &SandboxStatusViewRef) -> bool;

    /// 返回 member 数量；不会把 optional 缺失解释为 degraded 或 success。
    pub fn len(&self) -> usize;
}

/// generic object ref 到 status-view union 的解析错误。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum SandboxStatusViewRefError {
    /// generic ref 的 kind 不属于八类 status view。
    WrongStatusViewRefKind {
        /// 允许的 closed kind 集合。
        actual: SandboxObjectRefKind,
    },
    /// generic ref 的 underlying resource identity 为空或不满足 named ref contract。
    InvalidStatusViewRefIdentity,
}

/// status-view ref set 的 cardinality / duplicate 错误。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum SandboxStatusViewRefSetError {
    /// projection 没有任何 status view。
    EmptyStatusViewRefSet,
    /// projection 必须有且只能有一个 execution status view。
    MissingExecutionStatusView,
    /// 除redline外的singleton closed kind出现多个member。
    DuplicateSingletonStatusViewKind {
        /// 重复出现的 kind。
        kind: SandboxStatusViewKind,
    },
    /// 同一 typed identity 重复出现，即使 caller 使用了不同包装路径也必须拒绝。
    DuplicateStatusViewIdentity,
    /// caller把允许多项的redline kind传给singleton getter。
    StatusViewKindWasNotSingleton,
    /// member顺序不符合closed kind顺序，或redline内部顺序与coverage index不一致。
    NonCanonicalStatusViewOrder,
    /// member kind 与其 named ref wrapper 不一致。
    StatusViewKindIdentityMismatch,
}
```

cardinality 固定如下：

| member kind | cardinality | 缺失语义 | projection 处理 |
|---|---:|---|---|
| `Execution` | exactly `1` | set shape invalid | 不允许创建 projection；execution view 是 projection 的 context anchor |
| `Boundary` | `0..1` | 生命周期尚未建立或由 source snapshot 明确不适用 | 由 source group / degraded reason 解释，不能由 projection 猜测 |
| `PolicyDecision` | `0..1` | policy 尚未形成或 source group 尚未覆盖 | 不得显示 policy accepted |
| `Capture` | `0..1` | run 尚未进入 capture 或 source 尚未提交 | 不得补造 empty capture |
| `MaterialHandoff` | `0..1` | capture 尚未有 handoff 或 handoff view 尚未提交 | 不得把缺失解释为 `NotRequired` |
| `FailureControl` | `0..1` | 当前没有需要展示的 failure/control view | 是否无 failure 必须由 source status snapshot证明 |
| `CleanupReadiness` | `0..1` | cleanup 尚未产生 guard view | 不得据此放行 cleanup |
| `RedlineContainment` | `0..n ordered-unique` | 只有完整lineage index明确返回零条containment时才允许0项 | 每条coverage ref必须恰好一个matching view；partial / missing view固定使projection source不可用 |

`SandboxStatusViewRefSet` 的 canonical order固定为
`Execution -> Boundary -> PolicyDecision -> Capture -> MaterialHandoff -> FailureControl -> CleanupReadiness ->
RedlineContainment*`。前七类仍按kind唯一；只有最后一类可重复kind，但exact view identity仍必须唯一，且其内部顺序必须
等于§15.7.2完整coverage proof中的containment index顺序。constructor不排序、不丢重、不选择latest。

set-level校验只负责kind、identity、顺序和cardinality；它不能从ref本身推断所属context、canonical status、visibility或
source freshness。singleton缺失是待source snapshot解释的事实，不是自动`Fresh`、`NotRequired`、`Accepted`或
`Clean`。redline 0项更不能仅由set自身证明“没有redline”，必须由完整coverage proof同时成立。

#### 15.7.2 Context lineage binding

projection writer 必须在同一个 committed source snapshot 中取得每个 status view 的 owning context。仅凭八个 typed ref 不能证明它们属于同一 context，因此 `SandboxReadProjection` 不直接接受裸 `SandboxStatusViewRefSet` 作为 rebuild 输入，而是消费以下 body-free binding carrier：

```rust
/// 一个 status view identity 与其已读取 owning context 的 checked binding。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct SandboxStatusViewBinding {
    /// status view 的 closed typed identity。
    view_ref: SandboxStatusViewRef,
    /// 由对应 view getter 复制出的 owning context ref。
    context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
    /// 对应 view source 的 observation time。
    observed_at: Timestamp,
}

impl SandboxStatusViewBinding {
    /// 从已加载的 view identity、context lineage 和 observation time 构造 binding。
    pub fn try_new(
        view_ref: SandboxStatusViewRef,
        context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
        observed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxStatusViewBindingError>;

    /// 返回 view identity。
    pub fn view_ref(&self) -> &SandboxStatusViewRef;
    /// 返回 owning context ref。
    pub fn context_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionContextRef;
    /// 返回 source observation time。
    pub fn observed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
}

/// 一个redline containment truth与其current immutable status view的body-free projection binding。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct SandboxRedlineStatusViewBinding {
    /// exact containment truth identity。

    /// exact current immutable redline view identity。

    context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
    /// loaded containment row当前status transition的truth cursor。

    /// current view binding实际覆盖到的source truth cursor。
    view_source_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
    /// current view binding的materialization observation time。

impl SandboxRedlineStatusViewBinding {
    /// 从同一committed snapshot已校验的truth row与current view binding复制字段。
    pub fn try_from_committed_binding(
        redline_ref: RedlineContainmentRef,
        view_ref: RedlineContainmentViewRef,

/// projection source对一个execution lineage全部redline及current views的完整coverage proof。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct SandboxRedlineStatusViewCoverage {

    /// 返回coverage中exact containment数量。

    /// 判断完整index是否明确证明零条containment。

/// 一个 projection source group 的 status-view lineage 集合。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct SandboxStatusViewBindingSet {
    /// 按输入顺序保存且与每个 binding 同构的 closed view ref set。
    refs: SandboxStatusViewRefSet,
    /// 已逐项校验 lineage 的 binding rows。
    bindings: Vec<SandboxStatusViewBinding>,
    /// 同一source group对全部redline truth与current redline views的完整coverage。
    redline_coverage: SandboxRedlineStatusViewCoverage,
    /// 全组唯一 owning context ref。

    /// binding observation time 的最大值。

impl SandboxStatusViewBindingSet {
    /// 构造binding set；要求refs同构、context相等且redline members与完整coverage逐项一致。
    pub fn try_new(
        bindings: Vec<SandboxStatusViewBinding>,
        redline_coverage: SandboxRedlineStatusViewCoverage,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxStatusViewBindingSetError>;

    /// 返回绑定项的稳定顺序。
    pub fn as_slice(&self) -> &[SandboxStatusViewBinding];
    /// 返回已校验的 status-view ref set。
    pub fn refs(&self) -> &SandboxStatusViewRefSet;
    /// 返回完整redline truth-to-view coverage；零项也携带lineage index proof。
    pub fn redline_coverage(&self) -> &SandboxRedlineStatusViewCoverage;
    /// 返回全组唯一 owning context ref。
    pub fn context_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionContextRef;
    /// 返回所有 view observation time 的最大值。
    pub fn latest_observed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
```
