```rust
/// 单个 view binding 的字段错误。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum SandboxStatusViewBindingError {
    /// view ref 的 identity 或 closed kind 不合法。
    InvalidViewIdentity,
    /// context ref 为空或不满足 named ref contract。
    InvalidContextIdentity,
    /// observation time 不满足 canonical timestamp contract。
    InvalidObservationTime,
}

/// binding set 的 lineage / coverage 错误。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum SandboxStatusViewBindingSetError {
    /// binding set为空。
    EmptyBindingSet,
    /// 同一singleton kind或任一typed identity重复；redline kind本身允许多项。
    DuplicateBinding,
    /// binding未包含恰好一个 execution view。
    ExecutionBindingMissing,
    /// binding与closed status-view ref set的kind / identity不一致。
    BindingRefSetMismatch,
    /// 不同 view声明了不同 owning context。
    ContextLineageMismatch,
    /// redline coverage context与全组context不一致。
    RedlineCoverageContextMismatch,
    /// coverage ref set与truth-to-view binding的redline refs不是exact ordered同构。
    RedlineCoverageRefSetMismatch,
    /// status-view ref set中的redline view refs与coverage bindings不是exact ordered同构。
    RedlineViewCoverageMismatch,
    /// current redline view source cursor早于其loaded truth status cursor。
    RedlineStatusViewWasStale,
    /// coverage、truth、view或proof cursor不满足same-snapshot单调关系。
    RedlineCoverageCursorInvalid,
    /// binding observation time倒退或不是canonical time。
    BindingTimestampInvalid,
}
```

binding set 的构造顺序固定为：

```text
read complete redline lineage index, including an explicit zero-row result
  -> load every exact containment row and its current immutable view binding
  -> SandboxRedlineStatusViewBinding::try_from_committed_binding(...) per index row
  -> SandboxRedlineStatusViewCoverage::try_from_committed_indexes(...)
load each committed status view, including every redline view above
  -> copy view_ref + view.context_ref() + view.observed_at()
  -> SandboxStatusViewBinding::try_new(...)
  -> SandboxStatusViewBindingSet::try_new(bindings, redline_coverage)
  -> verify all context refs equal requested projection context
  -> only then create / rebuild SandboxReadProjection
```

coverage constructor要求`proof_truth_cursor >= containment_coverage.truth_cursor()`；每个binding的
`redline_truth_cursor <= view_source_truth_cursor <= proof_truth_cursor`，且context和redline ref按coverage位置逐项相等。
`SandboxStatusViewBindingSet`再要求其全部`RedlineContainment(view_ref)`成员与coverage binding中的view ref按位置逐项相等。
coverage为空时，两处redline view数量都必须为0；coverage非空时少一条、多一条、重复、换序或stale view均为typed
integrity error。partial page、missing index、status-filtered scan、latest row或repository unavailable不能构造coverage，
也不能降级为“已证明零条redline”。

因此，projection mapper不得把`context_ref`从selector、projection ref、view ref文本或第一个view猜出；也不得只验证
`Execution` view而忽略其余member的lineage。任何view属于另一个context、任一已知redline缺少current view，或任何
current view落后于loaded truth，均属于typed integrity error，不能转成`StatusViewDegradedReasonSet`。

#### 15.7.3 Set self-review 与 downstream boundary

| check | current contract |
|---|---|
| closed union | 仅八个 explicit named view ref variant；无 `SandboxOpaqueRef`、`ResourceRef`、字符串或 `Unknown` |
| duplicate | singleton kind与全部exact typed identity双重拒绝；redline允许多kind但identity仍唯一，不自动去重、不保留latest |
| mandatory member | exactly one `SandboxExecutionStatusViewRef`；其它六类singleton逐项至多一个；redline `0..n ordered-unique` |
| lineage | `SandboxStatusViewBindingSet`逐项校验context；redline额外由完整coverage绑定truth ref、view ref与cursor |
| redline absence | 只接受完整lineage index的zero-row coverage + zero redline view member；裸空set无证明力 |
| body boundary | set / binding 只保存 refs、context ref 和 timestamp；不保存 view body、status、reason或locator |
| degraded boundary | singleton optional缺失不能自动生成degraded reason；已知redline缺view是integrity error，index不可读则source unavailable而非空coverage |
| query boundary | query 只能读取已提交 set；不得构造 binding、补 view、refresh或repair |
| owner path | union / set / identity key在`crates/contracts/src/refs.rs`；binding set为本批support family #36，业务关系由`projection.rs`校验 |
| forward boundary | Step 7 只负责加载同一 snapshot 的各 view和typed lineage；Step 8不得重新定义union；Step 9 job不得从旧projection body反推member |

历史 `SandboxStatusSourceRefSet`、`SandboxStatusViewSourceSet`、`Vec<SandboxOpaqueRef>` 和把八类 view 压成单个 `SandboxProjectionStatus` 字符串均判定为 historical invalid；不提供兼容 alias。

### 15.8 `SandboxReadProjection`

`SandboxReadProjection` 是一个 controlled execution context 的可重建 read identity。它保存当前 status-view ref coverage、已 materialize 的 committed truth/reference cursor、显式 stale/rebuild 状态、caller-safe degraded reasons与audit linkage；它不保存任一 status view body，也不成为 execution、boundary、policy、run、capture、handoff、failure、cleanup或redline truth source。

projection 的变化来源有两个独立通道：

| source channel | cursor | 允许触发的变化 | 禁止替代 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sandbox core truth commit | `SandboxTruthCursor` | truth owner提交后使已存在 projection stale，或成为 rebuild snapshot 的 truth coverage | repository version、timestamp、event id、reference cursor |
| reference / projection marker commit | `SandboxReferenceCursor` | long-lived reference change、status-view marker / coverage change使已存在 projection stale | source version、dedup key、truth cursor、page cursor |

两个 cursor 只在各自类型内单调比较。projection 可以同时覆盖二者，但不能把二者合并成 generic `source_cursor`，也不能比较数值大小决定“哪个更新”。

#### 15.8.1 Projection stale marker 与双通道 fencing

```rust
/// projection 失效的有限来源；不允许 free-form source kind。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum SandboxProjectionStaleTrigger {
    /// committed Sandbox core truth cursor 前进。
    TruthCursorAdvanced,
    /// committed reference / projection marker cursor 前进。
    ReferenceCursorAdvanced,
    /// 同一 context 的 status-view ref coverage 发生变化。
    StatusViewCoverageChanged,
    /// operator-safe maintenance 显式要求重检，但不宣称 truth 变化。
    ScheduledRebuild,
}

/// 一个已提交 source change 对 exact projection 的 body-free stale marker。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct SandboxProjectionStaleMarker {
    /// marker 唯一目标的 read projection。
    projection_ref: SandboxReadProjectionRef,
    /// marker 唯一归属的 controlled execution context。
    context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
    /// truth-side change的committed cursor；非truth trigger时为空。
    source_truth_cursor: Option<SandboxTruthCursor>,
    /// reference-side change的committed cursor；非reference trigger时为空。
    source_reference_cursor: Option<SandboxReferenceCursor>,
    /// stale marker 的有限触发类别。
    trigger: SandboxProjectionStaleTrigger,
    /// caller-safe、非空 stale reason。
    reason: SandboxReason,
    /// marker observation time；不充当cursor或repository version。
    marked_at: Timestamp,
}

impl SandboxProjectionStaleMarker {
    /// 从一个已提交 source cursor 构造 marker；禁止双cursor混用。
    pub fn try_new(
        projection_ref: SandboxReadProjectionRef,
        context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
        source_truth_cursor: Option<SandboxTruthCursor>,
        source_reference_cursor: Option<SandboxReferenceCursor>,
        trigger: SandboxProjectionStaleTrigger,
        reason: SandboxReason,
        marked_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxProjectionStaleMarkerError>;

    /// 从已提交 truth change 构造 projection stale marker。
    pub fn from_truth_change(
        projection_ref: SandboxReadProjectionRef,
        context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
        source_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
        reason: SandboxReason,
        marked_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxProjectionStaleMarkerError>;

    /// 从已提交 reference / projection marker change 构造 stale marker。
    pub fn from_reference_change(
        projection_ref: SandboxReadProjectionRef,
        context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
        source_reference_cursor: SandboxReferenceCursor,
        reason: SandboxReason,
        marked_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxProjectionStaleMarkerError>;

    /// 返回 target projection ref。
    pub fn projection_ref(&self) -> &SandboxReadProjectionRef;
    /// 返回 owning context ref。
    pub fn context_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionContextRef;
    /// 返回 optional committed truth cursor。
    pub fn source_truth_cursor(&self) -> Option<SandboxTruthCursor>;
    /// 返回 optional committed reference cursor。
    pub fn source_reference_cursor(&self) -> Option<SandboxReferenceCursor>;
    /// 返回 stale trigger。
    pub fn trigger(&self) -> SandboxProjectionStaleTrigger;
    /// 返回 caller-safe reason。
    pub fn reason(&self) -> &SandboxReason;
    /// 返回 marker observation time。
    pub fn marked_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;

    /// 返回该 marker 所属的 committed cursor family。
    pub fn cursor_family(&self) -> SandboxProjectionCursorFamily;
}

/// projection stale marker 使用的 cursor family；两类值禁止互相比较。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum SandboxProjectionCursorFamily {
    /// Sandbox core truth committed cursor。
    Truth,
    /// reference / projection marker committed cursor。
    Reference,
}

/// projection stale marker 的 target、cursor或时间错误。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum SandboxProjectionStaleMarkerError {
    /// trigger没有required committed cursor。
    RequiredSourceCursorMissing,
    /// trigger携带不属于该通道的cursor。
    UnexpectedSourceCursor,
    /// marker同时携带truth与reference cursor，无法形成单通道fence。
    MixedSourceCursor,
    /// coverage change或scheduled rebuild没有显式选择一个committed source通道。
    SourceChannelMissing,
    /// marker target或context named ref不合法。
    MarkerTargetInvalid,
    /// marker time不满足canonical timestamp contract。
    MarkerTimestampInvalid,
}

/// 一个 projection 当前待处理的 stale marker 集合。
///
/// 每个 cursor family最多保留一个marker；集合允许为空，以表示首次rebuild尚无失效marker。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct SandboxProjectionStaleMarkerSet {
    /// 按固定 `Truth -> Reference` 顺序保存的零至两项 marker。
    markers: Vec<SandboxProjectionStaleMarker>,
}

impl SandboxProjectionStaleMarkerSet {
    /// 构造最多包含两个不同cursor family的marker set；不自动选择latest或丢弃另一family。
    pub fn try_new(
        markers: Vec<SandboxProjectionStaleMarker>,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxProjectionStaleMarkerSetError>;

    /// 构造首次rebuild使用的空marker set。
    pub fn empty() -> Self;

    /// 合并一个marker；同一exact marker幂等，较新同family marker替换旧marker。
    pub fn merge(
        &self,
        marker: SandboxProjectionStaleMarker,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxProjectionStaleMarkerSetError>;

    /// 返回按固定`Truth -> Reference`顺序保存的marker切片。
    pub fn as_slice(&self) -> &[SandboxProjectionStaleMarker];

    /// 返回truth-side marker。
    pub fn truth_marker(&self) -> Option<&SandboxProjectionStaleMarker>;
    /// 返回reference-side marker。
    pub fn reference_marker(&self) -> Option<&SandboxProjectionStaleMarker>;
    /// 判断集合是否为空。
    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断集合是否包含exact marker。
    pub fn contains_exact(&self, marker: &SandboxProjectionStaleMarker) -> bool;
}

/// stale marker set 的目标、family或顺序错误。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum SandboxProjectionStaleMarkerSetError {
    /// 同一cursor family出现两个不能合并的marker。
    DuplicateCursorFamily,
    /// marker target projection不一致。
    ProjectionTargetMismatch,
    /// marker context不一致。
    ContextTargetMismatch,
    /// 同一cursor与不同trigger/reason冲突，不能last-writer-wins。
    SameCursorConflict,
    /// marker set内部顺序不是固定canonical顺序。
    NonCanonicalMarkerOrder,
}
```

`StatusViewCoverageChanged` 必须由实际提交的 change channel选择一个 cursor：truth owner改变view coverage时使用truth cursor；reference / projection marker改变coverage时使用reference cursor。即使同一业务动作最终影响两类source，也必须先由各自committed mutation分别形成marker，不允许一个marker同时携带两个cursor。`ScheduledRebuild`同样必须绑定一个已经提交的当前 source cursor，不能用clock伪造进度。

#### 15.8.2 Rebuild source snapshot 与 completion carrier

```rust
/// rebuild worker 从同一 committed snapshot 复制出的 projection source。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct SandboxReadProjectionSourceSnapshot {
    /// snapshot 唯一目标的 existing或预生成 projection ref。
    projection_ref: SandboxReadProjectionRef,
    /// snapshot 唯一归属的 controlled execution context ref。
    context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
    /// 同一 snapshot 中 relation-checked status-view bindings。
    status_view_bindings: SandboxStatusViewBindingSet,
    /// status views 所覆盖的 committed truth cursor。
    source_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
    /// optional reference-side coverage cursor；没有reference-side变化时可为空。
    source_reference_cursor: Option<SandboxReferenceCursor>,
    /// source view缺口、stale或安全不可见部分的caller-safe reasons；完整snapshot为`None`。
    degraded_reasons: Option<StatusViewDegradedReasonSet>,
    /// source snapshot对应的audit trace ref。
    source_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    /// snapshot从committed store读出的时间。
    observed_at: Timestamp,
}

impl SandboxReadProjectionSourceSnapshot {
    /// 构造完整source snapshot；status-view group必须属于同一context且无degraded reason。
    pub fn complete(
        projection_ref: SandboxReadProjectionRef,
        context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
        status_view_bindings: SandboxStatusViewBindingSet,
        source_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
        source_reference_cursor: Option<SandboxReferenceCursor>,
        source_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        observed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxReadProjectionError>;

    /// 构造安全但不完整的source snapshot；必须提供非空degraded reasons。
    pub fn degraded(
        projection_ref: SandboxReadProjectionRef,
        context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
        status_view_bindings: SandboxStatusViewBindingSet,
        source_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
        source_reference_cursor: Option<SandboxReferenceCursor>,
        degraded_reasons: StatusViewDegradedReasonSet,
        source_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        observed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxReadProjectionError>;

    /// 返回projection target。
    pub fn projection_ref(&self) -> &SandboxReadProjectionRef;
    /// 返回owning context。
    pub fn context_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionContextRef;
    /// 返回relation-checked status-view bindings。
    pub fn status_view_bindings(&self) -> &SandboxStatusViewBindingSet;
    /// 返回status-view ref coverage。
    pub fn status_view_refs(&self) -> &SandboxStatusViewRefSet;
    /// 返回本source group的完整redline truth-to-view coverage；不复制第二份集合。
    pub fn redline_view_coverage(&self) -> &SandboxRedlineStatusViewCoverage;
    /// 返回committed truth coverage cursor。
    pub fn source_truth_cursor(&self) -> SandboxTruthCursor;
    /// 返回optional committed reference coverage cursor。
    pub fn source_reference_cursor(&self) -> Option<SandboxReferenceCursor>;
    /// 返回caller-safe degraded reasons；完整snapshot为`None`。
    pub fn degraded_reasons(&self) -> Option<&StatusViewDegradedReasonSet>;
    /// 返回source audit trace ref。
    pub fn source_audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;
    /// 返回snapshot observation time。
    pub fn observed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
    /// 判断snapshot是否可产生`Fresh` projection。
    pub fn is_complete(&self) -> bool;
}

/// 一次 projection rebuild attempt 的 exact fenced identity。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct SandboxProjectionRebuildAttempt {
    /// rebuild target projection。
    projection_ref: SandboxReadProjectionRef,
    /// rebuild target context。

    /// attempt消费的optional reference cursor。

    /// attempt开始时匹配的全部stale markers；initial create可为空集合。
    stale_markers: SandboxProjectionStaleMarkerSet,

}

impl SandboxProjectionRebuildAttempt {
    /// 从initial projection source开启首次build；没有existing stale marker。
    pub fn initial(

    /// 从existing projection与matching stale marker开启rebuild attempt。
    pub fn from_stale(
        projection: &SandboxReadProjection,

    /// 返回target projection ref。
    pub fn projection_ref(&self) -> &SandboxReadProjectionRef;
    /// 返回target context ref。

    /// 返回attempt truth cursor。

    /// 返回attempt start time。

/// rebuild完成后domain可消费的body-free completion；不含view body或builder output。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct SandboxProjectionRebuildCompletion {
    /// matching rebuild attempt。
    attempt: SandboxProjectionRebuildAttempt,
    /// rebuild mapper重新校验后的status-view bindings。
    status_view_bindings: SandboxStatusViewBindingSet,
    /// completion对应的source audit trace ref。
    source_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    /// rebuild完成时间。
    completed_at: Timestamp,
}

impl SandboxProjectionRebuildCompletion {
    /// 从matching attempt与同cursor source bindings构造completion。
    pub fn try_new(
        attempt: SandboxProjectionRebuildAttempt,
        status_view_bindings: SandboxStatusViewBindingSet,
        source_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        completed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxReadProjectionError>;

    /// 返回matching attempt。
    pub fn attempt(&self) -> &SandboxProjectionRebuildAttempt;
    /// 返回rebuilt status-view bindings。
    pub fn status_view_bindings(&self) -> &SandboxStatusViewBindingSet;
    /// 返回completion重新校验的完整redline truth-to-view coverage。
    pub fn redline_view_coverage(&self) -> &SandboxRedlineStatusViewCoverage;
    /// 返回completion source audit trace ref。
    pub fn source_audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;
    /// 返回completion time。
    pub fn completed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
}
```

source snapshot 的 invariant 固定为：

1. `status_view_bindings.context_ref() == context_ref`，且每个view逐项通过§15.7 lineage校验；
2. `status_view_bindings.redline_coverage()`必须来自完整lineage index；其context等于source context，
   `proof_truth_cursor <= source_truth_cursor`，containment refs与全部redline view refs exact ordered同构。zero-row proof才允许
   zero redline view；partial / missing index、known truth缺view或stale view都不能构造complete或degraded source；
3. `source_truth_cursor`始终必填，因为projection至少包含一个execution status view，而该view必须来自已提交Sandbox truth snapshot；
4. `source_reference_cursor`只覆盖reference / projection marker side，不得从view timestamp、source version或repository version推导；
5. `complete`要求degraded reasons为空，`degraded`要求non-empty ordered-unique safe reasons；degraded原因不得掩盖
   redline coverage完整性失败；
6. source audit trace ref来自snapshot linkage，不得由projection mapper临时生成；
7. `observed_at >= status_view_bindings.latest_observed_at()`，且不得早于attempt start / source audit observation relation；
8. snapshot只复制view refs与lineage，不读取或保存external body、view body、metric、log、artifact body或builder response。

`SandboxProjectionRebuildCompletion` 只能证明“哪些body-free view refs已按哪个committed cursor重建”，不能证明 view 内容在外部展示层可见，也不赋予query access。visibility仍由Step 7/8 query access contract独立裁定。

#### 15.8.3 Exact projection schema

```rust
/// 一个受控执行语境的可重建、body-free Sandbox read projection。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct SandboxReadProjection {
    /// projection 的 stable typed identity；不得由 context ref 文本拼接。
    projection_ref: SandboxReadProjectionRef,
    /// projection 唯一归属的 controlled execution context。
    context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
    /// 最近一次成功 materialize 或保留的 status-view lineage coverage；初始 Unavailable 可为空。
    status_view_bindings: Option<SandboxStatusViewBindingSet>,
    /// projection 自身相对已提交 source snapshot 的 canonical status。
    projection_status: SandboxReadProjectionStatus,
    /// 最近一次被 projection 接受的 Sandbox truth cursor；尚未接受 source 时为空。
    materialized_truth_cursor: Option<SandboxTruthCursor>,
    /// 最近一次被 projection 接受的 reference / projection cursor；没有reference-side coverage时为空。
    materialized_reference_cursor: Option<SandboxReferenceCursor>,
    /// 最新尚未被成功 rebuild 覆盖的 stale marker set；Fresh 时必须为空集合。
    stale_markers: SandboxProjectionStaleMarkerSet,
    /// 当前 rebuild attempt；非 Rebuilding 状态必须为空。
    rebuild_attempt: Option<SandboxProjectionRebuildAttempt>,
    /// projection source 缺口或不可用原因；只有 Degraded / Unavailable 时允许存在。
    degraded_reasons: Option<StatusViewDegradedReasonSet>,
    /// projection identity 建立时间。
    created_at: Timestamp,
    /// projection status 最近一次改变时间。
    status_changed_at: Timestamp,
    /// 最近一次接受完整或显式降级 source snapshot 的时间；从未接受时为空。
    last_materialized_at: Option<Timestamp>,
    /// 最近一次 projection mutation / source observation 的审计 trace ref。
    last_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
}

impl SandboxReadProjection {
    /// 从完整或显式降级的 committed source 创建 projection；不调用repository或读取view body。
    pub fn create(
        projection_ref: SandboxReadProjectionRef,
        context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
        source: SandboxReadProjectionSourceSnapshot,
        created_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxReadProjectionError>;

    /// 创建尚未成功materialize的不可用 projection identity；只允许由trusted maintenance mapper调用。
    pub fn create_unavailable(
        projection_ref: SandboxReadProjectionRef,
        context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
        last_known_status_view_bindings: Option<SandboxStatusViewBindingSet>,
        last_materialized_truth_cursor: Option<SandboxTruthCursor>,
        last_materialized_reference_cursor: Option<SandboxReferenceCursor>,
        reason: SandboxReason,
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        created_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxReadProjectionError>;

    /// 合并一个已提交 stale marker；重复marker幂等，更新marker不能丢失另一cursor family。
    pub fn mark_stale(
        &mut self,
        marker: SandboxProjectionStaleMarker,
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        changed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), SandboxReadProjectionError>;

    /// 开启一个与当前 stale / degraded / unavailable source匹配的rebuild attempt。
    pub fn start_rebuild(
        &mut self,
        attempt: SandboxProjectionRebuildAttempt,
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        changed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), SandboxReadProjectionError>;

    /// 消费matching completion，把projection推进到Fresh并替换view bindings / cursors。
    pub fn finish_rebuild(
        &mut self,
        completion: SandboxProjectionRebuildCompletion,
    ) -> Result<(), SandboxReadProjectionError>;

    /// 记录本次rebuild的安全降级；保留最近一次已materialize的旧view coverage。
    pub fn mark_degraded(
        &mut self,
        attempt: SandboxProjectionRebuildAttempt,
        degraded_reasons: StatusViewDegradedReasonSet,
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        changed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), SandboxReadProjectionError>;

    /// 消费matching attempt并记录projection当前不可提供；不清除旧coverage，也不宣称旧coverage仍然Fresh。
    pub fn mark_unavailable(
        &mut self,
        attempt: SandboxProjectionRebuildAttempt,
        reason: SandboxReason,
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        changed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), SandboxReadProjectionError>;

    /// 返回projection identity。
    pub fn projection_ref(&self) -> &SandboxReadProjectionRef;
    /// 返回owning context ref。
    pub fn context_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionContextRef;
    /// 返回最近保存的status-view bindings；初始Unavailable且尚无coverage时为None。
    pub fn status_view_bindings(&self) -> Option<&SandboxStatusViewBindingSet>;
    /// 返回最近保存的status-view ref set；初始Unavailable且尚无coverage时为None。
    pub fn status_view_refs(&self) -> Option<&SandboxStatusViewRefSet>;
    /// 返回最近accepted的完整redline truth-to-view coverage；尚无bindings时为None。
    pub fn redline_view_coverage(&self) -> Option<&SandboxRedlineStatusViewCoverage>;
    /// 返回projection canonical status。
    pub fn projection_status(&self) -> SandboxReadProjectionStatus;
    /// 返回最近接受的truth cursor；不能单独证明projection为Fresh。
    pub fn materialized_truth_cursor(&self) -> Option<SandboxTruthCursor>;
    /// 返回最近接受的reference cursor；不能单独证明projection为Fresh。
    pub fn materialized_reference_cursor(&self) -> Option<SandboxReferenceCursor>;
    /// 返回当前全部stale markers；truth/reference两类独立保存。
    pub fn stale_markers(&self) -> &SandboxProjectionStaleMarkerSet;
    /// 返回当前rebuild attempt。
    pub fn rebuild_attempt(&self) -> Option<&SandboxProjectionRebuildAttempt>;
    /// 返回caller-safe degraded reasons；Fresh / Stale / Rebuilding必须为空。
    pub fn degraded_reasons(&self) -> Option<&StatusViewDegradedReasonSet>;
    /// 返回projection建立时间。
    pub fn created_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
    /// 返回status最近改变时间。
    pub fn status_changed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
    /// 返回最近接受source snapshot的时间。
    pub fn last_materialized_at(&self) -> Option<&Timestamp>;
    /// 返回最近mutation关联的audit trace ref。
    pub fn last_audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;

    /// 判断projection是否已覆盖给定truth cursor；不把reference cursor转成truth cursor。
    pub fn covers_truth_cursor(&self, cursor: SandboxTruthCursor) -> bool;
    /// 判断projection是否已覆盖给定reference cursor。
    pub fn covers_reference_cursor(&self, cursor: SandboxReferenceCursor) -> bool;
    /// 判断当前projection是否可以读取但必须显式暴露status。
    pub fn is_readable(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断当前projection是否允许向caller宣称source coverage为Fresh。
    pub fn can_claim_fresh(&self) -> bool;
    /// 永远返回false；projection不能成为Sandbox core truth写源。
    pub fn is_truth_source(&self) -> bool;
}

/// projection状态与字段、cursor、lineage或transition不一致时的精确错误。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum SandboxReadProjectionError {
    /// projection或context named ref不满足non-empty identity contract。
    InvalidProjectionIdentity,
    /// marker / source / attempt的projection ref与当前对象不一致。
    ProjectionRefMismatch,
    /// marker / source / attempt的context ref与当前对象不一致。
    ProjectionContextMismatch,
    /// status-view binding set不满足八类closed union、cardinality或同context lineage。
    StatusViewBindingSetInvalid,
    /// source / completion没有完整redline lineage index coverage，不能把零项或partial read当成完整。
    RedlineViewCoverageMissingOrIncomplete,
    /// complete coverage、truth-to-view bindings与status-view refs不是exact ordered同构。
    RedlineViewCoverageMismatch,
    /// 任一redline current view source cursor早于loaded containment truth status cursor。
    RedlineStatusViewCoverageStale,
    /// source snapshot的context与binding set的context不一致。
    SourceContextMismatch,
    /// source snapshot没有可证明的execution status view coverage。
    MissingExecutionStatusView,
    /// projection必须有truth cursor但source未提供。
    TruthCursorMissing,
    /// source / completion cursor coverage与status-view source不一致。
    CursorCoverageInvalid,
    /// 新source truth cursor早于projection已materialize truth cursor。
    TruthCursorRegressed,
    /// 新source reference cursor早于projection已materialize reference cursor。
    ReferenceCursorRegressed,
    /// marker target或context不属于当前projection。
    StaleMarkerLineageMismatch,
    /// marker使用的source cursor早于已materialize或当前pending marker。
    StaleMarkerOlderThanCurrent,
    /// 同一cursor但不同marker reason / trigger形成冲突，不能last-writer-wins。
    StaleMarkerConflict,
    /// marker同时携带truth与reference cursor或缺少required channel。
    StaleMarkerCursorRelationInvalid,
    /// 当前projection status不允许请求的transition。
    ProjectionTransitionNotAllowed {
        /// 当前canonical projection status。
        status: SandboxReadProjectionStatus,
    },
    /// rebuild attempt与当前status / marker / source不匹配。
    RebuildAttemptMismatch,
    /// completion没有覆盖当前rebuild attempt的同一source snapshot。
    RebuildCompletionMismatch,
    /// completion的status-view bindings与attempt / context不一致。
    RebuildCompletionViewCoverageMismatch,
    /// completion没有达到Fresh所需的完整source coverage。
    RebuildCompletionSourceIncomplete,
    /// degraded factory或transition收到空reason set。
    DegradedReasonsEmpty,
    /// Fresh / Stale / Rebuilding状态携带degraded reason。
    UnexpectedDegradedReasons,
    /// Unavailable状态没有caller-safe reason，或其它状态错误携带availability-only reason。
    AvailabilityReasonRelationInvalid,
    /// status、marker、attempt、cursor、reason组合不满足canonical matrix。
    ProjectionStatusFieldRelationInvalid {
        /// 关系不合法的canonical status。
        status: SandboxReadProjectionStatus,
    },
    /// audit trace ref缺失、错配或时间关系不成立。
    ProjectionAuditRelationInvalid,
    /// created / changed / materialized / observed timestamp不满足单调关系。
    ProjectionTimestampInvalid,
    /// projection mutation试图写入core truth或触发query-side repair。
    ProjectionTruthMutationForbidden,
}
```

`is_truth_source()` 是固定返回 `false` 的契约性 predicate，而不是可配置开关。实现不得通过配置、feature flag或测试 fake 让 projection 变成 truth source；若需要修改核心 truth，必须调用对应 truth owner 的 command / domain transition。

#### 15.8.4 Projection status matrix

`SandboxReadProjectionStatus` 是本对象唯一的 projection lifecycle owner。`DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStatus`、`QueryAccessStatus`、view 内部的 visible status 和 repository availability 均不得替代本 enum。projection 可以保存旧 coverage，但旧 coverage 的存在不等于当前 source 已经 Fresh。

| status | `status_view_bindings` | materialized truth / reference cursor | `stale_markers` | `rebuild_attempt` | `degraded_reasons` | audit / time | read predicates |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Fresh` | `Some`，必须含exactly one execution view、完整redline coverage且全组context相同 | truth必须`Some`并覆盖redline proof cursor；reference按source coverage可选 | 必须 `empty` | `None` | `None` | `last_audit_trace_ref` 必填；`last_materialized_at` 必须 `Some` | `is_readable = true`；`can_claim_fresh = true` |
| `Stale` | 保留最近 accepted coverage，可为 `None`（初始不可用 projection） | 保留各自 family 的最近 accepted cursor；不存在的 family 保持 `None` | 必须 `non-empty`，最多 truth/reference 各一项 | `None` | `None` | status change 必须有新的 audit ref 和单调 `status_changed_at` | 有 coverage 时可读但必须显式 stale；无 coverage 时只能返回不可供给 surface |
| `Rebuilding` | 保留进入重建前的 coverage，可为 `None`（仅 initial build） | 保留进入重建前的 cursor，可为 `None`（仅 initial build） | 必须与 attempt 的 fencing set 相等；initial build 可为空 | 必须 `Some` | `None` | start mutation 必须有 audit ref；attempt `started_at` 不早于 projection status time | 有旧 coverage 时可读但不能宣称 Fresh；无 coverage 时不可供给旧内容 |
| `Degraded` | 必须`Some`，仍满足execution/context和完整redline coverage invariant；只能降级其它safe source gap | truth必须`Some`并覆盖redline proof cursor；reference按accepted source coverage可选 | 创建时可为空；由 failed rebuild 进入时保留 attempt 的 pending markers | `None` | 必须为 non-empty safe reason set | audit ref 必填；accepted degraded source 或旧 coverage 的时间关系必须成立 | `is_readable = true`；`can_claim_fresh = false` |
| `Unavailable` | 可为`Some`或`None`；若存在必须是最后一次accepted且当时完整的redline coverage | 按最后 accepted coverage保留；无 coverage时两类均为 `None` | 初始可为空；已有 pending marker 时必须保留 | `None` | 必须是由 `reason` 包装出的 non-empty singleton set | audit ref 必填；availability reason 不得为空 | `is_readable = false`；`can_claim_fresh = false` |

字段关系进一步固定如下：

1. `Fresh` 的 bindings、truth cursor、audit linkage 和 `last_materialized_at` 是同一个 accepted source snapshot 的结果；不能只更新 status 字段把 `Stale` 改成 `Fresh`。
2. `Degraded` 的两条来源必须区分：`create(... degraded source ...)` 可以写入该 source 提供的 body-free bindings 与 cursor；`mark_degraded(...)` 只保留进入 attempt 前的旧 coverage 与 cursor，不把失败 attempt 的不完整 source 当成 Fresh materialization。
3. `Unavailable` 的 `degraded_reasons` 只允许由 `create_unavailable` 或 `mark_unavailable` 从单个 `SandboxReason` 构造；不得让任意多 reason set 把 unavailable 伪装成普通 degraded。
4. `Stale`、`Rebuilding` 不携带 degraded reason；如果 rebuild 失败，必须进入 `Degraded` 或 `Unavailable`，不能在 `Rebuilding` 上附加失败字符串。
5. `materialized_truth_cursor` 与 `materialized_reference_cursor` 只能在各自 family 内比较。某一 family 为 `None` 时，不得用另一 family、timestamp、`Version` 或 page cursor 填充。
6. `last_audit_trace_ref` 是 mutation linkage，不是 view body、job report 或 query request trace 的替代；每个写入 transition 必须由 application 提供已规划的 audit ref。
7. 保存旧bindings的`Stale | Rebuilding | Degraded | Unavailable`不得把旧redline coverage描述为current complete；只有
   `Fresh`且materialized truth cursor覆盖proof cursor时可宣称current coverage。任何redline detection、status / preservation /
   investigation变化都会提交新truth cursor并使旧projection沿truth-side marker进入Stale。

`create` 的状态选择固定为：`source.is_complete() == true -> Fresh`，`source.is_complete() == false -> Degraded`。如果 source snapshot 没有 execution binding、truth cursor、audit linkage或 context relation，factory 必须返回 typed error，不能创建 `Unavailable`；只有 `create_unavailable` 承接没有可用 source 的初始 identity。

#### 15.8.5 Transition matrix and fencing

| current | callable / exact input | target | 成功时字段变化 | 拒绝条件 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| factory | `create(complete source)` | `Fresh` | 复制 bindings、两类 cursor、source audit；marker / attempt / reason 清空 | source incomplete、lineage不一致、cursor缺失或时间非法 |
| factory | `create(degraded source)` | `Degraded` | 复制安全的 partial bindings 与 accepted cursor；保存 non-empty reasons；无 attempt | degraded reasons为空、execution view缺失、source relation非法 |
| factory | `create_unavailable(reason)` | `Unavailable` | coverage / cursor按 last-known optional 保存；创建 singleton availability reason；marker为空 | reason为空、coverage与cursor不成对、identity或audit非法 |
| `Fresh` | `mark_stale(new marker, audit, time)` | `Stale` | 合并 marker；清空 reason；保留旧 coverage/cursor；写 audit/time | marker旧于已 materialized cursor、lineage不符、同 cursor conflict |
| `Stale` | `mark_stale(same marker, ...)` | `Stale`（幂等） | 不改变 coverage/cursor；audit 不得因 duplicate 重写为新 source事实 | marker payload冲突或cursor family不合法 |
| `Stale` | `start_rebuild(matching attempt, audit, time)` | `Rebuilding` | 保存 attempt；reason保持空；marker set与attempt绑定 | attempt marker/source不匹配、没有 pending marker、version/time回退 |
| `Degraded` | `mark_stale(new marker, audit, time)` | `Stale` | 清除 degraded reasons，保留 coverage/cursor并保存 marker | marker lineage或cursor relation非法 |
| `Degraded` | `start_rebuild(matching attempt, audit, time)` | `Rebuilding` | 保存 attempt；保留旧 coverage/cursor | 没有 matching pending marker；无 marker时不得静默重建 |
| `Unavailable` | `mark_stale(new marker, audit, time)` | `Stale` | 清除 availability reason，保留 last-known coverage/cursor并保存 marker | marker lineage或cursor relation非法 |
| `Unavailable` | `start_rebuild(initial attempt, audit, time)` | `Rebuilding` | 仅在无 coverage、无 cursor、无 pending marker 的初始 identity 上保存 initial attempt | 该对象已有任一 coverage/cursor/marker，或attempt不是由当前 committed source构造 |
| `Unavailable` | `start_rebuild(matching attempt, audit, time)` | `Rebuilding` | 对已有 last-known coverage / pending marker 保存 matching attempt | attempt marker/source不匹配、cursor回退或lineage非法 |
| `Rebuilding` | `mark_stale(exact fenced marker, ...)` | `Rebuilding`（幂等） | 不清除 attempt；不产生第二次重建 | marker与attempt同 cursor 但 payload冲突 |
| `Rebuilding` | `mark_stale(newer marker, audit, time)` | `Stale` | 合并新 marker；清除旧 attempt；旧 completion自动失效 | marker旧于当前 pending family或lineage非法 |
| `Rebuilding` | `finish_rebuild(matching completion)` | `Fresh` | 替换 bindings/cursors；清空 marker、attempt、reason；更新时间和audit | attempt、view coverage、cursor或completion time不匹配 |
| `Rebuilding` | `mark_degraded(matching attempt, reasons, audit, time)` | `Degraded` | 保留旧 accepted coverage/cursors；保留 attempt marker set；清除 attempt；写 reasons | 无旧 coverage、reason为空、attempt已失效 |
| `Rebuilding` | `mark_unavailable(matching attempt, reason, audit, time)` | `Unavailable` | 保留旧 coverage/cursors；保留 attempt marker set；清除 attempt；写 singleton reason | reason为空、attempt已失效或lineage不符 |

不允许的迁移包括 `Fresh -> Rebuilding`（必须先消费 committed marker 进入 `Stale`）、`Fresh -> Degraded/Unavailable`（必须经过一次 source / rebuild outcome）、`Stale -> Fresh`（必须先 `start_rebuild`）、`Degraded -> Fresh`（必须 matching rebuild completion）和任何状态到另一个状态的裸字段赋值。`mark_stale` 在 `Rebuilding` 中收到新 family marker 时必须使旧 attempt 失效；旧 completion 即使随后到达，也必须返回 `RebuildCompletionMismatch`，不能覆盖新 marker。

`SandboxProjectionRebuildAttempt::from_stale` 的 fencing 条件固定为：projection/context ref 相等；attempt 的 `stale_markers` 与当前 projection marker set 全字段相等；attempt source cursor 不早于 projection 对应 family 的 materialized cursor；truth/reference cursor 各自比较；`started_at` 不早于 projection `status_changed_at`。`initial` 只能用于 `Unavailable` 且没有任何既有 coverage、materialized cursor或pending marker的首次 build；已有任一 last-known字段时必须使用 `from_stale` 语义并提供 matching marker set。

`SandboxProjectionRebuildCompletion::try_new` 必须验证：attempt没有被新marker取代；bindings set的context与attempt相等，
完整redline coverage proof cursor及每条truth/view cursor均不晚于attempt truth cursor；redline refs与view refs保持exact
ordered同构；completion time不早于attempt start、binding observation和source audit relation；completion不携带degraded
reason、view body、builder output或external body。`finish_rebuild`成功后才清除marker；不能在`start_rebuild`或query读取时
提前清除。

#### 15.8.6 Persistence owner、source read 与 version fence

`SandboxReadProjection` 的 domain method 只负责校验字段关系和推进自身状态；它不读取 repository、分配 cursor、生成 audit trace，也不根据 projection ref 枚举 source。持久化责任按以下 owner 分离：

| responsibility | 唯一 owner | 必须提供的 typed input / output | 禁止替代 |
|---|---|---|---|
| status-view source loading | Step 7 application read port / versioned source reader | 一个committed snapshot中的八类view binding、完整redline lineage index +逐项truth/current-view relation、context、truth cursor、optional reference cursor、source audit、observed time、safe degraded reasons | 分别读取latest row后拼接；只取一条redline；用missing index构造empty coverage；从projection body反推字段 |
| affected projection selection | truth / reference owner 的正式 projection index / read port | `SandboxReadProjectionRef` 的有序、去重、context-bound 集合，或明确 empty result | 从 context string、view ref文本、marker payload、projection表全扫描猜目标 |
| stale marker staging | application maintenance flow + `SandboxProjectionStaleMarker` | committed source cursor、exact projection ref、exact context ref、typed trigger、safe reason、planned audit ref | repository 内部直接调用 `mark_projection_stale`；用 timestamp / repository version代替 cursor |
| projection mutation | application domain orchestration | versioned loaded `SandboxReadProjection` + exact object method result | repository 直接改 status、marker、attempt、reason或cursor字段 |
| projection save | projection repository / durable adapter | mutated projection、expected repository version、same UoW、assigned cursor linkage（如该 mutation产生 reference marker） | blind overwrite、latest-row save、用 projection status 当 optimistic version |
| source truth cursor assignment | `SandboxUnitOfWork` truth channel | staged truth writes后分配的 `SandboxTruthCursor` | `Version`、page cursor、event id、clock或id generator |
| reference cursor assignment | `SandboxUnitOfWork` reference channel | staged reference state / projection marker writes后分配的 `SandboxReferenceCursor` | `SandboxTruthCursor`、source version、dedup key或timestamp |
| audit linkage | audit owner + application UoW | pre-generated `SandboxAuditTraceRef`，与 mutation/source observation同组提交 | domain 自行生成 trace、用 query request trace代替 mutation audit |

source snapshot 的正式读取面必须满足以下结构：

```text
projection rebuild request
  -> load projection identity / expected repository version
  -> load projection source index by exact projection_ref + context_ref
  -> read complete redline lineage index from the same committed snapshot
  -> load every exact redline truth and current immutable redline view binding
  -> build SandboxRedlineStatusViewCoverage, including an explicit zero-row proof
  -> load all selected singleton status views from that committed snapshot
  -> load source truth cursor and optional reference cursor from committed metadata
  -> map each loaded view to SandboxStatusViewBinding
  -> SandboxStatusViewBindingSet::try_new(..., redline_coverage)
  -> SandboxReadProjectionSourceSnapshot::complete(...) or ::degraded(...)
  -> only then call SandboxProjectionRebuildAttempt / SandboxReadProjection method
```

source reader必须直接返回`SandboxStatusViewBindingSet`所需的每个binding的`view_ref`、`context_ref`和
`observed_at`，以及完整redline coverage所需的containment refs、逐项truth/view cursor和same-snapshot watermark。它不能
只返回`SandboxStatusViewRefSet`再让application查询context，也不能只返回view body由mapper猜ref、时间或lineage。
singleton optional view读取失败只有在formal reader分类为caller-safe reason后才可进入`degraded`；redline index不完整、
已知containment缺current view、view stale或set不一致则固定typed integrity / unavailable outcome，不得进入degraded
source或zero-row proof。

projection version fence 固定为：

1. application 先以 exact `SandboxReadProjectionRef` 加载 `Versioned<SandboxReadProjection>`；不存在时只能走 `create` 或 `create_unavailable` 的显式首次创建路径，不能把缺行解释为 stale。
2. application 从正式 projection index / source reader 取得 affected projection refs；不得从当前 projection 的 `status_view_bindings` 反向枚举受影响对象，也不得从 context / ref 文本拼 key。
3. application 调用 object method，拿到完整 mutated object；domain method 不接收 repository version，也不自行保存。
4. 如果 mutation 产生 projection/reference marker，先在同一 UoW stage mutated projection、marker / reference state、audit linkage，再调用 `assign_reference_marker_cursor()`；cursor 复制到 marker/source linkage后才允许 commit。
5. commit 使用 projection row 的 expected repository version；版本冲突返回 typed concurrency outcome，不能重新读取 latest projection、重放旧 attempt或丢弃新 marker后覆盖。
6. durable 与 fake adapter 必须遵循相同的 stage -> cursor assignment -> versioned save -> commit 顺序；fake 不得通过内存 map 直接改状态绕过 object method或模拟一个不存在的 cursor。

truth-side source change 的顺序同样固定为：先由 truth owner 在其 accepted UoW 提交 truth，得到 `SandboxTruthCursor`；再由 projection stale maintenance 消费该已提交 cursor形成 `SandboxProjectionStaleMarker`。projection marker 不能引用尚未提交的 truth cursor，也不能与 source truth write 共用一个“预先猜测”的 cursor。reference-side marker change 使用独立的 reference UoW channel；一个业务动作同时影响两个 family 时，必须形成两个 committed marker relation，不能把两个 cursor 合并成一个写入。

projection repository 不拥有以下任何公开状态迁移：`mark_stale`、`start_rebuild`、`finish_rebuild`、`mark_degraded` 和 `mark_unavailable`。repository 只能提供 versioned load、versioned save 和由正式 index 驱动的读取面；application 才能在完成 source / attempt / audit / cursor 校验后调用 domain method。历史 `mark_projection_stale(...)` 作为 repository 直接 mutation 已失效，Step 7 回归时必须改为“load -> domain method -> versioned save”的调用链。

#### 15.8.7 Query、rebuild job 与 fake/durable boundary

query 的 write set 固定为空。下表中的每一项都是 query 禁止调用的副作用：

| query path | 允许 | 禁止 |
|---|---|---|
| load projection | versioned read、读取已提交 projection、读取 query access 所需的 typed refs | 创建缺失 projection、写 `Unavailable`、补 audit、分配 cursor |
| inspect status | 返回 projection status、status-view refs、cursor coverage和safe degraded surface | refresh reference、重建 view、调用 backend probe、读取 raw body |
| stale handling | 显式返回 `Stale` / `Rebuilding` / `Degraded` / `Unavailable` surface | 将 stale 改为 Fresh、清 marker、启动 rebuild、retry failed source |
| missing source | 返回正式 query error 或由已提交 source reader提供的 degraded result | 创建 `Unresolved` / `Unavailable` state、写 projection row、从 latest rows拼 source |
| authorization / visibility | 消费已提交 query access decision与view refs | 反向修改 policy、boundary、cleanup或redline truth |
| audit / observability | 读取已提交 audit linkage；按既定读日志策略输出调用记录 | append mutation audit、写 projection marker、把 request trace写成 source audit |

`SandboxReadProjection::is_readable` 只是 domain predicate，不是 query write permission。query 即使发现 `is_readable == false`，也只能映射为既定 unavailable / not-visible surface；不得调用任何 projection transition。query 即使发现 status-view coverage 缺失，也不得从旧 projection body、view timestamp、context selector或本地 cache补出 bindings。

rebuild job 是 maintenance writer，但它也不得从旧 projection body推导新字段。其正式输入必须来自 source read port返回的 `SandboxReadProjectionSourceSnapshot` 或等价的、字段完全闭合的 body-free carrier；job 只能：

```text
load versioned projection
  -> load formal affected/source snapshot
  -> create matching attempt
  -> call projection.start_rebuild(...)
  -> commit Rebuilding state
  -> build completion from a new committed source snapshot / checked bindings
  -> reload versioned projection
  -> call finish_rebuild / mark_degraded / mark_unavailable
  -> save with expected version and commit
```

如果第二次 reload 发现新的 stale marker、repository version变化或 context lineage变化，旧 completion 必须被 typed reject；job 不得以“同一 projection ref”作为继续覆盖的理由。job 失败本身只能形成 projection maintenance outcome / audit linkage，不能调用 `FailureClassification::from_*`，不能把 host / SDK / SQL error文本写入 projection reason。

fake / durable parity 至少覆盖以下可观察契约：

| parity surface | fake 必须模拟 | durable 必须保证 | 两者共同禁止 |
|---|---|---|---|
| version fence | expected version冲突、同一旧 attempt被拒绝 | 原子 optimistic save / conflict outcome | latest-wins覆盖新 marker |
| cursor family | truth / reference cursor分别单调且类型隔离 | cursor来自各自已提交UoW channel | 数字比较两个family或共享一个字段 |
| source snapshot | 同一 snapshot返回完整 bindings / context / observed time | 读取一致性与source cursor linkage | 八次独立latest query拼组 |
| marker merge | exact duplicate幂等、同 cursor conflict拒绝、family独立保留 | 持久化顺序与唯一约束等价 | 自动去重、静默丢弃较新family |
| query no-write | 可断言 write count 恒为 zero | read transaction不产生projection mutation | query-side repair / refresh |
| stale completion fence | 新 marker使旧 completion失败 | 并发提交下旧版本不能覆盖新版本 | 以 job id、时间或 ref文本放宽 fencing |

影响 projection 的正式 index/read port 至少必须能够按 `SandboxReadProjectionRef`、`ControlledExecutionContextRef` 和 source change relation 返回目标集合；该关系的 schema、唯一性、写入/删除时机和 fake/durable parity 由 Step 7/11 继续闭合，但“从 context string 拼 key”“扫描所有 projection 再过滤 body”“从 status-view ref 文本反解 projection ref”均在当前设计中禁止。

本节不定义 repository trait 的完整 Rust 签名，也不把历史 Step 7 的 `SandboxOpaqueRef`、`SandboxProjectionStatus` 或 repository-owned `mark_projection_stale` 视为兼容路径；这些内容只作为下游 revalidation 输入保留。

## 16. Batch 6: Audit / Relay / View / Comparison / Reconciliation exact object contracts

本节只承载当前 `6R-04 batch 6` 的十个 named type。每个对象仍以其 registry row 为唯一 owner；本节的 embedded union、source snapshot 和 object-owned error 是该 owner 的组成部分，不新增平行 module、generic ref 或第二套 status enum。

本批统一遵守以下边界：

1. `SandboxTruthRefSet` 只表达已提交 Sandbox-owned truth 或已提交 source snapshot identity；它不表达 query projection、audit、relay、view 或 reconciliation 结果。
2. `SandboxProjectionRefSet` 只表达 read / derived / audit / relay / report 侧的 typed identity；它不成为 core truth，也不把 projection status 当作 truth status。
3. 两个 set 只校验 closed member、空集合语义、顺序和 identity 唯一性；context、scope、cursor、audit linkage 和同一 committed snapshot 关系由 view / report source factory 再校验。
4. set 不保存对象 body、raw external body、locator、status text、repository version、timestamp 或 cursor；也不执行 repository read、latest scan、refresh、repair 或 dedup side effect。
5. 本批只引用 `03_ddd_step_06_object_contracts_shared_types.md` 已有的 named ref、`SandboxObjectRefKind`、`SandboxTruthCursor`、`SandboxReferenceCursor`、`StatusViewDegradedReasonSet` 和三个 batch-6 shared status enum；不得在本节重新声明它们。

### 16.0.1 RefSet 成员闭合审查记录

`6R-04 batch 6` 在写入审计对象前重新审查两个 closed union。以下结论覆盖本批后续 view、comparison 和 reconciliation 的输入语义；它们不是新的上游 blocker。

| 审查项 | current 结论 | 不能采用的替代 |
|---|---|---|
| `IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef` 是否属于 truth set | 属于。它是 Sandbox 管理的隔离环境生命周期真相，必须能与 boundary、lease、run 做同一 scope 的 source snapshot 对账。 | 只放 `CoherentBoundaryRef`，再由 service 从 handle 文本或 backend 状态猜环境生命周期。 |
| `BackendCapabilitySummaryRef` 是否属于 truth set | 属于。它是已提交的 Sandbox-owned body-free capability snapshot；set 只携带 snapshot identity，不携带 capability 正文或 backend 产品状态。 | 把 capability summary 当 external source ref，或在 comparison 时重新 probe backend。 |
| `PolicyApplicabilitySnapshotRef` 是否属于 truth set | 属于。它是 policy / authorization 输入的本地快照 identity；它不等于 policy source truth，也不代表最终 execution decision。 | 只保存 `PolicyExecutionDecisionRef`，丢失对账所需的适用性输入 lineage。 |
| `BoundaryRequirementSetRef`、`ContextReferenceResolutionRef` 是否属于 truth set | 属于。二者是已提交的 Sandbox boundary / intake resolution value identity，可作为 source snapshot 成员；它们不携带外部正文。 | 从 `ControlledExecutionContextRef` 反解 requirement 或 context resolution。 |
| 纯规则 guard ref 是否属于 truth set | 不属于。`ControlledExecutionIntakeGuardRef`、`BoundaryCoherenceGuardRef`、`BackendCapabilityGuardRef`、`PolicyApplicabilityGuardRef`、`FailClosedPolicyGuardRef`、`ControlConflictGuardRef`、`CleanupSafetyGuardRef`、`RedlineContainmentGuardRef` 和 `DerivedReadOnlyGuardRef` 是规则快照，不是被对账的业务 truth。 | 用 guard ref 存在性替代对象 status、decision 或 source evidence。 |
| `CleanupGuardRef`、`RedlineContainmentRef` 是否属于 truth set | 属于。这里的 `CleanupGuard` / `RedlineContainment` 是已产生的 Sandbox safety truth，不是上表的纯规则 guard。 | 依据同名中的 `Guard` 字样整体排除。 |
| 空集合语义 | 允许。空集合表示在已闭合 scope / committed snapshot 中没有已知成员；缺少 source snapshot、scope 或 cursor 仍由 factory 返回 unavailable / degraded。 | 用空集合伪造“未执行检查”或把空集合当作 missing。 |
| `CapturedMaterialRef` 是否属于 generic truth union | 不属于 `SandboxObjectRef` union。它是 `(capture_ref, material_key)` 复合 value identity；audit 通过独立 `AuditMaterialRefSet` 携带它。 | 把 material key 单独提升为 Sandbox repository object ref。 |

审查后的闭合原则是：RefSet 只表达“已知且已提交的 identity 集合”，不表达集合是否完整、是否 Fresh、是否可见或是否已经修复。上层必须同时携带 scope、source cursor 和 completeness / degraded 结果，才能创建 view 或 report。

### 16.1 `SandboxTruthRefSet`

`SandboxTruthRefSet` 是 reconciliation、comparison source snapshot 和 audit/source linkage 可消费的 Sandbox truth identity 闭集。它不是 `SandboxSourceFactRef` 的别名：`SandboxSourceFactRef` 负责把单个 source fact 映射到 outbound event，而本 set 负责在一个已提交检查范围内携带多个不同 truth owner 的 typed identity。

#### 16.1.1 Capability、owner 与 allowed member union

| 项 | exact 结论 |
|---|---|
| canonical owner | `crates/contracts/src/refs.rs`；由 `S6T-04-015` 承接，不能在 domain、application 或 view 文件复制声明 |
| capability | 保存一个可为空、插入顺序稳定、无重复的 Sandbox truth ref 集合，供 source snapshot / comparison / reconciliation 做显式输入 |
| producer | 已提交 truth repository reader、domain transition outcome 或 application source mapper；public caller 不能用字符串直接 mint |
| consumer | `BackendCapabilityComparisonView`、`SandboxReconciliationReport`、audit / relay source linkage；具体 scope / context 校验由 consumer factory 完成 |
| cursor relation | set 不拥有 cursor；truth cursor 必须由同一 committed source snapshot 另外提供 |
| empty semantics | 空扫描可以产生合法的空 `SandboxTruthRefSet`；空只表示“已知成员为零”，不表示 source 缺失。query / job 必须另带 explicit empty / unavailable / degraded surface，不能仅凭空 set 创建 fake clean report |
| body boundary | 仅保存 typed ref identity，不保存 truth object body、external body、backend response、artifact/evidence body 或 locator |

允许的 member union 固定为以下 embedded enum。该 enum 不是独立 lifecycle object，也不新增 `SandboxObjectRefKind` variant；每个 variant 只包裹 `6R-01` 已登记的 named ref。

```rust
/// reconciliation / comparison 可检查的 Sandbox truth identity 闭集。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum SandboxTruthRef {
    /// 受控执行语境 truth。
    ControlledExecutionContext(ControlledExecutionContextRef),
    /// 执行环境身份 truth。
    ExecutionEnvironmentIdentity(ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef),
    /// Sandbox 管理的隔离环境 handle 生命周期 truth。
    IsolationEnvironmentHandle(IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef),
    /// intake context resolution truth。
    ExecutionContextResolution(ExecutionContextResolutionRef),
    /// intake external reference resolution boundary truth。
    ContextReferenceResolution(ContextReferenceResolutionRef),
    /// boundary requirement truth。
    BoundaryRequirementSet(BoundaryRequirementSetRef),
    /// coherent boundary truth。
    CoherentBoundary(CoherentBoundaryRef),
    /// boundary establishment decision truth。
    BoundaryEstablishmentDecision(BoundaryEstablishmentDecisionRef),
    /// body-free backend capability snapshot；不表示 backend 选择。
    BackendCapabilitySummary(BackendCapabilitySummaryRef),
    /// policy applicability snapshot truth。
    PolicyApplicabilitySnapshot(PolicyApplicabilitySnapshotRef),
    /// policy execution decision truth。
    PolicyExecutionDecision(PolicyExecutionDecisionRef),
    /// high-risk action decision truth。
    HighRiskActionDecision(HighRiskActionDecisionRef),
    /// controlled execution run truth。
    ControlledExecutionRun(ControlledExecutionRunRef),
    /// capture fact truth。
    CaptureFact(CaptureFactRef),
    /// observability material handoff truth；只保存本仓 material identity。
    ObservabilityMaterial(ObservabilityMaterialRef),
    /// material handoff truth。
    HandoffFact(HandoffFactRef),
    /// stable failure classification truth。
    FailureClassification(FailureClassificationRef),
    /// accepted / duplicate / conflict control truth。
    ControlFact(ControlFactRef),
    /// isolation lease truth。
    LeaseRecord(LeaseRecordRef),
    /// orphan recovery truth。
    OrphanRecoveryRecord(OrphanRecoveryRecordRef),
    /// cleanup guard truth。
    CleanupGuard(CleanupGuardRef),
    /// security redline containment truth。
    RedlineContainment(RedlineContainmentRef),
    /// long-lived external reference tracking truth。
    ReferenceResolutionState(ReferenceResolutionStateRef),
}

impl SandboxTruthRef {
    /// 返回已登记的 Sandbox object kind；不得返回可扩展字符串。
    pub fn kind(&self) -> SandboxObjectRefKind;

    /// 返回用于 set identity collision 检查的 generic ref 副本；不得用于 repository 读写。
    pub fn as_object_ref(&self) -> SandboxObjectRef;

    /// 判断该 member 是否提供 controlled execution context anchor。
    pub fn is_context_anchor(&self) -> bool;

    /// 判断该 member 是否属于执行 / boundary / policy / lifecycle truth。
    pub fn is_core_truth(&self) -> bool;

    /// 判断该 member 是否属于 reference-side committed truth。
    pub fn is_reference_truth(&self) -> bool;
}
```

`SandboxTruthRef` 明确排除纯规则 `*GuardRef`、`SandboxReadProjectionRef`、八类 status-view ref、`DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStateRef`、`SandboxAuditTraceRef`、`SandboxEventRelayRecordRef`、`SandboxReconciliationReportRef` 和所有 application stored-result ref。`CleanupGuardRef` 与 `RedlineContainmentRef` 是已经产生的 safety truth，仍保留在 union 中；不能因为名称包含 `Guard` 而排除。被排除的 projection / linkage / rule snapshot 若进入本 union，必须在 mapper 层返回 typed error。

#### 16.1.2 Private fields、constructor 与 object-owned error

```rust
/// 非空且按插入顺序保存的 Sandbox truth identity 集合。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq, Serialize)]
pub struct SandboxTruthRefSet {
    /// 已由 constructor 校验过的 closed truth members。
    refs: Vec<SandboxTruthRef>,
}

impl<'de> Deserialize<'de> for SandboxTruthRefSet {
    fn deserialize<D>(deserializer: D) -> Result<Self, D::Error>
    where
        D: serde::Deserializer<'de>,
    {
        let refs = Vec::<SandboxTruthRef>::deserialize(deserializer)?;
        Self::try_new(refs)
            .map_err(|_| serde::de::Error::custom("invalid sandbox truth ref set"))
    }
}

impl SandboxTruthRefSet {
    /// 从已解析的 closed truth members 构造 ordered-unique set；空输入表示已知成员为零。
    pub fn try_new(refs: Vec<SandboxTruthRef>) -> Result<Self, SandboxTruthRefSetError>;

    /// 返回 caller / committed mapper 提供的稳定插入顺序；不按 ref 文本排序。
    pub fn as_slice(&self) -> &[SandboxTruthRef];

    /// 返回 truth member 数量。
    pub fn len(&self) -> usize;

    /// 判断当前 committed source snapshot 是否没有已知 truth member。
    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool;

    /// 判断 set 是否包含完全相同的 typed truth member。
    pub fn contains(&self, member: &SandboxTruthRef) -> bool;

    /// 仅用于跨 union identity 审计；不得把返回的 generic ref传给 repository。
    pub fn contains_object_ref(&self, object_ref: &SandboxObjectRef) -> bool;

    /// 判断当前 set 是否是另一个 set 的 identity 子集；不比较 scope 或 cursor。
    pub fn is_subset_of(&self, other: &Self) -> bool;

    /// 判断 set 是否包含 context anchor。
    pub fn has_context_anchor(&self) -> bool;

    /// 判断 set 是否至少包含一项 core execution / boundary / policy / lifecycle truth。
    pub fn has_core_truth(&self) -> bool;

    /// 判断 set 是否包含 reference-side truth。
    pub fn has_reference_truth(&self) -> bool;
}

/// Sandbox truth ref set 的 shape、identity 和 closed-union错误。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum SandboxTruthRefSetError {
    /// 同一个 closed member identity 重复出现。
    DuplicateTruthRef,
    /// 不同 named wrapper 复用了同一个底层 Sandbox object identity。
    TruthRefIdentityCollision {
        /// 第一个发生碰撞的 object kind。
        first: SandboxObjectRefKind,
        /// 第二个发生碰撞的 object kind。
        second: SandboxObjectRefKind,
    },
    /// mapper 试图把不属于 truth union 的 object kind 放入 set。
    UnsupportedTruthRefKind {
        /// 被拒绝的 object kind。
        actual: SandboxObjectRefKind,
    },
    /// member wrapper 与其显式 object kind 不一致。
    TruthRefKindIdentityMismatch,
}
```

`try_new` 的 exact 校验顺序固定为：空输入直接接受；随后检查每个 member 的 named kind，再按 typed member equality 拒绝重复，最后按 `as_object_ref()` 检查跨 variant 的底层 identity collision。它不排序、不自动去重、不选择 latest、不补 context anchor，也不读取任何 object body。`contains_object_ref` 只用于 mapper 的 integrity check，不能成为 generic repository lookup API。

#### 16.1.3 Source lineage、状态边界与下游承接

| source / field | exact source | missing / invalid handling | forbidden substitute |
|---|---|---|---|
| member ref | 已提交 truth row、domain outcome 或同一 committed source snapshot | unknown kind、wrong wrapper、duplicate、identity collision -> `SandboxTruthRefSetError` | `SandboxOpaqueRef`、字符串、row id、locator |
| member order | source reader / caller 已给出的 deterministic order | order 不影响 identity equality；不得由 set 重排 | ref 文本排序、timestamp排序、priority排序 |
| context / scope | report / view source snapshot的独立字段 | set 不足以证明 scope；consumer factory做 typed integrity check | 从 ref 文本反解 context、取第一个 member 猜 scope |
| truth cursor | 同一 committed UoW truth channel | set不保存 cursor；缺 cursor由 source/report factory拒绝或进入明确 unavailable surface | `Version`、timestamp、page cursor、event id |
| status | owning truth object的 canonical status | set不复制或派生 status | status string、visible status、caller bool |
| body | 不存在于 set | 任何 body 字段进入 mapper -> forbidden-body boundary | raw output、SDK response、artifact/evidence body |

此 set 不拥有生命周期状态，不能执行 `mark_stale`、`reconcile`、`repair`、`publish`、`refresh` 或任何 UoW 写入。Step 7 必须让 repository / source reader直接返回带 committed cursor 和 scope lineage 的 carrier；Step 8/9 只能按本 set 做 schema / flow 映射，不能在协议层复制 union。

#### 16.1.4 Negative cuts 与停审记录

| negative cut | 必须拒绝的行为 | 责任 |
|---|---|---|
| projection contamination | 将 `SandboxReadProjectionRef`、view ref、derived ref、audit ref 或 relay ref加入 truth set | constructor / mapper |
| empty fake report | 把合法空 set解释成“检查已成功”或在没有 committed source snapshot 时创建 clean report | application reconciliation flow / report factory |
| generic ref fallback | 将 `SandboxObjectRef` 或 `ResourceRef`直接作为 public set member | contracts boundary |
| latest synthesis | 读取多个 latest row后临时拼 set | Step 7 source reader |
| truth promotion | 将 relay published、audit linked 或 view fresh 当作 truth status | view / reconciliation factory |

本对象的 Step 6 closure 只证明 set shape contract；它不证明任何实际 source row、数据库事务、编译或运行结果。Step 7~10 必须分别回指 source reader、protocol field mapping、flow side-effect inventory 和 state subject，不得把本 set误计为新的状态机。

### 16.2 `SandboxProjectionRefSet`

`SandboxProjectionRefSet` 是 read projection、status view、derived surface、audit linkage、relay record 和 reconciliation report 的 closed identity 集合。它表达“检查或读取了哪些 projection-side objects”，不表示这些对象的内容新鲜、可见、已发布或已修复。

#### 16.2.1 Capability 与 closed member union

| 项 | exact 结论 |
|---|---|
| canonical owner | `crates/contracts/src/refs.rs`，registry `S6T-04-015`；不得由 `projection.rs` 或 view mapper重新声明 |
| capability | 保存可为空、ordered-unique 的 projection/read-side identities，供 reconciliation、comparison、audit linkage 和 query source snapshot使用 |
| accepted source | 已提交 projection / view / derived / audit / relay / report row；不能由 query 临时生成 |
| freshness | 不由 set 判断；由对应 object status、source cursor 和 checked snapshot说明 |
| empty semantics | 空 projection-side检查范围可以创建合法空 `SandboxProjectionRefSet`；它只表示已知 projection-side 成员为零。source 缺失、scope 未闭合或读取降级必须由上层显式返回 |
| body boundary | 只保存 named refs；不保存 projection body、view body、relay payload、audit正文、raw provider response或locator |

```rust
/// reconciliation / read-source 可检查的 projection-side identity 闭集。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum SandboxProjectionRef {
    /// controlled execution 总览 status view。
    ExecutionStatusView(SandboxExecutionStatusViewRef),
    /// boundary status view。

    /// policy decision summary view。

    /// capture summary view。
    CaptureSummaryView(CaptureSummaryViewRef),
    /// material handoff status view。
    MaterialHandoffStatusView(MaterialHandoffStatusViewRef),
    /// failure / control status view。
    FailureControlStatusView(FailureControlStatusViewRef),
    /// cleanup readiness view。
    CleanupReadinessView(CleanupReadinessViewRef),
    /// redline containment view。
    RedlineContainmentView(RedlineContainmentViewRef),
    /// rebuildable Sandbox read projection。
    SandboxReadProjection(SandboxReadProjectionRef),
    /// inspect / preview / trend derived state。
    DerivedInspectPreviewTrendState(DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStateRef),
    /// inspect / preview / trend derived view。
    DerivedInspectPreviewTrendView(DerivedInspectPreviewTrendViewRef),
    /// backend capability comparison view。
    BackendCapabilityComparisonView(BackendCapabilityComparisonViewRef),
    /// reconciliation report。
    SandboxReconciliationReport(SandboxReconciliationReportRef),
    /// append-only audit linkage record。

    /// append-only event relay record。

}

impl SandboxProjectionRef {
    /// 返回已登记的 Sandbox object kind。
    pub fn kind(&self) -> SandboxObjectRefKind;

    /// 返回用于 set identity collision 检查的 generic ref 副本；不得用于 repository 读写。
    pub fn as_object_ref(&self) -> SandboxObjectRef;

    /// 判断 member 是否为 status view。
    pub fn is_status_view(&self) -> bool;

    /// 判断 member 是否为可重建 projection / derived state。

```

`SandboxProjectionRef` 不包含任何 `SandboxTruthRef` variant；尤其不允许把 `ControlledExecutionRunRef`、`FailureClassificationRef`、`CleanupGuardRef` 或 `RedlineContainmentRef`通过“projection 视图”包装后混入 projection union。视图 ref 只表示 view identity，不能反向恢复对应 truth body；`SandboxAuditTraceRef` 与 `SandboxEventRelayRecordRef`虽属于 projection-side linkage，仍保持 append-only / delivery lifecycle 的独立 owner。

#### 16.2.2 Private fields、constructor 与 object-owned error

```rust
/// 非空且按插入顺序保存的 projection-side identity 集合。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq, Serialize)]
pub struct SandboxProjectionRefSet {
    /// 已由 constructor 校验过的 closed projection members。
    refs: Vec<SandboxProjectionRef>,
}

impl<'de> Deserialize<'de> for SandboxProjectionRefSet {
    fn deserialize<D>(deserializer: D) -> Result<Self, D::Error>
    where
        D: serde::Deserializer<'de>,
    {
        let refs = Vec::<SandboxProjectionRef>::deserialize(deserializer)?;
        Self::try_new(refs)
            .map_err(|_| serde::de::Error::custom("invalid sandbox projection ref set"))
    }
}

impl SandboxProjectionRefSet {
    /// 从已解析的 closed projection members 构造 ordered-unique set；空输入表示已知成员为零。
    pub fn try_new(refs: Vec<SandboxProjectionRef>)
        -> Result<Self, SandboxProjectionRefSetError>;

    /// 返回 caller / committed mapper 提供的稳定插入顺序。
    pub fn as_slice(&self) -> &[SandboxProjectionRef];

    /// 返回 projection member 数量。
    pub fn len(&self) -> usize;

    /// 判断当前 source snapshot 是否没有已知 projection-side member。
    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool;

    /// 判断 set 是否包含完全相同的 typed projection member。
    pub fn contains(&self, member: &SandboxProjectionRef) -> bool;

    /// 仅用于跨 union identity 审计；不得用于 generic repository read。
    pub fn contains_object_ref(&self, object_ref: &SandboxObjectRef) -> bool;

    /// 判断当前 set 是否是另一个 set 的 identity 子集。
    pub fn is_subset_of(&self, other: &Self) -> bool;

    /// 判断 set 是否包含至少一个 rebuildable projection / derived state。
    pub fn has_rebuildable_state(&self) -> bool;

    /// 判断 set 是否包含至少一个 caller-facing status view。
    pub fn has_status_view(&self) -> bool;

    /// 判断 set 是否包含 append-only audit 或 relay linkage。
    pub fn has_append_only_linkage(&self) -> bool;
}

/// Sandbox projection ref set 的 shape、identity 和 closed-union错误。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum SandboxProjectionRefSetError {
    /// 同一个 closed member identity 重复出现。
    DuplicateProjectionRef,
    /// 不同 named wrapper 复用了同一个底层 Sandbox object identity。
    ProjectionRefIdentityCollision {
        /// 第一个发生碰撞的 object kind。
        first: SandboxObjectRefKind,
        /// 第二个发生碰撞的 object kind。
        second: SandboxObjectRefKind,
    },
    /// mapper 试图把不属于 projection union 的 object kind 放入 set。
    UnsupportedProjectionRefKind {
        /// 被拒绝的 object kind。
        actual: SandboxObjectRefKind,
    },
    /// member wrapper 与其显式 object kind 不一致。
    ProjectionRefKindIdentityMismatch,
}
```

`SandboxProjectionRefSet::try_new` 的校验顺序与 truth set 对称：空输入直接接受 -> closed kind -> exact duplicate -> underlying identity collision。它不验证 member 是否 Fresh、是否对当前 actor 可见、是否属于同一 context、是否有 matching truth cursor；这些关系必须由 `SandboxReadProjectionSourceSnapshot`、五个 view source factory、comparison source 或 reconciliation report factory验证。空 set 不能单独证明“没有问题”，也不能单独证明“读取成功”。

#### 16.2.3 Source lineage、关系矩阵与禁止写入

| member family | source / relation | set-level结论 | 禁止替代 |
|---|---|---|---|
| eight status views | 同一 committed source group逐项返回 typed view ref、context ref、observed time | set只保存 view identity；context lineage由 `SandboxStatusViewBindingSet` 校验 | 从 view ref 文本反解 context、缺失 member补空 view |
| `SandboxReadProjection` | projection repository committed row | set不保存 projection status / cursor；空 projection source仍须由上层注明 empty | 用 `SandboxTruthCursor` 伪造 projection identity |
| derived state / view | derived owner committed source | set不宣称 Fresh、可见或可重建成功 | 用 view body、latest timestamp、query result推 freshness |
| comparison view | 已提交 comparison source snapshot | set不选择 backend、不执行 capability probe | 在 set constructor内调用 `BackendCapabilityPort` |
| reconciliation report | 已提交 report identity | set不解释 `Clean` / `IssuesFound` | 用 report ref存在性伪造 Clean |
| audit / relay | append-only record / relay row | set不改变 trace / relay status | publish、retry、mark linked、repair |

set 的所有公开方法都是 pure getter / membership predicate。任何 query、view mapper、comparison builder 或 reconciliation job发现缺失、stale、wrong source、duplicate、timestamp损坏或 cursor mismatch时，必须返回对应 source-owned typed error 或 `StatusViewDegradedReasonSet`，不能在 set 内 refresh、rebuild、append audit、写 UoW 或重试 relay。

#### 16.2.4 Step 7~10 handoff 与 negative cuts

| downstream | 必须消费 | 不得自行补造 |
|---|---|---|
| Step 7 | repository / source reader返回的 exact projection members、context lineage、source cursor和observed time | `Vec<SandboxOpaqueRef>`、generic `ResourceRef`、全表扫描、latest scan |
| Step 8 | public DTO中明确的 set字段和 optionality；不复制 embedded union | wire-only `ProjectionStatus`、字符串 kind、两个Option selector |
| Step 9 | set作为 flow input；明确 read-only 或 append-only side effect | query内 rebuild/repair、relay publish、reconciliation auto-fix |
| Step 10 | set不是状态机；只作为状态对象的 source membership | 为 set增加 Fresh/Stale/Published/Completed lifecycle |

负向契约固定为：不得把 `SandboxProjectionRefSet` 转成 `SandboxTruthRefSet`；不得把 `SandboxTruthRefSet` 的 member 顺序当优先级；不得以两个 set 的交集或数量推导业务状态；不得将 set 序列化为可解析的 locator / path；不得在 fake 中用私有 map替代 typed set identity。

### 16.1~16.2 小批自检与停审记录

| 检查项 | 当前结论 |
|---|---|
| named type sections | `SandboxTruthRefSet`、`SandboxProjectionRefSet`各有唯一 canonical section |
| embedded member union | truth / projection 分离；不复用 generic ref，不新增 shared enum |
| private fields | 均为 `Vec<embedded typed union>`，无 public mutable field |
| constructor | 两者均为 fallible `try_new(Vec<...>)`；空输入合法，重复与跨 wrapper identity collision拒绝 |
| deserialize | 两者均必须复用 `try_new`；不得绕过 shape校验 |
| cursor / scope / context | 不由 set伪造；由 committed source snapshot / report factory闭合 |
| no-write | set无 repository、UoW、adapter、refresh、repair、publish或rebuild callable |
| historical generic ref | `SandboxOpaqueRef` / `SandboxOpaqueRefSet`不提供兼容 alias |
| upstream blocker | 未发现新的 L1/L2 blocker；当前仍只有 `SBX-DDD-GRANULARITY-REOPEN-001` 与 batch 6进行中状态 |

> 历史快照：本句记录 §16.1~§16.2 写入时的中间状态；当前 §16.3 已完成设计文本并在其对象级 gate 停审，不能据此进入 §16.4。

### 16.3 `SandboxAuditTrace`

`SandboxAuditTrace` 是 Sandbox-owned business audit linkage record。它只记录已经成立的 Sandbox source fact 在一个已接受提交中的审计关系，不保存审计正文、日志正文、外部调查正文或 relay payload。它不是任何 domain fact 的替代品，也不是 observability store 的查询结果。

本节同时关闭 support family #37：`SandboxAuditTraceKind`、`AuditActorContext`、`AuditReasonSummary`、`AuditMaterialRefSet` 以及它们所需的 transient source / material relation carrier。所有 carrier 都属于本节的对象实现契约；它们不能在 Step 7 repository、Step 8 DTO 或 Step 15 observability 分件中重新声明。

#### 16.3.1 Capability、owner 与创建前提

| 项 | exact 结论 |
|---|---|
| registry | `S6T-04-012`；`SandboxAuditTrace` 是唯一 current named type。 |
| canonical owner | `crates/domain/src/audit_trace.rs`；typed ref `SandboxAuditTraceRef` 仍由 `crates/contracts/src/refs.rs` 唯一拥有。 |
| capability | 将一个已接受 source fact、合法 trace subject、有限 trace kind、body-free actor / reason / material、trace context 和 committed truth cursor绑定为不可变 audit record。 |
| producer | application command、accepted consumer safety transition、projection / derived mutation 或具有正式 Sandbox source fact 的 maintenance flow；producer 必须先形成 source binding，不能由 query、纯 relay publish feedback 或日志 wrapper 创建。 |
| consumer | audit repository、read query、projection / reconciliation source、event relay builder 和 caller-safe report；consumer 只能读取，不能补链、补材料或改变 audit status。 |
| source prerequisite | 只能消费 `SandboxSourceFactRef` 对应的 staged source fact（同一 UoW）或带 committed cursor 的 source snapshot。bare ref、reference-only observation、纯 relay publish feedback 没有 formal source fact 时不得伪造业务 audit。 |
| subject prerequisite | `SandboxTraceSubjectRef` 必须来自 shared closed kind，且必须与 source fact 和 trace kind满足本节 relation matrix。guard、status view、audit 自身和 application helper永远不能成为 subject。 |
| commit prerequisite | 先预生成 `SandboxAuditTraceRef`，再创建 cursor-less draft；draft、source truth、relay、stored result 和 stale marker 同一 `SandboxUnitOfWork` staged，完整 write set 后由 UoW 分配 truth cursor，最后 finalize 并 append immutable record。rollback 后 source、draft、audit、relay 和 cursor 一并不可见。 |
| body boundary | 只允许 typed refs、safe reason、safe summary、digest、finite kind、core actor context 和 cursor；raw request / event / SDK / investigation / telemetry / artifact / evidence body一律拒绝。 |

本对象不拥有 `SandboxAuditTraceStatus` 的业务推进。当前可持久化 record 在 finalize 时已经有 canonical subject，因此 persisted status 固定为 `Linked`；`Recorded` 只表示同一 UoW 内的 transient draft / staged observation，`RelayPending` / `RelayFailed` 由历史 HLD 错误地放入 audit status，当前改由 `SandboxEventRelayRecord` 的独立 lifecycle 承接。shared enum暂不删除，避免静默改写 registry；旧 variant 的处理见 §16.3.8。纯 relay publisher feedback 若没有新的 Sandbox truth fact，只更新 relay record，不创建 `Relay` audit。

#### 16.3.2 `SandboxAuditTraceKind` closed enum

`SandboxAuditTraceKind` 表达审计的业务主语类别，不表达 repository 状态、HTTP route、topic、adapter 产品、job 名称或自由文本。`LeaseRecord` 与 `OrphanRecoveryRecord` 的审计归入 `Cleanup`；job 只是触发入口，不单独成为 audit kind。

```rust
/// 穷尽 Sandbox business audit 的主语类别；不表达 audit 或 relay 生命周期。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum SandboxAuditTraceKind {
    /// controlled execution context、identity 或 intake resolution 已发生正式变化。
    Intake,
    /// boundary requirement、capability、decision 或 isolation handle 已发生正式变化。
    Boundary,
    /// policy applicability、execution decision 或 high-risk decision 已发生正式变化。
    Policy,
    /// controlled execution run 已发生正式生命周期变化。
    Run,
    /// capture fact 或 capture completeness 已形成正式 source fact。
    Capture,
    /// material handoff 或 observability material handoff 已发生正式变化。
    Handoff,
    /// failure classification 已形成或发生正式关联变化。
    Failure,
    /// control fact 已受理、冲突、完成或失败。
    Control,
    /// lease、orphan recovery、cleanup readiness 或 release safety truth 已发生变化。
    Cleanup,
    /// security redline containment 已形成或发生正式变化。
    Redline,
    /// rebuildable read projection 已发生正式 materialization 或 stale 变化。
    Projection,
    /// derived inspect / preview / trend state 已发生正式维护变化。
    Derived,
    /// reconciliation report 已被提交并可被读取。
    Reconciliation,
    /// relay record 的传播观察被记录；不改变 source fact 的业务状态。
    Relay,
}

impl SandboxAuditTraceKind {
    /// 判断该 kind 是否允许 relay record 作为 trace subject。
    pub fn allows_relay_subject(self) -> bool;

    /// 判断该 kind 是否允许 investigation source / summary material。
    pub fn allows_investigation_material(self) -> bool;

    /// 校验 source fact variant 是否属于该 kind 的 closed source family。
    pub fn accepts_source_fact(self, source: &SandboxSourceFactRef) -> bool;

    /// 校验 trace subject kind 是否属于该 kind 的 closed subject family。
    pub fn accepts_subject(self, subject: &SandboxTraceSubjectRef) -> bool;
}
```

#### 16.3.2.1 Mechanical kind predicates

上述四个 predicate 必须由 `SandboxAuditTraceKind` 的显式 `match` 实现。实现不得
读取 status、reason、topic、publisher response 或 `ResourceRef` 字符串来补推 kind。
`SandboxSourceFactRef` 当前只有下表中的 13 个 source variant；`Relay` 不新增第 14
个 source variant，而是引用其中任意一个已经提交的原始 source。

| audit kind | `accepts_source_fact` 的唯一规则 | `accepts_subject` 的唯一规则 | `allows_relay_subject` | `allows_investigation_material` | source event / relay eligibility |
|---|---|---|---:|---:|---|
| `Intake` | 仅 `ExecutionContext` | `ControlledExecutionContext`、`ExecutionEnvironmentIdentity`、`ExecutionContextResolution`、`ContextReferenceResolution` | 否 | 否 | `SandboxExecutionContextChanged`；是 |
| `Boundary` | 仅 `BoundaryDecision` | `BoundaryRequirementSet`、`BoundaryEstablishmentDecision`、`CoherentBoundary`、`BackendCapabilitySummary`、`IsolationEnvironmentHandle` | 否 | 否 | `SandboxBoundaryChanged`；是 |
| `Policy` | 仅 `PolicyDecision` | `PolicyApplicabilitySnapshot`、`PolicyExecutionDecision`、`HighRiskActionDecision` | 否 | 否 | `SandboxPolicyDecisionChanged`；是 |
| `Run` | 仅 `Run` | `ControlledExecutionRun` | 否 | 否 | `SandboxRunChanged`；是 |
| `Capture` | 仅 `Capture` | `CaptureFact`、`ObservabilityMaterial` | 否 | 否 | `SandboxCaptureChanged`；是 |
| `Handoff` | 仅 `MaterialHandoff` | `HandoffFact`、`CaptureFact`、`ObservabilityMaterial` | 否 | 否 | `SandboxMaterialHandoffChanged`；是 |
| `Failure` | 仅 `Failure` | `FailureClassification`、`ControlledExecutionRun` | 否 | 否 | `SandboxFailureChanged`；是 |
| `Control` | 仅 `Control` | `ControlFact`、`ControlledExecutionRun` | 否 | 否 | `SandboxControlChanged`；是 |
| `Cleanup` | 仅 `Cleanup` | `CleanupGuard`、`LeaseRecord`、`OrphanRecoveryRecord`、`IsolationEnvironmentHandle`、`ControlledExecutionContext` | 否 | 是 | `SandboxCleanupChanged`；是 |
| `Redline` | 仅 `RedlineContainment` | `RedlineContainment`、`ControlledExecutionRun`、`CoherentBoundary`、`IsolationEnvironmentHandle` | 否 | 是 | `SandboxRedlineContainmentChanged`；是 |
| `Projection` | 仅 `Projection` | `SandboxReadProjection` | 否 | 否 | `SandboxProjectionChanged`；是 |
| `Derived` | 仅 `DerivedState` | `DerivedInspectPreviewTrendState` | 否 | 否 | `SandboxDerivedViewChanged`；是 |
| `Reconciliation` | 仅 `ReconciliationReport` | `SandboxReconciliationReport` | 否 | 否 | `SandboxReconciliationFindingAvailable`；是 |
| `Relay` | 任一 13 个已提交 source variant（显式穷举） | 仅 `SandboxEventRelayRecord` | 是 | 否 | 否；Relay audit 不再产生 relay；source owner 负责唯一性 |

机械实现的等价伪代码如下；新增 source 或 subject variant 时必须同步更新本表、
shared registry 和 exhaustive match，不能以 `_ => true` 扩大闭集：

```rust
fn accepts_source_fact(
    kind: SandboxAuditTraceKind,
    source: &SandboxSourceFactRef,
) -> bool {
    match kind {
        SandboxAuditTraceKind::Intake =>
            matches!(source, SandboxSourceFactRef::ExecutionContext(_)),
        SandboxAuditTraceKind::Boundary =>
            matches!(source, SandboxSourceFactRef::BoundaryDecision(_)),
        SandboxAuditTraceKind::Policy =>
            matches!(source, SandboxSourceFactRef::PolicyDecision(_)),
        SandboxAuditTraceKind::Run =>
            matches!(source, SandboxSourceFactRef::Run(_)),
        SandboxAuditTraceKind::Capture =>
            matches!(source, SandboxSourceFactRef::Capture(_)),
        SandboxAuditTraceKind::Handoff =>
            matches!(source, SandboxSourceFactRef::MaterialHandoff(_)),
        SandboxAuditTraceKind::Failure =>
            matches!(source, SandboxSourceFactRef::Failure(_)),
        SandboxAuditTraceKind::Control =>
            matches!(source, SandboxSourceFactRef::Control(_)),
        SandboxAuditTraceKind::Cleanup =>
            matches!(source, SandboxSourceFactRef::Cleanup(_)),
        SandboxAuditTraceKind::Redline =>
            matches!(source, SandboxSourceFactRef::RedlineContainment(_)),
        SandboxAuditTraceKind::Projection =>
            matches!(source, SandboxSourceFactRef::Projection(_)),
        SandboxAuditTraceKind::Derived =>
            matches!(source, SandboxSourceFactRef::DerivedState(_)),
        SandboxAuditTraceKind::Reconciliation =>
            matches!(source, SandboxSourceFactRef::ReconciliationReport(_)),
        SandboxAuditTraceKind::Relay => matches!(
            source,
            SandboxSourceFactRef::ExecutionContext(_)
                | SandboxSourceFactRef::BoundaryDecision(_)
                | SandboxSourceFactRef::PolicyDecision(_)
                | SandboxSourceFactRef::Run(_)
                | SandboxSourceFactRef::Capture(_)
                | SandboxSourceFactRef::MaterialHandoff(_)
                | SandboxSourceFactRef::Failure(_)
                | SandboxSourceFactRef::Control(_)
                | SandboxSourceFactRef::Cleanup(_)
                | SandboxSourceFactRef::RedlineContainment(_)
                | SandboxSourceFactRef::Projection(_)
                | SandboxSourceFactRef::DerivedState(_)
                | SandboxSourceFactRef::ReconciliationReport(_)
        ),
    }
}
```

`allows_relay_subject()` 的唯一实现为 `self == SandboxAuditTraceKind::Relay`；
`allows_investigation_material()` 的唯一实现为 `matches!(self, Cleanup | Redline)`。
`Relay` 的 `accepts_source_fact` 是对 13 个显式 source variant 的穷举匹配，
不是 `_ => true`；新增 source variant 时必须同时增加本表、shared registry、
`event_kind()` 映射和 closure 计数，否则设计差集不为零。
`accepts_subject()` 必须按上表的 `SandboxObjectRefKind` 闭集逐项匹配，并且先拒绝
`SandboxAuditTrace`、所有 guard / view、`SandboxIdempotencyRecord`、
`SandboxStoredOperationResult`、external ref 和 application helper。特别地，
`Cleanup` 的 execution `run_ref` 是 lineage anchor，不使 `ControlledExecutionRun`
成为 `Cleanup` subject；cleanup subject 不得借此绕过 `Run` kind。

`SandboxAuditTraceKind` 与 `SandboxEventKind` 不互相替代：前者描述 audit 主语，后者描述 outbound event；只有 `SandboxSourceFactRef::event_kind()` 能生成 event kind。`Relay` kind 的 source fact 仍必须是 relay 所传播的原始 source fact，不能以 `SandboxEventRelayRecordRef` 反向制造 source fact。

#### 16.3.3 Source fact / subject / kind relation matrix

下表是 `SandboxAuditTraceDraft::record` / `SandboxAuditTrace::rehydrate` 的闭集校验，不是建议性映射。除表内关系外，factory必须返回 `SandboxAuditTraceError::SourceSubjectRelationInvalid`；不得通过 `SandboxObjectRefKind` 的字符串、resource ref前缀或 status 文本猜测关系。

| trace kind | required source fact | allowed subject kinds | material / cursor rule |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Intake` | `SandboxSourceFactRef::ExecutionContext` | `ControlledExecutionContext`、`ExecutionEnvironmentIdentity`、`ExecutionContextResolution`、`ContextReferenceResolution` | staged source允许 `None` cursor，committed source必须有 cursor；首次 intake 不接受未解析 external body。 |
| `Boundary` | `SandboxSourceFactRef::BoundaryDecision` | `BoundaryRequirementSet`、`BoundaryEstablishmentDecision`、`CoherentBoundary`、`BackendCapabilitySummary`、`IsolationEnvironmentHandle` | capability / boundary summary只能以已提交 body-free ref出现。 |
| `Policy` | `SandboxSourceFactRef::PolicyDecision` | `PolicyApplicabilitySnapshot`、`PolicyExecutionDecision`、`HighRiskActionDecision` | 不接受 policy definition、approval 或 tool semantic body。 |
| `Run` | `SandboxSourceFactRef::Run` | `ControlledExecutionRun` | handle、lease、policy relation只能作为 source-side checked relation，不能另造 run status。 |
| `Capture` | `SandboxSourceFactRef::Capture` | `CaptureFact`、`ObservabilityMaterial` | captured material 与 observability material必须通过 material relation snapshot绑定。 |
| `Handoff` | `SandboxSourceFactRef::MaterialHandoff` | `HandoffFact`、`CaptureFact`、`ObservabilityMaterial` | target receipt 是 material / handoff support，不成为新的 Sandbox source fact。 |
| `Failure` | `SandboxSourceFactRef::Failure` | `FailureClassification`、`ControlledExecutionRun` | failure basis必须来自 owning failure object；不得保存 raw adapter error。 |
| `Control` | `SandboxSourceFactRef::Control` | `ControlFact`、`ControlledExecutionRun` | control effect observation与control fact relation必须已由 control factory校验。 |
| `Cleanup` | `SandboxSourceFactRef::Cleanup` | `CleanupGuard`、`LeaseRecord`、`OrphanRecoveryRecord`、`IsolationEnvironmentHandle`、`ControlledExecutionContext` | lease / orphan reaper只有在同一 accepted cleanup / safety source relation成立时写 business audit。 |
| `Redline` | `SandboxSourceFactRef::RedlineContainment` | `RedlineContainment`、`ControlledExecutionRun`、`CoherentBoundary`、`IsolationEnvironmentHandle` | investigation material只能是 body-free external ref / safe summary。 |
| `Projection` | `SandboxSourceFactRef::Projection` | `SandboxReadProjection` | stale / rebuild observation不得改变任何 core truth。 |
| `Derived` | `SandboxSourceFactRef::DerivedState` | `DerivedInspectPreviewTrendState` | derived failure只记录 derived maintenance，不升级为 `FailureClassification`。 |
| `Reconciliation` | `SandboxSourceFactRef::ReconciliationReport` | `SandboxReconciliationReport` | report 只能报告 findings / degraded，不自动修复 source 或 projection。 |
| `Relay` | 同一 accepted UoW 中已提交或将提交、被 relay record 明确引用的原始 source fact | `SandboxEventRelayRecord` | 只记录 relay append；relay status由 `SandboxEventRelayStatus` 独立拥有；publisher feedback 不创建新的 `Relay` audit。 |

#### 16.3.3.1 Subject-specific anchor cardinality
