| downstream | Step 7~11 的定向回查仍为 `downstream_revalidation_pending`；不得把本节 closure 传播为下游通过。 |
| blocker | 未发现新的 L1/L2 上游 blocker；`SBX-DDD-GRANULARITY-REOPEN-001`、`SBX-DDD-GRANULARITY-STEP6-001` 和 `BLK-SBX-VERSION-001` 继续开放。 |
| fact boundary | 未生成实现、编译、测试、run、evidence、验收或 commit 事实；正式 `03-详细设计.md` 未修改。 |

本对象到此停审。`6R-04` batch 6 的整体状态仍为 `in_progress`，`§16.4~§16.10` 尚未开始。

> 历史快照：用户已确认 `§16.3`，其契约现由 `§16.4` 消费。上述“等待确认”和
> “§16.4 尚未开始”只记录 `SandboxAuditTrace` 对象停审时的状态，不再是 current gate。

### 16.4 `SandboxEventRelayRecord`

`SandboxEventRelayRecord` 是 Sandbox-owned outbound event publication lifecycle record。
它只承接一个已经成立的 `SandboxSourceFactRef`、该 source 的 committed truth cursor、
与 source 一一对应的 `SandboxEventKind`、一份冻结的 body-free payload snapshot 以及一组
已验证但不透明的 publisher / route binding identity。它不拥有 source fact，不拥有 bus、
subscriber、topic、provider 或 downstream lifecycle，也不把 publication success解释为业务成功。

本节同时关闭 support family #38。HLD 候选 `SandboxEventRelayKind` 不成为 current enum，
因为 13 项正式 outbound event 已由 shared `SandboxEventKind` 唯一拥有；
`EventRelayTargetRefSet` 也不成为 current set，因为一个 relay record 只有一个正式 transport
publication boundary，bus 之后的 fan-out 不归 Sandbox。current support family 固定为：

- `SandboxRelaySourceBinding` 与 `SandboxEventRelayDraft`；
- `SandboxRelayPayloadIdentity`、`SandboxRelayEncodedPayload` 与
  `SandboxRelayPayloadSnapshot`；
- `SandboxRelayTargetBinding` 与 `SandboxRelayDedupKey`；
- `SandboxRelayAttemptRef`、retry decision、delivery observation、receipt、failure 和
  dead-letter summary；
- `SandboxEventRelayRecordError`、persistence carrier 与 rehydration input。

除纯 identity `SandboxRelayAttemptRef` 外，以上类型全部由
`crates/domain/src/event_relay.rs` 唯一拥有；`SandboxRelayAttemptRef`与
`SandboxEventRelayRecordRef`、`SandboxEventKind`、`SandboxEventRelayStatus`、
`SandboxSourceFactRef`、cursor、trace context 和 shared reason / core metadata 继续复用
`crates/contracts` / `core-contracts`，其中attempt ref的唯一declaration见shared registry §8.5.1。
Step 7 repository、Step 8 DTO、Step 9 flow、Step 13 retry
配置和 Step 14 publisher binding 不得复制一套同名或同义 schema。

#### 16.4.1 Capability、owner 与不可越界前提

| 项 | exact 结论 |
|---|---|
| registry | `S6T-04-013`；`SandboxEventRelayRecord` 是本节唯一 named lifecycle object。 |
| canonical owner | record、attempt relation、payload、binding、outcome与transition位于`crates/domain/src/event_relay.rs`；record ref与跨模块`SandboxRelayAttemptRef`位于`crates/contracts/src/refs.rs`。 |
| source prerequisite | 只能由 `SandboxSourceFactRef` 的 13 个 current variant创建；`event_kind` 必须严格等于 `source_fact_ref.event_kind()`。audit、query、view、job report、publisher feedback和 relay record自身都不能成为新的 source fact。 |
| commit prerequisite | 新 source path 使用 cursor-less draft；source truth、audit draft、relay draft、stored result和stale markers先在同一 UoW准备，UoW分配 `SandboxTruthCursor` 后再finalize relay record和payload snapshot并在commit前append。committed repair path只能复制source repository返回的原cursor。 |
| payload prerequisite | 必须由回归后 Step 8 的exact typed outbound mapper形成一份immutable、body-free、canonical encoded snapshot；没有完整payload source时不创建relay record。publisher不得从latest truth重建。 |
| target prerequisite | 只接受validated runtime config映射出的opaque publisher binding、topic-neutral route binding和runtime generation refs；不保存topic、endpoint、credential、provider response或subscriber list。 |
| lifecycle owner | record只拥有 `Pending / Published / Retryable / Failed / DeadLetter`。repository `Version`、worker claim、fencing token、job status和config availability不是domain状态。 |
| no rollback | publication / feedback失败只推进本record与job/report surface；source truth、source audit、projection和原stored result均保持已提交状态。 |
| no recursive relay | relay append或status transition不能创建新的 outbound relay。可在relay row已提交后按`§16.3`形成一次`Relay` audit；该audit的`requires_event_relay()`固定为false。 |
| body boundary | record、snapshot、receipt和failure只允许typed ref、finite kind/status、canonical encoded body-free bytes、fingerprint、safe reason、cursor、time和trace identity。raw request/output、SDK response、transport header、topic、locator、secret、artifact/evidence/telemetry/investigation正文一律拒绝。 |

`SandboxEventRelayRecord` 是“传播记录”，不是 Sandbox 主体执行功能。它与主体功能只有
source identity、same-UoW append 和 no-rollback 关系；它不能启动 run、修改 boundary / policy、
补 capture、重试 material handoff、解除 cleanup guard 或释放 redline containment。

#### 16.4.2 Source / event closed mapping 与 transient binding

`SandboxSourceFactRef::event_kind()` 是唯一 current source-to-event mapper。实现必须使用
穷尽 match；不得从对象 ref 文本、audit kind、route、payload类型名或topic反推 event kind。

| `SandboxSourceFactRef` variant | 唯一 `SandboxEventKind` | source owner | 禁止替代 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ExecutionContext` | `SandboxExecutionContextChanged` | accepted / rejected / unresolved context truth | identity ref、query view或request ref |
| `BoundaryDecision` | `SandboxBoundaryChanged` | boundary establishment decision truth | coherent boundary ref、backend response或handle ref |
| `PolicyDecision` | `SandboxPolicyDecisionChanged` | policy execution decision truth | policy summary、authorization正文或guard ref |
| `Run` | `SandboxRunChanged` | controlled run truth | runtime execution instance、backend handle或tool result |
| `Capture` | `SandboxCaptureChanged` | capture fact truth | output body、material locator或artifact ref |
| `MaterialHandoff` | `SandboxMaterialHandoffChanged` | handoff fact truth | receipt、target ref或relay ref |
| `Failure` | `SandboxFailureChanged` | failure classification truth | raw adapter error、stack trace或reason text |
| `Control` | `SandboxControlChanged` | control fact truth | inbound event id、operator flag或runtime control result |
| `Cleanup` | `SandboxCleanupChanged` | cleanup guard truth | lease status、reaper job result或caller bool |
| `RedlineContainment` | `SandboxRedlineContainmentChanged` | redline containment truth | advisory log、investigation正文或security alert id |
| `Projection` | `SandboxProjectionChanged` | read projection lifecycle truth | query response或view ref |
| `DerivedState` | `SandboxDerivedViewChanged` | derived state lifecycle truth | preview body、metric或comparison view |
| `ReconciliationReport` | `SandboxReconciliationFindingAvailable` | committed reconciliation report | finding string、scope string或job report |

```rust
use core_contracts::metadata::Timestamp;

/// 区分 relay source 是同一 UoW 中待提交，还是已经由 repository 证明已提交。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
enum SandboxRelaySourceCommit {
    /// source 正在当前 accepted UoW 中 staged，尚未取得 committed cursor。
    Staged,
    /// source 已提交；cursor 必须来自 source repository 的同一 committed snapshot。
    Committed {
        /// 原始 source truth cursor；不得替换为 relay append cursor。
        source_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
    },
}

/// 在创建 relay draft 前证明 source identity、event kind和commit边界的transient carrier。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct SandboxRelaySourceBinding {
    /// 正式 outbound event 对应的唯一 source fact identity。
    original_source_fact_ref: SandboxSourceFactRef,
    /// 由 source fact 穷尽映射出的正式 event kind。
    event_kind: SandboxEventKind,
    /// source owner记录的业务发生时间。
    source_occurred_at: Timestamp,
    /// source mutation预生成或已提交的audit trace identity。
    source_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    /// staged / committed source边界。
    source_commit: SandboxRelaySourceCommit,
}

impl SandboxRelaySourceBinding {
    /// 为当前 accepted UoW 中的 staged source 构造 cursor-less binding。
    pub fn from_staged_source(
        original_source_fact_ref: SandboxSourceFactRef,
        event_kind: SandboxEventKind,
        source_occurred_at: Timestamp,
        source_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxEventRelayRecordError>;

    /// 从一次 committed source snapshot构造repair / delayed append binding。
    pub fn from_committed_source(
        original_source_fact_ref: SandboxSourceFactRef,
        event_kind: SandboxEventKind,
        source_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
        source_occurred_at: Timestamp,
        source_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxEventRelayRecordError>;

    /// 返回原始 source fact identity。
    pub fn original_source_fact_ref(&self) -> &SandboxSourceFactRef;

    /// 返回已验证的正式 event kind。
    pub fn event_kind(&self) -> SandboxEventKind;

    /// 返回source owner的业务发生时间。
    pub fn source_occurred_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;

    /// 返回source mutation的audit identity。
    pub fn source_audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;

    /// 返回已提交source cursor；staged binding返回`None`。
    pub fn committed_source_truth_cursor(&self) -> Option<SandboxTruthCursor>;
}
```

两个 factory 都必须先验证 `event_kind == original_source_fact_ref.event_kind()`，再验证
typed ref shape、非零 committed cursor、audit ref shape和source occurrence time。它们不读取
repository；`from_committed_source` 的调用方必须是 Step 7 source reader返回的同一 committed
snapshot，不能只传一个 bare ref 和任意 cursor。`SandboxRelaySourceCommit` 保持 private，避免
API / DTO / fake 直接构造 `Committed` 绕过 source repository。

#### 16.4.3 Stable payload identity 与 immutable encoded snapshot

`stable_payload_identity` 是一份已经完成 exact Step 8 mapping 的 payload身份，不是 relay ref、
request digest、source digest、event kind或route identity。current identity使用 core
`RequestPayloadFingerprint`承载canonical envelope + typed payload fingerprint，同时保留独立
`payload_ref`和`schema_version_ref`，防止相同bytes在不同schema或不同protocol identity下被
误判为同一 payload。

```rust
use core_contracts::metadata::{RequestPayloadFingerprint, ResourceRef, Timestamp};

/// 标识一份冻结 outbound payload 的稳定身份；不是repository row version。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct SandboxRelayPayloadIdentity {
    /// Step 8 protocol mapper预生成的payload identity。
    payload_ref: ResourceRef,
    /// schema registry / protocol version的opaque稳定引用。
    schema_version_ref: ResourceRef,
    /// canonical envelope + typed payload 的core fingerprint。
    payload_fingerprint: RequestPayloadFingerprint,
}

impl SandboxRelayPayloadIdentity {
    /// 从exact Step 8 protocol encoder输出构造稳定payload identity。
    pub fn try_from_protocol_encoder(
        payload_ref: ResourceRef,
        schema_version_ref: ResourceRef,
        payload_fingerprint: RequestPayloadFingerprint,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxRelayPayloadIdentityError>;

    /// 返回payload的opaque protocol identity。
    pub fn payload_ref(&self) -> &ResourceRef;

    /// 返回冻结的schema version identity。
    pub fn schema_version_ref(&self) -> &ResourceRef;

    /// 返回canonical fingerprint；不得用它推断event kind或route。
    pub fn payload_fingerprint(&self) -> &RequestPayloadFingerprint;
}

/// 保存canonical encoder输出的exact body-free bytes；不接受任意调用方bytes。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct SandboxRelayEncodedPayload {
    /// 完整 outbound envelope + typed payload 的冻结bytes。
    bytes: Vec<u8>,
}

impl SandboxRelayEncodedPayload {
    /// 仅从Step 8 canonical encoder输出构造，并核验fingerprint和forbidden-body结果。
    pub fn try_from_protocol_encoder(
        bytes: Vec<u8>,
        payload_identity: &SandboxRelayPayloadIdentity,
        forbidden_body_markers: &ForbiddenExternalBodyMarkerSet,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxRelayPayloadIdentityError>;

    /// 返回publisher必须原样发送的冻结bytes。
    pub fn as_bytes(&self) -> &[u8];
}

/// 与一个relay record一对一持久化的immutable outbound payload snapshot。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct SandboxRelayPayloadSnapshot {
    /// owning relay record identity；snapshot不另建可错配的repository主键。
    relay_record_ref: SandboxEventRelayRecordRef,
    /// 原始source fact identity。
    original_source_fact_ref: SandboxSourceFactRef,
    /// 原始source的committed truth cursor。
    original_source_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
    /// 与source一一对应的event kind。
    event_kind: SandboxEventKind,
    /// 稳定payload identity。
    payload_identity: SandboxRelayPayloadIdentity,
    /// canonical body-free encoded payload。
    encoded_payload: SandboxRelayEncodedPayload,
    /// source mutation的audit trace identity。
    source_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    /// outbound event的trace correlation identity。
    trace_context: SandboxTraceContext,
    /// Sandbox producer的opaque稳定identity；不等于publisher adapter ref。
    producer_ref: ResourceRef,
    /// event业务发生时间，必须复制source occurrence time。
    occurred_at: Timestamp,
    /// snapshot在同一accepted UoW中的保存时间。
    stored_at: Timestamp,
}

impl SandboxRelayPayloadSnapshot {
    /// 从Step 8 exact outbound mapper和finalized source cursor构造immutable snapshot。
    pub fn try_from_protocol_encoder(
        relay_record_ref: SandboxEventRelayRecordRef,
        source_binding: &SandboxRelaySourceBinding,
        original_source_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
        payload_identity: SandboxRelayPayloadIdentity,
        encoded_payload: SandboxRelayEncodedPayload,
        trace_context: SandboxTraceContext,
        producer_ref: ResourceRef,
        stored_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxEventRelayRecordError>;

    /// 重验source、cursor、schema、fingerprint和encoded bytes关系，不执行修复。
    pub fn verify_integrity(&self) -> Result<(), SandboxEventRelayRecordError>;

    /// 返回owning relay identity。
    pub fn relay_record_ref(&self) -> &SandboxEventRelayRecordRef;

    /// 返回原始source fact identity。
    pub fn original_source_fact_ref(&self) -> &SandboxSourceFactRef;

    /// 返回原始source truth cursor。
    pub fn original_source_truth_cursor(&self) -> SandboxTruthCursor;

    /// 返回formal outbound event kind。
    pub fn event_kind(&self) -> SandboxEventKind;

    /// 返回稳定payload identity。
    pub fn payload_identity(&self) -> &SandboxRelayPayloadIdentity;

    /// 返回必须原样发布的body-free encoded payload。
    pub fn encoded_payload(&self) -> &SandboxRelayEncodedPayload;

    /// 返回source audit identity。
    pub fn source_audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;

    /// 返回trace correlation identity。
    pub fn trace_context(&self) -> &SandboxTraceContext;

    /// 返回event业务发生时间。
    pub fn occurred_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;

    /// 返回snapshot保存时间。
    pub fn stored_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
}

/// payload identity / canonical encoding边界的稳定错误。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum SandboxRelayPayloadIdentityError {
    /// payload identity为空或不满足opaque ref shape。
    PayloadRefInvalid,
    /// schema version identity为空或不满足opaque ref shape。
    SchemaVersionRefInvalid,
    /// schema version不受current outbound protocol encoder支持。
    UnsupportedSchemaVersion,
    /// core payload fingerprint为空或不满足canonical encoding contract。
    PayloadFingerprintInvalid,
    /// canonical encoder输出为空。
    EmptyEncodedPayload,
    /// encoded bytes与payload fingerprint不一致。
    PayloadFingerprintMismatch,
    /// protocol mapper报告payload含有禁止正文或敏感字段。
    ForbiddenExternalBody,
}
```

`SandboxRelayEncodedPayload` 保存的是 Sandbox 自己生成的、经过Step 8 schema / redaction gate的
正式 outbound event bytes，不是外部 raw body。它不能提供 `from(Vec<u8>)`、`DerefMut`、
`bytes_mut`、`replace`或直接 `Deserialize`。`try_from_protocol_encoder` 必须使用同一 current
canonical encoder / verifier重算 `RequestPayloadFingerprint`；当前实现激活仍受
`BLK-SBX-CANONICAL-001`约束，设计文本不能把未选算法伪装成已验证实现。若fingerprint无法
验证，必须阻断relay append，而不是保存bytes后由publisher猜测。

payload snapshot 不保存topic、route、endpoint、credential、subscriber、HTTP / bus header、
provider message id或SDK response。它也不保存artifact / evidence / telemetry / investigation正文。
13类typed payload的字段schema仍由回归后的Step 8唯一拥有；本节只固定它们形成一份immutable
encoded snapshot后如何绑定relay record。

#### 16.4.4 Publisher / route binding 与 relay dedup key

publisher binding是validated config generation的body-free身份快照，不是transport配置正文。
一条relay record只有一个正式publication boundary；真实bus如何fan-out到多个subscriber不归
Sandbox。因而HLD `EventRelayTargetRefSet`失效，不提供alias，也不复用material
`HandoffTargetSet`。

```rust
/// 冻结一次relay append使用的publisher / route / runtime generation身份。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct SandboxRelayTargetBinding {
    /// 该route binding唯一服务的formal outbound event kind。
    bound_event_kind: SandboxEventKind,
    /// validated runtime config选择的event publisher adapter binding ref。
    publisher_binding_ref: ResourceRef,
    /// 13-key closed route map为当前event kind解析出的topic-neutral binding ref。
    route_binding_ref: ResourceRef,
    /// 本次runtime assembly的不可变generation ref。
    runtime_generation_ref: ResourceRef,
}

impl SandboxRelayTargetBinding {
    /// 从validated config / runtime builder输出构造opaque target binding。
    pub fn try_from_validated_config(
        bound_event_kind: SandboxEventKind,
        publisher_binding_ref: ResourceRef,
        route_binding_ref: ResourceRef,
        runtime_generation_ref: ResourceRef,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxRelayTargetBindingError>;

    /// 返回该route binding唯一服务的formal event kind。
    pub fn bound_event_kind(&self) -> SandboxEventKind;

    /// 返回publisher binding identity；不得将其解析为provider或credential。
    pub fn publisher_binding_ref(&self) -> &ResourceRef;

    /// 返回topic-neutral route binding identity；不得将其解析为topic字符串。
    pub fn route_binding_ref(&self) -> &ResourceRef;

    /// 返回runtime config generation identity。
    pub fn runtime_generation_ref(&self) -> &ResourceRef;
}

/// relay append的immutable唯一键；不包含status、attempt、Version或publisher outcome。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct SandboxRelayDedupKey {
    /// 原始source fact identity。
    original_source_fact_ref: SandboxSourceFactRef,
    /// 原始source committed truth cursor。
    original_source_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
    /// 与source一一对应的event kind。
    event_kind: SandboxEventKind,
    /// frozen payload的稳定identity。
    stable_payload_identity: SandboxRelayPayloadIdentity,
}

impl SandboxRelayDedupKey {
    /// 从finalized relay record字段构造exact repository uniqueness key。
    pub fn try_new(
        original_source_fact_ref: SandboxSourceFactRef,
        original_source_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
        event_kind: SandboxEventKind,
        stable_payload_identity: SandboxRelayPayloadIdentity,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxEventRelayRecordError>;

    /// 返回原始source identity。
    pub fn original_source_fact_ref(&self) -> &SandboxSourceFactRef;

    /// 返回原始source cursor。
    pub fn original_source_truth_cursor(&self) -> SandboxTruthCursor;

    /// 返回formal event kind。
    pub fn event_kind(&self) -> SandboxEventKind;

    /// 返回stable payload identity。
    pub fn stable_payload_identity(&self) -> &SandboxRelayPayloadIdentity;
}

/// validated relay target binding的shape错误。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum SandboxRelayTargetBindingError {
    /// publisher binding ref为空。
    PublisherBindingInvalid,
    /// route binding ref为空。
    RouteBindingInvalid,
    /// runtime generation ref为空。
    RuntimeGenerationInvalid,
}
```

唯一键严格保持 `§16.3` 已确认的四元组：

```text
(original_source_fact_ref,
 original_source_truth_cursor,
 event_kind,
 stable_payload_identity)
```

`bound_event_kind`只保存closed event discriminator，不保存topic或配置正文；draft prepare和
rehydration必须要求它等于record `event_kind`。`target_binding` 不进入唯一键，因为current设计只允许每个formal event kind在一个runtime
generation中有一个validated publication boundary；bus fan-out不产生多个Sandbox relay record。
同一key命中existing row时，repository只能返回typed existing / duplicate disposition或conflict，
不能生成第二个ref。publisher retry、trusted feedback、route availability变化和job rerun都更新
同一Version-guarded record；不得通过重新生成payload ref绕过去重。

`DeadLetter` record不可原地复活，也不得为同一key自动创建replacement record。只有新的
source fact / source cursor形成新的formal event时才会自然产生新key；manual recovery若未来确需
重放同一payload，必须先重开设计，定义独立recovery protocol和identity，不能由worker私改
payload identity。

#### 16.4.5 Publish attempt、retry eligibility 与 typed delivery observation

relay lifecycle 不增加 `Attempting` 状态。一次 publisher side effect 是否正在进行，由
`active_attempt` 技术事实表达；`Pending` 或 `Retryable` 仍是 record 的业务传播状态。这样既不
修改 shared `SandboxEventRelayStatus` 闭集，也能在进程中断后识别“已有 attempt、结果未知”，
避免 worker 仅凭 `Pending | Retryable` 再发一次。

```rust
use std::num::{NonZeroU32, NonZeroU64};
use sandbox_contracts::refs::SandboxRelayAttemptRef;

/// 一次已经持久化、可以交给 publisher 或 recovery inspect 的 immutable attempt。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct SandboxRelayAttempt {
    /// owning relay record identity。
    relay_record_ref: SandboxEventRelayRecordRef,
    /// 本次 attempt 的唯一 identity。
    attempt_ref: SandboxRelayAttemptRef,
    /// 本 record 内从 1 开始、checked increment 的 attempt ordinal。
    attempt_ordinal: NonZeroU32,
    /// 开始 attempt 时 record 的 canonical status，只允许 `Pending | Retryable`。
    started_from_status: SandboxEventRelayStatus,
    /// 本 attempt 必须原样发送的 payload identity。
    payload_identity: SandboxRelayPayloadIdentity,
    /// 本 attempt 使用的 immutable publisher / route / generation binding。
    target_binding: SandboxRelayTargetBinding,
    /// application clock 记录的 attempt start time。
    started_at: Timestamp,
}

impl SandboxRelayAttempt {
    /// 返回 owning relay identity。
    pub fn relay_record_ref(&self) -> &SandboxEventRelayRecordRef;

    /// 返回 exact attempt identity；publisher dedup / inspect 必须携带该值。
    pub fn attempt_ref(&self) -> &SandboxRelayAttemptRef;

    /// 返回 checked attempt ordinal。
    pub fn attempt_ordinal(&self) -> NonZeroU32;

    /// 返回开始 attempt 前的 canonical relay status。
    pub fn started_from_status(&self) -> SandboxEventRelayStatus;

    /// 返回 immutable payload identity。
    pub fn payload_identity(&self) -> &SandboxRelayPayloadIdentity;

    /// 返回 immutable target binding。
    pub fn target_binding(&self) -> &SandboxRelayTargetBinding;

    /// 返回 attempt start time。
    pub fn started_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
}

/// validated configuration 映射出的 relay retry policy identity snapshot。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct SandboxRelayRetryPolicySnapshot {
    /// retry policy 的 opaque stable identity；不保存配置正文。
    retry_policy_ref: ResourceRef,
    /// policy 所属 runtime generation，必须等于 target binding generation。
    runtime_generation_ref: ResourceRef,
    /// 包含首次发送在内的最大 attempt 数，必须大于零。
    max_attempts: NonZeroU32,
}

impl SandboxRelayRetryPolicySnapshot {
    /// 从 validated config 输出构造 body-free retry policy snapshot。
    pub fn try_from_validated_config(
        retry_policy_ref: ResourceRef,
        runtime_generation_ref: ResourceRef,
        max_attempts: NonZeroU32,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxEventRelayRecordError>;

    /// 返回 retry policy identity。
    pub fn retry_policy_ref(&self) -> &ResourceRef;

    /// 返回 owning runtime generation identity。
    pub fn runtime_generation_ref(&self) -> &ResourceRef;

    /// 返回包含首次发送的最大 attempt 数。
    pub fn max_attempts(&self) -> NonZeroU32;
}

/// 在一个 exact record snapshot 上计算出的有限 attempt / retry disposition。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum SandboxRelayRetryDisposition {
    /// `Pending` 且从未开始 publisher attempt，可以开始首次发送。
    InitialAttemptAllowed,
    /// `Retryable`、未耗尽 attempt 且已达到 not-before age。
    RetryAllowed,
    /// `Retryable` 但尚未达到 not-before age；不得开始 attempt。
    RetryNotReady,
    /// 已达到 policy 的最大 attempt 数；只能转入 `DeadLetter`。
    RetryExhausted,
}

/// 绑定 record status、attempt count、latest outcome 与 policy generation 的瞬时决定。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct SandboxRelayRetryDecision {
    /// decision 唯一适用的 relay identity。
    relay_record_ref: SandboxEventRelayRecordRef,
    /// 计算 decision 时的 canonical status。
    evaluated_status: SandboxEventRelayStatus,
    /// 计算 decision 时已持久化的 attempt count。
    evaluated_attempt_count: u32,
    /// retry path 的 latest completed attempt；initial path 为 `None`。
    latest_attempt_ref: Option<SandboxRelayAttemptRef>,
    /// validated retry policy identity。
    retry_policy_ref: ResourceRef,
    /// 必须与 record target binding 相等的 runtime generation。
    runtime_generation_ref: ResourceRef,
    /// policy 最大 attempt 数。
    max_attempts: NonZeroU32,
    /// latest retryable outcome 要求的最小 age；initial path 为 `None`。
    required_retry_age_millis: Option<NonZeroU64>,
    /// application clock 对 latest attempt 计算的 checked age；initial path 为 `None`。
    checked_retry_age_millis: Option<u64>,
    /// 形成decision的application canonical time。
    evaluated_at: Timestamp,
    /// finite eligibility result。
    disposition: SandboxRelayRetryDisposition,
}

impl SandboxRelayRetryDecision {
    /// 返回 decision 唯一适用的 relay identity。
    pub fn relay_record_ref(&self) -> &SandboxEventRelayRecordRef;

    /// 返回 finite disposition；caller 不得仅凭该 enum 绕过其余 snapshot 字段。
    pub fn disposition(&self) -> SandboxRelayRetryDisposition;

    /// 返回 policy 最大 attempt 数。
    pub fn max_attempts(&self) -> NonZeroU32;

    /// 返回 retry not-before age；initial path 为 `None`。
    pub fn required_retry_age_millis(&self) -> Option<NonZeroU64>;

    /// 返回已检查的 retry age；initial path 为 `None`。
    pub fn checked_retry_age_millis(&self) -> Option<u64>;

    /// 返回decision evaluation time；attempt start不得早于该时间。
    pub fn evaluated_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
}
```

`SandboxRelayRetryDecision` 没有 public constructor。它只能由
`SandboxEventRelayRecord::evaluate_attempt_eligibility(...)` 产生，并在
`begin_publish_attempt(...)` 或 `dead_letter_retry_exhausted(...)` 内重新逐字段比较。
因此 application 不能构造一个 bare `RetryAllowed` bool，也不能把旧 decision 用到已经由并发
worker 更新过的 record。`Version` compare-and-set 仍由 Step 7 repository 保证，decision
comparison 不能替代 repository version。

publisher 或 trusted feedback 必须先在 infra / worker boundary 将 provider 结果映射为下面的
finite body-free carrier。domain 不接收 HTTP status、SDK error、header、response body、topic、
endpoint、provider message 或错误字符串。

```rust
/// Sandbox adapter 为可验证 publication acknowledgement 生成的 body-free receipt summary。

pub struct SandboxRelayReceiptSummary {
    /// adapter-normalized opaque receipt identity；不是 provider response body 或 evidence alias。

}

        receipt_ref: ResourceRef,
        acknowledged_payload_identity: SandboxRelayPayloadIdentity,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxEventRelayRecordError>;

    /// 返回 adapter-normalized receipt identity。

    /// 返回 publisher 明确确认的 payload identity。

}

/// 可以自动重试的 publisher failure 分类；retryability 由 variant 固定，不由 reason 推导。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum SandboxRelayRetryableFailureKind {
    /// publisher binding 暂时不可用。

    /// publisher 明确返回限流 / backpressure。
    PublisherBackpressure,
    /// exact attempt inspect明确证明publisher未接收publication，因此可安全另开attempt。
    PublicationConfirmedAbsent,
    /// validated route 当前暂不可用，但 generation 未失效。
    RouteTemporarilyUnavailable,
    /// transport在side effect前明确拒绝，且typed outcome证明publisher未接收publication。
    TransportRejectedBeforeAcceptance,
}

/// 一次 retryable publisher outcome 的 caller-safe failure summary。

/// publisher 明确判定为不可自动恢复的 terminal publication kind。

pub enum SandboxRelayPublisherDeadLetterKind {

/// dead-letter 的唯一形成依据；publisher terminal 与 retry exhaustion 不得混写。

/// 无法安全归入 publisher outcome 的 record / attempt 完整性故障类别。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum SandboxRelayIntegrityFailureKind {
    /// 已持久化 attempt 的 side-effect outcome 无法由bounded inspect / feedback安全确认。

    /// publisher adapter不支持对该exact attempt执行required inspect，且side effect不能证明absent。
    AttemptInspectionUnsupported,
    /// 多个可信inspect observation对同一active attempt给出互相冲突的finite outcome。
    AttemptInspectionConflict,
    /// publisher返回的结果无法由current typed outcome mapper安全归入finite closed enum。
    PublisherOutcomeUnclassifiable,
    /// matching trusted feedback与仍active的publisher observation互相冲突，无法选择winner。
    TrustedFeedbackConflict,

/// publisher adapter / trusted feedback 可交给 domain 的完整 outcome 闭集。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum SandboxRelayDeliveryOutcome {
    /// publisher 已确认接收 exact frozen payload；不表示 subscriber 已处理。

```

`SandboxRelayIntegrityFailureSummary::try_for_record` 的机械校验固定为：

1. record status只能为`Pending | Retryable`，且必须同时存在`latest_attempt`与
   `active_attempt_ref`；二者的attempt ref必须相等。
2. `affected_attempt_ref`必须等于current active / latest attempt ref；latest attempt的record、
   ordinal、payload与target必须仍等于record当前字段，且target的bound event kind等于record
   event kind。
3. `detected_at >= latest_attempt.started_at`且`detected_at >= status_changed_at`；时间倒退不能由
   repository timestamp修正。
4. reason必须满足shared safe-reason contract；五个failure kind全部使用同一必填attempt基数，
   不存在attempt-less、record-only或corrupt-pair variant。

constructor只形成尚未应用的body-free summary，不修改record。`record_integrity_failure`必须在
同一loaded record snapshot上再次执行上述relation检查，再由repository以Version CAS提交；旧
summary不能应用到后来产生的新active attempt。

`SandboxRelayDeliveryObservation::try_from_typed_outcome` 的校验顺序固定为：

1. observation 的 record、attempt、attempt ordinal、attempt start time、payload identity 和
   target binding全部复制自同一个`SandboxRelayAttempt`，不接受 caller 分别传入多组bare ref；
   target binding继续携带attempt从record复制的同一bound event kind。
2. `observed_at >= attempt.started_at`；时间不合法不能由 repository timestamp 修正。
3. `Published.receipt.acknowledged_payload_identity == attempt.payload_identity`；receipt ref
   必须非空，且不能等于 relay、attempt、payload、route 或 publisher binding ref。
4. `Retryable` 必须同时携带 finite retryable failure 和非零 not-before age；reason 不能改变
   `failure_kind`，也不能把它重分类为 terminal。
5. `DeadLetter` 只能携带 `SandboxRelayDeadLetterBasis::PublisherTerminal`；
   `RetryExhausted` 必须由 record 的 retry decision path形成，不能伪装成 publisher outcome。
6. source kind 只说明可信入口；它不改变 transition、retryability或receipt语义。

normal typed publisher outcome 只可能形成 `Published / Retryable / DeadLetter`。shared enum 中的
`Failed` 专门承接 `SandboxRelayIntegrityFailureSummary` 已显式分类的完整性故障；不得把 adapter
返回的未知字符串、timeout文本、任意 5xx 或 mapper异常直接塞进 `Failed`，也不得先写 `Failed`
再由 worker猜测是否迁移到 `Retryable`。

attempt / outcome 字段关系固定为：

| record 状态 / 阶段 | `attempt_count` | `latest_attempt` | `active_attempt_ref` | `latest_delivery_observation` | receipt / retry failure / dead-letter / integrity |
|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| initial `Pending` | `0` | `None` | `None` | `None` | 全部无 |
| in-flight `Pending` | `1` | `Some(ordinal=1, started_from=Pending)` | `Some == latest attempt ref` | `None` | 全部无 |
| resting `Retryable` | `>0` | `Some(ordinal=count)` | `None` | latest outcome=`Retryable`且attempt相等 | failure + non-zero retry age，其他无 |
| in-flight `Retryable` | `>1` | `Some(ordinal=count, started_from=Retryable)` | `Some == latest attempt ref` | 保留前一attempt的`Retryable` observation | 前一条 failure / retry age仍可读，但不得开始另一个并发attempt |
| terminal `Published` | `>0` | `Some(ordinal=count)` | `None` | latest outcome=`Published`且attempt相等 | exact receipt，其他无 |
| terminal publisher `DeadLetter` | `>0` | `Some(ordinal=count)` | `None` | latest outcome=`DeadLetter(PublisherTerminal)`且attempt相等 | exact dead-letter，其他无 |
| exhausted `DeadLetter` | `>0` | `Some(ordinal=count)` | `None` | latest outcome仍为同一attempt的`Retryable` | 独立`RetryExhausted` summary；不得伪造publisher observation |
| integrity `Failed` | `>0` | `Some(ordinal=count)` | `None` | 保留更早一条已验证observation或无 | 独立integrity summary必须引用刚关闭的latest attempt；active ref清空 |

一个 persisted `active_attempt_ref` 存在时，任何 worker 都不得开始新 attempt。恢复路径必须按
`(relay_record_ref, attempt_ref, payload_identity, target_binding)` 调用 Step 7 publisher inspect
或等待 matching trusted feedback：observed published/retryable/dead-letter时复用同一 attempt；
observed absent 仍只能按后续 flow 明确规则处理同一 attempt；unknown且无法安全分类时进入
`Failed` integrity path。timeout 本身不等于 observed absent，也不授权盲目重发。

#### 16.4.6 Cursor-less draft、finalized record 与 append pair

relay 创建使用与 source truth 相同的两阶段 cursor contract。`SandboxEventRelayDraft` 只存在于
active UoW，不实现 `Serialize` / `Deserialize`，也不能交给 publisher。它必须已经包含 exact
Step 8 encoder 输出、validated target binding 与同 generation retry policy，但在 source cursor
分配前不允许构造 durable `SandboxEventRelayRecord` 或 payload snapshot。

```rust
/// source cursor 尚未确定时，在 accepted UoW 内准备的一次 relay append。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct SandboxEventRelayDraft {
    /// application typed id generator预生成的relay identity。
    relay_record_ref: SandboxEventRelayRecordRef,
    /// staged或committed source的完整transient binding。
    source_binding: SandboxRelaySourceBinding,
    /// Step 8 encoder输出的stable payload identity。
    payload_identity: SandboxRelayPayloadIdentity,
    /// 与identity逐bytes验证过的immutable encoded payload。
    encoded_payload: SandboxRelayEncodedPayload,
    /// validated publisher / route / runtime generation binding。
    target_binding: SandboxRelayTargetBinding,
    /// 与target generation相同的validated retry policy snapshot。
    retry_policy_snapshot: SandboxRelayRetryPolicySnapshot,
    /// outbound correlation identity。
    trace_context: SandboxTraceContext,
    /// Sandbox producer的opaque stable identity。
    producer_ref: ResourceRef,
    /// relay row与payload snapshot在accepted UoW中的canonical creation time。
    recorded_at: Timestamp,
}

impl SandboxEventRelayDraft {
    /// 从完整source binding、exact protocol encoder输出与validated runtime binding准备draft。
    pub fn prepare(
        relay_record_ref: SandboxEventRelayRecordRef,
        source_binding: SandboxRelaySourceBinding,
        payload_identity: SandboxRelayPayloadIdentity,
        encoded_payload: SandboxRelayEncodedPayload,
        target_binding: SandboxRelayTargetBinding,
        retry_policy_snapshot: SandboxRelayRetryPolicySnapshot,
        trace_context: SandboxTraceContext,
        producer_ref: ResourceRef,
        recorded_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxEventRelayRecordError>;

    /// 为同一accepted UoW中的staged source注入刚分配的truth cursor并形成append pair。
    pub fn finalize_staged_source(
        self,
        source_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
    ) -> Result<SandboxRelayAppendPair, SandboxEventRelayRecordError>;

    /// 为repository已证明committed的source复制binding中的原truth cursor并形成append pair。
    pub fn finalize_committed_source(
        self,
    ) -> Result<SandboxRelayAppendPair, SandboxEventRelayRecordError>;

    /// 返回预生成relay identity；不得据此执行publisher side effect。
    pub fn relay_record_ref(&self) -> &SandboxEventRelayRecordRef;

    /// 返回source binding；只用于当前UoW relation检查。
    pub fn source_binding(&self) -> &SandboxRelaySourceBinding;
}
```

`prepare` 固定执行以下检查：relay ref、producer ref与trace context shape合法；
`source_binding.event_kind() == source_binding.original_source_fact_ref().event_kind()`，且
`target_binding.bound_event_kind() == source_binding.event_kind()`；encoded bytes与payload
fingerprint通过同一canonical verifier；`recorded_at >= source_occurred_at`；
`target_binding.runtime_generation_ref() == retry_policy_snapshot.runtime_generation_ref()`；
payload / route / publisher / runtime generation / retry policy / producer identity之间不得发生角色
碰撞。`prepare` 不读取 repository、不分配 truth cursor、不做unique lookup、不调用publisher。

`finalize_staged_source` 只接受 `Staged` binding和当前UoW新分配的非零 cursor；
`finalize_committed_source` 只接受 `Committed` binding并复制其中cursor。二者都调用同一个private
`finalize_with_cursor`，同时形成record、payload snapshot和dedup key。staged source不得调用
committed入口，committed source也不得再由caller传一个新cursor。

```rust
/// Sandbox-owned outbound event publication lifecycle record。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq, Serialize)]
pub struct SandboxEventRelayRecord {
    /// relay record的唯一Sandbox-local identity。
    relay_record_ref: SandboxEventRelayRecordRef,
    /// 被传播的13类closed source fact之一。
    original_source_fact_ref: SandboxSourceFactRef,
    /// source fact已提交的truth cursor；不是relay append cursor。
    original_source_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
    /// source mutation对应的canonical audit trace identity。
    source_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    /// 从source fact穷尽映射的formal outbound event kind。
    event_kind: SandboxEventKind,
    /// immutable payload snapshot的stable identity。
    payload_identity: SandboxRelayPayloadIdentity,
    /// immutable publisher / route / runtime generation binding。
    target_binding: SandboxRelayTargetBinding,
    /// 创建record时冻结的validated retry policy identity与上限。
    retry_policy_snapshot: SandboxRelayRetryPolicySnapshot,
    /// outbound event correlation identity。
    trace_context: SandboxTraceContext,
    /// current publication lifecycle status。
    relay_status: SandboxEventRelayStatus,
    /// 已持久化attempt总数；只在`begin_publish_attempt`中checked increment。
    attempt_count: u32,
    /// 最近一次已持久化attempt；count为零时必须为空。
    latest_attempt: Option<SandboxRelayAttempt>,
    /// 若最近attempt仍可能有side effect in-flight，保存与latest attempt相同的ref。
    active_attempt_ref: Option<SandboxRelayAttemptRef>,
    /// 最近一次已验证typed observation；开始retry attempt时保留前一observation。
    latest_delivery_observation: Option<SandboxRelayDeliveryObservation>,
    /// retry exhaustion形成的dead-letter；publisher terminal path必须为空。
    retry_exhaustion_dead_letter: Option<SandboxRelayDeadLetterSummary>,
    /// `Failed`状态唯一允许的完整性故障摘要。
    integrity_failure_summary: Option<SandboxRelayIntegrityFailureSummary>,
    /// record与payload snapshot在accepted UoW中的canonical creation time。
    recorded_at: Timestamp,
    /// 最近一次relay status变化时间；attempt开始不改变本字段。
    status_changed_at: Timestamp,
}

impl<'de> Deserialize<'de> for SandboxEventRelayRecord {
    fn deserialize<D>(_deserializer: D) -> Result<Self, D::Error>
    where
        D: serde::Deserializer<'de>,
    {
        // A relay row alone cannot prove its immutable payload/source pair.
        Err(serde::de::Error::custom(
            "sandbox event relay requires paired rehydration",
        ))
    }
}

impl SandboxEventRelayRecord {
    /// 从完整persistence bundle重建record；不存在row-only rehydration入口。
    pub fn rehydrate(
        input: SandboxRelayRehydrationInput,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxEventRelayRecordError>;

    /// 在当前immutable record snapshot上计算首次attempt / retry eligibility。
    pub fn evaluate_attempt_eligibility(
        &self,
        checked_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<SandboxRelayRetryDecision, SandboxEventRelayRecordError>;

    /// 消费同一record snapshot产生的allowed decision，先持久化一个new active attempt。
    pub fn begin_publish_attempt(
        &mut self,
        decision: &SandboxRelayRetryDecision,
        attempt_ref: SandboxRelayAttemptRef,
        started_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<SandboxRelayAttempt, SandboxEventRelayRecordError>;

    /// 消费matching active attempt的typed observation并进入Published / Retryable / DeadLetter。
    pub fn apply_delivery_observation(
        &mut self,
        observation: SandboxRelayDeliveryObservation,
    ) -> Result<SandboxRelayObservationDisposition, SandboxEventRelayRecordError>;

    /// 消费exact exhausted decision，将latest retryable failure终结为DeadLetter。
    pub fn dead_letter_retry_exhausted(
        &mut self,
        decision: &SandboxRelayRetryDecision,
        dead_letter: SandboxRelayDeadLetterSummary,
        changed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), SandboxEventRelayRecordError>;

    /// 对仍可验证的Pending / Retryable record记录完整性故障并fail closed到Failed。
    pub fn record_integrity_failure(
        &mut self,
        failure: SandboxRelayIntegrityFailureSummary,
    ) -> Result<(), SandboxEventRelayRecordError>;

    /// 返回relay record identity。
    pub fn relay_record_ref(&self) -> &SandboxEventRelayRecordRef;

    /// 返回original source fact identity。
    pub fn original_source_fact_ref(&self) -> &SandboxSourceFactRef;

    /// 返回original source committed truth cursor。
    pub fn original_source_truth_cursor(&self) -> SandboxTruthCursor;

    /// 返回source mutation的audit trace identity。
    pub fn source_audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;

    /// 返回formal outbound event kind。
    pub fn event_kind(&self) -> SandboxEventKind;

    /// 返回immutable payload identity。
    pub fn payload_identity(&self) -> &SandboxRelayPayloadIdentity;

    /// 返回immutable target binding。
    pub fn target_binding(&self) -> &SandboxRelayTargetBinding;

    /// 返回validated retry policy snapshot。
    pub fn retry_policy_snapshot(&self) -> &SandboxRelayRetryPolicySnapshot;

    /// 返回trace correlation identity。
    pub fn trace_context(&self) -> &SandboxTraceContext;

    /// 返回canonical relay status。
    pub fn relay_status(&self) -> SandboxEventRelayStatus;

    /// 返回已持久化attempt count。
    pub fn attempt_count(&self) -> u32;

    /// 返回latest attempt；从未开始attempt时为空。
    pub fn latest_attempt(&self) -> Option<&SandboxRelayAttempt>;

    /// 返回当前in-flight attempt ref；无in-flight side effect时为空。
    pub fn active_attempt_ref(&self) -> Option<&SandboxRelayAttemptRef>;

    /// 返回latest verified typed delivery observation。
    pub fn latest_delivery_observation(
        &self,
    ) -> Option<&SandboxRelayDeliveryObservation>;

    /// 返回Published receipt；只有latest outcome为Published时存在。
    pub fn receipt_summary(&self) -> Option<&SandboxRelayReceiptSummary>;

    /// 返回latest retryable failure；只从typed Retryable outcome提取。
    pub fn retryable_failure_summary(&self) -> Option<&SandboxRelayFailureSummary>;

    /// 返回terminal dead-letter summary；publisher terminal与exhaustion二选一。
    pub fn dead_letter_summary(&self) -> Option<&SandboxRelayDeadLetterSummary>;

    /// 返回Failed integrity summary；其他status必须为空。
    pub fn integrity_failure_summary(
        &self,
    ) -> Option<&SandboxRelayIntegrityFailureSummary>;

    /// 返回record creation time。
    pub fn recorded_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;

    /// 返回latest status transition time。
    pub fn status_changed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;

    /// 按immutable source / event / payload字段构造repository唯一键。
    pub fn dedup_key(&self) -> Result<SandboxRelayDedupKey, SandboxEventRelayRecordError>;

    /// 判断当前record是否为Published / Failed / DeadLetter终态。
    pub fn is_terminal(&self) -> bool;

    /// 判断当前是否有必须先inspect / feedback closure的active attempt。
    pub fn has_active_attempt(&self) -> bool;
}
```

`evaluate_attempt_eligibility` 的closed算法如下：

1. `active_attempt_ref.is_some()` 返回 `PublishAttemptAlreadyActive`，不产生decision。
2. `Pending` 只允许 `attempt_count == 0`、没有latest attempt / observation / failure；产生
   `InitialAttemptAllowed`。
3. `Retryable` 要求latest attempt与latest `Retryable` observation的record、attempt、payload、
   target完全相等；先比较`attempt_count`与frozen `max_attempts`。达到上限产生
   `RetryExhausted`，不再比较not-before。
4. 尚未耗尽时，以latest attempt `started_at`和`checked_at`使用checked canonical duration计算
   age；早于start或duration overflow返回`RetryClockRelationInvalid`。age达到
   `retry_not_before_age_millis`产生`RetryAllowed`，否则产生`RetryNotReady`。
5. `Published | Failed | DeadLetter` 全部返回 `PublishAttemptNotAllowed`；没有“terminal recovery”
   decision。

`begin_publish_attempt` 只接受 `InitialAttemptAllowed | RetryAllowed`，并重新比较decision中的
record ref、status、count、latest attempt、policy ref / max、runtime generation、required age和
checked age。`RetryNotReady | RetryExhausted` 均拒绝。通过后用`checked_add(1)`形成ordinal，
验证`started_at >= decision.evaluated_at()`、`started_at >= recorded_at`且retry path不早于latest
attempt start；new attempt复制record的payload identity和target binding，并重新要求
`target_binding.bound_event_kind() == record.event_kind`，随后保存new latest attempt与matching active
ref。record status和`status_changed_at`保持不变。repository必须先compare-and-set持久化这个active
attempt，再调用publisher；不允许side effect成功后才补写attempt。

`apply_delivery_observation` 要求record当前为`Pending | Retryable`，且observation的record ref、
attempt ref、payload identity、target binding与`active_attempt_ref` / `latest_attempt`逐项相等；
`observed_at >= latest_attempt.started_at`且不早于既有status time。通过后清空active ref，并按
finite outcome执行唯一映射：

| current status | typed outcome | target status | exact field effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Pending` | `Published(receipt)` | `Published` | 保存latest observation；receipt从observation读取；其他terminal summary为空。 |
| `Pending` | `Retryable(failure, age)` | `Retryable` | 保存latest observation、finite failure和non-zero age；无receipt / dead-letter / integrity。 |
| `Pending` | `DeadLetter(PublisherTerminal)` | `DeadLetter` | 保存latest observation；dead-letter从observation读取；exhaustion / integrity为空。 |
| `Retryable` | `Published(receipt)` | `Published` | 用current attempt observation替换旧retryable observation；不保留旧failure作为当前状态。 |
| `Retryable` | `Retryable(failure, age)` | `Retryable` | 用current attempt observation替换旧observation；status可同值迁移但time必须推进。 |
| `Retryable` | `DeadLetter(PublisherTerminal)` | `DeadLetter` | 用current attempt terminal observation替换旧retryable observation。 |

应用成功返回`Applied`。若record已经没有active attempt，但incoming observation与
`latest_delivery_observation`的全部持久化字段完全相等，且record status与该outcome的canonical
relation一致，则返回`DuplicateAlreadyApplied`，不更新时间、不写新audit / report、不再次ack
feedback。该duplicate分支允许current status为`Published | Retryable | DeadLetter`；direct
publisher outcome要求status与outcome同态，exhausted `DeadLetter`则只接受其已保存的latest
`Retryable` observation exact duplicate。相同attempt ref但source kind、observed time、outcome、
receipt、failure、retry age或dead-letter basis任一不同，返回
`DeliveryObservationConflict`；不得选择“更成功”或“更晚”的结果。`Failed`没有successful
delivery observation terminal，因此任何late observation均拒绝并进入operator reconciliation，
不能复活record。

`dead_letter_retry_exhausted` 只接受`Retryable`、无active attempt、exact
`RetryExhausted` decision、latest typed retryable observation与
`SandboxRelayDeadLetterBasis::RetryExhausted`逐字段相等的组合。它不创建伪publisher
observation，而是保留latest retryable observation并写入唯一exhaustion summary。

`record_integrity_failure` 只允许`Pending | Retryable -> Failed`。summary 的affected attempt是
必填typed ref，并且必须等于当前active attempt；current五种kind都不允许attempt-less summary。
成功后清空active ref、保留last verified observation、写入唯一integrity summary，
并以`detected_at`更新status time。它不接收raw error，也不允许从
`Published | Failed | DeadLetter`覆盖既有终态。

persisted record / payload pair、dedup key、source binding、fingerprint或immutable target binding
自身不一致时，record不可安全构造，必须由rehydration返回typed integrity error并进入migration /
quarantine / operator handoff；不得把corrupt row先rehydrate再调用`record_integrity_failure`。

```rust
/// 一个relay record与其immutable payload snapshot的唯一可追加组合。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct SandboxRelayAppendPair {
    /// initialized Pending lifecycle record。
    record: SandboxEventRelayRecord,
    /// 与record一对一、必须同事务保存的immutable encoded payload snapshot。
    payload_snapshot: SandboxRelayPayloadSnapshot,
    /// 从二者共同字段形成的repository uniqueness key。
    dedup_key: SandboxRelayDedupKey,
}

impl SandboxRelayAppendPair {
    /// 重验record / snapshot / key全部identity与时间关系；不读取repository。
    pub fn verify_integrity(&self) -> Result<(), SandboxEventRelayRecordError>;

    /// 返回initialized relay record。
    pub fn record(&self) -> &SandboxEventRelayRecord;

    /// 返回immutable payload snapshot。
    pub fn payload_snapshot(&self) -> &SandboxRelayPayloadSnapshot;

    /// 返回exact repository uniqueness key。
    pub fn dedup_key(&self) -> &SandboxRelayDedupKey;
}
```

append pair只由draft finalize生成，没有public `try_new(record, snapshot)`、`From`、
`into_record`或`into_snapshot`。Step 7 repository append port必须消费完整pair，在同一事务内：
先按dedup key检查single winner，再保存record row和payload snapshot，最后提交；任一失败二者均
不可见。publisher只能在该事务提交且active attempt另一次compare-and-set提交后读取snapshot。
relay append pair不包含`Relay` audit：如需要记录append linkage，只能在pair已提交后按§16.3的
committed relay source path追加一次，且该audit不再生成relay。

#### 16.4.7 Relay status、迁移矩阵与副作用边界

`SandboxEventRelayStatus` 的 current graph 固定为：

```text
draft finalize -> Pending

Pending   -> Published | Retryable | DeadLetter
Pending   -> Failed                       [integrity-only]

Retryable -> Published | Retryable | DeadLetter
Retryable -> Failed                       [integrity-only]

Published | Failed | DeadLetter -> terminal
```

`begin_publish_attempt` 不改变canonical status，因而不画成`Pending -> Pending`或
`Retryable -> Retryable`迁移；它只保存active attempt技术事实。矩阵中的
`Retryable -> Retryable`只表示一个新attempt获得新的typed retryable observation并替换旧的
current retry summary，必须有attempt ordinal严格增加，不是无side-effect status touch。

| From | To | 唯一object method / basis | exact precondition | record field effect | 外部owner副作用 | 非法时error |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| draft | `Pending` | `finalize_staged_source` / `finalize_committed_source` | source cursor committed；source/event/payload/target/policy relation全部闭合 | `attempt_count=0`；attempt / observation / summary全空；`recorded_at == status_changed_at` | 与payload snapshot原子append；不调用publisher | `SourceCommitBoundaryMismatch`;`RelayAppendPairMismatch` |
| `Pending` | `Published` | `apply_delivery_observation(Published)` | matching active first attempt；receipt确认exact payload | 清active；保存Published observation；status/time推进 | publish job / feedback report可记录Published；source不变 | `DeliveryObservationMismatch`;`RelayTransitionNotAllowed` |
| `Pending` | `Retryable` | `apply_delivery_observation(Retryable)` | matching active first attempt；finite retry kind + non-zero age | 清active；保存retryable observation；status/time推进 | retry scheduler只能读取not-before；source不变 | `DeliveryOutcomeRelationInvalid`;`RelayTransitionNotAllowed` |
| `Pending` | `DeadLetter` | `apply_delivery_observation(DeadLetter PublisherTerminal)` | matching active first attempt；terminal basis来自typed publisher | 清active；保存terminal observation；status/time推进 | report / operator surface；不得replacement | `DeadLetterBasisMismatch`;`RelayTransitionNotAllowed` |
| `Pending` | `Failed` | `record_integrity_failure` | matching active attempt；bounded inspect / feedback无法安全分类 | 清active；保存integrity summary；status/time推进 | internal diagnostic / operator handoff；source不变 | `IntegrityFailureRelationInvalid`;`RelayTransitionNotAllowed` |
| `Retryable` | `Published` | `apply_delivery_observation(Published)` | allowed retry已开始；matching current active attempt | 替换latest observation；清active；清current retry/dead-letter/integrity view | report Published；source不变 | 同上 |
| `Retryable` | `Retryable` | `apply_delivery_observation(Retryable)` | new attempt ordinal严格增加；matching current active attempt | 替换latest observation与current retry summary；清active；status time推进 | 重新按new not-before调度；source不变 | 同上 |
| `Retryable` | `DeadLetter` | `apply_delivery_observation(DeadLetter PublisherTerminal)` | matching current active attempt与publisher terminal basis | 保存terminal observation；清active；status/time推进 | report / operator surface；source不变 | 同上 |
| `Retryable` | `DeadLetter` | `dead_letter_retry_exhausted` | no active attempt；exact exhausted decision与latest retry failure一致 | 保留latest retryable observation；保存exhaustion summary；status/time推进 | 不再自动调度；source不变 | `RetryDecisionMismatch`;`DeadLetterBasisMismatch` |
| `Retryable` | `Failed` | `record_integrity_failure` | matching current active attempt且outcome无法安全分类 | 清active；保留last verified observation；保存integrity summary | internal diagnostic / operator handoff；source不变 | 同上 |

terminal 定义固定如下：

| status | terminal | current meaning | 明确不表示 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Pending` | 否 | 首次attempt尚未完成；可能尚未开始或exact attempt仍active | source未提交、run仍执行或subscriber pending |
| `Retryable` | 否 | latest typed attempt失败且policy尚可能允许新attempt；active retry attempt也保持此status | 必然会重试、route已恢复或source可回滚 |
| `Published` | 是 | publisher确认接收exact frozen payload | bus所有fan-out成功、subscriber消费、tools/runtime/member业务完成 |
| `Failed` | 是 | exact active attempt无法被finite outcome安全分类，record fail closed | 普通publisher retryable / terminal失败，或source业务失败 |
| `DeadLetter` | 是 | publisher明确terminal或validated retry policy耗尽 | 可原地恢复、可自动replacement或source失效 |

以下迁移和副作用全部禁止：

| forbidden path | 原因 | current disposition |
|---|---|---|
| `Retryable -> Pending` | retry开始由active attempt表达，不应丢失latest failure / not-before事实 | 调用`begin_publish_attempt`，status保持`Retryable`；旧transition historical invalid |
| `Failed -> Retryable` | `Failed`是完整性终态，无法靠后来解析错误字符串恢复可信lifecycle | operator handoff / migration；不得自动transition |
| 任一terminal -> 任一非terminal | 同一record终态不可重开 | `RelayTerminalStateReopenForbidden` |
| `Pending -> Published`且无active attempt | 无法证明publisher处理的是哪个payload / binding / attempt | `NoActivePublishAttempt` |
| publisher generic failure -> `Failed` | normal publisher outcome必须在adapter边界映射为Retryable或DeadLetter | adapter mapping失败本身走active attempt integrity classification，不解析字符串 |
| `Retryable -> DeadLetter`且只比较count | 必须绑定frozen policy、latest failure和exact decision | `RetryDecisionMismatch` |
| retry / feedback修改payload、route、source或cursor | 四者在record append时immutable | `RelayImmutableFieldMutationForbidden` |
| relay transition回滚 / 升级source fact | propagation lifecycle不拥有source truth | source、audit、stored result、projection均保持原committed值 |
| relay transition创建新outbound relay | 会递归传播relay自身 | 不创建event；可按§16.3追加一次body-free Relay audit |

每个 transition 的持久化都必须由 Step 7 repository 使用调用前`Version`执行single-row
compare-and-set；version conflict时丢弃本地mutation、reload canonical row并重新判断，不能重放
旧decision或旧observation到latest row。`Version`不进入domain object，也不进入dedup key、payload
或public DTO。transition commit失败不改变source truth，也不能把publisher side effect当作record
已提交；若side effect已经发生但transition commit unknown，必须用exact attempt inspect / matching
feedback恢复，禁止创建新attempt。

#### 16.4.8 Persistence wire、paired rehydration 与 snapshot integrity

relay persistence 必须同时返回 lifecycle row、immutable payload row、exact committed source
binding与repository从唯一索引读取的dedup key。四者缺一时不能构造domain record。wire carrier
只服务infra codec，字段保持private；它们不实现到domain object的`From / Into`，public DTO也
不能转换为任一wire carrier。

```rust
/// infra persistence codec读取relay lifecycle row使用的field carrier。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq, Serialize)]
pub struct SandboxRelayPersistenceRow {

    event_kind: SandboxEventKind,
    payload_identity: SandboxRelayPayloadIdentity,
    target_binding: SandboxRelayTargetBinding,
    retry_policy_snapshot: SandboxRelayRetryPolicySnapshot,
    trace_context: SandboxTraceContext,
    relay_status: SandboxEventRelayStatus,
    attempt_count: u32,
    latest_attempt: Option<SandboxRelayAttempt>,
    active_attempt_ref: Option<SandboxRelayAttemptRef>,
    latest_delivery_observation: Option<SandboxRelayDeliveryObservation>,
    retry_exhaustion_dead_letter: Option<SandboxRelayDeadLetterSummary>,
    integrity_failure_summary: Option<SandboxRelayIntegrityFailureSummary>,
    recorded_at: Timestamp,
    status_changed_at: Timestamp,
}

impl SandboxRelayPersistenceRow {
    /// 由persistence codec构造并执行field-shape / local status relation校验。
    /// source commit、payload bytes与dedup index relation留给paired bundle。
    pub fn try_new(
        relay_record_ref: SandboxEventRelayRecordRef,
        original_source_fact_ref: SandboxSourceFactRef,
        original_source_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
        source_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,

        relay_status: SandboxEventRelayStatus,

        latest_attempt: Option<SandboxRelayAttempt>,
        active_attempt_ref: Option<SandboxRelayAttemptRef>,
        latest_delivery_observation: Option<SandboxRelayDeliveryObservation>,
        retry_exhaustion_dead_letter: Option<SandboxRelayDeadLetterSummary>,
        integrity_failure_summary: Option<SandboxRelayIntegrityFailureSummary>,

/// repository一次committed read返回的完整relay persistence group。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct SandboxRelayPersistenceBundle {
    /// lifecycle persistence row。
    record_row: SandboxRelayPersistenceRow,
    /// exact one-to-one immutable payload row。
    payload_row: SandboxRelayPayloadPersistenceRow,
    /// 由同一source reader重建的committed source binding。
    source_binding: SandboxRelaySourceBinding,
    /// unique index实际返回并与row重算值比较的dedup key。
    stored_dedup_key: SandboxRelayDedupKey,
}

impl SandboxRelayPersistenceBundle {
    /// 绑定同一committed group；不得接受多次latest read拼接的fields。
    pub fn try_new(
        record_row: SandboxRelayPersistenceRow,
        payload_row: SandboxRelayPayloadPersistenceRow,
        source_binding: SandboxRelaySourceBinding,
        stored_dedup_key: SandboxRelayDedupKey,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxEventRelayRecordError>;

    /// 转换为domain rehydration input；不存在record-row-only fallback。
    pub fn into_rehydration_input(
        self,
    ) -> Result<SandboxRelayRehydrationInput, SandboxEventRelayRecordError>;
}

/// 已通过persistence-group校验、可交给domain rehydrate的唯一输入。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct SandboxRelayRehydrationInput {
    record_row: SandboxRelayPersistenceRow,
    payload_snapshot: SandboxRelayPayloadSnapshot,
    committed_source_binding: SandboxRelaySourceBinding,
    verified_dedup_key: SandboxRelayDedupKey,
}

impl SandboxRelayRehydrationInput {
    /// 只由`SandboxRelayPersistenceBundle`在完成pair validation后构造。
    fn try_from_bundle(
        bundle: SandboxRelayPersistenceBundle,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxEventRelayRecordError>;

    /// 返回lifecycle row，只供`SandboxEventRelayRecord::rehydrate`消费。
    fn record_row(&self) -> &SandboxRelayPersistenceRow;

    /// 返回已完成fingerprint / source pair校验的payload snapshot。
    pub fn payload_snapshot(&self) -> &SandboxRelayPayloadSnapshot;

    /// 返回同一committed source reader构造的binding。
    fn committed_source_binding(&self) -> &SandboxRelaySourceBinding;

    /// 返回已与row重算值相等的dedup key。
    fn verified_dedup_key(&self) -> &SandboxRelayDedupKey;
}
```

`SandboxRelayPersistenceRow` / `SandboxRelayPayloadPersistenceRow` 的实际 `Deserialize`
必须先进入module-private `*Wire`辅助struct，再调用各自`try_new`；不能derive后直写private field。
反序列化错误只返回固定安全文本，不回显ref、payload bytes、reason、route或provider信息。

`SandboxRelayPersistenceBundle::try_new` 与
`SandboxEventRelayRecord::rehydrate` 合并后的校验顺序固定如下；任一步失败都拒绝整个record，
不得丢字段、修status或从latest truth重建payload：

1. 验证record row、payload row、source binding和stored key中的
   `relay_record_ref / original_source_fact_ref / original_source_truth_cursor / event_kind /
   payload_identity`逐项相等；source binding必须为`Committed`且cursor非零。
2. 验证`event_kind == original_source_fact_ref.event_kind()`，record / payload的
   `source_audit_trace_ref`相等，并与source binding中的audit ref相等；不得从audit kind反推event。
3. 从payload row通过`SandboxRelayPayloadSnapshot::try_from_protocol_encoder`重建snapshot，要求
   source occurrence time、stored time、trace context、producer ref合法，并重新计算canonical
   encoded bytes fingerprint。`BLK-SBX-CANONICAL-001`开放时实现Activation仍被阻断；不能跳过
   verifier使设计看似通过。
4. 用record immutable fields重算`SandboxRelayDedupKey`并与stored key逐字段相等；唯一索引若
   指向另一record ref，repository返回identity conflict，不由domain选择winner。
5. 验证`target_binding.bound_event_kind == record.event_kind`，再验证target binding三ref、retry
   policy三字段与runtime generation relation；event kind与完整target binding必须等于每个
   persisted attempt / observation中复制的字段，不允许route kind或generation漂移。
6. 验证`recorded_at == payload_snapshot.stored_at`且
   `recorded_at >= source_binding.source_occurred_at()`；`status_changed_at >= recorded_at`。
7. 按下一张closed matrix验证status、attempt、observation、summary关系；attempt count使用ordinal
   直接证明，不扫描history，也不从timestamp推导次数。
8. 只有通过以上全部检查后，才构造private-field domain record；`rehydrate`不执行repository
   read、publisher call、retry、feedback ack、migration、audit append或source mutation。

rehydration status matrix：

| status / phase | required relation | forbidden relation |
|---|---|---|
| initial `Pending` | `count=0`;latest / active / observation / all summary均None | 任意attempt或summary存在 |
| in-flight `Pending` | `count=1`;latest ordinal=1且started-from Pending；active ref等于latest；无observation / summary | active缺失、attempt不为first、任意outcome存在 |
| resting `Retryable` | `count>0`;latest ordinal=count；无active；observation attempt / ordinal / start等于latest且outcome Retryable | receipt / dead-letter / integrity；retry age缺失 |
| in-flight `Retryable` | `count>1`;latest ordinal=count且started-from Retryable；active等于latest；observation ordinal=`count-1`且outcome Retryable | observation指向current active attempt、count不连续 |
| `Published` | `count>0`;latest ordinal=count；无active；matching Published observation + exact receipt | retry exhaustion / integrity / retry outcome |
| publisher `DeadLetter` | `count>0`;latest ordinal=count；无active；matching PublisherTerminal observation | exhaustion summary同时存在、generic reason代替basis |
| exhausted `DeadLetter` | `count>0`;latest ordinal=count；无active；matching Retryable observation + exact RetryExhausted summary | 伪造DeadLetter observation、policy/count/failure不一致 |
| `Failed` | `count>0`;latest ordinal=count；无active；integrity summary的必填affected attempt引用latest attempt；latest verified observation若有，其ordinal小于count | publisher outcome被保存为Failed、attempt ref缺失或不相等、retry/dead-letter summary存在 |

record 不保存完整attempt history；`latest_attempt + count + latest observation + integrity summary`
已足以执行current retry / recovery和校验ordinal连续性。若审计或运维需要历史每次attempt，Step 11
可以设计独立append-only technical history表，但它不能成为rehydration依赖、domain truth、public
receipt或event source，也不能改变本节状态。当前Step 6不新增该对象或repository。

repository保存与读取的固定关系为：

```text
create:
  finalized SandboxRelayAppendPair
    -> verify pair
    -> insert unique dedup key + lifecycle row + payload row in one transaction
    -> commit all or expose none

transition:
  load complete bundle + Version
    -> rehydrate canonical record
    -> domain method
    -> compare-and-set lifecycle row only
    -> payload row / dedup key remain immutable

publish:
  load complete bundle
    -> begin attempt + compare-and-set commit
    -> read exact immutable payload snapshot
    -> publisher side effect with exact attempt
    -> typed observation + compare-and-set commit
```

payload row和dedup key不存在update / delete-on-failure接口。record retention / archival与storage
vacuum留给Step 11 / operations policy，不能由`Published / Failed / DeadLetter` transition自动删除；
否则audit、feedback dedup和reconciliation无法证明原始publication identity。

#### 16.4.9 Object-owned error、typed outcome 与 public mapping

`SandboxRelayPayloadIdentityError` 和 `SandboxRelayTargetBindingError` 只拥有各自value object的
local shape错误；它们必须在draft / rehydration boundary穷尽映射到
`SandboxEventRelayRecordError`。record error不包装raw adapter、repository、codec或provider
error，也不携带payload bytes、topic、endpoint、credential、SDK response、SQL、path、secret、
stack trace或任意external body。

```rust
/// SandboxEventRelayRecord 自有的source、attempt、transition与paired persistence错误。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum SandboxEventRelayRecordError {
    /// relay record ref为空、与其他角色identity碰撞或不满足typed ref contract。
    RelayIdentityInvalid,
    /// source fact不在current 13项closed source union中。
    UnsupportedRelaySourceFact,
    /// caller提供的event kind不等于source fact的穷尽映射结果。
    SourceEventKindMismatch {
        /// caller / row携带的actual event kind。
        actual: SandboxEventKind,
        /// source fact唯一要求的event kind。
        expected: SandboxEventKind,
    },
    /// staged / committed source binding使用了错误的finalize入口。
    SourceCommitBoundaryMismatch,
    /// committed source cursor为零、与binding / row不一致或并非source truth cursor。
    SourceTruthCursorRelationInvalid,
    /// source audit ref缺失或record / payload / source binding三方不一致。
    SourceAuditTraceRelationInvalid,
    /// source occurrence、recorded、attempt、observation或status time关系不成立。
    RelayTimestampRelationInvalid,
    /// trace context为空、字段关系不合法或与payload row不一致。
    TraceContextInvalid,
    /// producer ref为空或与relay / payload / publisher等其他角色identity碰撞。
    ProducerIdentityInvalid,
    /// payload identity value object构造或relation校验失败。
    PayloadIdentityInvalid,
    /// encoded payload为空、含禁止正文或未通过canonical fingerprint验证。
    EncodedPayloadInvalid,
    /// protocol encoder或persistence row携带禁止进入relay的external body / secret字段。
    ForbiddenExternalBody,
    /// payload schema version不受current exact outbound encoder支持。
    UnsupportedPayloadSchemaVersion,
    /// record与immutable payload snapshot的source、event、identity、trace或time不一致。
    PayloadSnapshotRelationInvalid,
    /// current canonical verifier未配置或无法执行；不得跳过fingerprint验证。
    CanonicalPayloadVerificationUnavailable,
    /// validated publisher / route / runtime generation binding shape不合法。
    TargetBindingInvalid,
    /// target binding声明的event kind不等于source / record的formal event kind。
    TargetEventKindMismatch {
        /// target binding实际声明的event kind。
        actual: SandboxEventKind,
        /// source / record唯一要求的event kind。
        expected: SandboxEventKind,
    },
    /// retry policy identity、max attempts或runtime generation relation不合法。
    RetryPolicyRelationInvalid,
    /// 不同语义角色复用了同一opaque resource identity。
    RelayIdentityRoleCollision,
    /// dedup key字段与source / event / payload identity不一致。
    RelayDedupKeyMismatch,
    /// unique index中的相同key已指向另一relay identity。
    RelayDedupIdentityConflict,
    /// draft finalize形成的record、payload snapshot与dedup key不是同一append pair。
    RelayAppendPairMismatch,
    /// attempt ref为空、与record内既有attempt重复或与其他角色identity碰撞。
    RelayAttemptIdentityInvalid,
    /// attempt count无法checked increment或无法转换为non-zero ordinal。
    RelayAttemptCountOverflow,
    /// record已有必须先通过inspect / feedback关闭的active attempt。
    PublishAttemptAlreadyActive {
        /// 当前active attempt identity。
        attempt_ref: SandboxRelayAttemptRef,
    },
    /// current status或field relation不允许开始首次attempt / retry。
    PublishAttemptNotAllowed {
        /// 当前canonical relay status。
        status: SandboxEventRelayStatus,
    },
    /// supplied retry decision并非由当前record snapshot产生，或已因并发更新失效。
    RetryDecisionMismatch,
    /// retry checked time早于attempt start、duration overflow或not-before relation不成立。
    RetryClockRelationInvalid,
    /// mutation要求matching active attempt，但当前record不存在active attempt。
    NoActivePublishAttempt,
    /// observation的record、attempt、ordinal、payload、target或time与active attempt不一致。
    DeliveryObservationMismatch,
    /// 同一attempt已经提交了另一份不完全相同的typed observation。
    DeliveryObservationConflict,
    /// typed outcome的receipt、failure、retry age或terminal basis组合不合法。
    DeliveryOutcomeRelationInvalid,
    /// Published receipt未确认exact payload或receipt identity角色不合法。
    RelayReceiptRelationInvalid,
    /// dead-letter summary的publisher terminal / retry exhaustion basis不符合调用路径。
    DeadLetterBasisMismatch,
    /// integrity summary的kind、affected attempt或detected time与active record不一致。
    IntegrityFailureRelationInvalid,
    /// requested status transition不在本节closed graph中。
    RelayTransitionNotAllowed {
        /// relay record identity。
        relay_record_ref: SandboxEventRelayRecordRef,
        /// transition前status。
        from: SandboxEventRelayStatus,
        /// caller请求的目标status。
        to: SandboxEventRelayStatus,
    },
    /// caller尝试从Published / Failed / DeadLetter重开同一record。
    RelayTerminalStateReopenForbidden {
        /// terminal relay status。
        status: SandboxEventRelayStatus,
    },
    /// caller或mapper尝试修改source、cursor、event、payload、target或policy immutable field。
    RelayImmutableFieldMutationForbidden,
    /// persistence lifecycle row的local status / attempt / summary matrix不成立。
    PersistedRelayStatusRelationInvalid {
        /// row携带的canonical status。
        status: SandboxEventRelayStatus,
    },
    /// lifecycle row、payload row、source binding和stored key并非同一committed group。
    RelayPersistenceBundleMismatch,
    /// persistence bundle通过局部shape后仍无法形成完整domain rehydration input。
    RelayRehydrationInputMismatch,
    /// persisted row使用historical schema、旧status名或已失效target / kind布局。
    HistoricalRelaySchemaUnsupported,
    /// record-only、payload-only或public DTO到domain object的快捷构造被请求。
    PairedRehydrationRequired,
}
```

局部error映射固定如下；不得用`map_err(|_| Internal)`吞掉variant：

| local error | exact record error | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `SandboxRelayPayloadIdentityError::PayloadRefInvalid / SchemaVersionRefInvalid / PayloadFingerprintInvalid` | `PayloadIdentityInvalid` | 只承接identity shape错误。 |
| `UnsupportedSchemaVersion` | `UnsupportedPayloadSchemaVersion` | 保留稳定分类，Step 8映射`UnsupportedVersion`。 |
| `EmptyEncodedPayload / PayloadFingerprintMismatch` | `EncodedPayloadInvalid` | append / rehydrate均fail closed；不让publisher重建。 |
| `ForbiddenExternalBody` | `ForbiddenExternalBody` | public必须映射同名category，不能退化为普通Validation。 |
| `SandboxRelayTargetBindingError::*` | `TargetBindingInvalid` | 不回显具体binding ref。 |
| target binding与source / record event kind不相等 | `TargetEventKindMismatch` | 保存actual / expected finite enum，不保存route正文。 |
| shared typed-ref / trace / reason `ContractError` | 对应`RelayIdentityInvalid / TraceContextInvalid / *RelationInvalid` | mapper按构造位置穷尽，不能保留generic wrapper。 |

`SandboxRelayDeliveryOutcome::Retryable`、`Published`和`DeadLetter`不是error。只要observation
relation合法，`apply_delivery_observation`就成功提交对应status；application / jobs通过result
surface报告finite disposition。以下情况才返回object error：observation与active attempt不匹配、
outcome carrier关系不合法、terminal重开、retry decision过期或persistence pair损坏。这样不会把
“publisher明确拒绝”误当成Sandbox domain method异常，也不会把“method返回Ok”解释成发布成功。

Step 8 public mapper必须逐variant穷尽，候选稳定映射如下：

| record error family | `SandboxPublicErrorKind` | retryable / caller action |
|---|---|---|
| public输入可触发的typed ref、event kind、receipt / outcome relation invalid | `Validation` | 否；producer / trusted feedback contract需修复。 |
| source尚未committed、source group缺失 | `ReferenceUnresolved` | 当前调用否；由source append / repair flow按正式规则恢复。 |
| forbidden external body | `ForbiddenExternalBody` | 否；不得删字段后继续发布。 |
| schema version在protocol registry不受支持 | `UnsupportedVersion` | 否；回到Step 8 / producer升级，不创建relay。 |
| validated publisher / route adapter当前不可用 | `AdapterUnavailable` | 只由application / infra error映射；domain record error不伪造该事实。 |
| validated publisher / route binding被配置禁用 | `Disabled` | 只由application / infra mapping决定；不能创建弱fallback target。 |
| stale `Version`、single-winner compare-and-set失败 | `VersionConflict` | reload完整bundle；不得重放旧decision / observation。 |
| dedup key命中同一record | 不是public error | repository返回typed existing / duplicate disposition，复用canonical record。 |
| dedup key指向不同record、pair / rehydration / immutable relation损坏、attempt overflow | `Internal` | 否；quarantine / migration / operator handoff，不自动repair。 |
| terminal reopen、immutable mutation、row-only rehydrate请求 | `NoWriteViolation` 或 `Internal` | 实现缺陷；禁止执行mutation。 |
| historical relay schema | `Validation`（migration surface）或`Internal`（current store invariant） | 不自动转换；进入显式migration / revalidation。 |

retryability不能由public kind单独推导。尤其`AdapterUnavailable`不表示domain record一定已经是
`Retryable`；只有publisher port形成finite `SandboxRelayDeliveryOutcome::Retryable`并绑定exact
active attempt后，domain才可推进status。public reason只能使用固定template或carrier中已有
`SandboxReason`，不能调用raw cause的`Display`。

#### 16.4.10 Historical conflict ledger 与 negative cuts

本节覆盖HLD D10、原Step 6~14和正式historical `03`中的relay候选。旧材料只保留consumer
定位价值，不再拥有type、field、method、status或flow定义权；不得通过alias、serde alias、
deprecated method或compatibility wrapper保留第二条实现路径。

| historical name / pattern | current replacement | disposition / migration rule |
|---|---|---|
| `SandboxEventRelayKind` | shared `SandboxEventKind` 13项闭集 | historical invalid；source fact穷尽映射，不提供alias。 |
| `EventRelayTargetRefSet` / `target_refs` | 一个`SandboxRelayTargetBinding` | historical invalid；bus后续fan-out不归Sandbox，不把material target set复用于relay。 |
| `EventRelayStatus` | `SandboxEventRelayStatus` | historical invalid name；不提供type alias或wire alias。 |
| relay `Delivered` | `Published` | historical invalid variant；避免与material handoff receipt混用。 |
| `open(source_ref, target_set, relay_kind)` | `SandboxEventRelayDraft::prepare -> finalize_* -> SandboxRelayAppendPair` | 缺source cursor、payload snapshot、target generation、retry policy和pair atomicity；禁止兼容。 |
| `mark_published(receipt)`裸调用 | `begin_publish_attempt -> typed observation -> apply_delivery_observation` | receipt必须绑定exact active attempt / payload / target，不能直接改status。 |
| `mark_failed(String)` / generic `RelayFailureSummary` | finite retryable failure、publisher terminal dead-letter或integrity summary | error字符串不能决定retryability；不提供generic failure入口。 |
| domain-local `SandboxRelayAttemptRef`或DTO裸`ResourceRef` | contracts-owned `SandboxRelayAttemptRef` | historical / draft owner冲突已消除；禁止同名wrapper、alias或跨attempt类型转换。 |
| `is_retryable()`只看status | `evaluate_attempt_eligibility(checked_at)`返回完整decision | 必须同时检查active attempt、frozen policy、count、latest failure和not-before age。 |
| `Retryable -> Pending` | `begin_publish_attempt`保持`Retryable`并保存active attempt | historical invalid transition；不得清除latest failure / retry age。 |
| `Failed -> Retryable` | `Failed`为integrity terminal | historical invalid transition；只能显式migration / operator handoff，不能自动恢复。 |
| `Pending / Retryable -> Failed`承接普通publisher failure | normal outcome只进入`Published / Retryable / DeadLetter` | `Failed`只承接matching active attempt无法安全分类的integrity failure。 |
| `DeadLetter -> Pending`或同key replacement record | terminal same-record + no automatic replacement | historical invalid；只有新source cursor自然形成新key；manual replay需重开设计。 |
| target binding / runtime generation进入dedup key | source ref + source cursor + event kind + stable payload identity | target变化不能制造同一formal event的第二row；同keysingle winner。 |
| 每次retry生成new payload ref / bytes | immutable payload snapshot | retry必须原样发送已提交bytes；不得从latest truth、projection或source body重建。 |
| publisher先发、成功后补attempt | attempt compare-and-set commit后才允许side effect | commit unknown按exact attempt inspect / trusted feedback恢复，禁止盲发。 |
| raw topic / endpoint / credential / headers / provider message id | opaque publisher / route / generation refs + body-free receipt | forbidden persisted body；不得隐藏在safe reason或generic metadata。 |
| raw SDK response / HTTP status / error text解析retryability | typed publisher outcome mapper | domain只接收finite outcome；unknown进入bounded inspect，无法分类时fail closed。 |
| record row直接`Deserialize`为domain object | paired persistence bundle + rehydration input | row无法自证source / payload / key；不存在row-only fallback。 |
| corrupt pair读取时转`Failed` | reject rehydration + migration / quarantine | `Failed`只用于仍可验证record上的active-attempt integrity failure。 |
| audit row内`RelayPending / RelayFailed` | independent relay lifecycle | historical audit status无效；publisher feedback不修改source audit。 |
| mutable audit + relay combined row | `SandboxAuditTrace` + `SandboxEventRelayRecord` | linkage和publication lifecycle分离；各自append / mutation规则独立。 |
| relay status变化再创建relay event | no recursive relay | relay append后可有一次`Relay` audit，但其`requires_event_relay()`固定false。 |

negative capability cuts固定如下：

| capability / owner | relay可做什么 | relay绝对不能做什么 |
|---|---|---|
| source truth | 保存typed source identity与原committed cursor | 创建、修改、回滚、升级或supersede context / boundary / policy / run / capture / failure / cleanup / redline truth |
| tools | 传播`SandboxSourceFactRef`映射后的event | 解释tool语义、调度tool、判断tool result或补执行output |
| runtime | 保存run / capture等source ref与event payload snapshot | 运行agent loop、launch / terminate runtime、解析runtime body或拥有runtime lifecycle |
| member service | 传播已成立Sandbox fact | 创建member、推进member lifecycle、做membership / responsibility orchestration |
| artifact / evidence | payload可含正式Step 8允许的body-free typed ref | 捕获artifact body、生成evidence alias、宣称retention / acceptance成立 |
| observability | 暴露trace identity、attempt/status与safe diagnostic hook | 保存telemetry body、span baggage、日志正文或替代observability store |
| cleanup / lease / reaper | relay terminal状态可被只读report / guard source消费 | 释放environment、刷新lease、判断orphan、执行cleanup或解除redline containment |
| bus / subscriber | 调用一个opaque publication boundary并记录publisher ack | 拥有topic / subscription / fan-out / subscriber处理状态或推断所有consumer成功 |
| retry / recovery | 在同record、同payload、exact attempt与frozen policy下重试 | 改payload / route / source；原地复活terminal；同key自动建replacement；timeout即盲重发 |
| read / reconciliation | 作为projection ref与status observation输入 | query触发publish、reconciliation自动repair、view写status或从missing row补`Pending` |

本节没有定义publisher repository / port函数、job调度算法、DTO wire schema、retry duration配置值、
topic map、adapter产品选择或SQL layout。它只给这些下游owner提供不可缺失的exact object carrier、
method、state、error和atomicity输入；下游不得以“尚未进入Step 7/8/9”为理由补造第二套domain
schema。

#### 16.4.11 Static closure 与 downstream revalidation

本节closure只表示设计文本的类型、字段、状态、关系和负向边界已静态闭合；不表示代码存在、
编译通过、publisher可用、runtime测试执行、event已发布、evidence已形成或验收通过。

| closure item | exact rule | current result |
|---|---|---|
| canonical named owner | `SandboxEventRelayRecord`唯一位于`crates/domain/src/event_relay.rs`；named ref复用contracts | `1/1 closed` |
| support family #38 | source binding / draft、payload identity / bytes / snapshot、target / dedup、attempt / retry、observation / receipt / failure / dead-letter / integrity、persistence / error均有owner；attempt ref唯一在contracts | `1/1 family closed` |
| source / event mapping | 13个`SandboxSourceFactRef`逐项映射13个`SandboxEventKind`；无default / topic parser | `13/13 closed` |
| event kind owner | 复用shared current enum；`SandboxEventRelayKind` declaration为0 | `1 owner / 0 alias` |
| target cardinality | 每record一个opaquepublication boundary；target set / subscriber set为0 | `closed` |
| payload identity | `ResourceRef + schema_version_ref + RequestPayloadFingerprint`；bytes immutable并重验fingerprint | `closed`;`BLK-SBX-CANONICAL-001 open` |
| dedup key | source ref + source cursor + event kind + stable payload identity；target/status/attempt/version均排除 | `4/4 fields closed` |
| creation path | staged source与committed source两个explicit finalize入口；均只产完整append pair | `2/2 closed` |
| initial state | durable record固定`Pending`且count=0；payload row与dedup key同事务可见 | `closed` |
| attempt lifecycle | persisted active attempt before side effect；ordinal checked；commit unknown按exact attempt恢复 | `closed` |
| normal publisher outcome | `Published / Retryable / DeadLetter`三项finite outcome；无generic Failed outcome | `3/3 closed` |
| integrity outcome | `Failed`只由五类active-attempt integrity failure形成；五类summary均要求必填matching attempt ref；corrupt pair拒绝rehydrate | `5/5 closed` |
| status graph | `Pending -> Published/Retryable/Failed/DeadLetter`;`Retryable -> Published/Retryable/Failed/DeadLetter`;三终态 | `5/5 status closed` |
| forbidden transitions | `Retryable -> Pending`、`Failed -> Retryable`、terminal reopen、same-key replacement均显式禁止 | `closed` |
| retry eligibility | status、active attempt、count、frozen policy、generation、latest failure、not-before age全部绑定decision；attempt start不得早于decision evaluation | `closed` |
| event-kind binding | source、record、payload、target binding、attempt与observation中的event relation逐边界重验exact equality | `closed` |
| observation idempotency | exact全部持久化字段且canonical status/outcome relation一致才返回`DuplicateAlreadyApplied`并保持零mutation；exhausted `DeadLetter`只接受已保存`Retryable` observation的exact duplicate；同attempt任一字段不同返回`DeliveryObservationConflict` | `closed` |
| paired persistence | lifecycle row + payload row + committed source binding + stored dedup key一次性读取 | `4/4 group members closed` |
| rehydration | source/event/audit/payload/fingerprint/key/target/policy/time/status/attempt/summary逐项重验 | `closed` |
| object error | local value error显式映射；record relation / transition / persistence错误闭集；无raw cause wrapper | `closed` |
| public mapping | 只映射shared 16项`SandboxPublicErrorKind`；retryable不由public kind推导 | `closed_for_step_6` |
| no rollback / recursion | publisher结果不改source / source audit / stored result / projection；relay不再产生relay | `closed` |
| forbidden body | raw request/output、topic、endpoint、credential、header、SDK response、provider id、artifact/evidence/telemetry/investigation正文均拒绝 | `closed` |
| Rustdoc | 本节新增public type、variant、private field语义、factory、transition、getter均有中文Rustdoc或紧邻exact contract | `pass_for_static_design_audit` |
| implementation facts | compile / test / run / event / evidence / acceptance / commit均未生成 | `0 fabricated facts` |
