### H16.5 `FailureControlStatusView` 未闭合草案（historical_material）

> 本节是 `§16.5` 对象讨论过程中形成、但尚未通过对象级门禁的草案，现因以下冲突整体失效：
> `environment_identity_ref` 错误地设为必填；failure / control 使用两个无界 `Vec`；
> `Incomplete` 可由 caller reason 自选；正常分页 continuation 与 source degradation 混同；
> control kind / lineage 与 `failure_ref` 状态矩阵不完整；`source_audit_trace_ref` 容易被误解为
> “查询动作审计”。本节全部声明不得实现、不得被 Step 7~17 消费，也不计入 current closure。
> 唯一 current contract 从后续正式 `### 16.5` 标题开始。

`FailureControlStatusView` 是 `GetFailureControlStatus` 与 read projection 可消费的
contracts-owned、body-free、immutable read model。它从同一个 committed context scope 中的
failure classifications 与 control facts 装配可追溯状态，不重新分类 failure、不选择 control
winner、不执行 control effect，也不把查询结果写回 domain truth。

本节关闭 named type #23，并开始关闭 support family #39 中的 failure/control 部分。canonical
owner固定为`crates/contracts/src/views.rs`；所有字段类型只依赖`core-contracts`和
`crates/contracts/src/refs.rs`的named refs、shared finite enum、cursor、reason与metadata。
`crates/domain/src/failure.rs`和`control.rs`不声明同名view、item或source snapshot，application
mapper只能复制已加载 committed truth，不能把domain object直接放进public DTO。

#### H16.5.1 Capability、source cardinality 与边界裁决

| 项 | exact contract |
|---|---|
| capability | 按一个exact `ControlledExecutionContextRef`展示零至多条failure与零至多条control committed facts。 |
| identity | 每个已物化view有唯一`FailureControlStatusViewRef`；view ref不能转换为context、failure或control ref。 |
| source scope | 所有item必须属于同一context；environment identity、optional run / boundary / handle / generation relation必须兼容。 |
| failure cardinality | 允许零至多条；不得假设每个context只有一个failure，也不得按timestamp静默选择latest。 |
| control cardinality | 允许零至多条；accepted、duplicate、conflict、completed、failed和terminal override形成的事实都必须保留。 |
| empty semantics | 只有reader证明该committed scope的failure/control覆盖完整且两个set都为空时，才是合法empty view。 |
| degraded semantics | row coverage、projection linkage或read dependency安全不完整时，保留已验证item并显式标记incomplete与非空degraded reasons。 |
| integrity boundary | wrong context、duplicate ref、status-field矛盾、cursor/audit/time倒退或cross-link错配是typed error，不能降级掩盖。 |
| excluded source | lease、orphan、cleanup、redline、relay和observability status不进入本view；分别由§16.6、§16.7及其他owner展示。 |
| no-write | view没有classify、supersede、attach failure、submit control、complete effect、cleanup、repair或refresh方法。 |

历史`latest_control_status`被判定为不充分：同一context可以同时保留duplicate receipt fact、conflict
fact、accepted safety control与terminal control，按“最新”压成一个status会丢失正式事实并引入
timestamp winner。历史`lease_status`也从本view删除；它与failure/control没有一对一归属，而且
会与`CleanupReadinessView`职责重叠。

#### H16.5.2 Shared execution lineage

failure与control的read item复用一个contracts-only lineage carrier。它表达已提交owner refs之间的
显式关系，不从ref文本、status、view selector或repository key反推缺失成员。

```text historical-invalid-rust
/// failure/control read item共享的body-free execution lineage。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct FailureControlViewLineage {
    /// owning controlled execution context identity。
    context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
    /// owning execution environment identity。
    environment_identity_ref: ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef,
    /// optional controlled run；存在时必须带完整boundary group。
    run_ref: Option<ControlledExecutionRunRef>,
    /// optional coherent boundary；与handle/generation成组出现。
    boundary_ref: Option<CoherentBoundaryRef>,
    /// optional isolation environment handle；与boundary/generation成组出现。
    handle_ref: Option<IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef>,
    /// optional immutable backend/runtime generation；与boundary/handle成组出现。
    generation_ref: Option<ResourceRef>,
}

impl FailureControlViewLineage {
    /// 构造context + identity-only的pre-launch lineage。
    pub fn for_context(
        context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
        environment_identity_ref: ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef,
    ) -> Result<Self, FailureControlStatusViewError>;

    /// 构造没有run、但已经绑定boundary/handle/generation的lineage。
    pub fn for_boundary(
        context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
        environment_identity_ref: ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef,
        boundary_ref: CoherentBoundaryRef,
        handle_ref: IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef,
        generation_ref: ResourceRef,
    ) -> Result<Self, FailureControlStatusViewError>;

    /// 构造完整run + boundary/handle/generation lineage。
    pub fn for_run(
        context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
        environment_identity_ref: ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef,
        run_ref: ControlledExecutionRunRef,
        boundary_ref: CoherentBoundaryRef,
        handle_ref: IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef,
        generation_ref: ResourceRef,
    ) -> Result<Self, FailureControlStatusViewError>;

    /// 返回owning context identity。
    pub fn context_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionContextRef;
    /// 返回owning environment identity。
    pub fn environment_identity_ref(&self) -> &ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef;
    /// 返回optional run identity。
    pub fn run_ref(&self) -> Option<&ControlledExecutionRunRef>;
    /// 返回optional boundary identity。
    pub fn boundary_ref(&self) -> Option<&CoherentBoundaryRef>;
    /// 返回optional handle identity。
    pub fn handle_ref(&self) -> Option<&IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef>;
    /// 返回optional generation identity。
    pub fn generation_ref(&self) -> Option<&ResourceRef>;

    /// 判断两个lineage是否属于同一context/environment且optional execution group兼容。
    pub fn is_compatible_with(&self, other: &Self) -> bool;
}
```

`for_context`固定使四个optional字段全空；`for_boundary`固定run为空且boundary/handle/generation全有；
`for_run`固定五类execution refs完整。不存在接收六个独立`Option`的public constructor。
`is_compatible_with`要求context与environment identity相等；双方同一optional字段均存在时必须相等，
一方缺少run而另一方有run只在pre-launch/boundary-level fact与同context run-level fact并列时兼容；
一方有boundary group而另一方完全没有时，只允许无group一方是context-only lineage。它不按timestamp、
failure kind、control kind或reason判定兼容，也不能证明任一truth当前active。

#### H16.5.3 Failure status item 与 ordered set

```text historical-invalid-rust

impl FailureControlFailureItem {

        lineage: FailureControlViewLineage,

        failure_status: FailureClassificationStatus,
        status_reason: Option<SandboxReason>,

    /// 返回optional caller-safe status reason。

    /// 返回optional superseding control identity。

    /// 返回optional superseding redline identity。

    /// 返回latest transition audit identity。
    pub fn last_audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;
    /// 返回fact creation time。
    pub fn created_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
    /// 返回current status time。
    pub fn status_changed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;

    /// 判断failure是否仍为active blocking interpretation。
    pub fn is_active_failure(&self) -> bool;
}

/// 按committed `(truth_cursor, failure_ref)`顺序保存的failure status items。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct FailureControlFailureItemSet(Vec<FailureControlFailureItem>);

impl FailureControlFailureItemSet {
    /// 构造允许为空、ref唯一且按committed order严格递增的item set。
    pub fn try_new(
        items: Vec<FailureControlFailureItem>,
    ) -> Result<Self, FailureControlStatusViewError>;

    /// 返回合法空集合；只有complete source可把它解释为没有failure truth。
    pub fn empty() -> Self;
    /// 返回不可变item切片。
    pub fn as_slice(&self) -> &[FailureControlFailureItem];
    /// 判断set是否为空。
    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断是否存在active failure；`PendingInput`和`Unknown`也不能解释为success。
    pub fn has_active_or_pending_failure(&self) -> bool;
    /// 返回set覆盖的最大truth cursor；空set返回`None`。
    pub fn max_truth_cursor(&self) -> Option<SandboxTruthCursor>;
}
```

failure item矩阵固定如下：

| status | kind | status reason | supersession refs | `is_active_failure` |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PendingInput` | 必须为`Unknown` | `Some` | 两者为空 | true；输入不足不是success |
| `Classified` | 不得为`Unknown` | `Some` | 两者为空 | true |
| `Terminal` | 不得为`Unknown` | `Some` | 两者为空 | true |
| `Superseded` | 保留原kind，可为非`Unknown` | `Some` | control/redline恰好一个 | false |

`truth_cursor`必须非零，`status_changed_at >= created_at`。set拒绝duplicate failure ref、cursor倒退，
以及同cursor下非canonical ref顺序；它不自动sort、不按timestamp选winner、不删除superseded item。

control item必须按§12.3的publicly observable matrix机械重验：

| status | allowed kind | status reason | completion summary | helper result |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Accepted` | `Kill | Cancel | Deny | Timeout | Cleanup | Investigation` | `None` | `None` | effect pending=true |
| `IgnoredDuplicate` | 任一shared control kind | `Some` | optional | pending=false，unsafe=false |
| `Conflicted` | 任一shared control kind | `Some` | `None` | unsafe=true |
| `Completed` | 除`Other`外的accepted kind | `None` | `Some` | pending=false，unsafe=false |
| `Failed` | 除`Other`外的accepted kind | `Some` | optional | unsafe=true |

domain-only `ControlEffect`和`ControlConflictDisposition`不进入contracts view；它们继续由§12.2~12.3
拥有并在domain rehydration时校验。view item通过canonical `control_kind + control_status`与field
cardinality展示公共状态，不反向重建effect或disposition。optional `failure_ref`只允许在
`Accepted | Completed | Failed`且其relation由source snapshot后续对账；item factory不读取failure
repository。set拒绝duplicate ref、cursor倒退和非canonical同cursor顺序，不按timestamp覆盖旧
control，也不把`IgnoredDuplicate`解释为原control已完成。

#### H16.5.5 Committed scope proof 与 source completeness

空集合必须由一次完整scope read证明，不能由`Vec::is_empty()`、repository `None`、query selector或
caller bool推导。source reader在同一read snapshot中返回context scope cursor、匹配行计数和
highest returned cursor；proof不保存SQL range、page token、storage version或查询文本。

```text historical-invalid-rust

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct FailureControlStatusSourceSnapshot {
    /// source唯一归属的controlled execution context。

    /// source唯一归属的execution environment identity。

    /// available committed control status items。

    /// repository snapshot coverage proof。

    /// read coverage disposition；不改写item canonical status。

    /// incomplete source的非空caller-safe reasons；complete source固定为空。
    degraded_reasons: Option<StatusViewDegradedReasonSet>,
}

impl FailureControlStatusSourceSnapshot {
    /// 构造完整committed source；proof计数必须与两个item set精确相等。

        context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
        environment_identity_ref: ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef,
        failures: FailureControlFailureItemSet,
        controls: FailureControlControlItemSet,
        scope_proof: FailureControlCommittedScopeProof,
    ) -> Result<Self, FailureControlStatusViewError>;

    /// 构造安全但不完整的source；保留available items并要求非空degraded reasons。
    pub fn incomplete(
        context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
        environment_identity_ref: ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef,
        failures: FailureControlFailureItemSet,
        controls: FailureControlControlItemSet,
        scope_proof: FailureControlCommittedScopeProof,
        degraded_reasons: StatusViewDegradedReasonSet,
    ) -> Result<Self, FailureControlStatusViewError>;

    /// 返回source owning context。
    pub fn context_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionContextRef;
    /// 返回source owning environment identity。
    pub fn environment_identity_ref(&self) -> &ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef;
    /// 返回available failure items。
    pub fn failures(&self) -> &FailureControlFailureItemSet;
    /// 返回available control items。
    pub fn controls(&self) -> &FailureControlControlItemSet;
    /// 返回committed scope proof。
    pub fn scope_proof(&self) -> &FailureControlCommittedScopeProof;
    /// 返回source completeness。
    pub fn completeness(&self) -> FailureControlSourceCompleteness;
    /// 返回incomplete source reasons；complete source为空。
    pub fn degraded_reasons(&self) -> Option<&StatusViewDegradedReasonSet>;

    /// 判断complete source是否明确证明scope没有failure和control truth。
    pub fn proves_empty_scope(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断available item中是否存在pending/active failure或unsafe control。
    pub fn has_active_or_unsafe_state(&self) -> bool;

```

`FailureControlSourceCompleteness`属于support family #39的pure read disposition，不是持久化状态机，
不新增named ref，也不进入shared status总数。两个factory都执行以下机械校验：

1. `scope_proof.context_ref == context_ref`，proof cursor非零；proof observation time不早于source
   audit对应committed read，也不早于任一item的`status_changed_at`。
2. 每个failure/control item的lineage context与environment identity都分别等于source；item彼此按
   §16.5.2兼容。wrong scope不是degraded，而是`FailureControlItemLineageMismatch`。
3. 每个item的`truth_cursor <= scope_truth_cursor`；set最大cursor必须等于proof中对应returned max
   cursor。expected count不能小于returned set长度，也不能超过`u32`表达范围。
4. `complete`要求expected count与set长度逐项精确相等，proof的max cursor与set max逐项相等，且
   degraded reasons不存在。因此两个count均为0且两个set为空才证明合法empty。
5. `incomplete`要求至少一个`expected count > returned count`、正式reader报告dependency gap，或
   上层projection明确stale；必须携带非空ordered-unique degraded reasons。它不得因known row
   malformed、wrong context或cross-link冲突而构造。
6. failure的`superseded_by_control_ref`若存在，完整source必须包含同ref control item；该control
   必须kind为`Kill | Cancel | Deny | Timeout`，status为`Accepted | Completed | Failed`，lineage兼容，
   且control cursor不晚于failure supersession cursor。否则返回cross-link error。incomplete source
   可以缺matching control，但必须有明确degraded reason，不能把failure当inactive success。
7. control的`failure_ref`若存在，完整source必须包含同ref failure item且lineage兼容；incomplete
   source缺matching failure时必须degraded。任何同ref但lineage不相等都是integrity error。
8. failure的redline supersession只校验ref cardinality与status matrix；redline row body由§16.7
   view/source读取，当前source不跨读redline或把缺row解释为failure active/inactive。

`proves_empty_scope()`只在`Complete`、proof两个expected count均为0、两个set均为空时返回true。
`has_active_or_unsafe_state()`在source incomplete时固定返回true；complete时只要存在
`PendingInput | Classified | Terminal` failure，或`Accepted | Conflicted | Failed` control就返回true。
该helper只是public read predicate，不授权run、cleanup或control mutation。

<!-- CURRENT_CANONICAL_16_5_BEGIN -->

### 16.5 `FailureControlStatusView` current canonical contract

`FailureControlStatusView` 是 `GetFailureControlStatus` 和 `SandboxReadProjection` 消费的
contracts-owned、body-free、immutable read model。它只投影一个 exact
`ControlledExecutionContextRef` 下已经提交的 `FailureClassification` 与 `ControlFact`，不重新分类
failure、不执行或选择 control、不推进 cleanup / lease / redline，也不在读取时 append audit。

本对象关闭 named type #23，并关闭 support family #39 的第一个分支。canonical owner 固定为
`crates/contracts/src/views.rs`；typed refs、shared kind/status、truth cursor、reason 与 metadata 继续由
`crates/contracts/src/refs.rs`和`core-contracts`拥有。`crates/domain/src/failure.rs`与`control.rs`
不声明同名 view / item / source carrier；application mapper 只能复制正式 committed source，不能把
domain object、repository row、raw error或query access decision放进 public view。

#### 16.5.1 Capability、记录边界与历史冲突裁决

| 项 | current exact contract |
|---|---|
| query subject | 当前只允许一个required exact context + bounded page request。历史optional `failure_ref` direct selector缺少anchor-window/index语义，登记为downstream conflict并从current request删除。 |
| fact coverage | failure/control 均为零至多条 append-once / monotonic truth；不得假设每个 context 只有一条，也不得按 timestamp 选择 latest winner。 |
| bounded read | view 只保存一次合并 committed order 的有界窗口；窗口总 item 数 `<= requested_limit <= SBX-CFG-I003 maxQueryPageLimit`。 |
| normal continuation | `has_more = true` 只表示还有正常下一页，不是 degraded；next cursor 由 Step 7 repository page helper产生并由 Step 8 public page DTO opaque 包装。 |
| complete scope | committed scope summary 独立保存总计数与 active / unsafe 计数；即使当前窗口不是末页，也可安全判定 scope 是否有 active failure / unsafe control。 |
| empty | 只有 scope summary 证明 failure/control 总数均为零、窗口为空且 source 无 read gap 时才成立。空第一页不能仅凭 `items.is_empty()` 推导。 |
| degraded | 仅由 typed source read gap 产生；caller-safe reason 只解释 gap，不创造 gap。known malformed row、wrong scope、duplicate或cross-link矛盾必须报 typed error。 |
| identity | context 可处于 `PendingResolution | Rejected | Unresolved`，因此 `environment_identity_ref` 是 `Option`；只要scope summary total非零就必须为 `Some`，并与每项相等。 |
| audit field | source audit ref 是 committed context/source snapshot 的既有 audit linkage；不是本次 Query / repository read 动作的审计，也不得由 query 临时生成。 |
| excluded truth | lease、orphan、cleanup、redline body、relay与observability lifecycle均不进入本 view；由 §16.6、§16.7及其 owner承接。 |
| no-write | view / source没有 classify、supersede、attach failure、submit/complete control、refresh、repair、cleanup、append audit或分配 truth cursor的方法。 |

历史 `latest_control_status`、`lease_status` 与两个无界 `Vec` 全部失效。前者会丢失 duplicate、conflict
与并存 safety control，后者属于 cleanup lifecycle；无界集合则违反结构有界与 Query page 契约。
`FailureClassificationStatus`、`ControlFactStatus`、`SandboxFailureKind`、`SandboxControlKind`均直接复用
shared owner，不新增 `VisibleFailureStatus` / `VisibleControlStatus`。

#### 16.5.2 Shared execution lineage

```rust
/// failure/control read item共享的body-free execution lineage。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct FailureControlViewLineage {
    /// owning controlled execution context identity。
    context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
    /// owning execution environment identity；fact存在时恒为Some。
    environment_identity_ref: ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef,
    /// optional controlled run；存在时必须带完整boundary group。
    run_ref: Option<ControlledExecutionRunRef>,
    /// optional coherent boundary；与handle/generation成组出现。
    boundary_ref: Option<CoherentBoundaryRef>,
    /// optional isolation handle；与boundary/generation成组出现。
    handle_ref: Option<IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef>,
    /// optional immutable backend/runtime generation；与boundary/handle成组出现。
    generation_ref: Option<ResourceRef>,
}

impl FailureControlViewLineage {
    /// 构造context + identity-only的pre-boundary lineage。
    pub fn for_context(
        context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
        environment_identity_ref: ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef,
    ) -> Result<Self, FailureControlStatusViewError>;

    /// 构造没有run、但已经绑定完整boundary group的lineage。
    pub fn for_boundary(
        context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
        environment_identity_ref: ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef,
        boundary_ref: CoherentBoundaryRef,
        handle_ref: IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef,
        generation_ref: ResourceRef,
    ) -> Result<Self, FailureControlStatusViewError>;

    /// 构造完整run + boundary group lineage。
    pub fn for_run(
        context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
        environment_identity_ref: ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef,
        run_ref: ControlledExecutionRunRef,
        boundary_ref: CoherentBoundaryRef,
        handle_ref: IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef,
        generation_ref: ResourceRef,
    ) -> Result<Self, FailureControlStatusViewError>;

    /// 返回owning context identity。
    pub fn context_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionContextRef;
    /// 返回owning environment identity。
    pub fn environment_identity_ref(&self) -> &ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef;
    /// 返回optional run identity。
    pub fn run_ref(&self) -> Option<&ControlledExecutionRunRef>;
    /// 返回optional boundary identity。
    pub fn boundary_ref(&self) -> Option<&CoherentBoundaryRef>;
    /// 返回optional handle identity。
    pub fn handle_ref(&self) -> Option<&IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef>;
    /// 返回optional generation identity。
    pub fn generation_ref(&self) -> Option<&ResourceRef>;
    /// 判断两个lineage是否可在同一context view中并列。
    pub fn is_compatible_with(&self, other: &Self) -> bool;
}
```

不存在接收五个独立 `Option` 的 public constructor。`for_context` 使 run / boundary group全空；
`for_boundary`使 run为空且group全有；`for_run`使run与group全有。`is_compatible_with`要求context与
identity相等；双方同一 optional member 都存在时必须相等；context-only可与同context/identity的
boundary/run fact并列，boundary-level可与同一group的run fact并列。它不证明handle active、lease有效、
fact最新或control获胜。


| status | kind | supersession refs | active |
|---|---|---|---:|
| `PendingInput` | 必须 `Unknown` | 两者为空 | 是；输入不足不是success |
| `Classified` | 不得 `Unknown` | 两者为空 | 是 |
| `Terminal` | 不得 `Unknown` | 两者为空 | 是 |
| `Superseded` | 保留原非`Unknown` kind | control/redline恰好一个 | 否 |

四种 status 均必须有 owner-provided `status_reason`；factory不接受空 reason。truth cursor由已提交
truth row复制且非零，`status_changed_at >= created_at`。item不读取matching control / redline；跨对象
relation由source snapshot校验。


| status | allowed kind | status reason | summary | optional failure ref |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Accepted` | `Kill/Cancel/Deny/Timeout/Cleanup/Investigation` | `None` | `None` | allowed |
| `IgnoredDuplicate` | `Kill/Cancel/Deny/Timeout/Cleanup/Investigation` | `Some` | optional | forbidden |
| `Conflicted` | `Kill/Cancel/Deny/Timeout/Cleanup/Investigation` | `Some` | `None` | forbidden |
| `Completed` | `Kill/Cancel/Deny/Timeout/Cleanup/Investigation` | `None` | `Some` | retained-only |
| `Failed` | `Kill/Cancel/Deny/Timeout/Cleanup/Investigation` | `Some` | optional | allowed |

kind与lineage还必须同时满足：

| kind | required lineage | additional status restriction |
|---|---|---|
| `Kill/Cancel/Timeout` | 必须 `for_run`，完整run + boundary group | 可进入accepted/completed/failed类状态。 |
| `Cleanup` | 必须至少 `for_boundary`；若有run则完整group相等 | 不得由context-only进入accepted类状态。 |
| `Investigation` | `for_context`、`for_boundary`或`for_run`均可 | optional group必须完整，不得partial。 |
| `Deny` | 所有可持久化status都必须`for_run` | context-only pre-launch deny的effect为`Unsupported`，由failure/policy truth展示，guard在形成decision前拒绝，不能生成duplicate/conflict control fact。 |
| `Other` | 无合法持久化lineage | `ControlConflictGuard::evaluate`在形成decision前typed reject；view factory对任一status均返回`ControlKindLineageInvalid { control_kind: Other }`。 |

`failure_ref`只能在`Accepted | Failed`通过owning object attach；`Completed`不能新attach，但必须原样保留
Accepted阶段已提交的optional ref。`IgnoredDuplicate | Conflicted`始终禁止ref。所有存在的ref均由source
snapshot对账，relation-time failure status只允许`Classified | Terminal`。`retained-only`是source-level
cross-link relation，不是item factory可凭当前字段自行猜测的历史；任何control item只有进入通过
`FailureControlStatusSourceSnapshot`校验的view后才能公开。domain-only `ControlEffect`与
`ControlConflictDisposition`不进入 contracts view；view不从 kind/status 反向重建它们。时间必须单调，
truth cursor必须非零。

上述`Other`和context-only `Deny`裁决直接服从§12.2的owning truth：strict guard先校验target与
kind-derived effect，`Other`及无法映射effect的intent在duplicate/conflict比较前即失败，因此不存在可供
status view投影的`IgnoredDuplicate`或`Conflicted`事实。view不能为了兼容旧row而扩大truth owner；若存储中
出现此类row，必须按integrity / migration路径处理，不能显示为合法历史control。

#### 16.5.5 Bounded merged window

failure与control必须先投影成一个 closed union，再按 `(truth_cursor, item_kind, canonical_ref)` 合并排序。
排序只保证稳定分页，不表示不同 truth 在同一 cursor 内存在业务先后；`Failure` 固定排在 `Control` 前，
同 kind再按named ref canonical order排列。repository不得分别取两个 limit 后拼成最多 `2 * limit` 的view。

```rust
/// failure/control有界窗口中的closed item union。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum FailureControlStatusItem {
    /// committed failure classification状态项。

    Control(FailureControlControlItem),
}

impl FailureControlStatusItem {

    /// 返回由item自身字段唯一形成的stable order key。
    pub fn order_key(&self) -> FailureControlStatusOrderKey;
}

/// merged window item的closed kind；只用于稳定排序与计数。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum FailureControlStatusItemKind {
    /// failure classification item。
    Failure,
    /// control fact item。
    Control,
}

/// stable order key中使用的closed typed fact identity。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum FailureControlStatusItemRef {
    /// failure classification identity。
    Failure(FailureClassificationRef),
    /// control fact identity。

}

/// merged status item的stable `(truth_cursor, kind, ref)` order key。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub struct FailureControlStatusOrderKey {
    /// item current state对应的committed truth cursor。

}

/// validated page cursor映射出的snapshot-bound page anchor。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct FailureControlPageAnchor {
    /// first或continued closed position。

/// page anchor的closed位置类别。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum FailureControlPagePosition {

    First,

    Continued,

impl FailureControlPageAnchor {

    /// 返回continued after key；first为None。

/// 一次GetFailureControlStatus读取的validated item上限。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub struct FailureControlWindowLimit(u32);

impl FailureControlWindowLimit {
    /// 从非零requested limit和startup-validated max query limit构造窗口上限。
    pub fn try_new(
        requested_limit: u32,
        max_query_page_limit: u32,
    ) -> Result<Self, FailureControlStatusViewError>;
    /// 返回validated limit值。

}

/// 一个committed scope内按merged order返回的有界status item窗口。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct FailureControlStatusWindow {
    /// 本窗口实际使用的validated limit。
    limit: FailureControlWindowLimit,
    /// 按merged committed order排列且不重复的items。
    items: Vec<FailureControlStatusItem>,
    /// repository是否证明scope在本窗口后还有item。
    has_more: bool,
    /// 当前窗口第一个item的stable order key；空窗口为None。
    first_order_key: Option<FailureControlStatusOrderKey>,
    /// 当前窗口最后一个item的stable order key；空窗口为None。
    last_order_key: Option<FailureControlStatusOrderKey>,
}

impl FailureControlStatusWindow {
    /// 从同一committed snapshot的bounded repository page构造merged window。
    pub fn try_from_committed_page(
        limit: FailureControlWindowLimit,
        items: Vec<FailureControlStatusItem>,
        has_more: bool,
    ) -> Result<Self, FailureControlStatusViewError>;

    /// 返回validated item limit。
    pub fn limit(&self) -> FailureControlWindowLimit;
    /// 返回ordered immutable items。
    pub fn items(&self) -> &[FailureControlStatusItem];
    /// 返回当前窗口item数。
    pub fn returned_count(&self) -> u32;
    /// 判断scope是否还有正常下一页。
    pub fn has_more(&self) -> bool;
    /// 返回first stable order key。
    pub fn first_order_key(&self) -> Option<&FailureControlStatusOrderKey>;
    /// 返回last stable order key。
    pub fn last_order_key(&self) -> Option<&FailureControlStatusOrderKey>;
    /// 返回窗口内failure item数量。
    pub fn failure_count(&self) -> u32;
    /// 返回窗口内control item数量。
    pub fn control_count(&self) -> u32;
    /// 查找当前窗口内的failure item；不跨页读取。
    pub fn find_failure(
        &self,
        failure_ref: &FailureClassificationRef,
    ) -> Option<&FailureControlFailureItem>;
    /// 查找当前窗口内的control item；不跨页读取。
    pub fn find_control(
        &self,
        control_ref: &ControlFactRef,
    ) -> Option<&FailureControlControlItem>;
}
```

`FailureControlWindowLimit::try_new` 要求两个值均非零，且
`requested_limit <= max_query_page_limit`；`max_query_page_limit`来自正式配置
`SBX-CFG-I003`的startup-validated typed value，不能由 view 读取 raw config。窗口 item 数不得超过limit；
duplicate typed ref、merged order倒退、缓存自行sort、空窗口却 `has_more = true`、cursor字段与items不一致
均返回typed error。正常 next cursor不进入本 Step 6 object：Step 7 `Page<T>`拥有application-local opaque
cursor，Step 8 `SandboxPageInfoDto`拥有public cursor；两者都不得由`SandboxTruthCursor`序列化或拼接。
`FailureControlStatusOrderKey`只是opaque cursor内部经校验后的typed payload，不得直接序列化成public cursor；
其`item_ref` variant与实际item必须一致，不能传入独立kind制造排序冲突。

#### 16.5.6 Committed scope summary

窗口不能单独证明整个 scope 安全，因此 source reader必须从同一 committed snapshot返回一个有界聚合摘要。
摘要是索引聚合结果，不是第二套 failure/control truth；它不保存每条ref，也不按“当前页”重算总量。

```rust
/// 一个context committed failure/control scope的body-free聚合摘要。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct FailureControlCommittedScopeSummary {
    /// summary唯一适用的context。
    context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
    /// scope内全部committed failure事实数量。
    total_failure_count: u64,
    /// scope内全部committed control事实数量。
    total_control_count: u64,
    /// PendingInput/Classified/Terminal failure数量。
    active_failure_count: u64,
    /// Accepted control数量。
    pending_control_count: u64,
    /// Conflicted/Failed control数量。
    unsafe_control_count: u64,
    /// summary覆盖到的latest committed truth cursor。
    scope_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
    /// 该committed context/source snapshot已存在的audit linkage。
    source_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    /// summary mapper observation time。
    observed_at: Timestamp,
}

impl FailureControlCommittedScopeSummary {
    /// 从正式context indexes的同一committed snapshot聚合结果构造summary。
    pub fn try_from_committed_index(
        context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
        total_failure_count: u64,
        total_control_count: u64,
        active_failure_count: u64,
        pending_control_count: u64,
        unsafe_control_count: u64,
        scope_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
        source_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        observed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, FailureControlStatusViewError>;

    /// 返回owning context。
    pub fn context_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionContextRef;
    /// 返回全部failure数量。
    pub fn total_failure_count(&self) -> u64;
    /// 返回全部control数量。
    pub fn total_control_count(&self) -> u64;
    /// 返回active/pending failure数量。
    pub fn active_failure_count(&self) -> u64;
    /// 返回accepted control数量。
    pub fn pending_control_count(&self) -> u64;
    /// 返回conflicted/failed control数量。
    pub fn unsafe_control_count(&self) -> u64;
    /// 返回scope committed truth cursor。
    pub fn scope_truth_cursor(&self) -> SandboxTruthCursor;
    /// 返回committed source snapshot的既有audit linkage。
    pub fn source_audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;
    /// 返回summary observation time。
    pub fn observed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
    /// 判断整个committed scope是否明确为空。
    pub fn proves_empty_scope(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断整个scope是否存在active failure或pending/unsafe control。
    pub fn has_active_or_unsafe_state(&self) -> bool;
}
```

所有子计数必须不大于对应total；三类control计数允许不覆盖duplicate/completed等safe terminal事实。
`scope_truth_cursor`非零，且不得早于窗口中任一item cursor。`source_audit_trace_ref`必须来自context或
source index已提交状态变化的audit relation，它只说明 summary 的 committed source context；查询动作自身
只走普通observability hook，绝不能 append `SandboxAuditTrace`。`u64`避免长期append-only scope在
协议内部被 `u32` 截断；Step 8若当前DTO仍使用 `u32` count，必须改为checked `u64` schema。

#### 16.5.7 Typed source read gap

```rust
/// failure/control source读取中缺失的closed dependency类别。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum FailureControlReadGapKind {
    /// merged item window未能覆盖repository声明的本页范围。
    WindowCoverage,
    /// committed scope aggregate/index暂不可用或stale。
    ScopeSummary,
    /// item引用的matching failure/control不在可验证source中。
    CrossLinkDependency,
    /// projection提供的是last-known而非current committed source。
    ProjectionSource,
}

/// 一个可安全降级、但不能伪装完整读取的typed gap。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct FailureControlReadGap {
    /// 缺失dependency的closed类别。
    gap_kind: FailureControlReadGapKind,
    /// gap唯一适用的context。
    context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
    /// 本次source binding要求完整覆盖到的truth watermark。
    required_through_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
    /// reader能够安全证明已覆盖到的watermark；完全不可用时为None。
    available_through_cursor: Option<SandboxTruthCursor>,
    /// mapper允许对caller暴露的安全原因。
    reason: SandboxReason,
}

impl FailureControlReadGap {
    /// 从formal reader的typed disposition构造gap；不能由query caller自由选择kind。
    pub fn try_from_reader_disposition(
        gap_kind: FailureControlReadGapKind,
        context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
        required_through_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
        available_through_cursor: Option<SandboxTruthCursor>,
        reason: SandboxReason,
    ) -> Result<Self, FailureControlStatusViewError>;
    /// 返回gap kind。
    pub fn gap_kind(&self) -> FailureControlReadGapKind;
    /// 返回owning context。
    pub fn context_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionContextRef;
    /// 返回required coverage watermark。
    pub fn required_through_cursor(&self) -> SandboxTruthCursor;
    /// 返回reader已安全证明的optional available watermark。
    pub fn available_through_cursor(&self) -> Option<SandboxTruthCursor>;
    /// 返回caller-safe gap reason。
    pub fn reason(&self) -> &SandboxReason;
}

/// 非空、按kind与safe reason唯一且保持canonical order的read gap set。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct FailureControlReadGapSet(Vec<FailureControlReadGap>);

impl FailureControlReadGapSet {
    /// 构造非空gap set；duplicate kind、duplicate reason和非canonical order均拒绝。
    pub fn try_new(
        gaps: Vec<FailureControlReadGap>,
    ) -> Result<Self, FailureControlStatusViewError>;
    /// 返回immutable gap slice。
    pub fn as_slice(&self) -> &[FailureControlReadGap];
    /// 判断是否包含指定gap kind。
    pub fn contains(&self, kind: FailureControlReadGapKind) -> bool;
    /// 将每个typed gap的safe reason一一投影为degraded reason set。
    pub fn to_degraded_reasons(
        &self,
    ) -> Result<StatusViewDegradedReasonSet, FailureControlStatusViewError>;
}
```

`Incomplete` 不再是可独立传入的 enum。`FailureControlReadGapSet` 非空即 degraded，空即 complete；
gap kind与safe reason都必须唯一，degraded reasons必须由gap set逐项投影且数量、顺序、值完全一致。
两个不同gap不能复用同一个笼统reason，否则无法形成shared ordered-unique reason set，返回
`ReadGapSetInvalid`。SQL/IO/SDK错误、raw row、unknown ref、
authorization结果不能进入gap。malformed已知row、wrong context、duplicate ref、counter矛盾或同ref lineage
冲突属于integrity error，不允许构造gap。每个gap的`required_through_cursor`必须等于source binding
watermark；available存在时必须严格早于required，否则没有真实coverage gap。正常 `has_more`也不是gap。

#### 16.5.8 Checked source snapshot 与 cross-link

```rust
impl FailureControlStatusViewBinding {

/// cross-page relation proof的closed类别。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum FailureControlCrossLinkKind {
    /// failure由matching terminal control supersede。
    FailureSupersededByControl,
    /// accepted/failed control附着matching failure。
    ControlAttachedFailure,
}

/// 对当前窗口item所引用cross-page fact的body-free committed relation proof。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum FailureControlCrossLinkProof {
    /// failure supersession与matching control的committed relation。
    FailureSupersededByControl {
        /// source failure identity。
        failure_ref: FailureClassificationRef,
        /// source failure lineage。
        failure_lineage: FailureControlViewLineage,
        /// superseded failure current cursor。
        failure_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
        /// superseding control identity。
        control_ref: ControlFactRef,
        /// superseding control lineage。
        control_lineage: FailureControlViewLineage,
        /// superseding terminal control kind。
        control_kind: SandboxControlKind,
        /// supersession relation成立时的control status。
        control_status_at_relation: ControlFactStatus,
        /// supersession relation读取的control truth cursor。
        control_truth_cursor_at_relation: SandboxTruthCursor,
        /// matching supersession relation首次提交的cursor。
        relation_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
        /// matching supersession transition已有的audit linkage。
        relation_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    },
    /// control与matching failure attachment的committed relation。
    ControlAttachedFailure {
        /// source control identity。
        control_ref: ControlFactRef,
        /// source control lineage。
        control_lineage: FailureControlViewLineage,
        /// attachment relation成立时的control status。
        control_status_at_relation: ControlFactStatus,
        /// matching attachment relation首次提交的cursor。
        relation_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
        /// matching attachment transition已有的audit linkage。
        relation_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        /// attached failure identity。
        failure_ref: FailureClassificationRef,
        /// attached failure lineage。
        failure_lineage: FailureControlViewLineage,
        /// attachment relation成立时的failure status。
        failure_status_at_relation: FailureClassificationStatus,
        /// attachment relation读取的failure truth cursor。
        failure_truth_cursor_at_relation: SandboxTruthCursor,
    },
}

impl FailureControlCrossLinkProof {
    /// 构造failure supersession proof并校验terminal control关系与cursor顺序。
    pub fn try_failure_supersession(
        failure: &FailureControlFailureItem,
        control_ref: ControlFactRef,
        control_lineage: FailureControlViewLineage,
        control_kind: SandboxControlKind,
        control_status_at_relation: ControlFactStatus,
        control_truth_cursor_at_relation: SandboxTruthCursor,
        relation_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
        relation_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    ) -> Result<Self, FailureControlStatusViewError>;

    /// 构造control failure attachment proof并校验status、lineage与cursor顺序。
    pub fn try_control_failure_attachment(
        control: &FailureControlControlItem,
        failure_ref: FailureClassificationRef,
        failure_lineage: FailureControlViewLineage,
        control_status_at_relation: ControlFactStatus,
        failure_status_at_relation: FailureClassificationStatus,
        failure_truth_cursor_at_relation: SandboxTruthCursor,
        relation_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
        relation_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    ) -> Result<Self, FailureControlStatusViewError>;

    /// 返回cross-link kind。
    pub fn link_kind(&self) -> FailureControlCrossLinkKind;
    /// 返回relation owning context。
    pub fn context_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionContextRef;
}

/// 当前窗口需要的ordered-unique cross-link proof集合；允许为空。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct FailureControlCrossLinkProofSet(Vec<FailureControlCrossLinkProof>);

impl FailureControlCrossLinkProofSet {
    /// 构造按link kind + source ref + target ref排序且不重复的proof set。
    pub fn try_new(
        proofs: Vec<FailureControlCrossLinkProof>,
    ) -> Result<Self, FailureControlStatusViewError>;
    /// 返回合法空proof set。
    pub fn empty() -> Self;
    /// 返回immutable proof slice。
    pub fn as_slice(&self) -> &[FailureControlCrossLinkProof];
}

/// 从同一committed context scope复制出的bounded failure/control view source。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct FailureControlStatusSourceSnapshot {
    /// existing materialized view identity与source watermark。
    view_binding: FailureControlStatusViewBinding,
    /// source唯一归属的controlled execution context。
    context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
    /// accepted后存在；合法empty pre-acceptance scope可以为None。
    environment_identity_ref: Option<ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef>,
    /// 同一snapshot返回的bounded merged window。
    window: FailureControlStatusWindow,
    /// validated request cursor映射出的snapshot-bound page anchor。
    page_anchor: FailureControlPageAnchor,
    /// 同一snapshot返回的committed scope summary；degraded summary gap时可缺失。
    scope_summary: Option<FailureControlCommittedScopeSummary>,
    /// 当前窗口引用关系的committed cross-page proofs。
    cross_link_proofs: FailureControlCrossLinkProofSet,
    /// 非空表示source degraded；None表示reader声明完整。
    read_gaps: Option<FailureControlReadGapSet>,
    /// source mapper observation time。
    observed_at: Timestamp,
}

impl FailureControlStatusSourceSnapshot {
    /// 构造完整committed source；不允许read gap。
    pub fn complete(
        view_binding: FailureControlStatusViewBinding,
        context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
        environment_identity_ref: Option<ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef>,
        window: FailureControlStatusWindow,
        page_anchor: FailureControlPageAnchor,
        scope_summary: FailureControlCommittedScopeSummary,
        cross_link_proofs: FailureControlCrossLinkProofSet,
        observed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, FailureControlStatusViewError>;

    /// 从formal reader提供的非空typed gaps构造degraded source。
    pub fn degraded(
        view_binding: FailureControlStatusViewBinding,
        context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
        environment_identity_ref: Option<ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef>,
        window: FailureControlStatusWindow,
        page_anchor: FailureControlPageAnchor,
        scope_summary: Option<FailureControlCommittedScopeSummary>,
        cross_link_proofs: FailureControlCrossLinkProofSet,
        read_gaps: FailureControlReadGapSet,
        observed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, FailureControlStatusViewError>;

    /// 返回existing materialized view binding。
    pub fn view_binding(&self) -> &FailureControlStatusViewBinding;
    /// 返回source owning context。
    pub fn context_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionContextRef;
    /// 返回optional environment identity。
    pub fn environment_identity_ref(&self) -> Option<&ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef>;
    /// 返回bounded merged window。
    pub fn window(&self) -> &FailureControlStatusWindow;
    /// 返回validated snapshot-bound page anchor。
    pub fn page_anchor(&self) -> &FailureControlPageAnchor;
    /// 返回optional committed scope summary；complete source恒为Some。
    pub fn scope_summary(&self) -> Option<&FailureControlCommittedScopeSummary>;
    /// 返回checked cross-link proofs。
    pub fn cross_link_proofs(&self) -> &FailureControlCrossLinkProofSet;
    /// 返回optional typed read gaps。
    pub fn read_gaps(&self) -> Option<&FailureControlReadGapSet>;
    /// 返回source observation time。
    pub fn observed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
    /// 判断source是否由typed read gap降级。
    pub fn is_degraded(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断complete source是否明确证明scope为空。
    pub fn proves_empty_scope(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断整个scope是否存在active failure或pending/unsafe control。
    pub fn has_active_or_unsafe_state(&self) -> bool;
}
```

cross-link proof factory只接受以下矩阵：failure supersession control必须是
`Kill | Cancel | Deny | Timeout`，relation-time control status必须为
`Accepted | Completed | Failed`，`control_truth_cursor_at_relation <= relation_truth_cursor`，且relation
cursor等于failure supersession transition cursor。control attachment的relation-time control status必须为
`Accepted | Failed`，relation-time failure status必须为`Classified | Terminal`，两个source cursor都不得晚于
relation cursor。两种proof都要求context、identity与optional group兼容，并保存relation transition已有audit
ref。若matching target同时出现在window，current status只能是relation-time status的合法单调后继：
`Accepted -> Completed | Failed`，`Classified -> Terminal | Superseded`，`Terminal -> Superseded`；不得要求
current cursor仍等于relation cursor。proof不读取repository，也不保存effect、disposition、reason、raw row
或page cursor。

source factory按以下顺序校验：

1. binding、context与每个item context必须相等；binding cursor不早于任一item cursor。summary存在时，其
   context、cursor、source audit ref必须与binding完全相等。
2. `Continued` anchor的snapshot view ref/cursor必须与binding完全相等；first anchor不携带这些字段。
   continued `after`必须严格小于window首项order key；空continued允许after存在。anchor不匹配返回
   `PageAnchorRelationInvalid`，不能以invalid public cursor降级。
3. 窗口非空时`environment_identity_ref`必须`Some`并与每项identity相等。summary存在且任一total非零
   时identity也必须`Some`；只有summary totals均为零或summary缺失且window为空时才可为`None`。summary
   totals逐类不得小于当前窗口对应item count。summary totals非零而当前页为空只允许`Continued`且
   `has_more=false`，不能由第一页或空window自行声称。
4. 所有item lineage按§16.5.2兼容；同ref不同lineage是integrity error。
5. complete source要求summary为Some、read gaps为None，并执行page coverage。令
   `total = total_failure_count + total_control_count`，加法必须checked；`consumed = anchor.consumed_count`，
   `returned = window.returned_count`。必须满足`consumed <= total`和`consumed + returned <= total`。
   `First`时consumed固定0，combined total为0必须空且
   `has_more=false`；total在`1..=limit`必须全部返回且`has_more=false`；total大于limit必须返回exact
   limit且`has_more=true`。`Continued`若`has_more=true`必须返回exact limit且
   `consumed + returned < total`；若`has_more=false`必须`consumed + returned == total`，其中
   `consumed == total`时允许空exhausted page。degraded source只有含`WindowCoverage` gap时才可放宽
   returned/has_more coverage等式，但anchor identity、checked arithmetic与`consumed <= total`仍必须成立。
6. degraded source要求non-empty gap set。若summary为None，gap set必须同时含`ScopeSummary`与
   `WindowCoverage`；此时不执行total/count coverage等式，也不构造零值summary。若summary为Some，仍执行
   complete的count arithmetic，只有`WindowCoverage`可放宽returned/has_more等式。
7. source始终要求`observed_at >= binding.materialized_at`、所有item status time与所有proof relation time；
   summary存在时还必须`observed_at >= summary.observed_at`。summary缺失只跳过summary time，不跳过
   binding、item或proof time。
   每个gap的required watermark必须等于binding cursor，available watermark存在时严格更早。
8. complete source中每个带cross-link ref的window item必须有恰好一个matching proof；degraded source
   只有在gap set含`CrossLinkDependency`时才允许对应proof缺失。已有proof无论complete/degraded都必须
   完整校验，无关联item不得被proof冒充。当前窗口内可见的cross-link还必须精确对账。failure的
   superseding control若同页存在，kind必须为
   `Kill/Cancel/Deny/Timeout`、status为`Accepted/Completed/Failed`且lineage兼容；control的failure ref
   若同页存在，lineage必须兼容。错配永远报错。
9. matching ref不在当前窗口可能只是正常跨页，不能自动degraded。reader必须通过正式 cross-link index
   在同一snapshot生成matching proof；若该dependency无法验证，必须提供
   `CrossLinkDependency` gap。不得为了对账扩大window超过limit，也不得scan latest。
10. redline supersession只校验status/ref cardinality；redline body由§16.7读取。它不把跨页或未加载
   redline解释成failure重新active。

`proves_empty_scope()`只在source非degraded、summary totals均为0且window为空时为true。
`has_active_or_unsafe_state()`在degraded时fail closed返回true；完整时直接读取scope summary，绝不只检查
当前窗口。它是read predicate，不授权run、cleanup或任何control mutation。

#### 16.5.9 Exact error surface

```rust
/// failure/control status view的lineage、window、coverage、cross-link或field关系错误。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum FailureControlStatusViewError {
    /// lineage optional run/boundary/handle/generation不是合法closed shape。
    LineageShapeInvalid,
    /// 两个item不属于同一context / identity或compatible execution group。
    ItemLineageMismatch,
    /// source有fact但缺少environment identity，或identity与item不一致。
    EnvironmentIdentityRelationInvalid,
    /// failure status、kind、reason与supersession refs不满足canonical矩阵。
    FailureItemFieldRelationInvalid {
        /// 关系失败的canonical failure status。
        status: FailureClassificationStatus,
    },
    /// control status、kind、reason、summary或failure ref不满足canonical矩阵。
    ControlItemFieldRelationInvalid {
        /// 关系失败的canonical control status。
        status: ControlFactStatus,
    },
    /// control kind与context/boundary/run lineage不满足closed matrix。
    ControlKindLineageInvalid {
        /// 关系失败的control kind。
        control_kind: SandboxControlKind,
    },
    /// fact或relation cursor为零、晚于scope watermark或发生非法顺序。
    TruthCursorRelationInvalid,
    /// item、relation或view observation time违反monotonic contract。
    TimestampRelationInvalid,
    /// requested limit或configured ceiling为零，或request超过ceiling。
    WindowLimitInvalid,
    /// merged window返回items超过validated limit。
    WindowLimitExceeded,
    /// merged window未按truth cursor + kind + canonical ref严格排序。
    WindowOrderingInvalid,
    /// merged window包含重复failure/control ref。
    DuplicateWindowItem,
    /// empty window错误声明has_more或first/last cursor不匹配items。
    WindowFieldRelationInvalid,
    /// page anchor shape、snapshot identity、after key或consumed count关系不合法。
    PageAnchorRelationInvalid,
    /// anchor consumed、scope total、returned count、limit或has_more覆盖关系不合法。
    PageCoverageRelationInvalid,
    /// scope total/active/pending/unsafe count关系不合法。
    ScopeSummaryCountInvalid,
    /// scope summary、view binding或window不属于同一context / watermark / audit linkage。
    ScopeSnapshotRelationInvalid,
    /// typed read gap缺少safe reason、context错配或expected cursor越过scope。
    ReadGapRelationInvalid,
    /// read gap set为空、kind重复或非canonical order。
    ReadGapSetInvalid,
    /// degraded reason未与typed read gap形成逐项一一映射。
    ReadGapReasonMappingInvalid,
    /// complete factory错误收到read gap，或degraded factory缺少gap。
    SourceCompletenessRelationInvalid,
    /// current window带关联ref但缺少matching proof，或proof没有source item。
    CrossLinkProofCardinalityInvalid,
    /// cross-link的refs、status、kind、lineage、cursor或audit relation不一致。
    CrossLinkRelationInvalid {
        /// 关系失败的closed cross-link kind。
        link_kind: FailureControlCrossLinkKind,
    },
    /// 同一cross-link source/target relation出现重复proof。
    DuplicateCrossLinkProof,
    /// view identity binding不是同context、同cursor的committed status snapshot。
    ViewBindingRelationInvalid,
    /// source summary证明scope为空，但window、identity或degraded关系不支持empty。
    EmptyScopeRelationInvalid,
}
```

错误不得携带SQL、storage key、page token、raw row、SDK/HTTP/IO cause、external body、path、endpoint、
operator note或existence-sensitive hidden ref。repository unavailable、invalid public cursor、authorization、
visibility与transport failure由Step 7/8的application/public error owner映射；本enum只描述已进入contracts
source后的结构完整性。不得把上述variant折叠成自由文本再由service解析。

#### 16.5.10 `FailureControlStatusView`

```rust
/// 一个context的bounded failure/control committed status read model。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct FailureControlStatusView {
    /// existing materialized status snapshot identity。
    view_ref: FailureControlStatusViewRef,
    /// view唯一归属的controlled execution context。
    context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
    /// fact scope非空时必有；合法pre-acceptance empty scope可为空。
    environment_identity_ref: Option<ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef>,
    /// 当前response携带的bounded merged item window。
    window: FailureControlStatusWindow,
    /// 整个committed context scope的body-free aggregate summary；degraded gap时可缺失。
    scope_summary: Option<FailureControlCommittedScopeSummary>,
    /// source read gap投影出的非空caller-safe reason set；complete view为None。
    degraded_reasons: Option<StatusViewDegradedReasonSet>,
    /// source context/snapshot已有的audit linkage；不是query动作audit。
    source_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    /// view mapper observation time。
    observed_at: Timestamp,
}

impl FailureControlStatusView {
    /// 从完整、relation-checked committed source构造non-degraded view。
    pub fn from_committed_snapshot(
        source: FailureControlStatusSourceSnapshot,
    ) -> Result<Self, FailureControlStatusViewError>;

    /// 从带typed read gaps的checked source构造degraded view。
    pub fn from_degraded_snapshot(
        source: FailureControlStatusSourceSnapshot,
    ) -> Result<Self, FailureControlStatusViewError>;

    /// 返回existing materialized view identity。
    pub fn view_ref(&self) -> &FailureControlStatusViewRef;
    /// 返回owning context identity。
    pub fn context_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionContextRef;
    /// 返回optional environment identity。
    pub fn environment_identity_ref(&self) -> Option<&ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef>;
    /// 返回bounded merged item window。
    pub fn window(&self) -> &FailureControlStatusWindow;
    /// 返回optional entire committed scope summary；complete view恒为Some。
    pub fn scope_summary(&self) -> Option<&FailureControlCommittedScopeSummary>;
    /// 返回caller-safe degraded reason set；complete view为None。
    pub fn degraded_reasons(&self) -> Option<&StatusViewDegradedReasonSet>;
    /// 返回source snapshot已有audit linkage。
    pub fn source_audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;
    /// 返回view mapper observation time。
    pub fn observed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
    /// 判断source是否存在typed read gap。
    pub fn is_degraded(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断完整scope是否明确没有failure/control fact。
    pub fn is_empty_scope(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断整个scope是否存在active/pending/unsafe状态；degraded时fail closed为true。
    pub fn has_active_or_unsafe_state(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断当前window是否还有正常下一页；不表示degraded。
    pub fn has_more(&self) -> bool;
}
```

`from_committed_snapshot`只接受`source.is_degraded() == false`并固定`degraded_reasons = None`；
`from_degraded_snapshot`只接受non-empty typed gap set，并由
`FailureControlReadGapSet::to_degraded_reasons()`生成一一对应的
`Some(StatusViewDegradedReasonSet)`，caller不能另传第二份reason。
两条factory都从`source.view_binding()`复制view ref与source audit ref；不接收独立view ref、audit ref、
cursor、count或observed time覆盖source。summary若存在，其audit必须已与binding一致。

`is_empty_scope()`要求non-degraded、summary为Some且两个total为0、window为空、identity可空且
`has_more=false`。
`has_active_or_unsafe_state()`在degraded时固定true；完整时只读取summary的active/pending/unsafe counts。
因此：`PendingInput + Unknown`始终active，`IgnoredDuplicate/Completed`本身不unsafe，`Conflicted/Failed`
unsafe，`Accepted` pending。helper不解释run结果、不授权cleanup或control effect。

#### 16.5.11 Field source closure

| target field / carrier | exact source | relation guard | forbidden substitute |
|---|---|---|---|
| `view_ref` | committed status snapshot index / materialization writer | binding context + watermark + audit一致 | query id generator、context/failure ref转换、page cursor |
| `context_ref` | required Query selector + committed index exact match | binding/summary/items/gaps全等 | 从第一条item、view ref文本或repository key猜测 |
| `environment_identity_ref` | committed context relation | scope total非零即Some；每项exact equal | latest identity scan、run/boundary ref反推 |
| failure item fields | exact committed `FailureClassification` row | §16.5.3 matrix + truth cursor/audit/time | raw adapter error、latest failure、status字符串 |
| control item fields | exact committed `ControlFact` row | §16.5.4 status/kind/lineage matrix | effect/disposition重建、runtime result、latest control |
| merged order | formal context failure/control committed index | one combined limit、stable tuple order | 两次各自limit查询后拼接、timestamp order |
| page anchor | Step 8 cursor absent/present经Step 7验证后映射；continued绑定view ref/watermark/after/consumed | first/continued按total/limit精确覆盖；continued可合法exhausted | caller bool、cursor文本解析、裸truth cursor |
| scope counts | same-snapshot indexed aggregate；degraded typed gap时可None | complete必须Some；有值时`u64` inequalities + watermark | 零值placeholder、current page length、cached UI count、`u32` truncate |
| cross-link proof | same-snapshot relation index / committed relation row | exact refs/lineage/status/relation cursor/audit | scan latest matching ref、reason解析、page扩容 |
| degraded reasons | typed `FailureControlReadGapSet` | 1:1 order/value mapping为`Option<StatusViewDegradedReasonSet>`；complete为None | 裸`Vec`、caller bool、repository error Display、visibility reason |
| source audit ref | committed status binding + summary existing linkage | 两者exact equal | query trace、read log、post-query append audit |
| `observed_at` | application clock after complete read mapping | 不早于binding/summary/item/relation times | backend clock、row insertion time、page cursor |

view不保存cross-link proof与read-gap kind本体，因为它们是source validation carrier；只保存需要公开的item、
scope summary与safe degraded reasons。projection若保存view body，必须完整保存上述public字段以及page/window
identity，不能只保存`latest_control_status`或第一条failure。

#### 16.5.12 Query、materialization 与 no-second-truth boundary

| path | allowed | forbidden |
|---|---|---|
| Query access | 先消费application query access decision；NotVisible/Restricted不构造或泄漏view body | 把visibility写进view、由missing view推断对象不存在 |
| selector | required exact `context_ref` + validated page request | optional direct `failure_ref`、全仓scan、从ref文本解析context |
| source read | 同一snapshot读取binding、merged page、scope summary与needed relation proofs | 分别读取latest failure/control；query-side refresh/repair |
| view assembly | 调用本节source/view factory，返回Visible/Empty/Degraded及page info | classify failure、choose control winner、执行effect、补audit |
| status materialization | truth writer或projection maintenance在write flow中预生成/提交new view binding | Query生成view ref、query更新status snapshot、query分配truth cursor |
| continuation | Step 7 repository cursor -> Step 8 opaque public page cursor | truth cursor、version、timestamp、trace id充page cursor |
| projection | 保存/读取checked view，stale时显式surface | stale query触发rebuild、last-known伪fresh、view反写truth |

`GetFailureControlStatus` current request在Step 8回归时必须改为：required
`context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef`，required bounded `page_request`（可用`cursor=None`表示第一页），
删除历史optional `failure_ref`。response仍是`SandboxQueryResponseDto<FailureControlStatusViewDto>`并携带
`page_info`；不是把每条item改成顶层`SandboxPagedResponseDto`，因为scope summary、view identity与degraded
surface属于整个窗口。`page_info.returned_count`必须等于`view.window.returned_count()`，`has_more`必须一致。

public cursor的wire body与签名/完整性由Step 8 contracts owner定义，repository cursor的codec / validation由
Step 7 application port owner定义，物理retention数值由Step 14/正式`04`承接；但三层都必须满足本节不可放宽
的语义：cursor绑定`context_ref + view_ref + scope_truth_cursor + after order key + consumed_count`，任一字段
篡改、wrong context或snapshot不存在都返回invalid/expired cursor surface，不能降级读取latest。cursor有效期内
durable与fake必须都能读取同一个immutable status snapshot及relation index；snapshot被retention回收后只能
拒绝cursor并要求caller从第一页重新开始，不能将旧anchor套到新watermark。当前正式`04`尚无专门page cursor
retention item，此项登记为Step 14定向重验，不在本节伪造TTL。

#### 16.5.13 Historical conflict ledger

| historical material | current disposition | reason |
|---|---|---|
| optional `failure_ref` direct selector | invalidated_pending_step8_rewrite | 无anchor-window/index与context visibility语义；当前只支持context scope。 |
| single optional failure + `control_fact_refs` | invalidated | 丢失多failure状态、control状态与跨页顺序。 |
| `latest_control_status` | invalidated | timestamp winner丢失duplicate/conflict/并存control。 |
| `lease_status` | moved_to_§16.6 | lease/cleanup没有failure/control一对一关系。 |
| unbounded failure/control `Vec` | invalidated | append-only scope无硬上限，违反bounded query。 |
| `expected_*_count: u32` | invalidated | 长期scope可溢出；summary使用`u64`。 |
| caller-selected `Incomplete + reasons` | invalidated | reason不能证明source gap；改为typed read gap。 |
| required environment identity | invalidated | pre-acceptance合法empty context尚无identity。 |
| source audit as read audit | invalidated | Query不append business audit；字段只链接committed source snapshot。 |
| `failure_ref` on `Completed`一律禁止 | invalidated | Completed不能新attach，但必须单调保留Accepted阶段已提交的matching ref。 |
| `Other` control的duplicate/conflict fact | invalidated | strict guard在decision形成前拒绝`Other`，不存在合法committed fact。 |
| context-only `Deny` control fact | invalidated | pre-launch effect为`Unsupported`并由failure/policy truth承接；只有完整run lineage的`Deny`可形成control fact。 |

本表只登记本对象已经确定、但由后续Step拥有的消费义务。所有行当前均为
`downstream_revalidation_pending`；这不是允许实现者临时补schema的占位，也不表示历史Step仍有current
效力。进入对应Step时必须先读取本节，再在该Step中给出exact Rust-facing callable / DTO / flow / storage /
error / test contract，并逐项关闭本表。

| downstream owner | 必须消费的current contract | 必须删除或禁止的historical path | closure evidence required in that Step | 当前状态 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Step 7 Trait / Port / Adapter | 为`GetFailureControlStatus`定义typed source reader：required context、validated `FailureControlPageAnchor`、`FailureControlWindowLimit`，返回同一immutable snapshot的binding、merged window、scope summary、needed cross-link proofs与typed gaps；另为write-side truth/projection maintenance定义status snapshot materialization callable和cursor codec/validation surface。 | generic `load_status_snapshot`后由service拆latest rows；opaque-ref-only selector；query生成view ref；fake私有map反推summary或proof。 | 每个callable的exact input/output/error/async/UoW、first/continued cursor branch、writer调用方及fake/durable parity全部列明。 | `downstream_revalidation_pending` |
| Step 8 Protocol | request固定为required `context_ref + page_request`；response保留`SandboxQueryResponseDto<FailureControlStatusViewDto>`并定义view、merged item union、`u64` scope summary、optional identity、degraded reasons和page info完整schema；public cursor保持opaque且受完整性保护。 | optional `failure_ref`；两个无界list；`latest_control_status`；`lease_status`；`PendingInput`映成degraded；truth cursor充page cursor。 | request/response每字段required/optional、source、wire enum、cursor invalid/expired surface和stored/public mapper逐项闭合。 | `downstream_revalidation_pending` |
| Step 9 Function Flow | query顺序固定为access decision -> page request validation/cursor decode -> same-snapshot source read -> source factory -> view factory -> DTO/page info；`Visible/Empty/Degraded`分别由checked source决定，全程no-write/no-repair/no-audit-append。相关truth write/projection maintenance flow必须在commit边界物化新binding、merged index、aggregate与cross-link relation。 | missing failure直接`Empty`；`Unknown`当success；分别读latest failure/control；query refresh；读取时append业务audit。 | first、continued、exhausted、typed gap、invalid/expired cursor、integrity error和concurrent new truth分支各有独立调用图与事务顺序。 | `downstream_revalidation_pending` |
| Step 10 State Matrix | `FailureControlStatusView`、binding、window、gap与proof均不是新状态机；item只复用`FailureClassificationStatus`和`ControlFactStatus`owning graph。`PendingInput`是active truth而非degraded；`Other`及context-only`Deny`无合法control state。 | `Incomplete`第二状态owner；view status反写failure/control；duplicate/completed丢失；context-only deny / `Other`合法化。 | 主语筛选、复用状态矩阵、非法组合和no-transition结论与§12.1~§12.3逐项一致。 | `downstream_revalidation_pending` |
| Step 11 Persistence / Consistency | 定义immutable status snapshot store、一个context-scoped merged `(truth_cursor, item kind, named ref)` index、`u64` scope aggregate、cross-link relation index及原子materialization writer；cursor有效期内按view ref/watermark读取同一snapshot，fake与durable执行同一coverage校验。 | 两个独立limit查询再拼接；latest scan；zero summary placeholder；row-only view；read repair；snapshot回收后把旧anchor套到latest。 | logical schema、unique/ordering key、writer transaction order、retention/delete约束、reader consistency和fake/durable parity闭合。 | `downstream_revalidation_pending` |
| Step 12 Error / Recovery | contracts integrity error、typed read gap、repository unavailable、access denial、invalid cursor和expired cursor保持不同surface；已知malformed row进入migration/quarantine，不得降级掩盖。 | raw SQL/IO/SDK error进入reason；所有缺失都映`Degraded`；cursor失败回退第一页/latest；非法`Other`row正常展示。 | object/application/public error一一映射、retryability、safe reason来源、migration/quarantine与禁止恢复路径闭合。 | `downstream_revalidation_pending` |

### 16.6 `CleanupReadinessView` current canonical contract

`CleanupReadinessView` 是 `GetCleanupReadiness` 与 `SandboxReadProjection` 消费的
contracts-owned、body-free、immutable read model。它投影一个已提交 `CleanupGuard` 的 exact
execution lineage、canonical guard status、公开 blocker、release authorization / completion position
以及 owner closure status；它不重新执行 `CleanupSafetyGuard`、不调用 backend release、不推进
lease / orphan / boundary / handle，也不把 query 读取结果写回 cleanup truth。

本对象关闭 named type #24，并关闭 support family #39 的 cleanup 分支。canonical owner 固定为
`crates/contracts/src/views.rs`。domain-only `CleanupEvidenceSnapshot`、`InvestigationHandoffSummary`、
`CleanupSafetyDecision`、`CleanupReleaseBasis`、`CleanupCompletionBasis`、
`CleanupReleaseFailureBasis` 与 `CleanupBlockingReasonSet` 只参与 source mapper 校验，不进入 public
view 字段；否则会形成 `contracts -> domain` 反向依赖。

#### 16.6.1 Capability、记录边界与 historical conflict

本 view 回答的是“该 exact cleanup guard 当前处于什么 readiness / release closure position，哪些已提交
owner truth仍阻断 release”。它不回答“现在是否应创建 cleanup guard”，也不把“尚无 guard”解释成安全。

| capability | current owner | view允许表达 | view禁止承担 |
|---|---|---|---|
| cleanup readiness truth | `CleanupGuard` | exact guard ref、status、status reason、blocker | 重跑 safety evaluation、选择新 status |
| release authorization | `CleanupReleaseBasis` persisted in guard | 已授权 / 未授权 position与authorization audit/time | 构造basis、调用release adapter |
| release completion/failure | guard persisted completion/failure basis | body-free release summary ref或failure summary ref、finite phase | 根据adapter raw body判断成功 /失败 |
| owner closure | boundary / handle / optional lease / orphan committed truth | canonical status snapshot及same-basis closure relation | 推进owner status、把部分完成写成Completed |
| investigation / handoff / redline | guard evidence、investigation summary、accepted coverage与current完整redline lineage | finite blocker kind、全部typed subject refs、safe reason与ordered status set | 保存正文、ticket、receipt body、安全调查生命周期；选择single/latest redline |
| read completeness | committed cleanup status snapshot index | complete / typed degraded gap、source cursor与audit linkage | 用missing row、repository error或caller bool伪造degraded |

历史 C11 与旧 Step 7~17 只保留为 `H16.6 historical_material`。以下口径全部失效：

1. `from_cleanup_guard(cleanup_guard, lease)` 只加载两个对象，无法证明 handle / boundary / optional orphan
   已消费同一 completion basis，也无法表达 partial handle 无 lease row 的合法路径。
2. `visible_cleanup_status` 与 `blocks_release()` 会把 `Allowed` 未授权、已授权待release、release confirmed待
   owner closure和release failure四种不同位置压成一个布尔结论。
3. “no guard -> Empty” 不能证明没有 cleanup obligation；只有 committed scope absence proof 才能形成
   `Empty` query surface，而且 empty 绝不等于 release permitted。
4. `PendingInvestigation` 是 canonical owner truth，不是 read degradation。只有 source read gap才能产生
   degraded view。
5. 旧 persistence row把 `handoff_status/redline_status/lease_status` 当作 `CleanupGuard` columns；current
   truth保存 exact evidence / relation basis，view必须从同一 committed snapshot投影，不能扫描 latest。
6. stable cleanup lineage中的single optional redline会在同一context出现第二条containment时改变lineage identity，并
   遗漏active / Terminal owner；current read contract把redline移出stable lineage，改为guard accepted coverage与
   same-snapshot current complete coverage双层校验，不保留single-redline兼容字段。

#### 16.6.2 Contracts-only execution lineage

cleanup guard 一旦存在，就必须绑定完整 boundary / handle / pre-bound lease identity；run与persisted lease row
可以合法缺失。public lineage显式区分“lease identity存在”和“lease row存在”，不能用 optional lease ref混淆。

```rust
/// cleanup readiness view使用的body-free exact execution lineage。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct CleanupReadinessLineage {
    /// owning accepted controlled execution context ref。
    context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
    /// owning active execution environment identity ref。
    environment_identity_ref: ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef,
    /// completed / terminal source的exact run；boundary-only source为None。
    run_ref: Option<ControlledExecutionRunRef>,
    /// exact coherent boundary ref。
    boundary_ref: CoherentBoundaryRef,
    /// exact isolation environment handle ref。
    isolation_handle_ref: IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef,
    /// handle预绑定的exact lease identity；即使lease row尚未persist也必有。
    lease_ref: LeaseRecordRef,
    /// 当前snapshot是否存在exact lease row。
    lease_record_present: bool,
    /// optional exact orphan recovery record ref。
    orphan_record_ref: Option<OrphanRecoveryRecordRef>,
    /// 全组共用的canonical generation ref。
    generation_ref: ResourceRef,
}

impl CleanupReadinessLineage {
    /// 从已提交cleanup guard及其same-snapshot owner relation构造lineage。
    pub fn try_from_committed_relation(
        context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
        environment_identity_ref: ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef,
        run_ref: Option<ControlledExecutionRunRef>,
        boundary_ref: CoherentBoundaryRef,
        isolation_handle_ref: IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef,
        lease_ref: LeaseRecordRef,
        lease_record_present: bool,
        orphan_record_ref: Option<OrphanRecoveryRecordRef>,
        generation_ref: ResourceRef,
    ) -> Result<Self, CleanupReadinessViewError>;

    /// 返回owning context ref。
    pub fn context_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionContextRef;
    /// 返回owning environment identity ref。
    pub fn environment_identity_ref(&self) -> &ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef;
    /// 返回optional exact run ref。
    pub fn run_ref(&self) -> Option<&ControlledExecutionRunRef>;
    /// 返回exact boundary ref。
    pub fn boundary_ref(&self) -> &CoherentBoundaryRef;
    /// 返回exact isolation handle ref。
    pub fn isolation_handle_ref(&self) -> &IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef;
    /// 返回pre-bound exact lease identity。
    pub fn lease_ref(&self) -> &LeaseRecordRef;
    /// 判断same-snapshot中是否存在persisted lease row。
    pub fn lease_record_present(&self) -> bool;
    /// 返回optional orphan recovery ref。
    pub fn orphan_record_ref(&self) -> Option<&OrphanRecoveryRecordRef>;
    /// 返回canonical generation ref。
    pub fn generation_ref(&self) -> &ResourceRef;
}
```

factory必须验证全部named ref非空且kind正确。`lease_record_present = false`只允许boundary-only partial handle
source，且`run_ref / orphan_record_ref`均为None；有run或orphan时必须为true。lineage本身不根据ref文本推导
context，也不接受`backend_handle_ref`或redline ref。多redline的身份、完整性与status全部由§16.6.6 coverage owner
status set承接，不能通过扩展lineage字段恢复single/latest语义。

#### 16.6.3 Finite public readiness phase

`CleanupGuardStatus`继续是唯一持久化状态 owner。下列 phase 是由同一 committed guard字段机械投影的
contracts-only有限位置，不是第二状态机，不得被保存回 domain truth。

```rust
/// cleanup guard在read surface上的有限release closure位置；不是持久化状态机。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum CleanupReadinessPhase {
    /// guard仍等待evidence或investigation，尚无release authorization。
    Pending,
    /// guard被明确block，且不存在active release failure proof。
    Blocked,
    /// guard为Allowed，但尚未形成persisted release authorization basis。
    ReadyForAuthorization,
    /// exact release basis已持久化，backend confirmation尚未形成。
    ReleaseAuthorized,
    /// definitive release failure已持久化，必须新evidence /新guard恢复。
    ReleaseFailed,
    /// backend teardown及release owners已确认，但至少一条redline仍等待investigation handoff完成。
    PostReleaseInvestigationHold,
    /// backend teardown及release owners已确认，但active或Terminal redline持续阻断closure。
    PostReleaseBlocked,
    /// guard与全部owner已按同一completion basis完成收束。
    Completed,
}
```

机械派生矩阵固定如下：

| guard status | release basis | completion basis | failure basis | public phase |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PendingEvidence | PendingInvestigation` | None | None | None | `Pending` |
| `Blocked` | None | None | None | `Blocked` |
| `Blocked` | Some | None | Some(matching) | `ReleaseFailed` |
| `Allowed` | None | None | None | `ReadyForAuthorization` |
| `Allowed` | Some | None | None | `ReleaseAuthorized` |
| `PendingInvestigation` | Some | Some(matching) | None | `PostReleaseInvestigationHold` |
| `Blocked` | Some | Some(matching) | None | `PostReleaseBlocked` |
| `Completed` | Some | Some(matching) | None | `Completed` |

任何其它组合都是 integrity error，不得映为最接近的phase。尤其 `Allowed` 不等于“release已调用”，
matching confirmation、owner closure与guard `Completed`必须在同一UoW提交；任何committed
`Allowed + completion basis`都是half-commit integrity error。`Blocked + release failure`不能退化成普通policy
block；`Blocked + matching completion basis`则必须精确映射为`PostReleaseBlocked`，不能与release failure混淆。

#### 16.6.4 Public blocker schema

public blocker只暴露有限kind、contracts-owned typed subject与owner-safe reason。它不暴露 mount、host、PID、
network locator、artifact正文、investigation note、backend raw error或domain-only rule enum。

```rust
/// cleanup readiness调用方可见的有限阻断类别。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum CleanupReadinessBlockerKind {
    /// required capture / observability material尚未达到安全状态或已失败。
    EvidenceUnsafe,
    /// required material handoff尚未完成、可重试或已失败。
    MaterialHandoffUnsafe,
    /// external investigation handoff尚未accepted、明确block或已失败。
    InvestigationUnsafe,
    /// forbidden external body marker仍要求保留现场与责任交接。
    ExternalBodyPreservationRequired,
    /// active security redline仍阻断cleanup。
    RedlineActive,
    /// orphan owner尚未满足release前置。
    OrphanActive,
    /// isolation handle owner relation尚未满足release前置或closure。
    EnvironmentOwnerPending,
    /// definitive backend release failure要求新evidence恢复。
    ReleaseFailure,
}

/// cleanup blocker可公开指向的closed typed subject。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum CleanupReadinessBlockerSubject {
    /// cleanup guard自身。
    CleanupGuard(CleanupGuardRef),
    /// exact observability material truth。
    ObservabilityMaterial(ObservabilityMaterialRef),
    /// exact handoff truth。
    MaterialHandoff(HandoffFactRef),
    /// body-free external investigation target。
    Investigation(ExternalSourceRef),
    /// exact redline containment truth。
    Redline(RedlineContainmentRef),
    /// exact orphan recovery truth。
    Orphan(OrphanRecoveryRecordRef),
    /// exact isolation handle truth。
    IsolationHandle(IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef),
}

/// 一条由cleanup owner truth机械投影的caller-safe blocker。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct CleanupReadinessBlocker {
    /// finite blocker kind。
    blocker_kind: CleanupReadinessBlockerKind,
    /// exact body-free blocking subject。
    subject: CleanupReadinessBlockerSubject,
    /// owner-provided caller-safe reason。
    reason: SandboxReason,
}

impl CleanupReadinessBlocker {
    /// 从validated owner blocker构造public blocker。
    pub fn try_from_owner_reason(
        blocker_kind: CleanupReadinessBlockerKind,
        subject: CleanupReadinessBlockerSubject,
        reason: SandboxReason,
    ) -> Result<Self, CleanupReadinessViewError>;

    /// 返回finite blocker kind。
    pub fn blocker_kind(&self) -> CleanupReadinessBlockerKind;
    /// 返回typed blocking subject。
    pub fn subject(&self) -> &CleanupReadinessBlockerSubject;
    /// 返回caller-safe reason。
    pub fn reason(&self) -> &SandboxReason;
}

/// 按public kind和subject固定顺序保存的非重复public cleanup blocker集合。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct CleanupReadinessBlockerSet(Vec<CleanupReadinessBlocker>);

impl CleanupReadinessBlockerSet {
    /// 构造允许为空、按`(blocker_kind, subject)` ordered-unique的blocker set；不自动排序或去重。
    pub fn try_new(
        blockers: Vec<CleanupReadinessBlocker>,
    ) -> Result<Self, CleanupReadinessViewError>;

    /// 构造没有guard blocker且current redline coverage为空或全部Released时使用的空集合。
    pub fn empty() -> Self;
    /// 返回固定顺序的不可变blocker切片。
    pub fn as_slice(&self) -> &[CleanupReadinessBlocker];
    /// 判断集合是否为空。
    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断是否包含definitive release failure。
    pub fn has_release_failure(&self) -> bool;

    /// 将guard-owned blockers与current complete redline blockers按canonical key合并。
    pub fn merge_current_redline_blockers(
        &self,
        redline_blockers: CleanupReadinessBlockerSet,
    ) -> Result<Self, CleanupReadinessViewError>;
}
```

effective blocker set由guard snapshot blockers与
`CleanupRedlineStatusObservationSet::to_public_blockers()`机械合并。`Pending | Blocked | ReleaseFailed |
PostReleaseInvestigationHold | PostReleaseBlocked`必须非空；`ReadyForAuthorization | Completed`必须为空。
`ReleaseAuthorized`在current coverage仍zero-row / all-Released时为空，出现authorization后strictly-late non-Released
redline时按exact ref非空；该blocker只阻断新use、context/material closure和safe声明，不撤销已授权teardown。

merge唯一键仍为`(blocker_kind, subject)`。两边出现相同key时只有完整blocker相等才允许保留一项；reason或subject
payload冲突返回`CleanupBlockerMappingInvalid`，不得last-writer-wins。domain blocker到public kind的映射必须在同一
snapshot source factory中按closed表执行；未知domain blocker kind是typed integrity error，不能塞入`Other`或reason文本。

public set的唯一键固定为`(blocker_kind, subject)`，canonical order固定为
`CleanupReadinessBlockerKind`声明顺序，再按`CleanupReadinessBlockerSubject`声明顺序及typed ref canonical
order。mapper先逐项完成closed mapping，再按public key形成set；合法domain set的映射必须保持一一可判定，若两项
映射为同一public key则返回`CleanupBlockerMappingInvalid`，不得折叠、覆盖或拼接reason。reason不进入唯一键。
domain `CleanupBlockingSubject`闭集中没有可投影为public `Capture`、`Lease`或`Boundary`的合法分支，
因此public subject union不声明这些不可达variant；capture、lease和boundary状态仍分别通过evidence、lineage与owner
snapshot可见，但不能被伪造成guard-owned blocker。

#### 16.6.5 Body-free release progress

release authorization、confirmation和definitive failure是同一个 persisted authorization attempt 的互斥进度。
public carrier只保留caller-safe summary、audit与time，不暴露backend handle source。

```rust
/// cleanup release attempt在read surface上的body-free persisted progress。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum CleanupReleaseProgress {
    /// guard尚未持久化release authorization。
    NotAuthorized,
    /// exact authorization已持久化，尚无terminal backend outcome。
    Authorized {
        /// authorization transition audit ref。
        authorization_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        /// authorization time。
        authorized_at: Timestamp,
    },
    /// matching backend release confirmation已持久化。
    Confirmed {
        /// original authorization audit ref。
        authorization_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        /// original authorization time。
        authorized_at: Timestamp,
        /// body-free isolation backend release summary ref。
        release_summary_ref: SafeSummaryRef,
        /// backend owner observation time。
        release_observed_at: Timestamp,
        /// completion basis audit ref。
        confirmation_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        /// completion basis confirmation time。
        confirmed_at: Timestamp,
    },
    /// matching definitive non-retryable release failure已持久化。
    Failed {
        /// original authorization audit ref。
        authorization_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        /// original authorization time。
        authorized_at: Timestamp,
        /// body-free isolation backend failure summary ref。
        failure_summary_ref: SafeSummaryRef,
        /// backend owner failure observation time。
        failure_observed_at: Timestamp,
        /// guard failure transition audit ref。
        failure_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        /// guard将attempt收束为blocked的time。
        failed_at: Timestamp,
    },
}

impl CleanupReleaseProgress {
    /// 从guard尚无release basis的validated snapshot构造未授权位置。
    pub fn not_authorized() -> Self;

    /// 从persisted release basis构造authorized位置。
    pub fn authorized(
        authorization_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        authorized_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, CleanupReadinessViewError>;

    /// 从matching completion basis构造confirmed位置。
    pub fn confirmed(
        authorization_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        authorized_at: Timestamp,
        release_summary_ref: SafeSummaryRef,
        release_observed_at: Timestamp,
        confirmation_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        confirmed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, CleanupReadinessViewError>;

    /// 从matching release failure basis构造failed位置。
    pub fn failed(
        authorization_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        authorized_at: Timestamp,
        failure_summary_ref: SafeSummaryRef,
        failure_observed_at: Timestamp,
        failure_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        failed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, CleanupReadinessViewError>;

    /// 判断release authorization是否已持久化。
    pub fn is_authorized(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断matching backend release是否已确认。
    pub fn is_confirmed(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断attempt是否由definitive failure终结。
    pub fn is_failed(&self) -> bool;
}
```

`release_summary_ref`与`failure_summary_ref`的source kind必须为`IsolationBackend`。时间关系固定为
`authorized_at <= release_observed_at <= confirmed_at`或
`authorized_at <= failure_observed_at <= failed_at`。confirmed与failed互斥；transport timeout、retryable、
unavailable、unknown和commit-unknown均不能构造`Failed`，必须保持`Authorized`并交由Step 11~13恢复。

phase与progress必须逐项一致：

| phase | release progress |
|---|---|
| `Pending | Blocked | ReadyForAuthorization` | `NotAuthorized` |
| `ReleaseAuthorized` | `Authorized` |
| `PostReleaseInvestigationHold | PostReleaseBlocked | Completed` | `Confirmed` |
| `ReleaseFailed` | `Failed` |

#### 16.6.6 Same-snapshot owner closure status

owner snapshot只复制exact owner ref、canonical status、truth cursor、latest audit ref与status time。它不保存
domain basis；同一completion basis的relation由§16.6.8 source proof验证。redline不是release completion owner，且同一
lineage可有`0..n`条containment；因此它不再进入singleton owner union，而由完整coverage与按coverage顺序逐项同构的
专用status observation set承接。空set只有在coverage index明确返回零行时合法。

```rust

pub struct CleanupOwnerStatusSnapshot {

    /// 从同一committed source snapshot中的exact owner rows构造status snapshot。

        lineage: &CleanupReadinessLineage,
        boundary: CleanupOwnerStatusObservation,
        isolation_handle: CleanupOwnerStatusObservation,
        lease: Option<CleanupOwnerStatusObservation>,
        orphan: Option<CleanupOwnerStatusObservation>,
        redline_coverage: RedlineContainmentCoverageSnapshot,
        redline_statuses: CleanupRedlineStatusObservationSet,

    /// 返回boundary committed observation。

    /// 返回isolation handle committed observation。

    /// 返回optional persisted lease observation。

    /// 返回optional orphan recovery observation。
    pub fn orphan(&self) -> Option<&CleanupOwnerStatusObservation>;
    /// 返回完整current redline lineage coverage。
    pub fn redline_coverage(&self) -> &RedlineContainmentCoverageSnapshot;
    /// 返回与coverage逐项同构的全部current redline status observations。
    pub fn redline_statuses(&self) -> &CleanupRedlineStatusObservationSet;
    /// 返回boundary canonical status。
    pub fn boundary_status(&self) -> CoherentBoundaryStatus;
    /// 返回isolation handle canonical status。

    /// 返回optional persisted lease status。
```
