```rust
    /// 返回optional orphan recovery status。
    pub fn orphan_status(&self) -> Option<OrphanRecoveryRecordStatus>;
    /// 判断boundary、handle、optional lease和optional orphan是否都达到cleanup closure终态。
    pub fn all_release_owners_closed(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断完整current redline coverage是否为空或全部Released。
    pub fn all_redlines_released(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断current coverage是否只含Released与至少一条HandoffPending。
    pub fn has_redline_investigation_hold(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断current coverage是否有active或Terminal containment。
    pub fn has_redline_hard_block(&self) -> bool;
}
```

cardinality与closure矩阵：

| owner | lineage cardinality | completed要求 | 禁止推导 |
|---|---|---|---|
| boundary | exactly one | `Released` | handle Released不能替代 |
| handle | exactly one | `Released` | backend summary不能替代 |
| lease | `lease_record_present`同构 | row存在时`Released`；不存在保持None | pre-bound lease ref不证明row存在 |
| orphan | `orphan_record_ref`同构 | record存在时`Recovered` | lease Released不证明orphan recovered |
| redline | complete coverage `0..n`，status set与refs exact ordered同构 | normal closure要求zero-row或全部`Released`；`Terminal`继续hard block；不属于release owner | 任一Released不证明其它redline或backend release；missing index不证明zero-row |

`all_release_owners_closed()`只检查前四行。`PostReleaseInvestigationHold | PostReleaseBlocked | Completed`均要求
返回true，因为backend teardown owner已按matching completion basis闭合；前三者之间只由完整redline status set区分。
其它phase返回true或携带confirmed progress都表示half-commit / source snapshot不一致。任何helper仅用于read consistency，
不得授权mutation、context closure或material disposal。

#### 16.6.7 Committed current binding 与 explicit absence proof

一个 context 可以有多个历史 cleanup attempt，但只能有一个 committed current cleanup-view binding。fresh
recovery创建新guard时，write UoW必须原子提交新binding并保留旧binding供exact guard历史查询。reader不得按
`opened_at / status_changed_at / ref`排序选择“最新”。

```rust
/// cleanup readiness immutable view materialization允许引用的exact committed source。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum CleanupReadinessMaterializationSource {
    /// cleanup guard row在本UoW中创建或发生canonical transition / accepted re-evaluation。
    CleanupGuard {
        /// exact current cleanup guard。
        cleanup_guard_ref: CleanupGuardRef,
        /// guard row在本UoW提交的truth cursor。
        guard_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
        /// guard transition / re-evaluation已有的audit linkage。
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    },
    /// exact redline truth在本UoW中创建或发生status / preservation / investigation变化。
    RedlineContainment {
        /// exact changed containment truth。
        redline_ref: RedlineContainmentRef,
        /// redline row在本UoW提交的truth cursor。
        redline_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
        /// redline transition已有的audit linkage。
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    },
}

/// 一次cleanup readiness materialization的non-empty ordered-unique committed source set。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct CleanupReadinessMaterializationSourceSet(
    Vec<CleanupReadinessMaterializationSource>,
);

impl CleanupReadinessMaterializationSourceSet {
    /// 构造source set；CleanupGuard在前，redline按完整coverage index顺序排列。

        sources: Vec<CleanupReadinessMaterializationSource>,

    /// 返回canonical ordered source rows。

    /// 判断本次materialization是否包含exact guard mutation source。
    pub fn contains_cleanup_guard(&self, cleanup_guard_ref: &CleanupGuardRef) -> bool;
    /// 返回全部redline mutation source的exact ref set；没有redline变化时为空set。
    pub fn redline_refs(
        &self,
    ) -> Result<RedlineContainmentRefSet, CleanupReadinessViewError>;
}

/// context scope在一个committed watermark上没有current cleanup guard/view的证明。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct CleanupReadinessAbsenceProof {
    /// 已通过query access decision的exact context。
    context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
    /// current cleanup binding index已完整读取到的truth watermark。
    scope_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
    /// index明确证明的current binding count，合法值固定为0。
    current_binding_count: u64,
    /// absence snapshot已有的audit linkage。
    source_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    /// same-snapshot index observation time。

}

impl CleanupReadinessAbsenceProof {
    /// 从完整current-binding index read构造absence proof。
    pub fn try_from_committed_index_absence(
        context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
        scope_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
        current_binding_count: u64,
        source_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        observed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, CleanupReadinessViewError>;

    /// 返回proof owning context。
    pub fn context_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionContextRef;
    /// 返回proof覆盖的truth watermark。
    pub fn scope_truth_cursor(&self) -> SandboxTruthCursor;
    /// 返回固定为0的current binding count。
    pub fn current_binding_count(&self) -> u64;
    /// 返回source audit linkage。
    pub fn source_audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;
    /// 返回index observation time。
    pub fn observed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
}
```

source set必须非空，所有source cursor必须等于`scope_truth_cursor`，且source audit ref均有效。若包含CleanupGuard，ref必须
等于binding guard；若包含redline，每个ref必须属于本次source snapshot的完整coverage，且同一ref只能出现一次。
redline-only set只允许已有current cleanup guard且该redline mutation不要求改变guard canonical status / phase /
guard-owned blocker时使用：典型是authorization已持久化、completion尚未形成期间的strictly-late detection，或同status且
不改变cleanup blocker语义的preservation / investigation source refresh。pre-authorization出现新redline时，detection
UoW必须在同一`Versioned<SafetyGroup>`上重评current guard并登记CleanupGuard + Redline两类source；不能提交
`ReadyForAuthorization`与active redline并存的view。post-release hold中，任何使HandoffPending变为Released / Terminal或
改变hold phase的transition也必须与guard redline-only re-evaluation / settlement同UoW并登记两类source。source set不能
伪造guard transition。guard-only set用于guard open / evaluation / authorization / failure / settlement；同一UoW同时改变
guard与redline时两类source必须都登记。
materialization audit由write-side status snapshot writer预生成并与view/binding同组提交，不等于query trace，也不要求
等于任一source owner audit。

`current_binding_count`非0时factory拒绝，不能用此proof隐藏现有guard。absence proof只授权 Query 返回
`surface_status=Empty, view=None`；它不构造`CleanupReadinessView`，也不证明没有partial environment、lease、
orphan、redline或其他cleanup obligation，更不授权release。若binding index不可用，必须返回typed degraded /
unavailable surface，不能伪造count 0。

current-context selector必须命中current binding；exact `cleanup_guard_ref` selector必须命中该guard自己的
immutable binding。两种selector都要求request context与binding context相等。selector、binding position与
lookup proof在contracts层固定如下，Step 8不得再用两个optional字段、caller bool或“latest guard”重建同一语义。

```rust
/// cleanup readiness只读入口允许使用的closed selector。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum CleanupReadinessSelector {
    /// 读取context当前唯一cleanup guard binding。
    CurrentForContext {
        /// 已通过query access decision的exact context。
        context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
    },
    /// 读取context下一个exact current或historical cleanup guard binding。
    ExactGuard {
        /// 已通过query access decision的exact context。
        context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
        /// caller明确选择的exact cleanup guard。
        cleanup_guard_ref: CleanupGuardRef,
    },
}

impl CleanupReadinessSelector {
    /// 创建current-context selector。
    pub fn current_for_context(
        context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
    ) -> Result<Self, CleanupReadinessViewError>;

    /// 创建exact-guard selector。
    pub fn exact_guard(
        context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
        cleanup_guard_ref: CleanupGuardRef,
    ) -> Result<Self, CleanupReadinessViewError>;

    /// 返回selector owning context。
    pub fn context_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionContextRef;
    /// 返回optional exact cleanup guard selector。
    pub fn cleanup_guard_ref(&self) -> Option<&CleanupGuardRef>;
    /// 判断本selector是否要求current binding。
    pub fn requires_current_binding(&self) -> bool;
}

/// exact binding相对current cleanup binding index的位置；不是cleanup状态机。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum CleanupReadinessBindingPosition {
    /// selected binding就是context当前唯一binding。
    Current,
    /// selected binding属于已被fresh recovery原子替换的historical guard。
    Historical,
}

/// selector命中binding时，由current与immutable exact index共同形成的proof。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct CleanupReadinessBindingSelectionProof {
    /// 本proof消费的closed selector。
    selector: CleanupReadinessSelector,
    /// selector命中的immutable binding。
    binding: CleanupReadinessViewBinding,
    /// selected binding相对current index的位置。
    binding_position: CleanupReadinessBindingPosition,
    /// lookup snapshot中current index指向的exact cleanup guard。
    current_cleanup_guard_ref: CleanupGuardRef,
    /// current与exact binding index已完整读取到的truth watermark。
    lookup_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
    /// lookup index已有的audit linkage；不是query audit。
    lookup_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    /// same-snapshot lookup observation time。
    observed_at: Timestamp,
}

impl CleanupReadinessBindingSelectionProof {
    /// 从同一snapshot中的current与immutable exact binding index构造selection proof。
    pub fn try_from_committed_indexes(
        selector: CleanupReadinessSelector,
        binding: CleanupReadinessViewBinding,
        binding_position: CleanupReadinessBindingPosition,
        current_cleanup_guard_ref: CleanupGuardRef,
        lookup_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
        lookup_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        observed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, CleanupReadinessViewError>;

    /// 返回checked selector。
    pub fn selector(&self) -> &CleanupReadinessSelector;
    /// 返回selected immutable binding。
    pub fn binding(&self) -> &CleanupReadinessViewBinding;
    /// 返回selected binding相对current index的位置。
    pub fn binding_position(&self) -> CleanupReadinessBindingPosition;
    /// 返回lookup snapshot中的current cleanup guard ref。
    pub fn current_cleanup_guard_ref(&self) -> &CleanupGuardRef;
    /// 返回binding index lookup coverage watermark。
    pub fn lookup_truth_cursor(&self) -> SandboxTruthCursor;
    /// 返回binding index audit linkage。
    pub fn lookup_audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;
    /// 返回lookup observation time。
    pub fn observed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
    /// 判断selected binding是否可进入current `SandboxReadProjection`。
    pub fn is_current_binding(&self) -> bool;
}

/// exact guard binding index在committed watermark上明确无匹配行的proof。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct CleanupReadinessExactAbsenceProof {
    /// 已通过query access decision的exact context。
    context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
    /// caller明确选择但index中不存在的cleanup guard。
    cleanup_guard_ref: CleanupGuardRef,
    /// exact immutable binding index已完整读取到的truth watermark。
    scope_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
    /// exact binding count，合法值固定为0。
    exact_binding_count: u64,
    /// same-snapshot current binding；context尚无current guard时为None。
    current_cleanup_guard_ref: Option<CleanupGuardRef>,
    /// absence index已有的audit linkage。
    source_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    /// same-snapshot index observation time。
    observed_at: Timestamp,
}

impl CleanupReadinessExactAbsenceProof {
    /// 从完整exact-binding index read构造absence proof。
    pub fn try_from_committed_exact_index_absence(
        context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
        cleanup_guard_ref: CleanupGuardRef,
        scope_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
        exact_binding_count: u64,
        current_cleanup_guard_ref: Option<CleanupGuardRef>,
        source_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        observed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, CleanupReadinessViewError>;

    /// 返回proof owning context。
    pub fn context_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionContextRef;
    /// 返回未命中的exact cleanup guard ref。
    pub fn cleanup_guard_ref(&self) -> &CleanupGuardRef;
    /// 返回proof coverage watermark。
    pub fn scope_truth_cursor(&self) -> SandboxTruthCursor;
    /// 返回固定为0的exact binding count。
    pub fn exact_binding_count(&self) -> u64;
    /// 返回same-snapshot optional current cleanup guard ref。
    pub fn current_cleanup_guard_ref(&self) -> Option<&CleanupGuardRef>;
    /// 返回absence index audit linkage。
    pub fn source_audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;
    /// 返回index observation time。
    pub fn observed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
}

/// binding lookup层的closed outcome；尚未读取cleanup truth或owner rows。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum CleanupReadinessBindingLookupOutcome {
    /// selector命中一个relation-checked binding。
    Found(CleanupReadinessBindingSelectionProof),
    /// current selector由完整index明确证明没有current binding。
    CurrentAbsent(CleanupReadinessAbsenceProof),
    /// exact selector由完整index明确证明没有该guard binding。
    ExactAbsent(CleanupReadinessExactAbsenceProof),
    /// binding index当前不可完整读取；不得构造view或absence proof。
    Unavailable {
        /// 未能完成lookup的exact selector。
        selector: CleanupReadinessSelector,
        /// 恰好一条`ViewBinding`的typed read gap set。
        read_gaps: CleanupReadGapSet,
    },
}

impl CleanupReadinessBindingLookupOutcome {
    /// 构造命中binding的lookup outcome。
    pub fn found(proof: CleanupReadinessBindingSelectionProof) -> Self;
    /// 构造current index明确为空的lookup outcome。
    pub fn current_absent(
        selector: &CleanupReadinessSelector,
        proof: CleanupReadinessAbsenceProof,
    ) -> Result<Self, CleanupReadinessViewError>;
    /// 构造exact immutable index明确无匹配行的lookup outcome。
    pub fn exact_absent(
        selector: &CleanupReadinessSelector,
        proof: CleanupReadinessExactAbsenceProof,
    ) -> Result<Self, CleanupReadinessViewError>;
    /// 构造binding index不可完整读取的no-view outcome。
    pub fn unavailable(
        selector: CleanupReadinessSelector,
        read_gaps: CleanupReadGapSet,
    ) -> Result<Self, CleanupReadinessViewError>;
}
```

selection proof执行以下closed规则：

1. `CurrentForContext`只接受`binding_position=Current`，且selector context、binding context与current index
   context完全相等，`current_cleanup_guard_ref == binding.cleanup_guard_ref`。
2. `ExactGuard`要求selector guard与binding guard完全相等。current index指向同一guard时position固定
   `Current`；指向另一guard时固定`Historical`，不得由caller传bool覆盖。
3. 只要exact immutable binding存在，same-snapshot current index也必须存在；exact binding存在但current index
   为空表示非法删除或half-committed replacement，返回integrity error，不能构造historical view。
4. `lookup_truth_cursor >= binding.scope_truth_cursor`，`observed_at >= binding.materialized_at`；所有ref与cursor
   必须通过shared typed validation。reader不能按time、ref、repository insertion order选择一行。
5. current absence只适用于`CurrentForContext`且current count固定0；exact absence只适用于matching
   `ExactGuard`且exact count固定0。两种proof不能互换，也不能从repository `NotFound`字符串推导。
6. `Unavailable`必须恰好包含一条与selector context一致的`ViewBinding` gap；exact selector的gap还必须带matching guard ref。
   它只允许Step 8返回`Unavailable, view=None`，不得被映为`Empty`或`Degraded`。

exact historical guard可以通过Query读取，但绝不能替代current binding进入`SandboxReadProjection`；projection
materialization与rebuild必须要求`selection_proof.is_current_binding() == true`。fresh recovery必须在同一write UoW
提交new guard、new current binding和旧binding的historical保留关系；任何可见“两个current”或“old current未被
替换”的状态都是integrity error。

#### 16.6.8 Same-snapshot release / owner relation proof

public owner statuses不足以证明它们消费同一 authorization / completion。source factory必须额外消费
contracts-only relation-index carrier；这些carrier只用于构造校验，不进入最终view body。application mapper从
已加载domain truth复制字段，不能把domain object传入`contracts`，也不能用三个caller bool替代relation rows。

```rust

/// cleanup guard、release attempt与owner rows在同一snapshot中的checked relation proof。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct CleanupReadinessRelationProof {
    /// proof唯一适用的cleanup guard。
    cleanup_guard_ref: CleanupGuardRef,
    /// proof唯一适用的execution lineage。
    lineage: CleanupReadinessLineage,
    /// guard canonical status。
    guard_status: CleanupGuardStatus,
    /// 由guard basis cardinality机械派生的public phase。
    readiness_phase: CleanupReadinessPhase,
    /// pre-authorization为None；其余phase为exact persisted authorization。
    attempt_key: Option<CleanupReleaseAttemptKey>,
    /// guard persisted basis机械投影出的release progress。
    release_progress: CleanupReleaseProgress,
    /// 同一UoW写入的exact owner relation rows。

    /// relation index已完整读取到的truth cursor。
    relation_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
}

impl CleanupReadinessRelationProof {
    /// 从contracts-owned committed relation index构造proof；不接收domain objects或caller bool。
    pub fn try_from_committed_relation_index(
        cleanup_guard_ref: CleanupGuardRef,
        lineage: CleanupReadinessLineage,
        guard_status: CleanupGuardStatus,
        readiness_phase: CleanupReadinessPhase,
        attempt_key: Option<CleanupReleaseAttemptKey>,
        release_progress: CleanupReleaseProgress,
        owner_relations: CleanupReleaseOwnerRelationSet,
        relation_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
    ) -> Result<Self, CleanupReadinessViewError>;

    /// 返回owning cleanup guard identity。
    pub fn cleanup_guard_ref(&self) -> &CleanupGuardRef;
    /// 返回checked execution lineage。
    pub fn lineage(&self) -> &CleanupReadinessLineage;
    /// 返回canonical cleanup guard status。
    pub fn guard_status(&self) -> CleanupGuardStatus;
    /// 返回机械派生的public phase。
    pub fn readiness_phase(&self) -> CleanupReadinessPhase;
    /// 返回optional exact release attempt key。
    pub fn attempt_key(&self) -> Option<&CleanupReleaseAttemptKey>;
    /// 返回persisted release progress。
    pub fn release_progress(&self) -> &CleanupReleaseProgress;
    /// 返回exact owner relation rows。
    pub fn owner_relations(&self) -> &CleanupReleaseOwnerRelationSet;
    /// 返回relation index coverage cursor。
    pub fn relation_truth_cursor(&self) -> SandboxTruthCursor;
}
```

relation row factory先校验subject/status variant同构，再按kind执行closed matrix：

| kind | required subject/status | required progress |
|---|---|---|
| `Authorization` | guard `Allowed`、handle `ReleasePending`、optional orphan `Recovering` | `Authorized`，且audit/time等于attempt key |
| `Completion` | boundary `Released`、handle `Released`、optional lease `Released`、optional orphan `Recovered`；不为cleanup guard写瞬时status row | 所有row使用同一`Confirmed` progress |
| `Failure` | guard `Blocked`、optional orphan `Failed` | 所有row使用同一`Failed` progress |

set拒绝duplicate `(relation_kind, subject)`、混合attempt key、同kind混合progress、非canonical order和任一row
cursor晚于proof cursor；同一subject在不同kind下必须保留独立row，不能用completion / failure覆盖authorization。
proof再按
phase验证exact cardinality：`Pending | Blocked | ReadyForAuthorization`要求attempt=None、NotAuthorized、empty set；
`ReleaseAuthorized`要求attempt=Some且Authorization rows覆盖guard/handle/optional orphan；`ReleaseFailed`要求
Authorization rows仍在并追加Failure rows覆盖guard/optional orphan；`PostReleaseInvestigationHold |
PostReleaseBlocked | Completed`都要求Authorization rows与Completion rows同时存在，Completion按lineage覆盖
boundary/handle/optional lease/optional orphan，guard snapshot自身必须携带matching Confirmed progress。relation index保留
authorization rows，不用completion/failure rows覆盖历史关系，也不为guard写会随post-release hold重评而变化的
Completion status row。

current write contract要求matching confirmation UoW把release-owner closure、guard的`Completed`或两种post-release
hold结果、relation rows与immutable view binding原子提交。任何`Allowed + completion basis`、Confirmed progress但owner
未全Released、post-release / Completed guard缺Completion owner rows、relation row status与owner snapshot不等，都返回
`CleanupHalfCommittedConfirmation` integrity error。known wrong generation / backend target、late confirmation覆盖failure或
同一attempt同时有completion/failure也一律报错；即使projection stale或reader部分不可用也不能把已知冲突降级展示。
所有relation cursor必须不晚于binding cursor。后续redline-only re-evaluation只提交新guard row与新immutable view
binding，并继续引用原exact Completion owner rows；它不得覆盖owner rows、重放adapter或改变attempt key。

#### 16.6.9 Typed cleanup read gap

```rust
/// cleanup readiness source读取中缺失的closed dependency类别。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum CleanupReadGapKind {
    /// current/exact binding index暂不可完整读取。
    ViewBinding,
    /// cleanup guard row或其embedded basis暂不可完整读取。
    CleanupTruth,
    /// boundary / handle / optional lease / orphan或完整redline coverage/status rows暂不可完整读取。
    OwnerTruth,
    /// same-authorization / completion / failure relation index暂不可验证。
    ReleaseRelation,
    /// current cleanup materialization source不可用、stale或无法证明覆盖selected binding。
    ProjectionSource,
}

/// 一个可安全分类、但不能伪装完整cleanup readiness的typed source gap。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct CleanupReadGap {
    /// 缺失dependency的closed类别。
    gap_kind: CleanupReadGapKind,
    /// gap唯一适用的context。
    context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
    /// gap适用的exact cleanup guard；binding gap可为None。
    cleanup_guard_ref: Option<CleanupGuardRef>,
    /// source binding要求覆盖到的truth watermark。
    required_through_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
    /// reader能够安全证明已覆盖到的watermark；完全不可用时为None。
    available_through_cursor: Option<SandboxTruthCursor>,
    /// mapper允许对caller暴露的安全原因。
    reason: SandboxReason,
}

impl CleanupReadGap {
    /// 从formal reader的typed disposition构造gap。
    pub fn try_from_reader_disposition(
        gap_kind: CleanupReadGapKind,
        context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
        cleanup_guard_ref: Option<CleanupGuardRef>,
        required_through_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
        available_through_cursor: Option<SandboxTruthCursor>,
        reason: SandboxReason,
    ) -> Result<Self, CleanupReadinessViewError>;

    /// 返回gap kind。
    pub fn gap_kind(&self) -> CleanupReadGapKind;
    /// 返回owning context。
    pub fn context_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionContextRef;
    /// 返回optional exact cleanup guard identity。
    pub fn cleanup_guard_ref(&self) -> Option<&CleanupGuardRef>;
    /// 返回required coverage watermark。
    pub fn required_through_cursor(&self) -> SandboxTruthCursor;
    /// 返回optional available watermark。
    pub fn available_through_cursor(&self) -> Option<SandboxTruthCursor>;
    /// 返回caller-safe gap reason。
    pub fn reason(&self) -> &SandboxReason;
}

/// 非空、ordered-unique cleanup readiness read gap集合。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct CleanupReadGapSet(Vec<CleanupReadGap>);

impl CleanupReadGapSet {
    /// 构造非空、按`gap_kind`唯一且按enum声明顺序排列的gap set。
    pub fn try_new(
        gaps: Vec<CleanupReadGap>,
    ) -> Result<Self, CleanupReadinessViewError>;
    /// 返回immutable gap slice。
    pub fn as_slice(&self) -> &[CleanupReadGap];
    /// 判断是否包含指定gap kind。
    pub fn contains(&self, kind: CleanupReadGapKind) -> bool;
    /// 将typed gap reason一一投影为shared degraded reason set。
    pub fn to_degraded_reasons(
        &self,
    ) -> Result<StatusViewDegradedReasonSet, CleanupReadinessViewError>;
}
```

gap set非空即degraded或no-view，完整source固定None。binding已命中后，`CleanupTruth | OwnerTruth |
ReleaseRelation | ProjectionSource` gap的required cursor必须等于binding cursor，且必须带matching guard ref；
available存在时严格早于required。只有`ReleaseRelation` gap允许在完整current public field group上构造degraded
view；其余kind都只能形成no-view outcome。`ViewBinding`只允许在无法判定current / exact binding时产生，其required cursor
来自repository在同一read transaction中建立的context-scope target watermark，而不是伪造一个不存在的binding
cursor；current selector可不带guard ref，exact selector必须带matching guard ref。此时不能构造view，Query只返回
`Unavailable, view=None`。malformed row、duplicate current binding、wrong context、status / basis矛盾和
known owner relation冲突永远是integrity error。

`CleanupReadGapSet`的唯一键就是`gap_kind`，canonical order就是
`ViewBinding -> CleanupTruth -> OwnerTruth -> ReleaseRelation -> ProjectionSource`。同一种dependency gap只能保留
一条；多个底层读取失败必须先由formal reader合并为该kind覆盖范围最保守的required / available cursor和一个
owner-approved safe reason。reason不参与唯一键，禁止借不同reason重复同一kind；不同kind的safe reason还必须
彼此不同，以保持`to_degraded_reasons()`逐项一一映射。`ProjectionSource`即使携带较早
available cursor也只能形成no-view；较早materialized carrier不得装入selected current binding的view。
binding尚未命中时，set必须恰好只有一条`ViewBinding`；其余四种gap都依赖selected binding cursor和guard ref，
不得在selection不存在时附加。

#### 16.6.10 Contracts-only guard evidence reference / status snapshot

view不得依赖domain-only `CleanupEvidenceSourceBasis`、`InvestigationHandoffSummary`或
`CleanupReleaseFailureBasis`。application mapper必须先校验这些domain values，再机械复制为下列contracts-owned
read carriers。carrier保存的是“guard最近一次accepted evaluation使用了哪些body-free refs与canonical status”，
不是重新评估cleanup，也不是新的evidence truth、audit record或异常记录。

```rust
/// cleanup guard accepted evidence在read surface上的closed source类别。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum CleanupReadinessEvidenceSourceKind {
    /// completed run的capture、observability与handoff evidence。
    CompletedRunCapture,
    /// failed / terminated run的formal terminal material与handoff evidence。
    TerminalRun,
    /// 未形成run的完整或partial boundary / handle cleanup obligation。
    BoundaryOnly,
    /// partial handle definitive release failure后的fresh recovery evidence。
    BoundaryOnlyReleaseFailureRecovery,
}

/// exact handoff target progress机械派生的read position；不是handoff状态机。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum CleanupReadinessHandoffPosition {
    /// required handoff尚未打开。
    NotOpened,
    /// 至少一个required target尚未完成。
    Pending,
    /// 全部required target已形成validated delivery fact。
    Delivered,
    /// 至少一个target允许安全重试，且没有terminal failure。
    Retryable,
    /// 至少一个required target已terminal failed。
    Failed,
}

/// cleanup evidence引用的handoff batch与underlying target progress snapshot。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct CleanupReadinessHandoffSnapshot {
    /// 尚未打开handoff时为None；否则为exact batch ref。
    handoff_ref: Option<HandoffFactRef>,
    /// exact batch canonical aggregate status；与handoff ref同构。
    handoff_status: Option<HandoffFactStatus>,
    /// 从exact target progress机械派生的position。
    handoff_position: CleanupReadinessHandoffPosition,
    /// aggregate为`BlockedByCleanupGuard`时指向owning cleanup guard。
    blocking_cleanup_guard_ref: Option<CleanupGuardRef>,
}

impl CleanupReadinessHandoffSnapshot {
    /// 构造尚未打开handoff的explicit snapshot。
    pub fn not_opened() -> Self;

    /// 从committed handoff aggregate与exact target progress position构造snapshot。
    pub fn try_from_committed_handoff(
        cleanup_guard_ref: &CleanupGuardRef,
        handoff_ref: HandoffFactRef,
        handoff_status: HandoffFactStatus,
        handoff_position: CleanupReadinessHandoffPosition,
        blocking_cleanup_guard_ref: Option<CleanupGuardRef>,
    ) -> Result<Self, CleanupReadinessViewError>;

    /// 返回optional exact handoff ref。
    pub fn handoff_ref(&self) -> Option<&HandoffFactRef>;
    /// 返回optional canonical handoff status。
    pub fn handoff_status(&self) -> Option<HandoffFactStatus>;
    /// 返回underlying target progress position。
    pub fn handoff_position(&self) -> CleanupReadinessHandoffPosition;
    /// 返回optional matching cleanup block owner。
    pub fn blocking_cleanup_guard_ref(&self) -> Option<&CleanupGuardRef>;
}

/// external investigation handoff在cleanup read surface上的finite position。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum CleanupReadinessInvestigationPosition {
    /// 本次source没有external investigation observation；是否允许由guard truth决定。
    NotRequired,
    /// target存在但尚无validated acceptance。
    Pending,
    /// external owner已接收body-free refs / safe summary；不表示调查完成。
    Accepted,
    /// external owner明确要求保留现场并阻断cleanup。
    Blocked,
    /// handoff失败且当前没有可证明的安全接收。
    Failed,
}

/// guard最近一次accepted investigation observation的body-free read snapshot。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct CleanupReadinessInvestigationSnapshot {
    /// 非`NotRequired`时必有的investigation target。
    target_ref: Option<ExternalSourceRef>,
    /// 非`NotRequired`时必有的body-free safe summary。
    summary_ref: Option<SafeSummaryRef>,
    /// finite investigation handoff position。
    position: CleanupReadinessInvestigationPosition,
    /// `Pending | Blocked | Failed`必有的caller-safe reason。
    reason: Option<SandboxReason>,
    /// external observation canonical time。
    observed_at: Timestamp,
}

impl CleanupReadinessInvestigationSnapshot {
    /// 构造没有external investigation observation的explicit snapshot。

    /// 从validated external owner observation构造body-free snapshot。

    /// 返回optional investigation target。

    /// 返回optional investigation safe summary。

    /// 返回finite investigation position。

    /// 返回optional caller-safe reason。

    /// 返回external observation time。

}

/// partial-handle recovery使用的fresh lifecycle inspection read position。

    /// backend当前不可用，不能证明已释放或可重试。

```

evidence factory执行下列closed matrix：

| source | lineage shape | source field relation | 禁止替代 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CompletedRunCapture` | `run_ref=Some`且lease row存在 | capture / observability refs必有；handoff none只由`NotOpened`表达；capture status原样保留 | `Complete`默认值、aggregate `Delivered`替代target progress |
| `TerminalRun` | `run_ref=Some`且lease row存在 | run status只允许`Failed | Terminated`；无capture ref；observability必有 | 伪造capture、从failure reason推terminal status |
| `BoundaryOnly` | `run_ref=None` | boundary只允许`Failed | Established`；handle只允许`Created | Active | OrphanSuspected`；audit refs必有 | missing capture映成pending、current owner status覆盖status-at-evaluation |
| `BoundaryOnlyReleaseFailureRecovery` | `run_ref=None`、lease row absent、orphan absent | prior guard必须不同于current guard；两个summary均为`IsolationBackend` kind；`prior_failed_at < inspection_observed_at <= assembled_at` | backend target、raw lifecycle body、`Released` inspection、latest prior guard scan |

handoff snapshot要求ref/status同构；`NotOpened`固定`None / None / None`。非`NotOpened`必须有ref与status；
`BlockedByCleanupGuard`必须携带且只携带当前guard ref，其它aggregate status不得携带block ref。underlying
`Delivered`可与aggregate `BlockedByCleanupGuard`并存，因为后者是cleanup override，不得据此把target progress改回
pending。investigation `target_ref/summary_ref` source kind固定为`Investigation`；`NotRequired`为
`None / None / None`，`Accepted`为`Some / Some / None`，其余position为`Some / Some / Some(reason)`。

`assembled_at`不得早于investigation observation或recovery inspection。domain mapper还必须先证明terminal basis、
forbidden-body marker、prior release authorization / failure basis和exact backend target关系；这些domain-only proof不
复制进contracts。marker引发的preservation要求必须已机械体现在public blocker与investigation position中，不能因
carrier不暴露marker set而消失。任何已知映射矛盾返回integrity error，不得改写成typed read gap。

#### 16.6.11 Checked cleanup guard row snapshot

`CleanupReadinessGuardSnapshot`是一行完整 committed guard truth的contracts-only映射结果。它不允许把status、
blocker、release basis与evidence分别从不同版本读取；任何一项缺失都属于`CleanupTruth` gap并使本次请求不能构造
view，而不是用默认值补齐。

```rust
/// 一个committed cleanup guard row的relation-checked read snapshot。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct CleanupReadinessGuardSnapshot {
    /// exact cleanup guard identity。
    cleanup_guard_ref: CleanupGuardRef,
    /// 形成current guard decision的immutable safety guard ref。
    safety_guard_ref: CleanupSafetyGuardRef,
    /// guard唯一适用的execution lineage。
    lineage: CleanupReadinessLineage,
    /// latest accepted evidence与investigation snapshot。
    evidence: CleanupReadinessEvidenceSnapshot,
    /// guard current row最近一次accepted evaluation / settlement保存的完整redline coverage。
    accepted_redline_coverage: RedlineContainmentCoverageSnapshot,
    /// canonical persisted cleanup guard status。
    guard_status: CleanupGuardStatus,
    /// 由status与persisted basis cardinality机械派生的read phase。
    readiness_phase: CleanupReadinessPhase,
    /// pending / blocked时的ordered-unique public blockers。
    blockers: CleanupReadinessBlockerSet,
    /// current guard owner提供的caller-safe status reason。
    status_reason: SandboxReason,
    /// persisted release authorization / confirmation / failure progress。
    release_progress: CleanupReleaseProgress,
    /// guard首次打开时间。
    opened_at: Timestamp,
    /// latest accepted pure safety evaluation time。
    evaluated_at: Timestamp,
    /// current或最近一次进入Allowed的时间。
    allowed_at: Option<Timestamp>,
    /// guard与owner group完成收束的时间。
    completed_at: Option<Timestamp>,
    /// current guard status生效时间。
    status_changed_at: Timestamp,
    /// guard row读取到的truth cursor。
    guard_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
    /// guard latest transition已有的audit linkage。
    last_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
}

impl CleanupReadinessGuardSnapshot {
    /// 从同一committed guard row的validated mapper fields构造snapshot。
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    pub fn try_from_committed_guard_row(
        cleanup_guard_ref: CleanupGuardRef,
        safety_guard_ref: CleanupSafetyGuardRef,
        lineage: CleanupReadinessLineage,
        evidence: CleanupReadinessEvidenceSnapshot,
        accepted_redline_coverage: RedlineContainmentCoverageSnapshot,
        guard_status: CleanupGuardStatus,
        readiness_phase: CleanupReadinessPhase,
        blockers: CleanupReadinessBlockerSet,
        status_reason: SandboxReason,
        release_progress: CleanupReleaseProgress,
        opened_at: Timestamp,
        evaluated_at: Timestamp,
        allowed_at: Option<Timestamp>,
        completed_at: Option<Timestamp>,
        status_changed_at: Timestamp,
        guard_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
        last_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    ) -> Result<Self, CleanupReadinessViewError>;

    /// 返回exact cleanup guard ref。
    pub fn cleanup_guard_ref(&self) -> &CleanupGuardRef;
    /// 返回immutable safety guard ref。
    pub fn safety_guard_ref(&self) -> &CleanupSafetyGuardRef;
    /// 返回exact execution lineage。
    pub fn lineage(&self) -> &CleanupReadinessLineage;
    /// 返回latest accepted evidence snapshot。
    pub fn evidence(&self) -> &CleanupReadinessEvidenceSnapshot;
    /// 返回guard current row保存的accepted完整redline coverage。
    pub fn accepted_redline_coverage(&self) -> &RedlineContainmentCoverageSnapshot;
    /// 返回canonical cleanup guard status。
    pub fn guard_status(&self) -> CleanupGuardStatus;
    /// 返回机械派生的public readiness phase。
    pub fn readiness_phase(&self) -> CleanupReadinessPhase;
    /// 返回ordered-unique public blocker set。
    pub fn blockers(&self) -> &CleanupReadinessBlockerSet;
    /// 返回caller-safe current status reason。
    pub fn status_reason(&self) -> &SandboxReason;
    /// 返回persisted release progress。
    pub fn release_progress(&self) -> &CleanupReleaseProgress;
    /// 返回guard open time。
    pub fn opened_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
    /// 返回latest accepted evaluation time。
    pub fn evaluated_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
    /// 返回optional current / most recent allowed time。
    pub fn allowed_at(&self) -> Option<&Timestamp>;
    /// 返回optional completion time。
    pub fn completed_at(&self) -> Option<&Timestamp>;
    /// 返回current status change time。
    pub fn status_changed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
    /// 返回guard truth cursor。
    pub fn guard_truth_cursor(&self) -> SandboxTruthCursor;
    /// 返回guard latest transition audit ref。
    pub fn last_audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;
}
```

factory按以下顺序校验，不允许“尽量展示”：

1. guard ref、evidence lineage与显式lineage完全相等；accepted redline coverage的context / identity / boundary /
   handle / generation必须等于lineage，且必须是完整index snapshot；safety guard ref、truth cursor与audit ref均为合法
   typed value。
2. `evidence.assembled_at <= evaluated_at <= status_changed_at`，`opened_at <= status_changed_at`；
   `allowed_at/completed_at`存在时不得晚于status change。`Completed`要求`completed_at == status_changed_at`，
   其它status要求`completed_at=None`。
3. `PendingEvidence | PendingInvestigation | Blocked`要求non-empty blockers；release-failed `Blocked`只能有一个
   `ReleaseFailure` blocker；post-release `PendingInvestigation | Blocked`的guard blocker只能按accepted coverage中的
   exact redline refs生成。`Allowed | Completed`要求empty blockers。
4. status、basis与phase必须严格遵守§16.6.3矩阵；phase与progress必须严格遵守§16.6.5矩阵。未知组合、
   `Allowed + Confirmed`或`Completed + Authorized`都是integrity error。
5. `Allowed | Completed | ReleaseFailed`要求`allowed_at=Some`；pending / pre-authorization blocked允许None或保留
   历史allowed time，但该历史时间不形成permission。
6. `status_reason`只能复制guard owner reason；它不能从blocker拼接、从backend raw error截断或由Query替换。

domain blocker到public blocker的映射闭集如下；mapper必须逐项映射，再按public canonical key重排：

| domain blocker kind | public kind | public subject |
|---|---|---|
| `HandoffPending | HandoffRetryable | HandoffFailed` | `MaterialHandoffUnsafe` | domain subject为`Handoff`时使用exact `MaterialHandoff`；subject为`Evidence`且handoff `NotOpened`时使用source中必有的exact `ObservabilityMaterial` |
| `ObservabilityPending | ObservabilityFailed` | `EvidenceUnsafe` | exact `ObservabilityMaterial` |
| `InvestigationRequired | InvestigationPending | InvestigationBlocked` | `InvestigationUnsafe` | exact `Investigation`；target absent时为owning `CleanupGuard` |
| `ForbiddenBodyPreservationRequired` | `ExternalBodyPreservationRequired` | exact `Investigation`；target absent时为owning `CleanupGuard` |
| `OrphanConfirmationPending | OrphanRecoveryFailed` | `OrphanActive` | exact `Orphan` |
| `ReleaseRecoveryInspectionPending` | `EnvironmentOwnerPending` | exact `IsolationHandle` |
| `ReleaseFailureTerminal` | `ReleaseFailure` | exact `IsolationHandle` |
| `RedlineContainmentActive | RedlineHandoffPending | RedlineTerminal` | `RedlineActive` | exact `Redline` |

public mapper不得凭reason文字选择kind/subject。domain subject为`Evidence`时，只能按domain blocker kind与evidence
source中已验证的exact ref机械选择observability、guard或handle；不存在合法typed subject时返回
`CleanupBlockerMappingInvalid`，不能降级为字符串或`Other`。

#### 16.6.12 Complete / degraded source snapshot 与 no-view outcome

source snapshot只有在binding watermark上的guard、evidence与owner public字段全部存在时才可构造。typed gap不允许
用较早carrier、`None`、默认status或空blocker替代必填public字段；当前只有relation index无法完整验证时，才允许在
完整field group上形成degraded source。

```rust
/// 同一cleanup binding下的完整或显式降级read source snapshot。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct CleanupReadinessSourceSnapshot {
    /// selector、current position与immutable binding proof。
    selection: CleanupReadinessBindingSelectionProof,
    /// selected cleanup guard committed row snapshot。
    guard: CleanupReadinessGuardSnapshot,
    /// exact singleton release owners与完整current redline coverage / status snapshot。
    owners: CleanupOwnerStatusSnapshot,
    /// same-attempt relation proof；relation gap时可为None。
    relation_proof: Option<CleanupReadinessRelationProof>,
    /// non-empty表示source degraded；None表示完整。
    read_gaps: Option<CleanupReadGapSet>,
    /// source mapper完成本次same-snapshot读取的time。
    observed_at: Timestamp,
}

impl CleanupReadinessSourceSnapshot {
    /// 从完整binding、guard、owners与release relation构造non-degraded source。
    pub fn complete(
        selection: CleanupReadinessBindingSelectionProof,
        guard: CleanupReadinessGuardSnapshot,
        owners: CleanupOwnerStatusSnapshot,
        relation_proof: CleanupReadinessRelationProof,
        observed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, CleanupReadinessViewError>;

    /// 从完整current public field group与`ReleaseRelation` gap构造degraded source。
    pub fn degraded(
        selection: CleanupReadinessBindingSelectionProof,
        guard: CleanupReadinessGuardSnapshot,
        owners: CleanupOwnerStatusSnapshot,
        relation_proof: Option<CleanupReadinessRelationProof>,
        read_gaps: CleanupReadGapSet,
        observed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, CleanupReadinessViewError>;

    /// 返回checked binding selection proof。
    pub fn selection(&self) -> &CleanupReadinessBindingSelectionProof;
    /// 返回selected guard row snapshot。
    pub fn guard(&self) -> &CleanupReadinessGuardSnapshot;
    /// 返回same-snapshot owner status group。
    pub fn owners(&self) -> &CleanupOwnerStatusSnapshot;
    /// 返回optional same-attempt relation proof；complete source恒为Some。
    pub fn relation_proof(&self) -> Option<&CleanupReadinessRelationProof>;
    /// 返回optional typed read gaps。
    pub fn read_gaps(&self) -> Option<&CleanupReadGapSet>;
    /// 返回source mapper observation time。
    pub fn observed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
    /// 判断source是否由typed gap显式降级。
    pub fn is_degraded(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断selected guard是否为historical exact lookup。
    pub fn is_historical(&self) -> bool;
    /// fail closed判断本snapshot是否仍有unsafe或未完成cleanup position。
    pub fn has_unsafe_or_incomplete_cleanup(&self) -> bool;
    /// 合并guard-owned blockers与current complete redline blockers，形成final view唯一effective set。
    pub fn effective_blockers(
        &self,
    ) -> Result<CleanupReadinessBlockerSet, CleanupReadinessViewError>;
}

/// cleanup readiness query source lookup的closed outcome。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum CleanupReadinessSourceLookupOutcome {
    /// public field group可形成complete或degraded view。
    ViewSource(CleanupReadinessSourceSnapshot),
    /// current index完整证明context尚无current cleanup guard。
    CurrentAbsent(CleanupReadinessAbsenceProof),
    /// exact immutable index完整证明selected guard不存在。
    ExactAbsent(CleanupReadinessExactAbsenceProof),
    /// source不足以构造view body；只能返回`Unavailable, view=None`。
    NoView {
        /// 原始closed selector。
        selector: CleanupReadinessSelector,
        /// binding已命中但public field group不完整时保留selection proof。
        selection: Option<CleanupReadinessBindingSelectionProof>,
        /// 解释no-view source缺口的non-empty typed gaps。
        read_gaps: CleanupReadGapSet,
    },
}

impl CleanupReadinessSourceLookupOutcome {
    /// 构造可进入view factory的source outcome。
    pub fn view_source(source: CleanupReadinessSourceSnapshot) -> Self;
    /// 构造current binding明确为空的outcome。
    pub fn current_absent(proof: CleanupReadinessAbsenceProof) -> Self;
    /// 构造exact binding明确不存在的outcome。
    pub fn exact_absent(proof: CleanupReadinessExactAbsenceProof) -> Self;
    /// 构造不能安全形成view body的typed no-view outcome。
    pub fn no_view(
        selector: CleanupReadinessSelector,
        selection: Option<CleanupReadinessBindingSelectionProof>,
        read_gaps: CleanupReadGapSet,
    ) -> Result<Self, CleanupReadinessViewError>;
}
```

source factory按以下顺序校验：

1. selection selector、binding、guard的context / guard ref完全相等；guard lineage与evidence lineage完全相等。
   exact historical source允许`binding_position=Historical`，current selector绝不允许。
2. singleton owner observation的subject/status variant必须同构，并逐项命中lineage中的exact boundary、handle、optional
   lease与orphan。optional row cardinality必须与lineage声明一致。redline coverage的lineage必须等于guard lineage，status
   set与coverage refs exact ordered同构；缺index、partial page、missing row或latest scan不能伪装zero-row或“不适用”。
3. guard cursor和每个owner cursor不得晚于binding cursor。complete source要求relation proof存在且其coverage cursor
   等于binding cursor；degraded source只允许current binding，且允许relation proof缺失当且仅当gap set含
   `ReleaseRelation`。
4. relation proof存在时，无论source complete或degraded都必须完整校验：guard ref、lineage、status、phase、progress
   必须等于guard snapshot；attempt、row status、row cursor与owner snapshot按§16.6.8矩阵对账。known conflict不可
   因另一个gap存在而跳过。
5. relation row与current owner status的对账按“每个subject最新适用relation kind”执行。`ReleaseAuthorized`使用
   Authorization row；`ReleaseFailed`中guard / orphan使用Failure row、handle继续使用Authorization row；三种
   Confirmed phase的boundary / handle / optional lease / orphan使用Completion row，guard current status直接与snapshot
   phase对账。历史Authorization row保留其当时status，不要求等于terminal current status。
6. complete source要求`read_gaps=None`。degraded source要求`binding_position=Current`，只接受恰好一个
   `ReleaseRelation` gap；gap context、guard ref与selection一致，required cursor等于binding cursor，available存在时
   严格早于required。`ViewBinding |
   CleanupTruth | OwnerTruth | ProjectionSource`均不能进入degraded factory，因为把较早carrier放到当前view binding
   下会混合read-model identity。
7. `ReleaseRelation` gap允许relation proof为None；若proof存在，gap的available cursor必须为Some且proof coverage
   不得晚于available cursor；available为None时proof必须为None。relation缺失时
   view仍可显示loaded canonical fields，但fail-closed helper固定返回unsafe，且不得宣称same-attempt closure已证明。
8. binding的materialization source set必须非空且每项cursor等于binding cursor。phase-specific guard source要求为：
   `Pending | Blocked | ReadyForAuthorization`使用guard latest transition audit；`ReleaseAuthorized`的authorization
   materialization使用authorization audit，后续strictly-late redline-only materialization可不含guard source；
   `ReleaseFailed`使用failure audit；`PostReleaseInvestigationHold | PostReleaseBlocked | Completed`首次settlement与任何phase
   变化必须包含guard latest audit。binding `source_audit_trace_ref`是materialization writer audit，可与owner source audit
   不同但必须同UoW提交。`observed_at`不得早于selection、binding、guard、evidence、investigation、owner observation、
   release progress或已有relation row的任一time。
9. phase与owner closure必须一致：`PostReleaseInvestigationHold | PostReleaseBlocked | Completed`要求all release owners
   closed；其它phase若owners已全部closed则为half-commit integrity error。`ReleaseAuthorized`要求handle
   `ReleasePending`且optional orphan `Recovering`；`ReleaseFailed`要求handle保持`ReleasePending`且optional orphan为
   `Failed`。
10. redline coverage relation按phase固定：pre-authorization `Pending | Blocked | ReadyForAuthorization`要求guard accepted
    coverage与current coverage完全相等；`ReadyForAuthorization`还要求current全部Released或zero-row。
    `ReleaseAuthorized | ReleaseFailed`要求guard accepted authorization coverage是current coverage的identity子集，共有ref
    lineage不变，差集每项`detected_at > authorized_at`；任一current non-Released redline必须形成view blocker。三种
    Confirmed phase要求current coverage不早于guard accepted completion / latest hold coverage，ref不可消失；phase分别
    要求HandoffPending+Released only、存在active/Terminal、全部Released/zero-row。Terminal始终hard block。
11. blocker subject refs必须属于guard evidence / lineage / exact optional owner。pending investigation是canonical guard
    truth；即使projection stale，也不得把它转换为read gap或从blocker set删除。
12. owner current status必须满足下表。任何非`Completed` phase出现boundary / handle / persisted lease `Released`或
    orphan `Recovered`，即使尚未全组closed，也属于可见half-commit，不得作为普通pending / blocked source展示。

| phase | boundary | handle | persisted lease | optional orphan | complete redline status set |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Pending` | `Established | Failed` | `Created | Active | OrphanSuspected | ReleasePending` | `Active | Expiring | Expired | OrphanSuspected` | `Suspected | Confirmed` | zero-row、`HandoffPending | Released`；每条non-Released均有matching pending blocker |
| `Blocked` | `Established | Failed` | `Created | Active | OrphanSuspected | ReleasePending` | `Active | Expiring | Expired | OrphanSuspected` | `Suspected | Confirmed | Failed` | zero-row或任意`Detected | Contained | HandoffPending | Released | Terminal`；active/Terminal逐项block |
| `ReadyForAuthorization` | `Established | Failed` | `Created | Active | OrphanSuspected | ReleasePending` | `Active | Expiring | Expired | OrphanSuspected` | `Confirmed` | zero-row或全部`Released` |
| `ReleaseAuthorized` | `Established | Failed` | `ReleasePending` | `Active | Expiring | Expired | OrphanSuspected` | `Recovering` | authorization coverage全Released；current可新增strictly-late任意status并逐项显示blocker |
| `ReleaseFailed` | `Established | Failed` | `ReleasePending` | `Active | Expiring | Expired | OrphanSuspected` | `Failed` | authorization coverage全Released；current可新增strictly-late任意status，release failure仍为dominant blocker |
| `PostReleaseInvestigationHold` | `Released` | `Released` | `Released` | `Recovered` | 至少一条`HandoffPending`且其余全部`Released` |
| `PostReleaseBlocked` | `Released` | `Released` | `Released` | `Recovered` | 至少一条`Detected | Contained | Terminal`；其它可为任意valid status |
| `Completed` | `Released` | `Released` | `Released` | `Recovered` | zero-row或全部`Released` |

表中optional owner为None时跳过该列，但其None必须由lineage cardinality证明。`ReadyForAuthorization`中的
`ReleasePending` handle只允许`BoundaryOnlyReleaseFailureRecovery` evidence：它表示旧authorization失败后形成的
fresh guard尚未创建新basis，不表示当前guard已授权。`Blocked + orphan Failed`必须有matching
`OrphanRecoveryFailed` public blocker；`ReleaseFailed`则必须由当前guard自己的release failure basis与relation rows
证明，二者不能按status文本互换。`Pending`不接受active / terminal redline，因为其closed blocker会把guard机械派生为
`Blocked`；只允许`HandoffPending`形成`PendingInvestigation`，或全部Released / zero-row后由其它evidence形成pending。
authorization后新增redline不撤销已提交teardown permission，所以`ReleaseAuthorized`仍保留该phase，但view必须展示
逐项redline blocker且绝不声称safe；confirmation提交后则必须进入两种post-release hold之一或Completed。

`NoView`的closed规则：selection为None时必须恰好含一条`ViewBinding` gap；selection为Some时禁止`ViewBinding`，且必须含
`CleanupTruth | OwnerTruth | ProjectionSource`至少一项，表示必填public carrier或current materialized source不可用；
historical selection还允许只含`ReleaseRelation`，因为historical view必须完整relation-checked。只有current selection
单独含`ReleaseRelation`时必须走`degraded` source而不是no-view。current absence只映射
`surface_status=Empty, view=None`；exact absence可映射exact-selector的`Empty`，但不得被解释为“context没有current
cleanup obligation”。两种absence都必须发生在query access decision之后，NotVisible / Restricted优先且不得泄漏
existence。

`has_unsafe_or_incomplete_cleanup()`在degraded、relation proof缺失、historical source或phase非`Completed`时固定
返回true；仅current、complete、relation-checked `Completed` source返回false。它只供caller做保守显示 / retention
判断，不是release、delete、context closure或material disposal授权。任何mutation必须重新加载domain owners并消费
`CleanupGuard` checked method。

本error只描述已经进入contracts mapper后的结构完整性。repository unavailable、snapshot isolation失败、query
access denial、NotVisible / Restricted、transport、invalid public request、unsupported version与public error mapping由
Step 7/8 application/contracts owner处理；它们不得被伪装成本enum的integrity variant。反向地，malformed row、
duplicate current binding、wrong lineage、known half-commit与release outcome conflict不得映为普通repository
unavailable或degraded reason。

variant payload只允许closed enum；不得携带SQL、table/key、raw row、SDK/HTTP/IO cause、backend target、page token、
operator note、investigation body、artifact/observability正文、path、host、PID、endpoint、credential或hidden existence ref。
safe reason只保存在validated blocker/read gap/view字段，不作为error自由文本。

#### 16.6.14 `CleanupReadinessView`

```rust
/// 一个exact cleanup guard的body-free committed readiness read model。

    /// 从完整public field group与typed gaps构造degraded view。

```

`from_committed_snapshot`只接受`source.is_degraded() == false`且relation proof存在，固定
`degraded_reasons=None`。`from_degraded_snapshot`只接受current binding和恰好一个`ReleaseRelation` gap，通过
`CleanupReadGapSet::to_degraded_reasons()`生成唯一`Some(StatusViewDegradedReasonSet)`；caller不能另传reason、
status、phase、owner status或audit覆盖source。两条factory都从selection binding复制view ref、position、source
audit/cursor，从guard snapshot复制guard/evidence/status/phase/reason/progress，从owner snapshot复制owner statuses、
完整redline coverage与ordered status set；blockers由guard snapshot blockers与current redline status blockers通过
`merge_current_redline_blockers`机械形成，并从guard snapshot复制evaluation/status time，从source复制observed time。

factory不得在构造时查询repository、调用clock、评估guard、执行release、append audit、materialize projection、
生成view ref或分配truth cursor。所有校验必须在入参carrier上pure完成。`from_degraded_snapshot`仍保留已知
`Blocked | ReleaseFailed | Pending | PostReleaseInvestigationHold | PostReleaseBlocked` truth，不因degraded reason改写
phase；known unsafe永远优先于read incompleteness。

helper的closed semantics：

| helper | true condition | fail-closed rule |
|---|---|---|
| `is_current` | binding position为`Current` | 不按time/ref猜current |
| `is_degraded` | degraded reasons为Some | pending investigation本身不算degraded |
| `proves_release_owners_closed` | current、non-degraded、progress Confirmed、phase为`PostReleaseInvestigationHold | PostReleaseBlocked | Completed`、owner全closed且relation proof完整 | historical或degraded固定false；true不表示redline released或context可闭合 |
| `proves_all_redlines_released` | complete coverage明确zero-row或status set全部Released | missing/partial coverage、任一active/HandoffPending/Terminal均false；不是mutation permission |
| `has_unsafe_or_incomplete_cleanup` | historical、degraded、phase非Completed或未证明owner closure任一成立 | 只有current完整Completed返回false |
| `is_historical_read_only` | binding position为`Historical` | historical view不得进入projection或mutation guard |

任何helper都不能授权release、删除material、关闭context、推进lease/orphan/boundary/handle或解除redline。
`ReadyForAuthorization`只是可观察位置，正式release入口仍必须在新write UoW重新加载domain truth并调用
`CleanupGuard::authorize_release_for(...)`；view无`permits_release()`或`mark_*()`方法。

#### 16.6.15 Field source closure

| target field / carrier | exact source | relation guard | forbidden substitute |
|---|---|---|---|
| selector | Step 8 validated closed selector DTO | current/exact variant各自完整；context已通过access decision | 两个optional字段、caller `is_current` bool、ref文本解析 |
| `view_ref` | committed immutable cleanup status view row | selection binding、context、guard、cursor与audit一致 | Query id generator、guard ref转换、projection ref |
| `binding_position` | same-snapshot current index + exact-guard index | §16.6.7 selection proof机械派生 | timestamp/ref最大值、repository insertion order、caller bool |
| `cleanup_guard_ref` | exact selected binding + committed guard row | selector、binding、guard三方exact equal | context current guard猜测、latest scan |
| lineage | committed guard row及release-owner relations | context/identity/run/boundary/handle/lease/orphan/generation逐项相等；redline不进入stable lineage | 从backend handle、字符串、第一条owner row或single redline反推 |
| evidence source | guard内嵌`CleanupEvidenceSnapshot`经validated mapper复制 | 四种source闭集、ref/status/time与lineage矩阵 | 重跑guard、raw material、默认capture/handoff status |
| investigation | guard内嵌`InvestigationHandoffSummary`经validated mapper复制 | target/summary kind、position/reason cardinality与observation time | ticket/case body、caller状态、missing默认Accepted |
| `guard_status` | exact committed `CleanupGuard` row | blocker、basis、phase、time与audit矩阵 | owner status聚合、view phase反推、reason解析 |
| `readiness_phase` | guard status + embedded release/completion/failure basis cardinality | §16.6.3 closed matrix | 新持久化状态、adapter call result、boolean `released` |
| blockers | guard-owned blocker map + current complete redline status set | exact ref、kind/reason、strictly-late relation与canonical merge key | raw error、自由文本、`Other`、read gap reason、只展示guard旧blocker |
| `status_reason` | guard current owner-safe reason | guard row同version；不得由blocker拼接 | backend error截断、query wording、operator note |
| release progress | guard embedded release/completion/failure basis | same authorization、summary kind、audit/time与互斥结局 | backend target、latest lifecycle summary、adapter success bool |
| owner statuses | same-snapshot boundary/handle/optional lease/orphan + complete redline coverage/status rows | singleton subject/status同构；redline refs exact ordered同构；cursor不晚于binding | guard columns、single/latest redline scan、missing index解释为zero-row |
| relation proof | committed release-owner relation index | attempt + `(kind,subject)`唯一、phase coverage与owner current status对账 | 三个caller bool、只比较status、completion覆盖authorization row |
| degraded reasons | typed `CleanupReadGapSet` | ordered-unique 1:1映射为shared reason set | repository error Display、caller reason、canonical pending blocker |
| source audit/cursor | committed status binding | complete source必须覆盖selected binding；任一非relation current-source gap只形成no-view | query trace、clock生成cursor、post-query audit append、较早carrier冒充current |
| evaluation/status time | exact guard row | evidence/evaluation/status单调且与phase cardinality一致 | query clock、row insertion time、backend time |
| `observed_at` | application clock在formal source read/mapping之后取得 | 不早于所有已复制source/owner/relation observation | backend clock、binding materialized time冒充 |

最终view不保存selector、attempt key、release relation rows、typed gap kind、backend handle target、forbidden-body
marker set或domain basis。前四项由source validation carrier留存；backend target与domain proof只参与mapper校验；
forbidden-body事实通过canonical investigation position和public blocker可见，不能因为正文与marker本体不进入view而
丢失安全结论。

#### 16.6.16 Query、materialization 与 no-second-truth boundary

| path | allowed | forbidden |
|---|---|---|
| Query access | 先消费application query access decision；NotVisible/Restricted不读取或泄漏existence | 先查binding再决定visibility、把access status写入view |
| selector | `CurrentForContext`或`ExactGuard(context, guard)` closed union | 两个optional字段、guard-only selector、全仓scan、latest by time |
| binding read | 在一个read transaction读取current与exact indexes并构造lookup proof | `ORDER BY changed_at DESC`、缺current时选任一historical guard |
| source read | 按selected immutable binding watermark读取guard、owners与relation index | 分别读取latest rows、从projection body修补truth、读时repair |
| view assembly | 只调用本节source/view factory；canonical pending/blocked truth原样保留 | Query重跑safety guard、授权/调用release、推进owner、补audit |
| current absence | complete current-index absence proof -> `Empty, view=None` | repository NotFound、timeout或binding gap冒充Empty |
| exact absence | complete exact-index absence proof -> exact-selector `Empty, view=None` | 推导context无current cleanup obligation |
| binding unavailable | `ViewBinding` gap -> `Unavailable, view=None` | 构造空view、回退latest、映成current absence |
| mandatory public carrier unavailable | binding已知且`CleanupTruth/OwnerTruth` gap -> `Unavailable, view=None` | 默认status、空blocker、partial / earlier view body、no-view标成Degraded |
| current materialization unavailable | `ProjectionSource` gap -> `Unavailable, view=None` | 较早materialized carrier装入selected current binding、known malformed row降级 |
| relation unavailable | current public fields完整且`ReleaseRelation` gap -> `Degraded, view=Some`；historical exact read -> no-view | 删除release progress、凭owner Released宣称Completed、历史carrier缺proof仍展示 |
| complete current source | `Visible, view=Some` | `ReadyForAuthorization`自动触发release |
| complete historical source | `Visible, view=Some`且`binding_position=Historical` | 加入current projection、作为mutation guard或closure proof |
| projection | 只接受current checked binding；stale/degraded显式surface | historical guard覆盖current projection、Query触发rebuild |

`GetCleanupReadiness`在Step 8回归时必须收敛为：

```rust
/// cleanup readiness query的closed selector request。
pub struct GetCleanupReadinessRequestDto {
    /// current-context或exact-guard selector。
    pub selector: CleanupReadinessSelectorDto,
}

/// cleanup readiness public request允许的selector闭集。
pub enum CleanupReadinessSelectorDto {
    /// 选择一个context的current cleanup guard。
    CurrentForContext {
        /// 已通过query access validation的exact context。
        context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
    },
    /// 选择一个context下的exact current或historical cleanup guard。
    ExactGuard {
        /// 已通过query access validation的exact context。
        context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
        /// caller明确选择的exact cleanup guard。
        cleanup_guard_ref: CleanupGuardRef,
    },
}
```

该代码块只固定Step 8必须承接的schema shape；serialization、version与public validation error仍由Step 8唯一拥有。
response继续为`SandboxQueryResponseDto<CleanupReadinessViewDto>`，不分页。DTO必须逐字段承接§16.6.14；不得只返回
`guard_status + blocking_reasons`，也不得把`binding_position`藏进server私有metadata。

status materialization writer遵守以下索引语义：

1. 每次accepted guard truth变化创建新的immutable view row与binding，不原地改写旧view body。
2. 同一guard更新时，write UoW原子插入new immutable row，并把current-context index与exact-guard index都指向
   new binding；旧view row按retention保持只读。
3. fresh recovery创建new guard时，write UoW原子提交new guard/view/relation，current-context index与new exact
   guard index指向new binding；old exact-guard index继续指向old guard最后一个immutable binding。
4. current/exact index不按timestamp选winner。任一UoW可见两个current rows、exact index缺失、index先于guard或
   relation提交，均为integrity error。
5. authorization、definitive failure与matching confirmation/owner closure分别在其owning UoW提交new immutable
   binding及relation rows。confirmation、owner closure、guard Completed与completion rows必须同一UoW可见。
6. Query从不分配view ref/truth cursor、不写index、不刷新projection、不创建stored result/idempotency/audit truth。

snapshot/view retention时长和物理清理策略由Step 14与正式`04`重验，不在本节伪造数值。最低语义约束是：任何
仍可由exact-guard index选择的binding，其immutable view row、guard source和needed relation rows必须可读；若合法
retention决定删除historical binding，exact selector必须返回明确expired/unavailable application surface，不能改为
`ExactAbsent`或回退另一个guard。
