### 16.7 `RedlineContainmentView` current canonical contract

`RedlineContainmentView` 是 `GetRedlineContainmentStatus` 与 `SandboxReadProjection` 消费的
contracts-owned、body-free、immutable read model。它投影一个 exact `RedlineContainment` 的检测来源、完整
execution lineage、canonical containment status、stop-new-use / optional run termination proof、preservation
进度、external investigation handoff observation、cleanup-block disposition以及committed audit / truth cursor。
它不重新执行 `RedlineContainmentGuard`，不终止run，不推进boundary / handle，不调用investigation port，也不把
query结果写回redline truth。

本对象关闭named type #25，并关闭support family #39的redline分支。canonical owner固定为
`crates/contracts/src/views.rs`。domain-only `RedlineSignalSource`、`ContainmentRequirementSet`、
`InvestigationRequirementSet`、`RedlineSafetyMarkerSet`、`RedlineContainmentBasis`、
`RedlinePreservationSnapshot`、`RedlineInvestigationHandoffObservation`与`RedlineReleaseBasis`只参与source mapper
校验，不进入public字段；否则会形成`contracts -> domain`反向依赖。

#### 16.7.1 Capability、主体边界与historical conflict

本view回答“一个已明确选择的security redline containment当前收束到哪里，哪些已提交安全proof支持该结论”。
它与审计、异常处置和security investigation强相关，但它仍是redline安全主体的read model，不是通用审计附件，
也不承接正常执行发起、tools语义执行、runtime agent loop或member lifecycle orchestration。

| capability | current owner | view允许表达 | view禁止承担 |
|---|---|---|---|
| redline lifecycle truth | `RedlineContainment` | exact ref、canonical status、safe reason与status time | 选择新status、重跑guard、原地恢复Released / Terminal |
| detection source | validated `RedlineSignalSource` embedded in truth | finite source class、typed refs、safe summary与canonical redline kind | 保存host path、network destination、process command、secret、raw event或reason解析 |
| stop-new-use / run termination | containment basis + matching failure / boundary / optional run owner | body-free proof refs、canonical resulting status与same-UoW relation | 调backend kill、从failure kind猜relation、把Detected伪装Contained |
| preservation | exact persisted preservation snapshot | run/post-run material或boundary-signal位置、material status / handoff ref | 保存material body、创建handoff batch、扫描latest material |
| investigation handoff | exact latest persisted observation | typed target / receipt summary、finite disposition与safe reason | 拥有external case lifecycle、宣称调查完成、保存ticket / note / receipt body |
| cleanup block disposition | canonical status + exact release / terminal proof | Released只表示redline owner解除block；Terminal持续hard block | backend release、cleanup complete、context close、run / boundary复活 |
| read completeness | immutable view binding + same-snapshot source proof | complete、typed degraded或no-view surface | 以missing row、repository error、warning log或caller bool伪造安全结论 |

历史HLD C11与旧Step 7~17只保留为`H16.7 historical_material`。以下口径全部失效：

1. `VisibleRedlineStatus`与`RedlineContainmentStatusView`是第二状态owner / 错名；public view必须直接复用shared
   `RedlineContainmentStatus`，不得声明wire-only别名。
2. `context_ref`或`redline_ref`两个optional selector无法表达唯一选择。一个context可有多个不同kind / source的
   containment；不得按time、ref或repository insertion order选择“latest redline”。
3. `no redline -> Empty`只有在exact `(context_ref, redline_ref)` binding index完整证明count为0时成立；它不证明
   context没有其它redline，也不证明cleanup可放行。
4. `HandoffPending -> Degraded`错误地把canonical truth当read缺口。完整可读的HandoffPending必须是Visible；只有
   source / relation gap才能产生Degraded或Unavailable。
5. `investigation_handoff_ref`并不存在于current domain contract。调查交接由typed external target、safe receipt / status
   summary和finite observation组成，不能恢复generic opaque ref。
6. `safety_markers`不能作为无来源public set直接复制；view必须展示可验证的stop / preservation / investigation
   progress，domain marker仍由redline owner唯一拥有。
7. generic `load_status_snapshot(context_ref)`无法证明选择了哪条containment，也无法证明同一watermark上的failure、
   boundary、run、material和investigation relation；current reader必须使用本节exact selector / binding contract。
8. query、log、metric或audit append不能代替formal containment truth；read path不得release containment或修复缺失proof。

#### 16.7.2 Exact selector、current binding与explicit absence proof

`GetRedlineContainmentStatus`是单对象读取，因此selector固定为required context + required exact redline ref。context只用于
access scope与lineage校验，不能单独选择一条redline。若后续需要“列出context下全部redline”，Step 8必须定义独立、
分页、coverage-checked集合协议；不得扩展本selector为context-only latest lookup。

每个`RedlineContainment`在其生命周期内只有一个current view binding。每次accepted status或embedded preservation /
investigation observation变化时，write UoW插入新的immutable view row并原子替换exact-redline current binding；旧row
仅供retention内的audit / reconciliation，不由本query按时间回退读取。

```rust
/// 单对象redline containment只读入口的required exact selector。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct RedlineContainmentSelector {
    /// 已通过query access decision的owning context。
    context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
    /// caller明确选择的exact containment truth。
    redline_ref: RedlineContainmentRef,
}

impl RedlineContainmentSelector {
    /// 创建required context + exact redline selector；不接受optional或context-only形态。
    pub fn try_new(
        context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
        redline_ref: RedlineContainmentRef,
    ) -> Result<Self, RedlineContainmentViewError>;

    /// 返回selector owning context。
    pub fn context_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionContextRef;
    /// 返回selector exact containment ref。
    pub fn redline_ref(&self) -> &RedlineContainmentRef;
}

/// committed redline view identity、exact truth与source watermark的current binding。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct RedlineContainmentViewBinding {
    /// status materialization writer已提交的immutable view identity。
    view_ref: RedlineContainmentViewRef,
    /// view唯一归属的context。
    context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
    /// view投影的exact containment truth。
    redline_ref: RedlineContainmentRef,
    /// view覆盖的committed truth watermark。
    source_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
    /// source transition已有的audit linkage；不是query audit。
    source_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    /// binding提交时间。
    materialized_at: Timestamp,
}

impl RedlineContainmentViewBinding {
    /// 从exact-redline current binding index的committed row构造binding。
    pub fn try_from_committed_index(
        view_ref: RedlineContainmentViewRef,
        context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
        redline_ref: RedlineContainmentRef,
        source_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
        source_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        materialized_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, RedlineContainmentViewError>;

    /// 返回committed immutable view identity。
    pub fn view_ref(&self) -> &RedlineContainmentViewRef;
    /// 返回owning context。
    pub fn context_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionContextRef;
    /// 返回exact containment ref。
    pub fn redline_ref(&self) -> &RedlineContainmentRef;
    /// 返回source truth watermark。
    pub fn source_truth_cursor(&self) -> SandboxTruthCursor;
    /// 返回source transition audit linkage。
    pub fn source_audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;
    /// 返回binding materialization time。
    pub fn materialized_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
}

/// exact selector命中current binding时形成的same-snapshot selection proof。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct RedlineContainmentBindingSelectionProof {
    /// 本proof消费的required exact selector。
    selector: RedlineContainmentSelector,
    /// exact-redline index当前指向的immutable binding。
    binding: RedlineContainmentViewBinding,
    /// index read完整覆盖到的truth watermark。
    lookup_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
    /// index snapshot已有的audit linkage；不是query audit。
    lookup_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    /// same-snapshot lookup observation time。
    observed_at: Timestamp,
}

impl RedlineContainmentBindingSelectionProof {
    /// 从同一read snapshot中的exact selector与current binding构造selection proof。
    pub fn try_from_committed_index(
        selector: RedlineContainmentSelector,
        binding: RedlineContainmentViewBinding,
        lookup_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
        lookup_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        observed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, RedlineContainmentViewError>;

    /// 返回checked selector。
    pub fn selector(&self) -> &RedlineContainmentSelector;
    /// 返回selected current binding。
    pub fn binding(&self) -> &RedlineContainmentViewBinding;
    /// 返回index lookup coverage watermark。
    pub fn lookup_truth_cursor(&self) -> SandboxTruthCursor;
    /// 返回index audit linkage。
    pub fn lookup_audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;
    /// 返回lookup observation time。
    pub fn observed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
}

/// exact-redline current binding index在committed watermark上明确无匹配行的proof。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct RedlineContainmentAbsenceProof {
    /// 已通过query access decision的owning context。
    context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
    /// caller明确选择但index中不存在的containment ref。
    redline_ref: RedlineContainmentRef,
    /// exact index完整读取到的truth watermark。
    lookup_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
    /// exact binding count；合法值固定为0。
    exact_binding_count: u64,
    /// absence snapshot已有的audit linkage。
    source_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    /// same-snapshot index observation time。
    observed_at: Timestamp,
}

impl RedlineContainmentAbsenceProof {
    /// 从完整exact-binding index read构造absence proof。
    pub fn try_from_committed_index_absence(
        context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
        redline_ref: RedlineContainmentRef,
        lookup_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
        exact_binding_count: u64,
        source_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        observed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, RedlineContainmentViewError>;

    /// 返回proof owning context。
    pub fn context_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionContextRef;
    /// 返回未命中的exact containment ref。
    pub fn redline_ref(&self) -> &RedlineContainmentRef;
    /// 返回proof coverage watermark。
    pub fn lookup_truth_cursor(&self) -> SandboxTruthCursor;
    /// 返回固定为0的exact binding count。
    pub fn exact_binding_count(&self) -> u64;
    /// 返回source audit linkage。
    pub fn source_audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;
    /// 返回index observation time。
    pub fn observed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
}

/// binding lookup层的closed outcome；尚未读取redline truth或owner relation。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum RedlineContainmentBindingLookupOutcome {
    /// exact selector命中一个current immutable binding。
    Found(RedlineContainmentBindingSelectionProof),
    /// exact index完整证明selected containment没有binding。
    ExactAbsent(RedlineContainmentAbsenceProof),
    /// binding index当前不可完整读取；不得构造view或absence proof。
    Unavailable {
        /// 未能完成lookup的exact selector。
        selector: RedlineContainmentSelector,
        /// 恰好一条`ViewBinding`的typed gap set。
        read_gaps: RedlineContainmentReadGapSet,
    },
}

impl RedlineContainmentBindingLookupOutcome {
    /// 构造命中binding的lookup outcome。
    pub fn found(proof: RedlineContainmentBindingSelectionProof) -> Self;
    /// 构造exact index明确无匹配行的outcome。
    pub fn exact_absent(
        selector: &RedlineContainmentSelector,
        proof: RedlineContainmentAbsenceProof,
    ) -> Result<Self, RedlineContainmentViewError>;
    /// 构造binding index不可完整读取的no-view outcome。
    pub fn unavailable(
        selector: RedlineContainmentSelector,
        read_gaps: RedlineContainmentReadGapSet,
    ) -> Result<Self, RedlineContainmentViewError>;
}
```

selection与absence的closed规则如下：

1. selector、binding的context / redline ref必须逐项相等；任何错配是integrity error，不得返回NotFound或Degraded。
2. `lookup_truth_cursor >= binding.source_truth_cursor`且`observed_at >= binding.materialized_at`；cursor为0、类型混用或
   时间回退一律拒绝。
3. 同一redline index可见两个current binding、index先于view row、binding指向另一个context / truth或current row
   被静默删除，均为integrity error；reader不得按time / ref选winner。
4. absence proof只接受matching selector且`exact_binding_count == 0`。它只授权access decision之后返回
   `surface_status=Empty, view=None`，不证明context没有其它redline，也不授权cleanup / release。
5. binding index不可用时，`Unavailable`必须恰好包含一条与selector完全匹配的`ViewBinding` gap；不得映为Empty。
6. NotVisible / Restricted优先于binding lookup与absence返回，防止exact ref成为存在性探针。
7. old immutable view row不构成第二current binding。本协议不提供view-ref历史selector；audit / reconciliation如需历史
   row必须由各自Step 8协议和retention规则显式承接。

#### 16.7.3 Contracts-only execution lineage与impact

public view不能直接持有domain-only `RedlineImpact`，但必须保留active-run、post-run和boundary-only三类安全语义。
下列contracts enum是对domain impact的一一机械投影，不拥有状态迁移，不允许caller选择或持久化回truth。

```rust
/// redline containment对run / boundary影响面的contracts-only只读投影。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum RedlineContainmentImpact {
    /// detection时run为Preparing或Running，containment必须证明exact run已终止。
    ActiveRunAndBoundary,
    /// detection时没有run，只收紧boundary / handle并保留typed signal。
    BoundaryOnly,
    /// detection时run已经终态，不改写原终态，只保留材料并收紧boundary。
    PostRunPreservation,
}

/// redline containment view使用的body-free exact execution lineage。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct RedlineContainmentLineage {
    /// owning accepted controlled execution context ref。
    context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
    /// owning execution environment identity ref。
    environment_identity_ref: ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef,
    /// active-run / post-run path的exact run；boundary-only为None。
    run_ref: Option<ControlledExecutionRunRef>,
    /// exact coherent boundary ref。
    boundary_ref: CoherentBoundaryRef,
    /// exact isolation environment handle ref。
    isolation_handle_ref: IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef,
    /// 全组共用的canonical generation ref。
    generation_ref: ResourceRef,
    /// 从domain impact机械映射的public impact。
    impact: RedlineContainmentImpact,
}

impl RedlineContainmentLineage {
    /// 从已提交containment及same-snapshot owner relation构造lineage。
    pub fn try_from_committed_relation(
        context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
        environment_identity_ref: ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef,
        run_ref: Option<ControlledExecutionRunRef>,
        boundary_ref: CoherentBoundaryRef,
        isolation_handle_ref: IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef,
        generation_ref: ResourceRef,
        impact: RedlineContainmentImpact,
    ) -> Result<Self, RedlineContainmentViewError>;

    /// 返回owning context ref。
    pub fn context_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionContextRef;
    /// 返回owning environment identity ref。
    pub fn environment_identity_ref(&self) -> &ExecutionEnvironmentIdentityRef;
    /// 返回optional exact run ref。
    pub fn run_ref(&self) -> Option<&ControlledExecutionRunRef>;
    /// 返回exact boundary ref。
    pub fn boundary_ref(&self) -> &CoherentBoundaryRef;
    /// 返回exact isolation handle ref。
    pub fn isolation_handle_ref(&self) -> &IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef;
    /// 返回canonical generation ref。
    pub fn generation_ref(&self) -> &ResourceRef;
    /// 返回source-derived public impact。
    pub fn impact(&self) -> RedlineContainmentImpact;
}
```

`ActiveRunAndBoundary | PostRunPreservation`必须携带run ref；`BoundaryOnly`必须为None。impact只能由application mapper
对domain `RedlineImpact`穷尽match后传入；不得从run是否存在单独猜测，因为active与post-run都带run。factory还必须
校验全部typed ref有效、context / identity / run / boundary / handle / generation来自同一committed relation。backend
handle source、host identity、container / pod id、process id、mount path或network address不得进入lineage。

#### 16.7.4 Body-free detection source snapshot

检测来源需要可追踪，但不能把domain signal union、forbidden marker set或external正文暴露为public字段。public snapshot
只保留source family、exact body-free refs和high-risk decision discriminator；`redline_kind`仍由truth owner单独显示。

```rust
/// public redline view允许展示的有限detection source family。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum RedlineDetectionSourceKind {
    /// trusted isolation / runner boundary observation。
    BoundaryObservation,
    /// exact non-allowed high-risk action decision。
    HighRiskDecision,
    /// forbidden external body中的secret material breach。
    ForbiddenBody,
}

/// 一个redline truth保存的body-free detection source只读快照。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct RedlineDetectionSourceSnapshot {
    /// finite source family。
    source_kind: RedlineDetectionSourceKind,
    /// boundary / forbidden-body source的external owner ref；high-risk path为None。
    external_source_ref: Option<ExternalSourceRef>,
    /// boundary / forbidden-body owner提供的safe summary；high-risk path为None。
    source_summary_ref: Option<SafeSummaryRef>,
    /// high-risk path的exact immutable decision ref；其它path为None。
    high_risk_decision_ref: Option<HighRiskActionDecisionRef>,
    /// high-risk path的canonical action kind；其它path为None。
    high_risk_action_kind: Option<HighRiskActionKind>,
    /// high-risk path的canonical non-allowed status；其它path为None。
    high_risk_action_status: Option<HighRiskActionDecisionStatus>,
}

impl RedlineDetectionSourceSnapshot {
    /// 从validated boundary observation mapper构造body-free source snapshot。
    pub fn from_boundary_observation(
        redline_kind: RedlineKind,
        external_source_ref: ExternalSourceRef,
        source_summary_ref: SafeSummaryRef,
    ) -> Result<Self, RedlineContainmentViewError>;

    /// 从exact high-risk decision构造source snapshot并重验kind映射。
    pub fn from_high_risk_decision(
        redline_kind: RedlineKind,
        high_risk_decision_ref: HighRiskActionDecisionRef,
        high_risk_action_kind: HighRiskActionKind,
        high_risk_action_status: HighRiskActionDecisionStatus,
    ) -> Result<Self, RedlineContainmentViewError>;

    /// 从validated forbidden-secret marker source构造body-free snapshot。
    pub fn from_forbidden_body(
        redline_kind: RedlineKind,
        external_source_ref: ExternalSourceRef,
        source_summary_ref: SafeSummaryRef,
    ) -> Result<Self, RedlineContainmentViewError>;

    /// 返回finite source family。
    pub fn source_kind(&self) -> RedlineDetectionSourceKind;
    /// 返回optional external source ref。
    pub fn external_source_ref(&self) -> Option<&ExternalSourceRef>;
    /// 返回optional safe source summary ref。
    pub fn source_summary_ref(&self) -> Option<&SafeSummaryRef>;
    /// 返回optional high-risk decision ref。
    pub fn high_risk_decision_ref(&self) -> Option<&HighRiskActionDecisionRef>;
    /// 返回optional high-risk action kind。
    pub fn high_risk_action_kind(&self) -> Option<HighRiskActionKind>;
    /// 返回optional high-risk action status。
    pub fn high_risk_action_status(&self) -> Option<HighRiskActionDecisionStatus>;
}
```

closed mapping如下：

| source family | required fields | `redline_kind` relation | forbidden fields / fallback |
|---|---|---|---|
| `BoundaryObservation` | external source与summary都为`IsolationBackend &#124; Runner`且source kind一致 | 由domain已保存的typed observation穷尽映射；public factory接受八项`RedlineKind`但必须由mapper同时重验domain discriminator | high-risk字段、raw backend event、status code、host/path/process/network detail、从reason猜kind |
| `HighRiskDecision` | decision ref、action kind、`Blocked &#124; PendingAuthorization &#124; Unsupported`；lineage必须有matching active run | `FilesystemExpansion -> FilesystemBoundaryBreach`;`NetworkEgress -> NetworkBoundaryBreach`;`ProcessEscape -> ProcessBoundaryBreach`;`SecretExposure -> SecretExposure`;`ResourceExpansion &#124; Unknown -> UnauthorizedHighRiskAction` | external source/summary、`Allowed`、caller-supplied kind、policy总状态 |
| `ForbiddenBody` | external source与summary同kind，允许`IsolationBackend &#124; Runner &#124; Policy &#124; Investigation` | 固定`SecretExposure`；application必须先重验domain marker set包含`SecretMaterial` | marker集合、正文类别列表、secret/body、其它kind、reason解析 |

`BoundaryObservation + RedlineKind::Other`只允许domain source明确保存
`OtherSecurityBoundaryViolation`并由mapper重验；它不是wildcard。public snapshot不保存boundary observation discriminator，
因此mapper若无法证明exact mapping必须返回typed source error，不能用`Other`兜底。high-risk source中的observed run ref
必须等于lineage run ref；该relation由后续guard snapshot factory验证，避免在source snapshot重复保存同一ref。

#### 16.7.5 Canonical status与机械read phase

`RedlineContainmentStatus`继续是唯一持久化状态owner。下列phase只按canonical status、preservation progress和latest
investigation observation机械投影，不是第二状态机，不得被保存回domain truth。

```rust
/// redline containment在read surface上的有限安全收束位置；不是持久化状态机。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum RedlineContainmentPhase {
    /// detection truth已提交，尚未证明boundary stop-new-use / optional run termination。
    DetectionRecorded,
    /// containment proof已提交，尚未形成external-call前preservation recovery point。
    ContainmentEnforced,
    /// preservation已提交，但material尚未达到可作release判断的terminal-success位置。
    PreservationPending,
    /// preservation可供判断，但external investigation尚未accepted / terminally disposed。
    InvestigationPending,
    /// latest committed observation要求guard继续完成release或terminal disposition。
    DispositionPending,
    /// redline owner已解除cleanup block；不恢复run / boundary / handle。
    Released,
    /// containment attempt以不可normal-release的安全终态收束并持续block cleanup。
    Terminal,
}
```

phase derivation固定如下；详细preservation / investigation carrier在§16.7.7~§16.7.8闭合：

| canonical status | preservation position | investigation position | public phase |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Detected` | `NotRecorded` | `NotObserved` | `DetectionRecorded` |
| `Contained` | `NotRecorded` | `NotObserved` | `ContainmentEnforced` |
| `HandoffPending` | run/post-run material为`Prepared &#124; HandoffPending` | `NotObserved &#124; Pending &#124; Accepted` | `PreservationPending` |
| `HandoffPending` | material `HandoffFailed` | `NotObserved &#124; Pending` | `InvestigationPending` |
| `HandoffPending` | material `HandoffRecorded`或boundary signal | `NotObserved &#124; Pending` | `InvestigationPending` |
| `HandoffPending` | material `HandoffRecorded &#124; HandoffFailed`或boundary signal | `Accepted &#124; Blocked &#124; Failed` | `DispositionPending` |
| `Released` | completed material或boundary signal | `Accepted` | `Released` |
| `Terminal` | material `HandoffFailed`或任意valid preservation | `Accepted &#124; Blocked &#124; Failed` | `Terminal` |

任何其它组合都是integrity error。尤其HandoffPending本身不是Degraded；`DispositionPending`允许表达external outcome
已持久化但final guard transition因version conflict、commit-unknown或worker恢复尚未完成的安全位置，它仍hard block。
`Released`只解除redline owner block；`Terminal`不可映为Released，也不能因read gap或cleanup owner状态被覆盖。

#### 16.7.6 Containment proof、failure relation 与 stop-new-use source

`RedlineContainmentView`不得从`RedlineContainmentStatus`文字推导“已阻断新使用”或“run已终止”。这些结论只允许由
与exact containment同一snapshot读取的`RedlineContainmentBasis`、matching `FailureClassification`、boundary relation
和optional run relation机械映射。以下carrier是contracts-only source carrier，不是新的domain truth；application mapper必须
先消费domain owner的exact getter，再将body-free字段复制进carrier。

```rust
/// cleanup-race中已授权teardown的body-free关系证明。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct RedlineAuthorizedTeardownProof {
    /// 产生teardown authorization的exact cleanup guard。
    cleanup_guard_ref: CleanupGuardRef,
    /// teardown针对的exact isolation handle。
    isolation_handle_ref: IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef,
    /// authorization使用的canonical generation。
    generation_ref: ResourceRef,
    /// authorization transition已有的audit linkage。
    authorization_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    /// authorization生效时间。
    authorized_at: Timestamp,
    /// authorization row的truth cursor。
    authorization_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
}

impl RedlineAuthorizedTeardownProof {
    /// 从同一committed cleanup authorization row构造proof；不携带backend target。
    pub fn try_from_committed_authorization(
        cleanup_guard_ref: CleanupGuardRef,
        isolation_handle_ref: IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef,
        generation_ref: ResourceRef,
        authorization_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        authorized_at: Timestamp,
        authorization_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
    ) -> Result<Self, RedlineContainmentViewError>;

    /// 返回exact cleanup guard ref。
    pub fn cleanup_guard_ref(&self) -> &CleanupGuardRef;
    /// 返回exact isolation handle ref。
    pub fn isolation_handle_ref(&self) -> &IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef;
    /// 返回canonical generation ref。
    pub fn generation_ref(&self) -> &ResourceRef;
    /// 返回authorization audit ref。
    pub fn authorization_audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;
    /// 返回authorization time。
    pub fn authorized_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
    /// 返回authorization truth cursor。
    pub fn authorization_truth_cursor(&self) -> SandboxTruthCursor;
}

/// redline与boundary Failed owner之间的body-free互斥关系。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum RedlineBoundaryFailureRelationSnapshot {
    /// 本redline在同一UoW首次使boundary进入Failed。
    FailedByThisRedline {
        /// boundary保存的exact redline failure ref。
        boundary_failure_ref: FailureClassificationRef,
    },
    /// cleanup authorization已使boundary停止新使用，本redline不得覆盖prior failure。
    AlreadyFailedDuringAuthorizedRelease {
        /// 已提交的teardown authorization proof。
        authorization: RedlineAuthorizedTeardownProof,
        /// boundary原样保留的prior formal failure ref；partial failure可为None。
        prior_boundary_failure_ref: Option<FailureClassificationRef>,
    },
}

impl RedlineBoundaryFailureRelationSnapshot {
    /// 判断本redline是否拥有boundary首次Failed transition。
    pub fn failed_by_this_redline(&self) -> bool;
    /// 返回cleanup-race authorization proof（若存在）。
    pub fn authorization(&self) -> Option<&RedlineAuthorizedTeardownProof>;
    /// 返回boundary既有failure ref（若存在）。
    pub fn prior_boundary_failure_ref(&self) -> Option<&FailureClassificationRef>;
}

/// 与containment basis逐项对账的formal failure status snapshot。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct RedlineFailureRelationSnapshot {
    /// matching redline-derived failure classification ref。
    failure_ref: FailureClassificationRef,
    /// failure canonical kind；必须为`Redline`。
    failure_kind: SandboxFailureKind,
    /// failure canonical status。
    failure_status: FailureClassificationStatus,
    /// failure status row的truth cursor。
    truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
    /// failure transition已有的audit linkage。
    audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    /// failure status生效时间。
    status_changed_at: Timestamp,
}

impl RedlineFailureRelationSnapshot {
    /// 从matching `FailureSource::Redline` committed row构造snapshot。
    pub fn try_from_committed_failure(
        failure_ref: FailureClassificationRef,
        failure_kind: SandboxFailureKind,

        truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,

        status_changed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, RedlineContainmentViewError>;

    /// 返回matching failure ref。

    /// 返回failure kind。
    pub fn failure_kind(&self) -> SandboxFailureKind;
    /// 返回failure status。
    pub fn failure_status(&self) -> FailureClassificationStatus;
    /// 返回failure truth cursor。
    pub fn truth_cursor(&self) -> SandboxTruthCursor;
    /// 返回failure audit ref。
    pub fn audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;
    /// 返回failure status time。
    pub fn status_changed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
}

/// 一个exact containment的stop-new-use / run termination proof。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct RedlineContainmentProofSnapshot {
    /// exact containment identity。
    redline_ref: RedlineContainmentRef,
    /// source-derived containment impact。
    impact: RedlineContainmentImpact,
    /// matching formal failure relation。
    failure: RedlineFailureRelationSnapshot,
    /// exact boundary owner。
    boundary_ref: CoherentBoundaryRef,
    /// exact isolation handle owner。
    isolation_handle_ref: IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef,
    /// canonical generation。
    generation_ref: ResourceRef,
    /// active-run / post-run path的exact run；boundary-only为None。
    run_ref: Option<ControlledExecutionRunRef>,
    /// containment proof对应的run status；active path必须为`Terminated`。
    resulting_run_status: Option<ControlledExecutionRunStatus>,
    /// stop-new-use后boundary的canonical status；必须为`Failed`。
    resulting_boundary_status: CoherentBoundaryStatus,
    /// boundary首次failure或authorized-release race关系。
    boundary_failure_relation: RedlineBoundaryFailureRelationSnapshot,
    /// owner提供的contained safe reason。
    reason: SandboxReason,
    /// containment transition audit linkage。
    audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    /// proof提交时的truth cursor。
    truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
    /// proof生效时间。
    contained_at: Timestamp,
}

impl RedlineContainmentProofSnapshot {
    /// 从同一committed containment basis、failure与owner relation构造proof。
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    pub fn try_from_committed_basis(
        redline_ref: RedlineContainmentRef,
        impact: RedlineContainmentImpact,
        failure: RedlineFailureRelationSnapshot,
        boundary_ref: CoherentBoundaryRef,
        isolation_handle_ref: IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef,
        generation_ref: ResourceRef,
        run_ref: Option<ControlledExecutionRunRef>,
        resulting_run_status: Option<ControlledExecutionRunStatus>,
        resulting_boundary_status: CoherentBoundaryStatus,
        boundary_failure_relation: RedlineBoundaryFailureRelationSnapshot,
        reason: SandboxReason,
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
        contained_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, RedlineContainmentViewError>;

    /// 返回exact containment ref。
    pub fn redline_ref(&self) -> &RedlineContainmentRef;
    /// 返回source-derived impact。
    pub fn impact(&self) -> RedlineContainmentImpact;
    /// 返回matching failure relation。
    pub fn failure(&self) -> &RedlineFailureRelationSnapshot;
    /// 返回exact boundary ref。
    pub fn boundary_ref(&self) -> &CoherentBoundaryRef;
    /// 返回exact isolation handle ref。
    pub fn isolation_handle_ref(&self) -> &IsolationEnvironmentHandleRef;
    /// 返回canonical generation ref。
    pub fn generation_ref(&self) -> &ResourceRef;
    /// 返回optional exact run ref。
    pub fn run_ref(&self) -> Option<&ControlledExecutionRunRef>;
    /// 返回resulting run status。
    pub fn resulting_run_status(&self) -> Option<ControlledExecutionRunStatus>;
    /// 返回resulting boundary status。
    pub fn resulting_boundary_status(&self) -> CoherentBoundaryStatus;
    /// 返回boundary failure relation。
    pub fn boundary_failure_relation(&self) -> &RedlineBoundaryFailureRelationSnapshot;
    /// 返回contained safe reason。
    pub fn reason(&self) -> &SandboxReason;
    /// 返回containment audit ref。
    pub fn audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;
    /// 返回proof truth cursor。
    pub fn truth_cursor(&self) -> SandboxTruthCursor;
    /// 返回containment proof time。
    pub fn contained_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;

    /// 判断是否提供active-run exact termination proof。
    pub fn proves_active_run_termination(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断是否为cleanup authorization race path。
    pub fn is_authorized_release_race(&self) -> bool;
}
```

proof factory的closed规则如下：

| impact | run relation | boundary relation | required result |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ActiveRunAndBoundary` | `run_ref=Some`，run status为`Terminated`，terminal basis为exact redline | `FailedByThisRedline`；normal path不带authorization proof | `proves_active_run_termination() == true` |
| `PostRunPreservation` | `run_ref=Some`，resulting status与detection时terminal status完全相等 | `FailedByThisRedline`或matching authorized-release race | 不得改写原run terminal basis |
| `BoundaryOnly` | `run_ref=None`且resulting run status为`None` | `FailedByThisRedline`或matching authorized-release race | 不得伪造run termination |

failure snapshot必须是`SandboxFailureKind::Redline`，其source marker必须精确指向`redline_ref`，failure lineage、impact、
boundary、handle、generation和status time必须与proof一致。`resulting_boundary_status`不是由view status推断，而是从
同一boundary row复制并要求为`Failed`。authorized-release race要求authorization的guard、handle、generation、time和
truth cursor与cleanup release relation相等，且`authorized_at <= contained_at`；它不重新写boundary failure，不撤销已授权
teardown，也不把late redline视为可忽略事件。任何proof缺失、cursor落后、failure source错误或race relation不完整均为
integrity error，不能映为degraded reason。

#### 16.7.7 Preservation source、material owner与单调位置

public view必须展示`RedlineContainment`已持久化的exact preservation recovery point，而不是现场扫描出一份
latest material。contracts carrier只复制body-free owner ref、canonical status、formal source basis、audit / cursor与时间；
material locator、digest、summary body、stdout / stderr、host path、network / process细节和下游存储生命周期不进入本快照。

```rust
/// preservation在public read surface上的单调位置；不是第二material状态机。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum RedlinePreservationPosition {
    /// canonical containment尚未持久化preservation recovery point。
    NotRecorded,
    /// exact observability material已准备，尚未打开handoff。
    Prepared,
    /// exact material的唯一handoff batch已打开且仍在pending。
    HandoffPending,
    /// exact material owner已记录下游接收事实。
    HandoffRecorded,
    /// exact material owner已记录同一batch的terminal failure。
    HandoffFailed,
    /// boundary-only path已持久化exact typed signal，不伪造run material。
    BoundarySignalRecorded,
}

/// run-bearing preservation material保留的formal owner source。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum RedlinePreservationMaterialSourceSnapshot {
    /// completed run已形成exact capture-owned observability material。
    CompletedCapture {
        /// exact immutable capture fact。
        capture_ref: CaptureFactRef,
        /// material创建时保留的canonical capture status。
        capture_status: CaptureFactStatus,
        /// material创建时保留的typed collection disposition。
        collection_disposition: CaptureCollectionDisposition,
    },
    /// failed / terminated run已绑定的formal terminal owner。
    TerminalRun {
        /// material source run的canonical terminal status。
        run_status: ControlledExecutionRunStatus,
        /// `Failure | Control | Redline` exact terminal owner ref的contracts-only投影。
        terminal_owner: RedlinePreservationRunTerminalOwner,
    },
}

/// contracts层允许展示的run formal terminal owner。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum RedlinePreservationRunTerminalOwner {
    /// failed run的formal failure owner。
    Failure(FailureClassificationRef),
    /// terminated run的formal control owner。
    Control(ControlFactRef),
    /// terminated run的formal redline owner。
    Redline(RedlineContainmentRef),
}

/// exact `ObservabilityMaterial` owner在preservation组装时的body-free状态快照。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct RedlinePreservationMaterialSnapshot {
    /// exact observability material identity。
    observability_material_ref: ObservabilityMaterialRef,
    /// material的formal capture / terminal-run source。
    source: RedlinePreservationMaterialSourceSnapshot,
    /// material owner的canonical lifecycle status。
    material_status: ObservabilityMaterialStatus,
    /// `Prepared`为None；其余状态为owner保存的唯一exact handoff ref。
    handoff_ref: Option<HandoffFactRef>,
    /// material status row的truth cursor。
    truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
    /// material latest transition已有的audit linkage。
    audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    /// material首次prepared time。
    prepared_at: Timestamp,
    /// current material status生效时间。
    status_changed_at: Timestamp,
}

impl RedlinePreservationMaterialSnapshot {
    /// 从same-snapshot exact material owner构造body-free快照。
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    pub fn try_from_committed_material(
        observability_material_ref: ObservabilityMaterialRef,
        source: RedlinePreservationMaterialSourceSnapshot,

        truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        prepared_at: Timestamp,
        status_changed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, RedlineContainmentViewError>;

    /// 返回exact observability material ref。
    pub fn observability_material_ref(&self) -> &ObservabilityMaterialRef;
    /// 返回formal material source。
    pub fn source(&self) -> &RedlinePreservationMaterialSourceSnapshot;
    /// 返回material canonical status。
    pub fn material_status(&self) -> ObservabilityMaterialStatus;
    /// 返回optional exact handoff ref。
    pub fn handoff_ref(&self) -> Option<&HandoffFactRef>;
    /// 返回material truth cursor。
    pub fn truth_cursor(&self) -> SandboxTruthCursor;
    /// 返回material transition audit ref。

    /// 返回material prepared time。

    /// 返回material status time。
```
