```rust
/// `RedlineContainment` embedded preservation snapshot的contracts-only exact投影。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum RedlinePreservationSourceSnapshot {
    /// status只允许为Detected / Contained，尚未形成recovery point。
    NotRecorded,
    /// active-run redline终止exact run后保留的redline-owned terminal material。
    RunMaterial {
        /// exact containment identity。
        redline_ref: RedlineContainmentRef,
        /// exact execution lineage；impact必须为ActiveRunAndBoundary。
        lineage: RedlineContainmentLineage,
        /// same-snapshot material owner快照。
        material: RedlinePreservationMaterialSnapshot,
        /// domain preservation snapshot assembly time。
        assembled_at: Timestamp,
    },
    /// post-run redline保留existing material与exact redline signal的recovery point。
    PostRunMaterial {
        /// exact containment identity。
        redline_ref: RedlineContainmentRef,
        /// exact execution lineage；impact必须为PostRunPreservation。
        lineage: RedlineContainmentLineage,
        /// same-snapshot existing material owner快照。
        material: RedlinePreservationMaterialSnapshot,
        /// 与containment detection source精确相等的body-free signal。
        signal_source: RedlineDetectionSourceSnapshot,
        /// domain preservation snapshot assembly time。
        assembled_at: Timestamp,
    },
    /// boundary-only redline只保留typed signal的recovery point。
    BoundarySignal {
        /// exact containment identity。
        redline_ref: RedlineContainmentRef,
        /// exact execution lineage；impact必须为BoundaryOnly且run absent。
        lineage: RedlineContainmentLineage,
        /// 与containment detection source精确相等的body-free signal。
        signal_source: RedlineDetectionSourceSnapshot,
        /// domain preservation snapshot assembly time。
        assembled_at: Timestamp,
    },
}

impl RedlinePreservationSourceSnapshot {
    /// 构造active-run exact redline terminal material recovery point。
    pub fn try_from_run_material(
        redline_ref: RedlineContainmentRef,
        lineage: RedlineContainmentLineage,
        material: RedlinePreservationMaterialSnapshot,
        assembled_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, RedlineContainmentViewError>;

    /// 构造post-run existing material + exact signal recovery point。
    pub fn try_from_post_run_material(
        redline_ref: RedlineContainmentRef,
        lineage: RedlineContainmentLineage,
        material: RedlinePreservationMaterialSnapshot,
        signal_source: RedlineDetectionSourceSnapshot,
        assembled_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, RedlineContainmentViewError>;

    /// 构造boundary-only exact signal recovery point。
    pub fn try_from_boundary_signal(
        redline_ref: RedlineContainmentRef,
        lineage: RedlineContainmentLineage,
        signal_source: RedlineDetectionSourceSnapshot,
        assembled_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, RedlineContainmentViewError>;

    /// 返回public preservation position。
    pub fn position(&self) -> RedlinePreservationPosition;
    /// 返回optional exact containment ref；NotRecorded为None。
    pub fn redline_ref(&self) -> Option<&RedlineContainmentRef>;
    /// 返回optional exact lineage；NotRecorded为None。
    pub fn lineage(&self) -> Option<&RedlineContainmentLineage>;
    /// 返回optional material snapshot；run / post-run path为Some。
    pub fn material(&self) -> Option<&RedlinePreservationMaterialSnapshot>;
    /// 返回post-run / boundary-only的exact detection source。
    pub fn signal_source(&self) -> Option<&RedlineDetectionSourceSnapshot>;
    /// 返回optional assembly time；NotRecorded为None。
    pub fn assembled_at(&self) -> Option<&Timestamp>;
}
```

material卡位和source relation的closed矩阵如下：

| preservation variant | material formal source | required exact binding | public position |
|---|---|---|---|
| `RunMaterial` | `TerminalRun { run_status=Terminated, terminal_owner=Redline(exact redline_ref) }` | material run/context/identity/boundary/handle/generation与lineage全等；proof已证明active run terminated | 按material status映射 |
| `PostRunMaterial` from completed run | `CompletedCapture` | material run与lineage run相等，capture属于该existing completed run；signal与detection source相等 | 按material status映射 |
| `PostRunMaterial` from failed / terminated run | matching `TerminalRun` formal owner | 保留detection前已有run status / terminal owner，不允许改为current redline | 按material status映射 |
| `BoundarySignal` | 无material | lineage run为None；signal与detection source相等且只允许boundary observation / forbidden body | `BoundarySignalRecorded` |

`RedlinePreservationMaterialSnapshot`对status / handoff ref只接受四个exact组合：`Prepared + None`、
`HandoffPending + Some(H)`、`HandoffRecorded + Some(H)`、`HandoffFailed + Some(H)`。
`Prepared -> HandoffPending -> HandoffRecorded | HandoffFailed`是owner允许的唯一非幂等推进；一旦出现`H`，后续
snapshot必须保持同一ref。view mapper必须验证embedded preservation status / handoff ref与该same-snapshot
material owner快照完全相等；owner已推进而containment尚未refresh、owner cursor不可读或两者ref不一致时，
不能选latest或在query内补刷，必须进入后续typed preservation gap / integrity error。

`assembled_at`不得早于containment proof time、material prepared / status time或signal source owner time。
`NotRecorded`只能与`Detected | Contained`配对；`HandoffPending | Released | Terminal`必须携带其余三个variant之一。
public position只是从exact variant + owner status穷尽match的结果，不持久、不反向更新material，也不能证明
external observability store已建立或material可删除。

#### 16.7.8 Investigation handoff exact observation

redline strict requirement下没有`NotRequired`的可见成功分支。尚未保存observation用`NotObserved`表达；一旦存在，
contracts snapshot必须复制domain observation绑定的exact preservation、typed investigation target、body-free receipt
summary、finite disposition、safe reason与两层observation time。它不保存case id、ticket内容、operator note、
security response body、evidence alias或外部验收身份。

```rust
/// external investigation对exact preservation source的public有限位置。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum RedlineInvestigationPosition {
    /// containment owner尚未保存matching observation。
    NotObserved,
    /// external investigation target已知，但尚未形成可验证接收。
    Pending,
    /// external owner已接收exact refs / safe summary；不表示investigation结案。
    Accepted,
    /// external owner明确要求继续保留并阻断normal release。
    Blocked,
    /// external handoff失败且当前没有可证明的安全接收。
    Failed,
}

/// latest persisted redline investigation observation的contracts-only body-free投影。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum RedlineInvestigationObservationSnapshot {
    /// 没有matching persisted observation；不等于NotRequired或Accepted。
    NotObserved,
    /// external owner对exact preservation snapshot给出的latest committed observation。
    Observed {
        /// exact containment identity。
        redline_ref: RedlineContainmentRef,
        /// 与containment current embedded preservation必须完全相等的快照。
        preservation: RedlinePreservationSourceSnapshot,
        /// source kind必须为ExternalSourceKind::Investigation。
        source_kind: ExternalSourceKind,
        /// exact external investigation target。
        target_ref: ExternalSourceRef,
        /// target owner返回的body-free receipt / status summary。
        receipt_summary_ref: SafeSummaryRef,
        /// `Pending | Accepted | Blocked | Failed`有限处置。
        position: RedlineInvestigationPosition,
        /// Pending / Blocked / Failed必有；Accepted必为None。
        reason: Option<SandboxReason>,
        /// generic handoff summary owner observation time。
        summary_observed_at: Timestamp,
        /// redline-specific observation time。
        observed_at: Timestamp,
    },
}

impl RedlineInvestigationObservationSnapshot {
    /// 从exact domain observation与generic handoff summary构造contracts snapshot。
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    pub fn try_from_committed_observation(
        redline_ref: RedlineContainmentRef,
        preservation: RedlinePreservationSourceSnapshot,
        source_kind: ExternalSourceKind,
        target_ref: ExternalSourceRef,
        receipt_summary_ref: SafeSummaryRef,
        position: RedlineInvestigationPosition,
        reason: Option<SandboxReason>,
        summary_observed_at: Timestamp,
        observed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, RedlineContainmentViewError>;

    /// 返回finite investigation position。
    pub fn position(&self) -> RedlineInvestigationPosition;
    /// 返回optional exact containment ref。
    pub fn redline_ref(&self) -> Option<&RedlineContainmentRef>;
    /// 返回observation绑定的optional exact preservation snapshot。
    pub fn preservation(&self) -> Option<&RedlinePreservationSourceSnapshot>;
    /// 返回optional source kind。
    pub fn source_kind(&self) -> Option<ExternalSourceKind>;
    /// 返回optional exact investigation target。
    pub fn target_ref(&self) -> Option<&ExternalSourceRef>;
    /// 返回optional body-free receipt summary。
    pub fn receipt_summary_ref(&self) -> Option<&SafeSummaryRef>;
    /// 返回pending / blocked / failed的optional safe reason。
    pub fn reason(&self) -> Option<&SandboxReason>;
    /// 返回optional generic summary observation time。
    pub fn summary_observed_at(&self) -> Option<&Timestamp>;
    /// 返回optional redline-specific observation time。
    pub fn observed_at(&self) -> Option<&Timestamp>;
    /// 只在exact preservation已被external owner接收时返回true。
    pub fn is_accepted(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断latest observation是否要求terminal disposition。
    pub fn requires_terminal_disposition(&self) -> bool;
}
```

constructor必须先将domain `InvestigationHandoffDisposition`穷尽映射为
`RedlineInvestigationPosition`；`NotRequired`没有映射，必须返回typed strict-requirement error。其余关系固定如下：

| position | target / receipt | safe reason | release meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `NotObserved` | absent | absent | canonical absence；继续hard block，不是degraded |
| `Pending` | exact Investigation refs | required | 继续等待；不得被caller或query关闭 |
| `Accepted` | exact Investigation refs | absent | 只证明exact preservation handoff已接收；是否Released仍由guard / owner决定 |
| `Blocked` | exact Investigation refs | required | guard应形成terminal disposition；view不执行transition |
| `Failed` | exact Investigation refs | required | guard应形成terminal disposition；view不重试port |

`source_kind`、`target_ref.source_kind()`与`receipt_summary_ref.source_kind()`必须同为`Investigation`。
outer target / receipt必须与generic `InvestigationHandoffSummary`中的target / summary完全相等，
`summary_observed_at <= observed_at`且两者都不早于preservation assembly time。observation中的
`redline_ref`和preservation必须与current containment embedded values exact equal；material refresh后旧observation不得继续
显示为current。duplicate equal observation可幂等映射，不同target、不同preservation或time回退是integrity error，
不能选latest、合并reason或映射为Degraded。

#### 16.7.9 Release / terminal disposition proof

`RedlineContainmentStatus::Released | Terminal`的public读取不能只复制状态文字。它必须携带与exact
preservation、investigation、guard、audit和truth cursor同一提交快照的定向proof。
`RedlineReleaseDecision` 是一次纯评估的transient input；只有`RedlineContainment` transition成功提交后才能
映射为下列committed proof。query不读取不存在的第二份release decision，也不从`Accepted`观察操作出`Released`。

```rust
/// `HandoffPending` 中仅从已加载的exact material / investigation机械判定的下一步位置。
///
/// 这是read projection，不是可调用的domain transition。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum RedlineDispositionAssessment {
    /// 尚无preservation recovery point，不具备评估资格。
    NotEligible,
    /// material仍为`Prepared | HandoffPending`或investigation仍为`Pending`。
    KeepPending,
    /// exact material已`HandoffRecorded`，且investigation已`Accepted`，可供owner产生release decision。
    ReleaseCandidate,
    /// material失败或external owner明确block / fail，只能进入terminal处置。
    TerminalCandidate,
    /// release transition已提交并保留exact release proof。
    Released,
    /// terminal transition已提交并保留exact terminal proof。
    Terminal,
}

/// `Released` transition的contracts-only持久proof。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct RedlineReleaseCompletionProofSnapshot {
    /// exact containment truth ref。
    redline_ref: RedlineContainmentRef,
    /// 产生release裁定的strict guard ref。
    guard_ref: RedlineContainmentGuardRef,
    /// release时使用的exact preservation source。
    preservation: RedlinePreservationSourceSnapshot,
    /// 对上述preservation的accepted investigation observation。
    investigation: RedlineInvestigationObservationSnapshot,
    /// owner提供的released safe reason。
    reason: SandboxReason,
    /// release transition的existing audit linkage。
    audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    /// release transition提交时的truth cursor。
    truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
    /// redline owner解除cleanup block的canonical time。
    released_at: Timestamp,
}

impl RedlineReleaseCompletionProofSnapshot {
    /// 从committed `RedlineReleaseBasis` 及其same-snapshot子字段构造proof。
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    pub fn try_from_committed_release(
        redline_ref: RedlineContainmentRef,
        guard_ref: RedlineContainmentGuardRef,
        preservation: RedlinePreservationSourceSnapshot,
        investigation: RedlineInvestigationObservationSnapshot,
        reason: SandboxReason,
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
        released_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, RedlineContainmentViewError>;

    /// 返回exact containment ref。
    pub fn redline_ref(&self) -> &RedlineContainmentRef;
    /// 返回strict guard ref。
    pub fn guard_ref(&self) -> &RedlineContainmentGuardRef;
    /// 返回exact released preservation。
    pub fn preservation(&self) -> &RedlinePreservationSourceSnapshot;
    /// 返回accepted investigation observation。
    pub fn investigation(&self) -> &RedlineInvestigationObservationSnapshot;
    /// 返回released safe reason。
    pub fn reason(&self) -> &SandboxReason;
    /// 返回release audit ref。
    pub fn audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;
    /// 返回release truth cursor。
    pub fn truth_cursor(&self) -> SandboxTruthCursor;
    /// 返回released time。
    pub fn released_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
}

/// `Terminal` transition的contracts-only终态proof。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct RedlineTerminalDispositionProofSnapshot {
    /// exact containment truth ref。
    redline_ref: RedlineContainmentRef,
    /// 产生terminal裁定的strict guard ref。
    guard_ref: RedlineContainmentGuardRef,
    /// terminal时保留的exact preservation source。
    preservation: RedlinePreservationSourceSnapshot,
    /// 最后一次matching investigation observation。
    investigation: RedlineInvestigationObservationSnapshot,
    /// 只允许closed terminal cause。
    cause: RedlineTerminalDispositionCause,
    /// owner提供的terminal safe reason。
    reason: SandboxReason,
    /// terminal transition的existing audit linkage。
    audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    /// terminal transition提交时的truth cursor。
    truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
    /// terminal transition的canonical time。
    terminal_at: Timestamp,
}

/// `Terminal` 只能由guard已闭合的三类责任收束触发。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum RedlineTerminalDispositionCause {
    /// material handoff definitive failed，但investigation owner已接收责任。
    MaterialHandoffFailedAfterAcceptedInvestigation,
    /// investigation owner明确要求保留现场。
    InvestigationBlocked,
    /// investigation handoff failed，无法证明责任接收。
    InvestigationFailed,
}

impl RedlineTerminalDispositionProofSnapshot {
    /// 从committed terminal owner与exact preservation / investigation构造proof。
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    pub fn try_from_committed_terminal(
        redline_ref: RedlineContainmentRef,
        guard_ref: RedlineContainmentGuardRef,
        preservation: RedlinePreservationSourceSnapshot,
        investigation: RedlineInvestigationObservationSnapshot,
        cause: RedlineTerminalDispositionCause,
        reason: SandboxReason,
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
        terminal_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, RedlineContainmentViewError>;

    /// 返回exact containment ref。
    pub fn redline_ref(&self) -> &RedlineContainmentRef;
    /// 返回strict guard ref。
    pub fn guard_ref(&self) -> &RedlineContainmentGuardRef;
    /// 返回exact terminal preservation。
    pub fn preservation(&self) -> &RedlinePreservationSourceSnapshot;
    /// 返回matching investigation observation。
    pub fn investigation(&self) -> &RedlineInvestigationObservationSnapshot;
    /// 返回closed terminal cause。
    pub fn cause(&self) -> RedlineTerminalDispositionCause;
    /// 返回terminal safe reason。
    pub fn reason(&self) -> &SandboxReason;
    /// 返回terminal audit ref。
    pub fn audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;
    /// 返回terminal truth cursor。
    pub fn truth_cursor(&self) -> SandboxTruthCursor;
    /// 返回terminal time。
    pub fn terminal_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
}

/// 读取面可见的已提交处置proof；不拥有任何transition能力。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum RedlineDispositionProofSnapshot {
    /// 当前还没有已提交的Released / Terminal proof。
    NotCommitted,
    /// 已提交的Released proof。
    Released(RedlineReleaseCompletionProofSnapshot),
    /// 已提交的Terminal proof。
    Terminal(RedlineTerminalDispositionProofSnapshot),
}

impl RedlineDispositionProofSnapshot {
    /// 返回当前committed disposition位置。
    pub fn position(&self) -> RedlineDispositionAssessment;
    /// 返回optional released proof。
    pub fn released(&self) -> Option<&RedlineReleaseCompletionProofSnapshot>;
    /// 返回optional terminal proof。
    pub fn terminal(&self) -> Option<&RedlineTerminalDispositionProofSnapshot>;
    /// 判断是否是已提交的终态proof。
    pub fn is_committed_terminal(&self) -> bool;
}
```

proof factory必须遵循以下关系：

| canonical status | proof variant | exact prerequisites | public assessment |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Detected` | `NotCommitted` | 无containment proof，不许作处置评估 | `NotEligible` |
| `Contained` | `NotCommitted` | stop-new-use proof已存在，preservation尚未建立 | `NotEligible` |
| `HandoffPending` | `NotCommitted` | material `Prepared &#124; HandoffPending`或investigation `Pending` | `KeepPending` |
| `HandoffPending` | `NotCommitted` | material `HandoffRecorded` + investigation `Accepted` | `ReleaseCandidate` |
| `HandoffPending` | `NotCommitted` | material `HandoffFailed` + investigation `Accepted`，或investigation `Blocked &#124; Failed` | `TerminalCandidate` |
| `Released` | `Released` | proof中的preservation / observation / guard / cursor / audit与owner row exact equal；investigation必须`Accepted` | `Released` |
| `Terminal` | `Terminal` | cause与材料和investigation状态穷尽匹配；release proof必须为`None` | `Terminal` |

`ReleaseCandidate` 和`TerminalCandidate`只表示同一committed source可被guard评估，不证明`RedlineReleaseDecision`已提交。
`KeepPending` 不创建新status、audit、proof或异步重试。`Released` 不证明backend已释放或cleanup已完成；
`Terminal` 不可被映射为`Released`。如果已授权teardown后出现late redline，必须新建立containment并在当前读取中展示；不能修改旧release proof。

#### 16.7.10 Typed read gap与四值read surface outcome

read gap只描述formal reader在一次公平读取中无法覆盖的依赖类别；它不是`RedlineContainmentStatus`、不是失败classification，也不允许读取路径调用repair。已知的错行、错配、half-commit、cursor回退和证据互相矛盾必须抛出integrity error，不能降级为普通gap。

```rust
/// redline view source可安全分类的闭集读取缺口。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum RedlineContainmentReadGapKind {
    /// current / exact view binding index不可完整读取。
    ViewBinding,
    /// `RedlineContainment` truth row或其当前status字段不可完整读取。
    ContainmentTruth,
    /// context / identity / boundary / handle / generation / optional run的exact lineage不可证明。
    LineageTruth,
    /// detection source的typed ref、safe summary或high-risk decision不可完整读取。
    DetectionSource,
    /// stop-new-use、failure、boundary、run termination或authorized-release race proof不可证明。
    ContainmentProof,
    /// preservation recovery point、material owner或signal绑定不可完整读取。
    Preservation,
    /// investigation target、receipt summary、disposition或绑定的快照不可完整读取。
    Investigation,
    /// release / terminal proof或当前处置关系不可完整读取。
    Disposition,
    /// 非权威projection / materialization source不新鲜，但不能覆盖当前truth。
    ProjectionSource,
}

/// 一条与exact selector和truth watermark绑定的caller-safe typed gap。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct RedlineContainmentReadGap {
    /// gap的closed类别。
    gap_kind: RedlineContainmentReadGapKind,
    /// access decision已通过的owning context。
    context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
    /// exact selector的containment ref；ViewBinding gap也必须携带它。
    redline_ref: RedlineContainmentRef,
    /// 当前source必须覆盖的truth cursor。
    required_through_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
    /// reader能证明的已覆盖cursor；完全不可用时为None。
    available_through_cursor: Option<SandboxTruthCursor>,
    /// 只能暴露给caller的安全reason。
    reason: SandboxReason,
}

impl RedlineContainmentReadGap {
    /// 从formal reader typed disposition构造gap。
    pub fn try_from_reader_disposition(
        gap_kind: RedlineContainmentReadGapKind,
        context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
        redline_ref: RedlineContainmentRef,
        required_through_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
        available_through_cursor: Option<SandboxTruthCursor>,
        reason: SandboxReason,
    ) -> Result<Self, RedlineContainmentViewError>;

    /// 返回gap类别。
    pub fn gap_kind(&self) -> RedlineContainmentReadGapKind;
    /// 返回owning context。
    pub fn context_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionContextRef;
    /// 返回exact containment ref。
    pub fn redline_ref(&self) -> &RedlineContainmentRef;
    /// 返回required coverage cursor。
    pub fn required_through_cursor(&self) -> SandboxTruthCursor;
    /// 返回optional available cursor。
    pub fn available_through_cursor(&self) -> Option<SandboxTruthCursor>;
    /// 返回caller-safe gap reason。
    pub fn reason(&self) -> &SandboxReason;
}

/// 非空、ordered-unique的redline read gap集合。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct RedlineContainmentReadGapSet(Vec<RedlineContainmentReadGap>);

impl RedlineContainmentReadGapSet {
    /// 按`ViewBinding -> ContainmentTruth -> LineageTruth -> DetectionSource -> ContainmentProof -> Preservation -> Investigation -> Disposition -> ProjectionSource`构造闭集。
    pub fn try_new(
        gaps: Vec<RedlineContainmentReadGap>,
    ) -> Result<Self, RedlineContainmentViewError>;
    /// 返回不变gap切片。
    pub fn as_slice(&self) -> &[RedlineContainmentReadGap];
    /// 判断是否包含指定gap kind。
    pub fn contains(&self, kind: RedlineContainmentReadGapKind) -> bool;
    /// 将typed gap逐项映射为shared caller-safe degraded reason。
    pub fn to_degraded_reasons(
        &self,
    ) -> Result<StatusViewDegradedReasonSet, RedlineContainmentViewError>;
}
```

gap与读取结果的关系固定如下：

| gap kind | 可能的公开结果 | 必须保持的安全口径 |
|---|---|---|
| `ViewBinding` | `Unavailable` | 只能带一条与selector exact match的gap；不能构造view或absence proof |
| `ContainmentTruth &#124; LineageTruth &#124; DetectionSource &#124; ContainmentProof` | `Unavailable` | 缺少核心security source时不返回部分view；不能以status文字补造proof |
| `Preservation &#124; Investigation` | `Unavailable` | `HandoffPending` / `Released` / `Terminal`都必须能证明对应的保留与责任交接 |
| `Disposition` | `Degraded`仅限当前canonical status为`HandoffPending`且已加载完整核心source | 只能表示“处置评估关系缺失”，保持hard block；`Released &#124; Terminal`遇到该gap一律不可返回view |
| `ProjectionSource` | `Degraded`仅限`Detected &#124; Contained &#124; HandoffPending &#124; Terminal`的完整security field group；`Released`为`Unavailable` | 可显示已加载的hard block truth，但不能宣称current projection linkage完整；不得使用过期view body |

`RedlineContainmentReadGapSet`只能包含一个同类gap，不自动去重；多个backend / repository失败必须由formal reader合并为覆盖范围最保守的一条gap。所有gap的`required_through_cursor`必须与已命中binding的source cursor相等；`available` 若存在必须严格早于required。已知的方法错误、两个current binding、错误lineage、证据矛盾、cursor回退和明确的完整row缺失不是gap，而是`RedlineContainmentViewError`。

#### 16.7.11 Same-snapshot source composition、timeline与lookup outcome

`RedlineContainmentSourceSnapshot` 是读取路径唯一的合成输入。它必须由一次对已命中binding、canonical truth、exact lineage、detection source、containment proof、preservation、investigation和处置proof的同一致公平读取组装。
不允许先读取status再分别追查material、调用外部port、扫描latest row或以query时间创建第二快照。

```rust
/// exact containment的public timeline快照；无关联的时间必须为None。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct RedlineContainmentTimelineSnapshot {
    /// detection truth首次提交时间。
    detected_at: Timestamp,
    /// 首次进入Contained的时间。
    contained_at: Option<Timestamp>,
    /// 首次进入HandoffPending的时间。
    handoff_pending_at: Option<Timestamp>,
    /// 进入Released的时间。
    released_at: Option<Timestamp>,
    /// 进入Terminal的时间。
    terminal_at: Option<Timestamp>,
    /// 当前canonical status生效时间。
    status_changed_at: Timestamp,
}

impl RedlineContainmentTimelineSnapshot {
    /// 从committed truth row构造timeline；不接受query clock。
    pub fn try_from_committed_truth(
        detected_at: Timestamp,
        contained_at: Option<Timestamp>,
        handoff_pending_at: Option<Timestamp>,
        released_at: Option<Timestamp>,
        terminal_at: Option<Timestamp>,
        status_changed_at: Timestamp,
        containment_status: RedlineContainmentStatus,
    ) -> Result<Self, RedlineContainmentViewError>;

    /// 返回 detection time。
    pub fn detected_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
    /// 返回 optional contained time。
    pub fn contained_at(&self) -> Option<&Timestamp>;
    /// 返回 optional handoff-pending time。
    pub fn handoff_pending_at(&self) -> Option<&Timestamp>;
    /// 返回 optional released time。
    pub fn released_at(&self) -> Option<&Timestamp>;
    /// 返回 optional terminal time。
    pub fn terminal_at(&self) -> Option<&Timestamp>;
    /// 返回 current status time。
    pub fn status_changed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
}

/// containment proof是否已存在的explicit source union。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum RedlineContainmentProofState {
    /// `Detected`时尚未形成stop-new-use proof。
    NotContained,
    /// `Contained | HandoffPending | Released | Terminal`的exact proof。
    Contained(RedlineContainmentProofSnapshot),
}

impl RedlineContainmentProofState {
    /// 构造不含containment proof的初始位置。
    pub fn not_contained() -> Self;
    /// 构造已校验的containment proof。
    pub fn contained(
        proof: RedlineContainmentProofSnapshot,
    ) -> Result<Self, RedlineContainmentViewError>;
    /// 判断是否已提供stop-new-use proof。
    pub fn is_contained(&self) -> bool;
    /// 返回optional proof。
    pub fn proof(&self) -> Option<&RedlineContainmentProofSnapshot>;
}

/// 一个同一committed snapshot中的redline读取公开字段。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct RedlineContainmentSourceSnapshot {
    /// exact selector与current binding proof。
    selection: RedlineContainmentBindingSelectionProof,
    /// exact containment owner的strict guard ref。
    guard_ref: RedlineContainmentGuardRef,
    /// canonical redline kind。
    redline_kind: RedlineKind,
    /// exact body-free execution lineage。
    lineage: RedlineContainmentLineage,
    /// detection source的body-free snapshot。
    detection_source: RedlineDetectionSourceSnapshot,
    /// stop-new-use / run termination proof state。
    containment_proof: RedlineContainmentProofState,
    /// canonical containment status。
    containment_status: RedlineContainmentStatus,
    /// owner提供的current safe reason。
    status_reason: SandboxReason,
    /// exact preservation source。
    preservation: RedlinePreservationSourceSnapshot,
    /// latest matching investigation observation。
    investigation: RedlineInvestigationObservationSnapshot,
    /// 已完整读取时为committed disposition proof；Disposition gap时为None。
    disposition: Option<RedlineDispositionProofSnapshot>,
    /// containment lifecycle时间轴。
    timeline: RedlineContainmentTimelineSnapshot,
    /// source快照覆盖到的truth watermark。
    source_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
    /// source truth已有的audit linkage；不是query audit。
    source_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    /// mapper完成这次formal read的观测时间。
    observed_at: Timestamp,
    /// non-empty时表示只能形成degraded或no-view。
    read_gaps: Option<RedlineContainmentReadGapSet>,
}

impl RedlineContainmentSourceSnapshot {
    /// 构造没有typed gap的完整source。
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    pub fn complete(
        selection: RedlineContainmentBindingSelectionProof,
        guard_ref: RedlineContainmentGuardRef,
        redline_kind: RedlineKind,
        lineage: RedlineContainmentLineage,
        detection_source: RedlineDetectionSourceSnapshot,
        containment_proof: RedlineContainmentProofState,
        containment_status: RedlineContainmentStatus,
        status_reason: SandboxReason,
        preservation: RedlinePreservationSourceSnapshot,
        investigation: RedlineInvestigationObservationSnapshot,
        disposition: RedlineDispositionProofSnapshot,
        timeline: RedlineContainmentTimelineSnapshot,
        source_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
        source_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        observed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, RedlineContainmentViewError>;

    /// 构造仅带允许gap的当前完整核心source。
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    pub fn degraded(
        selection: RedlineContainmentBindingSelectionProof,
        guard_ref: RedlineContainmentGuardRef,
        redline_kind: RedlineKind,
        lineage: RedlineContainmentLineage,
        detection_source: RedlineDetectionSourceSnapshot,
        containment_proof: RedlineContainmentProofState,
        containment_status: RedlineContainmentStatus,
        status_reason: SandboxReason,
        preservation: RedlinePreservationSourceSnapshot,
        investigation: RedlineInvestigationObservationSnapshot,
        disposition: Option<RedlineDispositionProofSnapshot>,
        timeline: RedlineContainmentTimelineSnapshot,
        source_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
        source_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        read_gaps: RedlineContainmentReadGapSet,
        observed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, RedlineContainmentViewError>;

    /// 返回checked binding selection。
    pub fn selection(&self) -> &RedlineContainmentBindingSelectionProof;
    /// 返回strict guard ref。
    pub fn guard_ref(&self) -> &RedlineContainmentGuardRef;
    /// 返回canonical redline kind。
    pub fn redline_kind(&self) -> RedlineKind;
    /// 返回exact lineage。
    pub fn lineage(&self) -> &RedlineContainmentLineage;
    /// 返回detection source。
    pub fn detection_source(&self) -> &RedlineDetectionSourceSnapshot;
    /// 返回containment proof state。
    pub fn containment_proof(&self) -> &RedlineContainmentProofState;
    /// 返回canonical containment status。
    pub fn containment_status(&self) -> RedlineContainmentStatus;
    /// 返回current safe reason。
    pub fn status_reason(&self) -> &SandboxReason;
    /// 返回exact preservation source。
    pub fn preservation(&self) -> &RedlinePreservationSourceSnapshot;
    /// 返回latest investigation observation。
    pub fn investigation(&self) -> &RedlineInvestigationObservationSnapshot;
    /// 返回committed disposition proof；Disposition gap时为None。
    pub fn disposition(&self) -> Option<&RedlineDispositionProofSnapshot>;
    /// 返回containment timeline。
    pub fn timeline(&self) -> &RedlineContainmentTimelineSnapshot;
    /// 返回source truth cursor。
    pub fn source_truth_cursor(&self) -> SandboxTruthCursor;
    /// 返回source audit ref。
    pub fn source_audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;
    /// 返回formal read observation time。
    pub fn observed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
    /// 返回optional typed gaps。
    pub fn read_gaps(&self) -> Option<&RedlineContainmentReadGapSet>;
    /// 判断是否由typed gap降级。
    pub fn is_degraded(&self) -> bool;
}
```

source factory的closed relation：

1. `selection.selector().context_ref()`、`selection.selector().redline_ref()`与`lineage.context_ref()`、与source中所有exact redline ref逐项相等；`guard_ref`、`redline_kind`、`detection_source`、proof、preservation、investigation与committed truth owner的exact getter一致。
2. `source_truth_cursor == selection.binding().source_truth_cursor()`，且不早于proof、preservation material、investigation、disposition、timeline和source audit的cursor；`observed_at`不早于所有已复制时间。
3. `complete` 必须`read_gaps=None`且`disposition=Some`。`degraded` 只允许恰好一条gap：`Disposition`要求`HandoffPending + disposition=None`；`ProjectionSource`要求canonical status为`Detected | Contained | HandoffPending | Terminal`、所有security field完整且`disposition=Some`。`Released`和其他gap类别不能进入degraded source。
4. `Detected` 只允许`NotContained + NotRecorded + NotObserved + NotCommitted`；`Contained` 只允许已有proof而不能有preservation或处置proof；`Released` 必须是Accepted investigation + Released proof；`Terminal` 必须是Terminal proof且不得携带Released proof。
5. `HandoffPending` 必须有containment proof和preservation；investigation可为`NotObserved | Pending | Accepted | Blocked | Failed`，但`NotRequired`无法映射。当前没有Disposition gap时必须有`Some(disposition)`；当前有gap时只能保持`None`。处置评估只能来自这些已加载的子字段，不能在source factory内调guard。
6. 本selector只命中exact containment的current binding。旧immutable view row只由audit / reconciliation的后续专用协议读取，不进入本source factory，也不能被当作current materialization或cleanup关闭证明。

```rust
/// 已命中绑定后的source reader输出；不执行view构造或mutation。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum RedlineContainmentSourceLookupOutcome {
    /// 已形成完整或允许的degraded source。
    ViewSource(RedlineContainmentSourceSnapshot),
    /// exact binding index完整证明该selector没有current binding。
    ExactAbsent(RedlineContainmentAbsenceProof),
    /// source不足以安全形成view body。
    Unavailable {
        /// 原始exact selector。
        selector: RedlineContainmentSelector,
        /// 非空typed读取缺口。
        read_gaps: RedlineContainmentReadGapSet,
    },
}

impl RedlineContainmentSourceLookupOutcome {
    /// 构造可进入view factory的source。
    pub fn view_source(source: RedlineContainmentSourceSnapshot) -> Self;
    /// 构造exact absence outcome。
    pub fn exact_absent(
        selector: &RedlineContainmentSelector,
        proof: RedlineContainmentAbsenceProof,
    ) -> Result<Self, RedlineContainmentViewError>;
    /// 构造不可形成view body的unavailable outcome。
    pub fn unavailable(
        selector: RedlineContainmentSelector,
        read_gaps: RedlineContainmentReadGapSet,
    ) -> Result<Self, RedlineContainmentViewError>;
}
```

`ExactAbsent` 只能由已通过access decision的exact binding索引产生；如果binding已命中而truth row、proof、material或view row缺失，必须是`Unavailable`或integrity error，不能回退成`Empty`。`Unavailable`的`ViewBinding` gap必须是唯一一条gap；已命中binding后的其余gap必须携带同一selector与matching binding cursor。

#### 16.7.12 Exact error surface

`RedlineContainmentViewError`只描述已进入contracts mapper后的结构完整性。它必须把selector、
binding、lineage、detection、containment proof、preservation、investigation、disposition、timeline、
coverage cursor和view field的非法关系分别保留为typed variant；不得以一个`InvalidState`或自由文本
让application重新解析错误类别。

```rust
/// redline containment read contract的selector、proof、source或view关系错误。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum RedlineContainmentViewError {
    /// required context或exact redline selector为空、错型或出现非法组合。
    SelectorShapeInvalid,
    /// selector中的context / redline与已命中的binding不完全相等。
    SelectorBindingMismatch,
    /// exact current binding重复、指向错误view或与immutable row半提交。
    CurrentBindingIntegrityInvalid,
    /// exact absence proof的selector、count、cursor、audit或观察时间关系无效。
    AbsenceProofInvalid,
    /// lookup outcome把Found、ExactAbsent或Unavailable放到了错误selector分支。
    BindingLookupOutcomeInvalid,
    /// view binding的context、redline、view ref、source cursor、audit或materialized time无效。
    ViewBindingRelationInvalid,
    /// containment lineage的run optional shape、impact与context / identity / boundary / handle / generation关系无效。
    LineageShapeInvalid,
    /// detection source family与domain source discriminator不匹配。
    DetectionSourceShapeInvalid {
        /// 关系失败的closed detection source family。
        source_kind: RedlineDetectionSourceKind,
    },
    /// detection source的typed ref、summary、high-risk字段或redline kind映射不满足闭集。
    DetectionSourceFieldRelationInvalid,
    /// containment status、proof state、boundary状态或run termination proof不一致。
    ContainmentProofRelationInvalid,
    /// matching failure row不是Redline kind，或status / cursor / audit / time关系不合法。
    FailureRelationInvalid {
        /// 关系失败的canonical failure status。
        status: FailureClassificationStatus,
    },
    /// boundary首次失败与authorized-release race proof不满足互斥关系。
    BoundaryFailureRelationInvalid,
    /// preserving source variant与impact、run shape或detection signal不一致。
    PreservationShapeInvalid,
    /// material owner status、handoff ref、source、cursor、audit或时间关系无效。
    PreservationMaterialRelationInvalid {
        /// 关系失败的canonical material status。
        material_status: ObservabilityMaterialStatus,
    },
    /// preservation position、redline ref或assembly time关系无效。
    PreservationSnapshotRelationInvalid {
        /// 关系失败的public preservation position。
        position: RedlinePreservationPosition,
    },
    /// strict redline requirement被错误映射为NotRequired或缺少matching observation。
    InvestigationRequirementMissing,
    /// investigation target、receipt summary、source kind、reason cardinality或时间关系无效。
    InvestigationObservationRelationInvalid {
        /// 关系失败的finite investigation position。
        position: RedlineInvestigationPosition,
    },
    /// disposition assessment无法从同一committed preservation / investigation source穷尽派生。
    DispositionAssessmentInvalid,
    /// committed Released proof与exact preservation、Accepted observation、guard、cursor、audit或时间不一致。
    ReleaseProofRelationInvalid,
    /// committed Terminal proof的cause、preservation、investigation、guard、cursor、audit或时间不一致。
    TerminalProofRelationInvalid {
        /// 关系失败的closed terminal cause。
        cause: RedlineTerminalDispositionCause,
    },
    /// proof variant与canonical containment status不匹配，或Released / Terminal proof互斥关系被破坏。
    DispositionProofStatusInvalid,
    /// lifecycle timeline的历史时间缺失、越序、与canonical status不一致或被query clock覆盖。
    TimelineRelationInvalid,
    /// source、binding、proof、material、investigation或disposition cursor为零、回退或跨越required watermark。
    TruthCursorRelationInvalid,
    /// source中的任何committed time违反detected -> contained -> handoff -> terminal的单调关系。
    TimestampRelationInvalid,
    /// typed read gap的context、redline、required / available cursor或safe reason关系无效。
    ReadGapRelationInvalid,
    /// gap set为空、重复、非canonical order或超过本对象允许的组合。
    ReadGapSetInvalid,
    /// typed gap与shared StatusViewDegradedReasonSet没有逐项、同序映射。
    ReadGapReasonMappingInvalid,
    /// complete / degraded source收到错误gap，或缺少构造public field group所需的核心source。
    SourceCompletenessRelationInvalid,
    /// source lookup outcome的selector、gap、absence或source关系不满足closed mapping。
    SourceLookupOutcomeInvalid,
    /// final view字段没有从同一checked source机械复制，或complete / degraded factory选错。
    ViewFieldRelationInvalid,
}
```

本enum不承接repository unavailable、snapshot isolation失败、query access denial、NotVisible /
Restricted、transport、invalid public request、unsupported version或public error mapping；这些错误由
Step 7/8 的application与public error owner映射。反向地，malformed committed row、两个current
binding、wrong lineage、known half-commit、cursor回退、证据矛盾和release / terminal outcome conflict
不得降级为repository unavailable或普通degraded reason。

variant payload只能携带本节已经登记的closed enum；不得携带SQL、table/key、raw row、SDK/HTTP/IO cause、
backend target、page token、investigation body、artifact / observability正文、path、host、PID、endpoint、
credential、operator note或hidden existence ref。safe reason只存在于validated source、gap或final view，
不作为error自由文本。

#### 16.7.13 Final `RedlineContainmentView`、factory、getter与helper

`RedlineContainmentView`只表示一个required exact selector命中的current immutable binding。它不提供
historical selector、latest fallback或context-only集合语义；旧immutable row必须由后续audit /
reconciliation协议定义独立读取面。view中的所有字段都来自同一个`RedlineContainmentSourceSnapshot`，
且source的selector、binding与truth cursor已经在factory前完成校验。

```rust
/// 一个exact current redline containment的body-free committed read model。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct RedlineContainmentView {
    /// status materialization writer已提交的immutable view identity。
    view_ref: RedlineContainmentViewRef,
    /// view唯一归属的owning controlled execution context。
    context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
    /// caller明确选择并由binding证明的exact containment identity。
    redline_ref: RedlineContainmentRef,
    /// exact containment owner使用的strict guard identity。
    guard_ref: RedlineContainmentGuardRef,
    /// canonical redline kind，由truth owner提供。
    redline_kind: RedlineKind,
    /// exact body-free execution lineage。
    lineage: RedlineContainmentLineage,
    /// detection source的finite、body-free快照。
    detection_source: RedlineDetectionSourceSnapshot,
    /// stop-new-use / optional run termination proof state。
    containment_proof: RedlineContainmentProofState,
    /// 唯一persisted redline lifecycle status owner的当前状态。
    containment_status: RedlineContainmentStatus,
    /// 由status、preservation、investigation与committed disposition机械派生的read phase。
    phase: RedlineContainmentPhase,
    /// truth owner提供的caller-safe current reason。
    status_reason: SandboxReason,
    /// exact persisted preservation recovery point。
    preservation: RedlinePreservationSourceSnapshot,
    /// latest matching external investigation observation。
    investigation: RedlineInvestigationObservationSnapshot,
    /// 已完整读取时为Some；Disposition gap的合法degraded view为None。
    disposition: Option<RedlineDispositionProofSnapshot>,
    /// containment lifecycle timeline，所有时间来自committed truth。
    timeline: RedlineContainmentTimelineSnapshot,
    /// read gap逐项映射出的caller-safe reason；complete view为None。
    degraded_reasons: Option<StatusViewDegradedReasonSet>,
    /// source transition已有的audit linkage；不是query audit。
    source_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    /// selected current binding覆盖的truth watermark。
    source_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
    /// formal read完成后的观察时间。
    observed_at: Timestamp,
}

impl RedlineContainmentView {
    /// 从完整、same-snapshot、relation-checked source构造Visible view。
    pub fn from_committed_snapshot(
        source: RedlineContainmentSourceSnapshot,
    ) -> Result<Self, RedlineContainmentViewError>;

    /// 从完整核心security fields与一个允许的typed gap构造Degraded view。
    pub fn from_degraded_snapshot(
        source: RedlineContainmentSourceSnapshot,
    ) -> Result<Self, RedlineContainmentViewError>;

    /// 返回immutable view identity。
    pub fn view_ref(&self) -> &RedlineContainmentViewRef;
    /// 返回owning context。
    pub fn context_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionContextRef;
    /// 返回exact redline containment identity。
    pub fn redline_ref(&self) -> &RedlineContainmentRef;
    /// 返回exact containment owner使用的strict guard identity。
    pub fn guard_ref(&self) -> &RedlineContainmentGuardRef;
    /// 返回canonical redline kind。
    pub fn redline_kind(&self) -> RedlineKind;
    /// 返回exact body-free execution lineage。
    pub fn lineage(&self) -> &RedlineContainmentLineage;
    /// 返回body-free detection source。
    pub fn detection_source(&self) -> &RedlineDetectionSourceSnapshot;
    /// 返回stop-new-use / run termination proof state。
    pub fn containment_proof(&self) -> &RedlineContainmentProofState;
    /// 返回canonical persisted containment status。
    pub fn containment_status(&self) -> RedlineContainmentStatus;
    /// 返回mechanically derived read phase。
    pub fn phase(&self) -> RedlineContainmentPhase;
    /// 返回truth owner提供的current safe reason。
    pub fn status_reason(&self) -> &SandboxReason;
    /// 返回exact preservation source。
    pub fn preservation(&self) -> &RedlinePreservationSourceSnapshot;
    /// 返回latest investigation observation。
    pub fn investigation(&self) -> &RedlineInvestigationObservationSnapshot;
    /// 返回optional committed Released / Terminal proof。
    pub fn disposition(&self) -> Option<&RedlineDispositionProofSnapshot>;
    /// 返回当前已提交proof的assessment；gap时为None。
    pub fn disposition_assessment(&self) -> Option<RedlineDispositionAssessment>;
    /// 返回containment lifecycle timeline。
    pub fn timeline(&self) -> &RedlineContainmentTimelineSnapshot;
    /// 返回optional caller-safe degraded reasons。
    pub fn degraded_reasons(&self) -> Option<&StatusViewDegradedReasonSet>;
    /// 返回source transition的audit linkage。
    pub fn source_audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;
    /// 返回source truth watermark。
    pub fn source_truth_cursor(&self) -> SandboxTruthCursor;
    /// 返回formal read observation time。
    pub fn observed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;

    /// 判断view是否由非空typed read gap显式降级。
    pub fn is_degraded(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断同一source是否明确提供了containment proof。
    pub fn proves_containment(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断当前redline是否仍阻断cleanup安全完成。
    pub fn is_cleanup_blocking(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断当前status是否为已提交Released proof。
    pub fn is_released(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断当前status是否为不可normal-release的Terminal。
    pub fn is_terminal(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断当前view是否可作为只读安全记录；不表示任何mutation permission。
    pub fn is_read_complete(&self) -> bool;
}
```

`RedlineContainmentPhase`的派生必须由source carrier上的四个字段纯函数完成，不接受query clock、
caller phase或status文字：

```rust
impl RedlineContainmentPhase {
    /// 从同一committed source穷尽派生read phase；未知组合返回typed integrity error。
    pub fn try_from_source(
        containment_status: RedlineContainmentStatus,
        containment_proof: &RedlineContainmentProofState,
        preservation: &RedlinePreservationSourceSnapshot,
        investigation: &RedlineInvestigationObservationSnapshot,
        disposition: Option<&RedlineDispositionProofSnapshot>,
    ) -> Result<Self, RedlineContainmentViewError>;
}
```

factory的顺序固定为：

1. 验证source selector、current binding、truth owner ref、lineage、detection source、proof、preservation、
   investigation、timeline和source audit全部属于同一exact redline；source中的context与redline ref不能由
   final factory重新选择。
2. 调用`RedlineContainmentPhase::try_from_source`，并重验phase与canonical status的闭集。任何
   `Detected + Contained proof`、`Released + Terminal proof`、`Terminal + Released proof`或
   `HandoffPending + missing preservation`都是integrity error。
3. `from_committed_snapshot`只接受`read_gaps=None`、`disposition=Some`以及完整source cursor；
   `from_degraded_snapshot`只接受current binding和一个允许的`Disposition`或`ProjectionSource` gap。
   `Disposition` gap只能发生在`HandoffPending`，`ProjectionSource` gap不能发生在`Released`。
4. 从selection.binding复制`view_ref`、context、redline、source cursor与source audit；从source复制`guard_ref`及其余
   body-free字段，禁止caller传入第二份字段覆盖。degraded reasons只能由typed gap set的映射生成。
5. factory只执行pure validation和字段复制；不得读取repository、调用clock、重跑guard、调用backend /
   investigation port、推进status、写audit、写projection、生成view ref或分配truth cursor。

helper语义固定如下：

| helper | true condition | fail-closed / negative rule |
|---|---|---|
| `is_degraded` | `degraded_reasons=Some` | canonical `HandoffPending`、`Pending`或`Terminal`本身不构成degraded |
| `proves_containment` | `containment_proof=Contained(...)`且source完整性已通过 | 不由`Contained`文字、boundary status或failure kind猜测 |
| `is_cleanup_blocking` | status不是`Released`，或view degraded，或proof / disposition未完整 | true只表示保守显示；不授权cleanup、release、delete或context close |
| `is_released` | status为`Released`且disposition为matching `Released` proof | 不证明backend已释放、cleanup已完成或run可复活 |
| `is_terminal` | status为`Terminal`且disposition为matching `Terminal` proof | Terminal永远hard block，不被其它redline或owner状态覆盖 |
| `is_read_complete` | `read_gaps=None`且source / proof / disposition关系完整 | degraded、Unavailable source或任何integrity error不能返回true |

view没有`permits_release`、`mark_contained`、`mark_released`、`repair`或`close_context`
方法。即使`is_released=true`，cleanup owner仍必须在自己的write UoW重新加载domain truth并调用
checked transition；read view只能作为安全记录和caller-safe显示。

#### 16.7.14 Field source closure

| target field / carrier | exact source | relation guard | forbidden substitute |
|---|---|---|---|
| selector context / redline | Step 8 validated required exact selector | context已通过access decision；两个ref必须非空且kind正确 | 两个optional字段、context-only lookup、ref文本解析 |
| `view_ref` | exact current binding指向的immutable view row | binding context / redline / cursor / audit与source一致 | Query id generator、redline ref转换、page cursor |
| `context_ref` / `redline_ref` | selector + binding + truth row三方exact equal | 不允许从lineage第一项或projection key反推 | latest row、caller selected ref、absence fallback |
| `guard_ref` | exact `RedlineContainment` owner保存的strict guard ref | source、Released / Terminal proof中的guard ref必须逐项相等 | query选择的guard、latest guard、配置profile ref |
| `redline_kind` | `RedlineContainment` canonical truth row | detection source mapper同时重验kind discriminator | source family文字、reason解析、high-risk action kind直接替代 |
| `lineage` | same-snapshot containment relation | context / identity / optional run / boundary / handle / generation全等；impact与run shape一致 | backend handle、host identity、process id、mount path、single redline |
| `detection_source` | truth owner embedded signal经contracts mapper复制 | source kind、typed refs、safe summary和kind映射闭集 | raw event、host/path/network/process detail、forbidden body |
| `containment_proof` | committed containment basis、matching failure、boundary relation与optional run relation | status、impact、run termination、boundary Failed、failure kind/ref/cursor/audit全等 | status文字、failure reason、caller bool、query重跑guard |
| `containment_status` | exact committed `RedlineContainmentStatus` row | source cursor、status time、audit与timeline一致 | phase反推、material status、investigation position |
| `phase` | source的status + preservation + investigation + committed disposition纯派生 | `RedlineContainmentPhase`闭集；不是persisted state | 新enum owner、adapter result、timestamp winner |
| `status_reason` | redline owner current caller-safe reason | 与canonical truth同version、非空且不含正文 | backend error截断、query wording、marker拼接 |
| `preservation` | embedded exact preservation recovery point + material owner snapshot | material status / handoff ref单调；run/post-run/boundary path与lineage全等 | latest material scan、material body、下游receipt |
| `investigation` | latest matching committed redline observation | exact preservation、Investigation source kind、target / summary / reason cardinality和时间全等 | `NotRequired`、ticket正文、caller status、missing默认Accepted |
| `disposition` | current `RedlineDispositionProofSnapshot::NotCommitted / Released / Terminal`；Disposition gap时为None | variant与status一致；terminal proof与guard、preservation、investigation、cursor、audit exact equal | `Accepted`直接推Released、query生成decision、backend success bool |
| `timeline` | truth row保存的transition times | detection必有；各optional time只在对应status已发生且单调 | query clock、row insertion time、latest observation time |
| `degraded_reasons` | typed `RedlineContainmentReadGapSet` | 1:1、ordered、safe reason同序映射；complete为None | repository Display、caller reason、canonical pending blocker |
| source audit / cursor | selected binding与同一truth snapshot的existing linkage | source cursor等于binding cursor且不早于所有子source cursor | query trace、post-query audit、clock生成cursor |
| `observed_at` | formal reader完成same-snapshot mapping后的application clock | 不早于binding、truth、proof、material、investigation、disposition和timeline times | backend clock、materialized_at冒充 |

final view刻意不保存selector对象、binding lookup proof、read-gap kind、release relation rows、
backend target、forbidden-body marker set、material body、external case body或domain basis。它们分别属于
source validation、application mapper或后续专用审计协议；安全结论必须已经通过公开的proof、preservation、
investigation position、status reason与blocker-safe字段表达，不能因隐藏正文而消失。

#### 16.7.15 Query、materialization与no-second-truth boundary

| path | allowed | forbidden |
|---|---|---|
| query access | 先消费application access decision；NotVisible / Restricted在binding lookup前结束 | 先查exact ref再决定visibility；用Empty泄漏不存在或存在 |
| selector validation | required `context_ref + redline_ref`，构造`RedlineContainmentSelector` | optional selector、context-only latest、historical view-ref selector |
| binding lookup | 在一个公平read transaction读取exact current binding index并形成Found / ExactAbsent / Unavailable | `ORDER BY time DESC`、扫描所有redline后选winner、用旧row回退 |
| source read | 按selected binding watermark同一snapshot读取truth、lineage、proof、preservation、investigation和disposition | 先读status再追material；分别读latest；调用external investigation port |
| view assembly | 只调用本节source/view factory，原样保留canonical pending / blocked / terminal truth | 重跑containment guard、终止run、推进boundary / handle、提交release / terminal |
| exact absence | complete binding index证明count=0后返回`Empty, view=None` | repository NotFound、timeout、partial index或missing row冒充Empty |
| binding unavailable | `ViewBinding` gap返回`Unavailable, view=None` | 构造空view、回退旧row、映为absence或Degraded |
| core source unavailable | `ContainmentTruth / LineageTruth / DetectionSource / ContainmentProof / Preservation / Investigation` gap返回`Unavailable, view=None` | 用status文字、None、默认proof或空reason补造部分view |
| disposition gap | current完整核心source + 唯一`Disposition` gap返回`Degraded, view=Some`，保持`HandoffPending` hard block | 把`Pending`改成`Degraded`、生成新decision、把Released / Terminal降级展示 |
| projection-source gap | current完整security fields + 唯一`ProjectionSource` gap可对`Detected / Contained / HandoffPending / Terminal`返回Degraded | `Released`遇该gap仍返回view；使用过期body冒充current |
| integrity error | malformed row、duplicate binding、wrong lineage、cursor conflict、proof contradiction直接typed failure | 通过retry、warning、degraded reason或Empty掩盖已知矛盾 |
| query side effect | 仅可发受限diagnostic / metric hook；write set、business audit append、backend call均为0 | query refresh、repair、re-materialize、release、investigation retry或写stored result |

Step 8的request schema必须保持以下闭集；serialization、version和public error具体字段由Step 8
唯一拥有，但不得新增context-only或historical分支：

```rust
/// redline containment query的required exact request。
pub struct GetRedlineContainmentStatusRequestDto {
    /// 已通过visibility / scope校验的owning context。
    pub context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
    /// caller明确选择的exact current containment。
    pub redline_ref: RedlineContainmentRef,
}
```

response继续使用`SandboxQueryResponseDto<RedlineContainmentViewDto>`。DTO必须逐字段承接
本节final view的body-free字段、strict guard ref、canonical shared status、phase、preservation position、investigation
position、optional disposition proof、timeline、source cursor、audit linkage和degraded reasons；不得把
material body、host/path/process/network detail、investigation receipt正文或backend lifecycle作为DTO字段。
`HandoffPending`在source完整时是`Visible`，不是`Degraded`；`Unavailable`的`view`必须为None。

status materialization writer遵守以下事务语义：

1. `RedlineContainment`每次accepted status、preservation、investigation observation、Released或Terminal
   proof变化时，创建新的immutable view row和新的current binding；旧row只保留给retention内的audit /
   reconciliation，不由本query选择。
2. current binding key固定为exact `(context_ref, redline_ref)`；同一execution lineage的多条redline
   各自占用独立binding，不能以single/latest列覆盖。binding row必须与view row、source cursor和source audit
   在同一write UoW可见。
3. writer必须先提交canonical redline truth及其proof / material / investigation source，再提交对应immutable
   view row，最后原子替换current binding；任何binding先于truth、view先于binding或多个current row可见都是
   integrity error。
4. late redline在cleanup authorization之后必须创建新的containment和新的current binding；它不能修改旧
   release proof、撤销已授权teardown或被cleanup projection忽略。读取时必须逐条显示当前exact redline，不得以旧
   cleanup状态覆盖。
5. duplicate equal observation、duplicate equal materialization和commit-unknown replay必须由write owner提供
   single-winner / duplicate-equivalent语义；Query不分配idempotency truth。
6. source / view retention的具体TTL和物理删除由Step 14与正式`04`定向重验；本节只固定最低关系：
   任何current binding仍可选时，其view row、truth source、proof、preservation、investigation和needed audit
   linkage必须可读。合法retention删除历史row时，当前exact selector不能伪装成ExactAbsent或回退其它row。

projection只接受current、source cursor与binding exact一致的checked view。historical audit row、
stale projection或degraded view不得覆盖current truth，也不得触发Query侧重建。

#### 16.7.16 Historical conflict ledger

| historical material | current disposition | reason |
|---|---|---|
| `VisibleRedlineStatus` / `RedlineContainmentStatusView` | invalidated | 形成第二状态owner或错误对象名；public view直接复用canonical `RedlineContainmentStatus`并由`RedlineContainmentPhase`机械投影。 |
| optional `context_ref` + optional `redline_ref` | invalidated_pending_step8_rewrite | 无法表达唯一selector，也允许context-only或ref-only存在性探测；current request要求两个ref同时存在。 |
| context-only latest redline | invalidated | 一个execution lineage允许`0..n`条redline；按time、ref、kind或插入顺序选winner会丢失独立containment。 |
| `no redline -> Empty` | invalidated | 只有access decision之后、complete exact binding index上的`count=0` proof可以形成本selector的Empty。 |
| `HandoffPending -> Degraded` | invalidated | `HandoffPending`是canonical active truth；只有typed read gap可以形成Degraded。 |
| generic `investigation_handoff_ref` | invalidated | current owner没有该identity；必须使用exact preservation-bound target、safe receipt summary和finite observation。 |
| untyped `safety_markers` public set | invalidated | marker属于domain containment owner；public安全结论由detection、containment proof、preservation、investigation和disposition relation表达。 |
| `load_status_snapshot(context_ref)`后从aggregate挑一条redline | invalidated_pending_step7_9_rewrite | 无exact selector/current binding/absence proof，也不能证明failure、boundary、run、material与investigation处于同一watermark。 |
| `sandbox_redline_status_index(redline_ref, context_ref, status)` | invalidated_pending_step11_rewrite | status-only row缺immutable view identity、guard、source cursor、audit linkage及same-snapshot relation；不能作为current view binding。 |
| unique active `(context_ref, redline_kind, source_ref)` | invalidated_pending_step11_rewrite | 同lineage和同kind可出现多条独立redline；identity与current binding均以exact `redline_ref`区分。 |
| status文字证明containment / release | invalidated | `Contained`必须有matching failure/boundary/optional run proof；`Released`和`Terminal`必须有exact guard、preservation、investigation与disposition proof。 |
| investigation `Accepted`直接推`Released` | invalidated | Accepted只证明external owner接收；`ReleaseCandidate`仍需domain guard评估和owner transition提交。 |
| `Released`证明backend release、cleanup complete或context closure | invalidated | redline Released只解除该containment的cleanup block；cleanup和owner closure必须重新加载各自canonical truth。 |
| strict redline investigation `NotRequired` | invalidated | 所有strict redline都要求formal handoff；尚无观察使用`NotObserved`，不能绕过investigation owner。 |
| latest material / observation scan | invalidated | preservation refresh会使旧observation失效；只能读取与current embedded preservation exact equal的observation。 |
| missing proof / malformed relation统一映`Degraded` | invalidated | core source gap为Unavailable；已知错行、duplicate binding、half-commit、cursor冲突和proof矛盾是typed integrity error。 |
| query refresh、repair、release或append business audit | invalidated | query是no-write read path；只能发受限diagnostic / metric，不能创建第二份truth或改变containment。 |
| late redline撤销已授权teardown或被旧cleanup状态覆盖 | invalidated | late redline创建新的containment和exact binding；不改写旧authorization，但必须阻断material/context closure。 |

上述项目全部归入`H16.7 historical_material`或`downstream_revalidation_pending`。旧正式`03~07`、README或
