### 16.8 `DerivedInspectPreviewTrendView` current canonical contract

`DerivedInspectPreviewTrendView` 是 `GetDerivedInspectPreviewTrend` 与
`SandboxReadProjection` 消费的 contracts-owned、body-free、immutable read model。它把一个 exact
`DerivedInspectPreviewTrendState` 的 current canonical status 与最近一次已提交 inspect / preview / trend
materialization 放在同一 checked read source 中，但不把二者合并成第二套 freshness truth。

本对象关闭 named type #26，并关闭 support family #40 的 derived 分支；comparison 分支仍由 `§16.9`
承接。canonical owner 固定为 `crates/contracts/src/views.rs`。本节不修改正式 `03~07`，也不定义
repository trait、protocol DTO、query flow、storage table、配置或测试结果；这些只登记为 Step 7~17
定向重验义务。

#### 16.8.1 Capability、主体边界与 historical conflict

本 view 回答“一个已明确选择的 derived state 当前处于什么维护状态，最近一次成功、已提交的 body-free
派生结果覆盖了哪些 source / cursor”。它不回答“现在应不应该 rebuild”，也不把派生失败提升为 Sandbox
核心 failure。

| capability | current owner | view允许表达 | view禁止承担 |
|---|---|---|---|
| derived maintenance status | `DerivedInspectPreviewTrendState` | exact state ref、`Inspect / Preview / Trend` kind、canonical `Fresh / Stale / Rebuilding / Failed / Unavailable`、safe failure / availability reason | 新增 `DerivedFreshnessStatus` / `DerivedVisibleStatus`、query改状态、由read gap猜状态 |
| committed derived result | trusted maintenance builder + immutable materialization row | inspect计数与assessment、preview摘要计数与redaction/truncation、trend窗口与direction；均不含正文 | query临时计算、从state字段补造结果、保存preview正文、trend samples、metric/log/artifact body或builder response |
| source lineage | `DerivedSourceRefSet` + committed source cursor | current state coverage与last-known materialization coverage分别可见并机械比较 | caller提交`source_refs`筛选、generic `SandboxOpaqueRef`、repository latest scan |
| access scope | exact current binding index | required context + exact state + exact kind relation、明确absence proof | context-only latest、kind-only search、先读state再判断是否可见 |
| read completeness | same-snapshot state / materialization / binding reader | complete view、允许的typed degraded view或no-view | 将canonical `Stale / Rebuilding / Failed / Unavailable`一律降级为Degraded |
| no-write | query application boundary | 读取已提交row和既有audit linkage | rebuild、mark stale、repair source、生成marker/ref/cursor、append business audit或修改core truth |

以下 historical material 从本节起失效，不提供兼容 alias：

1. HLD `from_derived_state(state, SafePreviewSummary)` 允许 query 用一个临时 summary 构造view，既没有
   committed materialization identity，也不能证明 summary与state source cursor一致。
2. HLD `preview_summary + trend_summary` 同时可选会让一个view混入两个kind结果；current materialization
   使用closed enum，variant必须与state的exact `DerivedMaterialKind`一一对应。
3. `DerivedVisibleStatus` 与 `DerivedFreshnessStatus` 是无owner第二状态；唯一canonical owner为
   `DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStatus`，query surface另由 `SandboxQuerySurfaceStatus` 表达。
4. 旧Step 8 request的`scope_ref: SandboxOpaqueRef`与caller `source_refs`允许调用方伪造scope和coverage；
   current selector固定为required context、exact state和exact kind。
5. 旧Step 9从state直接组DTO，state并不保存派生结果；current query只能消费已提交materialization source。
6. 旧maintenance flow只保存state，会形成`Fresh`但不存在result row的half-commit；current成功写入必须在
   同一UoW提交state、immutable view/materialization row和exact current binding。
7. derived builder / repository failure不是 `FailureClassification`，也不能只因status为`Failed`就映为
   read degradation。canonical failure与读取缺口必须分开。

#### 16.8.2 Exact selector、current binding与explicit absence proof

`GetDerivedInspectPreviewTrend` 是单对象current读取。selector固定为required context + required exact
derived state + required expected kind。kind只用于防止调用方把另一个derived family或错误state当作目标；它不允许
按kind扫描或选择latest。若未来需要“列出context下全部derived state”，必须新增独立分页协议和complete index
coverage，不能放宽本selector。

```rust
/// 单对象derived inspect / preview / trend只读入口的required exact selector。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct DerivedInspectPreviewTrendSelector {
    /// 已通过query access decision的owning context。
    context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
    /// caller明确选择的exact derived state。
    derived_state_ref: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStateRef,
    /// caller预期的exact `Inspect / Preview / Trend` kind。
    derived_kind: DerivedMaterialKind,
}

impl DerivedInspectPreviewTrendSelector {
    /// 创建required context + exact state + exact kind selector。
    pub fn try_new(
        context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
        derived_state_ref: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStateRef,
        derived_kind: DerivedMaterialKind,
    ) -> Result<Self, DerivedInspectPreviewTrendViewError>;

    /// 返回selector owning context。
    pub fn context_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionContextRef;
    /// 返回selector exact derived state ref。
    pub fn derived_state_ref(&self) -> &DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStateRef;
    /// 返回selector expected kind。
    pub fn derived_kind(&self) -> DerivedMaterialKind;
}

/// current derived view identity与exact state status snapshot的committed binding。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct DerivedInspectPreviewTrendViewBinding {
    /// immutable current view row identity。
    view_ref: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendViewRef,
    /// view唯一归属的access context。
    context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
    /// view投影的exact derived state。
    derived_state_ref: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStateRef,
    /// view唯一承接的exact derived kind。
    derived_kind: DerivedMaterialKind,
    /// binding提交时state的canonical status。
    derived_status: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStatus,
    /// binding提交时state的status生效时间。
    state_status_changed_at: Timestamp,
    /// state latest transition已有的audit linkage；不是query audit。
    state_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    /// immutable view row与binding原子提交的时间。
    bound_at: Timestamp,
}

impl DerivedInspectPreviewTrendViewBinding {
    /// 从exact-state current binding index的committed row构造binding。
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    pub fn try_from_committed_index(
        view_ref: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendViewRef,
        context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
        derived_state_ref: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStateRef,
        derived_kind: DerivedMaterialKind,
        derived_status: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStatus,
        state_status_changed_at: Timestamp,
        state_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        bound_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, DerivedInspectPreviewTrendViewError>;

    /// 返回immutable current view ref。
    pub fn view_ref(&self) -> &DerivedInspectPreviewTrendViewRef;
    /// 返回owning access context。
    pub fn context_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionContextRef;
    /// 返回exact derived state ref。
    pub fn derived_state_ref(&self) -> &DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStateRef;
    /// 返回exact derived kind。
    pub fn derived_kind(&self) -> DerivedMaterialKind;
    /// 返回binding记录的canonical state status。
    pub fn derived_status(&self) -> DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStatus;
    /// 返回state status生效时间。
    pub fn state_status_changed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
    /// 返回state transition audit linkage。
    pub fn state_audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;
    /// 返回binding commit time。
    pub fn bound_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
}

/// exact selector命中current binding后形成的same-snapshot selection proof。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct DerivedInspectPreviewTrendBindingSelectionProof {
    /// 本proof消费的required selector。
    selector: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendSelector,
    /// exact-state index当前指向的immutable binding。
    binding: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendViewBinding,
    /// same-snapshot index observation time。
    observed_at: Timestamp,
}

impl DerivedInspectPreviewTrendBindingSelectionProof {
    /// 从同一公平read snapshot中的selector与current binding构造proof。
    pub fn try_from_committed_index(
        selector: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendSelector,
        binding: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendViewBinding,
        observed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, DerivedInspectPreviewTrendViewError>;

    /// 返回checked selector。
    pub fn selector(&self) -> &DerivedInspectPreviewTrendSelector;
    /// 返回selected current binding。
    pub fn binding(&self) -> &DerivedInspectPreviewTrendViewBinding;
    /// 返回lookup observation time。
    pub fn observed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
}
```

selector、binding与selection proof固定满足：

1. 三者的context / state / kind逐项相等；`BackendComparison | Reconciliation`在selector和binding factory
   均返回typed `UnsupportedDerivedKind`。
2. `binding.derived_status`、`state_status_changed_at`、`state_audit_trace_ref`必须与同一UoW物化的state
   snapshot全等；不能按status文本、timestamp或view ref选择winner。
3. `bound_at >= state_status_changed_at`且selection `observed_at >= bound_at`。repository `Version`不进入
   public/view truth，也不能代替时间或source cursor。
4. exact index可见两个current binding、binding指向错误context/state/kind、view row未提交或state与binding
   half-commit均为integrity error，不得回退旧row、latest row或映为Empty。
5. NotVisible / Restricted access decision优先于binding lookup和absence，防止exact state ref成为存在性探针。
6. 旧immutable row只供后续audit / reconciliation专用读取；本query没有view-ref历史selector。

```rust
/// exact-state index明确证明state与current binding均不存在的absence proof。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct DerivedInspectPreviewTrendAbsenceProof {
    /// access-approved owning context。
    context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
    /// caller选择但不存在的exact derived state。
    derived_state_ref: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStateRef,
    /// caller预期的exact derived kind。
    derived_kind: DerivedMaterialKind,
    /// exact state identity count；合法值固定为0。
    exact_state_count: u64,
    /// exact current binding count；合法值固定为0。
    exact_binding_count: u64,
    /// absence index已有的audit linkage。
    source_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    /// same-snapshot index observation time。
    observed_at: Timestamp,
}

impl DerivedInspectPreviewTrendAbsenceProof {
    /// 从完整exact state / binding index read构造absence proof。
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    pub fn try_from_committed_index_absence(
        context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
        derived_state_ref: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStateRef,
        derived_kind: DerivedMaterialKind,
        exact_state_count: u64,
        exact_binding_count: u64,
        source_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        observed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, DerivedInspectPreviewTrendViewError>;

    /// 返回proof owning context。
    pub fn context_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionContextRef;
    /// 返回未命中的exact derived state ref。
    pub fn derived_state_ref(&self) -> &DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStateRef;
    /// 返回expected derived kind。
    pub fn derived_kind(&self) -> DerivedMaterialKind;
    /// 返回固定为0的state count。
    pub fn exact_state_count(&self) -> u64;
    /// 返回固定为0的binding count。
    pub fn exact_binding_count(&self) -> u64;
    /// 返回absence snapshot audit linkage。
    pub fn source_audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;
    /// 返回index observation time。
    pub fn observed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
}
```

absence proof只在两个count同时为0时成立，并且只授权access decision之后返回
`surface_status=Empty, view=None`。`state=1 / binding=0`、`state=0 / binding=1`、任一count大于1或kind关系
错误都是half-commit / index integrity error；不能解释为尚未物化、MissingProjection或普通read gap。binding index
技术不可用时必须返回typed no-view outcome，不能伪造两个0。

#### 16.8.3 Committed materialization source scope

`DerivedInspectPreviewTrendState` 只保存维护状态，不保存派生结果。current contract因此定义独立的
`DerivedMaterializationSourceSnapshot`：它是 trusted maintenance builder实际消费的已提交、body-free source
coverage，也是 inspect / preview / trend materialization唯一允许回指的输入。query不能创建或刷新该snapshot。

```rust
/// 一次成功derived materialization实际消费的committed、body-free source coverage。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct DerivedMaterializationSourceSnapshot {
    /// formal source index验证出的owning access context。
    context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
    /// 本次materialization唯一归属的derived state。
    derived_state_ref: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStateRef,
    /// 本次materialization的exact `Inspect / Preview / Trend` kind。
    derived_kind: DerivedMaterialKind,
    /// builder实际消费的ordered-unique source refs。
    source_refs: DerivedSourceRefSet,
    /// builder消费的committed truth watermark；无local truth source时为None。
    source_truth_cursor: Option<SandboxTruthCursor>,
    /// builder消费的committed reference watermark；无reference-side source时为None。
    source_reference_cursor: Option<SandboxReferenceCursor>,
    /// source snapshot已有的audit linkage；不是query audit。
    source_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    /// formal source assembler完成同一公平读取的时间。
    observed_at: Timestamp,
}

impl DerivedMaterializationSourceSnapshot {
    /// 从formal derived source index的一次完整committed read构造source snapshot。
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    pub fn try_from_committed_source_index(
        context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
        derived_state_ref: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStateRef,
        derived_kind: DerivedMaterialKind,
        source_refs: DerivedSourceRefSet,
        source_truth_cursor: Option<SandboxTruthCursor>,
        source_reference_cursor: Option<SandboxReferenceCursor>,
        source_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        observed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, DerivedInspectPreviewTrendViewError>;

    /// 返回owning access context。
    pub fn context_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionContextRef;
    /// 返回exact derived state ref。
    pub fn derived_state_ref(&self) -> &DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStateRef;
    /// 返回exact derived kind。
    pub fn derived_kind(&self) -> DerivedMaterialKind;
    /// 返回builder实际消费的source coverage。
    pub fn source_refs(&self) -> &DerivedSourceRefSet;
    /// 返回optional committed truth watermark。
    pub fn source_truth_cursor(&self) -> Option<SandboxTruthCursor>;
    /// 返回optional committed reference watermark。
    pub fn source_reference_cursor(&self) -> Option<SandboxReferenceCursor>;
    /// 返回source audit linkage。
    pub fn source_audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;
    /// 返回source observation time。
    pub fn observed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
}
```

source snapshot的scope与cursor关系固定如下：

1. source set必须满足`§15.3.3`当前kind的minimum source rule，并由formal source index证明每个local truth、
   material、reference state、projection和safe summary都可回链到同一`context_ref`。constructor只做carrier
   shape校验；Step 7 reader必须提供该scope proof，fake与durable contract test必须共同验证。
2. source set含`is_local_truth()`成员时truth cursor必须为Some，否则必须为None；含
   `has_reference_side_source()`成员时reference cursor必须为Some，否则必须为None。两个cursor可以同时存在，
   但禁止跨family比较或合并为`Version`。
3. source set非空且只能服务`Inspect | Preview | Trend`。`BackendComparison | Reconciliation`、audit trace、
   event relay record和reconciliation report不能通过generic ref塞入该coverage。
4. `observed_at`不得早于所消费source的latest committed observation；source audit ref必须已经存在，不能由query、
   builder raw response或post-build日志补造。
5. source snapshot不保存source body。resolver / builder只允许把已验证typed ref、safe summary ref、cursor、time和
   audit linkage交给本carrier。

#### 16.8.4 Inspect与preview body-free materialization

Inspect只公开“检查了多少subject、形成多少finding、是否存在finding”以及external owner提供的safe summary refs；
Preview只公开候选计数、可表示/脱敏/省略计数和safe summary refs。二者都不公开output、文件、artifact、metric、
log或工具结果正文。

```rust
/// inspect materialization的有限结果分类；不是persisted lifecycle status。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum DerivedInspectResultClass {
    /// 完整检查没有产生finding。
    NoFindings,
    /// 完整检查产生至少一个caller-safe finding summary。
    FindingsPresent,
}

/// 一次已提交inspect结果的body-free materialization payload。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct DerivedInspectMaterialization {
    /// trusted builder实际检查的subject数量。
    inspected_subject_count: u64,
    /// builder形成的finding数量；不得大于subject数量。
    finding_count: u64,
    /// 与finding count机械一致的有限结果分类。
    result_class: DerivedInspectResultClass,
    /// external owner限定的body-free safe summary refs；不包含summary正文。
    summary_refs: SafeSummaryRefSet,
}

impl DerivedInspectMaterialization {
    /// 构造已通过builder output validation的inspect payload。
    pub fn try_from_builder_output(
        inspected_subject_count: u64,
        finding_count: u64,
        result_class: DerivedInspectResultClass,
        summary_refs: SafeSummaryRefSet,
    ) -> Result<Self, DerivedInspectPreviewTrendViewError>;

    /// 返回实际检查subject数量。
    pub fn inspected_subject_count(&self) -> u64;
    /// 返回finding数量。
    pub fn finding_count(&self) -> u64;
    /// 返回finite inspect result class。
    pub fn result_class(&self) -> DerivedInspectResultClass;
    /// 返回body-free safe summary refs。
    pub fn summary_refs(&self) -> &SafeSummaryRefSet;
    /// 判断是否存在至少一个finding。
    pub fn has_findings(&self) -> bool;
}

/// preview payload对candidate coverage的有限说明；不是freshness或query surface状态。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum DerivedPreviewCoverage {
    /// 全部candidate均由safe summary表示，没有redaction或limit omission。
    Complete,
    /// 一项或多项candidate因安全边界只计数、不公开summary ref。
    Redacted,
    /// 一项或多项candidate因validated materialization limit被省略。
    Truncated,
    /// 同一次materialization同时存在redaction与limit omission。
    RedactedAndTruncated,
}

/// 一次已提交preview结果的body-free materialization payload。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct DerivedPreviewMaterialization {
    /// trusted builder识别出的candidate总数。
    candidate_count: u64,
    /// 有exact safe summary ref表示的candidate数量。
    represented_count: u64,
    /// 因security / visibility boundary只计数的candidate数量。
    redacted_count: u64,
    /// 因validated materialization limit省略的candidate数量。
    omitted_count: u64,
    /// 与三类count机械一致的coverage分类。
    coverage: DerivedPreviewCoverage,
    /// 每个represented candidate恰好一个、ordered-unique的safe summary ref。
    summary_refs: SafeSummaryRefSet,
}

impl DerivedPreviewMaterialization {
    /// 构造body-free preview payload并校验count、coverage和summary cardinality。
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    pub fn try_from_builder_output(
        candidate_count: u64,
        represented_count: u64,
        redacted_count: u64,
        omitted_count: u64,
        coverage: DerivedPreviewCoverage,
        summary_refs: SafeSummaryRefSet,
    ) -> Result<Self, DerivedInspectPreviewTrendViewError>;

    /// 返回candidate总数。
    pub fn candidate_count(&self) -> u64;
    /// 返回represented candidate数量。
    pub fn represented_count(&self) -> u64;
    /// 返回redacted candidate数量。
    pub fn redacted_count(&self) -> u64;
    /// 返回omitted candidate数量。
    pub fn omitted_count(&self) -> u64;
    /// 返回finite preview coverage。
    pub fn coverage(&self) -> DerivedPreviewCoverage;
    /// 返回ordered-unique safe summary refs。
    pub fn summary_refs(&self) -> &SafeSummaryRefSet;
    /// 判断本preview是否完整表示全部candidate。
    pub fn is_complete_preview(&self) -> bool;
}
```

inspect与preview factory的机械规则：

| payload | required relation | rejected relation |
|---|---|---|
| inspect | `finding_count <= inspected_subject_count`；0 finding对应`NoFindings`，大于0对应`FindingsPresent`；有finding时summary refs必须non-empty | class与count冲突、finding超过subject、finding存在但无任何safe summary ref |
| preview | `candidate_count = represented + redacted + omitted`；`represented_count = summary_refs.as_slice().len()`；coverage由redacted/omitted是否为0唯一决定 | count overflow / 不等、重复summary、coverage与count不一致、用正文填represented item |

`Redacted | Truncated | RedactedAndTruncated` 是成功materialization内部的coverage说明，不自动令derived state
变成`Failed / Unavailable`，也不自动令query surface变成`Degraded`。它们只表示当前body-free preview按已验证
security/limit contract输出；若builder无法满足该contract，应拒绝materialization并由state owner进入typed derived
failure，而不是提交结构矛盾的payload。

#### 16.8.5 Trend window与body-free aggregate

Trend只能对已提交safe summaries和Sandbox lifecycle refs形成有界aggregate。它不保存时间序列sample、metric/log
body、查询表达式、dashboard payload或external store locator。window边界来自trusted builder消费的committed source
observations；不得用query当前时间动态滑动同一materialization。

```rust
/// trend aggregate相对有界window的有限方向；不是capacity verdict或状态机。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum DerivedTrendDirection {
    /// 有效aggregate与window起点相比增加。
    Increasing,
    /// 有效aggregate与window起点相比保持稳定。
    Stable,
    /// 有效aggregate与window起点相比减少。
    Decreasing,
    /// 有效point不足以形成方向结论。
    InsufficientData,
}

/// trend materialization使用的闭区间和coverage计数。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct DerivedTrendWindow {
    /// window最早committed source observation time。
    window_start: Timestamp,
    /// window最晚committed source observation time。
    window_end: Timestamp,
    /// trusted builder实际纳入aggregate的point数量。
    included_point_count: u64,
    /// 因security / compatibility rule拒绝的point数量。
    excluded_point_count: u64,
}

impl DerivedTrendWindow {
    /// 从builder使用的committed source observations构造有界window。
    pub fn try_from_committed_observations(
        window_start: Timestamp,
        window_end: Timestamp,
        included_point_count: u64,
        excluded_point_count: u64,
    ) -> Result<Self, DerivedInspectPreviewTrendViewError>;

    /// 返回window起点。
    pub fn window_start(&self) -> &Timestamp;
    /// 返回window终点。
    pub fn window_end(&self) -> &Timestamp;
    /// 返回included point数量。
    pub fn included_point_count(&self) -> u64;
    /// 返回excluded point数量。
    pub fn excluded_point_count(&self) -> u64;
    /// 返回本window总候选point数量。
    pub fn candidate_point_count(&self) -> u64;
}

/// 一次已提交trend结果的body-free aggregate payload。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct DerivedTrendMaterialization {
    /// aggregate实际覆盖的有界committed window。
    window: DerivedTrendWindow,
    /// 与included point机械一致的finite direction。
    direction: DerivedTrendDirection,
    /// external owner提供的body-free aggregate summary refs。
    aggregate_summary_refs: SafeSummaryRefSet,
}

impl DerivedTrendMaterialization {
    /// 构造body-free trend aggregate并校验window、direction和summary关系。
    pub fn try_from_builder_output(
        window: DerivedTrendWindow,
        direction: DerivedTrendDirection,
        aggregate_summary_refs: SafeSummaryRefSet,
    ) -> Result<Self, DerivedInspectPreviewTrendViewError>;

    /// 返回committed trend window。
    pub fn window(&self) -> &DerivedTrendWindow;
    /// 返回finite direction。
    pub fn direction(&self) -> DerivedTrendDirection;
    /// 返回body-free aggregate summary refs。
    pub fn aggregate_summary_refs(&self) -> &SafeSummaryRefSet;
    /// 判断当前aggregate是否有足够point形成方向结论。
    pub fn has_directional_signal(&self) -> bool;
}
```

`window_end >= window_start`；`included + excluded`必须checked add无overflow。`included_point_count < 2`时
direction只能为`InsufficientData`，且summary set允许为空；`included_point_count >= 2`时direction不能为
`InsufficientData`且aggregate summary set必须non-empty。excluded point只说明body-free aggregate的输入coverage，
不自动形成read gap；若安全规则不允许产生任何可解释aggregate，builder应拒绝materialization，由state owner记录
derived-only failure或unavailable。

#### 16.8.6 Closed materialization union与commit identity

三类payload由一个closed union承接，variant与source/state kind必须全等。materialization identity不新增named ref：
immutable row以已规划的`DerivedInspectPreviewTrendViewRef`作为唯一repository identity，避免为同一public row再创建
`DerivedMaterializationRef`第二身份。

```rust
/// inspect / preview / trend三类body-free committed payload的closed union。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum DerivedInspectPreviewTrendMaterialization {
    /// exact `DerivedMaterialKind::Inspect` payload。
    Inspect(DerivedInspectMaterialization),
    /// exact `DerivedMaterialKind::Preview` payload。
    Preview(DerivedPreviewMaterialization),
    /// exact `DerivedMaterialKind::Trend` payload。
    Trend(DerivedTrendMaterialization),
}

impl DerivedInspectPreviewTrendMaterialization {
    /// 返回payload对应的exact shared derived kind。
    pub fn derived_kind(&self) -> DerivedMaterialKind;
    /// 返回inspect payload；其它variant返回None。
    pub fn inspect(&self) -> Option<&DerivedInspectMaterialization>;
    /// 返回preview payload；其它variant返回None。
    pub fn preview(&self) -> Option<&DerivedPreviewMaterialization>;
    /// 返回trend payload；其它variant返回None。
    pub fn trend(&self) -> Option<&DerivedTrendMaterialization>;
}

/// 一个已成功提交、可被current view引用的immutable derived materialization row。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct DerivedInspectPreviewTrendCommittedMaterialization {
    /// immutable row与public view共用的typed identity。
    view_ref: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendViewRef,
    /// builder实际消费的committed source coverage。
    source: DerivedMaterializationSourceSnapshot,
    /// 与source kind一一对应的body-free payload。
    materialization: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendMaterialization,
    /// trusted builder完成输出验证的时间。
    materialized_at: Timestamp,
    /// 成功materialization transition已有的audit linkage。
    materialization_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
}

impl DerivedInspectPreviewTrendCommittedMaterialization {
    /// 从validated source、matching payload和成功transition linkage构造immutable row。
    pub fn try_from_successful_build(
        view_ref: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendViewRef,
        source: DerivedMaterializationSourceSnapshot,
        materialization: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendMaterialization,
        materialized_at: Timestamp,
        materialization_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    ) -> Result<Self, DerivedInspectPreviewTrendViewError>;

    /// 返回immutable materialization/view identity。
    pub fn view_ref(&self) -> &DerivedInspectPreviewTrendViewRef;
    /// 返回committed source snapshot。
    pub fn source(&self) -> &DerivedMaterializationSourceSnapshot;
    /// 返回closed payload。
    pub fn materialization(&self) -> &DerivedInspectPreviewTrendMaterialization;
    /// 返回materialization completion time。
    pub fn materialized_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
    /// 返回successful transition audit linkage。
    pub fn materialization_audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;
}
```

committed materialization factory必须验证：

1. `source.derived_kind == materialization.derived_kind`，只能是`Inspect | Preview | Trend`。
2. `materialized_at >= source.observed_at`，audit ref非空且属于本次successful derived transition；builder内部
   log、job report ref、query trace或后续relay audit不能替代。
3. `view_ref`由application writer预生成，并与state Fresh transition、immutable row、current binding在同一
   write UoW提交。domain state不保存view ref，repository不得在save后补写binding。
4. payload只含finite enum、count、time和safe summary refs；summary digest可验证完整性但不构成artifact / evidence
   identity，也不证明external summary当前仍可读取。
5. duplicate equal build可命中同一idempotency/write identity；相同view ref但source、payload、time或audit不同是
   typed conflict，不能last-writer-wins。

`DerivedInspectPreviewTrendViewRef`是本对象唯一的immutable read-row identity类型，但“唯一类型”不表示所有status
snapshot复用同一个ref值。successful Fresh UoW中的row同时承担current view与successful materialization，此时current
binding ref与materialization ref全等。后续accepted Stale / Rebuilding / Failed / Unavailable transition必须生成新的
immutable current view row和新的`DerivedInspectPreviewTrendViewRef`，并以本节carrier链接原successful row；不得原地
修改Fresh row。新status row不计入successful materialization count。初始Unavailable / Rebuilding / Failed的status-only
row同样有current view ref，但没有successful materialization。该规则不新增`DerivedMaterializationRef`、planned文件或
第二套identity类型。

#### 16.8.7 State/materialization同构与last-known规则

formal reader必须在一个公平read snapshot内读取current state、binding指向的immutable row和source coverage。state
status是唯一canonical maintenance truth；materialization只保存最近一次成功结果。二者关系固定如下：

| canonical state status | committed materialization | state current source vs materialization source | public view rule |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Fresh` | required | source refs、truth cursor、reference cursor、kind全部exact equal | 完整source时`Visible`；任何已知不等是integrity error |
| `Stale` | required | materialization保持last-known；current marker可证明source cursor更新或source set replacement | 返回`Stale`且带last-known payload；不是Degraded |
| `Rebuilding` | 有历史成功结果时required；初始build可无 | 有历史结果时保留last-known；初始attempt以`NeverMaterialized` proof证明尚无成功row | 返回`Rebuilding`；有历史结果带last-known payload，无历史结果为status-only；不是Degraded |
| `Failed` | optional | 有旧成功结果时保留last-known；初始build失败可没有materialization | 有payload时返回`Visible` canonical Failed view；无payload仍返回status-only Visible view，failure summary required |
| `Unavailable` | optional | 有旧成功结果时保留last-known；初始source不可用可没有materialization | 有或无payload均返回status-only / last-known Visible view，availability reason required |

该矩阵修正`§15.6.3`中“Stale只能显式stale/degraded”和“Failed只能返回failure summary”的历史简写：
canonical status本身不等于read gap。只要current state、binding与optional last-known row完整可读，五种status都能形成
一个body-free view；public surface分别使用`Visible / Stale / Rebuilding / Visible / Visible`，而不是自动Degraded。
`Failed | Unavailable`没有旧materialization是合法初始位置，不是absence、MissingProjection或half-commit。

last-known关系必须由state自己的marker / cursor证明，不能由query比较时间猜测：

1. `Fresh`时materialization source必须与state `source_refs / materialized_*_cursor`exact全等，binding status/time/audit
   必须与state全等。
2. `Stale`时materialization source必须等于state保留的最近成功cursor coverage；`Rebuilding`在存在last-known时遵守同一
   规则，在初始attempt时必须由`NeverMaterialized` proof证明成功row count为零。current rebuild marker target必须
   等于state ref，kind不变，marker source/cursor不得早于已有materialization。若marker表示source-set replacement，
   old materialization coverage可以不同，但必须被marker明确取代，不能靠repository latest source推导。
3. `Failed`时failure summary cursor必须对应当前failed attempt / marker，不得被拿来覆盖旧materialization cursor；
   materialization存在时仍必须通过last-known relation。
4. `Unavailable`时availability reason来自state；materialization存在时只说明last-known结果，不能宣称external source
   当前可用。
5. binding始终投影current state status，即使payload来自旧成功结果。不得保留一个`Fresh` binding去展示已经
   `Stale / Failed / Unavailable`的state，也不得把old row的status当current。

#### 16.8.8 Contracts-only state snapshot与maintenance detail

`crates/contracts/src/views.rs`不能依赖domain-owned `DerivedFailureSummary`或直接持有
`DerivedInspectPreviewTrendState`。application mapper必须从同一committed state row机械复制以下contracts-only
snapshot；它不拥有transition，也不能保存回domain truth。

```rust
/// derived-only failure在public read surface上的有限分类。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum DerivedViewFailureClass {
    /// source ref、cursor或cross-owner coverage不合法。
    SourceCoverageInvalid,
    /// trusted builder拒绝已验证source组合。
    BuilderRejected,
    /// builder输出没有通过body-free materialization contract。
    MaterializationInvalid,
    /// 同一source snapshot的关系或version fence冲突。
    ConsistencyConflict,
    /// 同一marker的维护重试达到策略终点。
    RetryExhausted,
}

/// canonical state status对应的caller-safe maintenance detail；不是第二状态机。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum DerivedMaintenanceDetail {
    /// Fresh state没有pending marker、failure或availability reason。
    Fresh,
    /// state已消费一个committed marker并等待maintenance。
    Stale {
        /// marker的有限trigger。
        trigger: DerivedRebuildTrigger,
        /// marker owner提供的safe reason。
        reason: SandboxReason,
        /// marker observation time。
        marked_at: Timestamp,
    },
    /// matching marker正在被维护job重建。
    Rebuilding {
        /// attempt绑定marker的有限trigger。
        trigger: DerivedRebuildTrigger,
        /// marker owner提供的safe reason。
        reason: SandboxReason,
        /// marker observation time。
        marked_at: Timestamp,
        /// current Rebuilding status生效时间。
        started_at: Timestamp,
    },
    /// 当前attempt以derived-only failure结束。
    Failed {
        /// domain failure kind的一一机械投影。
        failure_class: DerivedViewFailureClass,
        /// owner提供的caller-safe failure reason。
        reason: SandboxReason,
        /// failed attempt实际消费的truth cursor。
        attempted_truth_cursor: Option<SandboxTruthCursor>,
        /// failed attempt实际消费的reference cursor。
        attempted_reference_cursor: Option<SandboxReferenceCursor>,
        /// failure observation time。
        failed_at: Timestamp,
    },
    /// current target source暂不可用。
    Unavailable {
        /// state owner提供的caller-safe availability reason。
        reason: SandboxReason,
    },
}

impl DerivedMaintenanceDetail {
    /// 返回detail对应的唯一canonical state status。
    pub fn derived_status(&self) -> DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStatus;
    /// 返回optional caller-safe maintenance reason；Fresh为None。
    pub fn reason(&self) -> Option<&SandboxReason>;
}

/// 从一个committed domain state row机械复制的contracts-only read snapshot。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStateReadSnapshot {
    /// formal source index证明的owning access context。
    context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
    /// exact derived state identity。
    derived_state_ref: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStateRef,
    /// state当前声明的target source coverage。
    current_source_refs: DerivedSourceRefSet,
    /// state当前target覆盖的committed truth cursor；无local truth source时为None。
    current_source_truth_cursor: Option<SandboxTruthCursor>,
    /// state当前target覆盖的committed reference cursor；无reference-side source时为None。
    current_source_reference_cursor: Option<SandboxReferenceCursor>,
    /// exact inspect / preview / trend kind。
    derived_kind: DerivedMaterialKind,
    /// domain state唯一拥有的canonical status。
    derived_status: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStatus,
    /// 与canonical status一一对应的public maintenance detail。
    maintenance_detail: DerivedMaintenanceDetail,
    /// 最近成功materialization的source coverage；从未成功时为None。
    last_materialized_source_refs: Option<DerivedSourceRefSet>,
    /// 最近成功materialization覆盖的truth cursor。
    materialized_truth_cursor: Option<SandboxTruthCursor>,
    /// 最近成功materialization覆盖的reference cursor。
    materialized_reference_cursor: Option<SandboxReferenceCursor>,
    /// state首次建立时间。
    created_at: Timestamp,
    /// current canonical status生效时间。
    status_changed_at: Timestamp,
    /// latest state transition已有的audit linkage。
    last_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
}

impl DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStateReadSnapshot {
    /// 从完整committed state row及formal context binding构造read snapshot。
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    pub fn try_from_committed_state(
        context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
        derived_state_ref: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStateRef,
        current_source_refs: DerivedSourceRefSet,
        current_source_truth_cursor: Option<SandboxTruthCursor>,
        current_source_reference_cursor: Option<SandboxReferenceCursor>,
        derived_kind: DerivedMaterialKind,
        derived_status: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStatus,
        maintenance_detail: DerivedMaintenanceDetail,
        last_materialized_source_refs: Option<DerivedSourceRefSet>,
        materialized_truth_cursor: Option<SandboxTruthCursor>,
        materialized_reference_cursor: Option<SandboxReferenceCursor>,
        created_at: Timestamp,
        status_changed_at: Timestamp,
        last_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    ) -> Result<Self, DerivedInspectPreviewTrendViewError>;

    /// 返回owning access context。
    pub fn context_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionContextRef;
    /// 返回exact derived state ref。
    pub fn derived_state_ref(&self) -> &DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStateRef;
    /// 返回current target source coverage。
    pub fn current_source_refs(&self) -> &DerivedSourceRefSet;
    /// 返回current target的optional truth cursor。
    pub fn current_source_truth_cursor(&self) -> Option<SandboxTruthCursor>;
    /// 返回current target的optional reference cursor。
    pub fn current_source_reference_cursor(&self) -> Option<SandboxReferenceCursor>;
    /// 返回exact derived kind。
    pub fn derived_kind(&self) -> DerivedMaterialKind;
    /// 返回canonical state status。
    pub fn derived_status(&self) -> DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStatus;
    /// 返回status-specific maintenance detail。
    pub fn maintenance_detail(&self) -> &DerivedMaintenanceDetail;
    /// 返回optional last-success source coverage。
    pub fn last_materialized_source_refs(&self) -> Option<&DerivedSourceRefSet>;
    /// 返回optional materialized truth cursor。
    pub fn materialized_truth_cursor(&self) -> Option<SandboxTruthCursor>;
    /// 返回optional materialized reference cursor。
    pub fn materialized_reference_cursor(&self) -> Option<SandboxReferenceCursor>;
    /// 返回state creation time。
    pub fn created_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
    /// 返回current status time。
    pub fn status_changed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
    /// 返回latest state transition audit linkage。
    pub fn last_audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;
    /// 判断state是否已有一次成功materialization。
    pub fn has_last_materialization(&self) -> bool;
}
```

state snapshot factory必须按canonical status逐项验证detail：Fresh只接受`Fresh`；Stale/Rebuilding必须复制
matching marker的trigger/reason/time；Failed必须一一映射domain `DerivedFailureKind`、safe reason、attempt cursor和
failure time；Unavailable只复制state unavailable reason。detail不能从status文字、job report或repository error构造。

current target cursor的来源必须由state status机械确定：Fresh从state的materialized cursor复制；Stale / Rebuilding
从matching rebuild marker复制；Failed从matching current marker复制，并另保留failure detail的attempt cursor；
Unavailable从matching marker复制，无marker且尚无formal target cursor时保持双None。它们必须与
`current_source_refs`的source family presence一致，不能从query时间、repository version或latest row猜测。

last-success字段遵守：`last_materialized_source_refs=None`时两类materialized cursor必须都是None；Some时cursor
presence必须与该set的local/reference family一一对应。Fresh强制Some且current source与last-success source全等；
其它status允许None，或允许由current marker证明的source replacement。`status_changed_at >= created_at`，且detail内
marker/failure/start time不得晚于status time或发生回退。

#### 16.8.9 Explicit never-materialized proof

optional materialization不能由repository `None`、empty summary set或state status猜测。只有完整成功物化索引证明该
state从未提交成功row时，才允许状态完整但payload为空。

```rust
/// exact state从未成功提交derived materialization的same-snapshot proof。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct DerivedNeverMaterializedProof {
    /// proof归属的owning context。
    context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
    /// exact derived state identity。
    derived_state_ref: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStateRef,
    /// exact derived kind。
    derived_kind: DerivedMaterialKind,
    /// 成功materialization row总数；合法值固定为0。
    successful_materialization_count: u64,
    /// 完整索引已有的audit linkage。
    source_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    /// same-snapshot index observation time。
    observed_at: Timestamp,
}

impl DerivedNeverMaterializedProof {
    /// 从完整successful-materialization index read构造zero-count proof。
    pub fn try_from_committed_index_absence(
        context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
        derived_state_ref: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStateRef,
        derived_kind: DerivedMaterialKind,
        successful_materialization_count: u64,
        source_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        observed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, DerivedInspectPreviewTrendViewError>;

    /// 返回proof owning context。
    pub fn context_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionContextRef;
    /// 返回exact derived state ref。
    pub fn derived_state_ref(&self) -> &DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStateRef;
    /// 返回exact derived kind。
    pub fn derived_kind(&self) -> DerivedMaterialKind;
    /// 返回固定为0的successful row count。
    pub fn successful_materialization_count(&self) -> u64;
    /// 返回index audit linkage。
    pub fn source_audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;
    /// 返回index observation time。
    pub fn observed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
}

/// formal reader对last-success materialization的closed read position。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum DerivedMaterializationReadPosition {
    /// 已完整读取最近一次successful immutable materialization。
    Present(DerivedInspectPreviewTrendCommittedMaterialization),
    /// 完整索引证明该state从未成功materialize。
    NeverMaterialized(DerivedNeverMaterializedProof),
    /// materialization存在性或row当前不可完整读取；必须配typed gap。
    Unavailable,
}

impl DerivedMaterializationReadPosition {
    /// 返回optional完整committed materialization。
    pub fn materialization(
        &self,
    ) -> Option<&DerivedInspectPreviewTrendCommittedMaterialization>;
    /// 判断是否有正式zero-success proof。
    pub fn is_never_materialized(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断materialization read是否不可完整供给。
    pub fn is_unavailable(&self) -> bool;
}
```

Fresh只允许`Present`；`NeverMaterialized`只允许state snapshot的last-success字段全None且canonical status为初始
`Rebuilding`、`Failed`或`Unavailable`。`Stale`必须有last-known materialization，不能用该proof替代。
`Unavailable`不等于never-materialized，必须与`MaterializationRow | MaterializationSource` typed gap一起进入
degraded/no-view factory。明确查到state声称last-success但成功row count为0，或state声称从未成功但index有row，均为
half-commit integrity error，不能降级。

#### 16.8.10 Typed read gap与public surface映射

derived read gap只表示formal reader在一个公平read snapshot中无法完整供给哪一类已提交依赖。它不是
`DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStatus`，不会把`Fresh`改成`Stale`，也不会把`Failed`升级为
`FailureClassification`。已知wrong-kind、duplicate binding、state / binding half-commit、last-success coverage
矛盾、cursor回退或payload关系损坏必须返回typed integrity error，不能包装成gap继续展示。

本对象同时依赖truth与reference两类cursor；gap不能把二者压成generic `Version`。每条gap必须绑定exact
context / state / kind，并分别声明required与available truth / reference coverage。某一cursor family不属于当前
source coverage时，对应required与available必须同时为None；属于coverage时required必须为Some，available若为Some
则必须严格早于required。

```rust
/// derived view source可安全分类的闭集读取缺口。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum DerivedInspectPreviewTrendReadGapKind {
    /// exact state / current binding index当前不可完整读取。
    ViewBinding,
    /// canonical derived state row或state contracts snapshot不可完整读取。
    StateTruth,
    /// current target source refs、scope relation或对应cursor coverage不可完整证明。
    CurrentSourceCoverage,
    /// last-success immutable materialization row当前不可完整读取。
    MaterializationRow,
    /// committed materialization的source snapshot、safe summary ref或cursor relation不可完整读取。
    MaterializationSource,
}

/// 一条与exact derived selector及双cursor coverage绑定的caller-safe读取缺口。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct DerivedInspectPreviewTrendReadGap {
    /// 缺失dependency的closed类别。
    gap_kind: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendReadGapKind,
    /// access decision已通过的owning context。
    context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
    /// gap适用的exact derived state。
    derived_state_ref: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStateRef,
    /// gap适用的exact inspect / preview / trend kind。
    derived_kind: DerivedMaterialKind,
    /// 读取必须覆盖到的truth watermark；无local truth source时为None。
    required_truth_cursor: Option<SandboxTruthCursor>,
    /// reader能够证明的truth watermark；完全不可用或无此family时为None。
    available_truth_cursor: Option<SandboxTruthCursor>,
    /// 读取必须覆盖到的reference watermark；无reference-side source时为None。
    required_reference_cursor: Option<SandboxReferenceCursor>,
    /// reader能够证明的reference watermark；完全不可用或无此family时为None。
    available_reference_cursor: Option<SandboxReferenceCursor>,
    /// owner-approved、caller-safe的gap原因。
    reason: SandboxReason,
}

impl DerivedInspectPreviewTrendReadGap {
    /// 从formal reader的typed disposition构造双cursor gap。
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    pub fn try_from_reader_disposition(
        gap_kind: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendReadGapKind,
        context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
        derived_state_ref: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStateRef,
        derived_kind: DerivedMaterialKind,
        required_truth_cursor: Option<SandboxTruthCursor>,
        available_truth_cursor: Option<SandboxTruthCursor>,
        required_reference_cursor: Option<SandboxReferenceCursor>,
        available_reference_cursor: Option<SandboxReferenceCursor>,
        reason: SandboxReason,
    ) -> Result<Self, DerivedInspectPreviewTrendViewError>;

    /// 返回gap kind。
    pub fn gap_kind(&self) -> DerivedInspectPreviewTrendReadGapKind;
    /// 返回owning context。
    pub fn context_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionContextRef;
    /// 返回exact derived state ref。
    pub fn derived_state_ref(&self) -> &DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStateRef;
    /// 返回exact derived kind。
    pub fn derived_kind(&self) -> DerivedMaterialKind;
    /// 返回optional required truth cursor。
    pub fn required_truth_cursor(&self) -> Option<SandboxTruthCursor>;
    /// 返回optional available truth cursor。
    pub fn available_truth_cursor(&self) -> Option<SandboxTruthCursor>;
    /// 返回optional required reference cursor。
    pub fn required_reference_cursor(&self) -> Option<SandboxReferenceCursor>;
    /// 返回optional available reference cursor。
    pub fn available_reference_cursor(&self) -> Option<SandboxReferenceCursor>;
    /// 返回caller-safe gap reason。
    pub fn reason(&self) -> &SandboxReason;
}

/// 非空、按closed kind排序且每类至多一项的derived read gap集合。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct DerivedInspectPreviewTrendReadGapSet(
    Vec<DerivedInspectPreviewTrendReadGap>,
);

impl DerivedInspectPreviewTrendReadGapSet {
    /// 按`ViewBinding -> StateTruth -> CurrentSourceCoverage -> MaterializationRow -> MaterializationSource`构造集合。
    pub fn try_new(
        gaps: Vec<DerivedInspectPreviewTrendReadGap>,
    ) -> Result<Self, DerivedInspectPreviewTrendViewError>;
    /// 返回immutable gap切片。
    pub fn as_slice(&self) -> &[DerivedInspectPreviewTrendReadGap];
    /// 判断是否包含指定gap kind。
    pub fn contains(&self, kind: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendReadGapKind) -> bool;
    /// 将typed gap reason逐项、同序映射到shared degraded reason set。
    pub fn to_degraded_reasons(
        &self,
    ) -> Result<StatusViewDegradedReasonSet, DerivedInspectPreviewTrendViewError>;
}
```

gap cardinality与公开surface固定如下：

| read position | allowed gap | public surface | view | 禁止替代 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| binding index未能判定 | 恰好一条`ViewBinding` | `Unavailable` | `None` | 构造0-count absence、回退old binding、映`Empty`或`Degraded` |
| binding已命中但state不完整 | `StateTruth` | `Unavailable` | `None` | 从binding status补state、把repository error写入maintenance detail |
| state完整但current source coverage不完整 | `CurrentSourceCoverage` | `Degraded` | `Some`，仅限下述完整status/materialization关系 | query扫描source、把canonical status改成Unavailable |
| state声明last-success但row不可完整读取 | `MaterializationRow &#124; MaterializationSource` | `Unavailable` | `None` | 丢弃payload后构造status-only view、回退更旧row |
| state合法声明从未成功materialize | 无gap，`NeverMaterialized` proof | `Visible` | `Some` status-only；仅初始`Rebuilding &#124; Failed &#124; Unavailable` | 将proof映为Empty、MissingProjection或Degraded |
| all source完整、status为Fresh | 无gap | `Visible` | `Some` | 额外标记Degraded、由query刷新 |
| all source完整、status为Stale | 无gap | `Stale` | `Some` last-known | 将canonical stale写成read gap |
| all source完整、status为Rebuilding | 无gap | `Rebuilding` | `Some`；可有last-known | 因job active自动Degraded或Failed |
| all source完整、status为Failed | 无gap | `Visible` | `Some`；可status-only | 映为query Failed或core failure |
| all source完整、status为Unavailable | 无gap | `Visible` | `Some`；可status-only | 映为query Unavailable，丢失canonical maintenance truth |

`CurrentSourceCoverage`是唯一允许返回`Degraded, view=Some`的gap。它要求state row、maintenance detail、binding和
last-success materialization位置都已经完整读取；若materialization为`Present`，其committed source也必须完整。
gap只说明current target source relation暂不能覆盖selected state snapshot，不能改写last-known payload，也不能产生
新的current source set。Fresh不允许该gap，因为Fresh必须证明current target与last-success exact同构；Stale /
Rebuilding / Failed / Unavailable可在其它字段完整时降级展示。多个gap、`MaterializationRow`与
`MaterializationSource`任一缺口、或state缺口一律`Unavailable, view=None`。

`DerivedInspectPreviewTrendReadGapSet`不自动去重。同kind只能一项，不同kind的safe reason也必须不同，以保持
`StatusViewDegradedReasonSet`的一一映射。`ViewBinding`必须是唯一项；binding已命中后的gap必须与selection的
context / state / kind全等。SQL、IO、SDK、raw row、backend target、path、host、PID、endpoint、credential、summary
正文和hidden ref不能进入gap reason。

#### 16.8.11 Same-snapshot source snapshot与materialization relation

`DerivedInspectPreviewTrendSourceSnapshot`是final view唯一允许消费的合成输入。formal reader必须在同一个公平read
transaction中完成selection、canonical state snapshot、last-success materialization position以及source relation
校验；不得先读state status，再用latest scan追一条payload或summary。

```rust
/// exact current derived view的一次same-snapshot、body-free读取输入。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct DerivedInspectPreviewTrendSourceSnapshot {
    /// exact selector命中的current binding selection proof。
    selection: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendBindingSelectionProof,
    /// 从committed domain state row机械复制的contracts snapshot。
    state: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStateReadSnapshot,
    /// last-success materialization的closed读取位置。
    materialization_position: DerivedMaterializationReadPosition,
    /// 仅允许`CurrentSourceCoverage`的typed degraded gap；完整source为None。
    read_gaps: Option<DerivedInspectPreviewTrendReadGapSet>,
    /// formal reader完成same-snapshot组装的时间。
    observed_at: Timestamp,
}

impl DerivedInspectPreviewTrendSourceSnapshot {
    /// 构造无typed gap的完整source snapshot。
    pub fn complete(
        selection: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendBindingSelectionProof,
        state: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStateReadSnapshot,
        materialization_position: DerivedMaterializationReadPosition,
        observed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, DerivedInspectPreviewTrendViewError>;

    /// 构造current target coverage暂不完整、但public field group完整的degraded source。
    pub fn degraded_current_source(
        selection: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendBindingSelectionProof,
        state: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStateReadSnapshot,
        materialization_position: DerivedMaterializationReadPosition,
        read_gaps: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendReadGapSet,
        observed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, DerivedInspectPreviewTrendViewError>;

    /// 返回checked selection proof。
    pub fn selection(&self) -> &DerivedInspectPreviewTrendBindingSelectionProof;
    /// 返回canonical state read snapshot。
    pub fn state(&self) -> &DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStateReadSnapshot;
    /// 返回last-success materialization read position。
    pub fn materialization_position(&self) -> &DerivedMaterializationReadPosition;
    /// 返回optional typed gaps。
    pub fn read_gaps(&self) -> Option<&DerivedInspectPreviewTrendReadGapSet>;
    /// 返回formal read observation time。
    pub fn observed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
    /// 判断source是否带唯一允许的current-source degradation。
    pub fn is_degraded(&self) -> bool;
    /// 返回本source必须映射的public query surface。
    pub fn surface_status(&self) -> SandboxQuerySurfaceStatus;
}
```

source factory按以下顺序机械校验：

1. selection selector、binding和state的context / state / kind逐项全等；binding的status、status time与audit ref必须
   等于state。Fresh时binding `view_ref`必须等于`Present.materialization.view_ref`。其它status使用Present时，binding
   指向current immutable status row，materialization ref指向更早的successful row，两者必须不同；NeverMaterialized时
   binding仍以自己的`view_ref`标识status-only immutable row，不得由query生成新identity。
2. `observed_at`不早于selection、binding、state、never-materialized proof及present materialization/source的所有
   committed time。query clock只形成read observation，不覆盖任何source time。
3. Fresh只能使用`Present`且state last-success coverage与materialization source refs / 双cursor exact全等。
   `Stale`必须使用`Present`，其source必须等于state保留的last-success coverage；`Rebuilding`在已有成功结果时
   同样必须使用`Present`并保留该last-known coverage，但初始build attempt允许使用`NeverMaterialized`。current
   marker关系按`§16.8.7`验证；`NeverMaterialized`只表示成功materialization index为零，不表示current status-only
   view row不存在。
4. Failed / Unavailable可使用`Present`或`NeverMaterialized`。Present时继续校验last-success exact coverage；
   NeverMaterialized时state的last-success refs与两个cursor必须全None，proof的context / state / kind与selection全等。
5. `Unavailable` read position不能进入任何source factory，只能由lookup outcome配
   `MaterializationRow | MaterializationSource` gap返回no-view。
6. complete固定`read_gaps=None`。degraded factory只接受恰好一个`CurrentSourceCoverage` gap；canonical Fresh、
   `ViewBinding | StateTruth | MaterializationRow | MaterializationSource`、多gap或错误双cursor coverage全部拒绝。

source中的payload variant必须与state kind全等。current binding始终指向已提交的immutable view row；当
`materialization_position=NeverMaterialized`时，该row只保存status/detail/source-coverage等body-free view fields，
不计入successful materialization row，并继续使用同一种`DerivedInspectPreviewTrendViewRef` identity类型，不得创建
status-only第二ref类型。present source audit、materialization audit、state audit和binding audit
可以是不同transition linkage，但都必须已提交并保持各自角色；不得要求它们文本相等，也不得用query trace替换。
`surface_status()`只读取checked state与gap：有允许gap固定`Degraded`；否则按
`Fresh -> Visible, Stale -> Stale, Rebuilding -> Rebuilding, Failed -> Visible, Unavailable -> Visible`映射。

#### 16.8.12 Binding/source lookup outcome

formal reader必须用closed outcome区分“exact state确实不存在”“source可构造view”和“当前无法安全构造view”。
application service不能从多个`Option`或repository `NotFound`重新解释这一边界。

```rust
/// exact derived selector的一次same-snapshot formal reader输出。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum DerivedInspectPreviewTrendSourceLookupOutcome {
    /// 已形成完整或唯一允许degraded的checked source。
    ViewSource(DerivedInspectPreviewTrendSourceSnapshot),
    /// exact state与current binding index共同证明不存在。
    ExactAbsent(DerivedInspectPreviewTrendAbsenceProof),
    /// binding或必要source不足以安全形成view body。
    Unavailable {
        /// access-approved exact selector。
        selector: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendSelector,
        /// 非空typed read gaps。
        read_gaps: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendReadGapSet,
    },
}

impl DerivedInspectPreviewTrendSourceLookupOutcome {
    /// 构造可进入final view factory的source outcome。
    pub fn view_source(source: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendSourceSnapshot) -> Self;
    /// 构造exact state + binding共同缺失的absence outcome。
    pub fn exact_absent(
        selector: &DerivedInspectPreviewTrendSelector,
        proof: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendAbsenceProof,
    ) -> Result<Self, DerivedInspectPreviewTrendViewError>;
    /// 构造当前无法安全形成view的typed no-view outcome。
    pub fn unavailable(
        selector: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendSelector,
        read_gaps: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendReadGapSet,
    ) -> Result<Self, DerivedInspectPreviewTrendViewError>;
}
```

`ExactAbsent`要求selector与proof三元组全等且两个count均为0，只映射`Empty, view=None`。binding index技术不可用时
`Unavailable`必须恰好一条`ViewBinding`；binding命中后可返回`StateTruth`、`CurrentSourceCoverage`、
`MaterializationRow`或`MaterializationSource`，但`CurrentSourceCoverage`在满足degraded source前提时应进入
`ViewSource`，不能无故降为no-view。已知state=1/binding=0、state=0/binding=1、duplicate current、wrong view ref、
wrong kind、cursor矛盾或malformed row直接返回`DerivedInspectPreviewTrendViewError`，不属于该enum的普通分支。

#### 16.8.13 Exact error surface

`DerivedInspectPreviewTrendViewError`只描述已经进入contracts mapper的 selector、state、materialization、source 或
view 结构关系错误。它不承接 repository unavailable、snapshot isolation failure、query access denial、transport、
invalid public request、unsupported protocol version或application retry decision；这些由Step 7 / Step 8 owner映射。
反向地，已知malformed row、duplicate current binding、wrong lineage、half-commit、cursor回退和payload矛盾不得被
包装为普通技术不可用或typed degraded gap。

```rust
/// derived inspect / preview / trend view的selector、source、materialization或字段关系错误。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum DerivedInspectPreviewTrendViewError {
    /// required context、exact state或kind selector为空、错型或包含comparison / reconciliation kind。
    SelectorShapeInvalid,
    /// selector或source使用了本对象不承接的derived kind。
    UnsupportedDerivedKind {
        /// 被拒绝的shared material kind。
        kind: DerivedMaterialKind,
    },
    /// selector与current binding的context、state或kind不完全相等。
    SelectorBindingMismatch,
    /// current binding重复、缺失必需字段、指向错误row或与state形成half-commit。
    CurrentBindingIntegrityInvalid,
    /// absence proof的selector、kind、count、audit或观察时间关系无效。
    AbsenceProofInvalid,
    /// lookup outcome把source、absence或unavailable放到了错误selector分支。
    BindingLookupOutcomeInvalid,
    /// binding的view ref、status、status time、audit或bound time relation无效。
    ViewBindingRelationInvalid,
    /// state snapshot的context、state ref、kind、status或current target字段关系无效。
    StateSnapshotRelationInvalid,
    /// maintenance detail与canonical state status、marker、failure或availability reason不一致。
    MaintenanceDetailRelationInvalid,
    /// current source set不满足exact derived kind的minimum coverage或包含错误成员。
    CurrentSourceCoverageInvalid,
    /// current source set与其truth / reference cursor presence不一致。
    CurrentSourceCursorRelationInvalid,
    /// last-success source set与materialized cursor、state字段或current status关系不一致。
    MaterializedSourceCoverageInvalid,
    /// current target与last-success source coverage的同构、replacement或marker关系不成立。
    CurrentMaterializedRelationInvalid,
    /// materialization read position与state的last-success字段或successful row count矛盾。
    MaterializationReadPositionInvalid,
    /// materialization row的source、payload、view ref、audit或completion time关系无效。
    MaterializationRowRelationInvalid,
    /// materialization source snapshot的context、state、kind、source set、cursor或audit relation无效。
    MaterializationSourceRelationInvalid,
    /// state kind与materialization union variant不一致。
    MaterializationKindMismatch {
        /// state声明的kind。
        state_kind: DerivedMaterialKind,
        /// materialization实际kind。
        materialization_kind: DerivedMaterialKind,
    },
    /// inspect count、result class与summary cardinality不一致。
    InspectMaterializationRelationInvalid,
    /// preview count、coverage与safe summary cardinality不一致。
    PreviewMaterializationRelationInvalid,
    /// trend window、point count、direction与aggregate summary关系不一致。
    TrendMaterializationRelationInvalid,
    /// derived payload携带了不允许的body、无限字段或非finite关系。
    BodyFreeMaterializationViolation,
    /// typed read gap的selector、dual cursor、safe reason或status允许范围无效。
    ReadGapRelationInvalid,
    /// gap set为空、重复、非canonical order或包含互斥gap组合。
    ReadGapSetInvalid,
    /// typed gap与shared degraded reason set没有逐项、同序映射。
    ReadGapReasonMappingInvalid,
    /// complete / degraded source收到错误gap，或缺少构造view所需的core field group。
    SourceCompletenessRelationInvalid,
    /// source snapshot的selection、state、materialization position、gap或观察时间关系无效。
    SourceSnapshotRelationInvalid,
    /// source lookup outcome的selector、absence、gap或source关系不满足closed mapping。
    SourceLookupOutcomeInvalid,
    /// current view ref与status row、successful row或binding lineage关系无效。
    ViewIdentityRelationInvalid,
    /// final view字段没有从同一个checked source机械复制，或status-only / last-known形态选择错误。
    ViewFieldRelationInvalid,
    /// source、materialization、binding、detail或observed time违反canonical单调时间关系。
    TimestampRelationInvalid,
}
```

本enum的variant payload只允许本节已登记的closed enum；不得携带SQL、table/key、raw row、SDK/HTTP/IO cause、
backend target、page token、query trace、path、host、PID、endpoint、credential、builder response、external case body
或hidden existence ref。`SandboxReason`只可通过已经校验的state detail、source gap或view字段传递，不能作为error自由
文本让application重新解析。

#### 16.8.14 Final `DerivedInspectPreviewTrendView`、factory、getter与helper

该view是一个required exact selector命中的current immutable derived read row。它同时承载current canonical
maintenance status和最近一次successful body-free materialization（如果存在），但不拥有state transition、builder
执行、source refresh、query repair或任何core truth mutation。`view_ref`永远表示current row；
`materialization.view_ref()`（存在时）表示最近一次successful row。两者只有Fresh成功UoW中相等。

```rust
/// 一个exact current derived inspect / preview / trend的body-free committed read model。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct DerivedInspectPreviewTrendView {
    /// current status row与current binding共同提交的immutable view identity。
    view_ref: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendViewRef,
    /// view唯一归属的owning controlled execution context。
    context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
    /// caller明确选择且binding证明的exact derived state identity。
    derived_state_ref: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStateRef,
    /// exact inspect / preview / trend kind。
    derived_kind: DerivedMaterialKind,
    /// domain state唯一拥有的canonical maintenance status。
    derived_status: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStatus,
    /// 与canonical status一一对应的contracts-only maintenance detail。
    maintenance_detail: DerivedMaintenanceDetail,
    /// current target source coverage；不含source body。
    current_source_refs: DerivedSourceRefSet,
    /// current target的optional committed truth cursor。
    current_source_truth_cursor: Option<SandboxTruthCursor>,
    /// current target的optional committed reference cursor。
    current_source_reference_cursor: Option<SandboxReferenceCursor>,
    /// 最近一次successful materialization的source coverage；从未成功时为None。
    last_materialized_source_refs: Option<DerivedSourceRefSet>,
    /// 最近一次successful materialization覆盖的truth cursor。
    materialized_truth_cursor: Option<SandboxTruthCursor>,
    /// 最近一次successful materialization覆盖的reference cursor。
    materialized_reference_cursor: Option<SandboxReferenceCursor>,
    /// 最近一次successful body-free payload；初始status-only row时为None。
    materialization: Option<DerivedInspectPreviewTrendMaterialization>,
    /// 最近一次successful row的immutable identity；与payload同生共死。
    materialized_view_ref: Option<DerivedInspectPreviewTrendViewRef>,
    /// 最近一次successful materialization的transition audit linkage。
    materialization_audit_trace_ref: Option<SandboxAuditTraceRef>,
    /// state / binding已有的source audit linkage；不是query audit。
    source_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    /// exact derived state首次建立时间；从state snapshot机械复制。
    created_at: Timestamp,
    /// exact derived state当前canonical status生效时间；从state snapshot机械复制。
    status_changed_at: Timestamp,
    /// typed gap映射出的caller-safe reason；complete view为None。
    degraded_reasons: Option<StatusViewDegradedReasonSet>,
    /// formal reader完成same-snapshot组装的观察时间。
    observed_at: Timestamp,
}

impl DerivedInspectPreviewTrendView {
    /// 从完整、same-snapshot、relation-checked source构造view。
    pub fn from_committed_snapshot(
        source: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendSourceSnapshot,
    ) -> Result<Self, DerivedInspectPreviewTrendViewError>;

    /// 从完整核心字段与唯一允许的`CurrentSourceCoverage` gap构造degraded view。
    pub fn from_degraded_snapshot(
        source: DerivedInspectPreviewTrendSourceSnapshot,
    ) -> Result<Self, DerivedInspectPreviewTrendViewError>;

    /// 返回current immutable view identity。
    pub fn view_ref(&self) -> &DerivedInspectPreviewTrendViewRef;
    /// 返回owning context。
    pub fn context_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionContextRef;
    /// 返回exact derived state identity。
    pub fn derived_state_ref(&self) -> &DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStateRef;
    /// 返回exact inspect / preview / trend kind。
    pub fn derived_kind(&self) -> DerivedMaterialKind;
    /// 返回canonical maintenance status。
    pub fn derived_status(&self) -> DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStatus;
    /// 返回status-specific maintenance detail。
    pub fn maintenance_detail(&self) -> &DerivedMaintenanceDetail;
    /// 返回current target source coverage。
    pub fn current_source_refs(&self) -> &DerivedSourceRefSet;
    /// 返回current target的optional truth cursor。
    pub fn current_source_truth_cursor(&self) -> Option<SandboxTruthCursor>;
    /// 返回current target的optional reference cursor。
    pub fn current_source_reference_cursor(&self) -> Option<SandboxReferenceCursor>;
    /// 返回optional last-success source coverage。
    pub fn last_materialized_source_refs(&self) -> Option<&DerivedSourceRefSet>;
    /// 返回optional last-success truth cursor。
    pub fn materialized_truth_cursor(&self) -> Option<SandboxTruthCursor>;
    /// 返回optional last-success reference cursor。
    pub fn materialized_reference_cursor(&self) -> Option<SandboxReferenceCursor>;
    /// 返回optional last-success body-free materialization。
    pub fn materialization(&self) -> Option<&DerivedInspectPreviewTrendMaterialization>;
    /// 返回optional last-success row identity。
    pub fn materialized_view_ref(&self) -> Option<&DerivedInspectPreviewTrendViewRef>;
    /// 返回optional last-success transition audit linkage。
    pub fn materialization_audit_trace_ref(&self) -> Option<&SandboxAuditTraceRef>;
    /// 返回state / binding已有的source audit linkage。
    pub fn source_audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;
    /// 返回exact derived state首次建立时间。
    pub fn created_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
    /// 返回exact derived state当前canonical status生效时间。
    pub fn status_changed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
    /// 返回optional caller-safe degraded reasons。
    pub fn degraded_reasons(&self) -> Option<&StatusViewDegradedReasonSet>;
    /// 返回formal read observation time。
    pub fn observed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;

    /// 返回由canonical state与typed gap决定的public query surface。
    pub fn surface_status(&self) -> SandboxQuerySurfaceStatus;
    /// 判断view是否由唯一允许的typed current-source gap显式降级。
    pub fn is_degraded(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断是否存在last-success materialization payload。
    pub fn has_materialization(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断当前view是否为status-only而没有successful payload。
    pub fn is_status_only(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断payload是否是current Fresh source的结果，而非last-known结果。
    pub fn is_current_materialization(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断payload是否是Stale / Rebuilding / Failed / Unavailable的last-known结果。
    pub fn is_last_known_materialization(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断当前derived state是否为Fresh。
    pub fn is_fresh(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断当前derived state是否正在Rebuilding。
    pub fn is_rebuilding(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断当前derived state是否为derived-only Failed。
    pub fn is_failed(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断当前derived state是否为Unavailable。
    pub fn is_unavailable(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断当前view是否可作为完整的body-free只读记录。
    pub fn is_read_complete(&self) -> bool;
}
```

final factory固定执行以下校验与复制顺序：

1. 先验证source的selection、state和materialization position；不接受独立`view_ref`、status、cursor、reason、payload
   或audit参数覆盖source。access decision、visibility和selector normalization不在该factory内重做。
2. 从selection.binding复制current `view_ref`、context、state、kind、state status、status time和state audit linkage；
   从state复制maintenance detail、current source refs / cursors、last-success coverage / cursors、`created_at`与
   `status_changed_at`。两个生命周期时间必须来自同一个state snapshot，不能由binding或query clock重算。
3. `Present`复制materialization union、其`view_ref`、source audit与materialization audit；`NeverMaterialized`将
   payload、materialized row ref与materialization audit全部置为None。NeverMaterialized proof必须已经证明成功row count
   为0，不能由`Option::None`猜测。
4. `from_committed_snapshot`要求`read_gaps=None`；`from_degraded_snapshot`要求恰好一条
   `CurrentSourceCoverage` gap，并由gap set唯一生成`Some(StatusViewDegradedReasonSet)`。其它gap、Fresh+gap、
   多gap和gap reason重复全部返回typed error。
5. final fields只保存body-free ref、finite enum、count、safe reason、cursor、time和audit linkage；不得复制source
   body、preview正文、trend samples、metric/log/artifact body、builder response或technical error。
6. factory只执行pure validation和字段复制；不得读取repository、调用clock、运行builder、重跑guard、刷新source、
   分配ref/cursor、推进state、写view、append business audit或调用任何backend / tool / runtime。

view field relation与helper语义固定如下：

| helper / relation | true condition | fail-closed / negative rule |
|---|---|---|
| `surface_status` | gap存在为`Degraded`；否则按`Fresh -> Visible`、`Stale -> Stale`、`Rebuilding -> Rebuilding`、`Failed / Unavailable -> Visible` | canonical maintenance status不是query error；技术read gap也不能改写status |
| `has_materialization` | `materialization`、`materialized_view_ref`、last-success source/cursors、materialization audit同时为Some | 任一半存在均是integrity error，不返回false掩盖 |
| `is_status_only` | materialization position为`NeverMaterialized`并且上述last-success字段全None | `Failed / Unavailable` status不自动等于status-only |
| `is_current_materialization` | status为Fresh，materialization ref与current `view_ref`全等，source/cursor与current target全等 | Stale、Rebuilding、Failed、Unavailable永远不标为current |
| `is_last_known_materialization` | materialization存在且current `view_ref`与materialized ref不同，状态允许保留历史结果 | 不比较timestamp猜测，不把旧row当Fresh |
| `is_read_complete` | `degraded_reasons=None`且source关系已checked | typed gap、status-only或canonical Failed / Unavailable本身不让该值为false；只有read gap / integrity使其为false |
| kind / payload | `derived_kind == materialization.derived_kind` | comparison / reconciliation payload typed reject |

`is_read_complete()`描述read source是否完整，不表示derived maintenance成功；因此一个无gap的Failed或Unavailable
status-only view可以是完整读取。反向地，`is_degraded()`只由typed gap产生，绝不由Stale、Rebuilding、Failed、
Unavailable、Redacted preview或InsufficientData trend自动产生。

#### 16.8.15 Field source closure

下表把final view、source carrier和support proof的每个公开字段绑定到唯一来源。`exact source`是已经通过同一
fair-read snapshot校验的输入，不是application在mapper中重新查询的建议。`forbidden substitute`是实现时必须由
contracts、repository contract和negative test共同拒绝的替代路径。

| target field / carrier | exact source | relation guard | forbidden substitute |
|---|---|---|---|
| selector `context_ref` / `derived_state_ref` / `derived_kind` | Step 8 validated required exact selector；context已通过access decision | 三者非空；kind只能是`Inspect \| Preview \| Trend`；不由view ref反解 | optional selector、context-only latest、caller source filter、ref文本解析 |
| current `view_ref` | exact current binding指向的immutable status row | binding context/state/kind与state snapshot全等；每次current status materialization生成独立ref值 | query id generator、state ref转换、旧successful row回退 |
| `context_ref` | selector + binding + state snapshot三方exact equal | 不从source set第一项或repository key猜测 | first source member、view ref字符串、latest context scan |
| `derived_state_ref` | exact current binding及state row | state identity与selector全等；不存在cross-kind alias | materialization ref、job run ref、projection ref |
| `derived_kind` | state canonical kind与binding expected kind | state、binding、payload union三方全等；comparison/reconciliation typed reject | payload variant名称、summary类别、caller label |
| `derived_status` | `DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStateReadSnapshot.derived_status()` | binding status、state status、maintenance detail status全等 | `SandboxQuerySurfaceStatus`、materialization存在与否、job result |
| `maintenance_detail` | contracts-only state snapshot机械投影 | detail variant与canonical status及marker/failure/availability relation全等 | status文字、repository error、job report、query reason |
| `current_source_refs` | state snapshot current target coverage | minimum source rule、context scope、kind与source set闭合 | caller `source_refs`、latest source scan、summary body |
| current truth/reference cursors | state snapshot从Fresh、marker或attempt机械复制的双cursor | source family presence exact；truth与reference不得合并为`Version` | repository version、timestamp、query observation time |
| last-success source refs/cursors | state snapshot `last_materialized_*`字段 | None时双cursor全None；Some时与set family exact；Fresh必须与current全等 | current target refs、failed attempt cursor、latest row cursor |
| materialization union | `DerivedMaterializationReadPosition::Present`中的committed row | row source、state kind、payload kind、body-free invariants全等 | state字段拼payload、preview/trend临时计算、builder response |
| `materialized_view_ref` | Present row的`view_ref()` | payload、source、audit、row identity必须同时存在；status-only为None | current status row ref、query生成ref、oldest/latest winner |
| materialization audit ref | Present row的successful transition linkage | 只链接successful materialization；不得用state transition、query trace或job report替代 | append query audit、log trace、relay audit |
| `source_audit_trace_ref` | state/binding已有的committed source linkage | binding与state snapshot exact equal；只表达既有mutation linkage | query audit、read log、post-query append |
| `created_at` | `DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStateReadSnapshot.created_at()` | 与state、binding lineage和`status_changed_at`同一snapshot；`status_changed_at >= created_at` | binding创建时间、materialization时间、query observation time |
| `status_changed_at` | `DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStateReadSnapshot.status_changed_at()` | 与binding的state status time、maintenance detail marker/failure time关系一致；不晚于`observed_at` | `bound_at`、materialized_at、query clock、repository version |
| `degraded_reasons` | `DerivedInspectPreviewTrendReadGapSet::to_degraded_reasons()` | complete为None；degraded逐项同序、一对一、reason不重复 | caller bool、repository `Display`、canonical Failed/Unavailable reason |
| `observed_at` | formal reader完成source assembly后的application clock | 不早于selection、binding、state、proof、materialization和source observations | backend clock、row insertion time、materialized_at冒充 |
| `DerivedNeverMaterializedProof` | successful-materialization exact index的同snapshot zero-count结果 | count固定为0；context/state/kind/audit/time与selection一致 | `Option::None`、empty summary、state status、repository NotFound |
| `DerivedMaterializationReadPosition` | formal materialization index reader | Present / NeverMaterialized / Unavailable三分闭集；Unavailable必须带typed gap | 两个optional字段、latest row scan、absence fallback |
| read gap双cursor字段 | formal reader覆盖证明 | 无该source family时required/available同时None；available严格早于required | generic version、错误文本、caller freshness bool |

final view不保存selector对象、binding selection proof、gap kind本体、source body或domain transition carrier；这些
字段已经在factory前完成验证。它仍必须公开足以解释status、last-known coverage、status-only和degraded surface的
body-free字段，不能通过“少保存字段”把实现选择留给application。

#### 16.8.16 Query、materialization与no-second-truth boundary

本节只定义contracts对象对下游的边界，不提前定义Step 7 trait、Step 8 wire encoding或Step 11物理表。下游必须
把下面的调用顺序、write set和禁止副作用逐项落为自己的exact contract；缺一项不得以`load_status_snapshot`泛化。

| path | required order / allowed operation | forbidden operation | write set / external call |
|---|---|---|---|
| access | 先消费application `SandboxQueryAccessDecision`；`NotVisible / Restricted`在exact lookup前结束 | 先查state或binding再决定visibility；用Empty泄漏存在性 | 0；不调用backend/tool/runtime |
| selector | 构造required `context_ref + derived_state_ref + derived_kind` selector | context-only latest、kind scan、caller source filter、historical view-ref selector | 0 |
| exact lookup | 在一个公平read snapshot读取state count与current binding count；0/0才构造`AbsenceProof` | repository `None`直接Empty；先读state再查binding；回退旧binding | 0；只调用formal read index |
| source assembly | 按selected binding加载state snapshot、materialization position、source/cursor relation并调用source factory | latest scan、query临时计算preview/trend、调用builder或外部resolver | 0；backend/tool/runtime call = 0 |
| complete view | `ViewSource`进入`from_committed_snapshot`；保留canonical status与last-known语义 | 把Stale/Rebuilding/Failed/Unavailable改成普通query error；把Failed升格core failure | 0；不append业务audit |
| degraded view | 只接受单一`CurrentSourceCoverage` gap；由gap机械产生safe reason | Materialization/State/Binding gap构造部分view；用旧payload掩盖当前row缺失 | 0；不修复source |
| no-view | `ViewBinding`、`StateTruth`、`MaterializationRow`、`MaterializationSource` gap返回`Unavailable, view=None` | 回退更旧row、伪造NeverMaterialized、映为Empty | 0 |
| exact absence | 完整索引证明state=0且binding=0后返回`Empty, view=None` | timeout、partial index、wrong kind、row decode error冒充absence | 0 |
| DTO mapping | 只从checked view复制字段；public surface由view/outcome映射 | DTO重新比较cursor、重建status、生成view ref或reason | 0；仅允许受限diagnostic hook |
| query completion | 可记录operation、surface、kind、gap/error class等低基数diagnostic | 记录exact sensitive ref、reason正文、source body或追加`SandboxAuditTrace` | business write set = 0 |

successful maintenance writer的原子边界固定为：

1. 先在同一write UoW验证accepted source snapshot、matching rebuild marker和expected state version；application预生成
   本次current immutable row使用的`DerivedInspectPreviewTrendViewRef`，但不由query生成。
2. 对成功路径，canonical `DerivedInspectPreviewTrendState`完成matching `finish_rebuild`并进入`Fresh`，同时提交
   successful immutable materialization row、current status view row（Fresh成功时二者可共用同一ref值）和exact
   `(context_ref, derived_state_ref, derived_kind)` current binding。三者必须在同一个可见提交边界出现。
3. 对Stale、Rebuilding、Failed或Unavailable status transition，提交新的current status row/ref和binding；旧
   successful materialization row保持immutable并由state的last-success coverage继续指向。新status row不得被计入
   successful-materialization index，也不得修改旧payload。
4. 对初始无成功结果的Unavailable / Rebuilding / Failed，提交status-only current row、state detail和binding；同一
   read snapshot必须能构造`NeverMaterializedProof`。status-only row不能被当作successful materialization，不能令
   Fresh成立。
5. 对derived-only failure或source unavailable，只更新derived state及其view materialization；不得写
   `FailureClassification`、context、boundary、policy、run、capture、cleanup、redline或backend lifecycle truth。
6. 任一state、view row、successful materialization、binding或既有audit linkage写入失败，整个UoW不得暴露半提交；
   query永远不执行补偿写、repair、rebuild、release、investigation retry或read-audit append。

current binding的逻辑唯一性是`(context_ref, derived_state_ref, derived_kind)`；successful materialization的读取位置
按同一exact state/kind索引，并以immutable row count支持`Present / NeverMaterialized / Unavailable`三分结果。旧row
只可供未来audit / reconciliation专用协议读取，不能成为本query的第二selector。具体PK、unique index、snapshot
isolation、retention和cursor codec由Step 7、Step 11、Step 13、Step 14继续闭合，不能在实现时自行发明。

`DerivedInspectPreviewTrendStatus`是唯一canonical maintenance state。`SandboxQuerySurfaceStatus`、
`DerivedMaintenanceDetail`、read gap、view phase和status-only/read-complete helper都不是新的persisted state machine；
它们只能由checked source机械派生，不能反写state或影响builder policy。

### 16.9 `BackendCapabilityComparisonView` current canonical contract

`BackendCapabilityComparisonView`是`GetBackendCapabilityComparison`消费的contracts-owned、body-free、
immutable read model。它只比较一个exact `BoundaryRequirementSet`与一组明确选择、已提交的
`BackendCapabilitySummary` snapshot，并把每个backend的十维有限verdict、snapshot freshness和source
completeness装配为可解释只读记录。

本对象关闭named type #27，并关闭support family #40的comparison分支。canonical owner固定为
`crates/contracts/src/views.rs`。本节不修改正式`03~07`，不定义repository trait、wire DTO、query flow、
物理表、配置值或测试结果；这些只登记为Step 7~17定向重验义务。

#### 16.9.1 Step开工、输入审计与主体边界

本对象开工前已重新读取详细设计SOP、书写规范、可落码性标准、正式`00~02`、HLD handoff、`6R-01`
shared registry、`6R-02` requirement / capability对象、`§15.2` reference state、`§16.8` derived view，以及
historical Step 7~17 consumer。审计结论如下：

| audit question | current conclusion | implementation consequence |
|---|---|---|
| comparison比较什么 | 一个exact immutable `BoundaryRequirementSet`与caller明确选择的`1..N`个committed `BackendCapabilitySummary` | 不允许context-only、profile-only或全backend扫描 |
| comparison axis来自哪里 | `BoundaryLimitKind`十项closed set：CPU、memory、wall-clock、IO、filesystem、network、process、workspace、mount、lifecycle | 不允许backend-specific flag、字符串kind或漏维比较 |
| capability结论来自哪里 | 每个summary内的`BoundaryCapabilityVerdictSet`及`BackendCapabilitySummaryStatus` | view不重新评估requirement数值，不解析adapter错误 |
| 是否决定建立boundary | 否；comparison只展示已提交snapshot相对exact requirement的只读差异 | `Supported`不能等于`BoundaryEstablishmentDecision::Established`，也不能触发launch |
| stale / unavailable如何表达 | snapshot canonical status与typed read gap分离；存在的stale/unknown snapshot可完整展示，读取缺口按本节surface规则处理 | 不把status改写为repository error，也不把gap伪造成Unsupported |
| 是否允许refresh | query严格no-write、no-refresh、no-backend-call | refresh只属于`RefreshBackendCapabilitySummaries`或正式maintenance flow |
| 是否保存raw capability | 否；只保存typed refs、finite verdict、safe proof/reason refs、cursor、count、time和audit linkage | 不保存SDK response、backend product detail、host/profile body或requirement数值 |
| 是否属于Sandbox主体功能 | 否；属于boundary/capability记录面的derived read projection与异常可见性 | 不建立环境、不执行tool/runtime、不修改resource/filesystem/network/process truth |

没有发现新的L1/L2语义blocker。以下既有blocker继续开放：

- `SBX-DDD-GRANULARITY-REOPEN-001`；
- `SBX-DDD-GRANULARITY-STEP6-001`；
- `BLK-SBX-CANONICAL-001`；
- `BLK-SBX-VERSION-001`。

以下historical material从本节起失效，不提供alias或fallback：

1. `scope_ref: SandboxOpaqueRef`或`comparison_scope_ref`直接作为query selector；它不能证明exact requirement、
   owning context或backend snapshot集合。
2. `comparison_ref + backend_capability_summary_refs + unsupported_limit_kinds + DerivedFreshnessStatus`四字段摘要；
   它丢失per-backend/per-kind verdict、Unknown、proof/reason、cursor和source completeness。
3. query调用capability port或扫描configured backend profiles再现场比较；这会让read path创建第二份capability truth。
4. 用`unsupported_limit_kinds.is_empty()`推出Supported；Unknown、Stale、Unavailable与遗漏维度都会被误放行。
5. 用一个global comparison status覆盖每个summary自己的canonical status；这会形成第二状态owner。
6. 把comparison result输入boundary establishment或runtime launch；正式guard仍必须直接加载exact requirement、
   capability summary与checked age并形成`BackendCapabilityDecision`。

#### 16.9.2 Exact selector、backend set与current binding

query只允许读取caller明确选择的一个comparison state。selector必须同时携带owning context、exact
requirement和有序非空backend capability summary refs。caller顺序只用于稳定展示，不表示优先级、fallback顺序或
