backend选择。相同summary ref重复、同一backend generation重复、跨requirement或跨context成员均拒绝。

```rust
/// Backend capability comparison的required exact selector。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct BackendCapabilityComparisonSelector {
    /// 已通过query access decision的owning execution context。
    context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
    /// comparison唯一评估的immutable boundary requirement set。
    requirement_ref: BoundaryRequirementSetRef,
    /// caller明确选择且保持展示顺序的non-empty capability summary refs。
    capability_summary_refs: BackendCapabilityComparisonSourceRefSet,
}

impl BackendCapabilityComparisonSelector {
    /// 构造required context、exact requirement和non-empty exact summary set selector。
    pub fn try_new(
        context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
        requirement_ref: BoundaryRequirementSetRef,
        capability_summary_refs: BackendCapabilityComparisonSourceRefSet,
    ) -> Result<Self, BackendCapabilityComparisonViewError>;

    /// 返回owning context。
    pub fn context_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionContextRef;
    /// 返回exact immutable requirement ref。
    pub fn requirement_ref(&self) -> &BoundaryRequirementSetRef;
    /// 返回caller明确选择的ordered source refs。
    pub fn capability_summary_refs(&self) -> &BackendCapabilityComparisonSourceRefSet;
}

/// 保持caller明确选择顺序、拒绝重复的capability summary ref集合。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct BackendCapabilityComparisonSourceRefSet(
    Vec<BackendCapabilitySummaryRef>,
);

impl BackendCapabilityComparisonSourceRefSet {
    /// 创建non-empty ordered-unique source set；不按opaque ref文本排序。
    pub fn try_new(
        refs: Vec<BackendCapabilitySummaryRef>,
    ) -> Result<Self, BackendCapabilityComparisonViewError>;

    /// 返回保持caller选择顺序的只读slice。
    pub fn as_slice(&self) -> &[BackendCapabilitySummaryRef];
    /// 返回source数量。
    pub fn len(&self) -> usize;
    /// 判断source set是否为空；合法实例固定为false。
    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断是否包含exact capability summary ref。
    pub fn contains(&self, capability_ref: &BackendCapabilitySummaryRef) -> bool;
}
```

`BackendCapabilityComparisonSourceRefSet`属于support family #40，只在`crates/contracts/src/views.rs`声明；它不是
新的named object、repository identity或backend allowlist。它不接受`ExternalSourceRef`、`SandboxOpaqueRef`、
backend profile ref、adapter config ref或字符串。成员是否属于同一requirement/context/generation必须由checked
source snapshot验证，不能由set constructor读取repository。

当前cardinality contract固定为`1..=16`：`backendCapability.backendProfileRefs`在`04-配置设计.md`的
`SBX-CFG-I036`已经规定`UniqueRefList<BackendProfile,16>`且长度`1..=16`；comparison selector只能选择该已验证
候选闭集的非空子集，因此`BackendCapabilityComparisonSourceRefSet::try_new`也拒绝空集和超过16项。选择顺序
只保留展示稳定性，不表示fallback或优先级。该上限属于当前设计契约，`04`配置、Step 7 reader和Step 16
cardinality测试必须定向重验；不得在实现中静默截断、分页或扩大到未登记的profile。

current binding唯一键固定为`(context_ref, requirement_ref, source_set_digest)`。digest只由application使用已验证、
有序typed refs经canonical writer计算并作为opaque `SandboxSourceDigest`保存；contracts不自行hash，也不暴露digest
作为selector替代品。

```rust
/// Exact comparison selector与current immutable view row的committed binding。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct BackendCapabilityComparisonViewBinding {
    /// 当前immutable comparison view row identity。
    view_ref: BackendCapabilityComparisonViewRef,
    /// comparison所属execution context。
    context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
    /// comparison使用的exact requirement set。
    requirement_ref: BoundaryRequirementSetRef,
    /// comparison使用的ordered exact source refs。
    capability_summary_refs: BackendCapabilityComparisonSourceRefSet,
    /// canonical source-set digest，只证明binding identity，不替代refs。
    source_set_digest: SandboxSourceDigest,
    /// 本row覆盖的truth cursor。
    truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
    /// 本row覆盖的reference cursor。
    reference_cursor: SandboxReferenceCursor,
    /// 形成comparison row的既有audit linkage。
    audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    /// immutable row与current binding原子提交时间。
    bound_at: Timestamp,
}

impl BackendCapabilityComparisonViewBinding {
    /// 从已提交comparison row relation构造binding；不生成ref、digest或cursor。
    pub fn try_new(
        view_ref: BackendCapabilityComparisonViewRef,
        context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
        requirement_ref: BoundaryRequirementSetRef,
        capability_summary_refs: BackendCapabilityComparisonSourceRefSet,
        source_set_digest: SandboxSourceDigest,
        truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
        reference_cursor: SandboxReferenceCursor,
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        bound_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, BackendCapabilityComparisonViewError>;

    /// 判断binding是否与exact selector逐字段一致。
    pub fn matches_selector(
        &self,
        selector: &BackendCapabilityComparisonSelector,
    ) -> bool;

    /// 返回current comparison view ref。
    pub fn view_ref(&self) -> &BackendCapabilityComparisonViewRef;
    /// 返回owning context ref。
    pub fn context_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionContextRef;
    /// 返回exact requirement ref。
    pub fn requirement_ref(&self) -> &BoundaryRequirementSetRef;
    /// 返回ordered exact capability summary refs。
    pub fn capability_summary_refs(&self) -> &BackendCapabilityComparisonSourceRefSet;
    /// 返回canonical source-set digest。
    pub fn source_set_digest(&self) -> &SandboxSourceDigest;
    /// 返回truth cursor。
    pub fn truth_cursor(&self) -> SandboxTruthCursor;
    /// 返回reference cursor。
    pub fn reference_cursor(&self) -> SandboxReferenceCursor;
    /// 返回既有audit linkage。
    pub fn audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;
    /// 返回binding提交时间。
    pub fn bound_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
}
```

#### 16.9.3 Explicit absence proof与cardinality

selector要求`capability_summary_refs`非空，因此`Empty`不表示“没有backend”或“summary缺失”。只有formal current
binding index在同一完整snapshot证明exact key的current binding count为`0`，且该exact key从未留下任何immutable
comparison row，才能返回`Empty`。replacement会保留同一exact key的历史immutable rows，因此current读取必须分别证明
“唯一current binding”“binding精确指向的一条target row”和“该key下可能存在的历史row总数”，不能把三者压成一个
`comparison_row_count`。任一index unavailable、partial、duplicate或row decode失败都不能冒充absence。

```rust
/// 证明exact comparison selector尚无binding与materialized row的完整索引结果。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct BackendCapabilityComparisonAbsenceProof {
    /// proof评估的exact selector。
    selector: BackendCapabilityComparisonSelector,
    /// exact current binding count；合法absence固定为零。
    current_binding_count: u32,
    /// exact key下current与historical immutable rows总数；合法absence固定为零。
    total_rows_for_exact_key: u32,
    /// proof读取的truth cursor。
    truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
    /// proof读取的reference cursor。
    reference_cursor: SandboxReferenceCursor,
    /// complete index snapshot已有的source/index audit linkage；不是本次query追加的audit。
    source_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    /// proof完成时间。
    observed_at: Timestamp,
}

impl BackendCapabilityComparisonAbsenceProof {
    /// 仅从同一complete index snapshot的current-binding与exact-key-row双零结果构造absence proof。
    pub fn try_new(
        selector: BackendCapabilityComparisonSelector,
        current_binding_count: u32,
        total_rows_for_exact_key: u32,
        truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
        reference_cursor: SandboxReferenceCursor,
        source_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        observed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, BackendCapabilityComparisonViewError>;

    /// 返回proof对应的selector。
    pub fn selector(&self) -> &BackendCapabilityComparisonSelector;
    /// 返回固定为零的exact current binding count。
    pub fn current_binding_count(&self) -> u32;
    /// 返回固定为零的exact-key immutable row总数。
    pub fn total_rows_for_exact_key(&self) -> u32;
    /// 返回truth cursor。
    pub fn truth_cursor(&self) -> SandboxTruthCursor;
    /// 返回reference cursor。
    pub fn reference_cursor(&self) -> SandboxReferenceCursor;
    /// 返回complete index snapshot已有的audit linkage。
    pub fn source_audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;
    /// 返回proof observation time。
    pub fn observed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
}
```

`source_audit_trace_ref`必须来自能够证明该exact-key index snapshot的既有owner linkage，且与proof的selector、双cursor和
`observed_at`相容；它不得由query创建，也不得指向一次read trace、diagnostic span或view-specific business audit。若
repository只能给出两个零计数但无法给出该linkage，reader必须返回typed unavailable/integrity结果，不能构造proof。

合法cardinality固定如下；`binding_target_row_count`只统计current binding的exact `view_ref`命中的row，不统计同key历史
rows：

| current binding count | binding target row count | total rows for exact key | outcome | rule |
|---:|---:|---:|---|---|
| 0 | n/a | 0 | `ExactAbsent` | 只能在access-approved complete snapshot构造absence proof |
| 1 | 1 | >=1 | 继续source assembly | binding、target row ref、selector、source digest、双cursor必须exact一致；其余同key rows仅为historical |
| 0 | n/a | >0 | integrity / reconciliation | 同key历史或orphan row存在，不能回退为Empty或由query重绑 |
| 1 | 0 | >=0 | integrity error | binding target缺失或half-commit，不能现场重建comparison |
| 1 | >1 | >=2 | integrity error | 同一binding target ref命中重复row，不能选择任意一条 |
| >1 | 任意 | 任意 | integrity error | exact key违反single-current invariant，不允许timestamp/ref/latest winner |

即使`total_rows_for_exact_key > 1`，只要唯一current binding精确命中唯一target row且relation完整，current读取仍然合法。
历史row不得参与current选择，也不得改变surface status。反之，`current_binding_count == 0`但同key历史row仍存在时，
reader必须进入integrity / reconciliation路径；absence proof不能只检查current index后把它误判为Empty。

#### 16.9.4 十维comparison item与finite verdict

view逐backend、逐`BoundaryLimitKind`保存十项body-free comparison item。item只复制已提交
`BoundaryCapabilityVerdict`的finite verdict、safe proof summary或safe reason，不复制exact requirement value、
adapter response、backend product feature flag或host detail。

```rust
/// Public comparison中一个boundary dimension的有限结论。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum BackendCapabilityComparisonVerdict {
    /// 已提交capability snapshot对exact requirement给出可验证支持。
    Supported,
    /// 已提交capability snapshot明确不支持exact requirement。
    Unsupported,
    /// 已提交snapshot无法形成支持或不支持的可验证结论。
    Unknown,
}

/// 一个backend snapshot相对exact requirement某一维度的body-free comparison item。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct BackendCapabilityComparisonItem {
    /// 本item唯一评估的canonical boundary dimension。
    limit_kind: BoundaryLimitKind,
    /// 从domain verdict机械映射的public finite verdict。
    verdict: BackendCapabilityComparisonVerdict,
    /// Supported / Unsupported时来自IsolationBackend的body-free proof summary。
    proof_summary_ref: Option<SafeSummaryRef>,
    /// Unsupported / Unknown时caller-safe reason；Supported固定为None。
    reason: Option<SandboxReason>,
}

impl BackendCapabilityComparisonItem {
    /// 从checked Supported verdict构造item；必须有proof且不得带reason。
    pub fn supported(
        limit_kind: BoundaryLimitKind,
        proof_summary_ref: SafeSummaryRef,
    ) -> Result<Self, BackendCapabilityComparisonViewError>;

    /// 从checked Unsupported verdict构造item；必须同时有proof与safe reason。
    pub fn unsupported(
        limit_kind: BoundaryLimitKind,
        proof_summary_ref: SafeSummaryRef,
        reason: SandboxReason,
    ) -> Result<Self, BackendCapabilityComparisonViewError>;

    /// 从checked Unknown verdict构造item；不得伪造proof且必须有safe reason。
    pub fn unknown(
        limit_kind: BoundaryLimitKind,
        reason: SandboxReason,
    ) -> Result<Self, BackendCapabilityComparisonViewError>;

    /// 返回canonical comparison dimension。
    pub fn limit_kind(&self) -> BoundaryLimitKind;
    /// 返回finite public verdict。
    pub fn verdict(&self) -> BackendCapabilityComparisonVerdict;
    /// 返回optional body-free proof summary。
    pub fn proof_summary_ref(&self) -> Option<&SafeSummaryRef>;
    /// 返回optional caller-safe reason。
    pub fn reason(&self) -> Option<&SandboxReason>;
    /// 判断本维度是否明确supported。
    pub fn is_supported(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断本维度是否明确unsupported。
    pub fn is_unsupported(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断本维度是否unknown且必须fail closed。
    pub fn is_unknown(&self) -> bool;
}
```

`BackendCapabilityComparisonVerdict`不是persisted state owner，只是从`BoundaryCapabilityVerdictKind`逐项机械映射的
contracts enum。它不提供`PartialOrd`，不得按`Supported > Unknown > Unsupported`排序或聚合；aggregate必须使用本节
明确的保守规则。`SandboxReason`沿用`S6T-SH-001` canonical shared carrier；不得退化为`String`、raw adapter
error或新的reason ref。

#### 16.9.5 Per-backend snapshot与十维完整性

comparison必须保留每一个selected capability summary的独立身份、canonical status、generation、双cursor、评估时间、
十维item和item计数。多个backend不能先合并成一个bool或一个kind set再进入view；否则无法解释“backend A支持而
backend B unknown”的结果，也无法在source refresh时识别哪一项过期。

```rust
/// 一个selected backend capability summary相对exact requirement的body-free comparison row。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct BackendCapabilityComparisonBackendRow {
    /// 产生本row的immutable backend capability summary。
    capability_summary_ref: BackendCapabilitySummaryRef,
    /// 本summary绑定的backend body-free source identity。
    backend_ref: ExternalSourceRef,
    /// 跟踪该backend capability source的long-lived reference state。
    reference_state_ref: ReferenceResolutionStateRef,
    /// reference state的canonical source disposition。
    reference_status: ReferenceResolutionStateStatus,
   /// summary的canonical persisted status。
   capability_status: BackendCapabilitySummaryStatus,
    /// summary status对应的caller-safe原因；Fresh固定为None，其他status必须由summary source提供。
    capability_status_reason: Option<SandboxReason>,
   /// summary评估的requirement identity，必须与selector相等。
   requirement_ref: BoundaryRequirementSetRef,
    /// summary与requirement共用的generation identity。
    generation_ref: ResourceRef,
    /// 十项按BoundaryLimitKind canonical顺序排列的comparison item。
    items: Vec<BackendCapabilityComparisonItem>,
    /// 明确Supported item数量，范围固定为0..=10。
    supported_count: u8,
    /// 明确Unsupported item数量，范围固定为0..=10。
    unsupported_count: u8,
    /// Unknown item数量，范围固定为0..=10。
    unknown_count: u8,
    /// summary对应的truth cursor。
    truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
    /// summary对应的reference cursor。
    reference_cursor: SandboxReferenceCursor,
    /// summary checked time。
    checked_at: Timestamp,
    /// reference-state 已提交 observation 的 source audit linkage。
    source_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
}

impl BackendCapabilityComparisonBackendRow {
    /// 从同一checked summary source构造per-backend row；不重新评估requirement。
    pub fn try_new(
        capability_summary_ref: BackendCapabilitySummaryRef,
        backend_ref: ExternalSourceRef,
        reference_state_ref: ReferenceResolutionStateRef,
       reference_status: ReferenceResolutionStateStatus,
       capability_status: BackendCapabilitySummaryStatus,
        capability_status_reason: Option<SandboxReason>,
       requirement_ref: BoundaryRequirementSetRef,
       generation_ref: ResourceRef,
        items: Vec<BackendCapabilityComparisonItem>,
        truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
        reference_cursor: SandboxReferenceCursor,
        checked_at: Timestamp,
        source_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    ) -> Result<Self, BackendCapabilityComparisonViewError>;

    /// 返回capability summary ref。
    pub fn capability_summary_ref(&self) -> &BackendCapabilitySummaryRef;
    /// 返回backend body-free source ref。
    pub fn backend_ref(&self) -> &ExternalSourceRef;
    /// 返回tracked reference state ref。
    pub fn reference_state_ref(&self) -> &ReferenceResolutionStateRef;
    /// 返回reference state canonical status。
    pub fn reference_status(&self) -> ReferenceResolutionStateStatus;
   /// 返回summary canonical status。
   pub fn capability_status(&self) -> BackendCapabilitySummaryStatus;
    /// 返回summary status的caller-safe原因。
    pub fn capability_status_reason(&self) -> Option<&SandboxReason>;
   /// 返回summary requirement ref。
   pub fn requirement_ref(&self) -> &BoundaryRequirementSetRef;
    /// 返回requirement generation ref。
    pub fn generation_ref(&self) -> &ResourceRef;
    /// 返回十项canonical comparison item。
    pub fn items(&self) -> &[BackendCapabilityComparisonItem];
    /// 返回Supported item数量。
    pub fn supported_count(&self) -> u8;
    /// 返回Unsupported item数量。
    pub fn unsupported_count(&self) -> u8;
    /// 返回Unknown item数量。
    pub fn unknown_count(&self) -> u8;
    /// 返回truth cursor。
    pub fn truth_cursor(&self) -> SandboxTruthCursor;
    /// 返回reference cursor。
    pub fn reference_cursor(&self) -> SandboxReferenceCursor;
    /// 返回capability checked time。
    pub fn checked_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
    /// 返回既有source audit linkage。
    pub fn source_audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;

    /// 判断十维item是否全部Supported。
    pub fn is_fully_supported(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断是否存在至少一项明确Unsupported。
    pub fn has_unsupported(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断是否存在Unknown。
    pub fn has_unknown(&self) -> bool;
}
```

`try_new`的机械校验固定为：`backend_ref.source_kind == IsolationBackend`；summary status、item verdict和
`supported/unsupported/unknown_count`完全一致；items恰好覆盖十个`BoundaryLimitKind`且按canonical顺序唯一；
每项的proof/reason关系与`6R-02 BoundaryCapabilityVerdict`一致；summary requirement ref等于传入requirement；
generation、truth cursor、reference cursor和checked time来自同一个source snapshot。它不调用repository、不读取
requirement body、不调用backend adapter。
`capability_status_reason`必须与`BackendCapabilitySummary.status_reason()`逐字段相等；`Fresh`必须为`None`，
`Stale | Unknown | Unsupported`必须为`Some`，且不得把该reason复制进每个Supported item。

`capability_status`与十维item关系固定：

| summary status | item relation | comparison row处理 |
|---|---|---|
| `Fresh` | 十维complete且全部Supported | 保留Fresh；只有Fresh且全部Supported才可参与`FullySupported` |
| `Stale` | 十维complete；任意finite verdict允许 | 保留Stale；不得把旧结论升级为current launch capability |
| `Unsupported` | 至少一项Unsupported；不得全部Supported | 保留Unsupported；必须保留不支持维度 |
| `Unknown` | 至少一项Unknown；Unknown不得携带proof | 保留Unknown；不得降级为Unsupported或Supported |

该status是`BackendCapabilitySummaryStatus`唯一owner。comparison view可以按多个row形成aggregate，但不得生成
另一个persisted capability status或修改summary status。

#### 16.9.6 Aggregate comparison status与保守规则

aggregate status只描述本次selected source集合的可读比较结果，不描述boundary establishment。它是view内的finite
read classification，不是新的状态机；每次从checked rows机械派生，不能被query写回。

```rust
/// 多个selected backend row的body-free aggregate comparison结论。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum BackendCapabilityComparisonStatus {
    /// 所有selected row均Fresh且十维全部Supported，且source relation完整。
    FullySupported,
    /// 至少一个selected row包含明确Unsupported，但不存在Unknown或读取缺口。
    Unsupported,
    /// 至少一个selected row包含Unknown，或summary canonical status为Unknown。
    Unknown,
    /// source存在但至少一个selected row为Stale，且没有更高优先级Unknown/Unsupported。
    Stale,
    /// source存在且可解释，但仅有部分comparison row完成或当前source coverage不完整。
    Degraded,
    /// source已被完整读取但无法形成comparison结论，或所有selected row均Unavailable。
    Unavailable,
}

impl BackendCapabilityComparisonStatus {
    /// 判断aggregate是否表示全部selected backend可支持exact requirement。
    pub fn is_fully_supported(self) -> bool;
    /// 判断aggregate是否包含明确Unsupported。
    pub fn is_unsupported(self) -> bool;
    /// 判断aggregate是否包含Unknown并必须fail closed。
    pub fn is_unknown(self) -> bool;
    /// 判断aggregate是否为source freshness问题。
    pub fn is_stale(self) -> bool;
    /// 判断aggregate是否为读取完整性降级。
    pub fn is_degraded(self) -> bool;
    /// 判断aggregate是否没有可用comparison source。
    pub fn is_unavailable(self) -> bool;
}
```

aggregate precedence和必要条件固定为：

1. 任一typed integrity error直接返回error，不构造aggregate。
2. 任一row有`Unknown`或summary status `Unknown`，aggregate为`Unknown`；Unknown不能被Unsupported覆盖。
3. 没有Unknown时，任一row有明确`Unsupported`或summary status `Unsupported`，aggregate为`Unsupported`。
4. 没有Unknown/Unsupported时，若所有row均`Fresh + fully_supported`，aggregate为`FullySupported`。
5. 没有上述结论时，若至少一个row为`Stale`且所有source row仍完整可读，aggregate为`Stale`。
6. 若source row存在但有唯一允许的`CurrentCapabilityCoverage` gap，aggregate仍按完整row的canonical status机械派生，
   只把公共query surface映射为`SandboxQuerySurfaceStatus::Degraded`并产生view；该gap不能改写已有row或aggregate的
   canonical comparison status。因而一个带该gap的source可以同时保留`FullySupported`、`Unsupported`、`Unknown`或
   `Stale`的comparison status。
7. 若requirement、binding、comparison row、capability source或source relation缺失，aggregate为`Unavailable`且
   不产生view；不能用旧row、empty item或`FullySupported`替代。

`Degraded`和`Unavailable`保留在`BackendCapabilityComparisonStatus`闭集内，用于source classifier与防御性边界表达，
但不是可持久化的第二状态机，也不是final view可接受的aggregate值：`Degraded`必须通过typed
`CurrentCapabilityCoverage` gap映射到公共surface，`Unavailable`必须通过no-view outcome返回。final factory收到这两
个值时返回`UnsupportedAggregateForView`，避免把surface status倒灌为comparison truth。

`Unsupported`与`Unknown`都保持fail-closed，但语义不同：Unsupported是已验证不满足，Unknown是无法证明。它们不
   进入`SandboxFailureClassification`，不改变`BoundaryEstablishmentDecision`，也不触发cleanup/reaper。

#### 16.9.7 Dual cursor、generation与freshness relation

comparison必须同时保存truth cursor和reference cursor。truth cursor说明本地requirement/boundary truth读取水位；
reference cursor说明外部backend capability snapshot读取水位。二者不能合并为core `Version`，也不能用timestamp替代。

```rust
/// comparison source的双cursor关系证明。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct BackendCapabilityComparisonCursorRelation {
    /// requirement / local boundary truth cursor。
    truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
    /// backend capability reference cursor。
    reference_cursor: SandboxReferenceCursor,
    /// source relation observation time。
    observed_at: Timestamp,
    /// 本次比较使用的requirement generation。
    requirement_generation_ref: ResourceRef,
}

impl BackendCapabilityComparisonCursorRelation {
    /// 从同一checked source snapshot构造cursor relation。
    pub fn try_new(
        truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
        reference_cursor: SandboxReferenceCursor,
        observed_at: Timestamp,
        requirement_generation_ref: ResourceRef,
    ) -> Result<Self, BackendCapabilityComparisonViewError>;

    /// 返回truth cursor。
    pub fn truth_cursor(&self) -> SandboxTruthCursor;
    /// 返回reference cursor。
    pub fn reference_cursor(&self) -> SandboxReferenceCursor;
    /// 返回observation time。
    pub fn observed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
    /// 返回requirement generation。
    pub fn requirement_generation_ref(&self) -> &ResourceRef;

    /// 判断candidate row是否与本次comparison relation同构。
    pub fn matches_row(
        &self,
        row: &BackendCapabilityComparisonBackendRow,
    ) -> bool;
}
```

`Fresh`只表示各source snapshot自身通过其canonical freshness window；它不自动表示comparison整体
`FullySupported`。整体`FullySupported`还要求：每个selected row的requirement ref、generation、truth/reference cursor
与selector/source relation一致，十维均Supported，且没有typed gap。外部summary `Stale`不得因query observation
时间较新而变Fresh；reference cursor前进但source未重建时只能形成新的comparison row或Degraded/Unavailable，不能
原地更新旧row。

#### 16.9.8 Typed read gap与public surface

read gap必须区分“comparison source没有形成”“当前source coverage不完整”“本地/外部读取不可用”和“数据已损坏”。
gap不是`BackendCapabilityComparisonStatus`的替代enum，也不能把canonical Unsupported/Unknown改写成技术错误。

```rust
/// comparison read assembly可以分类的closed source gap kind。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
pub enum BackendCapabilityComparisonReadGapKind {
    /// exact requirement source无法读取或缺少。
    RequirementSource,
    /// exact current comparison binding无法读取或无法唯一判定。
    ComparisonBinding,
    /// current immutable comparison row缺失或不可读取。
    ComparisonRow,
    /// selected capability summary或tracked reference source缺失或不可读取。
    CapabilitySource,
    /// truth/reference cursor覆盖不足，但已有完整row仍可安全展示。
    CurrentCapabilityCoverage,
    /// source relation存在不一致，不能安全展示。
    SourceRelation,
}

impl BackendCapabilityComparisonReadGapKind {
    /// 判断该kind是否是唯一允许构造带view的Degraded surface。
    pub fn permits_degraded_view(self) -> bool;
    /// 判断该kind是否必须返回Unavailable/no-view。
    pub fn requires_unavailable_no_view(self) -> bool;
}

/// 一个exact comparison selector上的typed source gap。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct BackendCapabilityComparisonReadGap {
    /// gap适用的access-approved exact selector。
    selector: BackendCapabilityComparisonSelector,
    /// 缺失dependency的closed kind。
    gap_kind: BackendCapabilityComparisonReadGapKind,
    /// 读取必须覆盖到的truth watermark；无可证明要求时为None。
    required_truth_cursor: Option<SandboxTruthCursor>,
    /// reader能够证明的truth watermark；完全不可用时为None。
    available_truth_cursor: Option<SandboxTruthCursor>,
    /// 读取必须覆盖到的reference watermark；无可证明要求时为None。
    required_reference_cursor: Option<SandboxReferenceCursor>,
    /// reader能够证明的reference watermark；完全不可用时为None。
    available_reference_cursor: Option<SandboxReferenceCursor>,
    /// owner-approved、caller-safe的唯一gap reason。
    reason: SandboxReason,
}

impl BackendCapabilityComparisonReadGap {
    /// 从formal reader disposition构造gap；caller不得任意改写kind或cursor关系。
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    pub fn try_from_reader_disposition(
        selector: BackendCapabilityComparisonSelector,
        gap_kind: BackendCapabilityComparisonReadGapKind,
        required_truth_cursor: Option<SandboxTruthCursor>,
        available_truth_cursor: Option<SandboxTruthCursor>,
        required_reference_cursor: Option<SandboxReferenceCursor>,
        available_reference_cursor: Option<SandboxReferenceCursor>,
        reason: SandboxReason,
    ) -> Result<Self, BackendCapabilityComparisonViewError>;

    /// 返回gap适用的exact selector。
    pub fn selector(&self) -> &BackendCapabilityComparisonSelector;
    /// 返回gap kind。
    pub fn gap_kind(&self) -> BackendCapabilityComparisonReadGapKind;
    /// 返回optional required truth cursor。
    pub fn required_truth_cursor(&self) -> Option<SandboxTruthCursor>;
    /// 返回optional available truth cursor。
    pub fn available_truth_cursor(&self) -> Option<SandboxTruthCursor>;
    /// 返回optional required reference cursor。
    pub fn required_reference_cursor(&self) -> Option<SandboxReferenceCursor>;
    /// 返回optional available reference cursor。
    pub fn available_reference_cursor(&self) -> Option<SandboxReferenceCursor>;
    /// 返回caller-safe reason。
    pub fn reason(&self) -> &SandboxReason;
}

/// 非空、canonical ordered-unique的comparison read gap集合。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct BackendCapabilityComparisonReadGapSet(
    Vec<BackendCapabilityComparisonReadGap>,
);

impl BackendCapabilityComparisonReadGapSet {
    /// 构造非空gap set；kind、safe reason、selector和canonical order必须闭合。
    pub fn try_new(
        gaps: Vec<BackendCapabilityComparisonReadGap>,
    ) -> Result<Self, BackendCapabilityComparisonViewError>;
    /// 返回immutable gap slice。
    pub fn as_slice(&self) -> &[BackendCapabilityComparisonReadGap];
    /// 判断是否包含指定gap kind。
    pub fn contains(&self, kind: BackendCapabilityComparisonReadGapKind) -> bool;
    /// 判断该集合是否只包含唯一CurrentCapabilityCoverage gap。
    pub fn is_current_capability_coverage_only(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断该集合是否全部要求Unavailable/no-view。
    pub fn requires_unavailable_no_view(&self) -> bool;
    /// 将typed gap reason按同一稳定顺序一一映射为shared degraded reasons。
    pub fn to_degraded_reasons(
        &self,
    ) -> Result<StatusViewDegradedReasonSet, BackendCapabilityComparisonViewError>;
}
```

`BackendCapabilityComparisonReadSurface`不再作为current type。comparison只提供纯映射方法，最终公共surface复用
shared registry中唯一的`SandboxQuerySurfaceStatus` owner：`CurrentCapabilityCoverage`映射为
`SandboxQuerySurfaceStatus::Degraded`并允许携带view；完整source根据canonical comparison status映射为
`Visible`或`Stale`；`RequirementSource`、`ComparisonBinding`、`ComparisonRow`、`CapabilitySource`、
`SourceRelation`映射为`Unavailable`且不携带view。`NotVisible`、`Restricted`和`Empty`由application的access /
existence policy决定，不能由comparison view猜测。多gap、同类重复gap、gap与完整`FullySupported`同时出现、或
`SourceRelation`与旧row可拼接时，返回typed integrity error，不退化展示。

```rust
/// comparison source读取结果的纯surface映射，不是新的状态owner。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct BackendCapabilityComparisonReadSurfaceMapping {
    /// 唯一公共query surface status；由shared `SandboxQuerySurfaceStatus`承载。
    surface_status: SandboxQuerySurfaceStatus,
    /// 可见view是否允许出现在response中。
    view_allowed: bool,
    /// 由checked gap逐项投影的caller-safe原因；完整source为None。
    degraded_reasons: Option<StatusViewDegradedReasonSet>,
}

impl BackendCapabilityComparisonReadSurfaceMapping {
    /// 从完整source status构造Visible或Stale映射；不接受caller覆盖。
    pub fn complete(
        comparison_status: BackendCapabilityComparisonStatus,
    ) -> Result<Self, BackendCapabilityComparisonViewError>;
    /// 从唯一CurrentCapabilityCoverage gap set构造Degraded映射并机械生成reason。
    pub fn degraded(
        read_gaps: BackendCapabilityComparisonReadGapSet,
    ) -> Result<Self, BackendCapabilityComparisonViewError>;
    /// 从全部要求no-view的gap set构造Unavailable映射。
    pub fn unavailable(
        read_gaps: BackendCapabilityComparisonReadGapSet,
    ) -> Result<Self, BackendCapabilityComparisonViewError>;
    /// 返回公共query surface status。
    pub fn surface_status(&self) -> SandboxQuerySurfaceStatus;
    /// 判断是否允许携带comparison view。
    pub fn view_allowed(&self) -> bool;
    /// 返回可选degraded reasons。
    pub fn degraded_reasons(&self) -> Option<&StatusViewDegradedReasonSet>;
}
```

`BackendCapabilityComparisonReadGapSet`必须满足以下不变量：非空；所有gap的selector逐字段全等；每个
`gap_kind`至多一项；不同gap的safe reason不同；按照`RequirementSource -> ComparisonBinding -> ComparisonRow
-> CapabilitySource -> CurrentCapabilityCoverage -> SourceRelation`的声明顺序保存；同一source family的
`available_*_cursor`若存在则严格早于对应`required_*_cursor`，没有required cursor时不得出现available cursor。
`CurrentCapabilityCoverage`必须至少有一个required/available cursor pair，且只能与完整requirement、binding、row、
reference source和audit linkage共同构成degraded source。其它kind只能构成no-view outcome。`to_degraded_reasons()`
只做一一、同序、同值映射；它不把技术错误、canonical Unsupported/Unknown或visibility decision转成reason。
`StatusViewDegradedReasonSet`只保存caller-safe `SandboxReason`，不保存summary正文、requirement值、backend detail、
host locator或adapter error。

#### 16.9.9 Contracts-only source snapshots与selection proof

final view不得直接接收`BoundaryRequirementSet`、`ReferenceResolutionState`或`BackendCapabilitySummary` domain
object；contracts层只接收由application在同一公平read snapshot中机械复制的body-free read snapshot。这样可以保持
`contracts -> domain`依赖为零，并让每个comparison字段有可追溯来源。

```rust
/// exact requirement source的contracts-only read snapshot。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct BackendCapabilityComparisonRequirementSourceSnapshot {
    /// immutable requirement identity。
    requirement_ref: BoundaryRequirementSetRef,
    /// requirement所属context，必须与selector相等。
    context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
    /// requirement与capability必须共同使用的generation。
    generation_ref: ResourceRef,
    /// requirement source的truth watermark。
    truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
    /// requirement建立时间。
    created_at: Timestamp,
}

impl BackendCapabilityComparisonRequirementSourceSnapshot {
    /// 从已加载的requirement truth与同一read watermark构造snapshot。
    pub fn try_new(
        requirement_ref: BoundaryRequirementSetRef,
        context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
        generation_ref: ResourceRef,
        truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
        created_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, BackendCapabilityComparisonViewError>;

    /// 返回requirement ref。
    pub fn requirement_ref(&self) -> &BoundaryRequirementSetRef;
    /// 返回owning context ref。
    pub fn context_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionContextRef;
    /// 返回canonical generation。
    pub fn generation_ref(&self) -> &ResourceRef;
    /// 返回truth cursor。
    pub fn truth_cursor(&self) -> SandboxTruthCursor;
    /// 返回requirement created time。
    pub fn created_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
}

/// 一个capability summary与long-lived reference state的checked body-free source relation。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct BackendCapabilityComparisonReferenceSourceSnapshot {
    /// exact capability summary identity。
    capability_summary_ref: BackendCapabilitySummaryRef,
    /// 跟踪backend source的reference state identity。
    reference_state_ref: ReferenceResolutionStateRef,
    /// reference state的canonical resolution status。
    reference_status: ReferenceResolutionStateStatus,
    /// reference state当前观察到的backend source。
    backend_ref: ExternalSourceRef,
    /// source当前可选的safe summary；不保存summary正文。
    safe_summary_ref: Option<SafeSummaryRef>,
    /// reference mutation已提交的reference cursor。
    reference_cursor: SandboxReferenceCursor,
    /// reference state最近一次transition的audit linkage。
    source_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    /// reference source observation time。
    observed_at: Timestamp,
}

impl BackendCapabilityComparisonReferenceSourceSnapshot {
    /// 从同一read watermark复制reference state与mutation metadata；不调用resolver。
    pub fn try_new(
        capability_summary_ref: BackendCapabilitySummaryRef,
        reference_state_ref: ReferenceResolutionStateRef,
        reference_status: ReferenceResolutionStateStatus,
        backend_ref: ExternalSourceRef,
        safe_summary_ref: Option<SafeSummaryRef>,
        reference_cursor: SandboxReferenceCursor,
        source_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        observed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, BackendCapabilityComparisonViewError>;

    /// 返回capability summary ref。
    pub fn capability_summary_ref(&self) -> &BackendCapabilitySummaryRef;
    /// 返回tracked reference state ref。
    pub fn reference_state_ref(&self) -> &ReferenceResolutionStateRef;
    /// 返回reference status。
    pub fn reference_status(&self) -> ReferenceResolutionStateStatus;
    /// 返回backend source ref。
    pub fn backend_ref(&self) -> &ExternalSourceRef;
    /// 返回optional safe summary ref。
    pub fn safe_summary_ref(&self) -> Option<&SafeSummaryRef>;
    /// 返回reference cursor。
    pub fn reference_cursor(&self) -> SandboxReferenceCursor;
    /// 返回source transition audit ref。
    pub fn source_audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;
    /// 返回source observation time。
    pub fn observed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
}
```

`BackendCapabilityComparisonReferenceSourceSnapshot::try_new`只验证carrier关系：backend source必须是
`IsolationBackend`；source version唯一来自`backend_ref.source_version_ref()`，不在本snapshot复制第二份字段；safe
summary若存在必须与backend source kind兼容；`reference_cursor`必须来自已提交reference mutation metadata；
`source_audit_trace_ref`必须来自`ReferenceResolutionState.last_audit_trace_ref()`。它不把
`SandboxReferenceCursor`写回reference state，不从timestamp或summary ref推导cursor。

reference status与公开surface的关系固定为：

| reference status | summary row是否可保留 | comparison处理 |
|---|---|---|
| `Resolved` | 是 | 可形成complete source，前提是summary、generation和verdict完整 |
| `Stale` | 可保留last-known | source relation、summary和双cursor完整时可形成完整`Stale` view；仅current coverage不足时加`CurrentCapabilityCoverage` gap |
| `Unresolved` | 否 | `CapabilitySource -> Unavailable/no-view` |
| `Invalid` | 否 | `CapabilitySource -> Unavailable/no-view`；forbidden-body marker不得降级 |
| `Unavailable` | 否 | `CapabilitySource -> Unavailable/no-view`；旧summary不得掩盖当前source不可用 |

```rust
/// 保持selector source顺序、拒绝重复且要求每个row一一对应的backend row set。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct BackendCapabilityComparisonBackendRowSet(
    Vec<BackendCapabilityComparisonBackendRow>,
);

impl BackendCapabilityComparisonBackendRowSet {
    /// 按selector source ref顺序构造row set；缺row、重复row或多余row均拒绝。
    pub fn try_new(
        selector: &BackendCapabilityComparisonSelector,
        rows: Vec<BackendCapabilityComparisonBackendRow>,
    ) -> Result<Self, BackendCapabilityComparisonViewError>;

    /// 返回按selector顺序排列的只读row slice。
    pub fn as_slice(&self) -> &[BackendCapabilityComparisonBackendRow];
    /// 返回selected backend数量；合法实例固定非零。
    pub fn len(&self) -> usize;
    /// 判断row set是否为空；合法实例固定为false。
    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断所有row是否十维fully supported。
    pub fn all_fully_supported(&self) -> bool;
    /// 返回含明确Unsupported的row数量。
    pub fn unsupported_row_count(&self) -> usize;
    /// 返回含Unknown的row数量。
    pub fn unknown_row_count(&self) -> usize;
    /// 返回canonical Stale row数量。
    pub fn stale_row_count(&self) -> usize;
}

/// selector、current binding与source identity的same-snapshot选择证明。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct BackendCapabilityComparisonBindingSelectionProof {
    /// access-approved exact selector。
    selector: BackendCapabilityComparisonSelector,
    /// 与selector exact匹配的current binding。
    binding: BackendCapabilityComparisonViewBinding,
}

impl BackendCapabilityComparisonBindingSelectionProof {
    /// 从已命中的single-current binding构造selection proof。
    pub fn try_new(
        selector: BackendCapabilityComparisonSelector,
        binding: BackendCapabilityComparisonViewBinding,
    ) -> Result<Self, BackendCapabilityComparisonViewError>;

    /// 返回exact selector。
    pub fn selector(&self) -> &BackendCapabilityComparisonSelector;
    /// 返回checked current binding。
    pub fn binding(&self) -> &BackendCapabilityComparisonViewBinding;
    /// 返回current view ref。
    pub fn view_ref(&self) -> &BackendCapabilityComparisonViewRef;
    /// 返回binding truth cursor。
    pub fn truth_cursor(&self) -> SandboxTruthCursor;
    /// 返回binding reference cursor。
    pub fn reference_cursor(&self) -> SandboxReferenceCursor;
}
```

row set只验证ref identity与顺序，不读取summary或reference state；row与source snapshot之间的generation、cursor、status
和safe-summary关系由source factory再次验证。`BackendCapabilityComparisonBindingSelectionProof`不拥有新的状态，
也不允许caller修改binding、替换view ref或重排source refs。

#### 16.9.10 Same-snapshot source assembly与lookup outcome

`BackendCapabilityComparisonSourceSnapshot`是final view唯一允许消费的合成输入。formal reader必须在一个公平read
transaction内依次完成access decision后的exact selector验证、requirement source读取、current binding读取、selected
reference state读取、selected capability summary读取、row assembly和source relation检查。query不能在该过程中调用
backend capability adapter、refresh job、builder或任何写路径。

```rust
/// exact comparison view的一次same-snapshot、body-free source assembly。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct BackendCapabilityComparisonSourceSnapshot {
    /// exact selector与current binding的selection proof。
    selection: BackendCapabilityComparisonBindingSelectionProof,
    /// requirement的contracts-only source snapshot。
    requirement_source: BackendCapabilityComparisonRequirementSourceSnapshot,
    /// 每个selected summary对应的tracked reference source。
    reference_sources: Vec<BackendCapabilityComparisonReferenceSourceSnapshot>,
    /// 按selector顺序排列的per-backend comparison rows。
    rows: BackendCapabilityComparisonBackendRowSet,
    /// requirement与capability source的dual cursor relation。
    cursor_relation: BackendCapabilityComparisonCursorRelation,
    /// 从rows与source relation机械派生的aggregate status。
    comparison_status: BackendCapabilityComparisonStatus,
    /// 完整source为None；只允许CurrentCapabilityCoverage gap时为Some。
    read_gaps: Option<BackendCapabilityComparisonReadGapSet>,
    /// comparison row/binding写入已有的audit linkage。
    comparison_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    /// formal reader完成组装的观察时间。
    observed_at: Timestamp,
}

impl BackendCapabilityComparisonSourceSnapshot {
    /// 构造无typed gap的完整source snapshot。
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    pub fn complete(
        selection: BackendCapabilityComparisonBindingSelectionProof,
        requirement_source: BackendCapabilityComparisonRequirementSourceSnapshot,
        reference_sources: Vec<BackendCapabilityComparisonReferenceSourceSnapshot>,
        rows: BackendCapabilityComparisonBackendRowSet,
        cursor_relation: BackendCapabilityComparisonCursorRelation,
        comparison_status: BackendCapabilityComparisonStatus,
        comparison_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        observed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, BackendCapabilityComparisonViewError>;

    /// 构造只带唯一CurrentCapabilityCoverage gap但仍可展示row的degraded source。
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    pub fn degraded_current_capability_coverage(
        selection: BackendCapabilityComparisonBindingSelectionProof,
        requirement_source: BackendCapabilityComparisonRequirementSourceSnapshot,
        reference_sources: Vec<BackendCapabilityComparisonReferenceSourceSnapshot>,
        rows: BackendCapabilityComparisonBackendRowSet,
        cursor_relation: BackendCapabilityComparisonCursorRelation,
        comparison_status: BackendCapabilityComparisonStatus,
        read_gaps: BackendCapabilityComparisonReadGapSet,
        comparison_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        observed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, BackendCapabilityComparisonViewError>;

    /// 返回selection proof。
    pub fn selection(&self) -> &BackendCapabilityComparisonBindingSelectionProof;
    /// 返回requirement source。
    pub fn requirement_source(&self) -> &BackendCapabilityComparisonRequirementSourceSnapshot;
    /// 返回reference source snapshots。
    pub fn reference_sources(&self) -> &[BackendCapabilityComparisonReferenceSourceSnapshot];
    /// 返回per-backend rows。
    pub fn rows(&self) -> &BackendCapabilityComparisonBackendRowSet;
    /// 返回cursor relation。
    pub fn cursor_relation(&self) -> &BackendCapabilityComparisonCursorRelation;
    /// 返回aggregate status。
    pub fn comparison_status(&self) -> BackendCapabilityComparisonStatus;
    /// 返回optional typed read gaps。
    pub fn read_gaps(&self) -> Option<&BackendCapabilityComparisonReadGapSet>;
    /// 返回comparison mutation audit linkage。
    pub fn comparison_audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;
    /// 返回formal read observation time。
    pub fn observed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
    /// 判断source是否只由CurrentCapabilityCoverage gap降级。
    pub fn is_degraded(&self) -> bool;
}
```

source factory的mandatory relation如下：

1. selection selector、binding和requirement source的context / requirement ref必须逐字段相等。
2. rows必须与selector source refs一一对应；每个row的summary ref、backend ref、reference state ref、requirement ref、
   generation、双cursor和十维items必须与对应reference source及requirement source相容。
3. 每个reference source的`backend_ref`必须等于对应summary source的backend ref；`Resolved`要求summary safe source
   relation完整；`Stale`在source relation完整时可以进入完整last-known row，若current coverage不足则只能通过
   `CurrentCapabilityCoverage`进入degraded source；`Unresolved | Invalid | Unavailable`不能进入row assembly。
4. `cursor_relation.truth_cursor`必须等于requirement source与binding truth cursor；reference cursor必须覆盖所有
   selected reference source且不得由source version或timestamp替代。
5. aggregate status必须由rows、summary canonical status和read gap按§16.9.6机械重算一致；factory不接受caller覆盖后的
   status。
6. complete必须`read_gaps=None`且source statuses全部可完整读取；degraded factory必须恰好一条
   `CurrentCapabilityCoverage` gap，且rows、requirement、binding、reference state和audit linkage仍完整。
7. `observed_at`不得早于selection、requirement、reference source、row、binding、cursor relation和comparison audit的
   committed time；query clock只形成observation time。

```rust
/// exact comparison selector的一次same-snapshot formal reader输出。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum BackendCapabilityComparisonSourceLookupOutcome {
    /// 已形成完整或唯一允许degraded的checked source。
    ViewSource(BackendCapabilityComparisonSourceSnapshot),
    /// exact binding与comparison row index共同证明没有current comparison。
    ExactAbsent(BackendCapabilityComparisonAbsenceProof),
    /// binding或必要source不足以安全形成view body。
    Unavailable {
        /// access-approved exact selector。
        selector: BackendCapabilityComparisonSelector,
        /// 非空typed read gaps。
        read_gaps: BackendCapabilityComparisonReadGapSet,
    },
}

impl BackendCapabilityComparisonSourceLookupOutcome {
    /// 构造可进入final view factory的source outcome。
    pub fn view_source(source: BackendCapabilityComparisonSourceSnapshot) -> Self;
    /// 构造exact absence outcome；proof必须与selector全等。
    pub fn exact_absent(
        selector: &BackendCapabilityComparisonSelector,
        proof: BackendCapabilityComparisonAbsenceProof,
    ) -> Result<Self, BackendCapabilityComparisonViewError>;
    /// 构造不可形成view的typed no-view outcome。
    pub fn unavailable(
        selector: BackendCapabilityComparisonSelector,
        read_gaps: BackendCapabilityComparisonReadGapSet,
    ) -> Result<Self, BackendCapabilityComparisonViewError>;
}
```

lookup precedence固定为：access denial由application先行结束；只有`current_binding_count=0`且
`total_rows_for_exact_key=0`才允许`ExactAbsent`；命中唯一binding后必须由`binding_target_row_count=1`证明current row，
同key其余历史row不参与选择。任何row/source半缺失、binding为零但同key仍有历史row、target重复或relation不等都进入
typed gap或integrity / reconciliation路径，不能回退Empty。selected source set的顺序、summary ref或backend profile
配置不能由reader自行扩展。`CapabilitySource`缺口不能被映为Unknown，因为Unknown必须来自已提交、完整的summary
snapshot。

#### 16.9.11 Typed error surface

`BackendCapabilityComparisonViewError`只承接已经进入contracts mapper的comparison结构关系错误。它不表示一次
repository read失败，也不承接snapshot isolation、access decision、visibility、transport、backend adapter、public
request validation或retry policy。前述运行时结果必须由Step 7~9的application / infrastructure owner分别映为
`BackendCapabilityComparisonSourceLookupOutcome`、`SandboxQuerySurfaceStatus`或public error；contracts error不得让
上层重新解析字符串来决定分支。

```rust
/// backend capability comparison contracts的selector、source、gap、view或materialization关系错误。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum BackendCapabilityComparisonViewError {
    /// required context、requirement或source selector缺失、错型或包含未登记对象。
    SelectorShapeInvalid,
    /// ordered source ref set含空ref、重复成员、错误ref kind或未闭合的typed source关系。
    SourceRefSetInvalid,
    /// source ref set不满足当前配置固定的`1..=16` cardinality。
    SourceRefCardinalityInvalid,
    /// selector中的requirement、context、source成员与已验证source relation不一致。
    SelectorSourceRelationInvalid,
    /// selector与current binding未逐字段全等。
    SelectorBindingMismatch,
    /// current binding不是single-current、缺字段、指向错误immutable row或形成half-commit。
    BindingIntegrityInvalid,
    /// exact absence proof的selector、双零计数、cursor、audit linkage或观察时间关系无效。
    AbsenceProofInvalid,
    /// comparison item的limit kind、finite verdict、proof/reason或canonical order关系无效。
    ComparisonItemInvalid,
    /// 单个backend row的summary、source、status、generation、cursor、item或count关系无效。
    BackendRowIntegrityInvalid,
    /// backend row set为空、重复、漏项、多项或未按selector source顺序排列。
    BackendRowSetInvalid,
    /// summary canonical status与其status reason的presence、kind或安全性关系无效。
    CapabilityStatusReasonInvalid,
    /// requirement contracts-only snapshot与selector、generation、truth cursor或created time关系无效。
    RequirementSourceInvalid,
    /// reference state、backend source、safe summary、reference cursor或source audit关系无效。
    ReferenceSourceInvalid,
    /// truth/reference cursor、generation或source observation的覆盖关系无效。
    CursorRelationInvalid,
    /// rows、summary status、gap和机械聚合结果不一致。
    AggregateStatusMismatch,
    /// 单条read gap的selector、required/available cursor或safe reason关系无效。
    ReadGapRelationInvalid,
    /// gap set为空、重复、乱序、互斥组合或与允许的surface分支不一致。
    ReadGapSetInvalid,
    /// typed gap与shared degraded reason set没有逐项、同序、同值映射。
    ReadGapReasonMappingInvalid,
    /// complete/degraded source缺少形成public view所需的完整field group，或带错gap。
    SourceCompletenessInvalid,
    /// source lookup outcome的selector、absence、source或gap分支不满足closed mapping。
    SourceLookupOutcomeInvalid,
    /// aggregate值只适用于classifier或no-view boundary，不能进入final view。
    UnsupportedAggregateForView {
        /// 被拒绝的防御性aggregate值；合法view只接受complete canonical status。
        status: BackendCapabilityComparisonStatus,
    },
    /// final view ref、binding、immutable row或source lineage关系无效。
    ViewIdentityRelationInvalid,
    /// final view字段未从同一checked source机械复制，或helper与字段不一致。
    ViewFieldRelationInvalid,
    /// comparison status到shared `SandboxQuerySurfaceStatus`的映射关系无效。
    SurfaceMappingInvalid,
    /// source、binding、row、audit、cursor与observed time违反单调时间关系。
    TimestampRelationInvalid,
    /// view或row携带requirement value、backend body、SDK response或其他禁止正文。
    BodyFreeContractViolation,
    /// candidate materialization与current binding replacement的identity/version relation冲突。
    MaterializationConflict,
}
```

error owner与运行时分支必须按以下矩阵保持分离：

| 已观察条件 | comparison contracts结果 | 负责的后续映射 | 禁止替代 |
|---|---|---|---|
| selector或source set违反shape/cardinality | 对应typed error | application request validation | 将空selector当作`Empty` |
| exact index在同一完整snapshot得到current binding=0、exact-key total rows=0 | `ExactAbsent` proof | application existence mapper -> `Empty` | repository `None`或只读current index直接推断absence |
| index或必要source当前不可完整读取 | `Unavailable` + typed gap | application surface/error mapper | 旧row、latest scan、`Unknown`或`Empty` |
| 已有完整row但current capability coverage不足 | `ViewSource` + 唯一`CurrentCapabilityCoverage` gap | shared surface -> `Degraded` | 改写row status或丢弃last-known row |
| committed row已明确Unsupported / Unknown / Stale | complete source + canonical aggregate | normal visible/stale mapper | 把业务结论包装成技术error |
| committed data已损坏、重复或half-commit | typed integrity error | internal corruption / reconciliation owner | 降级成caller-safe gap继续展示 |
| access denied、NotVisible、Restricted或协议错误 | 不进入本error owner | application / protocol owner | comparison factory猜测资源存在性 |

本enum的payload只允许本节已经登记的closed enum；不得携带SQL、table/key、raw row、SDK/HTTP/IO cause、backend
target、host/path/PID、endpoint、credential、page token、query trace、adapter response或external body。
`SandboxReason`只能作为已校验source/gap/view字段的一部分被复制，不能作为自由文本error让application重新解析。
`MaterializationConflict`只表示contracts候选的identity/version关系冲突；真正的数据库冲突、serialization failure和
commit-unknown仍由writer/application owner返回，不得伪装成该enum的可重试语义。

#### 16.9.12 Final `BackendCapabilityComparisonView`

`BackendCapabilityComparisonView`是exact selector命中的current immutable、body-free comparison read model。它只
从一个已通过same-snapshot校验的`BackendCapabilityComparisonSourceSnapshot`构造；不接收caller单独传入的status、
rows、cursor、reason、digest或view ref，也不拥有任何transition、refresh、backend call、boundary establishment或
execution launch能力。`view_ref`始终来自current binding指向的immutable comparison row；query不得生成新的identity。

```rust
/// 一个exact requirement与selected capability summaries的body-free committed comparison view。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct BackendCapabilityComparisonView {
    /// current immutable comparison row与binding共同提交的view identity。
    view_ref: BackendCapabilityComparisonViewRef,
    /// comparison唯一归属的owning execution context。
    context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
    /// 本次比较使用的exact immutable requirement set。
    requirement_ref: BoundaryRequirementSetRef,
    /// caller明确选择且binding证明的ordered capability summary refs。
    capability_summary_refs: BackendCapabilityComparisonSourceRefSet,
    /// canonical source-set digest；只用于materialization identity，不替代typed refs。
    source_set_digest: SandboxSourceDigest,
    /// requirement与所有row共同使用的canonical generation。
    requirement_generation_ref: ResourceRef,
    /// requirement source的committed creation time。
    requirement_created_at: Timestamp,
    /// 按selector source顺序排列的per-backend comparison rows。
    rows: BackendCapabilityComparisonBackendRowSet,
    /// 从checked rows和source relation机械派生的aggregate comparison status。
    comparison_status: BackendCapabilityComparisonStatus,
    /// local requirement truth覆盖水位。
    truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
    /// external capability reference覆盖水位。
    reference_cursor: SandboxReferenceCursor,
    /// comparison immutable row/binding materialization已有的audit linkage。
    comparison_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    /// 仅由唯一CurrentCapabilityCoverage gap映射的caller-safe reasons。
    degraded_reasons: Option<StatusViewDegradedReasonSet>,
    /// formal reader完成same-snapshot assembly的观察时间。
    observed_at: Timestamp,
}

impl BackendCapabilityComparisonView {
    /// 从无gap、完整且relation-checked source复制current view字段。
    pub fn from_committed_snapshot(
        source: BackendCapabilityComparisonSourceSnapshot,
    ) -> Result<Self, BackendCapabilityComparisonViewError>;

    /// 从只带唯一CurrentCapabilityCoverage gap的source复制degraded view字段。
    pub fn from_degraded_snapshot(
        source: BackendCapabilityComparisonSourceSnapshot,
    ) -> Result<Self, BackendCapabilityComparisonViewError>;

    /// 返回current immutable comparison view identity。
    pub fn view_ref(&self) -> &BackendCapabilityComparisonViewRef;
    /// 返回owning context。
    pub fn context_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionContextRef;
    /// 返回exact requirement identity。
    pub fn requirement_ref(&self) -> &BoundaryRequirementSetRef;
    /// 返回ordered selected capability summary refs。
    pub fn capability_summary_refs(&self) -> &BackendCapabilityComparisonSourceRefSet;
    /// 返回canonical source-set digest。
    pub fn source_set_digest(&self) -> &SandboxSourceDigest;
    /// 返回requirement generation。
    pub fn requirement_generation_ref(&self) -> &ResourceRef;
    /// 返回requirement creation time。
    pub fn requirement_created_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
    /// 返回按selector顺序排列的backend rows。
    pub fn rows(&self) -> &BackendCapabilityComparisonBackendRowSet;
    /// 返回机械派生的aggregate comparison status。
    pub fn comparison_status(&self) -> BackendCapabilityComparisonStatus;
    /// 返回local truth cursor。
    pub fn truth_cursor(&self) -> SandboxTruthCursor;
    /// 返回external reference cursor。
    pub fn reference_cursor(&self) -> SandboxReferenceCursor;
    /// 返回既有comparison materialization audit linkage。
    pub fn comparison_audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;
    /// 返回optional caller-safe degraded reasons。
    pub fn degraded_reasons(&self) -> Option<&StatusViewDegradedReasonSet>;
    /// 返回formal reader observation time。
    pub fn observed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;

    /// 将comparison view映射到唯一shared public query surface status。
    pub fn surface_status(&self) -> SandboxQuerySurfaceStatus;
    /// 判断view是否只因CurrentCapabilityCoverage gap而显式降级。
    pub fn is_degraded(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断所有selected rows均Fresh且十维Supported。
    pub fn is_fully_supported(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断是否存在明确Unsupported结论。
    pub fn has_unsupported(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断是否存在Unknown结论。
    pub fn has_unknown(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断aggregate是否为Stale。
    pub fn is_stale(&self) -> bool;
    /// 判断source assembly是否无typed read gap。
    pub fn is_read_complete(&self) -> bool;
    /// 返回selected backend row数量；合法view固定为1..=16。
    pub fn row_count(&self) -> usize;
}
```

两个factory的复制和拒绝规则固定如下：

1. factory先验证source的selection、binding、requirement source、row set、cursor relation、aggregate和时间关系，
   再复制字段；不接受任何独立覆盖参数。access decision、selector normalization和visibility不在factory内重做。
2. `from_committed_snapshot`只接受`read_gaps=None`，且aggregate必须是`FullySupported`、`Unsupported`、`Unknown`或
   `Stale`。`Degraded`与`Unavailable`即使由内部classifier产生，也返回`UnsupportedAggregateForView`。
3. `from_degraded_snapshot`只接受非空、唯一的`CurrentCapabilityCoverage` gap；该gap之外的requirement、binding、
   row、reference source、audit linkage和双cursor必须完整。它保留机械派生的原始aggregate，不把aggregate改写为
   `Degraded`；只有`surface_status()`返回`SandboxQuerySurfaceStatus::Degraded`。
4. `view_ref`、context、requirement、source refs、digest和audit从selection/binding复制；generation与created time从
   requirement source复制；rows从checked row set复制；双cursor从cursor relation复制。任何字段不从timestamp、digest、
   row顺序或另一次repository read推导。
5. `degraded_reasons`在complete view中固定为`None`；degraded view只能由
   `BackendCapabilityComparisonReadGapSet::to_degraded_reasons()`产生`Some`。factory不得自己拼接reason、去重或重排。
6. final view只保存typed refs、digest、finite enum、十维finite item、count、safe reason、双cursor、audit linkage和
   timestamp；不得保存requirement数值、backend profile正文、SDK response、host/path/endpoint/PID、credential、artifact、
   log、metric、tool output或runtime process body。
7. factory是pure validation + copy：不得读取repository、调用backend/capability port、刷新reference、调用clock、分配
   ref/cursor、推进state、写current binding、append business audit或启动tool/runtime。

helper语义和负向规则固定如下：

| helper | true condition | negative rule |
|---|---|---|
| `surface_status()` | degraded view -> `Degraded`；否则`Stale`只映`Stale`，其余四种可见canonical aggregate映`Visible` | 不把comparison aggregate持久化为query status；不由`Unsupported`映`Failed` |
| `is_degraded()` | `degraded_reasons.is_some()`且source gap恰为CurrentCapabilityCoverage | Stale、Unknown、Unsupported、summary status reason不能自动产生Degraded |
| `is_fully_supported()` | aggregate为`FullySupported`且每row十维Supported | degraded view仍可保留该comparison truth；调用方必须另看`is_read_complete()` |
| `has_unsupported()` | 至少一个row有Unsupported或aggregate为Unsupported | 不把Unknown或CapabilitySource gap折叠成Unsupported |
| `has_unknown()` | 至少一个row有Unknown或aggregate为Unknown | 不从缺失source推导Unknown |
| `is_stale()` | aggregate为`Stale` | reference status或query时间新旧不能单独改写aggregate |
| `is_read_complete()` | `degraded_reasons=None`且source relation已checked | canonical Unsupported、Unknown或Stale本身不表示read failure |
| `row_count()` | 等于row set长度 | 不从source ref set重新计数；row set为空已在factory拒绝 |

任何违反上述关系的rehydration或factory调用必须返回typed error，而不是让getter返回默认值、空slice、`false`或
`None`来掩盖半提交。`BackendCapabilityComparisonView`不提供`refresh`、`recompare`、`establish_boundary`、
`launch_tool`、`launch_runtime`、`capture_artifact`、`append_audit`或`cleanup`方法。

#### 16.9.13 Field source closure

下表把`BackendCapabilityComparisonView`的每个字段、source carrier和公共映射字段绑定到唯一来源。这里的
`exact source`必须已经在同一个公平read snapshot中通过source factory；application不得在DTO mapper或getter中再次
查询、排序、比较或补字段。`forbidden substitute`是实现、rehydration和negative test必须共同拒绝的路径。

| target field / carrier | exact source | relation guard | forbidden substitute |
|---|---|---|---|
| selector `context_ref` | validated exact selector与current binding | selector、binding、requirement source和每个row的context relation由factory逐项闭合 | 从backend ref、digest、repository partition或第一条row反推 |
| selector `requirement_ref` | validated exact selector | 与requirement source、binding和每个row的requirement ref全等 | 从generation、view ref或comparison audit反推 |
| selector `capability_summary_refs` | validated ordered-unique `BackendCapabilityComparisonSourceRefSet` | cardinality固定`1..=16`；row set保持相同成员和顺序 | configured profile全量扫描、caller临时filter、按backend name排序 |
| `view_ref` | current binding指向的immutable comparison row | binding、row、source snapshot三方identity全等；每次current replacement生成新的ref | query id generator、selector hash、requirement ref转换、旧row回退 |
| `source_set_digest` | current binding的committed digest | digest只证明已验证有序source refs的materialization identity；必须与writer candidate和binding全等 | query重新计算、request fingerprint、permission key、content/body digest |
| `requirement_generation_ref` | requirement source snapshot与cursor relation | requirement、每个row和cursor relation使用同一generation；不得跨代拼接 | repository version、truth cursor数值、row中任一generation winner |
| `requirement_created_at` | requirement source snapshot | 不早于source commit origin；与`observed_at`和所有row/source time单调 | binding time、query clock、capability checked time |
| `rows` | checked `BackendCapabilityComparisonBackendRowSet` | 与selector source refs一一对应；顺序、summary ref、backend ref、reference state、generation、双cursor和十维items全等 | 现场重算requirement、合并多个row、latest row scan、只保留Unsupported set |
| row `capability_summary_ref` | committed `BackendCapabilitySummary` source snapshot | 与selector成员和reference source成员同一identity | backend profile ref、ExternalSourceRef、source digest |
| row `backend_ref` | summary source的`ExternalSourceRef` | source kind必须为`IsolationBackend`；source version只从该ref读取 | profile配置、adapter endpoint、host locator、字符串backend name |
| row `reference_state_ref` / `reference_status` | selected committed `ReferenceResolutionState` snapshot | reference state与backend ref、summary ref、reference cursor和audit linkage相容 | resolver live result、summary status文字、query时间 |
| row `capability_status` | `BackendCapabilitySummaryStatus`唯一canonical owner | comparison只复制；不得让aggregate status写回summary | item count猜测、`Unsupported`集合为空、query freshness |
| row `capability_status_reason` | `BackendCapabilitySummary.status_reason()` | `Fresh -> None`；`Stale \| Unknown \| Unsupported -> Some`且逐字段相等 | item reason拼接、raw adapter error、query wording、gap reason |
| row `requirement_ref` / `generation_ref` | summary checked source与requirement snapshot | 两者分别与selector和requirement source全等 | row位置、source digest、capability source version |
| row `items` | checked `BoundaryCapabilityVerdictSet`的十项机械映射 | 恰好十个`BoundaryLimitKind`，canonical顺序唯一；proof/reason形态闭合 | exact requirement数值重新比较、backend feature flag、字符串kind |
| row item `proof_summary_ref` | checked verdict的body-free proof summary | Supported必须有proof且无reason；Unsupported有proof与reason；Unknown无proof且有reason | summary正文、adapter response、reason文本解析 |
| row item `reason` | checked verdict或summary owner提供的`SandboxReason` | only Unsupported/Unknown item可有reason；Supported固定None | 缺source时伪造Unknown、raw error截断、aggregate status reason复制 |
| row item counts | row construction时对十项finite verdict机械计数 | counts必须与items逐项一致，范围固定`0..=10` | caller传入计数、数据库聚合、只统计Unsupported |
| row `truth_cursor` | selected capability summary source snapshot | 与requirement source和comparison cursor relation满足同一read watermark关系 | `Version`、timestamp、generation数值、query observation |
| row `reference_cursor` | reference mutation metadata / summary source snapshot | 与reference state和source relation全等；不可从source version替代 | `ExternalSourceRef.source_version_ref()`、digest、row insertion time |
| row `checked_at` | committed capability summary check time | 不晚于source assembly observed time；不代表query refresh | query clock、backend response time、reference transition time猜测 |
| row `source_audit_trace_ref` | reference state / capability summary已有source audit linkage | 必须与reference source的audit linkage相容；只链接既有mutation | query trace、new read audit、adapter log ID |
| aggregate `comparison_status` | §16.9.6对checked rows、summary status和gap的机械重算 | `Degraded`只作为gap classifier；final view不接受该值；`Unavailable`不构造view | caller override、`unsupported_limit_kinds.is_empty()`、surface status反推 |
| final `truth_cursor` | `BackendCapabilityComparisonCursorRelation.truth_cursor()` | 与requirement source、binding和所有row的truth cursor满足same-snapshot关系 | row中任一最大值、repository version、observed time |
| final `reference_cursor` | `BackendCapabilityComparisonCursorRelation.reference_cursor()` | 覆盖所有selected reference source；与binding和row relation全等 | source version最大值、timestamp、digest |
| final `comparison_audit_trace_ref` | source snapshot的已提交comparison mutation audit linkage | 必须等于binding audit linkage的validated relation；不是本次query的audit | query trace、read log、diagnostic span、人工备注 |
| final `degraded_reasons` | `ReadGapSet::to_degraded_reasons()` | complete固定None；degraded只允许唯一CurrentCapabilityCoverage gap，且同序一一映射 | caller bool、canonical Unsupported/Unknown reason、repository Display |
| final `surface_status` | `BackendCapabilityComparisonReadSurfaceMapping` | gap优先映Degraded；无gap时按canonical aggregate映Visible或Stale；visibility由application先行 | 把aggregate enum持久化为surface state、由reason文本解析、由row缺失猜Empty |
| final `observed_at` | formal reader完成source assembly后的application clock | 不早于selection、binding、requirement、reference sources、rows、cursor relation和audit committed times | backend clock、row insertion time、`checked_at`冒充 |
| `ExactAbsent` proof | same-snapshot exact current-binding index与exact-key row index的双零结果 | access已通过；`current_binding_count`与`total_rows_for_exact_key`固定为0；selector、双cursor和观察时间完整 | repository `None`、timeout、partial index、只查current index、source set为空 |
| `ReadGap` cursor fields | formal reader的coverage proof | 无该source family时required/available同时None；有要求时available严格早于required | generic version、timestamp差值、caller freshness bool |
| `ReadGapSet` order and reason | `ReadGapKind` canonical order与各gap owner reason | selector逐字段全等；同kind至多一项；reason不重复；互斥组合拒绝 | 集合自动去重、按字符串排序、把技术error折成reason |
| `SourceLookupOutcome` | formal reader在同一snapshot的closed branch | `ViewSource`、`ExactAbsent`、`Unavailable`三分互斥；命中binding后不得回退absence | latest winner、old row fallback、Unknown替代CapabilitySource gap |

字段闭包还必须维护以下不可逆关系：

1. `BackendCapabilitySummaryStatus::Unknown`只能来自完整、已提交的summary snapshot；`CapabilitySource`缺失、
   `ReferenceResolutionState`为`Unresolved/Invalid/Unavailable`或source lookup失败，都只能产生typed gap/no-view，不能
   伪造Unknown row。
2. `ReferenceResolutionStateStatus::Stale`允许保留完整的last-known summary row；它不是read gap。只有current coverage
   不足且其它字段完整时，才额外产生唯一`CurrentCapabilityCoverage` gap；该gap不覆盖row的Stale或其它canonical status。
3. `Unsupported`是已验证的能力结论，`Unknown`是完整snapshot中的不可证明结论，`Stale`是source freshness truth；三者
   都不能被`SandboxQuerySurfaceStatus::Degraded`反向解释，也不能被query改写。
4. `source_set_digest`、`truth_cursor`、`reference_cursor`和`comparison_audit_trace_ref`均是已提交writer事实的引用或
   carrier。query、final factory和DTO mapper不得生成、推进、覆盖或重新计算它们。
5. final view不保存selector对象、binding selection proof、gap kind本体、domain requirement body、backend profile
   body、source endpoint、artifact/log/metric正文或任何hidden existence ref；这些内容要么只用于factory前校验，要么由
   application / audit / reconciliation owner独立承接。

字段来源闭包的判定标准是：任一公开字段都能沿着`view -> source snapshot -> checked source carrier -> committed owner`
回溯到唯一节点；若需要依赖“最新一条”“大多数row”“空值默认”“reason字符串解析”或query时重新读取，则判定为未闭合，
必须返回对应typed error或回到上游source writer补齐关系。

#### 16.9.14 Application access、visibility与query no-write boundary

`BackendCapabilityComparisonView`属于Sandbox的boundary/capability记录、审计和异常可见性读面，不属于隔离执行主体
功能。它不创建execution environment，不决定resource limit，不执行filesystem/network/process boundary，不启动tool或
runtime，不采集artifact、log、metric正文，也不维护lease、cleanup、reaper或security redline truth。application、
repository和protocol层必须把这些边界落实为可检查的调用约束，而不是依靠view字段命名推断。

##### 16.9.14.1 Access decision先行

query application先消费既有`SandboxQueryAccessDecision`。comparison contracts不创建、修改或解释该decision，也不
从comparison source反推caller是否有权知道目标存在。access decision与source mapping是两层独立事实：前者决定是否
可以开始exact lookup，后者只决定已授权读取后的source完整性和comparison surface。

| access decision | 是否开始exact comparison lookup | public处理 | comparison view责任 |
|---|---:|---|---|
| `NotVisible` | 否 | 返回application-owned `NotVisible`，不返回存在性、count、view ref或gap detail | 不构造selector source proof，不读取binding/index |
| `Restricted` | 否，除非上游明确给出允许body-free comparison的专门policy | 返回application-owned `Restricted`或受限surface；不得由comparison猜测可见字段 | 不把restricted decision写入view，不通过空view伪造absence |
| `Unavailable` | 否 | 返回application-owned unavailable surface；不把access技术状态改成comparison `Unknown` | 不读取source，不构造`ReadGap` |
| `Visible` | 是 | 进入exact selector与same-snapshot source reader | 只消费access-approved selector |
| `Degraded`且`permits_read=true` | 是 | application保留access层degraded语义，再与source mapping组合 | 可继续读取；不得把access marker当成`CurrentCapabilityCoverage` gap |
| `Degraded`且`permits_read=false` | 否 | 返回application-owned degraded/no-view surface | 不构造source或view |

`NotVisible`、`Restricted`和access-level `Unavailable`必须在任何精确binding count、row count、summary ref读取之前
结束。access-level `Degraded`即使允许读取，也不能升级权限、扩大source set、改变selector顺序或绕过no-write guard。
application最终组合access surface与comparison source surface时，必须保持以下优先级：access denial不能被source
`Visible`覆盖；source `Unavailable`不能被access `Visible`包装成`Empty`；source `CurrentCapabilityCoverage`只能在
access已经允许返回view时映射为公共`Degraded`。

##### 16.9.14.2 Exact selector与source set责任

通过access后，application request validator负责把public request转换成required exact selector candidate；contracts
selector factory负责再次验证typed shape、kind和cardinality。两者责任不能合并为“repository接收任意ref后自行解释”。

| 阶段 | owner | 必须完成 | 禁止行为 |
|---|---|---|---|
| public request validation | protocol/application | required `context_ref`、`requirement_ref`和ordered capability summary refs存在；query kind为`GetBackendCapabilityComparison` | optional context-only、profile-only、opaque scope、空source默认为all |
| selector construction | contracts factory | 构造`BackendCapabilityComparisonSelector`；拒绝wrong kind、重复ref、跨context/requirement候选和`0`或`>16`成员 | 按字符串排序、静默去重、截断16项、从配置扩展caller选择 |
| source membership validation | same-snapshot reader/application | 证明每个selected summary属于同一requirement/generation/context relation，并与reference state一一对应 | 只凭source ref文本、backend profile配置或summary数量证明关系 |
| binding identity | maintenance writer + exact index | 使用`(context_ref, requirement_ref, source_set_digest)`查唯一current binding；digest不替代三类typed identity | 用`view_ref`、digest或timestamp单独作为public selector |

caller提供的顺序只用于稳定展示和row对应关系，不表达fallback、优先级或安全决策。query不得在selector已校验后
追加configured backend、删除caller选择、重新排序或按“最强backend”选winner。source set digest只能作为已验证有序
typed refs的materialization identity；它不能证明access、source内容、requirement数值、current freshness或backend
availability。

##### 16.9.14.3 Same-snapshot query sequence

`GetBackendCapabilityComparison`的current query必须在一个公平read transaction中完成下列顺序。Step 7负责把每个
读取动作落成typed reader callable，Step 9负责把顺序落成flow；本节先固定不可省略的语义和分支。

1. application消费access decision，并在不读取comparison identity的情况下处理denial/restriction。
2. application验证public request和query kind，构造required exact selector；selector failure在读transaction外以
   validation surface结束。
3. reader开始一个公平read snapshot，先读取exact current binding index、该key的immutable row index和binding target
   relation；分别得到`current_binding_count`、`total_rows_for_exact_key`和可选的`binding_target_row_count`，不能先读取
   一条latest row再补count，也不能把历史row总数当作current target count。
4. `current_binding_count == 0 && total_rows_for_exact_key == 0`时，reader只在index完整、双cursor和audit linkage完整的
   前提下构造`BackendCapabilityComparisonAbsenceProof`并返回`ExactAbsent`。若binding为零但同key历史row存在，必须进入
   integrity / reconciliation路径，不得返回Empty。
5. `current_binding_count == 1 && binding_target_row_count == 1 && total_rows_for_exact_key >= 1`时，reader固定沿binding
   target读取current row、requirement source、selected reference state、selected capability summaries、cursor relation和
   既有comparison audit linkage；所有读取必须属于同一snapshot和同一selector。同key其余历史row不参与current选择。
6. reader调用contracts source carriers与`BackendCapabilityComparisonSourceSnapshot` factory；它不得在query内重算
   requirement数值、调用resolver、调用capability adapter、刷新summary或拼接raw row。
7. `ViewSource`按`read_gaps`选择`from_committed_snapshot`或`from_degraded_snapshot`；factory完成后，application调用
   shared surface mapper，再把checked view逐字段映射到protocol DTO。
8. query completion只允许发低基数diagnostic/metric hook；hook失败不得改变已经读取的view outcome，也不得触发补偿写。

以下cardinality组合必须在同一snapshot内一次性分类，不能由多个query结果拼接：

| current binding count | binding target row count | total rows for exact key | source lookup outcome | public result / 禁止替代 |
|---:|---:|---:|---|---|
| `0` | n/a | `0` | `ExactAbsent` | `Empty`, `view=None`；不能用repository `None`、timeout或partial index替代 |
| `1` | `1` | `>=1` | 继续source assembly | 依source完整性返回complete/degraded/no-view；历史row不得参与选择 |
| `0` | n/a | `>0` | typed integrity / reconciliation | no-view；不得回退`Empty`、重绑历史row或挑latest row |
| `1` | `0` | 任意 | typed integrity error | binding target缺失；不得由query现场创建view |
| `1` | `>1` | 任意 | typed integrity error | duplicate target row；不得按timestamp/ref取一条 |
| `>1` | 任意 | 任意 | typed integrity error | single-current invariant violation；不得选择最大时间或最大ref |
| `1` | `1`但relation不等 | `>=1` | typed integrity error | binding-target selector/digest/cursor不等；不得退回任一历史row |

##### 16.9.14.4 Outcome与surface mapping

comparison source outcome和application access outcome必须分别保留。contracts mapping只负责source-local映射；
application/protocol owner负责把access、visibility、public error和wire surface组合成最终响应。

| source outcome | comparison view | source-local surface | application public disposition |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ViewSource`且`read_gaps=None`、aggregate为`FullySupported \| Unsupported \| Unknown` | `Some` | `Visible` | 返回完整body-free comparison view；Unsupported/Unknown继续fail closed |
| `ViewSource`且aggregate为`Stale` | `Some` | `Stale` | 返回last-known comparison view；不得作为current launch capability |
| `ViewSource`带唯一`CurrentCapabilityCoverage` gap | `Some` | `Degraded` | 返回view与typed degraded reasons；保留原aggregate，不改写canonical row status |
| `ExactAbsent` | `None` | `Empty` | 只有access已通过且absence proof完整时返回Empty |
| `Unavailable`带`RequirementSource \| ComparisonBinding \| ComparisonRow \| CapabilitySource \| SourceRelation` gap | `None` | `Unavailable` | 返回no-view；不得回退旧row、MissingProjection或Unknown |
| contracts integrity error | `None` | 不生成伪造surface | application internal/reconciliation/error mapper；不得降级继续展示 |
| access `NotVisible` / `Restricted` | `None` | access owner决定 | 在source lookup前返回对应access surface；不得泄漏exact existence |

`Unsupported`和`Unknown`属于已读取的comparison业务结论，不是`Failed`或`Unavailable`技术错误；`Stale`属于
source freshness truth，不是`CurrentCapabilityCoverage` gap。反向地，`CapabilitySource`缺失不能生产`Unknown`，因为
Unknown必须由完整summary snapshot的canonical status和十维items共同证明。

##### 16.9.14.5 Query no-write与外部调用零边界

comparison query必须使用read-only transaction或等价的snapshot read context。下表是可审计的硬约束：

| operation class | allowed | required count / write set | forbidden |
|---|---|---:|---|
| repository read | exact binding/index、requirement source、reference state、summary、row、audit linkage | read calls可按Step 7组合；write set=`0` | save、upsert、delete、repair、rebind、rebuild、refresh marker |
| contracts factory | pure validation、carrier assembly、field copy、surface mapping | ref/cursor allocation=`0` | clock call、repository call、status transition、reason synthesis |
| truth/reference mutation | none | truth cursor advance=`0`；reference cursor advance=`0` | mark stale、refresh source、write requirement/capability truth |
| identity/materialization | read existing ref/digest only | new view ref/digest=`0` | query生成view identity、重算digest、写current binding |
| backend/capability | none | adapter call=`0` | probe、refresh、health check、profile scan、SDK call |
| tool/runtime/environment | none | launch/attach/kill=`0` | 创建environment、执行tool/runtime、读取PID/path/endpoint |
| artifact/observability body | none | capture/material body call=`0` | 采集artifact、log、metric正文、上传或解析SDK body |
| cleanup/security/member orchestration | none | domain mutation=`0` | lease/reaper、cleanup、redline、member lifecycle、agent loop |
| audit | only low-cardinality diagnostic/metric hook | business `SandboxAuditTrace` append=`0` | 把query trace写入source/view或追加业务audit |

`read-only transaction`不等于“可以在读时修复”：任何ORM lazy write、last-access timestamp写入、cache-aside materialize、
implicit sequence allocation、outbox append或read-triggered projection rebuild都违反本边界。若底层存储无法提供上述
零写入语义，Step 7/11必须在实现前显式选择隔离的read connection或将该依赖登记为blocker，不得由query静默接受副作用。

##### 16.9.14.6 Diagnostic与sensitive field boundary

query可以向受控diagnostic hook报告operation name、surface class、aggregate class、row count、gap kind、error kind和
是否命中absence proof等低基数信息，但必须先经过redaction allowlist。不得记录完整selector、context/requirement/
summary/view ref、source digest、reason正文、backend source version、host/path/endpoint/PID、requirement数值、
capability body、SDK response或access-sensitive existence detail。diagnostic hook不是`SandboxAuditTrace`，也不拥有
重试、repair或source refresh能力。

本节的no-write boundary只约束comparison query和view factory；maintenance writer、capability refresh consumer、reference
resolver、boundary establishment、tool/runtime launch和cleanup/reaper仍由各自owner负责。任何下游文档把这些writer或
external call放进`GetBackendCapabilityComparison`，都必须先标记为historical conflict并回到本节修正，不能通过“方便
实现”扩大comparison对象职责。

#### 16.9.15 Maintenance materialization writer、UoW与current replacement

comparison query reader要求先命中current binding；首次materialization则必然发生在binding不存在时。因此 writer
不能复用`BackendCapabilityComparisonSourceSnapshot`作为输入，否则会形成“先有binding才能创建binding”的循环。
current contract将两条路径严格分开：

- maintenance writer消费不含binding的checked materialization candidate，在write UoW中首次创建或替换current row；
- query reader只消费已经提交的binding、immutable row和same-snapshot source，不创建candidate或执行write。

##### 16.9.15.1 Binding-free materialization candidate

`BackendCapabilityComparisonMaterializationCandidate`是maintenance-only、body-free staged value。它不是新的named
object、domain state、repository identity或protocol DTO；唯一持久化view identity仍是
`BackendCapabilityComparisonViewRef`。candidate必须由application在不调用backend adapter的情况下，从已经提交且
通过same-snapshot验证的requirement、reference state与capability summary source构造。

```rust
/// 不依赖current binding、可供comparison maintenance writer原子提交的checked candidate。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct BackendCapabilityComparisonMaterializationCandidate {
    /// application writer预生成的new immutable view identity。
    view_ref: BackendCapabilityComparisonViewRef,
    /// 本candidate唯一适用的exact selector。
    selector: BackendCapabilityComparisonSelector,
    /// canonical writer对ordered typed source refs计算的opaque digest。
    source_set_digest: SandboxSourceDigest,
    /// exact requirement的contracts-only source snapshot。
    requirement_source: BackendCapabilityComparisonRequirementSourceSnapshot,
    /// 与selector成员一一对应的reference source snapshots。
    reference_sources: Vec<BackendCapabilityComparisonReferenceSourceSnapshot>,
    /// 按selector顺序排列、十维完整的comparison rows。
    rows: BackendCapabilityComparisonBackendRowSet,
    /// candidate覆盖的dual cursor / generation relation。
    cursor_relation: BackendCapabilityComparisonCursorRelation,
    /// 从complete rows机械派生的canonical aggregate。
    comparison_status: BackendCapabilityComparisonStatus,
    /// accepted source maintenance已有的business audit linkage。
    comparison_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    /// candidate完成pure validation的application observation time。
    prepared_at: Timestamp,
}

impl BackendCapabilityComparisonMaterializationCandidate {
    /// 从已提交、无read gap的source components构造binding-free candidate。
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    pub fn try_from_checked_sources(
        view_ref: BackendCapabilityComparisonViewRef,
        selector: BackendCapabilityComparisonSelector,
        source_set_digest: SandboxSourceDigest,
        requirement_source: BackendCapabilityComparisonRequirementSourceSnapshot,
        reference_sources: Vec<BackendCapabilityComparisonReferenceSourceSnapshot>,
        rows: BackendCapabilityComparisonBackendRowSet,
        cursor_relation: BackendCapabilityComparisonCursorRelation,
        comparison_status: BackendCapabilityComparisonStatus,
        comparison_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        prepared_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, BackendCapabilityComparisonViewError>;

    /// 返回new immutable view identity。
    pub fn view_ref(&self) -> &BackendCapabilityComparisonViewRef;
    /// 返回exact selector。
    pub fn selector(&self) -> &BackendCapabilityComparisonSelector;
    /// 返回canonical source-set digest。
    pub fn source_set_digest(&self) -> &SandboxSourceDigest;
    /// 返回requirement source snapshot。
    pub fn requirement_source(&self) -> &BackendCapabilityComparisonRequirementSourceSnapshot;
    /// 返回reference source snapshots。
    pub fn reference_sources(&self) -> &[BackendCapabilityComparisonReferenceSourceSnapshot];
    /// 返回checked row set。
    pub fn rows(&self) -> &BackendCapabilityComparisonBackendRowSet;
    /// 返回dual cursor relation。
    pub fn cursor_relation(&self) -> &BackendCapabilityComparisonCursorRelation;
    /// 返回canonical aggregate status。
    pub fn comparison_status(&self) -> BackendCapabilityComparisonStatus;
    /// 返回accepted source audit linkage。
    pub fn comparison_audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;
    /// 返回candidate validation observation time。
    pub fn prepared_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;

    /// 使用writer commit time机械形成matching current binding payload。
    pub fn binding_at(
        &self,
        bound_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<BackendCapabilityComparisonViewBinding, BackendCapabilityComparisonViewError>;
}
```

candidate factory与reader source factory共享同一个private relation validator，但candidate不接受selection proof或
current binding。validator必须执行以下完整约束：

1. selector、requirement source、reference source和rows的context、requirement、source refs、generation、双cursor、
   backend ref、reference state与audit relation逐项闭合；row set cardinality固定`1..=16`且保持selector顺序。
2. 每个row恰好十项canonical `BoundaryLimitKind`，summary status/reason、item verdict/proof/reason、count与source
   snapshot逐项一致；candidate不重新评估requirement数值。
3. reference source只接受可形成完整row的`Resolved`，或关系完整的last-known `Stale`；
   `Unresolved | Invalid | Unavailable`拒绝。candidate不能携带`ReadGapSet`，也不能持久化partial/degraded row。
4. aggregate只接受`FullySupported | Unsupported | Unknown | Stale`并按§16.9.6机械重算；`Degraded | Unavailable`
   返回`UnsupportedAggregateForView`。read-time `CurrentCapabilityCoverage`只能由后续reader根据current source形成。
5. `source_set_digest`必须由application canonical writer对selector中的ordered typed refs计算；candidate factory只校验
