   digest shape与调用方提供的typed relation，不实现hash。digest算法仍受`BLK-SBX-CANONICAL-001`阻断。
6. `comparison_audit_trace_ref`必须指向accepted source maintenance已有且在writer UoW中可验证的audit record。comparison
   view自身不是`SandboxAuditTrace`的allowed source fact或subject，writer不得为了candidate伪造view-specific business
   audit；row只保存已有linkage。
7. `prepared_at`不得早于requirement、reference sources、rows、cursor relation和linked audit的committed times。
   application clock不覆盖任何source time。
8. `binding_at(bound_at)`要求`bound_at >= prepared_at`，并只从candidate复制view ref、selector字段、digest、双cursor和
   audit linkage；不得重新计算digest、推进cursor、替换source refs或生成第二个view ref。

##### 16.9.15.2 First / replacement write expectation

writer必须显式声明本次提交是首次创建还是替换current binding。该expectation是application/repository之间的CAS
carrier，不进入public view或protocol DTO，也不替代Step 13 idempotency identity。

```rust
/// comparison current binding写入的closed optimistic expectation。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum BackendCapabilityComparisonBindingWriteExpectation {
    /// exact key预期没有current binding和任何immutable comparison row。
    FirstMaterialization,
    /// exact key预期仍指向给定binding及repository version。
    ReplaceCurrent {
        /// writer在同一UoW读取并验证的current binding。
        expected_binding: BackendCapabilityComparisonViewBinding,
        /// current binding row的core optimistic repository version。
        expected_version: Version,
    },
}

impl BackendCapabilityComparisonBindingWriteExpectation {
    /// 构造insert-if-absent首次materialization expectation。
    pub fn first_materialization() -> Self;

    /// 构造exact current binding compare-and-swap replacement expectation。
    pub fn replace_current(
        expected_binding: BackendCapabilityComparisonViewBinding,
        expected_version: Version,
    ) -> Result<Self, BackendCapabilityComparisonViewError>;

    /// 判断expectation是否要求exact key不存在。
    pub fn expects_absent(&self) -> bool;
    /// 返回replacement期望的current binding；首次创建为None。
    pub fn expected_binding(&self) -> Option<&BackendCapabilityComparisonViewBinding>;
    /// 返回replacement期望的repository version；首次创建为None。
    pub fn expected_version(&self) -> Option<&Version>;
}
```

`FirstMaterialization`不是caller对absence的断言。repository writer必须在同一write transaction中对exact
`(context_ref, requirement_ref, source_set_digest)`执行insert-if-absent，并验证current binding count与该key下的
immutable comparison row count同时为0；`0/1` orphan row、`1/0` half-commit或任一duplicate都返回integrity/conflict，
不能按首次创建覆盖。query的`BackendCapabilityComparisonAbsenceProof`不能代替write-time原子检查，因为query snapshot
可能在writer commit前失效。

`ReplaceCurrent`必须满足：expected binding与candidate的context、requirement、ordered source refs和digest逐字段相等；
candidate使用新的`view_ref`；expected version仍是repository当前version；candidate truth/reference cursor分别不得低于
expected binding cursor。任一关系不成立返回typed materialization conflict或application version conflict，不能
last-writer-wins。若source refs或其顺序变化，digest与logical key随之变化，该写入属于另一个key的首次materialization，
不得以replacement偷偷改变selector identity。

##### 16.9.15.3 Writer callable与提交结果

Step 7必须提供一个comparison-specific typed writer callable；本节不定义trait名称或repository接口，但固定其
Rust-facing语义如下：

```rust
/// maintenance-only callable；不会被GetBackendCapabilityComparison query调用。
materialize_backend_capability_comparison(
    candidate: BackendCapabilityComparisonMaterializationCandidate,
    expectation: BackendCapabilityComparisonBindingWriteExpectation,
    write_context: AcceptedSandboxWriteContext,
) -> ApplicationResult<BackendCapabilityComparisonMaterializationWriteOutcome>;
```

`AcceptedSandboxWriteContext`必须已经证明本次maintenance operation有合法source owner、UoW和business audit
linkage；它不能由query access decision、diagnostic hook或public DTO构造。writer返回的support outcome只说明提交或
duplicate-equivalent关系，不是测试结果、运行结果、boundary establishment结果或backend健康结论。

```rust
/// comparison materialization writer的有限成功结果。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum BackendCapabilityComparisonMaterializationWriteOutcome {
    /// 本次candidate与binding replacement在同一UoW首次或替换提交成功。
    Committed {
        /// 已提交的current immutable view identity。
        view_ref: BackendCapabilityComparisonViewRef,
        /// 已提交的current binding。
        binding: BackendCapabilityComparisonViewBinding,
    },
    /// 已存在完全相同的candidate；本次没有追加第二个row或第二个current binding。
    DuplicateEquivalent {
        /// 已存在的current immutable view identity。
        view_ref: BackendCapabilityComparisonViewRef,
        /// 已存在且逐字段相等的current binding。
        binding: BackendCapabilityComparisonViewBinding,
    },
}
```

`Committed`与`DuplicateEquivalent`均要求返回的binding已经可由同一公平read snapshot重新组装为
`BackendCapabilityComparisonSourceLookupOutcome::ViewSource`；返回值不得携带raw repository result、SQL、adapter
response、commit token、retry hint或隐藏的old row ref。底层的`VersionConflict`、unique conflict、serialization
failure、repository unavailable和commit-unknown由application/infrastructure owner单独映射，不新增为view status。

writer callable的前置检查、write set和后置检查固定如下：

| 阶段 | 必须动作 | 可见写集 | 失败结果 | 禁止替代 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| preflight | 校验candidate无gap、selector/source/generation/cursor/audit关系，校验expectation shape | `0` | contracts typed error；不打开写UoW | 让repository decode后再猜字段 |
| exact-key check | 在写事务内读取exact key的current binding count、current row relation和repository `Version` | `0` | absent/replacement expectation不满足 -> conflict/integrity | timestamp/ref winner |
| stage row | 预提交新的immutable row payload，view ref只来自candidate | staged only | row relation或body violation -> rollback | 原地修改旧row |
| stage binding | 以single-current约束准备insert或CAS replacement；复制digest、双cursor、audit linkage | staged only | unique/CAS conflict -> rollback | 先暴露binding再补row |
| finalize linkage | 校验source audit linkage、source cursor和bound time；若需要新业务audit，按allowed source fact在同UoW finalize | staged only | audit/cursor relation失败 -> rollback | query audit、view作为audit subject |
| commit | 原子提交immutable row、current binding、必要audit linkage和index/version变化 | all-or-nothing | commit failure -> all invisible；commit-unknown进入reconciliation | partial commit、补偿式query write |
| post-commit | 只返回`Committed`或`DuplicateEquivalent`，发受限diagnostic hook | `0` | hook失败不回滚source | 用query重新materialize |

writer不得把candidate的`prepared_at`、repository `Version`或commit wall-clock写成truth/reference cursor；这些值只用于
CAS和时间关系。candidate中的`truth_cursor`、`reference_cursor`必须是source owner已接受的cursor；comparison writer不
再创建第三种comparison cursor，也不以materialization次数推进任一source cursor。

##### 16.9.15.4 First materialization exact write order

首次物化用于exact key从未提交过comparison row的情况。它不要求已有current binding，但要求writer在同一UoW内建立
完整的row/binding/audit relation。严格顺序如下：

1. application根据已提交requirement、reference state和capability summary source形成candidate，预生成唯一
   `BackendCapabilityComparisonViewRef`，并由canonical writer生成`SandboxSourceDigest`；算法未定时不得伪造digest值。
2. writer打开write UoW，以`FirstMaterialization`锁定或原子检查exact key，要求current binding count=`0`且该key的
   immutable comparison row count=`0`。历史其它selector的row不参与该key；同key的历史row存在而current缺失时不是首次
   成功条件，而是需要reconciliation/retention处理的冲突。
3. writer校验candidate与requirement/source cursors和accepted audit linkage属于同一source snapshot；任何
   `Unresolved | Invalid | Unavailable` reference state、partial row、缺维度或aggregate不一致均在提交前拒绝。
4. writer stage新的immutable comparison row。row必须保存完整十维items、每row summary/source identity、canonical
   status/reason、generation、双cursor和source audit linkage；不得只保存aggregate或unsupported kind set。
5. writer stage与row逐字段匹配的current binding，key固定为`(context_ref, requirement_ref, source_set_digest)`，
   并把candidate的view ref、双cursor和audit linkage复制进去。binding不能先于row对其它reader可见。
6. writer在同一UoW完成必要的source audit linkage finalize和唯一 index/version更新，然后原子commit。commit之前任何
   read snapshot都不得看到current binding；commit之后任何公平snapshot都必须看到row与binding的完整关系。
7. 若并发writer先提交等价candidate，后到writer只能返回`DuplicateEquivalent`；若candidate任一typed field、view ref、
   cursor、audit或canonical row内容不同，返回conflict，不得覆盖先赢家。

首次物化成功后，`ExactAbsent`不再合法；若之后row或binding缺失，必须是half-commit/retention/integrity分支，不能
   重新返回Empty或现场重建row。首次路径不创建`BackendCapabilityComparisonStatus`持久化状态；status仍从row机械读取。

##### 16.9.15.5 Replacement exact write order

replacement用于同一exact key已经有current binding、但已接受的requirement/capability source snapshot形成新的immutable
comparison row。它不是原地更新，也不是把旧row标记为stale后复用旧ref。

1. application在source owner完成新的accepted source snapshot后读取current binding与core `Version`，构造
   `ReplaceCurrent { expected_binding, expected_version }`和新的candidate；candidate必须使用新的view ref。
2. writer在同一write UoW重新读取并锁定exact current binding，验证仍只有一个current、version全等、expected binding
   与candidate selector/digest/source refs全等。不能信任application先前读到的binding。
3. candidate的truth/reference cursor必须分别大于或等于expected binding cursor；相同generation下cursor回退直接拒绝。
   requirement generation变化但requirement ref不变时，拒绝原key replacement并要求requirement owner形成新的immutable
   requirement identity或明确reconciliation结果。
4. writer stage新的immutable row，保留旧row不可变；新row与candidate全部字段逐项闭合。旧row不得被删除、重写、改status、
   改items或替换其audit linkage。
5. writer stage current binding CAS replacement，使新binding成为唯一current；旧binding只能转为historical/index history
   记录，不能在current index继续可见。row、new binding、source audit linkage和index version必须同一commit边界出现。
6. concurrent writer若先完成replacement，后到writer的expected version失败；后到writer不能重新加载latest后无条件重试，
   也不能以时间、ref或aggregate优先级选赢家。只有同一application idempotency operation且candidate canonical payload
   完全相等时，才允许映为`DuplicateEquivalent`。
7. replacement commit成功后，query只选择new current binding；旧row只由未来audit/reconciliation exact historical
   protocol读取。query不得为了显示“最近结果”在旧row和new row之间做latest scan。

如果source ref顺序、成员、requirement ref或context发生变化，source-set digest / logical key也必须变化；该场景不是
   replacement。旧key和新key可以分别保留各自current binding，caller只有在选择对应exact selector时才能读取对应view，
   不允许application把二者合并成一个comparison集合。

##### 16.9.15.6 Atomicity、duplicate、commit-unknown与rehydration

comparison writer必须把以下规则落为repository contract、UoW contract和Step 13 concurrency tests的共同输入：

| 情形 | writer处理 | query可见结果 | 禁止行为 |
|---|---|---|---|
| two first writers，同一key、完全相同candidate | single-current/unique winner；另一方只返回`DuplicateEquivalent` | 一个current row/binding | 两个current、重复audit、timestamp winner |
| two first writers，同一key、payload不同 | 一个winner；另一方conflict | winner完整可读；loser不产生view | last-writer-wins、覆盖row |
| concurrent replacements，expected version相同 | 一个CAS winner；其它返回version conflict | winner新binding；旧row immutable | reload latest后静默覆盖 |
| late old source completion | expected cursor/version fencing拒绝 | 新current保持可读 | 旧completion回写new binding |
| duplicate retry，commit已确认 | exact candidate canonical equality -> `DuplicateEquivalent` | 不追加row/binding/audit | 再生成view ref或cursor |
| commit-unknown | 不自动重放；由reconciliation按exact key、candidate identity和index关系判定 | 判定前不向caller宣称Committed；不展示半提交 | blind retry、复制row、返回伪造commit |
| row写入成功、binding写入失败或反之 | 整个UoW rollback；若无法证明则进入quarantine/reconciliation | 不返回Empty；不返回partial view | query修复、回退旧row、status-only替代 |
| audit linkage写入失败 | row/binding同UoW rollback | source旧版本保持原状 | 先显示view再补audit |
| rehydration发现两个current或row/binding字段不等 | typed integrity error并进入migration/reconciliation owner | no-view；不降级 | 选最新、按ref排序、忽略异常字段 |

commit-unknown的reconciliation只能读取已提交index和candidate的opaque write identity；不得调用backend、重新比较
requirement或通过query写修复。若无法证明“完整提交”或“完全未提交”，必须保持caller-safe no-view/infrastructure
unknown，直到专用reconciliation owner完成处理；本view不新增`PendingCommit`状态。

current binding仍可被exact selector选中期间，以下内容必须同时可读：current immutable row、requirement source、selected
capability summary/reference source、双cursor关系和必要source audit linkage。retention/deletion job不得先删row再保留
binding，也不得把删除后的exact selector映为`ExactAbsent`；历史row删除后只能影响专用historical query，不改变current
absence proof规则。具体retention时长、索引实现、isolation level和fake/durable parity由Step 11、13、14和正式`04`
定向重验，本节不伪造配置值。

#### 16.9.17 Step 7~17 定向重验登记

本登记把`BackendCapabilityComparisonView`对后续详细设计Step的消费义务展开到实现可核对粒度。每一行都是
`downstream_revalidation_pending`，不是对旧Step内容的确认，也不是允许实现者在当前Step之外自行补schema的授权。
进入对应Step时，owner必须先读取`§16.9.1~§16.9.16`、本节对应条目和该Step的SOP，再在该Step正式中间产物中
给出唯一current定义。若下表的要求与旧正式文档、旧README或旧Step内容冲突，以本节current contract为准，并在
对应Step记录冲突处置和受影响planned boundary。

##### 16.9.17.1 Step 7 Trait / Port / Adapter

Step 7必须把本对象的contracts carrier连接到application reader、maintenance writer、repository/UoW和source
owner。trait名可以沿用仓库既有命名风格，但每个能力只能有一个canonical Rust symbol；不得让fake、query service
或adapter各自发明同义 callable。

| contract slice | Step 7必须闭合的exact callable / input | exact output / error | transaction、source与side-effect义务 | 必须删除的旧路径 | planned boundary / current status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| access-approved read | canonical reader callable必须固定为`read_backend_capability_comparison_source`语义；输入包括已通过access的`SandboxQueryAccessDecision`、`BackendCapabilityComparisonSelector`和read snapshot context；不接受`scope_ref`、view ref-only或profile list | 返回`ApplicationResult<BackendCapabilityComparisonSourceLookupOutcome>`；`ViewSource`、`ExactAbsent`、`Unavailable`必须保持三分闭集；repository unavailable、snapshot failure、access denial和public validation由application owner分层映射 | 一个公平read snapshot内读取exact binding/index、requirement source、reference state、summary、row、cursor和既有audit linkage；read callable的write set=`0`、backend adapter call=`0`、identity allocation=`0` | `SandboxDerivedRepository::get_derived_state_with_version`直组comparison DTO；generic `load_status_snapshot`；latest/context-only scan | `CB-SBX-09A`、`CB-SBX-09B`; `downstream_revalidation_pending` |
| binding/index read | exact lookup callable必须分别证明`current_binding_count`、`binding_target_row_count`、`total_rows_for_exact_key`和single-current relation；输入必须带typed key`(context_ref, requirement_ref, source_set_digest)`及同一snapshot | 返回binding/target/historical cardinality relation或typed persistence/integrity error；只有`current=0,total=0`可构造`BackendCapabilityComparisonAbsenceProof`；present要求`current=1,target=1,total>=1`，其中同key历史row不构成冲突 | index读不能以timestamp、ref排序、配置顺序或latest-wins选赢家；`current=0,total>0`、target缺失/重复或binding-target不等必须进入integrity/reconciliation；query不得创建row、重绑旧row或写read repair | repository `None`即Empty；把同key总row数要求为1；从一条latest row反推current；将`MissingProjection`作为所有missing的兜底 | `CB-SBX-09A`、`CB-SBX-09B`、`CB-SBX-12B`; `downstream_revalidation_pending` |
| maintenance candidate writer | 已固定语义的`materialize_backend_capability_comparison`；输入为`BackendCapabilityComparisonMaterializationCandidate`、`BackendCapabilityComparisonBindingWriteExpectation`和已授权`AcceptedSandboxWriteContext` | 返回`ApplicationResult<BackendCapabilityComparisonMaterializationWriteOutcome>`，成功仅为`Committed`或`DuplicateEquivalent`；底层version/unique/serialization/repository/commit-unknown必须有application typed mapping，不塞入view status | 首次使用insert-if-absent；replacement使用expected binding + core `Version` CAS；immutable row、current binding、必要source audit linkage和index/version同一UoW原子提交；query不能调用该writer | query refresh/rebuild/recompare；先暴露binding再补row；原地改row；commit-unknown盲重放；view-specific audit伪造 | `CB-SBX-11B`、`CB-SBX-12B`; `downstream_revalidation_pending` |

Step 7的停审条件是：reader、binding/index reader、candidate writer、source bridge、UoW/version和fake/durable parity

不需要再猜repository或adapter函数。未满足时，Step 7不得把旧`get_read_projection`标记为已承接。

##### 16.9.17.2 Step 8 Protocol

Step 8必须重写`GetBackendCapabilityComparison`协议族的request、response、二级DTO和mapper。协议只暴露body-free
comparison record，不暴露domain requirement value、backend product detail或repository key。以下字段名是current
协议收口所必须使用的语义；Step 8必须为每一字段补wire type、required/optional、serde名称、缺失处理和public
error/surface映射，不能继续使用旧四字段摘要。

| protocol surface | exact current schema obligation | field source / mapping | required negative cases | planned boundary / current status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| request | `GetBackendCapabilityComparisonRequestDto`必须携带`context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef`、`requirement_ref: BoundaryRequirementSetRef`和有序`capability_summary_refs: Vec<BackendCapabilitySummaryRef>`；请求还必须承接既有protocol metadata / actor context，但不得再放`scope_ref`或caller source filter | application由request构造`BackendCapabilityComparisonSelector`；selector factory再校验typed kind、ordered unique和`1..=16` | 缺context、缺requirement、空/重复/超过16 source、wrong kind、跨context或scope-only请求 -> `Validation`；不得以Empty隐藏请求错误 | `CB-SBX-09A`; `downstream_revalidation_pending` |
| top-level response | 使用既有`SandboxQueryResponseDto<BackendCapabilityComparisonViewDto>`；surface、view optional、visibility marker、error和projection marker的共用语义由shared protocol owner承接 | `view`只来自`BackendCapabilityComparisonView`；`Visible`、`Stale`、`Degraded`、`Empty`、`Unavailable`、`NotVisible`、`Restricted`分别由application mapper组合，不由DTO自行推断 | NotVisible/Restricted不得携带view、count、source refs或absence proof；Unavailable不得回退Empty；integrity error不得返回partial view | `CB-SBX-09A`、`CB-SBX-09B`; `downstream_revalidation_pending` |
| view DTO | `BackendCapabilityComparisonViewDto`必须逐字段承接`view_ref`、`context_ref`、`requirement_ref`、ordered summary refs、source-set digest、generation、requirement created time、rows、aggregate status、双cursor、audit linkage、degraded reasons和observed time | 每个字段映射到§16.9.13唯一source；digest必须是opaque typed digest，不作为selector替代；audit linkage只能是已成立source audit ref | 不增加`comparison_ref`、`DerivedFreshnessStatus`、顶层`unsupported_limit_kinds`、raw requirement/backend body、latest timestamp或generic opaque identity | `CB-SBX-02A`、`CB-SBX-09A`; `downstream_revalidation_pending` |
| row/item DTO | 定义`BackendCapabilityComparisonBackendRowDto`和`BackendCapabilityComparisonItemDto`的完整schema；row必须保留summary ref、backend typed source ref、reference state/status/reason、capability status/reason、generation、十维items/counts、双cursor、checked time和source audit linkage | item按canonical `BoundaryLimitKind`顺序映射`Supported | Unsupported | Unknown`及safe proof/reason；不得由DTO重新聚合 | 缺维度、重复kind、count不符、raw proof/body、把Unknown映Unsupported、只返回unsupported kind set -> `Validation`或internal integrity mapping | `CB-SBX-02A`、`CB-SBX-09A`; `downstream_revalidation_pending` |
| gap/surface DTO | public wire必须定义CurrentCapabilityCoverage degraded reasons、Unavailable/no-view和absence Empty的映射；gap本体不直接作为任意字符串列表暴露 | `StatusViewDegradedReasonSet`和shared `SandboxQuerySurfaceStatus`由contracts/application mapper提供；aggregate status不被改写为Degraded | `CapabilitySource`缺失不能映Unknown；binding/row gap不能映Degraded；`Unsupported`/`Unknown`不能映Failed | `CB-SBX-09A`、`CB-SBX-12A`; `downstream_revalidation_pending` |
| error / retry mapping | Step 8必须列出contracts `BackendCapabilityComparisonViewError`到`SandboxPublicErrorKind` / query surface的显式映射 | `Validation`、`NotVisible`、`VersionConflict`、`AdapterUnavailable`、`NoWriteViolation`、`Internal`等使用shared public owner；raw cause只保留脱敏reason | 不允许`_ => Internal`吞掉新增variant，不允许把业务Unsupported当AdapterUnavailable，不允许协议alias旧status | `CB-SBX-12A`; `downstream_revalidation_pending` |
| protocol-to-object closure | DTO mapper必须能由`ViewSource`、`ExactAbsent`、`Unavailable`三分结果构造每个响应分支，并列出不构造view的分支 | mapper只复制checked fields，不查询repository、不生成ref/digest/cursor、不调用backend | 旧`api -> get_read_projection -> DTO`、DTO从空Option猜状态、mapper重排rows或补reason | `CB-SBX-09A`、`CB-SBX-09B`; `downstream_revalidation_pending` |

Step 8协议族停审要求：request、top-level response、view、row/item、gap/surface、error/retry和DTO-to-object closure
全部逐字段可回指Step 6/7；wire enum和shared enum不漂移；协议中不出现旧`scope_ref`、`comparison_ref`、
`unsupported_limit_kinds`或`DerivedFreshnessStatus` current用法。

##### 16.9.17.3 Step 9 Function Flow

Step 9必须把读路径和maintenance写路径拆成独立flow，不能用一个“derived comparison flow”同时描述query、refresh和
materialization。以下两个入口是必须分别展开的current flow label；实际Rust函数名必须与Step 8/7唯一映射。

###### 16.9.17.3.1 `GetBackendCapabilityComparisonFlow`

| flow stage | exact callable / input | successful output | failure / side effect | forbidden shortcut |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| access | query handler先消费既有`SandboxQueryAccessDecision`和actor/metadata context | `Visible`或允许读取的access branch进入selector validation | `NotVisible`、`Restricted`、access-unavailable在任何binding/index read前返回；query write set=`0` | 先查binding/row再决定权限；用Empty隐藏目标存在 |
| selector | `GetBackendCapabilityComparisonRequestDto` -> `BackendCapabilityComparisonSelector::try_new` | required exact context/requirement/source set | shape/cardinality/wrong-kind error -> public Validation；不访问repository | 从scope/config扩展source set、静默去重或排序 |
| exact lookup | `read_backend_capability_comparison_source(selector, read_context)` | `ViewSource`、`ExactAbsent`或`Unavailable` | 只有`current=0,total=0`才Empty；present要求`current=1,target=1,total>=1`；half-commit、orphan historical row、duplicate target或relation不等进入error/reconciliation；source gap保留typed kind | `get_read_projection`、latest scan、把同key历史row当duplicate current、repository None猜absence |
| source assembly | same-snapshot reader载入requirement/reference/summary/row/audit并调用source factory | complete source或唯一CurrentCapabilityCoverage degraded source | contracts relation error、source unavailable、cursor mismatch分别映typed branch；不调用adapter | query现场比较requirement、读取raw backend、补Unknown |
| final view | `BackendCapabilityComparisonView::from_committed_snapshot`或`from_degraded_snapshot` | body-free immutable view | factory拒绝wrong aggregate/gap/body/time；不分配view ref | mapper自行拼view、改aggregate、重算digest |
| public mapping | application调用shared surface mapper并构造`SandboxQueryResponseDto<BackendCapabilityComparisonViewDto>` | visible/stale/degraded view，或Empty/no-view response | diagnostic hook失败不回滚/重试/写audit；public error按Step 8 mapper | query append audit、refresh/rebuild、stored result write |

###### 16.9.17.3.2 `MaterializeBackendCapabilityComparisonFlow`

| flow stage | exact input / callable | UoW and state relation | failure handling | forbidden shortcut |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| source acceptance | accepted source owner形成`BackendCapabilityComparisonMaterializationCandidate`和`AcceptedSandboxWriteContext` | candidate无gap、十维完整、双cursor/generation/audit relation checked；不从query absence proof构造candidate | source unresolved/invalid/unavailable、digest未能由canonical writer证明 -> 不进入write UoW或按design blocker停留 | writer调用backend、从配置扫描profile、把query source直接当binding |
| expectation | 首次`FirstMaterialization`或replacement `ReplaceCurrent(expected_binding, expected_version)` | exact key和CAS expectation在write UoW内重新读取；不能信任caller外部读 | expectation mismatch -> conflict/integrity；不得latest reload后静默覆盖 | timestamp/ref winner、latest-wins、旧row原地改写 |
| stage | `materialize_backend_capability_comparison(candidate, expectation, write_context)` | row、binding、audit linkage、index/version staged但未对reader可见；truth/reference cursor不由writer推进 | row/binding/audit任一失败全UoW rollback；无法确认则commit-unknown reconciliation | 先提交binding、补row、query修复half-commit |
| commit | UoW atomic commit | new immutable row + single current binding + required linkage同一边界可见 | `Committed`或`DuplicateEquivalent`；commit-unknown不宣称成功 | 复制row、重复audit、返回伪造commit token |
| post-commit | writer outcome mapper / bounded diagnostic hook | write set归零；source cursor保持owner值 | hook失败不回滚已提交source，不触发query rematerialization | 用query验证并补写、把outcome改成业务Unsupported |

Step 9的每条flow停审必须提供ASCII调用图、对象/函数参数、port回指、事务边界、错误映射、状态/审计/relay副作用
和最小测试切口。`GetBackendCapabilityComparisonFlow`必须证明所有外部执行调用为零；`Materialize...Flow`必须证明
首次、replacement、duplicate、conflict、commit-unknown和reconciliation边界独立存在。

##### 16.9.17.4 Step 10 State Matrix

Step 10必须先筛选状态主语，不能因为旧表里有`DerivedFreshnessStatus`就为comparison新增derived state machine。
本对象相关候选按下表处理：

| candidate subject | 是否进入comparison state matrix | canonical owner | exact rule | forbidden state drift |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `BackendCapabilitySummaryStatus` | 是，但作为selected source的外部canonical status，不由comparison推进 | capability summary source owner | row逐项复制status/reason；source refresh形成新accepted snapshot；comparison只读取 | comparison query修改summary status；aggregate覆盖summary status |
| `ReferenceResolutionStateStatus` | 是，作为reference/source freshness owner | reference state owner | `Resolved`、完整last-known `Stale`等可进入source relation；`Unresolved | Invalid | Unavailable`不能伪造Unknown row | 用comparison aggregate反写reference state |
| `BackendCapabilityComparisonStatus` | 仅作为view内机械派生值，不是持久化状态机 | `BackendCapabilityComparisonBackendRowSet` + §16.9.6 rules | `FullySupported`、`Unsupported`、`Unknown`、`Stale`由rows/source status重算；`Degraded`/`Unavailable`只作防御性classifier branch | transition、status row、status-only identity、aggregate winner |
| `SandboxQuerySurfaceStatus` | 是shared read surface，但不拥有comparison lifecycle | application/shared query surface owner | access与source gap组合映Visible/Stale/Degraded/Empty/Unavailable等；不得改写aggregate | view status反写source、surface当business truth |
| `BackendCapabilityComparisonViewRef`、binding、source digest、cursors、gap set | 否 | ref/value/index carrier | 只承载identity、relation或read proof；由writer/reader按既定规则使用 | 把ref/version/timestamp/lock当状态机 |
| `BackendCapabilityComparisonMaterializationWriteOutcome` | 否 | application writer outcome | `Committed`与`DuplicateEquivalent`是一次调用结果，不是长期状态 | 把duplicate当业务状态、把commit-unknown加成view status |

Step 10必须输出comparison相关的状态主语筛选表、状态族归属、非法转换表和跨状态机审计。当前允许的业务/技术
转换只有source owner自己的transition，以及maintenance writer的CAS/duplicate结果；comparison query不得触发任何
transition。旧`DerivedFreshnessStatus`、`Failed`、`Rebuilding`等若仍在Step 10作为comparison主状态出现，必须标记为
`invalidated_pending_step_10_revalidation`并阻断后续测试/实施闭环。

##### 16.9.17.5 Step 11 Persistence / Transaction / Consistency

Step 11必须把comparison从旧的generic derived row中拆出，形成可由exact selector证明current、又允许保留同key
historical rows的logical persistence contract。本节只固定逻辑对象、key、index、transaction order和可见性，不选择
数据库产品、物理表DDL、isolation level名称、retention时长、digest算法或`Version` codec。

###### 16.9.17.5.1 Logical stores与key/index

| logical store | row purpose / required payload | PK / unique | required index | mutation rule |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `backend_capability_comparison_rows` | 保存一个immutable `BackendCapabilityComparisonView` row；含exact key三元组、view ref、ordered source refs、digest、generation、十维rows、aggregate、双cursor、source audit linkage和times | PK `view_ref`；同一`view_ref`只能有一份canonical payload | complete exact-key index `(context_ref, requirement_ref, source_set_digest, view_ref)`；source dependency index `(capability_summary_ref, exact_key, view_ref)`必须保留selector position | insert only；禁止原地更新status/items/cursor/audit；historical row只可按retention contract归档，不可成为current winner |
| `backend_capability_comparison_current_bindings` | 保存exact key唯一current pointer及其完整`BackendCapabilityComparisonViewBinding` | unique / PK `(context_ref, requirement_ref, source_set_digest)`；target `view_ref`在current集合中唯一 | target lookup `view_ref -> exact key`；必须能在同snapshot得到`current_binding_count`与core `Version` | first insert-if-absent；replacement用expected binding + expected `Version` CAS；禁止last-writer-wins |
| `backend_capability_comparison_row_source_links` | 保存view row与ordered summary/reference/source audit linkage的可校验关系；可物理内嵌，但逻辑上必须逐position可重建 | unique `(view_ref, source_position)`；unique `(view_ref, capability_summary_ref)` | reverse index `(capability_summary_ref, view_ref)`供source maintenance定位候选；不能供public query扩展selector | 与row同UoW insert；row immutable期间不可改position、source或audit link |
| `backend_capability_comparison_exact_key_row_index` | 对active与archived historical rows提供完整exact-key cardinality；支撑absence与integrity proof | unique `(exact_key, view_ref)` | exact-key count必须覆盖current target和所有仍受逻辑retention约束的historical rows | row提交时同UoW增加；归档不得让曾物化key被误判为从未存在 |
| existing requirement / capability / reference / audit stores | comparison只引用既有owner记录，不复制requirement数值、backend body或audit正文 | 由各source owner定义 | exact ref、generation与cursor lookup | comparison writer无权更新source owner truth；只验证并保存linkage |

`exact_key`是`(context_ref, requirement_ref, source_set_digest)`的简写，不是新的public type或selector。public query仍使用
typed `BackendCapabilityComparisonSelector`，repository/application在selector通过校验后才计算或加载matching opaque
digest。`backend_capability_comparison_exact_key_row_index`必须在逻辑上覆盖active与archived rows；如果物理归档让
complete count失真，reader必须返回Unavailable / integrity error，而不是构造absence proof。

cardinality与current/historical关系固定为：

| same-snapshot observation | persistence conclusion | query / writer action |
|---|---|---|
| `current=0,total=0`且两个index complete | exact key从未物化 | query可构造absence proof；first writer仍需在write UoW重验双零 |
| `current=1,target=1,total>=1`且binding-target relation全等 | 合法current，可能有历史rows | query只沿binding target组装；replacement保留历史rows |
| `current=0,total>0` | orphan/historical-without-current或reconciliation中间异常 | no-view + integrity/reconciliation；不得重绑latest row或返回Empty |
| `current=1,target=0`或`target>1` | half-commit / duplicate target corruption | no-view + integrity；query不得repair |
| `current>1` | single-current unique invariant失效 | no-view + integrity；不得按time/ref/version选winner |
| `current=1,target=1,total>=1`但selector/digest/cursor/audit不等 | binding-target relation corruption | no-view + quarantine/reconciliation；不得回退historical row |

###### 16.9.17.5.2 Same-snapshot reader与rehydration

reader必须在一个公平read snapshot中按以下顺序工作：先完成access与selector validation；读取exact current binding、
exact-key logical row count和binding target count；分类absence/present/integrity；present时只沿binding target读取row和
source links；再读取requirement、selected reference/capability source及既有audit linkage；最后构造selection proof、
source snapshot和final view。snapshot开始后不得刷新source、重算digest、切换configured profiles或补读latest row。

rehydration必须逐项验证：row body可以构造本节所有private field；ordered source links恰好`1..=16`且与selector/row
同序；每个backend row恰好十维；aggregate可机械重算；binding和target row的exact key、view ref、双cursor、audit
linkage全等；source observation不晚于reader `observed_at`。任一decode、missing column、unknown enum、duplicate index、
body-free violation或relation mismatch返回typed persistence/contracts error，不能以默认值、空集合或旧schema alias继续。

###### 16.9.17.5.3 Writer UoW与rollback visibility

| writer path | lock / expectation | same-UoW staged writes | commit visibility | rollback / unknown handling |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| first materialization | atomic exact-key insert-if-absent；重验`current=0,total=0` | immutable row、ordered source links、exact-key row index、current binding、必要source audit linkage确认和binding `Version` | commit前全部不可见；commit后`current=1,target=1,total=1`同snapshot可读 | 任一步失败全部不可见；无法确认commit时进入reconciliation，不自动重放 |
| replacement | 锁定unique current binding；expected binding与core `Version` CAS；candidate cursor不得回退 | new immutable row、new source links、exact-key row index增量、current binding replacement、必要audit linkage确认和new version | commit前旧binding保持current；commit后new target唯一current，old row继续historical | CAS/unique/serialization失败全部rollback；不得先删old row或先暴露new binding |
| duplicate equivalent | exact operation identity与candidate canonical payload均相等，且已提交relation完整 | write set必须为0 | 返回existing current binding/view ref | 若只能证明部分相等或commit状态不明，不得返回DuplicateEquivalent |

comparison writer不得推进truth/reference cursor、修改source status、追加view-specific business audit或保存query trace。
repository `Version`只服务于binding CAS，不得被序列化为truth/reference cursor；commit time只形成`bound_at`，不能覆盖
source `checked_at`、requirement `created_at`或reader `observed_at`。

###### 16.9.17.5.4 Retention、archive与fake/durable parity

current binding仍指向row时，row、source links、exact-key index和必要audit linkage均不得被删除或归档到current reader
不可达位置。historical row只有在不被任何current binding引用、没有未完成commit reconciliation、满足audit/security/
legal retention且exact-key complete cardinality仍可证明时才有资格归档。当前没有确认retention时长；Step 14/正式`04`
只能绑定经审查的typed配置，不能在本节伪造数值。删除最后一个historical row若会使曾物化key变成`current=0,total=0`，
则在当前absence contract下禁止；物理archive必须继续由逻辑exact-key index计入`total_rows_for_exact_key`。

fake必须和durable adapter共同满足：原子staging/rollback、single-current unique、immutable row、ordered source links、
active+archive logical count、same-snapshot read、expected `Version` CAS、duplicate-equivalent、commit-unknown注入和rehydration
validation。fake不得使用一个`HashMap<selector, latest_view>`跳过historical cardinality，也不得自动修复orphan row。

Step 11停审条件是logical store、PK/unique/index、current/historical relation、same-snapshot reader、UoW顺序、rehydration、
retention和fake/durable parity全部闭合，并将旧`get_derived_state_with_version`、generic derived state row和latest scan标记为
historical conflict。受影响planned boundary为`CB-SBX-02B`、`CB-SBX-09A`、`CB-SBX-09B`、`CB-SBX-11B`、
`CB-SBX-12B`，状态保持`downstream_revalidation_pending`。

##### 16.9.17.6 Step 12 Error / Recovery

Step 12必须保持contracts relation error、application access/validation、typed source gap、persistence integrity、
concurrency conflict和backend/source unavailable六层分离。`Unsupported`、`Unknown`和`Stale`是已提交comparison结论，
不是异常；`ExactAbsent`是完整proof，不是repository error；`CurrentCapabilityCoverage`是唯一允许带view的degraded gap。

###### 16.9.17.6.1 Error owner与public mapping

| observed condition / owner | exact internal result | retry / recovery class | public or operational mapping | forbidden mapping |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| selector shape/ref/cardinality错误 | `SelectorShapeInvalid` / `SourceRefSetInvalid` / `SourceRefCardinalityInvalid` | caller修正，不自动重试 | `SandboxPublicErrorKind::Validation`，no-view | Empty、Unavailable、scope fallback |
| selector与已提交source relation不等 | `SelectorSourceRelationInvalid` / `SelectorBindingMismatch` | 非重试；修正请求或进入integrity review | Validation或Internal取决于错误发生在request前还是rehydration后 | 扫描相似source、重排refs |
| item/row/status/cursor/aggregate/body/time factory不变量失败 | 对应27项closed `BackendCapabilityComparisonViewError` variant | 非重试；design/data integrity review | `Internal` + redacted diagnostic，no-view | raw reason、Unknown、Degraded继续展示 |
| current binding/target/index损坏 | `BindingIntegrityInvalid`或application persistence integrity error | 需reconciliation / quarantine | `Internal`，no-view | Empty、latest winner、query rebind |
| requirement/binding/row/capability/source relation当前不可读但未证明损坏 | `Unavailable` + exact typed gap | 依source/repository恢复可重试读取 | public `Unavailable`，no-view | Unknown、Unsupported、MissingProjection |
| 唯一CurrentCapabilityCoverage不足且last-known row完整 | `ViewSource` + exact gap | 等source maintenance；query自身不重试写 | `Degraded` + view | 改aggregate、刷新backend |
| repository snapshot/begin/read暂不可用 | application/infra repository unavailable | 可重试read，必须重新开始完整snapshot | `AdapterUnavailable`或query `Unavailable` | 拼接两次partial read、Empty |
| first unique / replacement expected version冲突 | application unique / `VersionConflict` | 仅fresh-read后由同一maintenance operation决定重试 | `VersionConflict`或job item retryable | last-writer-wins、自动换key |
| candidate relation/expectation冲突 | `MaterializationConflict` | 非盲重试；重建checked candidate或人工检查 | Validation/Internal按owner分层 | 把冲突写成view status |
| transaction commit unknown | application/infrastructure commit-unknown | 自动重放禁止；按exact key和candidate identity对账 | operational Internal / pending reconciliation，不宣称Committed | 生成新view ref后重试、DuplicateEquivalent猜测 |
| no-write query调用writer/backend/refresh | `NoWriteViolation` | implementation defect，不重试该路径 | public `NoWriteViolation` + safe diagnostic | 补偿写、business audit掩盖 |

`BackendCapabilityComparisonViewError`的27个variant必须在Step 12逐项列出mapper，不允许`_ => Internal`作为未来variant
兜底。variant可以共享public `Internal`，但必须保留独立low-cardinality diagnostic class和测试入口。SQL、table/key、raw
row、backend response、host/path/PID、credential、full refs或reason正文不得进入public error、log label或metric label。

###### 16.9.17.6.2 Recovery与禁止路径

| failure point | allowed recovery owner | allowed action | prohibited action |
|---|---|---|---|
| validation before read snapshot | caller / protocol | 修正required typed fields后发起新query | 用配置补selector、返回Empty |
| transient read unavailable | caller retry / repository operations | 丢弃旧partial snapshot，从access开始重新读取 | 在旧snapshot上补一条latest row |
| source coverage lag | capability/reference maintenance owner | 形成新的accepted source snapshot，随后独立materialize | query probe、query mark stale、query写binding |
| orphan historical row或half-commit | reconciliation owner | quarantine并按durable transaction事实形成report；修复动作需独立设计授权 | query绑定historical row、删除异常后伪造absence |
| first/replacement conflict | maintenance application | fresh-read current binding/version；只有同一operation/candidate identity可重试 | reload latest后无条件覆盖、改变source order |
| commit unknown | dedicated reconciliation | 只读取exact key、candidate view ref/payload identity、row/binding/index/audit relation | 调backend、重算comparison、盲重放writer |
| body-free / decode violation | migration/security/reconciliation owner | no-view、quarantine、保留safe diagnostic | 截断raw body后继续展示、把未知enum默认为Unknown |
| diagnostic hook failure | observability owner | 保持已确定query/writer outcome，单独上报hook failure | 回滚已提交row、追加business audit、重跑query |

comparison query和view factory永远不是恢复owner。它们不能repair、refresh、rebuild、rebind、delete、append audit、推进
cursor或调用backend。Step 12停审必须形成27-variant mapping、retryability、safe reason来源、quarantine/reconciliation
入口、commit-unknown和所有禁止恢复路径；受影响planned boundary为`CB-SBX-09A`、`CB-SBX-09B`、`CB-SBX-12A`、
`CB-SBX-12B`，状态保持`downstream_revalidation_pending`。

##### 16.9.17.7 Step 13 Concurrency / Idempotency / Re-entry

comparison query不创建idempotency record、stored result或lock。maintenance materialization必须复用触发它的trusted
consumer/job/application operation identity，并在retry期间保持同一个candidate `view_ref`、exact selector、source-set
digest、canonical payload和write context；重新生成view ref后不能再声称是原candidate的duplicate replay。

###### 16.9.17.7.1 Race matrix

| race | conflicted resource | control / winner rule | loser result | required negative test |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| two first writers, same exact key, same operation and canonical candidate | current binding unique key、candidate view ref | insert-if-absent single winner；loser重读并证明完整canonical equality | `DuplicateEquivalent`，write set 0 | current=1,target=1,total=1；audit/link不重复 |
| two first writers, same key, different candidate | current binding unique key | first complete commit wins | conflict；loser row/link全部rollback | 不得出现loser historical row或last-writer-wins |
| two replacements with same expected version | binding core `Version` | CAS single winner | `VersionConflict`；loser staged row/index/link rollback | total只增加winner一条；old row仍immutable |
| late old source completion after newer replacement | binding version、truth/reference cursor | expected version + non-regressing cursor fence | conflict / stale completion report | old completion不得重绑current |
| retry after confirmed commit | operation identity + candidate canonical payload | exact equality and complete relation | `DuplicateEquivalent` | 不生成第二view ref、row、binding或audit |
| retry after commit unknown | candidate identity + exact-key durable relation | reconciliation先判定fully committed / not committed / indeterminate | indeterminate保持blocked；不得宣称success | blind retry必须被拒绝 |
| query racing first/replacement commit | fair read snapshot | 只允许commit-before或commit-after完整视图 | Empty仅限真正first commit前双零；否则old/new完整view | 不得看到new binding + missing row或混合source |
| retention racing query/replacement | current target与historical index | current-target pin + transaction/retention fence | retention skip/conflict | 不得删除current row或让logical total count瞬时归零 |

###### 16.9.17.7.2 Idempotency digest与re-entry

| operation family | idempotency identity / digest inclusion | duplicate handling | forbidden field / behavior |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GetBackendCapabilityComparison` Query | 无持久化idempotency key；可有只读trace digest，包含exact typed selector | 每次重新读取一个公平snapshot | stored replay、binding lock、refresh、view ref生成 |
| trusted source maintenance invoking materialization | 复用owner的`(operation_name, channel, idempotency_key)`；digest必须包含context、requirement、ordered summary refs、source-set digest、candidate view ref、generation、双cursor和accepted source/audit identities | completed same digest先验证current durable relation，再返回stored owner result或writer `DuplicateEquivalent` | arrival time、trace id、retry count、raw source body、backend response |
| first/replacement repository write | exact key + candidate view ref + canonical candidate payload + expectation kind；replacement另含expected binding identity和core `Version` | same operation/equal payload可duplicate；same key/different payload conflict | 用timestamp、aggregate优先级或new view ref决定same request |
| reconciliation of commit unknown | 原candidate identity和opaque owner write identity；不创建新的business idempotency key | 输出fully committed / not committed / indeterminate的report-only结论 | 调backend、重算digest算法、重放不确定side effect |

`source_set_digest`是materialization key的一部分，但不是Step 13 idempotency key，也不替代canonical request digest。
canonical hash/writer仍由`BLK-SBX-CANONICAL-001`约束；Step 13只能规定字段集合、稳定顺序和同值判定，不能伪造算法或
fixture。core `Version`的编码与持久化由`BLK-SBX-VERSION-001`约束；fake不得用整数自增事实冒充已选durable codec。

###### 16.9.17.7.3 Fake / durable concurrency parity

fake和durable adapter必须共同验证：parallel first single winner、parallel replacement CAS、loser staged writes不可见、
same-operation duplicate equality、different payload conflict、late source fence、commit-before/after query snapshot、
commit-unknown reconciliation和retention pin。fake必须提供确定性的barrier/failpoint观察write set、adapter call count和
audit append count；这些是未来测试能力要求，不是本节已经执行的测试结果。

Step 13停审条件是每个race都有conflict resource、control、loser result和test cut；materialization operation identity
可计算且query明确无idempotency truth；commit-unknown和re-entry没有盲重放。受影响planned boundary为`CB-SBX-02B`、
`CB-SBX-09B`、`CB-SBX-11B`、`CB-SBX-12B`，状态保持`downstream_revalidation_pending`。

##### 16.9.17.8 Step 14 Config / External Binding

Step 14必须把comparison所需的配置引用、source registry、maintenance writer和外部协作绑定到已有配置owner；它只定义
代码读取和startup validation边界，不把配置写成query selector、capability truth、digest算法、version codec或真实运行
结果。正式`04-配置设计.md`与本对象存在历史冲突时，以本节的typed selector和no-write边界为current contract。

###### 16.9.17.8.1 Config reference table

| config item / source | typed role | read owner / read point | validation and effect | forbidden use / current disposition |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `SBX-CFG-I036 backendCapability.backendProfileRefs` | `UniqueRefList<BackendProfile,16>`，长度固定`1..=16` | startup registry与capability/source maintenance builder；不由query handler读取来扩展请求 | empty、duplicate、unknown、wrong kind fail-fast；为registered candidate universe提供上限和source registry关系 | 不能把profile ref直接当capability summary、不能从配置全量生成query selector、不能静默截断/分页/扩大；`1..=16`是当前设计依据，不是运行结果 |
| `SBX-CFG-I035 backendCapability.adapterProfileRef` | typed adapter profile ref | startup builder绑定capability source adapter；maintenance refresh调用 | missing/unknown/disabled按配置owner fail-fast或job blocked；adapter outcome仍须转换为已提交summary/reference status | query不得读取adapter profile、probe backend或把profile可用性当Supported |
| `SBX-CFG-I037 backendCapability.freshnessThresholdSeconds` | source-owner freshness policy ref/value | capability summary refresh与source acceptance；comparison query只读取已提交status | 校验由配置owner完成；source refresh据此形成Fresh/Stale等canonical summary status | 不在query中以当前配置重算旧row freshness；不覆盖summary status；本节不重写数值 |
| `SBX-CFG-I038 backendCapability.probeTimeoutMillis` | adapter operation timeout binding | capability adapter wrapper / refresh job | timeout只形成typed unavailable/failed adapter outcome；不得形成allow或Unknown comparison row | comparison reader与materialization writer均不得调用probe；本节不伪造超时值 |
| `SBX-CFG-I082 derivedMaintenance.batchSize` | `SandboxPageLimit` | derived/comparison maintenance job entry | startup ceiling与job input validation；只限制maintenance批量，不改变selector source set | query不得分页或截断caller selector；不把batch size当backend数量上限 |
| `SBX-CFG-I083 derivedMaintenance.comparisonScopeRef` | historical `OpaqueRef<ComparisonScope>`，仅为registered maintenance job scope | startup/job registry与maintenance job snapshot；不得进入public query request或selector factory | missing/unregistered可使job fail-fast/reject；scope只能选择已注册的maintenance candidate scope | **不得**作为`GetBackendCapabilityComparison` selector、current binding key、absence identity或all-backend scan依据；旧`comparison_scope_ref`路径登记为`invalidated_pending_step_14_revalidation` |
| derived maintenance cadence | typed cadence ref | job scheduler/entry | invalid cadence blocks scheduling;不伪造job已运行 | query不能触发maintenance或借cadence refresh |
| comparison retention policy | typed retention reference only when formally defined | retention/reconciliation owner | current target、audit/security/legal constraints先于删除；未定义时保持blocked/pending | 本轮不填TTL、日期、删除阈值或archive结果 |
| canonical source digest algorithm | unresolved implementation binding | canonical writer/verifier owner | 只有经`BLK-SBX-CANONICAL-001`关闭后才允许生成/验证digest | 不在config或fake中伪造hash算法、fixture digest或string concatenation |
| core repository `Version` codec | unresolved core binding | persistence/UoW builder | 只有经`BLK-SBX-VERSION-001`关闭后才可固定序列化/比较实现 | 不用timestamp、整数自增或config value替代core `Version` |

`I036`只约束已注册candidate universe；caller query仍必须显式提供ordered `BackendCapabilitySummaryRef`子集，并由
selector factory验证`1..=16`。`I083`即使仍存在于正式配置文档，也只能作为maintenance job scope binding；它不能扩大、
重排或替代caller source refs，也不能证明context、requirement、summary generation或access。配置读取失败、registry
unknown或adapter disabled只能阻止对应startup/maintenance能力，不能让query以Empty、Unknown或FullySupported继续。

###### 16.9.17.8.2 Runtime builder与external binding order

runtime builder必须按以下顺序装配，并在每一步保留typed failure boundary：

```text
load raw config
  -> validate typed config and I036 backend profile registry
  -> bind core clock / Version / UoW owner (exact version binding still open)
  -> bind requirement, reference-state, capability-summary and source-audit repositories
  -> bind comparison row / current-binding / exact-key index repositories
  -> bind canonical digest writer/verifier when blocker is closed
  -> bind read-only query facade (selector validation only; no config-driven source expansion)
  -> bind materialization writer and maintenance job scope (I083 applies here only)
  -> bind diagnostic / audit / relay hooks with redaction allowlist
  -> expose application entrypoints
```

任何必需binding缺失、wrong kind、disabled adapter、unsupported schema或source owner不兼容时，builder必须返回typed
startup/disabled outcome；不得安装一个“可用但默认全选backend”的fallback。query facade可以接收已经构造的access decision、
selector和read context，但不得持有backend adapter、profile scanner、maintenance scheduler或write UoW。

###### 16.9.17.8.3 External dependency boundary

| dependency family | binding form | data allowed across boundary | unavailable disposition | forbidden dependency direction |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| local requirement / truth owner | repository/UoW port | typed requirement ref、generation、body-free source snapshot、truth cursor | no-view/integrity or caller retry according owner | comparison不能拥有boundary truth或修改requirement |
| reference resolution owner | committed reference-state repository / accepted event consumer | reference state ref/status、backend source ref、safe summary ref、reference cursor、existing audit linkage | `Unresolved/Invalid/Unavailable` -> typed gap/no-view；不得现场resolver | query和comparison contracts不得调用live resolver |
| capability summary owner | committed summary repository / maintenance consumer | summary ref/status/reason、ten finite verdicts、generation、checked time、source audit linkage | missing/unavailable -> no-view;summary Unknown only from complete source | query和writer不得调用backend capability adapter |
| backend products / isolation adapters | runtime adapter port owned by source maintenance or boundary flow | typed adapter outcome only；不传raw SDK/body进入comparison | adapter unavailable/unsupported按source owner处理 | comparison不引入Docker/gVisor/Firecracker/k8s产品依赖 |
| audit owner | same-UoW source audit linkage and audit repository | typed existing `SandboxAuditTraceRef`与approved source metadata | linkage unavailable blocks materialization;query hook failure不回滚view | view不能成为audit subject或伪造business audit |
| observability owner | bounded diagnostic/metric hook | low-cardinality operation/surface/status/gap/error/outcome classes | hook failure isolated;不改变business result | 不把observability store或raw logs作为comparison source |
| sibling runtime/tools/member services | runtime/event/fixture seams only | typed refs、safe summaries、event receipts | missing sibling -> fake/wait/design blocker | 不添加跨仓Rust path dependency；不引入tools semantic execution、runtime loop或member lifecycle |

Step 14必须把上述依赖逐项映射到既有`03_ddd_step_14_config_external_binding.md`的config section、startup validator、
runtime builder和adapter table；不能以`comparisonScopeRef`或某个fixture值代替source owner。不存在的外部仓库、digest实现、
version codec、retention数值和真实profile registry继续登记为开放事实，不得写成已绑定。

###### 16.9.17.8.4 Config negative cuts and handoff

必须至少登记以下negative cuts：I036空/重复/17项/wrong-kind；I083缺失或未注册；query request带scope-only或scope与
explicit refs冲突；config profile扩大caller set；disabled adapter被当作visible source；retention配置会先删current row；
digest/version codec未绑定却生成candidate；fake config默认summary掩盖source gap。每个cut都必须指向startup、job、query或
writer的唯一owner和typed result。

Step 14停审条件是config key/type/owner/read point/validation/失败策略、I036上限依据、I083 query禁用、runtime builder
顺序、external adapter绑定、cross-repo裁剪、retention/digest/version开放项和fake/config parity均闭合。受影响planned
boundary为`CB-SBX-03A`、`CB-SBX-03B`、`CB-SBX-09A`、`CB-SBX-09B`、`CB-SBX-11B`、`CB-SBX-12B`、`CB-SBX-14A`、
`CB-SBX-14B`，状态保持`downstream_revalidation_pending`。

##### 16.9.17.9 Step 15 Observability / Audit

Step 15必须把comparison的source maintenance audit、writer outcome、query diagnostic、metric和security redaction
分成不同载体。任何一次query读取都不是`SandboxAuditTrace`业务事件；view row只链接source owner已经提交的audit，不能
为了“可追踪”追加view-specific business audit。

###### 16.9.17.9.1 Logging and diagnostic hooks

| hook location | allowed fields | purpose | forbidden fields / behavior | failure rule |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| query access/validation rejection | operation class、validation/error class、surface class（不含存在性细节） | 识别请求形状或权限失败 | context/requirement/summary/view ref、scope、digest、actor敏感细节、reason正文 | hook失败不改变Validation/NotVisible结果 |
| query lookup completion | operation、surface（Visible/Stale/Degraded/Empty/Unavailable）、aggregate class、gap class、bounded row count、absence-hit bool | 低基数读面诊断 | exact selector、row/source IDs、backend name、cursor、timestamps、requirement值、body | 不重试、不写repair、不追加business audit |
| final factory rejection | contracts error variant class、redacted source family、integrity flag | 设计/数据闭环诊断 | raw row/SQL/codec/body/host/path/stack with secret | no-view；hook单独失败不掩盖typed error |
| writer preflight/commit outcome | operation、expectation kind、Committed/DuplicateEquivalent/conflict class、write-set class、commit-unknown bool | maintenance reliability | candidate payload、view ref、full digest、Version、audit ref、source reason正文 | writer outcome先由UoW确定；hook失败不回滚commit |
| reconciliation | issue class、current/historical cardinality class、quarantine class、report outcome | 对账运维入口 | exact key、row IDs、full source refs、raw store record | 只写专用report/audit owner；不得由query修复 |

`row count`在diagnostic中只能使用bounded class或经审查的低基数范围，不记录exact key、current target ref或历史row列表。
absence命中也不得泄漏access未允许的exact existence；access denial在任何comparison diagnostic前结束。

###### 16.9.17.9.2 Metrics

允许的metric维度固定为有限枚举：`operation_kind`、`surface_class`、`aggregate_class`、`gap_class`、`error_class`、
`expectation_kind`、`write_outcome_class`、`source_count_bucket`和`current/historical_cardinality_class`。不得把
context、requirement、summary、view、digest、backend product、host、path、PID、cursor、timestamp或reason正文作为label。

至少登记以下metric切口，但不填阈值、告警策略或执行结果：

| metric family | increment point | semantic distinction |
|---|---|---|
| comparison query outcome | public mapping完成后 | Visible/Stale/Degraded/Empty/Unavailable/NotVisible/Restricted分别计数；不把Unsupported/Unknown当技术失败 |
| comparison source gap | reader分类后 | Requirement/Binding/Row/Capability/CurrentCoverage/Relation按closed kind计数 |
| comparison cardinality integrity | exact index relation分类后 | absence、valid-present、historical-present、orphan、half-commit、duplicate-current/target |
| materialization outcome | writer UoW结束后 | Committed、DuplicateEquivalent、VersionConflict、Integrity、CommitUnknown |
| query side-effect guard | protected call boundary | backend-call、write-attempt、audit-append、identity-allocation violation；只用于实现缺陷诊断 |
| redaction/body-free guard | mapper/factory/repository boundary | forbidden body、unknown enum、sensitive label attempt；不记录正文 |

###### 16.9.17.9.3 Audit linkage and event boundary

| event / audit subject | owner | allowed linkage | comparison rule |
|---|---|---|---|
| accepted backend capability summary/reference maintenance | source owner | existing source audit ref、source cursor、accepted status/reason class | comparison row可复制/链接；不得创建boundary-established audit |
| comparison materialization writer | maintenance/source owner | 必要source mutation audit linkage与writer outcome reference（若既有audit schema允许） | row/binding只能与既有approved linkage同UoW提交；view不是新业务subject |
| `ConsumeBackendCapabilitySummaryChanged` | consumer owner | typed receipt、affected refs、projection/derived stale marker；trace ref按shared rule可为None | consumer不得建立comparison view或boundary accepted audit |
| comparison query | query owner | 仅低基数 diagnostic/metric hook | business `SandboxAuditTrace` append固定为0；不写relay、stored result或audit trace |
| reconciliation of orphan/commit-unknown | reconciliation owner | report/audit subject为reconciliation issue，而不是query/view | report记录safe issue class；不回写source或current binding |

audit fields若存在必须经过shared subject mapper和redaction allowlist。禁止记录完整selector、source-set digest、view ref、
current binding key、raw reason、requirement values、capability body、adapter response、host/path/endpoint/PID、artifact/log/
metric正文或credential。diagnostic hook不是audit authority，也不能改变retry、surface或writer outcome。

###### 16.9.17.9.4 Observability停审条件

Step 15停审要求：每个query/writer/reconciliation入口有hook时点、字段allowlist、cardinality规则、redaction负向清单、
audit owner和hook failure behavior；必须证明query business-audit append=`0`、writer不伪造view-specific audit、source audit
linkage不被丢失、metrics不泄漏typed refs。受影响planned boundary为`CB-SBX-02A`、`CB-SBX-09A`、`CB-SBX-09B`、
`CB-SBX-11B`、`CB-SBX-11C`、`CB-SBX-12A`，状态保持`downstream_revalidation_pending`。

fixture shape、assertion和negative branch；不得把多项合成一个happy-path snapshot。

| `comparison_item_truth_table` | 十个`BoundaryLimitKind`上的Supported/Unsupported/Unknown | Supported有proof无reason；Unsupported有proof和reason；Unknown无proof有reason | raw reason/body、重复/缺kind、错误proof/reason presence拒绝 |
| `comparison_backend_row_integrity` | 四种summary status、十项完整items、counts、generation、双cursor、audit/time | ordered ten dimensions；count总和=10；status/reason与source owner全等 | Fresh带reason、Unsupported全Supported、Unknown无Unknown item、count伪造拒绝 |

### 16.10 `SandboxReconciliationReport` current canonical contract

本节是 `6R-04` batch 6 的 `SandboxReconciliationReport` canonical section。它承接
`SandboxTruthRefSet`、`SandboxProjectionRefSet`、`SandboxTruthCursor`、
`SandboxReferenceCursor`、`SandboxAuditTraceRef` 和
`SandboxSourceFactRef::ReconciliationReport` 的既有 owner，不复制这些 shared type。

本对象只提供一个以已提交快照为依据的只读对账报告。它可以记录 core truth、projection、
handoff、relay 和 derived material 之间的关系异常，也可以明确报告依赖缺失或对账执行失败；
它不能修复任何 truth、projection、handoff、relay 或 derived state。Query 只能按 exact
`SandboxReconciliationReportRef` 读取已物化报告；Operations Job 才能从受信任的显式 scope
生成新报告。scope 不是 Sandbox repository object，不进入 `SandboxObjectRefKind`，也不
提供 `get(scope_ref)`、latest scan 或字符串解析路径。

#### 16.10.1 Capability、owner、范围与 historical invalidation

| 项 | current canonical conclusion |
|---|---|
| canonical named owner | `SandboxReconciliationReport` 唯一归属 `crates/contracts/src/views.rs`；`SandboxReconciliationReportRef` 复用 `6R-01` named wrapper。 |
| support owner | scope、snapshot、coverage、finding、lookup outcome、report error 和 job/query carrier 均属于本节 support family #41；不新增独立 repository truth。 |
| capability | 对一组显式、已提交、同一 watermark 的 Sandbox truth / projection identities 做关系检查并生成 immutable report。 |
| accepted source | 只能消费已提交 Sandbox truth、projection、handoff、relay、derived identity 和 safe summary；不得读取外部正文或 backend SDK raw response。 |
| write authority | 仅 materialization job 可写 immutable report row、current binding、finding linkage 和报告审计 linkage；query write set 恒为零。 |
| repair authority | 无。任何修复必须回到 owning truth、projection rebuild、relay、handoff、cleanup 或 redline flow；report 不调用 repair、refresh、release、reaper 或 backend launch。 |
| status owner | 继续唯一复用 `SandboxReconciliationReportStatus::{Clean, IssuesFound, Degraded, Failed}`；不得定义 `ReconciliationReportStatus` alias、`VisibleReconciliationStatus` 或 `DerivedFreshnessStatus`。 |
| object identity | 只有 `SandboxReconciliationReportRef` 是可持久化 report identity；finding key 和 scope ref 都是 report-local typed value，不是 `SandboxObjectRef`。 |
| body boundary | report、finding、scope、snapshot 只能保存 refs、cursor、finite kind、safe reason、coverage、timestamp 和 audit linkage；path、URL、host、process、network、artifact/evidence body、observability body、policy正文和 SDK response 均禁止进入。 |

旧材料中的以下形式全部登记为 `historical_invalidated_pending_step_7_8_revalidation`，不提供
兼容 alias 或 fallback：

| historical pattern | invalidation reason | current replacement |
|---|---|---|
| `SandboxOpaqueRef` 作为 scope identity | 无法判断 scope 是否是对象 ref、是否可作为 repository key，也无法阻止 scope-only latest scan。 | `SandboxReconciliationScopeRef` value carrier；显式 context + typed target sets。 |
| `SandboxOpaqueRef` 作为 finding identity | finding 无法回指所属 report、ordinal 或 target kind。 | `SandboxReconciliationFindingRef`，由 report ref + non-zero ordinal 构成。 |
| `Vec<SandboxOpaqueRef>` truth / projection / finding 集合 | 丢失 closed union、wrong-kind reject、duplicate 和 body-free边界。 | `SandboxTruthRefSet`、`SandboxProjectionRefSet`、`SandboxReconciliationFindingSet`。 |
| `SandboxReconciliationSnapshotItem` | item schema 未定义 source owner、coverage、cursor 和 same-snapshot proof；实现者会自行拼 latest row。 | 完整 `SandboxReconciliationSourceSnapshot`；分页只作为 Step 7 reader carrier，不能成为第二 truth。 |
| `target_kinds = empty => all supported` | 空选择器等价于隐式全量扫描，无法审计本次 job 的范围。 | scope 内显式 typed ref sets；空 set 只有在 coverage 明确证明 `CompleteEmpty` 时有效。 |
| `save_reconciliation_report(report)` generic latest write | 缺少 immutable report ref、current binding、expected version 和 source audit linkage。 | Step 7 定义 typed report writer；本节先固定 writer 输入和关系。 |

本对象不承接隔离执行、resource limits、filesystem/network/process boundary、tool/runtime
launch policy、artifact capture truth、observability store、core failure classification、
cleanup/lease/reaper、security redline transition、tools semantic execution、runtime agent
loop 或 member lifecycle orchestration。报告中的 finding 只能指出这些 owner 的已提交关系缺口，
不能替代这些 owner。

#### 16.10.2 `SandboxReconciliationScopeRef`：非 object-kind 的 typed value carrier

HLD 使用了 `SandboxReconciliationScopeRef` 名称，本轮保留名称以维持上游语义，但明确它
不是 `SandboxObjectRef` 的 named wrapper。它没有对应的 `SandboxObjectRefKind` variant，
不能实现 `Into<SandboxObjectRef>`，不能由 `ResourceRef` 或字符串构造，不能作为任意
repository 的主键。其 equality 是字段等值，不是对某个外部 scope registry 的推断。

```rust
/// 对账 job/query 使用的显式 Sandbox-local 范围值；不是 repository object identity。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq, Serialize)]
pub struct SandboxReconciliationScopeRef {
    /// 对账范围所属的受控执行语境锚点。
    context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
    /// 本次对账明确选择的 truth identities；空集合表示当前已知没有 truth target。
    truth_refs: SandboxTruthRefSet,
    /// 本次对账明确选择的 projection/read-side identities；空集合表示当前已知没有 projection target。
    projection_refs: SandboxProjectionRefSet,
}

#[derive(Deserialize)]
struct SandboxReconciliationScopeRefWire {
    context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
    truth_refs: SandboxTruthRefSet,
    projection_refs: SandboxProjectionRefSet,
}

impl<'de> Deserialize<'de> for SandboxReconciliationScopeRef {
    fn deserialize<D>(deserializer: D) -> Result<Self, D::Error>
    where
        D: serde::Deserializer<'de>,
    {
        let wire = SandboxReconciliationScopeRefWire::deserialize(deserializer)?;
        Self::try_from_explicit_targets(wire.context_ref, wire.truth_refs, wire.projection_refs)
            .map_err(|_| serde::de::Error::custom("invalid sandbox reconciliation scope"))
    }
}

impl SandboxReconciliationScopeRef {
    /// 从受信任的 explicit target selection 构造 scope；不执行 repository read 或 target expansion。
    pub fn try_from_explicit_targets(
        context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
        truth_refs: SandboxTruthRefSet,
        projection_refs: SandboxProjectionRefSet,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxReconciliationScopeError>;

    /// 返回 scope 的 context anchor；不得从任一 member ref 反向推导。
    pub fn context_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionContextRef;

    /// 返回 explicit truth targets；调用方不得绕过 set invariant 修改。
    pub fn truth_refs(&self) -> &SandboxTruthRefSet;

    /// 返回 explicit projection targets；调用方不得绕过 set invariant 修改。
    pub fn projection_refs(&self) -> &SandboxProjectionRefSet;

    /// 判断两个 scope 是否字段完全相等；不比较 report ref、时间或 repository version。
    pub fn same_scope(&self, other: &Self) -> bool;

    /// 判断 scope 是否没有任何 explicit target；此结果不能单独构造 Clean report。
    pub fn has_no_explicit_targets(&self) -> bool;

    /// 返回 scope 中 truth 与 projection target 的总数量。
    pub fn target_count(&self) -> usize;
}

/// `SandboxReconciliationScopeRef` 的字段关系和 explicit-selection 错误。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum SandboxReconciliationScopeError {
    /// scope 试图把历史 reconciliation report 当作本次检查 target，形成 report-on-report 循环。
    ReconciliationReportTargetForbidden,
}
```

`try_from_explicit_targets` 依赖 nested named ref / set 已完成 shape 校验；它不读取 member body，
也不从 member ref 文本解析 context。它唯一额外拒绝
`SandboxProjectionRef::SandboxReconciliationReport`，防止 report-on-report、自引用 finding 和
递归 retention 链。member 与 context 的 lineage 只能由 source reader 加载 owner snapshot 后通过
`SandboxReconciliationTargetBinding` 证明，不能由 scope constructor 假装验证。空 truth set、
空 projection set 或两者同时为空均允许存在，但只有完整 coverage 才能证明检查已完成；空集合
不能被解释为 `Clean`、`NoIssue` 或 `NotFound`。

scope 的不可变性规则如下：

| 规则 | exact contract |
|---|---|
| selector completeness | 所有 target 必须在 scope 中显式出现；不得有 `all`、empty-means-all、wildcard、latest 或 implicit current。 |
| context ownership | context 是独立字段；不得从 truth/projection ref、report ref 或 audit ref 反推。 |
| identity | scope equality 使用 context + 两个 typed set 的 ordered identity；不使用字符串拼接、digest 猜测或 timestamp。 |
| persistence | scope 可作为 report 的 value snapshot 保存，但不能单独保存为 object row、current binding 或 repository key。 |
| mutation | 没有 `add_target`、`remove_target`、`expand_all`、`refresh` 或 `repair` 方法；范围变化必须形成新的 job input。 |

#### 16.10.3 Exact report selector 与 source selection proof

报告读取和报告生成必须拆开。Query 只读取已生成 report；Job 读取 explicit scope 并生成新的
immutable report。两个入口不能共享一个“scope 或 report ref 任意一个可用”的宽松 selector。

```rust
/// Query 读取已物化 reconciliation report 的唯一 selector。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct SandboxReconciliationReportSelector {
    /// 必须是已生成或已持久化的 typed report ref；不接受 scope-only 查询。
    report_ref: SandboxReconciliationReportRef,
}

impl SandboxReconciliationReportSelector {
    /// 从 exact report ref 构造 selector；空或 wrong-kind ref 由 named wrapper 拒绝。
    pub fn try_new(
        report_ref: SandboxReconciliationReportRef,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxReconciliationSelectorError>;

    /// 返回唯一 query key。
    pub fn report_ref(&self) -> &SandboxReconciliationReportRef;
}

/// Job source selection 的 transient proof；不是 public DTO，也不是 persisted identity。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct SandboxReconciliationSelectionProof {
    /// 已冻结的显式对账范围；不得在 selection 阶段扩张或缩减。
    scope: SandboxReconciliationScopeRef,
    /// 与 scope 完全相等且保持原顺序的 truth target 集合。
    selected_truth_refs: SandboxTruthRefSet,
    /// 与 scope 完全相等且保持原顺序的 projection target 集合。
    selected_projection_refs: SandboxProjectionRefSet,
}

impl SandboxReconciliationSelectionProof {
    /// 只接受与 scope 两个 target set 完全相等的 explicit selection。
    pub fn try_new(
        scope: SandboxReconciliationScopeRef,
        selected_truth_refs: SandboxTruthRefSet,
        selected_projection_refs: SandboxProjectionRefSet,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxReconciliationSelectionError>;

    /// 返回经过等值校验的 scope。
    pub fn scope(&self) -> &SandboxReconciliationScopeRef;

    /// 返回 selected truth refs；不得通过此 carrier 扩展 scope。
    pub fn selected_truth_refs(&self) -> &SandboxTruthRefSet;

    /// 返回 selected projection refs；不得通过此 carrier 扩展 scope。
    pub fn selected_projection_refs(&self) -> &SandboxProjectionRefSet;
}

/// 对账 selector 的错误；不回显原始 ref 或 scope body。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum SandboxReconciliationSelectorError {
    /// report ref 不是已登记的 reconciliation report kind。
    WrongReportRefKind,
    /// report ref 不满足 named wrapper 的非空约束。
    EmptyReportRef,
    /// public query 试图使用 scope、target kind 或 latest selector。
    ScopeOnlyQueryForbidden,
}

/// Job selection 与 scope 关系错误。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum SandboxReconciliationSelectionError {
    /// selected truth refs 与 scope truth refs 不完全相等。
    TruthSelectionMismatch,
    /// selected projection refs 与 scope projection refs 不完全相等。
    ProjectionSelectionMismatch,
    /// scope 被隐式扩展或缩小。
    ImplicitScopeExpansion,
}
```

Query 的 exact contract 是 `SandboxReconciliationReportSelector { report_ref }`。以下输入均必须
在 entry 或 application validation 阶段拒绝：只有 scope、只有 target kind、空 selector、从
scope 推导 latest report、从 context 查“当前报告”或用 report ref 与另一个 scope 静默择一。Query
不得因此读取 scope member、刷新 source、创建 cursor、追加 audit 或执行 job。

Job 的 selection proof 必须由 trusted application input 构造；`selected_*_refs` 与 scope 内的
两个 set 逐项等值。它不能通过配置 I083 的 comparison scope、I085 cadence、page limit 或任何
字符串扩展本次 reconciliation target。`I085` 只决定 job 是否注册 / 调度，不能改变 selection
内容；I083 只属于 backend comparison，不能成为 reconciliation scope。

##### 16.10.3.1 Checked target、lineage binding 与 committed read proof

`SandboxTruthRefSet` 与 `SandboxProjectionRefSet` 只保存 identity，不能证明 target row 存在、
属于 scope context 或处于哪一个 cursor。source reader 必须把每个已检查 target 映射为以下 closed
observation。`Missing` 与 `RelationInvalid` 是完整检查得到的异常结果，可形成 finding；它们不同于
coverage 的 `Partial / Unavailable / Failed`，后者表示该 target 尚未完成检查。

```rust
/// reconciliation 可检查的 truth / projection target identity 闭集。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum SandboxReconciliationTargetRef {
    /// core / safety / reference truth target。
    Truth(SandboxTruthRef),
    /// projection / view / audit / relay / derived target。
    Projection(SandboxProjectionRef),
}

impl SandboxReconciliationTargetRef {
    /// 返回底层已登记 object kind；只用于 integrity comparison，不用于 generic repository read。
    pub fn object_kind(&self) -> SandboxObjectRefKind;

    /// 返回 target 对应的五类 coverage channel。
    pub fn coverage_kind(&self) -> SandboxReconciliationCoverageKind;

    /// 返回 generic object ref 副本；repository 仍必须使用 named ref callable。
    pub fn as_object_ref(&self) -> SandboxObjectRef;

    /// 判断 target 是否为本节禁止的 reconciliation-report recursive target。
    pub fn is_reconciliation_report(&self) -> bool;

    /// 返回该 owner 是否在 canonical object 上拥有 source audit linkage 字段。
    pub fn source_audit_requirement(&self) -> SandboxReconciliationSourceAuditRequirement;
}

/// target owner 对 source audit linkage 的 closed requiredness；不是 audit 状态机。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum SandboxReconciliationSourceAuditRequirement {
    /// canonical owner 有 audit linkage 字段；Present binding 必须复制 exact ref。
    Required,
    /// canonical owner 不拥有独立 audit linkage；不得为满足 reconciliation 伪造 ref。
    NotOwned,
}

/// 已存在 target row 与 scope context、source cursor及owner-declared linkage的body-free binding。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct SandboxReconciliationTargetBinding {
    /// 被检查的 exact target identity。
    target_ref: SandboxReconciliationTargetRef,
    /// owner snapshot 明确提供的 context anchor。
    context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
    /// target 依赖的 committed truth cursor；纯 reference-side target 可为空。
    source_truth_cursor: Option<SandboxTruthCursor>,
    /// target 依赖的 committed reference/projection cursor；纯 truth target 可为空。
    source_reference_cursor: Option<SandboxReferenceCursor>,
    /// target owner 已有的 source audit linkage；`NotOwned` owner 必须为空。
    source_audit_trace_ref: Option<SandboxAuditTraceRef>,
    /// owner snapshot 明确声明的 body-free relation refs；不从 target ref 文本推导。
    relation_refs: SandboxReconciliationRelationRefSet,
}

impl SandboxReconciliationTargetBinding {
    /// 从同一 committed read transaction 的 owner snapshot 构造 binding。
    pub fn try_from_committed_target(
        target_ref: SandboxReconciliationTargetRef,
        context_ref: ControlledExecutionContextRef,
        source_truth_cursor: Option<SandboxTruthCursor>,
        source_reference_cursor: Option<SandboxReferenceCursor>,
        source_audit_trace_ref: Option<SandboxAuditTraceRef>,
        relation_refs: SandboxReconciliationRelationRefSet,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxReconciliationTargetBindingError>;

    /// 返回 exact target identity。
    pub fn target_ref(&self) -> &SandboxReconciliationTargetRef;

    /// 返回 owner-provided context anchor。
    pub fn context_ref(&self) -> &ControlledExecutionContextRef;

    /// 返回 optional truth cursor。
    pub fn source_truth_cursor(&self) -> Option<SandboxTruthCursor>;

    /// 返回 optional reference cursor。
    pub fn source_reference_cursor(&self) -> Option<SandboxReferenceCursor>;

    /// 返回 owner 已有的 source audit linkage；owner不拥有该字段时为`None`。
    pub fn source_audit_trace_ref(&self) -> Option<&SandboxAuditTraceRef>;

    /// 返回 owner snapshot 已声明的 closed relation refs。
    pub fn relation_refs(&self) -> &SandboxReconciliationRelationRefSet;
}

/// 单个 target 的已检查观察；不是 persisted target state。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum SandboxReconciliationTargetObservation {
    /// target row存在，lineage / cursor与owner-required linkage完整。
    Present(SandboxReconciliationTargetBinding),
    /// exact target 已检查但不存在；该结果必须转成 finding。
    Missing {
        /// 不存在的 exact target。
        target_ref: SandboxReconciliationTargetRef,
        /// 脱敏、稳定的 missing 原因。
        reason: SandboxReason,
    },
    /// target row存在，但与 scope context、cursor或owner关系冲突。
    RelationInvalid {
        /// 关系不合法的 exact target。
        target_ref: SandboxReconciliationTargetRef,
        /// source reader已分类的有限invalidity；不得从reason文本反推。
        invalidity_kind: SandboxReconciliationTargetInvalidityKind,
        /// 脱敏、稳定的 relation 原因。
        reason: SandboxReason,
    },
}

impl SandboxReconciliationTargetObservation {
    /// 返回 observation 的 exact target identity。
    pub fn target_ref(&self) -> &SandboxReconciliationTargetRef;

    /// 返回 observation kind；不返回可扩展字符串。
    pub fn kind(&self) -> SandboxReconciliationTargetObservationKind;

    /// 返回 Present binding；Missing / RelationInvalid 为 None。
    pub fn binding(&self) -> Option<&SandboxReconciliationTargetBinding>;

    /// 返回RelationInvalid的有限invalidity；其它observation为None。
    pub fn invalidity_kind(&self) -> Option<SandboxReconciliationTargetInvalidityKind>;

    /// 返回异常观察的安全原因；Present 为 None。
    pub fn reason(&self) -> Option<&SandboxReason>;

    /// 返回该单target observation唯一对应的finding kind；Present为None。
    pub fn expected_finding_kind(&self) -> Option<SandboxReconciliationFindingKind>;
}

/// target observation 的有限类别。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum SandboxReconciliationTargetObservationKind {
    /// target 存在且关系完整。
    Present,
    /// target 已检查但不存在。
    Missing,
    /// target 存在但关系无效。
    RelationInvalid,
}

/// 已检查target无法形成Present binding的有限原因；不是自由扩展error code。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum SandboxReconciliationTargetInvalidityKind {
    /// row存在，但owner-provided context / execution lineage与scope冲突。
    ContextLineage,
    /// canonical owner要求的source audit linkage缺失，或NotOwned owner携带伪造linkage。
    SourceAuditLinkage,
    /// target自身required cursor缺失、wrong-family或与committed row metadata冲突。
    CursorBinding,
    /// exact logical key存在multiple-current或half-commit binding。
    CurrentBinding,
    /// source reader检测到正文、secret、locator或raw diagnostic越过body-free边界。
    ForbiddenBodyBoundary,
}

impl SandboxReconciliationTargetInvalidityKind {
    /// 将有限invalidity机械映射为唯一finding kind。
    pub fn finding_kind(self) -> SandboxReconciliationFindingKind;
}

/// 按 scope target 顺序保存且不允许重复 target 的 observation 集合。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct SandboxReconciliationTargetObservationSet {
    /// 按 scope target 顺序保存的 ordered-unique observation。
    observations: Vec<SandboxReconciliationTargetObservation>,
}

impl SandboxReconciliationTargetObservationSet {
    /// 构造 ordered-unique observation set；空集合仅用于完整空 scope或全量 source gap。
    pub fn try_new(
        observations: Vec<SandboxReconciliationTargetObservation>,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxReconciliationTargetObservationSetError>;

    /// 返回只读 observation slice。
    pub fn as_slice(&self) -> &[SandboxReconciliationTargetObservation];

    /// 返回 observation 数量。
    pub fn len(&self) -> usize;

    /// 判断是否没有已检查 target observation。
    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool;

    /// 判断是否含 Missing / RelationInvalid observation。
    pub fn has_issue_observation(&self) -> bool;

    /// 按 exact target identity 返回唯一 observation。
    pub fn get(
        &self,
        target_ref: &SandboxReconciliationTargetRef,
    ) -> Option<&SandboxReconciliationTargetObservation>;

    /// 判断集合是否包含字段完全相等的 observation。
    pub fn contains_exact(&self, observation: &SandboxReconciliationTargetObservation) -> bool;
}

/// committed reader 交付的双 watermark 与 target observations。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct SandboxReconciliationCommittedReadProof {
    /// 本次公平读取覆盖的 committed truth high-watermark。
    truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
    /// 本次公平读取覆盖的 committed reference high-watermark。
    reference_cursor: SandboxReferenceCursor,
    /// 在同一读取事务中形成的完整 target observation 集合。
    observations: SandboxReconciliationTargetObservationSet,
}

impl SandboxReconciliationCommittedReadProof {
    /// 仅供同一公平 read transaction 的 source reader 形成 proof。
    pub fn try_from_committed_reader(
        truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
        reference_cursor: SandboxReferenceCursor,
        observations: SandboxReconciliationTargetObservationSet,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxReconciliationCommittedReadProofError>;

    /// 返回 read transaction 的 truth high-watermark。
    pub fn truth_cursor(&self) -> SandboxTruthCursor;

    /// 返回 read transaction 的 reference high-watermark。
    pub fn reference_cursor(&self) -> SandboxReferenceCursor;

    /// 返回该 transaction 中完成的 target observations。
    pub fn observations(&self) -> &SandboxReconciliationTargetObservationSet;
}

/// target binding 的局部关系错误。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum SandboxReconciliationTargetBindingError {
    /// truth/reference cursor 同时为空，无法证明 target 来自 committed source。
    MissingSourceCursor,
    /// target 是禁止递归检查的 reconciliation report。
    ReconciliationReportTargetForbidden,
    /// canonical owner要求source audit linkage，但binding没有提供。
    RequiredSourceAuditRefMissing,
    /// canonical owner不拥有source audit linkage，却传入了一个ref。
    UnexpectedSourceAuditRef,
    /// relation ref set 与 target owner family 不兼容。
    InvalidRelationRefSet,
}

/// observation set 的 duplicate / recursive target 错误。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum SandboxReconciliationTargetObservationSetError {
    /// 同一个 exact target 出现两次。
    DuplicateTargetObservation,
    /// observation 包含禁止递归检查的 reconciliation report。
    ReconciliationReportTargetForbidden,
}

/// committed read proof 的 watermark / binding 错误。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum SandboxReconciliationCommittedReadProofError {
    /// 任一 Present binding 的 truth cursor 超过 read transaction watermark。
    TruthCursorAheadOfWatermark,
    /// 任一 Present binding 的 reference cursor 超过 read transaction watermark。
    ReferenceCursorAheadOfWatermark,
    /// observations 未通过 ordered-unique validation。
    ObservationSetInvalid,
}
```

`source_audit_requirement()` 的返回值必须按 closed target union 穷尽实现，不能由 repository
schema、是否恰好查到 audit row 或配置开关动态决定：

| audit requirement | exact target members | binding rule |
|---|---|---|
| `NotOwned` | `ExecutionContextResolution`、`ContextReferenceResolution`、`BoundaryRequirementSet`、`BackendCapabilitySummary`、`PolicyApplicabilitySnapshot`、`SandboxAuditTrace` | canonical owner没有独立 source audit字段；`source_audit_trace_ref`必须为`None`。`SandboxAuditTrace`本身就是被检查target，不得自引用或找“audit of audit”。 |
| `Required` | 其余18类truth target；八类status view、`SandboxReadProjection`、`DerivedInspectPreviewTrendState`、`DerivedInspectPreviewTrendView`、`BackendCapabilityComparisonView`、`SandboxEventRelayRecord` | binding必须复制canonical owner / committed binding已有的exact audit ref；缺失、wrong relation或人为构造均不能形成`Present`。 |
| forbidden | `SandboxReconciliationReport` | 递归target在audit判断前即拒绝；不能借`NotOwned`绕过。 |

`Required` target找不到可信linkage时，source reader必须形成
`RelationInvalid { invalidity_kind: SourceAuditLinkage, ... }`；`NotOwned` target存在伪造linkage时也
形成同类invalid observation。`try_from_committed_target`只校验requiredness和typed shape；audit row
是否确实以该target为subject，仍由同一committed source reader验证。不存在“先填任意audit ref，
report writer以后补链”的路径。

coverage family 的机械映射固定为：`HandoffFact` target -> `Handoff`；
`SandboxEventRelayRecord` target -> `Relay`；`DerivedInspectPreviewTrendState`、
`DerivedInspectPreviewTrendView`、`BackendCapabilityComparisonView` target -> `Derived`；其余
`SandboxTruthRef` -> `Truth`；其余允许的 `SandboxProjectionRef` -> `Projection`。
`SandboxReconciliationReport` target始终拒绝。`Present` binding 的 context 必须在 source snapshot
factory 中等于 scope context；Missing / RelationInvalid 只能保存 typed target 和 safe reason，不能
保存损坏 row、raw SQL、SDK response 或正文片段。

#### 16.10.4 `SandboxReconciliationSourceSnapshot` 与 same-snapshot proof

Source snapshot 是 report factory 的唯一输入面。历史 `SandboxReconciliationSnapshotItem`、
逐 item latest lookup、先读 truth 再读 projection 的拼接路径均失效。reader 必须在一个公平
的 committed read transaction 中返回完整、body-free、同一 watermark 的 snapshot；无法形成
该 snapshot 时，job 只能返回 typed degraded/failed job outcome，不能伪造空集合或 Clean report。

```rust
/// 对账 source reader 在同一 committed read group 中形成的 body-free snapshot。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct SandboxReconciliationSourceSnapshot {
    /// 本次 snapshot 使用的显式 scope value。
    scope: SandboxReconciliationScopeRef,
    /// 在 scope 内实际完成检查的 truth identities；degraded snapshot 可为 scope truth refs 子集。
    checked_truth_refs: SandboxTruthRefSet,
    /// 在 scope 内实际完成检查的 projection/read-side identities；可为 scope projection refs 子集。
    checked_projection_refs: SandboxProjectionRefSet,
    /// 同一 committed read transaction 的双 watermark 与 target observations。
    read_proof: SandboxReconciliationCommittedReadProof,
    /// source reader在Present targets间完成的typed relation mismatch集合。
    relation_mismatches: SandboxReconciliationRelationMismatchSet,
    /// 五类 target family 的完整性与缺口证明。
    coverage: SandboxReconciliationCoverage,
    /// source reader 形成 snapshot 时的 application canonical time。
    observed_at: Timestamp,
}

impl SandboxReconciliationSourceSnapshot {
    /// 仅从 committed source reader 提供的全部 carrier 构造 snapshot；不读取 repository。
    pub fn try_new(
        scope: SandboxReconciliationScopeRef,
        checked_truth_refs: SandboxTruthRefSet,
        checked_projection_refs: SandboxProjectionRefSet,
        read_proof: SandboxReconciliationCommittedReadProof,
        relation_mismatches: SandboxReconciliationRelationMismatchSet,
        coverage: SandboxReconciliationCoverage,
        observed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxReconciliationSnapshotError>;

    /// 返回 explicit scope。
    pub fn scope(&self) -> &SandboxReconciliationScopeRef;

    /// 返回已检查 truth refs；不得作为 generic repository key。
    pub fn checked_truth_refs(&self) -> &SandboxTruthRefSet;

    /// 返回已检查 projection refs；不得作为 generic repository key。
    pub fn checked_projection_refs(&self) -> &SandboxProjectionRefSet;

    /// 返回 committed truth cursor。
    pub fn truth_cursor(&self) -> SandboxTruthCursor;

    /// 返回 committed reference cursor。
    pub fn reference_cursor(&self) -> SandboxReferenceCursor;

    /// 返回 committed read proof 与 target observations。
    pub fn read_proof(&self) -> &SandboxReconciliationCommittedReadProof;

    /// 返回同一snapshot内已验证的relation mismatches。
```
