```rust
    pub fn relation_mismatches(&self) -> &SandboxReconciliationRelationMismatchSet;

    /// 返回 coverage proof。
    pub fn coverage(&self) -> &SandboxReconciliationCoverage;

    /// 返回 source observation time。
    pub fn observed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;

    /// 判断两个 snapshot 是否使用完全相同的 scope、member set 和双 cursor。
    pub fn same_committed_snapshot(&self, other: &Self) -> bool;

    /// 判断该 snapshot 是否有完整 coverage；空 target 只有 `CompleteEmpty` 才算完整。
    pub fn has_complete_coverage(&self) -> bool;

    /// 判断该 snapshot 是否存在任一 degraded / unavailable / failed coverage channel。
    pub fn is_coverage_degraded(&self) -> bool;
}

/// source snapshot 的 shape、scope、cursor 和 coverage 关系错误。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum SandboxReconciliationSnapshotError {
    /// checked truth refs 不是 scope truth refs 的 identity 子集。
    TruthRefsOutsideScope,
    /// checked projection refs 不是 scope projection refs 的 identity 子集。
    ProjectionRefsOutsideScope,
    /// 双 cursor 不是合法 committed cursor。
    InvalidCommittedCursorPair,
    /// coverage entry 与两个 checked set 的 cardinality 不一致。
    CoverageCardinalityMismatch,
    /// observations 与 checked truth/projection sets 未做到一项一观察。
    ObservationCoverageMismatch,
    /// observations没有保持scope truth在前、projection在后的exact checked-target顺序。
    ObservationOrderMismatch,
    /// relation mismatch集合引用了非Present、scope外或未由owner声明的relation。
    RelationMismatchSetInvalid,
    /// Present target binding 的 context 与 scope context 不一致。
    TargetLineageMismatch,
    /// source observation time 不是合法 canonical timestamp。
    InvalidObservedAt,
}
```

`try_new` 的验证顺序固定为：

1. 验证 `truth_cursor` 和 `reference_cursor` 都来自 committed channel，且均非零；不接受
   `Version`、page cursor、timestamp、request id 或 job run id 替代。
2. 验证 `checked_truth_refs` / `checked_projection_refs` 分别是 scope 两个 set 的 identity 子集；
   超出 scope 表示隐式扩展，必须返回 typed error。只有 coverage 完整时才要求两组集合分别与
   scope 完全相等；degraded snapshot 可以保留诚实的已检查子集。
3. 验证 coverage 五个 channel 的 requested / checked / missing cardinality 与 checked sets
   和 scope 的闭合映射；不能只校验总数。
4. 验证 read proof 中每个 observation 与 checked sets 一一对应，顺序固定为
   `checked_truth_refs` 后接 `checked_projection_refs`；Present binding 的 context
   必须等于 scope context，binding cursor不得超过 proof high-watermark。read proof 必须由同一
   source reader transaction形成，domain 不解析 cursor 数字来猜测跨 transaction 同一性。
5. 最后验证 canonical `observed_at`。失败不降级为 `Degraded` report，而是拒绝 snapshot。

snapshot 只保存 identity 与 coverage，不保存任何 truth/projection body。`same_committed_snapshot`
比较 scope、两个 checked set、read proof observations、truth cursor 和 reference cursor；不比较 observed time，也不把
较新的 cursor 自动视为同一 snapshot。`has_complete_coverage()` 对每个 channel 只接受
`Complete` 或 `CompleteEmpty`；任何 `Partial`、`Unavailable` 或 `Failed` 都不是完整检查。

#### 16.10.5 Five-channel coverage contract

对账 coverage 不使用一个 `is_complete: bool`，因为该字段无法说明哪一类 source 缺失。当前闭合
五类 channel：core truth、projection/read surface、handoff、event relay、derived material。
它们分别对应不同 owner；一个 channel 的 unavailable 不得被另一个 channel 的空集合掩盖。

```rust
/// 对账覆盖证明的五类 source family。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum SandboxReconciliationCoverageKind {
    /// core truth identities 及其 canonical status / lineage。
    Truth,
    /// read projection、status view、audit / relay linkage identities。
    Projection,
    /// capture / handoff relation 与 handoff progress。
    Handoff,
    /// source fact 到 relay record 的传播关系。
    Relay,
    /// derived inspect / preview / trend / comparison material。
    Derived,
}

/// 单一 source family 的覆盖状态；不是 Sandbox persisted lifecycle state。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum SandboxReconciliationCoverageState {
    /// 有至少一个 requested target，且全部 target 已在同一 snapshot 中检查。
    Complete,
    /// requested target 数为零，且 source reader 明确证明该 channel 在 scope 内为空。
    CompleteEmpty,
    /// 只检查到部分 target，缺口仍可安全记录但不能宣称 Clean。
    Partial,
    /// source owner 不可用，无法完成该 channel 的读取。
    Unavailable,
    /// source owner 返回不可恢复的 typed failure；报告只能显式 Failed 或保留失败摘要。
    Failed,
}

/// 一个 coverage channel 的 cardinality 和安全原因摘要。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq, Serialize)]
pub struct SandboxReconciliationCoverageEntry {
    /// 覆盖的 source family。
    kind: SandboxReconciliationCoverageKind,
    /// 该 channel 的显式 requested target 数。
    requested_count: u32,
    /// 在本次 committed snapshot 中实际完成检查的 target 数。
    checked_count: u32,
    /// 尚未检查的 target 数；必须等于 requested - checked（完整空 channel为零）。
    missing_count: u32,
    /// 当前 channel 的覆盖状态。
    state: SandboxReconciliationCoverageState,
    /// Partial / Unavailable / Failed 时的脱敏稳定原因。
    reason: Option<SandboxReason>,
}

impl SandboxReconciliationCoverageEntry {
    /// 构造单个 channel entry；校验 cardinality、state 和 reason 的关系。
    pub fn try_new(
        kind: SandboxReconciliationCoverageKind,
        requested_count: u32,
        checked_count: u32,
        missing_count: u32,
        state: SandboxReconciliationCoverageState,
        reason: Option<SandboxReason>,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxReconciliationCoverageEntryError>;

    /// 返回 channel kind。
    pub fn kind(&self) -> SandboxReconciliationCoverageKind;

    /// 返回 requested target 数。
    pub fn requested_count(&self) -> u32;

    /// 返回 checked target 数。
    pub fn checked_count(&self) -> u32;

    /// 返回 missing target 数。
    pub fn missing_count(&self) -> u32;

    /// 返回 coverage state。
    pub fn state(&self) -> SandboxReconciliationCoverageState;

    /// 返回安全原因；不返回 raw adapter error 或外部正文。
    pub fn reason(&self) -> Option<&SandboxReason>;

    /// 判断该 channel 是否完整。
    pub fn is_complete(&self) -> bool;

    /// 判断该 channel 是否造成 degraded / failed coverage。
    pub fn has_gap(&self) -> bool;
}

/// 五类 coverage entry 的 shape error。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum SandboxReconciliationCoverageEntryError {
    /// checked_count 大于 requested_count。
    CheckedExceedsRequested,
    /// missing_count 不等于 requested_count - checked_count。
    MissingCountMismatch,
    /// Complete channel 不是全量，或 CompleteEmpty 存在非零 target。
    CompleteStateCardinalityMismatch,
    /// Partial / Unavailable / Failed 缺少安全原因，或完整状态携带了错误原因。
    ReasonStateMismatch,
}

/// 固定包含 Truth / Projection / Handoff / Relay / Derived 五个 coverage channel。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq, Serialize)]
pub struct SandboxReconciliationCoverage {
    /// core truth coverage。
    truth: SandboxReconciliationCoverageEntry,
    /// projection/read-side coverage。
    projection: SandboxReconciliationCoverageEntry,
    /// capture/handoff relation coverage。
    handoff: SandboxReconciliationCoverageEntry,
    /// event relay relation coverage。
    relay: SandboxReconciliationCoverageEntry,
    /// derived material coverage。
    derived: SandboxReconciliationCoverageEntry,
}

impl SandboxReconciliationCoverage {
    /// 从五个唯一 channel entry 构造 coverage；顺序不影响固定字段 owner。
    pub fn try_new(
        truth: SandboxReconciliationCoverageEntry,
        projection: SandboxReconciliationCoverageEntry,
        handoff: SandboxReconciliationCoverageEntry,
        relay: SandboxReconciliationCoverageEntry,
        derived: SandboxReconciliationCoverageEntry,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxReconciliationCoverageError>;

    /// 返回指定 channel entry。
    pub fn entry(&self, kind: SandboxReconciliationCoverageKind)
        -> &SandboxReconciliationCoverageEntry;

    /// 判断五个 channel 是否全部为 Complete / CompleteEmpty。
    pub fn is_complete(&self) -> bool;

    /// 判断是否至少一个 channel 为 Partial / Unavailable / Failed。
    pub fn has_gap(&self) -> bool;

    /// 判断是否存在 source owner 明确返回 Failed。
    pub fn has_failed_channel(&self) -> bool;

    /// 返回五个 entry 的固定顺序；用于 report / DTO deterministic mapping。
    pub fn as_ordered_refs(&self) -> [&SandboxReconciliationCoverageEntry; 5];
}

/// coverage 五 channel 缺失、重复或错 kind 错误。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum SandboxReconciliationCoverageError {
    /// entry 的 kind 与其固定字段位置不一致。
    ChannelKindMismatch,
    /// 同一 channel 被重复提供。
    DuplicateChannel,
    /// 五个 channel 未全部提供。
    MissingChannel,
}
```

Coverage cardinality 规则固定如下：

| state | cardinality | reason | report implication |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Complete` | `requested_count > 0`，`checked_count == requested_count`，`missing_count == 0` | `None` | 可参与 `Clean` / `IssuesFound`。 |
| `CompleteEmpty` | 三个 count 均为 `0` | `None` | 只证明该 channel 已完成且为空，不单独证明无问题。 |
| `Partial` | `requested_count > checked_count`，`missing_count > 0` | 必须有 | 至少使 report `Degraded`；已发现 findings 不得丢失。 |
| `Unavailable` | count 可为零或已有部分结果，但 owner 不能完成读取 | 必须有 | report `Degraded`；不能映射成 `Clean` 或 `Empty`。 |
| `Failed` | count 由 source owner 提供，但检查不可恢复 | 必须有 | 由 report factory按失败上下文决定 `Failed`；不能静默降为 `Degraded`。 |

`CompleteEmpty` 必须来自 source reader 对 explicit scope 的完整枚举证明，而不是从
`SandboxTruthRefSet::is_empty()` 或 `SandboxProjectionRefSet::is_empty()` 机械推导。五个
channel 中任一 channel 缺失都会使 `SandboxReconciliationSourceSnapshot::has_complete_coverage()`
为 false。coverage entry 不拥有 lifecycle transition，不调用 resolver、backend、relay、
handoff、cleanup 或 reaper；它只记录 source reader 已经提供的结果。

本批只完成 scope / snapshot / coverage carrier 的设计闭口；Step 7 仍需定义 source reader 如何
产生五个 entry、如何在 fake/durable 中保持同一 snapshot proof，以及分页 / batch size 如何累积
而不产生 `SandboxReconciliationSnapshotItem` 第二真相。上述 reader 细节不得由实现者在
`SandboxDerivedRepository` 中自行补造。

#### 16.10.6 Closed relation refs、finding kind 与 severity

Finding 不保存任意字符串 target、generic `SandboxOpaqueRef` 或 raw row。跨对象 finding 的
secondary subject 必须来自 target binding 已声明的 relation refs。`SourceFact` 角色专门服务
relay source relation，可包含 `SandboxSourceFactRef::ReconciliationReport`，但这不把历史 report
升级为本次 scope target，也不读取 report body。

```rust
/// reconciliation finding 可引用的 secondary relation identity。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum SandboxReconciliationRelationRef {
    /// scope 内另一项已检查 target。
    CheckedTarget(SandboxReconciliationTargetRef),
    /// relay owner 已提交的 closed source fact identity。
    SourceFact(SandboxSourceFactRef),
}

impl SandboxReconciliationRelationRef {
    /// 返回 relation 的 generic object identity副本；不得用于 repository read。
    pub fn as_object_ref(&self) -> SandboxObjectRef;

    /// 判断 relation 是否为 relay source fact role。
    pub fn is_source_fact(&self) -> bool;

    /// 判断 relation 是否为 scope 内 checked target role。
    pub fn is_checked_target(&self) -> bool;
}

/// 按 owner snapshot 顺序保存且不允许 identity 冲突的 relation refs。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq, Serialize)]
pub struct SandboxReconciliationRelationRefSet {
    /// 按 owner snapshot 顺序保存的 ordered-unique relation refs。
    refs: Vec<SandboxReconciliationRelationRef>,
}

impl SandboxReconciliationRelationRefSet {
    /// 构造 ordered-unique relation set；空集合表示 owner 没有需对账的跨对象 relation。
    pub fn try_new(
        refs: Vec<SandboxReconciliationRelationRef>,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxReconciliationRelationRefSetError>;

    /// 返回只读 relation refs。
    pub fn as_slice(&self) -> &[SandboxReconciliationRelationRef];

    /// 判断集合是否包含 exact relation role 和 identity。
    pub fn contains(&self, relation_ref: &SandboxReconciliationRelationRef) -> bool;

    /// 判断集合是否为空。
    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool;
}

/// relation set 的 duplicate、identity collision 和 role 错误。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum SandboxReconciliationRelationRefSetError {
    /// exact relation ref 重复。
    DuplicateRelationRef,
    /// 不同 relation role 复用了同一底层 object identity。
    RelationIdentityCollision,
    /// relation 使用了本 owner family 不支持的 source fact / target kind。
    UnsupportedRelationRole,
}

/// 对账发现的有限类别；不允许实现侧扩展自由文本 kind。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum SandboxReconciliationFindingKind {
    /// explicit scope target 已检查但不存在。
    TargetMissing,
    /// target 存在但不属于 scope context 或 owner lineage。
    TargetLineageMismatch,
    /// 两项 core / safety truth 的正式关系不一致。
    TruthRelationMismatch,
    /// projection / status view 与其 owning truth 不一致。
    TruthProjectionMismatch,
    /// capture、material、run 与 handoff progress 关系不一致。
    HandoffRelationMismatch,
    /// relay record 与 closed source fact identity / cursor 关系不一致。
    RelaySourceMismatch,
    /// derived state/view/comparison 与其 source target 关系不一致。
    DerivedSourceMismatch,
    /// target / related target 的 committed cursor 关系回退或越界。
    CursorRelationMismatch,
    /// expected source audit linkage 缺失、wrong-kind 或不匹配。
    AuditLinkageMismatch,
    /// 同一 logical selector 出现多个 current binding 或 half-commit binding。
    CurrentBindingConflict,
    /// source reader 检出正文或敏感材料越过 body-free boundary；只保留安全 marker / reason。
    ForbiddenBodyBoundaryViolation,
}

/// Finding 对后续维护的影响级别；不改变 core execution truth。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum SandboxReconciliationFindingSeverity {
    /// 需要正式 owner flow 处理，但不阻止 report/query 读取。
    ActionRequired,
    /// 在 owner 修复前阻止受影响 projection/reconciliation maintenance；不自动终止或释放 execution。
    MaintenanceBlocking,
}

impl SandboxReconciliationFindingKind {
    /// 返回该 finding kind 唯一允许的 severity。
    pub fn required_severity(self) -> SandboxReconciliationFindingSeverity;

    /// 判断该 kind 是否必须有 secondary relation ref。
    pub fn requires_related_ref(self) -> bool;

    /// 判断该 kind 是否禁止 secondary relation ref。
    pub fn forbids_related_ref(self) -> bool;
}
```

Finding kind 与 target / related / severity 的 closed matrix 固定如下：

| finding kind | required primary | related ref | required severity | source observation / proof |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `TargetMissing` | 任一 scope target | 禁止 | `MaintenanceBlocking` | primary observation必须为`Missing`。 |
| `TargetLineageMismatch` | 任一 scope target | 禁止 | `MaintenanceBlocking` | primary observation必须为`RelationInvalid`。 |
| `TruthRelationMismatch` | `Truth` target | 必须是另一`CheckedTarget(Truth)` | `MaintenanceBlocking` | 两端都已检查；secondary必须出现在primary binding relation set。 |
| `TruthProjectionMismatch` | truth或projection任一端 | 必须是另一端的`CheckedTarget` | `ActionRequired` | 一端truth、一端projection；两端均在scope observations中。 |
| `HandoffRelationMismatch` | `HandoffFact`或handoff status view | capture/run/material/handoff checked target | `MaintenanceBlocking` | relation set明确包含secondary；不能从material key或status text推导。 |
| `RelaySourceMismatch` | `SandboxEventRelayRecord` | 必须是`SourceFact` | `ActionRequired` | relay binding relation set明确包含closed source fact。 |
| `DerivedSourceMismatch` | derived state/view/comparison target | 必须是`CheckedTarget` source | `ActionRequired` | secondary在scope中已检查，且由derived owner relation set声明。 |
| `CursorRelationMismatch` | 任一`Present` target | optional checked target | `MaintenanceBlocking` | primary / optional secondary cursor来自同一 read proof；不比较timestamp/version。 |
| `AuditLinkageMismatch` | 任一 target | 禁止 | `MaintenanceBlocking` | observation为`RelationInvalid`或source audit linkage验证失败。 |
| `CurrentBindingConflict` | projection/view/derived/relay target | 禁止 | `MaintenanceBlocking` | primary observation必须为`RelationInvalid(CurrentBinding)`；reader不选择winner。 |
| `ForbiddenBodyBoundaryViolation` | 检出越界marker的target | 禁止 | `MaintenanceBlocking` | 只允许safe reason；body、path、host、payload、secret本身不得进入finding。 |

`MaintenanceBlocking` 只阻止受影响的 read-side / reconciliation maintenance 继续把异常结果当成
健康状态；它不是 `FailureClassification`、`CleanupGuard` 或 `RedlineContainment` 的替代，不能
直接终止 run、释放 handle、关闭 context 或修改 policy decision。`ActionRequired` 也不是成功或
降级状态；report aggregate 仍由 coverage 与 finding set机械决定。

##### 16.10.6.1 Present-target relation mismatch proof

`Missing`与`RelationInvalid`已经是单target observation；两个都为`Present`的target之间仍可能存在
truth/projection、handoff、relay source、derived source或cursor关系不一致。该事实不能由finding
factory临时比较body，也不能只用两个ref和自由文本表示。source reader必须在同一read proof上先
形成以下typed mismatch，再由finding assembler逐项消费。

```rust
/// 两个已检查source roles之间的body-free relation mismatch。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct SandboxReconciliationRelationMismatch {
    /// owner relation所在的primary Present target。
    primary_target_ref: SandboxReconciliationTargetRef,
    /// primary binding中已声明的secondary relation；cursor mismatch允许为空。
    related_ref: Option<SandboxReconciliationRelationRef>,
    /// 仅允许六类cross-target finding kind。
    finding_kind: SandboxReconciliationFindingKind,
    /// source reader给出的已脱敏稳定原因。
    reason: SandboxReason,
}

impl SandboxReconciliationRelationMismatch {
    /// 从同一observation set中的Present binding及其declared relation构造mismatch。
    pub fn try_from_present_relation(
        primary_target_ref: SandboxReconciliationTargetRef,
        related_ref: Option<SandboxReconciliationRelationRef>,
        finding_kind: SandboxReconciliationFindingKind,
        reason: SandboxReason,
        observations: &SandboxReconciliationTargetObservationSet,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxReconciliationRelationMismatchError>;

    /// 返回primary target identity。
    pub fn primary_target_ref(&self) -> &SandboxReconciliationTargetRef;

    /// 返回optional secondary relation identity。
    pub fn related_ref(&self) -> Option<&SandboxReconciliationRelationRef>;

    /// 返回已验证的cross-target finding kind。
    pub fn finding_kind(&self) -> SandboxReconciliationFindingKind;

    /// 返回caller-safe mismatch reason；不得解析为kind或status。
    pub fn reason(&self) -> &SandboxReason;
}

/// 按source observation与declared relation顺序保存的relation mismatch集合。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct SandboxReconciliationRelationMismatchSet {
    /// 按 source observation 与 declared relation 顺序保存的 mismatch 集合。
    mismatches: Vec<SandboxReconciliationRelationMismatch>,
}

impl SandboxReconciliationRelationMismatchSet {
    /// 构造ordered-unique mismatch set，并重新验证全部Present relation。
    pub fn try_new(
        mismatches: Vec<SandboxReconciliationRelationMismatch>,
        observations: &SandboxReconciliationTargetObservationSet,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxReconciliationRelationMismatchSetError>;

    /// 返回canonical mismatch顺序。
    pub fn as_slice(&self) -> &[SandboxReconciliationRelationMismatch];

    /// 返回mismatch数量。
    pub fn len(&self) -> usize;

    /// 判断是否没有cross-target mismatch。
    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool;

    /// 判断集合是否包含字段完全相等的mismatch。
    pub fn contains_exact(&self, mismatch: &SandboxReconciliationRelationMismatch) -> bool;
}

/// relation mismatch的target、role、kind或source proof错误。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum SandboxReconciliationRelationMismatchError {
    /// primary不是同一observation set中的Present target。
    PrimaryTargetNotPresent,
    /// related checked target不在同一observation set中，或不是Present。
    RelatedTargetNotPresent,
    /// related ref没有出现在primary binding的owner-declared relation set中。
    RelatedRefNotDeclaredByOwner,
    /// finding kind不属于允许的六类cross-target mismatch。
    UnsupportedRelationFindingKind,
    /// finding kind与primary / related target family组合不一致。
    FindingTargetRoleMismatch,
    /// kind要求related ref但输入为空，或仅允许none的cursor分支出现非法role。
    RelatedRefCardinalityMismatch,
}

/// relation mismatch set的duplicate与canonical order错误。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum SandboxReconciliationRelationMismatchSetError {
    /// `(primary, kind, related-role-and-identity)`完全重复。
    DuplicateRelationMismatch,
    /// mismatch没有按observation、kind、declared relation的canonical顺序排列。
    RelationMismatchOrderInvalid,
    /// 任一mismatch无法在同一observation set中重新验证。
    RelationMismatchInvalid,
}
```

允许的六类关系固定为：`TruthRelationMismatch`、`TruthProjectionMismatch`、
`HandoffRelationMismatch`、`RelaySourceMismatch`、`DerivedSourceMismatch`和
`CursorRelationMismatch`。前五类必须有`related_ref`；`CursorRelationMismatch`允许`None`表示
primary自身的两个committed cursor关系无效，也允许一个owner-declared
`CheckedTarget`表示跨target cursor关系。`TargetMissing`、`TargetLineageMismatch`、
`AuditLinkageMismatch`、`CurrentBindingConflict`和`ForbiddenBodyBoundaryViolation`只能来自单target
observation，传入本factory必须返回`UnsupportedRelationFindingKind`。

canonical mismatch order不比较ref字符串：先按observations中的primary位置，再按
`SandboxReconciliationFindingKind`声明顺序，最后按primary binding的`relation_refs`位置；
`CursorRelationMismatch(None)`排在该primary的related cursor mismatch之前。set不静默排序、不去重，
这样fake与durable reader必须输出相同顺序，finding ordinal也不会因存储实现变化而漂移。

#### 16.10.7 `SandboxReconciliationFindingRef`、finding object 与 ordered set

Finding 是 report-local immutable value，不是第53类 `SandboxObjectRef`，也没有独立 latest index、
repository owner或lifecycle status。它的identity必须同时说明所属report与report内位置，避免旧
`SandboxOpaqueRef`让finding跨report复用、脱离source snapshot单独漂移。

```rust
use std::num::NonZeroU32;

/// 一个immutable reconciliation report内的1-based finding identity。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd, Serialize)]
pub struct SandboxReconciliationFindingRef {
    /// finding唯一所属的report identity。
    report_ref: SandboxReconciliationReportRef,
    /// report canonical finding stream中的1-based连续位置。
    ordinal: NonZeroU32,
}

#[derive(Deserialize)]
struct SandboxReconciliationFindingRefWire {
    report_ref: SandboxReconciliationReportRef,
    ordinal: u32,
}

impl<'de> Deserialize<'de> for SandboxReconciliationFindingRef {
    fn deserialize<D>(deserializer: D) -> Result<Self, D::Error>
    where
        D: serde::Deserializer<'de>,
    {
        let wire = SandboxReconciliationFindingRefWire::deserialize(deserializer)?;
        Self::try_new(wire.report_ref, wire.ordinal)
            .map_err(|_| serde::de::Error::custom("invalid sandbox reconciliation finding ref"))
    }
}

impl SandboxReconciliationFindingRef {
    /// 从exact report ref和非零1-based ordinal构造report-local identity。
    pub fn try_new(
        report_ref: SandboxReconciliationReportRef,
        ordinal: u32,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxReconciliationFindingRefError>;

    /// 返回owning report identity。
    pub fn report_ref(&self) -> &SandboxReconciliationReportRef;

    /// 返回1-based ordinal；不得转成字符串repository key。
    pub fn ordinal(&self) -> NonZeroU32;
}

/// finding ref的局部shape错误。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum SandboxReconciliationFindingRefError {
    /// ordinal为0；finding stream固定从1开始。
    ZeroOrdinal,
}

/// report中一个由committed source snapshot机械生成的body-free finding。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq, Serialize)]
pub struct SandboxReconciliationFinding {
    /// report-local immutable finding identity。
    finding_ref: SandboxReconciliationFindingRef,
    /// 发生缺失、invalidity或relation mismatch的primary target。
    primary_target_ref: SandboxReconciliationTargetRef,
    /// cross-target mismatch的owner-declared relation；单target finding必须为空。
    related_ref: Option<SandboxReconciliationRelationRef>,
    /// 有限finding类别；不从reason文本解析。
    finding_kind: SandboxReconciliationFindingKind,
    /// 由finding kind唯一派生的维护影响级别。
    severity: SandboxReconciliationFindingSeverity,
    /// source observation或typed mismatch提供的caller-safe原因。
    reason: SandboxReason,
    /// source snapshot的committed truth high-watermark。
    source_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
    /// source snapshot的committed reference high-watermark。
    source_reference_cursor: SandboxReferenceCursor,
    /// source reader形成snapshot的canonical observation time。
    observed_at: Timestamp,
}

impl SandboxReconciliationFinding {
    /// 从Missing或RelationInvalid observation机械映射单target finding。
    pub fn try_from_target_observation(
        finding_ref: SandboxReconciliationFindingRef,
        observation: &SandboxReconciliationTargetObservation,
        source: &SandboxReconciliationSourceSnapshot,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxReconciliationFindingError>;

    /// 从source snapshot中已登记的typed relation mismatch机械映射finding。
    pub fn try_from_relation_mismatch(
        finding_ref: SandboxReconciliationFindingRef,
        mismatch: &SandboxReconciliationRelationMismatch,
        source: &SandboxReconciliationSourceSnapshot,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxReconciliationFindingError>;

    /// 返回report-local finding identity。
    pub fn finding_ref(&self) -> &SandboxReconciliationFindingRef;

    /// 返回owning report identity。
    pub fn report_ref(&self) -> &SandboxReconciliationReportRef;

    /// 返回primary target identity。
    pub fn primary_target_ref(&self) -> &SandboxReconciliationTargetRef;

    /// 返回optional owner-declared related identity。
    pub fn related_ref(&self) -> Option<&SandboxReconciliationRelationRef>;

    /// 返回finite finding kind。
    pub fn finding_kind(&self) -> SandboxReconciliationFindingKind;

    /// 返回kind唯一确定的severity。
    pub fn severity(&self) -> SandboxReconciliationFindingSeverity;

    /// 返回caller-safe finding reason。
    pub fn reason(&self) -> &SandboxReason;

    /// 返回finding所属source snapshot的truth cursor。
    pub fn source_truth_cursor(&self) -> SandboxTruthCursor;

    /// 返回finding所属source snapshot的reference cursor。
    pub fn source_reference_cursor(&self) -> SandboxReferenceCursor;

    /// 返回source observation time。
    pub fn observed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;

    /// 判断finding是否阻断受影响maintenance继续宣称健康。
    pub fn is_maintenance_blocking(&self) -> bool;
}

/// 一个report的完整canonical finding stream；合法为空。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq, Serialize)]
pub struct SandboxReconciliationFindingSet {
    /// 按 source canonical order 保存的完整 finding stream。
    findings: Vec<SandboxReconciliationFinding>,
}

impl SandboxReconciliationFindingSet {
    /// 按source canonical order生成全部且仅生成应有findings。
    pub fn assemble_from_snapshot(
        report_ref: SandboxReconciliationReportRef,
        source: &SandboxReconciliationSourceSnapshot,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxReconciliationFindingSetError>;

    /// 从persisted report bundle重建set；重新执行identity、source与顺序校验。
    pub fn rehydrate(
        report_ref: &SandboxReconciliationReportRef,
        findings: Vec<SandboxReconciliationFinding>,
        source: &SandboxReconciliationSourceSnapshot,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxReconciliationFindingSetError>;

    /// 返回1-based ordinal对应的finding；ordinal不存在时为None。
    pub fn get(
        &self,
        finding_ref: &SandboxReconciliationFindingRef,
    ) -> Option<&SandboxReconciliationFinding>;

    /// 返回canonical finding stream。
    pub fn as_slice(&self) -> &[SandboxReconciliationFinding];

    /// 返回finding数量。
    pub fn len(&self) -> usize;

    /// 判断report是否没有finding。
    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool;

    /// 返回MaintenanceBlocking finding数量。
    pub fn maintenance_blocking_count(&self) -> usize;

    /// 返回ActionRequired finding数量。
    pub fn action_required_count(&self) -> usize;

    /// 判断是否存在至少一个MaintenanceBlocking finding。
    pub fn has_maintenance_blocking(&self) -> bool;
}

/// finding factory的source observation、relation和field-copy错误。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum SandboxReconciliationFindingError {
    /// Present observation本身没有finding；只有typed relation mismatch可引用Present target。
    PresentObservationHasNoFinding,
    /// 输入observation不在source snapshot中，或字段不完全相等。
    ObservationNotInSourceSnapshot,
    /// input relation mismatch不在source snapshot的canonical mismatch set中。
    RelationMismatchNotInSourceSnapshot,
    /// invalidity kind与primary target family不兼容。
    InvalidityTargetRoleMismatch,
    /// observation / mismatch映射出的kind与目标或related role不兼容。
    FindingTargetRoleMismatch,
    /// finding ref或source carrier不满足其typed shape。
    InvalidFindingIdentity,
}

/// finding set装配、ordinal、report ownership或rehydration完整性错误。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum SandboxReconciliationFindingSetError {
    /// source要求的finding数超过NonZeroU32可表达范围。
    FindingCountExceedsU32,
    /// 任一finding ref不属于输入report。
    FindingReportRefMismatch,
    /// ordinal不是从1开始连续递增，或与slice位置不一致。
    FindingOrdinalSequenceInvalid,
    /// finding ref或`(primary, kind, related)`语义键重复。
    DuplicateFinding,
    /// persisted finding数量与从source重新装配的canonical stream不同。
    CanonicalFindingCountMismatch,
    /// persisted finding字段与同ordinal canonical finding不完全相等。
    CanonicalFindingPayloadMismatch,
    /// 单个finding无法从source observation / mismatch构造。
    FindingAssemblyFailed,
}
```

`SandboxReconciliationFinding`不提供public arbitrary-field constructor、setter或standalone
`Deserialize`。持久化只能把它作为report bundle的一部分读取，再由report rehydration调用
`SandboxReconciliationFindingSet::rehydrate`；否则调用方可以改写severity、reason、cursor或ordinal，
制造不属于source snapshot的finding。`finding_ref`也不实现`Into<SandboxObjectRef>`，repository
不得提供`get_finding(finding_ref)`作为第二个aggregate读取面；query先按exact report ref读取report，
再在内存中使用`FindingSet::get`。

单target observation的映射闭集如下：

| observation | invalidity | finding kind | extra target restriction |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Missing` | n/a | `TargetMissing` | 任一合法scope target。 |
| `RelationInvalid` | `ContextLineage` | `TargetLineageMismatch` | 任一合法scope target。 |
| `RelationInvalid` | `SourceAuditLinkage` | `AuditLinkageMismatch` | 任一target；`Required`缺失或`NotOwned`伪造两种路径都保留该kind。 |
| `RelationInvalid` | `CursorBinding` | `CursorRelationMismatch` | 任一target；related固定为`None`。 |
| `RelationInvalid` | `CurrentBinding` | `CurrentBindingConflict` | 只允许projection/status-view/derived/relay target；truth target必须返回`InvalidityTargetRoleMismatch`。 |
| `RelationInvalid` | `ForbiddenBodyBoundary` | `ForbiddenBodyBoundaryViolation` | 任一target；reason不得包含被检出的正文。 |
| `Present` | n/a | none | 不生成单target finding；只消费§16.10.6.1中已登记的relation mismatch。 |

`assemble_from_snapshot`的算法固定为：

1. 按`read_proof.observations()`顺序逐target处理；`Missing/RelationInvalid`立即生成一个finding，
   `Present`则按`relation_mismatches`中该primary的canonical顺序生成零到多个finding。
2. 每成功生成一项才checked increment ordinal；第一项为1，最后一项等于`len()`。任何overflow在
   写入前返回`FindingCountExceedsU32`，不得截断、分页后重置或回绕。
3. finding的`severity`只调用`finding_kind.required_severity()`；两个cursor和`observed_at`只从
   source snapshot复制。caller不能传这些字段，也不能从target binding挑一个较新cursor。
4. coverage gap不生成finding。`Partial/Unavailable/Failed`没有exact target observation时只能保留在
   coverage和report状态中；不得用coverage reason合成`TargetMissing`或generic finding。
5. `rehydrate`先按输入source重新执行上述算法，再要求persisted stream与canonical stream长度、
   ordinal、report ref及全部字段逐项相等。它不静默排序、不修severity、不丢弃duplicate，也不接受
   “同kind/target但reason不同”作为等价。

因此一个已完成检查的missing target是finding，而一个尚未完成检查的coverage gap不是finding；
二者可同时存在于`Degraded`或`Failed`报告中，但不能相互替代。finding set只描述已证明的问题，
不声称未检查区域没有问题。

#### 16.10.8 Final `SandboxReconciliationReport` aggregate 与四状态构造规则

Report不接受public `report_status`参数。正常路径必须先有完整shape的
`SandboxReconciliationSourceSnapshot`，再机械装配finding set和status；只有source/snapshot/finding/
report assembly发生不可恢复失败且仍保有可信scope时，才允许走独立failure basis构造`Failed`。
technical timeout、repository unavailable若可安全表达为coverage `Unavailable`，结果是`Degraded`，
不能为了省略partial detail直接升级为`Failed`。

##### 16.10.8.1 Unrecoverable assembly failure basis

```rust
/// 无法形成validated source snapshot或canonical report时的有限失败阶段。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum SandboxReconciliationAssemblyFailureKind {
    /// committed source reader无法取得可验证的scope-bounded read proof。
    CommittedSourceRead,
    /// source components存在，但无法通过snapshot shape / scope / coverage校验。
    SourceSnapshotAssembly,
    /// validated snapshot存在，但canonical finding stream无法完整装配。
    FindingAssembly,
    /// finding已装配，但report field/status/audit relation无法完成。
    ReportAssembly,
}

/// 构造Failed report所需的body-free、不可恢复assembly failure摘要。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq, Serialize)]
pub struct SandboxReconciliationAssemblyFailure {
    /// failure唯一适用的explicit scope；不得由error文本恢复。
    scope: SandboxReconciliationScopeRef,
    /// 发生不可恢复失败的有限阶段。
    failure_kind: SandboxReconciliationAssemblyFailureKind,
    /// source reader已明确定位的失败coverage channel；无法定位时为None。
    failed_coverage_kind: Option<SandboxReconciliationCoverageKind>,
    /// 失败前最后一对已验证committed cursors；只有成对存在或成对缺失两种合法形态。
    last_validated_cursors: Option<SandboxReconciliationCommittedCursorPair>,
    /// 已脱敏、稳定的失败原因；不得保存raw repository/adapter/SQL错误。
    reason: SandboxReason,
    /// trusted application mapper确认不可恢复失败的canonical time。
    failed_at: Timestamp,
}

impl SandboxReconciliationAssemblyFailure {
    /// 从trusted source/report assembler的finite failure mapping构造摘要。
    pub fn try_new(
        scope: SandboxReconciliationScopeRef,
        failure_kind: SandboxReconciliationAssemblyFailureKind,
        failed_coverage_kind: Option<SandboxReconciliationCoverageKind>,
        last_validated_cursors: Option<SandboxReconciliationCommittedCursorPair>,
        reason: SandboxReason,
        failed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxReconciliationAssemblyFailureError>;

    /// 返回failure适用的explicit scope。
    pub fn scope(&self) -> &SandboxReconciliationScopeRef;

    /// 返回finite assembly stage。
    pub fn failure_kind(&self) -> SandboxReconciliationAssemblyFailureKind;

    /// 返回optional failed coverage channel。
    pub fn failed_coverage_kind(&self) -> Option<SandboxReconciliationCoverageKind>;

    /// 返回最后一对已验证committed cursors。
    pub fn last_validated_cursors(&self) -> Option<&SandboxReconciliationCommittedCursorPair>;

    /// 返回caller-safe failure reason。
    pub fn reason(&self) -> &SandboxReason;

    /// 返回failure confirmation time。
    pub fn failed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
}

/// 一次same-snapshot committed read的truth/reference cursor pair。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct SandboxReconciliationCommittedCursorPair {
    /// committed truth high-watermark。
    truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
    /// committed reference/projection high-watermark。
    reference_cursor: SandboxReferenceCursor,
}

impl SandboxReconciliationCommittedCursorPair {
    /// 只从同一committed reader返回的两个cursor构造pair。
    pub fn try_from_committed_reader(
        truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
        reference_cursor: SandboxReferenceCursor,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxReconciliationAssemblyFailureError>;

    /// 返回truth cursor。
    pub fn truth_cursor(&self) -> SandboxTruthCursor;

    /// 返回reference cursor。
    pub fn reference_cursor(&self) -> SandboxReferenceCursor;
}

/// assembly failure摘要的stage/channel/cursor/time错误。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum SandboxReconciliationAssemblyFailureError {
    /// source read以外阶段缺少最后已验证cursor，或source read错误伪造了cursor。
    FailureStageCursorRelationInvalid,
    /// failed coverage kind与failure stage不兼容。
    FailedCoverageKindRelationInvalid,
    /// cursor pair不是同一committed reader返回的合法pair。
    InvalidCommittedCursorPair,
    /// failure time不满足canonical timestamp contract。
    InvalidFailedAt,
}
```

`CommittedSourceRead`允许`last_validated_cursors=None`，也允许在reader已取得合法pair后于后续channel
读取失败时保留`Some`；是否存在pair不由error字符串决定。后三个failure kind只允许在至少完成一次
committed read后构造，必须携带`Some(cursor pair)`。`failed_coverage_kind`只允许
`CommittedSourceRead | SourceSnapshotAssembly`使用；finding/report assembly失败已经位于coverage
之后，必须为`None`。这些规则防止把任意application error包装成Failed report。

##### 16.10.8.2 Report basis、private fields 与 factories

```rust
/// report的两种互斥source basis；不存在两个Option同时有值或同时为空的形态。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum SandboxReconciliationReportBasis {
    /// 已通过scope、cursor、observation、relation与coverage校验的source snapshot。
    CheckedSnapshot(SandboxReconciliationSourceSnapshot),
    /// 无法安全形成checked snapshot/report时的不可恢复failure摘要。
    AssemblyFailure(SandboxReconciliationAssemblyFailure),
}

impl SandboxReconciliationReportBasis {
    /// 返回basis适用的exact scope。
    pub fn scope(&self) -> &SandboxReconciliationScopeRef;

    /// 返回checked snapshot；assembly failure为None。
    pub fn checked_snapshot(&self) -> Option<&SandboxReconciliationSourceSnapshot>;

    /// 返回assembly failure；checked snapshot为None。
    pub fn assembly_failure(&self) -> Option<&SandboxReconciliationAssemblyFailure>;
}

/// canonical scope writer / verifier 的一次成功校验回执。
///
/// 该回执不实现 serde 或 Clone，字段私有，且只能由 contracts crate 内与选定算法绑定的
/// verifier 创建。application / infra / public DTO 不能用 `scope + digest` 自行伪造回执。
#[derive(Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct SandboxReconciliationScopeDigestVerificationReceipt {
    /// verifier 实际重新编码并校验的完整 scope value。
    scope: SandboxReconciliationScopeRef,
    /// verifier 对 canonical scope bytes 验证通过的 opaque digest。
    digest: SandboxSourceDigest,
}

impl SandboxReconciliationScopeDigestVerificationReceipt {
    /// 只供与 canonical writer / verifier 同 crate 的受限入口在验证成功后创建回执。
    pub(crate) fn from_canonical_verifier(
        scope: SandboxReconciliationScopeRef,
        digest: SandboxSourceDigest,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxReconciliationScopeDigestBindingError>;

    /// 返回本次验证覆盖的完整 scope。
    pub fn scope(&self) -> &SandboxReconciliationScopeRef;

    /// 返回本次验证通过的 opaque digest。
    pub fn digest(&self) -> &SandboxSourceDigest;
}

/// 由 canonical scope writer / verifier 形成的 scope 与 opaque digest 绑定证明。
///
/// 该 carrier 不把 digest 变成 scope identity。它只能消费不可伪造的 verifier receipt；
/// 当前算法选择与 receipt factory 仍受 `BLK-SBX-CANONICAL-001` 阻断。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq, Serialize)]
pub struct SandboxReconciliationScopeDigestBinding {
    /// digest 唯一适用的完整 scope value。
    scope: SandboxReconciliationScopeRef,
    /// canonical writer 对 context 与 ordered target refs 形成的 opaque digest。
    digest: SandboxSourceDigest,
}

impl SandboxReconciliationScopeDigestBinding {
    /// 消费 canonical verifier 的成功回执；不存在公开的 raw scope/digest pair constructor。
    pub fn try_from_verification_receipt(
        receipt: SandboxReconciliationScopeDigestVerificationReceipt,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxReconciliationScopeDigestBindingError>;

    /// 返回 digest 绑定的完整 scope。
    pub fn scope(&self) -> &SandboxReconciliationScopeRef;

    /// 返回 opaque digest；不得据此反向生成 target set。
    pub fn digest(&self) -> &SandboxSourceDigest;

    /// 判断两个 binding 是否 scope 与 digest 均逐字段相等。
    pub fn is_exactly_equal(&self, other: &Self) -> bool;
}

/// scope digest binding 的算法、scope 和编码错误。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum SandboxReconciliationScopeDigestBindingError {
    /// digest 不是 canonical writer 已接受的 `algorithm:value` carrier。
    DigestShapeInvalid,
    /// digest 与完整 scope 的 canonical verification 不相等。
    DigestScopeMismatch,
    /// scope 不满足显式 target / recursive-target 约束。
    ScopeInvalid,
    /// 当前实现尚未绑定 canonical writer/verifier，不能伪造 binding。
    CanonicalWriterUnavailable,
}

/// 尚未取得本次report mutation truth cursor的staged reconciliation report。
///
/// draft不是repository row，不实现serde，也不能被query读取。它只能在active write UoW内
/// 与matching audit draft、optional relay draft、current binding和stored job result共同暂存。
#[derive(Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct SandboxReconciliationReportDraft {
    /// application typed id generator预生成的report identity。
    report_ref: SandboxReconciliationReportRef,
    /// canonical writer 已验证的完整 scope/digest 绑定。
    scope_digest_binding: SandboxReconciliationScopeDigestBinding,
    /// validated snapshot或unrecoverable assembly failure二选一。
    basis: SandboxReconciliationReportBasis,
    /// 从checked snapshot机械装配的canonical finding stream；assembly failure固定为空。
    findings: SandboxReconciliationFindingSet,
    /// 由basis、coverage和findings唯一派生的shared canonical status。
    report_status: SandboxReconciliationReportStatus,
    /// 同一UoW预生成、最终必须链接本report source fact的audit identity。
    report_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    /// report pure assembly完成的canonical time；不是commit time或cursor。
    generated_at: Timestamp,
}

impl SandboxReconciliationReportDraft {
    /// 从validated committed snapshot装配finding并机械选择四状态之一。
    pub fn assemble_from_committed_snapshot(
        report_ref: SandboxReconciliationReportRef,
        scope_digest_binding: SandboxReconciliationScopeDigestBinding,
        source: SandboxReconciliationSourceSnapshot,
        report_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        generated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxReconciliationReportError>;

    /// 从不可恢复assembly failure构造唯一允许的snapshot-less Failed draft。
    pub fn failed_from_assembly(
        report_ref: SandboxReconciliationReportRef,
        scope_digest_binding: SandboxReconciliationScopeDigestBinding,
        failure: SandboxReconciliationAssemblyFailure,
        report_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        generated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxReconciliationReportError>;

    /// 返回预生成report identity。
    pub fn report_ref(&self) -> &SandboxReconciliationReportRef;

    /// 返回exact scope value。
    pub fn scope(&self) -> &SandboxReconciliationScopeRef;

    /// 返回canonical scope/digest binding。
    pub fn scope_digest_binding(&self) -> &SandboxReconciliationScopeDigestBinding;

    /// 返回opaque canonical scope digest。
    pub fn scope_digest(&self) -> &SandboxSourceDigest;

    /// 返回report source basis。
    pub fn basis(&self) -> &SandboxReconciliationReportBasis;

    /// 返回canonical finding stream。
    pub fn findings(&self) -> &SandboxReconciliationFindingSet;

    /// 返回机械派生的report status。
    pub fn report_status(&self) -> SandboxReconciliationReportStatus;

    /// 返回预生成audit identity。
    pub fn report_audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;

    /// 返回pure assembly time。
    pub fn generated_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;

    /// 消费draft并绑定同一UoW分配的report mutation truth cursor。
    pub fn finalize_committed(
        self,
        report_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
    ) -> Result<SandboxReconciliationReport, SandboxReconciliationReportError>;
}

/// 以已提交source为依据、不会修复owner truth的immutable reconciliation report。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct SandboxReconciliationReport {
    /// report唯一Sandbox object identity。
    report_ref: SandboxReconciliationReportRef,
    /// canonical writer 已验证的完整 scope/digest 绑定。
    scope_digest_binding: SandboxReconciliationScopeDigestBinding,
    /// validated snapshot或unrecoverable assembly failure二选一。
    basis: SandboxReconciliationReportBasis,
    /// 从checked snapshot机械装配的canonical finding stream；assembly failure固定为空。
    findings: SandboxReconciliationFindingSet,
    /// 由basis、coverage和findings唯一派生的shared canonical status。
    report_status: SandboxReconciliationReportStatus,
    /// report materialization同UoW预生成并最终提交的audit linkage。
    report_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    /// report source fact与audit/optional relay共同提交的truth cursor。
    report_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
    /// report pure assembly完成的canonical time；不等于repository commit time。
    generated_at: Timestamp,
}

impl SandboxReconciliationReport {
    /// 从完整persisted bundle重建report；重新计算findings和status，不信任stored enum/count。
    pub fn rehydrate(
        input: SandboxReconciliationReportRehydrationInput,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxReconciliationReportError>;

    /// 返回report identity。
    pub fn report_ref(&self) -> &SandboxReconciliationReportRef;

    /// 返回exact scope value。
    pub fn scope(&self) -> &SandboxReconciliationScopeRef;

    /// 返回canonical scope/digest binding；调用方不得扩展或反推scope member。
    pub fn scope_digest_binding(&self) -> &SandboxReconciliationScopeDigestBinding;

    /// 返回opaque canonical scope digest。
    pub fn scope_digest(&self) -> &SandboxSourceDigest;

    /// 返回report source basis。
    pub fn basis(&self) -> &SandboxReconciliationReportBasis;

    /// 返回checked source snapshot；assembly failure report为None。
    pub fn source_snapshot(&self) -> Option<&SandboxReconciliationSourceSnapshot>;

    /// 返回assembly failure；checked report为None。
    pub fn assembly_failure(&self) -> Option<&SandboxReconciliationAssemblyFailure>;

    /// 返回canonical finding stream。
    pub fn findings(&self) -> &SandboxReconciliationFindingSet;

    /// 返回shared canonical report status。
    pub fn report_status(&self) -> SandboxReconciliationReportStatus;

    /// 返回report materialization audit linkage。
    pub fn report_audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;

    /// 返回report source fact自身的committed truth cursor。
    pub fn report_truth_cursor(&self) -> SandboxTruthCursor;

    /// 返回report generation time。
    pub fn generated_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;

    /// 返回checked source coverage；assembly failure report为None。
    pub fn coverage(&self) -> Option<&SandboxReconciliationCoverage>;

    /// 返回checked source truth cursor。
    pub fn source_truth_cursor(&self) -> Option<SandboxTruthCursor>;

    /// 返回checked source reference cursor。
    pub fn source_reference_cursor(&self) -> Option<SandboxReferenceCursor>;

    /// 仅对完整coverage且finding为空的Clean report返回true。
    pub fn can_claim_clean(&self) -> bool;

    /// 判断report是否保留至少一个已证明finding。
    pub fn has_findings(&self) -> bool;

    /// 判断report是否因coverage gap而不完整。
    pub fn is_degraded(&self) -> bool;

    /// 判断report是否由failed coverage或assembly failure形成。
    pub fn is_failed(&self) -> bool;

    /// 固定返回false；report没有truth/projection repair authority。
    pub fn can_repair_source(&self) -> bool;
}
```

`SandboxReconciliationScopeDigestVerificationReceipt::from_canonical_verifier` 的
`pub(crate)` 可见性是安全边界，不是示例简写。回归后的 Step 7 必须提供一个 typed application
callable，由该 callable 调用 contracts crate 内选定的 canonical verifier，并直接返回
`SandboxReconciliationScopeDigestBinding`；repository adapter、job DTO、query mapper和fake均不得取得
receipt constructor。verifier必须重新 canonicalize完整context + ordered truth refs + ordered projection
refs，逐字段解码回同一scope后再验证digest；只检查`algorithm:value` shape不算成功。算法、实现库和
fixtures未固定时，callable返回typed unavailable并保持`BLK-SBX-CANONICAL-001`开放，不能使用fixture
hash、timestamp、`DefaultHasher`或字符串拼接替代。

对象不提供`report_clean(scope)`、`with_status(status)`、`mark_failed`、`add_finding`、`repair`或
`refresh`。`SandboxReconciliationReportDraft::assemble_from_committed_snapshot`消费report ref是为了
在一次装配中生成report-local finding refs；同一个source若使用另一个report ref会形成另一份immutable
report，而不是修改旧报告。draft和final report都不自行分配id、cursor或audit ref。

`source_truth_cursor()`与`report_truth_cursor()`不能混用：前者是被检查source snapshot的high-watermark，
后者是report source fact自身在materialization UoW中的commit cursor。checked-snapshot draft finalization
要求`report_truth_cursor > source.truth_cursor()`；assembly-failure draft若有last validated cursor pair，
同样要求report cursor严格晚于pair的truth cursor。没有last cursor的failure仍要求report cursor为UoW分配的
合法非零值。任何代码用source cursor、repository `Version`、timestamp、job run id或page cursor填充
`report_truth_cursor`都必须返回typed error。

##### 16.10.8.3 四状态唯一派生矩阵

`SandboxReconciliationReportStatus`不是可推进的lifecycle，也没有transition method。draft factory与
rehydration必须共享一个private exhaustive `derive_report_status`；任何caller status、job status、
repository error、finding severity或reason文本都不能覆盖该结果。优先级从上到下固定如下：

| priority | basis | coverage | canonical findings | required report status | exact implication |
|---:|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `AssemblyFailure` | 不适用 | 必须为空 | `Failed` | 只允许§16.10.8.1的四类unrecoverable stage；不能保留伪造snapshot。 |
| 2 | `CheckedSnapshot` | 至少一个channel为`Failed` | 可空或非空，已证明finding必须保留 | `Failed` | failed coverage优先于其它gap和finding；不能降为Degraded或IssuesFound。 |
| 3 | `CheckedSnapshot` | 无`Failed`，至少一个`Partial | Unavailable` | 可空或非空，已证明finding必须保留 | `Degraded` | coverage不完整但仍有可信checked subset；不能用finding把coverage升级为完整。 |
| 4 | `CheckedSnapshot` | 五channel均`Complete | CompleteEmpty` | 非空 | `IssuesFound` | 完整检查已证明至少一个issue；severity不改变顶层status。 |
| 5 | `CheckedSnapshot` | 五channel均`Complete | CompleteEmpty` | 空 | `Clean` | 唯一允许claim clean的组合；完整空scope也必须五channel各有`CompleteEmpty` proof。 |

等价的机械算法固定为：

```rust
fn derive_report_status(
    basis: &SandboxReconciliationReportBasis,
    findings: &SandboxReconciliationFindingSet,
) -> SandboxReconciliationReportStatus {
    match basis {
        SandboxReconciliationReportBasis::AssemblyFailure(_) => {
            SandboxReconciliationReportStatus::Failed
        }
        SandboxReconciliationReportBasis::CheckedSnapshot(source)
            if source.coverage().has_failed_channel() =>
        {
            SandboxReconciliationReportStatus::Failed
        }
        SandboxReconciliationReportBasis::CheckedSnapshot(source)
            if source.coverage().has_gap() =>
        {
            SandboxReconciliationReportStatus::Degraded
        }
        SandboxReconciliationReportBasis::CheckedSnapshot(_)
            if !findings.is_empty() =>
        {
            SandboxReconciliationReportStatus::IssuesFound
        }
        SandboxReconciliationReportBasis::CheckedSnapshot(_) => {
            SandboxReconciliationReportStatus::Clean
        }
    }
}
```

private helper返回`Clean`前还必须断言coverage完整；由于`has_gap()`与五channel穷尽状态互补，任何
未来新增coverage state而未更新match都必须编译失败或使closure audit失败，不能落入默认Clean。
`AssemblyFailure`固定finding为空，因为该basis无法形成canonical source stream；checked snapshot的
`Degraded | Failed`必须保留从已检查subset装配出的全部findings。以下组合一律返回typed error：

- `Clean + finding`、`Clean + coverage gap`或没有五channel完整proof的空scope；
- `IssuesFound + empty findings`、`IssuesFound + Partial/Unavailable/Failed coverage`；
- `Degraded + complete coverage`或任一`Failed` channel；
- `Failed + checked snapshot但没有failed channel`，除非basis是`AssemblyFailure`；
- assembly failure携带finding，或checked snapshot的persisted finding stream与canonical stream不一致。

helper语义固定为：`can_claim_clean()`仅比较上述priority 5完整条件；`is_degraded()`仅对
`SandboxReconciliationReportStatus::Degraded`返回true；`is_failed()`仅对`Failed`返回true；
`has_findings()`独立读取finding set，因此Degraded/Failed也可能返回true。不存在
`is_healthy = status != Failed`之类放宽判断。

##### 16.10.8.4 Report-owned typed error

```rust
/// reconciliation report draft、finalization、rehydration与字段关系错误。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum SandboxReconciliationReportError {
    /// report ref为空、wrong-kind或与finding/audit/current binding owner不一致。
    ReportIdentityInvalid,
    /// canonical scope/digest binding无法验证，或binding scope与basis scope不相等。
    ScopeDigestBindingInvalid,
    /// checked snapshot或assembly failure的scope与report scope binding不一致。
    ScopeBasisMismatch,
    /// checked snapshot无法装配canonical finding stream。
    FindingAssemblyFailed,
    /// persisted finding stream与从checked snapshot重新装配的stream不完全相等。
    FindingRehydrationMismatch,
    /// assembly failure basis携带了finding，或checked basis遗漏了已证明finding。
    BasisFindingRelationInvalid,
    /// persisted status与basis、coverage、finding机械派生状态不相等。
    PersistedStatusMismatch {
        /// persistence row中读取的状态。
        persisted: SandboxReconciliationReportStatus,
        /// current canonical规则重新派生的状态。
        derived: SandboxReconciliationReportStatus,
    },
    /// Clean没有完整coverage或仍有finding。
    CleanClaimInvalid,
    /// IssuesFound没有finding，或coverage不是完整检查。
    IssuesFoundClaimInvalid,
    /// Degraded没有Partial/Unavailable gap，或错误包含Failed channel。
    DegradedClaimInvalid,
    /// Failed既没有failed coverage，也没有合法assembly failure basis。
    FailedClaimInvalid,
    /// assembly failure stage/channel/cursor/time relation不满足§16.10.8.1。
    AssemblyFailureInvalid,
    /// report audit ref缺失、wrong-kind或与linked audit proof不一致。
    ReportAuditLinkageInvalid,
    /// report truth cursor不是同一write UoW分配值，或没有严格覆盖已检查source truth cursor。
    ReportTruthCursorInvalid,
    /// generated/audit/bound/source/failure timestamp不满足canonical单调关系。
    TimestampRelationInvalid,
    /// persistence row、basis、finding、audit linkage或binding不是同一committed report group。
    RehydrationInputMismatch,
    /// report bundle携带path、host、process、network、payload、secret或其它禁止正文。
    BodyFreeContractViolation,
    /// current contract禁止对immutable report/finding/basis执行post-persist mutation。
    ImmutableMutationForbidden,
}
```

该error只表示已经进入contracts report boundary后的shape/invariant失败。repository unavailable、
snapshot isolation失败、`Version` conflict、unique conflict、rollback failure、commit-unknown、access
denial、protocol validation、idempotency conflict和job item failure仍由Step 7~13的application/infra
owner承接，不得塞入本enum或改写report status。error不携带SQL、table/key、raw row、adapter cause、
stack、scope/ref字符串、path/host/PID、payload或secret；public mapper必须穷尽映射，不得解析Display。

##### 16.10.8.5 Persistence row、audit linkage snapshot 与 rehydration

`SandboxReconciliationReport`不直接实现`Deserialize`，也不允许 persistence mapper 把row直接
`Into<Report>`。row自身不能证明findings来自其snapshot、audit trace确实以本report为source/
subject，也不能证明report cursor与source cursor属于同一提交序列。durable与fake adapter必须共同
构造以下完整bundle；public DTO不得构造任一carrier。

```rust
/// persistence codec完成字段解码后交给report rehydration的内部row carrier。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct SandboxReconciliationReportPersistenceRow {
    /// immutable report identity。
    report_ref: SandboxReconciliationReportRef,
    /// 完整scope与canonical digest的verified binding。
    scope_digest_binding: SandboxReconciliationScopeDigestBinding,
    /// persisted checked snapshot或assembly failure basis。
    basis: SandboxReconciliationReportBasis,
    /// persisted finding stream；由rehydration重新与source canonical stream比较。
    persisted_findings: Vec<SandboxReconciliationFinding>,
    /// persisted status；不能作为canonical status来源。
    persisted_report_status: SandboxReconciliationReportStatus,
    /// persisted report audit linkage ref。
    report_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    /// report source fact自身的committed truth cursor。
    report_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
    /// report pure assembly time。
    generated_at: Timestamp,
}

impl SandboxReconciliationReportPersistenceRow {
    /// 由infra codec从一个report aggregate group构造row carrier；不执行repository read。
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    pub fn try_new(
        report_ref: SandboxReconciliationReportRef,
        scope_digest_binding: SandboxReconciliationScopeDigestBinding,
        basis: SandboxReconciliationReportBasis,
        persisted_findings: Vec<SandboxReconciliationFinding>,
        persisted_report_status: SandboxReconciliationReportStatus,
        report_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        report_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
        generated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxReconciliationReportError>;

    /// 返回persisted report identity。
    pub fn report_ref(&self) -> &SandboxReconciliationReportRef;

    /// 返回persisted scope/digest binding。
    pub fn scope_digest_binding(&self) -> &SandboxReconciliationScopeDigestBinding;

    /// 返回persisted source basis。
    pub fn basis(&self) -> &SandboxReconciliationReportBasis;

    /// 返回persisted finding stream；不得在mapper中排序或去重。
    pub fn persisted_findings(&self) -> &[SandboxReconciliationFinding];

    /// 返回persisted status，仅供rehydration等值校验。
    pub fn persisted_report_status(&self) -> SandboxReconciliationReportStatus;

    /// 返回persisted audit ref。
    pub fn report_audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;

    /// 返回persisted report commit cursor。
    pub fn report_truth_cursor(&self) -> SandboxTruthCursor;

    /// 返回persisted generation time。
    pub fn generated_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
}

/// 从已完成`SandboxAuditTrace::rehydrate`的committed audit复制出的report-specific linkage。
///
/// 该snapshot只服务跨crate report校验，不替代audit object或audit repository。application mapper
/// 必须先证明audit kind为Reconciliation，再调用本factory；contracts继续机械校验source、subject、
/// cursor、status和time，防止任意audit ref被复用。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct SandboxReconciliationReportAuditLinkageSnapshot {
    /// audit唯一链接的report identity。
    report_ref: SandboxReconciliationReportRef,
    /// committed audit identity。
    audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    /// audit row中保存的closed source fact；必须是本report。
    source_fact_ref: SandboxSourceFactRef,
    /// audit row中保存的正式subject；必须是本report。
    subject_ref: SandboxTraceSubjectRef,
    /// audit复制的report source fact commit cursor。
    source_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
    /// audit发生时间。
    occurred_at: Timestamp,
    /// committed audit唯一允许的linkage status。
    status: SandboxAuditTraceStatus,
}

impl SandboxReconciliationReportAuditLinkageSnapshot {
    /// 从已经完成domain audit rehydration的committed reconciliation trace复制安全字段。
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    pub fn try_from_committed_reconciliation_audit(
        report_ref: SandboxReconciliationReportRef,
        audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        source_fact_ref: SandboxSourceFactRef,
        subject_ref: SandboxTraceSubjectRef,
        source_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
        occurred_at: Timestamp,
        status: SandboxAuditTraceStatus,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxReconciliationReportError>;

    /// 返回audit绑定的report identity。
    pub fn report_ref(&self) -> &SandboxReconciliationReportRef;

    /// 返回committed audit identity。
    pub fn audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;

    /// 返回audit source fact；固定为本report。
    pub fn source_fact_ref(&self) -> &SandboxSourceFactRef;

    /// 返回audit subject；固定为本report。
    pub fn subject_ref(&self) -> &SandboxTraceSubjectRef;

    /// 返回audit复制的report truth cursor。
    pub fn source_truth_cursor(&self) -> SandboxTruthCursor;

    /// 返回audit occurrence time。
    pub fn occurred_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;

    /// 返回persisted linkage status；current合法值固定为Linked。
    pub fn status(&self) -> SandboxAuditTraceStatus;
}

/// 一个same-committed-group report row与audit linkage的完整rehydration输入。
#[derive(Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct SandboxReconciliationReportRehydrationInput {
    /// persistence row及其nested report aggregate。
    row: SandboxReconciliationReportPersistenceRow,
    /// 从matching committed reconciliation audit复制的linkage snapshot。

}

impl SandboxReconciliationReportRehydrationInput {
    /// 绑定同一committed report/audit group；不允许row-only fallback。

}

/// infra reader一次性提供的report aggregate与audit committed bundle。
#[derive(Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct SandboxReconciliationReportPersistenceBundle {
    /// 从同一 read transaction 取得的完整 report persistence row。

    /// 消费bundle并生成report唯一允许的rehydration输入。
```
