```rust
}
```

`SandboxReconciliationReport::rehydrate`的验证顺序固定如下；前一步失败后不得由后一步覆盖：

1. 校验row report ref、scope/digest binding与basis scope逐字段相等；重新调用canonical verifier验证
   digest。writer/verifier未绑定时返回`ScopeDigestBindingInvalid`并保持implementation blocker，不能
   以字符串拼接或fixture digest放行。
2. `CheckedSnapshot`重新执行snapshot的scope、checked set、observation order、relation mismatch、
   coverage、双cursor和time校验，再调用`SandboxReconciliationFindingSet::rehydrate`逐ordinal比较
   persisted findings。`AssemblyFailure`重新执行stage/channel/cursor/time校验，并要求findings为空。
3. 使用§16.10.8.3的唯一helper重算status，要求与`persisted_report_status`完全相等；不迁移旧status、
   不按finding count猜status，也不把`Failed` channel降为`Degraded`。
4. 校验audit snapshot的`report_ref`、`audit_trace_ref`分别等于row；`source_fact_ref`严格等于
   `SandboxSourceFactRef::ReconciliationReport(row.report_ref.clone())`；`subject_ref.as_object_ref()`
   严格等于report generic object ref；status严格为`SandboxAuditTraceStatus::Linked`。
5. audit `source_truth_cursor == row.report_truth_cursor`。checked basis还要求report cursor严格覆盖source
   truth cursor；failure basis有last cursor时严格覆盖pair truth cursor。reference cursor不转型参与比较。
6. checked basis要求`generated_at >= source.observed_at()`；failure basis要求
   `generated_at >= failure.failed_at()`；audit `occurred_at >= generated_at`。比较使用canonical timestamp
   compatibility gate，不能用字符串、repository version或wall-clock latest。
7. 最后执行body-free检查，确认scope、basis、finding、reason与audit snapshot中没有外部正文、locator、
   raw diagnostic或secret；通过全部步骤后才构造immutable report。

persistence mapper的固定读取顺序为：

```text
load exact report row + nested scope/basis/finding rows by report_ref
  -> rebuild every nested set/value through its canonical constructor
  -> build SandboxReconciliationReportPersistenceRow
  -> load exact audit row by report_audit_trace_ref in the same fair snapshot
  -> rehydrate SandboxAuditTrace with its committed report source proof
  -> copy SandboxReconciliationReportAuditLinkageSnapshot
  -> SandboxReconciliationReportPersistenceBundle::try_new(...)
  -> SandboxReconciliationReport::rehydrate(bundle.into_rehydration_input()?)
```

找不到audit row、audit尚未`Linked`、source/subject/cursor不等、nested finding缺行或只能从latest source
拼装时，reader必须返回typed integrity/unavailable结果；不得返回不带audit的report、丢弃finding、现场
修复row或将exact miss回退到scope/latest查询。historical report不需要仍是current binding target即可按
report ref读取；current/historical分类属于后续index carrier，不进入aggregate rehydration不变量。

#### 16.10.9 Exact report query lookup 与 no-write surface

Query只接受§16.10.3的`SandboxReconciliationReportSelector { report_ref }`。access decision必须在
任何report/index/audit读取前完成；通过access后，reader仍不能把repository `None`直接映为Empty，
因为missing report row旁边可能残留finding、current binding、audit、relay或stored-result relation。
exact absence必须由完整反向索引在同一公平read snapshot中证明。

```rust
/// exact report ref所有owner/dependent logical index的同snapshot cardinality。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct SandboxReconciliationReportIndexCardinality {
    /// report aggregate root row数量；合法值为0或1。
    report_row_count: u32,
    /// report-local finding row数量。
    finding_row_count: u32,
    /// 以本report为target的current binding数量；合法值为0或1。
    current_binding_target_count: u32,
    /// 以本report为source与subject的reconciliation audit数量。
    audit_relation_count: u32,
    /// 以本report为source的finding-available relay数量；合法值为0或1。
    relay_source_count: u32,
    /// stored job result中引用本report的关系数量。
    stored_result_relation_count: u32,
}

impl SandboxReconciliationReportIndexCardinality {
    /// 从同一read transaction的complete indexes构造cardinality；不执行latest scan。
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    pub fn try_from_complete_indexes(
        report_row_count: u32,
        finding_row_count: u32,
        current_binding_target_count: u32,
        audit_relation_count: u32,
        relay_source_count: u32,
        stored_result_relation_count: u32,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxReconciliationReportLookupError>;

    /// 返回aggregate root数量。
    pub fn report_row_count(&self) -> u32;

    /// 返回finding row数量。
    pub fn finding_row_count(&self) -> u32;

    /// 返回current binding target数量。
    pub fn current_binding_target_count(&self) -> u32;

    /// 返回matching audit relation数量。
    pub fn audit_relation_count(&self) -> u32;

    /// 返回optional relay source数量。
    pub fn relay_source_count(&self) -> u32;

    /// 返回stored result relation数量。
    pub fn stored_result_relation_count(&self) -> u32;

    /// 判断全部owner/dependent index是否共同证明exact ref从未提交或已完整删除。
    pub fn proves_exact_absence(&self) -> bool;
}

/// complete indexes对exact report ref共同形成的不存在证明。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct SandboxReconciliationReportAbsenceProof {
    /// absence唯一适用的exact selector。
    selector: SandboxReconciliationReportSelector,
    /// 必须全部为零的complete index cardinality。
    cardinality: SandboxReconciliationReportIndexCardinality,
    /// logical report index覆盖到的committed truth cursor。
    index_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
    /// same-snapshot absence observation time。
    observed_at: Timestamp,
}

impl SandboxReconciliationReportAbsenceProof {
    /// 仅从完整反向索引的全零结果构造absence proof。
    pub fn try_from_complete_zero_indexes(
        selector: SandboxReconciliationReportSelector,
        cardinality: SandboxReconciliationReportIndexCardinality,
        index_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
        observed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxReconciliationReportLookupError>;

    /// 返回absence适用的exact selector。
    pub fn selector(&self) -> &SandboxReconciliationReportSelector;

    /// 返回全部为零的index cardinality。
    pub fn cardinality(&self) -> &SandboxReconciliationReportIndexCardinality;

    /// 返回index committed truth cursor。
    pub fn index_truth_cursor(&self) -> SandboxTruthCursor;

    /// 返回absence observation time。
    pub fn observed_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
}

/// exact report读取无法形成aggregate时的有限缺口类别。
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum SandboxReconciliationReportReadGapKind {
    /// aggregate root或nested basis row当前不可完整读取。
    ReportAggregate,
    /// finding rows当前不可完整读取。
    FindingAggregate,
    /// matching reconciliation audit当前不可完整读取。
    AuditLinkage,
    /// scope digest verifier当前不可用。
    ScopeDigestVerification,
    /// complete reverse-index snapshot当前不可用。
    ReverseIndexCoverage,
    /// same-snapshot repository reader无法完成一致读取。
    RepositorySnapshot,
}

/// 一个caller-safe report read gap；不携带row、key或raw repository error。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct SandboxReconciliationReportReadGap {
    /// 无法形成完整 aggregate 的有限、低基数缺口类别。
    kind: SandboxReconciliationReportReadGapKind,
    /// application 稳定映射的 caller-safe 缺口原因。
    reason: SandboxReason,
}

impl SandboxReconciliationReportReadGap {
    /// 从application稳定映射的finite kind与安全原因构造gap。
    pub fn try_new(
        kind: SandboxReconciliationReportReadGapKind,
        reason: SandboxReason,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxReconciliationReportLookupError>;

    /// 返回finite gap kind。
    pub fn kind(&self) -> SandboxReconciliationReportReadGapKind;

    /// 返回caller-safe reason。
    pub fn reason(&self) -> &SandboxReason;
}

/// ordered-unique且非空的report read gap集合。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct SandboxReconciliationReportReadGapSet {
    /// 按 kind 声明顺序保存的非空、ordered-unique gap 集合。
    gaps: Vec<SandboxReconciliationReportReadGap>,
}

impl SandboxReconciliationReportReadGapSet {
    /// 构造按kind声明顺序排列的非空gap set；不自动排序或去重。
    pub fn try_new(
        gaps: Vec<SandboxReconciliationReportReadGap>,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxReconciliationReportLookupError>;

    /// 返回canonical gap slice。
    pub fn as_slice(&self) -> &[SandboxReconciliationReportReadGap];

    /// 返回gap数量。
    pub fn len(&self) -> usize;
}

/// access-approved exact selector的一次same-snapshot reader结果。
#[derive(Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum SandboxReconciliationReportLookupOutcome {
    /// exact ref命中并完成aggregate/audit rehydration。
    Report(SandboxReconciliationReport),
    /// complete reverse indexes共同证明exact ref不存在。
    ExactAbsent(SandboxReconciliationReportAbsenceProof),
    /// source当前不可完整读取，但没有把known integrity corruption伪装成gap。
    Unavailable {
        /// access-approved exact selector。
        selector: SandboxReconciliationReportSelector,
        /// 非空typed gaps。
        gaps: SandboxReconciliationReportReadGapSet,
    },
}

/// report exact lookup的cardinality、absence、gap与relation错误。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum SandboxReconciliationReportLookupError {
    /// selector不是exact typed report ref。
    SelectorInvalid,
    /// aggregate root、current target、audit或relay cardinality超过closed上限。
    IndexCardinalityInvalid,
    /// absence proof任一owner/dependent index不为零或不完整。
    ExactAbsenceNotProven,
    /// present aggregate的finding/audit/index count与rehydrated report不一致。
    PresentRelationInvalid,
    /// gap set为空、重复、乱序或包含非安全原因。
    ReadGapSetInvalid,
    /// index cursor或observation time不满足canonical contract。
    LookupSnapshotInvalid,
    /// known orphan、half-commit、duplicate或wrong-owner relation不得映为Empty/Unavailable。
    PersistenceIntegrityInvalid,
}
```

reader分类优先级固定为：access denial先结束；完整index全零才`ExactAbsent`；root=1时只沿exact
report ref、nested aggregate refs和matching audit ref重建；必要channel暂时不可读才`Unavailable`；
任一`root>1`、root=0但dependent count非零、finding count不等canonical count、audit不是exactly one、
current target重复、relay重复或stored result悬挂均返回integrity error并交reconciliation/quarantine，
不能按timestamp/ref选winner或降为Empty。historical report允许`current_binding_target_count=0`；current
report允许为1，但query不会因为该值为0拒绝exact historical read。

public surface映射固定如下：`Clean | IssuesFound | Failed` report读取成功时为
`SandboxQuerySurfaceStatus::Visible`并携带report；`Degraded`为`Degraded`并携带report；ExactAbsent为
`Empty`且不携带report；typed read gap为`Unavailable`且不携带partial report；known integrity error为
`Failed`且不携带report。report status `Failed`表示被读取的immutable报告记录了一次失败，不表示本次
query assembly失败，因此不能丢掉report。`NotVisible | Restricted`仍由access owner先行且不泄漏存在性。

query write/call budget严格为：write UoW=`0`、idempotency reservation=`0`、identity allocation=`0`、
business audit append=`0`、relay append=`0`、source refresh/rebuild/repair=`0`、backend/tool/runtime call=`0`。
query只能发低基数diagnostic/metric hook；hook失败不改变business result，也不能触发retry或read repair。

#### 16.10.10 Operations Job materialization、stored replay 与 current binding

只有 `SandboxJobKind::RunSandboxReconciliation` 可以从 explicit scope 生成新报告。本入口不是
Query、Command、Consumer、relay publisher 或 generic derived rebuild 的复用分支。job input 必须
完整携带 scope、selection proof、scope digest binding 和 invocation identity；它不能携带
`target_kinds`、page cursor、empty-means-all、latest selector 或 caller-selected report status。

##### 16.10.10.1 Job-only exact input 与 immutable materialization candidate

```rust
use core_contracts::metadata::JobRunId;

/// `RunSandboxReconciliation` 唯一允许的 application job 输入。
///
/// 该 carrier 只由 jobs entry 将已验证的 job envelope 映射而来，不实现 public query selector，
/// 也不允许 application 根据 config 或 repository latest scan 扩展 scope。
#[derive(Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct RunSandboxReconciliationJobInput {
    /// core-owned 一次 job invocation identity；不等于 report ref 或 idempotency key。
    job_run_id: JobRunId,
    /// 已验证且 channel 固定为 Job 的 application 调用语境。
    call_context: SandboxServiceCallContext,
    /// 本次 job 明确选择的完整 Sandbox-local scope。
    scope: SandboxReconciliationScopeRef,
    /// 证明 selected refs 与 scope 两个 set 逐项相等的 transient proof。
    selection_proof: SandboxReconciliationSelectionProof,
    /// canonical verifier 对完整 scope 形成的不可伪造 digest binding。
    scope_digest_binding: SandboxReconciliationScopeDigestBinding,
}

impl RunSandboxReconciliationJobInput {
    /// 从 exact job invocation、Job call context、selection proof 和 verified binding 构造输入。
    pub fn try_new(
        job_run_id: JobRunId,
        call_context: SandboxServiceCallContext,
        scope: SandboxReconciliationScopeRef,
        selection_proof: SandboxReconciliationSelectionProof,
        scope_digest_binding: SandboxReconciliationScopeDigestBinding,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxReconciliationMaterializationError>;

    /// 返回 job invocation identity。
    pub fn job_run_id(&self) -> &JobRunId;

    /// 返回已验证的 Job application call context。
    pub fn call_context(&self) -> &SandboxServiceCallContext;

    /// 返回本次不可扩展的 explicit scope。
    pub fn scope(&self) -> &SandboxReconciliationScopeRef;

    /// 返回 scope 与 selected refs 的等值 proof。
    pub fn selection_proof(&self) -> &SandboxReconciliationSelectionProof;

    /// 返回 canonical scope/digest binding。
    pub fn scope_digest_binding(&self) -> &SandboxReconciliationScopeDigestBinding;
}

/// 在写事务前已完成 pure assembly，但尚未取得 report truth cursor 的完整物化候选。
///
/// candidate 不实现 serde 或 Clone；它只能被一次 writer 调用消费。report、audit、relay 和
/// stored-result identity 均由 typed id generator 预生成，candidate 自身不分配 identity。
#[derive(Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct SandboxReconciliationMaterializationCandidate {
    /// exact job input；保留 invocation、idempotency 和 scope relation。
    job_input: RunSandboxReconciliationJobInput,
    /// 已完成 snapshot/failure、finding 和 status 装配的 report draft。
    report_draft: SandboxReconciliationReportDraft,
    /// matching reconciliation audit draft；source 固定为 staged report。
    report_audit_draft: SandboxAuditTraceDraft,
    /// findings 非空时唯一允许存在的 relay draft；空 finding 必须为 None。
    finding_relay_draft: Option<SandboxEventRelayDraft>,
    /// 完整 stored job report identity；不得用 report ref 代替。
    stored_result_ref: SandboxStoredOperationResultRef,
}

impl SandboxReconciliationMaterializationCandidate {
    /// 绑定 job input、report/audit draft、条件式 relay draft 与 stored result identity。
    pub fn try_new(
        job_input: RunSandboxReconciliationJobInput,
        report_draft: SandboxReconciliationReportDraft,
        report_audit_draft: SandboxAuditTraceDraft,
        finding_relay_draft: Option<SandboxEventRelayDraft>,
        stored_result_ref: SandboxStoredOperationResultRef,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxReconciliationMaterializationError>;

    /// 返回 job input。
    pub fn job_input(&self) -> &RunSandboxReconciliationJobInput;

    /// 返回 report draft。
    pub fn report_draft(&self) -> &SandboxReconciliationReportDraft;

    /// 返回 matching audit draft。
    pub fn report_audit_draft(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceDraft;

    /// 返回 optional finding relay draft。
    pub fn finding_relay_draft(&self) -> Option<&SandboxEventRelayDraft>;

    /// 返回完整 stored job result identity。
    pub fn stored_result_ref(&self) -> &SandboxStoredOperationResultRef;
}
```

`RunSandboxReconciliationJobInput::try_new` 必须验证：`call_context.channel == Job`；operation
与 `SandboxJobKind::RunSandboxReconciliation` 的 Step 8 canonical `OperationName` 映射相等；
idempotency key 与 request fingerprint 均存在；selection proof 的 scope 与 input scope 相等；
scope digest binding 的 scope 逐字段相等，并由 canonical verifier重新验证。`SandboxServiceCallContext`
的 exact fields 与 factory 仍由 `6R-05` 唯一拥有；本节只声明消费约束，不复制其 schema。

candidate factory 的 closed checks 如下：report draft scope/binding 等于 job input；audit draft 的
trace ref 等于 report draft `report_audit_trace_ref`，kind 固定 `Reconciliation`，source 固定
`SandboxSourceFactRef::ReconciliationReport(report_ref)`，subject generic object ref固定为同一 report；
audit source binding 必须是 cursor-less staged source。relay presence 必须严格等价于
`report_draft.findings().is_empty() == false`；若存在，source/event 固定为 report/
`SandboxReconciliationFindingAvailable`，且 report ref、audit ref、payload finding refs、status、
scope digest 与 draft逐项相等。stored result ref 与 report ref、job run id、audit ref均必须角色不同。

##### 16.10.10.2 Current binding logical key 与 write expectation

current binding 的逻辑键是完整 scope value 加其 verified digest，而不是 digest 单字段。repository
可以把 digest用作索引组件，但每次命中后都必须重新加载完整 scope并逐字段比对；同 digest、不同
scope 是 collision/integrity error，不能选一条作为 current。

```rust
/// 一个 scope/digest logical key 当前唯一指向的 immutable report binding。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct SandboxReconciliationCurrentBinding {
    /// 已通过 canonical verifier 的完整 logical key。
    scope_digest_binding: SandboxReconciliationScopeDigestBinding,
    /// current immutable report identity。
    report_ref: SandboxReconciliationReportRef,
    /// report source fact自身的 committed truth cursor。
    report_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
    /// report status 的机械副本；只用于 index integrity 校验。
    report_status: SandboxReconciliationReportStatus,
    /// matching committed report audit identity。
    report_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    /// current binding 提交时间；不参与 winner 选择。
    bound_at: Timestamp,
}

impl SandboxReconciliationCurrentBinding {
    /// 只从已 finalization 的 report 与 matching committed audit 构造 binding payload。
    pub fn try_from_committed_report(
        report: &SandboxReconciliationReport,
        report_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
        bound_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxReconciliationMaterializationError>;

    /// 返回完整 scope/digest logical key。
    pub fn scope_digest_binding(&self) -> &SandboxReconciliationScopeDigestBinding;

    /// 返回 current report identity。
    pub fn report_ref(&self) -> &SandboxReconciliationReportRef;

    /// 返回 report commit cursor。
    pub fn report_truth_cursor(&self) -> SandboxTruthCursor;

    /// 返回机械复制的 report status。
    pub fn report_status(&self) -> SandboxReconciliationReportStatus;

    /// 返回 report audit linkage。
    pub fn report_audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;

    /// 返回 binding time。
    pub fn bound_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;

    /// 判断完整 scope、digest、report、cursor、status、audit 和 time 是否逐字段相等。
    pub fn is_exactly_equal(&self, other: &Self) -> bool;
}

/// reconciliation current binding 的 closed optimistic write expectation。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum SandboxReconciliationBindingWriteExpectation {
    /// logical key 预期从未提交 report/current/tombstone relation。
    FirstMaterialization,
    /// exact logical key 预期仍指向给定 binding 和 repository version。
    ReplaceCurrent {
        /// application 在同一 workflow 已读取的 current binding完整快照。
        expected_binding: SandboxReconciliationCurrentBinding,
        /// current binding row 的 core optimistic version。
        expected_version: Version,
    },
}

impl SandboxReconciliationBindingWriteExpectation {
    /// 构造 insert-if-absent first expectation。
    pub fn first_materialization() -> Self;

    /// 构造 exact binding + core Version CAS replacement expectation。
    pub fn replace_current(
        expected_binding: SandboxReconciliationCurrentBinding,
        expected_version: Version,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxReconciliationMaterializationError>;

    /// 判断是否为首次物化 expectation。
    pub fn expects_absent(&self) -> bool;

    /// 返回 replacement expected binding；first 为 None。
    pub fn expected_binding(&self) -> Option<&SandboxReconciliationCurrentBinding>;

    /// 返回 replacement expected core Version；first 为 None。
    pub fn expected_version(&self) -> Option<&Version>;
}
```

`FirstMaterialization` 不是 caller 提供的 absence proof。writer 必须在同一 write transaction 中
检查 logical key 的 current binding、report history relation、controlled tombstone 和 in-flight
operation relation；只有四者都证明 never committed 才可 first insert。`current=0, history>0`、
`tombstone=1`、report row 存在但 binding 缺失，均不是 first success 条件。`ReplaceCurrent` 要求
expected binding 的完整 scope/digest等于 candidate；UoW 内重新读取的 current binding 和 `Version`
必须全等；new report ref必须不同，new report truth cursor在commit后严格晚于旧 report cursor。
scope成员或顺序变化属于另一个 logical key的 first materialization，不能借 replacement改 key。

##### 16.10.10.3 Stored job report、typed save/get 与 writer outcome

reconciliation report 与 stored job result 是 exactly-one 关系：每一个 committed report 必须被一个
且仅一个 `SandboxReconciliationStoredJobReport` 引用；每一个该类型 stored result 必须引用恰好一个
matching committed report。generic `SandboxStoredOperationResult` 在 `6R-05` 保存其
`stored_result_ref`、operation/kind/status和本完整 envelope；不得只保存 report ref或 counters。

```rust
/// `RunSandboxReconciliation` 成功路径必须原样保存和 replay 的完整 job report envelope。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct SandboxReconciliationStoredJobReport {
    /// generic stored result repository 使用的 typed identity。
    stored_result_ref: SandboxStoredOperationResultRef,
    /// 原 invocation identity；duplicate replay 不生成新的原始 run identity。
    original_job_run_id: JobRunId,
    /// 固定为 `RunSandboxReconciliation`。
    job_kind: SandboxJobKind,
    /// 原始完成状态；只允许 Succeeded / Degraded / Failed。
    original_report_status: SandboxJobReportStatus,
    /// 唯一 committed reconciliation report identity。
    report_ref: SandboxReconciliationReportRef,
    /// report canonical status；必须等于 rehydrated report。
    reconciliation_status: SandboxReconciliationReportStatus,
    /// 完整、ordered finding refs；不得只保存 count。
    finding_refs: Vec<SandboxReconciliationFindingRef>,
    /// findings 非空时唯一 relay identity；为空时必须为 None。
    finding_relay_record_ref: Option<SandboxEventRelayRecordRef>,
    /// matching report audit identity。
    report_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    /// report source fact commit cursor。
    report_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
    /// report scope 的 verified digest；完整 scope仍由 report承载。
    scope_digest: SandboxSourceDigest,
    /// original job start time。
    started_at: Timestamp,
    /// report/stored envelope 在同一 UoW完成的时间。
    finished_at: Timestamp,
}

impl SandboxReconciliationStoredJobReport {
    /// 从 committed report、optional finalized relay和job invocation形成完整 stored envelope。
    pub fn try_from_committed_group(
        stored_result_ref: SandboxStoredOperationResultRef,
        original_job_run_id: JobRunId,
        report: &SandboxReconciliationReport,
        finding_relay_record_ref: Option<SandboxEventRelayRecordRef>,
        started_at: Timestamp,
        finished_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxReconciliationStoredJobReportError>;

    /// 从 persistence row 与 exact report bundle重新校验完整 envelope。
    pub fn rehydrate(
        persisted: SandboxReconciliationStoredJobReportPersistenceRow,
        report: &SandboxReconciliationReport,
        relay: Option<&SandboxEventRelayRecord>,
    ) -> Result<Self, SandboxReconciliationStoredJobReportError>;

    /// 返回 stored result identity。
    pub fn stored_result_ref(&self) -> &SandboxStoredOperationResultRef;

    /// 返回原始 job run identity。
    pub fn original_job_run_id(&self) -> &JobRunId;

    /// 返回原始非 duplicate-overlay job report status。
    pub fn original_report_status(&self) -> SandboxJobReportStatus;

    /// 返回唯一 report identity。
    pub fn report_ref(&self) -> &SandboxReconciliationReportRef;

    /// 返回 report canonical status。
    pub fn reconciliation_status(&self) -> SandboxReconciliationReportStatus;

    /// 返回完整 finding ref stream。
    pub fn finding_refs(&self) -> &[SandboxReconciliationFindingRef];

    /// 返回 optional finding relay identity。
    pub fn finding_relay_record_ref(&self) -> Option<&SandboxEventRelayRecordRef>;

    /// 返回 report audit linkage。
    pub fn report_audit_trace_ref(&self) -> &SandboxAuditTraceRef;

    /// 返回 report commit cursor。
    pub fn report_truth_cursor(&self) -> SandboxTruthCursor;

    /// 返回 scope digest。
    pub fn scope_digest(&self) -> &SandboxSourceDigest;

    /// 返回 original start time。
    pub fn started_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;

    /// 返回 original finish time。
    pub fn finished_at(&self) -> &Timestamp;
}

/// persistence codec 解码后交给 stored job report rehydration 的内部 row。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct SandboxReconciliationStoredJobReportPersistenceRow {
    /// generic stored result repository 使用的 typed identity。
    stored_result_ref: SandboxStoredOperationResultRef,
    /// 原 invocation 的 job run identity；duplicate replay 不改写。
    original_job_run_id: JobRunId,
    /// 固定为 `RunSandboxReconciliation` 的 closed job kind。
    job_kind: SandboxJobKind,
    /// 原始完成状态；不得持久化 duplicate overlay。
    original_report_status: SandboxJobReportStatus,
    /// 唯一 matching committed reconciliation report identity。
    report_ref: SandboxReconciliationReportRef,
    /// 与 rehydrated report 完全相等的 canonical report status。
    reconciliation_status: SandboxReconciliationReportStatus,
    /// 完整、连续且保持 canonical order 的 finding refs。
    finding_refs: Vec<SandboxReconciliationFindingRef>,
    /// finding 非空时唯一 matching relay identity；否则必须为空。
    finding_relay_record_ref: Option<SandboxEventRelayRecordRef>,
    /// 与 report 同一 committed group 的 audit trace identity。
    report_audit_trace_ref: SandboxAuditTraceRef,
    /// report source fact 的 committed truth cursor。
    report_truth_cursor: SandboxTruthCursor,
    /// canonical verifier 已确认的 report scope digest。
    scope_digest: SandboxSourceDigest,
    /// 原始 job invocation 的开始时间。
    started_at: Timestamp,
    /// report 与 stored envelope 同一 UoW 完成的时间。
    finished_at: Timestamp,
}

/// stored report 的 owner、field、relay、time 与 replay错误。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum SandboxReconciliationStoredJobReportError {
    /// stored result ref为空、wrong-kind或被另一operation拥有。
    StoredResultIdentityInvalid,
    /// job kind不是RunSandboxReconciliation，或generic stored result kind不匹配。
    StoredResultKindMismatch,
    /// stored envelope找不到exact report，或一个report被零个/多个envelope引用。
    ReportRelationCardinalityInvalid,
    /// status/cursor/audit/digest与rehydrated report不等。
    ReportFieldMismatch,
    /// finding refs不是report完整、连续、同序的finding stream。
    FindingRefStreamMismatch,
    /// relay presence不等于finding非空，或relay source/event/report relation不匹配。
    FindingRelayRelationInvalid,
    /// original status不是report status的机械映射，或持久化了DuplicateReplayed overlay。
    JobReportStatusInvalid,
    /// start/finish/report/audit/relay time关系无效。
    TimestampRelationInvalid,
    /// completed idempotency record指向的stored envelope缺失或不可重建。
    DuplicateMissingStoredReport,
    /// duplicate operation、request fingerprint或stored result kind不等。
    DuplicateReplayMismatch,
}

/// reconciliation materialization writer 的有限成功结果。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum SandboxReconciliationMaterializationWriteOutcome {
    /// 本次 UoW 提交了一个新的 immutable report/current/stored group。
    Committed {
        /// 新的 current binding。
        binding: SandboxReconciliationCurrentBinding,
        /// 原样保存、可供 duplicate replay 的完整 job report。
        stored_job_report: SandboxReconciliationStoredJobReport,
    },
    /// 相同 idempotency operation 已提交；本次 write set 为零并返回原 stored report。
    DuplicateReplayed {
        /// 从 typed store读取的原完整 job report；entry只 overlay DuplicateReplayed disposition。
        stored_job_report: SandboxReconciliationStoredJobReport,
    },
}

/// materialization input、binding、transaction和commit reconciliation的稳定错误类别。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum SandboxReconciliationMaterializationError {
    /// job kind、operation name、channel、idempotency或run identity无效。
    JobInputInvalid,
    /// selection proof、scope与scope digest binding不完全相等。
    ScopeSelectionBindingMismatch,
    /// report/audit/relay/stored identity或field relation无效。
    CandidateRelationInvalid,
    /// first expectation遇到既存report/history/tombstone/in-flight relation。
    FirstMaterializationConflict,
    /// replacement expected binding与当前binding不等。
    CurrentBindingConflict,
    /// core optimistic Version不等；不得用cursor/time代替。
    VersionConflict,
    /// digest命中但完整scope不同，必须隔离处理。
    ScopeDigestCollision,
    /// current/report/audit/relay/stored relation出现zero/multiple/half-commit。
    PersistenceIntegrityInvalid,
    /// canonical scope verifier未绑定或验证失败。
    ScopeDigestVerificationUnavailable,
    /// findings非空但relay append所需的完整能力组合未装配或不可用。
    FindingRelayUnavailable,
    /// commit结果未知；不得宣称Committed或自动盲重放。
    CommitUnknown,
    /// typed stored job report缺失、wrong-kind或与report不一致。
    StoredJobReportUnavailable,
    /// retention试图删除current、stored replay依赖或无tombstone历史。
    RetentionPinViolation,
}
```

`original_report_status` 的机械映射固定为：report `Clean | IssuesFound` -> job `Succeeded`；report
`Degraded` -> job `Degraded`；report `Failed` -> job `Failed`。`DuplicateReplayed` 只是在返回原 envelope
时由 entry/service outcome overlay 的本次调用处置，不得覆盖 persisted original status、job run id、
start/finish time 或任一 item ref。duplicate outcome 不返回 `SandboxReconciliationCurrentBinding`：原 report
可能已被后续成功 replacement 转为 historical，此时不存在指向它的 current binding；entry 必须只从
`stored_job_report.report_ref()` 沿 exact immutable bundle 映射结果，不能要求该 report 仍为 current。
typed save/get surface必须成对存在：Step 7需定义
`save_reconciliation_stored_job_report(envelope, uow)` 与
`get_reconciliation_stored_job_report(stored_result_ref)`；generic get 或从current report重组均不满足闭环。

##### 16.10.10.4 同一 UoW 的唯一 write order 与 relay gate

首次和 replacement 共用以下唯一顺序。表中“complete idempotency”表示在 active UoW 中 stage
completion relation；commit前不对 duplicate reader可见。

```text
validate exact job input + canonical scope verification outside write UoW
  -> reserve idempotency with full SandboxServiceCallContext in write UoW
  -> duplicate same fingerprint:
       load typed stored job report + exact report/audit/optional relay in zero-write snapshot
       verify complete relation
       return DuplicateReplayed without source read or new identities
  -> first execution:
       read exact committed source and assemble report draft
       build staged reconciliation audit draft
       if findings.len() > 0:
         require relay store + canonical encoder/verifier + schema binding
           + validated publisher/route/target binding + same-generation retry policy
         otherwise return FindingRelayUnavailable and roll back the whole UoW
         build exact SandboxReconciliationFindingAvailable payload
         build staged SandboxEventRelayDraft
       else:
         finding relay draft = None
       atomically check FirstMaterialization or ReplaceCurrent expectation
       stage immutable report/finding rows
       stage new current binding (insert or Version CAS replacement)
       stage full SandboxReconciliationStoredJobReport
       stage generic SandboxStoredOperationResult linkage
       stage idempotency completion -> stored_result_ref
       uow.assign_truth_change_cursor()
       report = report_draft.finalize_committed(report_truth_cursor)
       audit = audit_draft.finalize_staged_source(report_truth_cursor)
       relay_pair = optional relay_draft.finalize_staged_source(report_truth_cursor)
       rebuild binding/stored envelope from finalized group and verify exact equality
       atomically commit report + findings + binding + audit + optional relay pair
         + typed stored envelope + generic stored result + idempotency completion
  -> emit only allowlisted diagnostic/metric hooks after commit
```

relay gate 是硬不变量，不由 config 或 job status放宽：仅 `findings.len() > 0` 创建
`SandboxReconciliationFindingAvailable`。`Clean` 不创建；只有 coverage gap、没有 finding 的
`Degraded` 不创建；assembly-failure 或 failed coverage 但没有 finding 的 `Failed` 也不创建。
若 report含 finding，即使 report status为`Degraded | Failed`，仍创建一条 relay，payload必须携带
完整 ordered finding refs，不能只发 count。finding 非空时，relay store、canonical encoder/verifier、
`SandboxReconciliationFindingAvailable` schema binding、validated publisher/route/target binding与同generation
retry policy都是 materialization 的提交前置；任一未装配、被禁用或当前不可用，都返回
`SandboxReconciliationMaterializationError::FindingRelayUnavailable`并回滚整个UoW，不得提交report-only、
无relay stored envelope或伪造relay ref。

publisher暂时不可投递不等于relay append不可用。只要上述append能力和validated target binding完整，
本次UoW仍提交`SandboxEventRelayStatus::Pending` record与冻结payload；后续publisher/relay worker按§16.4
推进`Published | Retryable | Failed | DeadLetter`，其失败不回滚已经提交的report/source truth。Step 14
只能决定“reconciliation materialization + finding relay append”完整组合能否注册：若配置意图关闭finding
event，则必须同时关闭会产生新report的materialization job能力，不能保留会生成finding却静默丢event的
report-only分支。Query读取既有report不依赖publisher注册，历史relay truth也不得因feature关闭被删除。

任一 pre-commit failure 必须回滚 reservation、report/finding row、binding、audit、relay、stored
envelope、generic stored result、idempotency completion和本次分配cursor的可见性。post-commit hook
失败不回滚已提交 group。query、duplicate path和commit-unknown reconciliation均不得重新读 source、
重新装配 finding、重新编码 payload或生成新 report/audit/relay/stored identities。

##### 16.10.10.5 Duplicate、并发、rollback、commit-unknown 与 retention

| 场景 | required handling | committed visible relation | forbidden behavior |
|---|---|---|---|
| same operation + same fingerprint duplicate | 从 idempotency result ref读取 typed stored envelope，再 exact-load report/audit/optional relay重验；不读取或返回current binding | 原 report、finding refs、audit、relay、times原样；本次 surface overlay `DuplicateReplayed`；原report可为current或historical | 重跑source reader、重新对账、从current binding拼report、要求原report仍current |
| same key + different fingerprint | idempotency conflict，write set=0 | 原 group不变 | 复用原stored report、覆盖current |
| two same job operations并发 | reservation/unique winner；loser等待或读取winner完整stored result | exactly one report/audit/stored group和至多一条finding relay | 两个report refs、两个audit、重复event |
| two different job operations同scope并发 | 两者可在事务内形成不同draft；只有first/CAS winner提交完整group，loser全量回滚；后续另一次成功replacement才会把原current转为historical | one newly committed current group；若是replacement，旧committed current保持为historical exact report | 把CAS loser的report单独提交为historical、按timestamp/ref选current、共享stored result |
| concurrent replacements共享Version | 一个CAS winner；其它`VersionConflict`，不得自动reload latest后覆盖 | one new current；old及任何committed historical immutable | last-writer-wins、cursor/time winner |
| late older source completes | expected binding/version和source cursor fence拒绝整个主路径UoW；只有未来另行定义的historical-only typed writer policy才可独立提交 | newer current不回退；当前主路径不留下late draft | old report重新设current、CAS失败后私留historical row |
| required finding relay unavailable | encoder/schema/store/target/retry任一缺失或不可用即`FindingRelayUnavailable` | 旧current或absence relation完整保持；本次report/finding/audit/stored均不可见 | report-only success、伪relay ref、post-commit补event |
| publisher temporarily unavailable after valid append wiring | 先以`Pending` relay与冻结payload同组提交；后续delivery owner分类 | 完整report group和Pending relay可见；publisher结果不改report | 把delivery unavailable误当append unavailable、回滚report或重建payload |
| pre-commit failpoint | whole UoW rollback | 旧current或absence relation完整保持 | half report、audit-only、stored-only、cursor advance |
| commit unknown | 记录 opaque operation/candidate identity，进入专用只读 reconciliation | 只有完整 committed / fully absent / indeterminate三分 | 自动重放、生成新identity、猜DuplicateReplayed |
| retention racing current read/replacement | current target、audit、stored replay和optional relay全组 pin；CAS/fence决定顺序 | reader只见完整commit-before或commit-after group | 删除current row、留下悬挂stored result |
| legal historical retention | 先写受控 tombstone / logical history marker，再按policy删除允许的physical payload | exact report查询返回expired/tombstoned typed surface，不得称“从未存在” | 全索引清零后返回ExactAbsent、删除audit/security/legal pin |

commit-unknown reconciliation只能按 operation identity、stored result ref、report ref、完整 scope/digest、
current/history/tombstone cardinality和same-snapshot group relation判断：全部关系存在且重验通过才可确认
committed；全部 relation均不存在才可确认not committed；其余均是indeterminate并进入quarantine/operator
路径。它没有 core truth、projection、relay或current binding修复权限。

retention最低关系固定为：current report、matching audit、stored job report、completed idempotency relation
以及findings非空时的relay/payload在其可 replay/read 期间共同不可删除；historical exact report在正式
retention期内同样保持bundle可重建。物理TTL、archive backend和policy ref由Step 14/正式`04`重验，
本节不伪造数值。删除后必须保留足以区分`NeverCommitted`与`ControlledTombstone`的logical marker；
否则 exact all-zero index不是可靠 absence proof。

#### 16.10.11 Field source closure

本节把`SandboxReconciliationReport`及support family #41的公开字段绑定到唯一source owner。这里的
`exact source`必须先由同一committed read或同一write UoW中的typed factory验证；application、repository
codec、protocol mapper和job accumulator只能机械复制，不能通过latest scan、字符串解析、count推断、
`Option`默认值或当前时钟补造字段。support carrier仍是`SandboxReconciliationReport`的实现闭包，不因此
升级为新的named object、repository truth或状态机。

##### 16.10.11.1 Scope、selector、selection与target observation

| target field / carrier | exact source | relation guard | forbidden substitute |
|---|---|---|---|
| scope `context_ref` | trusted job input中的exact `ControlledExecutionContextRef` | 每个`Present` target binding必须逐字段等于该context；Missing/RelationInvalid仍保留scope anchor | 从第一个target、report ref、digest、repository partition或audit subject反推 |
| scope `truth_refs` / `projection_refs` | caller或trusted scheduler显式提交的ordered-unique typed sets | 禁止reconciliation report递归target；selection proof与两个set完全相等 | empty-means-all、target kind expansion、配置扫描、latest projection、裸`Vec<ResourceRef>` |
| `SandboxReconciliationReportSelector.report_ref` | Query request中的exact `SandboxReconciliationReportRef` | named wrapper shape/kind先行；它是唯一query key | scope/context/latest selector、stored result ref、job report ref、字符串转换 |
| selection proof `scope` / `selected_*_refs` | validated job scope及其两个exact member sets | 三者必须逐项相等；proof不执行repository read | job page、configured family、source reader实际返回子集 |
| target ref `Truth` / `Projection` | scope typed sets的逐项机械映射 | `object_kind`、coverage family和audit requiredness来自closed union mapping | ref文本、repository table名、运行时downcast、generic object ref |
| target binding `target_ref` / `context_ref` | committed owner snapshot | target属于本次checked set且context等于scope | scope声明本身冒充row存在证明、第一条row context |
| target binding双cursor | owner snapshot的committed mutation metadata | 至少一个cursor存在；任一存在值不得超过read proof watermark | `Version`、page token、timestamp、job run id、两次read各取一个cursor |
| target binding `source_audit_trace_ref` | canonical owner已有audit linkage | `Required`必须有且exact；`NotOwned`必须为None | 为满足reconciliation临时追加audit、query trace、diagnostic span |
| target binding `relation_refs` | owner snapshot公开的body-free closed relation | role与owner family兼容，ordered-unique且identity不碰撞 | 从body、ref文本、status、数据库foreign key名或finding kind反推 |
| `Present` observation |完整target binding | 同一target最多一项，且不得是reconciliation report target | row `Some`、generic get success、未经lineage/cursor/audit校验的partial row |
| `Missing.target_ref/reason` | exact typed read得到的not-found分类及approved safe mapper | 只表示该target已完成检查且不存在；必须形成`TargetMissing` finding | source unavailable、timeout、decode error、tombstone、partial page、raw SQL error |
| `RelationInvalid` fields | source reader对存在row的finite invalidity分类 | invalidity唯一映射finding kind；reason不参与分类 | reason substring、missing row、coverage gap、caller指定finding kind |
| observation set order | checked truth refs后接checked projection refs | exact target一一对应且ordered-unique | repository返回顺序、hash-map顺序、按kind/ref重新排序 |
| committed read proof | 同一committed reader的truth/reference watermarks与observation set | binding cursor均不越过watermark；proof整体创建 | 两个独立transaction拼接、最大cursor、当前repository head |

`SandboxReconciliationTargetObservationKind`、`SandboxReconciliationTargetInvalidityKind`和
`SandboxReconciliationSourceAuditRequirement`均为closed classifier，不是持久化状态机。它们只能由上述
typed owner mapping返回；不得由DTO string、error message或数据库nullable字段反向推导。

##### 16.10.11.2 Source snapshot、coverage与relation mismatch

| target field / carrier | exact source | relation guard | forbidden substitute |
|---|---|---|---|
| snapshot `scope` | selection proof中的exact scope | 与canonical scope digest binding的完整scope逐字段相等 | digest命中、context-only key、source reader扩展后的集合 |
| `checked_truth_refs` / `checked_projection_refs` | committed reader实际完成检查的scope内子集 | 分别为scope set子集；complete coverage时必须完全相等 | 成功row集合、finding target集合、去掉Missing后的集合 |
| snapshot `read_proof` | 同一source read transaction | observation与checked sets一项一观察且顺序一致 | repository page集合、独立truth/projection reads、latest snapshot |
| `relation_mismatches` | `Present` binding之间的owner-declared relation验证 | primary必须Present；related ref必须由primary声明；kind与target family匹配 | 对Missing target构造relation mismatch、从finding reason重建、任意cross-ref |
| snapshot `coverage` | source reader对五个固定channel的完整cardinality accounting | requested/checked/missing与scope、checked sets和family mapping一致 | 一个`is_complete` bool、总数差、未请求channel省略、空set自动CompleteEmpty |
| snapshot `observed_at` | source assembly完成后的canonical application clock | 不早于同一read中已提交source observation；不改变cursor identity | backend clock、query response time、report generated/commit time |
| coverage `kind` | target closed-union到五类family的canonical mapping | 固定字段位置与kind相等；五类均必须存在 | repository名称、配置feature、caller传入字符串 |
| coverage counts | explicit scope请求量与reader完成量 | `checked <= requested`且`missing = requested - checked`；按channel独立闭合 | SQL total、finding count、observation中只数Present、跨channel抵消 |
| coverage `state` | counts与source owner typed availability共同派生 | Complete/CompleteEmpty/Partial/Unavailable/Failed与count/reason矩阵完全匹配 | caller bool、error文本、空集合默认成功、Unavailable降为CompleteEmpty |
| coverage `reason` | Partial/Unavailable/Failed的approved safe mapper | gap状态必须有；完整状态必须无 | raw repository/adapter error、finding reason复制、缺reason填默认字符串 |
| relation ref set | primary owner snapshot的closed body-free relation stream | exact role + identity ordered-unique；不同role不得复用底层identity | generic object refs、source body、外部URL/path、数据库join现场生成 |
| relation mismatch `primary_target_ref` |同一observation set中的Present target | 必须与owner-declared relation set和finding kind相容 | Missing/RelationInvalid target、scope外target、finding primary字段回填 |
| relation mismatch `related_ref` | primary binding已声明的exact relation | required kind必须Some，cursor-only kind必须None | repository临时join结果、finding payload、另一个scope target |
| relation mismatch `finding_kind` / `reason` | finite relation checker + approved safe mapper | kind不从reason推导，且只允许六类cross-target mismatch | arbitrary enum cast、raw diff、public message字符串 |

`SandboxReconciliationCoverageState`和`SandboxReconciliationFindingSeverity`只表达本次report assembly
的有限分类，不拥有transition method、repository version或current winner。coverage gap可以影响report status，
但不能修改任一source target；relation mismatch可以形成finding，不能自动调用repair owner。

##### 16.10.11.3 Finding identity、finding stream与severity

| target field / carrier | exact source | relation guard | forbidden substitute |
|---|---|---|---|
| finding ref `report_ref` | 本次draft预生成的exact report identity | set内所有finding必须属于同一report | job report ref、stored result ref、scope digest、current report |
| finding ref `ordinal` | canonical finding assembly order的`1..=n`连续序号 | non-zero、无gap、无duplicate且与vector位置一致 | database sequence、hash order、timestamp、target count |
| finding `primary_target_ref` | Missing/RelationInvalid observation或validated relation mismatch | 必须位于source scope/checked relation中 | arbitrary caller target、scope字符串、relay payload target |
| finding `related_ref` | relation mismatch的exact optional related ref | kind requiredness与source mismatch逐字段一致 | 从reason解析、finding mapper再次lookup、generic object ref |
| finding `finding_kind` | observation invalidity或relation mismatch finite mapping | `TargetMissing`只来自Missing；lineage invalid只来自typed invalidity；cross-target kind只来自mismatch | caller选择、severity反推、coverage state、raw error |
| finding `severity` | `SandboxReconciliationFindingKind::required_severity()` | caller、persistence row和DTO均无override权 | config、job status、reason内容、target owner状态 |
| finding `reason` | source observation或relation mismatch的safe reason | 与source逐字段相等；不参与kind/severity派生 | raw body/error、mapper润色、缺省文本、多个reason拼接 |
| finding双cursor / `observed_at` | checked source snapshot | 所有finding必须复制同一snapshot watermarks/time | report commit cursor、current binding cursor、job finish time |
| finding set order | scope target顺序、observation kind、finding kind、owner relation顺序组成的canonical order | rehydrate必须重算并逐项全等 | database order、severity排序、ref排序、DTO排序、set自动去重 |

`SandboxReconciliationFindingSet::assemble`是finding stream的唯一正常创建入口；`rehydrate`只验证已持久化
stream，不能容忍缺ordinal、重复、额外finding或顺序变化。finding为空只表示没有已证明的不一致，不表示
coverage完整、report为Clean、scope从未存在或job成功。

##### 16.10.11.4 Report basis、digest、status、persistence与audit linkage

| target field / carrier | exact source | relation guard | forbidden substitute |
|---|---|---|---|
| assembly failure `scope` | validated job scope | 与scope digest receipt及report basis scope完全相等 | error附带scope string、current binding、last successful report scope |
| assembly failure `failure_kind` / channel | trusted assembler finite mapping | coverage kind只在CommittedSourceRead/SourceSnapshotAssembly允许；后两阶段固定None | raw error class名、status、reason文本、catch-all internal |
| assembly failure cursor pair | failure前最后一个validated same-snapshot proof | 两cursor成对存在/缺失；非source-read阶段必须Some | 只保存一个cursor、current head、report mutation cursor |
| assembly failure `reason` / `failed_at` | approved safe mapper + failure confirmation application clock | no raw cause；时间满足canonical contract | panic/SQL/SDK message、job finish time倒填 |
| report basis | validated source snapshot或validated assembly failure二选一 | scope与digest binding相等；不存在双Option或无basis | `Result`字符串序列化、空snapshot、old report fallback |
| verification receipt `scope/digest` | selected canonical writer/verifier实际重编码结果 | receipt不serde、不Clone且factory crate-restricted | caller提交raw digest、fixture常量、request fingerprint、hash(scope debug) |
| scope digest binding | consumed verification receipt | full scope + digest共同构成可校验binding；digest不单独充当scope identity | digest-only repository key、timestamp/hash fallback、反向解析members |
| draft/final `report_ref` | application typed id generator | 一个ref最多一个immutable report bundle；duplicate不生成新ref | scope digest、job run id、stored result ref、query id generator |
| draft/final `scope_digest_binding` |本次job input已验证binding | 与basis scope及current binding完整相等 | query重算、repository仅保存digest、current scope覆盖historical scope |
| draft/final `basis` / `findings` | checked snapshot assembly或assembly failure factory | checked snapshot机械装配findings；assembly failure findings固定空 | caller-provided finding refs、旧report findings、coverage count生成占位 |
| draft/final `report_status` | §16.10.8.3四状态矩阵机械派生 | Clean/IssuesFound/Degraded/Failed与basis、coverage、findings逐项闭合 | job status、surface status、finding count单独决定、caller override |
| `report_audit_trace_ref` | 同一UoW预生成并最终提交的matching audit identity | source fact=`ReconciliationReport(report_ref)`、subject、cursor、status、time均匹配 | query audit、job diagnostic trace、old/current report audit、post-commit补写 |
| `report_truth_cursor` | active UoW唯一truth-change cursor assignment | report/audit/optional relay source及binding/stored envelope逐字段相等 | source snapshot cursor、reference cursor、Version、time、max cursor |
| `generated_at` | pure report assembly完成的canonical time | 不晚于matching report audit/stored finish relation；rehydrate逐字段验证 | repository insert time、job finish time、query clock |
| persistence row fields | finalized immutable report逐字段编码 | persisted status和findings必须由rehydration重算后全等 |只保存summary/count、codec default、historical alias enum |
| audit linkage snapshot fields | matching committed `SandboxAuditTrace` | report/source fact/subject/cursor/time/status cardinality恰好一 | log/span、optional audit、另一个report的trace、raw audit body |
| rehydration input/bundle | exactly-one report row + exactly-one matching audit linkage | finding rows归属、连续顺序及all field equality通过后才返回report | row-only decode、audit后补、missing relation降级、latest audit |

`SandboxReconciliationReportPersistenceRow.persisted_report_status`只用于integrity comparison，不是第二status
owner；rehydration必须从basis、coverage和findings重新派生。`SandboxReconciliationScopeDigestBinding`当前
设计shape已闭合，但算法、writer/verifier实现与fixtures仍受`BLK-SBX-CANONICAL-001`阻断，不得以本文
示例或任意hash实现冒充验证事实。

##### 16.10.11.5 Exact query lookup、cardinality、absence与gap

| target field / carrier | exact source | relation guard | forbidden substitute |
|---|---|---|---|
| index cardinality六项count | same-snapshot exact report-key indexes与bundle relations | 每项独立计数；不能仅靠report row存在判定完整 | repository `Option`、总表count、current binding key、缓存命中 |
| report row/finding count | exact `report_ref` row与finding child index | row必须1；finding count必须等于rehydrated stream长度 | report status、stored count、relay payload count |
| current binding target count | exact bindings whose target is该report | `0..=1`；historical report合法为0，current report必须1 | scope/digest current lookup、timestamp winner、latest report |
| audit/relay/stored relation counts | exact source/report relation indexes | audit=1、stored=1；relay严格等于finding非空；finding非空但append依赖缺失时整组不得提交 | event disabled默认0、job status推断、generic stored result存在、report-only success |
| absence proof selector/cardinality | access通过后的same-snapshot exact lookup | 仅`report=0,finding=0,current=0,audit=0,relay=0,stored=0`且无tombstone/history异常 | `get(None)`、current=0、retention删除后全零、timeout、wrong-kind |
| absence `index_truth_cursor/observed_at` | lookup snapshot watermark + reader completion clock | 证明本次观察边界，不作为winner或version | source truth cursor、page cursor、query request time |
| read gap kind/reason | typed lookup/retention/integrity mapper | ordered-unique closed set；`NotVisible`优先于存在性读取 | repository/raw error string、多个gap折成Unavailable、Empty fallback |
| `Found(report)` | exact row + audit + optional relay + stored relation完成rehydration | historical report即使不current也可Found；report immutable | 要求current binding、从current report替代requested historical ref |
| `ExactAbsent(proof)` | exact all-zero never-committed proof | controlled tombstone、history residue、half-commit都不允许 | `None`、deleted payload、scope无current、generic 404 |
| `Unavailable(gaps)` | typed gap或integrity/retention不可判定 | 不携带partial report；query write set保持0 | partial DTO、old report fallback、repair/rebind/reconciliation run |

Query必须先完成`SandboxQueryAccessDecision`，再执行exact lookup。拒绝、限制或access unavailable时，
report repository read count为0；允许读取后也不得打开write UoW、分配ref/digest/cursor、追加business audit、
刷新source、修复binding或调用backend/tool/runtime/handoff/cleanup/reaper/redline接口。

##### 16.10.11.6 Job input、candidate、current binding与stored replay

| target field / carrier | exact source | relation guard | forbidden substitute |
|---|---|---|---|
| job input `job_run_id` | operations job entry invocation identity | 不等于idempotency key、report ref或stored result ref；duplicate返回原run id | request id、timestamp、new id on replay |
| job input `call_context` | validated `SandboxServiceCallContext` | operation=`RunSandboxReconciliation`、channel=job、actor/request/trace/idempotency/fingerprint完整 |只传key/digest、route/topic解析operation、system actor绕过context |
| job input scope/selection/digest binding | §16.10.2~§16.10.3及canonical verifier receipt | 三者完整scope逐字段相等；input不从config扩展target | target kinds、I085 cadence、I083 scope、page/batch参数 |
| candidate `report_draft` | validated source snapshot或assembly failure的report factory | report scope与job scope/digest一致 | job accumulator创建report、current report clone、query DTO |
| candidate audit/relay drafts | report source relation及finding stream | audit必有；relay当且仅当findings非空；非空时encoder/schema/store/validated target/retry能力全部是提交前置 | job status决定relay、coverage gap事件、post-commit event、config允许report-only |
| candidate `stored_result_ref` | application typed id generator | 与generic stored result及typed envelope exactly-one；rollback不可见 | report ref复用、job run id、idempotency ref、duplicate新ref |
| current binding logical key | 完整`SandboxReconciliationScopeDigestBinding` | scope和digest都匹配；collision隔离；scope成员变化形成新key | digest-only、context-only、target set hash、latest scope |
| current binding report/cursor/status/audit/time | finalized report + matching committed audit + application bind time | 每项逐字段等于report bundle；time不参与winner | candidate draft、job status、source cursor、timestamp winner |
| first expectation | UoW内current/history/tombstone/in-flight四类关系均证明never committed | caller只表达期望，writer重新验证 | caller bool、preflight `None`、retention后全零 |
| replacement expected binding/version | caller在同一workflow读取的完整current binding及core `Version` | exact key、binding和version均全等；new report ref不同且cursor前进 | cursor/time/digest代version、reload latest后自动重试 |
| stored envelope identity/run/kind/status | typed generator + original invocation + fixed job kind + report到job状态机械映射 | persisted original status只允许Succeeded/Degraded/Failed | `DuplicateReplayed`持久化、generic status、当前调用的新run id |
| stored envelope report/finding/relay/audit/cursor/digest | finalized committed report group | finding refs完整同序；relay presence严格等于finding非空；非空却无relay时不能形成stored envelope；其它字段逐项全等 | 只保存count、从current report重组、另一个scope同status report、受控免发marker |
| stored envelope start/finish | original invocation lifecycle canonical clock | duplicate原样返回；finish不早于start/report/audit/relay要求 | replay当前时间、repository update time、report generated_at替代两者 |
| generic stored result relation | `SandboxStoredOperationResult` owner保存typed envelope identity/kind/status | exactly-one typed envelope且completed idempotency指向它 | generic blob替代typed get、report ref直接作为result ref |
| materialization outcome `Committed` | whole UoW commit confirmed | binding与stored envelope均来自同一finalized group | report row可见即宣称Committed、post-commit重组 |
| materialization outcome `DuplicateReplayed` | same fingerprint completed record + typed stored bundle完整重验 | write set=0；只返回stored job report；原report可为current或historical | 重跑source、读取/返回current binding、要求仍current、生成新identities、覆盖original status |

不同job operation对同一scope并发时，current binding只表示CAS winner；每个已成功提交的immutable report
仍各自拥有matching audit、typed stored envelope和optional relay，并可按exact report ref读取。loser若在CAS前
整个UoW回滚，则没有historical report；若正式后续策略允许“report committed但不成为current”，该分支必须
由Step 7/11/13定义独立typed writer outcome和atomic relation，不能把`VersionConflict`后的半提交擅自解释为
historical success。本节当前唯一主路径仍是report/binding/stored group同一UoW提交。

字段来源闭包的判定标准是：任一公开或持久化字段都能沿
`surface/stored envelope -> report bundle -> checked source or assembly failure -> committed owner`
回溯到唯一节点；若需要依赖scope latest、digest-only identity、current winner重组historical report、reason文本、
raw error、query时钟或config target expansion，则判定为未闭合，必须返回typed error或回到后续owner Step重验。

| Step 16 finding event cut写“finding / degraded refs from report” | `invalidated_pending_step_16_rewrite` | event只含finding stream，不因coverage degraded发送；必须增加zero-finding Degraded/Failed无relay断言。 |
| Step 16只测clean/issues/degraded/failed和no-repair | `insufficient_pending_step_16_rewrite` | 还需scope/selection、five-channel coverage、finding order、rehydration/cardinality、exact absence/tombstone、UoW/CAS、duplicate、commit-unknown、retention和fake/durable parity。 |
| Step 17 query表写`report ref from latest index` | `invalidated_pending_step_17_rewrite` | implementation handoff必须固定exact report selector和historical readable bundle；不得交给implementation agent选择latest index。 |
| Step 17 generic job/input row只列scope/page/succeeded/failed refs | `invalidated_pending_step_17_rewrite` | reconciliation object-to-file handoff必须列出exact typed job input、candidate、binding expectation、stored envelope、writer outcome及affected boundaries。 |
| README/旧正式`03~07`中的auto-repair、latest report或summary-only report描述 | `historical_material` | 不继承；report只读且immutable，不拥有truth/projection/relay/handoff/cleanup/redline repair。 |

冲突台账的关闭条件不是“实现时兼容旧字段”，而是回归后的Step 7~17分别删除旧source、写入current
callable/schema/flow/matrix/transaction/error/race/config/observability/test/handoff，并完成跨Step差集审计。
在此之前旧中间产物和正式`03~07`继续为`historical_reviewed_revalidation_pending`，不能成为实现输入。

#### 16.10.13 Step 7~17 定向重验登记

本节只登记 `SandboxReconciliationReport` 对后续详细设计 Step 的 exact consumer obligation。它不提前
修改对应 Step 文件，不把旧设计标为 current，也不创建 trait、DTO、physical table、配置值、测试结果、
实现 boundary 或运行证据。每个 Step 必须在轮到自身串行回归时重新读取 `§16.10.1~§16.10.14`，删除
§16.10.12 已失效的 consumer，并按本节完成字段、callable、顺序、错误和负向差集；只在旧行后追加
一句“遵循新报告契约”不算重验。

##### 16.10.13.1 Step 7 Trait / Port / Adapter Contract

Step 7 必须建立 reconciliation-specific logical ports，不能继续复用 generic derived repository 或
`SandboxOpaqueRef` finder。exact trait 名由 Step 7 在其模块小循环中闭合，但 callable 集合、输入输出
角色和 call budget 不得少于下表。

| callable capability | required typed input | required typed output | owner / side effect | forbidden substitute |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| canonical scope verification | 完整 `SandboxReconciliationScopeRef` | 直接返回已验证 `SandboxReconciliationScopeDigestBinding` 或 typed unavailable | application verifier bridge；不得向 caller 暴露 receipt constructor | raw digest pair、fixture hash、`DefaultHasher`、repository-generated digest |
| committed source assembly | `SandboxReconciliationSelectionProof`、matching digest binding、same-snapshot read context | 完整 `SandboxReconciliationSourceSnapshot` 或四类 `SandboxReconciliationAssemblyFailure` 的 typed application outcome | truth/reference/projection reader；只读 owner snapshots | opaque scope、latest page、两个 transaction 拼接、`SandboxReconciliationSnapshotItem` 第二真相 |
| exact report lookup | `SandboxReconciliationReportSelector` + access-approved read context | `SandboxReconciliationReportLookupOutcome` 或 typed integrity error | reconciliation report reader；read set 只含 exact aggregate/index/audit/relay/stored relation | `Option<Report>`、scope latest、generic derived getter、read repair |
| current binding read for job | 完整 scope/digest binding | zero-or-one exact binding + core `Version`，并区分 history/tombstone/integrity | writer workflow only；不得被 Query 暴露 | digest-only lookup、timestamp winner、`Option` 当 absence proof |
| first/replacement materialization | `SandboxReconciliationMaterializationCandidate` + binding expectation + accepted write context | `SandboxReconciliationMaterializationWriteOutcome` | reconciliation-specific writer；完整 group 同一 UoW | `save(report) -> opaque ref`、post-commit audit/event、CAS loser historical row |
| typed stored report save/get | exact `SandboxReconciliationStoredJobReport` 或 stored result ref | unit save result / 完整 typed envelope | stored-result owner；与 generic relation exactly-one | generic JSON blob、counts-only job report、从 current report 重组 |
| relay append prerequisite | finalized report source binding、Step 8 exact encoder output、validated target/retry binding | §16.4 `SandboxEventRelayDraft` / finalized append pair | existing relay owner；finding 非空时为 materialization mandatory dependency | optional best-effort publisher call、fake relay ref、report-only mode |
| commit-unknown inspection | operation/candidate/stored/report identities + full relation snapshot | fully committed / fully absent / indeterminate typed classification | read-only recovery owner | blind replay、new identities、source rerun、binding repair |

Step 7 repository surface还必须把 report root、finding stream、current/history/tombstone、matching audit、optional
relay与typed stored result的same-snapshot cardinality作为一个完整读取能力暴露；不能让application分别调用六个
`count_*` 后跨 transaction 自行拼 proof。durable与fake必须实现同一 public port 和 typed outcome，fake不得
增加 `latest_by_scope`、default empty report、private repair或忽略 `Version` 的捷径。

Step 7停审条件：上述8组capability均能回指本节exact carrier；query read port不持有writer、id generator、
source assembler、relay appender或external adapter；writer能表达`FindingRelayUnavailable`、CAS conflict、
commit unknown和typed stored replay；所有generic/opaque/latest callable差集为0。任一项缺失都继续
`blocked_by_step_6_regression`，不得交给Step 8补schema掩盖。

##### 16.10.13.2 Step 8 Protocol Contract

Step 8 必须分别闭合 Query、Operations Job 与 Outbound Event 三个协议面；它们共享typed identity但不共享
同一DTO。wire schema必须从本节字段逐项机械映射，不得把scope、report、stored result和current binding压成
一个generic ref。

| protocol surface | required fields / mapping | cardinality and visibility | prohibited field or behavior |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GetSandboxReconciliationReport` request | required exact `SandboxReconciliationReportRef` + shared query metadata | exactly one selector；access denial先于存在性读取 | optional scope、context、latest flag、stored result ref、both-present precedence |
| query report response | surface status + caller-safe report identity、canonical status、digest、basis/coverage、ordered findings、source/report cursor、audit linkage和generated time | `Visible/Degraded/Empty/Unavailable/Failed`按§16.10.9机械映射；Failed report仍携带report | summary-only status/count、query clock补字段、partial report on read gap、current binding外泄 |
| checked basis DTO | exact scope的可见body-free投影、五个coverage entries、checked cursor pair | 五channel固定同序；optional字段与basis variant闭合 | raw source rows、generic map、只发`is_complete`、reason推导status |
| finding DTO | typed finding ref、primary target、optional related ref、kind、severity、safe reason、双cursor、observed time | ordinal `1..=n`连续同序；related presence按kind | count替代stream、DTO重排、raw diff/body、caller severity override |
| operations job spec | explicit context + ordered truth refs + ordered projection refs + invocation metadata | entry从字段构造scope/selection proof并调用canonical verifier；不信任wire digest | opaque scope、target kinds、empty-means-all、page cursor、caller-selected status/digest |
| stored/replayed job report | original run id/status/times、exact report、full finding refs、optional relay、audit、report cursor、scope digest | persisted status只允许Succeeded/Degraded/Failed；duplicate仅加调用级overlay | persisted DuplicateReplayed、current binding、new run id/time、counts-only items |
| finding-available payload | typed report ref、canonical report status、verified scope digest、完整ordered finding refs | 仅finding非空生成；generic relay envelope另带source/cursor/audit/trace | degraded refs、finding count only、opaque refs、route/topic/provider字段 |

Step 8 encoder是提交前 dependency：它必须先完成schema version、body-free/redaction与canonical fingerprint验证，
再把冻结bytes交给§16.4 relay draft。encoder unavailable不是可发布一个无event report的理由；必须向application
返回可穷尽映射到`FindingRelayUnavailable`的typed failure。publisher transport DTO不得重新读取report或重排finding。

Step 8停审条件：request/response/event/job/stored replay每个字段都有唯一Step 6 source、required/optional规则、
wire enum和error mapping；`SandboxReconciliationReportView`、`ReconciliationReportStatus`、opaque scope、
latest selector与report-only event branch全部为0；没有为Query、Job和Event复制第二套finding schema。

##### 16.10.13.3 Step 9 Function Flow

Step 9必须将query、first/replacement job、duplicate和commit-unknown拆成独立flow，不能继续用generic
`get_read_projection`或“load page -> save report”摘要。

| flow | mandatory order | success surface | rollback / no-side-effect boundary |
|---|---|---|---|
| exact query | validate request -> access decision -> exact same-snapshot index/cardinality read -> aggregate/audit rehydrate -> surface map -> low-cardinality hook | Report / ExactAbsent / Unavailable，integrity走typed failure | write/id allocation/business audit/relay/source/external calls均为0；denial path repository read=0 |
| first materialization | validate job context -> construct exact scope/proof -> canonical verify -> reserve idempotency -> same-snapshot source assembly -> report/audit/required relay drafts -> first expectation -> finalize cursor/group -> atomic commit | Committed binding + stored report | finding relay依赖缺失、任何stage失败或first conflict整组回滚；不得report-only |
| replacement | 读取exact current binding+Version -> source fence ->形成new identities/drafts -> CAS stage -> whole-group commit | new current；old committed report自然成为historical | loser全量不可见；不得reload latest后覆盖或私留historical candidate |
| duplicate same fingerprint | completed idempotency -> typed stored report -> exact immutable report/audit/relay bundle revalidation -> overlay disposition | 只返回原stored report；原report可current/historical | source read、new identity、current binding read/return、audit/event append和write UoW均为0 |
| different fingerprint | idempotency conflict before source read | no new report | 原group不变；不得返回原stored payload冒充同request |
| commit unknown inspection | freeze original identities -> same-snapshot full relation inspection -> classify committed/absent/indeterminate | only complete committed可恢复原outcome；absent允许上层显式新调用 | 不自动重放、不重算source/finding/payload、不修index/current |

finding非空分支的正确顺序是“先证明append能力完整并编码payload，再stage全组”；不能先提交report后尝试
event。publisher delivery在commit后独立消费Pending relay，不进入materialization事务，也不因暂时Unavailable
把已提交report回滚。无finding的Clean/Degraded/Failed分支不构造payload、relay identity或target binding。

Step 9停审条件：每个调用点都能回指Step 7 callable与Step 8 DTO；事务内外边界、cursor assignment、
idempotency completion、error mapping和call count具名；旧 `report_clean`、page snapshot、optional event、latest
query与job failure catch-all均删除。

##### 16.10.13.4 Step 10 State Matrix

`SandboxReconciliationReportStatus`是factory result classifier，不是可迁移lifecycle。Step 10必须把它列入
“非状态机有限状态主语”审计，而不是写`Pending -> Completed`或rerun transition。

| subject | legal source / values | transition conclusion | cross-owner relation |
|---|---|---|---|
| report status | factory一次派生`Clean / IssuesFound / Degraded / Failed` | immutable；无from/to、update、supersede或rerun transition | report到job status按§16.10.10.3机械映射 |
| coverage state | 每channel一次形成`Complete / CompleteEmpty / Partial / Unavailable / Failed` | snapshot classifier；不持久化独立lifecycle | 只影响report status优先级，不修改source owner |
| finding kind/severity | finite checker + required severity mapper | immutable；无transition | finding非空要求exactly-one Pending relay append |
| materialization outcome | `Committed / DuplicateReplayed` invocation outcome | 非持久化状态机；duplicate不改原job status | Committed才返回current binding；duplicate只返回stored report |
| relay status | §16.4 `Pending / Published / Retryable / Failed / DeadLetter` | 独立publication lifecycle | Pending与report同UoW；后续状态不反写report |

Step 10还必须重验report status与`SandboxQuerySurfaceStatus`、`SandboxJobReportStatus`、
`SandboxEventRelayStatus`三套owner的cross-state matrix，禁止同名合并。`Failed report`成功读取仍是可见business
record；query technical failure不创建Failed report；`DuplicateReplayed`不是persisted job status；publisher
Unavailable不把report改Degraded。

Step 10停审条件：旧`ReconciliationReportStatus`、`report_clean`、job failure mapper任意造Failed report、
report Pending/Completed和event Delivered全部删除；本对象不新增独立状态机，historical状态/enum总数只在
Step 10全量主语清单重算后传播，当前不得提前修改30/31盘点结论。

##### 16.10.13.5 Step 11 Persistence / Transaction / Consistency

Step 11必须从本节aggregate关系推导logical schema，不能把report塞入generic derived row。physical表名、
codec与存储产品留给Step 11自身，但以下logical relation和constraint必须全部可表达。

| logical relation | key / cardinality | immutable or mutable rule | required index / consistency proof |
|---|---|---|---|
| report root | exact report ref，0..1 | immutable；basis/status/cursor/time不得更新 | exact PK与scope/digest collision verification |
| finding stream | `(report_ref, ordinal)`，root存在时exact `0..n` | immutable、连续、同序、owner report唯一 | report-local range/index与canonical count |
| current binding | full scope value + verified digest，exact 0..1 | only insert or core `Version` CAS replacement | full-value equality after digest hit；target report exact 1 |
| history / tombstone | logical key/report ref的controlled marker | append-only；区分historical、expired、never committed | first/absence/retention proof均可读取 |
| report audit relation | report source/subject exact 1 | matching audit immutable | report ref + audit ref + cursor same-group relation |
| finding relay relation | finding空=0，非空=1 | relay/payload按§16.4独立生命周期；source link不可换 | source report ref + event kind unique relation |
| typed stored job report | report exact 1；stored result exact 1 | original run/status/times/items immutable | bidirectional unique relation + generic result kind |
| idempotency completion | operation/key/fingerprint -> stored result exact 1 | completion与whole group同commit可见 | duplicate zero-write lookup |

write UoW必须以一个truth cursor提交report、findings、new current binding、matching audit、required relay/payload、
typed envelope、generic stored result和idempotency completion。任何pre-commit failure、unique/CAS conflict或
`FindingRelayUnavailable`使整个candidate不可见；cursor allocation也不能单独可见。replacement只移动current
binding，旧root/finding/audit/relay/stored group保持immutable可exact读取。

reader必须在同一公平snapshot返回完整`SandboxReconciliationReportIndexCardinality`及bundle；root=0但任一dependent
relation非零、root>1、audit/stored非1、relay与finding不一致、duplicate current target或scope/digest collision均是
integrity error。historical report允许current target=0，不得误判absent。fake与durable必须共享constraint、failpoint、
snapshot和rehydration tests；fake不能省略history/tombstone或把HashMap `None`直接映Empty。

retention必须共同pin current、audit、stored replay、completed idempotency与required relay；historical在可读/可replay
期间保持完整bundle。合法物理删除前先提交controlled tombstone/history marker，不能把删除后的全零索引解释成
NeverCommitted。具体TTL、archive和isolation implementation留Step 14/正式`04`，但这些最低不等式不可配置放宽。

##### 16.10.13.6 Step 12 Error / Recovery

Step 12必须保持object shape error、application flow error、infra persistence error与public surface error分层，
不得用generic Internal吞掉本节21个error enum的新增variant。

| failure class | owning error / mapping obligation | retryability / recovery | forbidden mapping |
|---|---|---|---|
| selector/scope/selection invalid | contracts error -> public Validation | corrected new request only | unavailable、Empty、Failed report |
| source coverage gap | valid report basis -> Degraded/Failed report按矩阵 | explicit new job可产生new immutable report | 自动refresh/repair、raw source error写reason |
| assembly failure四类 | validated `SandboxReconciliationAssemblyFailure` -> Failed report | new invocation with corrected dependency；旧report不改 | catch-all job error造failure basis |
| exact absence | `ExactAbsent` -> Empty | no retry side effect | tombstone/history/integrity也映Empty |
| read dependency unavailable | typed gap -> Unavailable | caller policy可重读；不得partial report | missing row、corruption降级为gap |
| bundle/cardinality corruption | lookup/materialization integrity error -> Failed technical surface + quarantine/reconciliation handoff | operator/migration owner；no repair in query/report | 选latest、删孤儿、默认row |
| finding relay append unavailable | `FindingRelayUnavailable` -> current job typed failed，whole UoW rollback | 修复完整wiring后以新显式调用重试 | commit report-only、改成Degraded、伪relay ref |
| publisher delivery unavailable | relay owner Pending/Retryable/Failed/DeadLetter；report保持已提交 | relay recovery按§16.4 | 回滚report、重新编码payload |
| current/Version conflict | materialization conflict | caller显式新workflow重新读取；writer内部不自动换expectation | last-writer-wins、CAS loser historical success |
| commit unknown | opaque original identities -> committed/absent/indeterminate | only complete/absent可确定；indeterminate quarantine/operator | blind replay、猜Committed/DuplicateReplayed |
| stored replay missing/mismatch | stored report error -> integrity failure | repair/migration owner；duplicate不得重跑source | 从current report重组、new run id |
| controlled tombstone | expired/tombstoned typed surface | retention policy owner | ExactAbsent / never committed |

所有safe reason必须来自approved mapper，不携带SQL、table/key、raw row、SDK/transport error、path/host/PID、
payload、scope/ref文本或secret。retryability由finite error kind决定，不能解析Display。Step 12停审时每个contracts
variant必须有application/public/diagnostic唯一owner，wildcard fallback、reason substring和“unknown as retryable”差集为0。

##### 16.10.13.7 Step 13 Concurrency / Idempotency

Step 13必须同时冻结调用幂等身份与scope current winner，两者不是同一个key。idempotency key由完整
`SandboxServiceCallContext`中的operation/key/fingerprint拥有；current logical key由full scope + verified digest拥有。

| race / replay | required winner rule | loser / replay result | forbidden result |
|---|---|---|---|
| same operation/key/fingerprint | one reservation/commit winner | 完整typed stored report replay，zero writes；不返回binding | second report/audit/event、rerun source |
| same key, different fingerprint | original record remains | conflict before source read | replay original as same request、overwrite current |
| same job operation concurrent first | unique/idempotency winner | wait then replay exact stored group或typed in-flight | duplicate report refs/relay |
| different operations, same absent scope | one first/current winner | other whole UoW conflict/rollback | loser historical row、timestamp winner |
| replacements share expected Version | one CAS winner | othersVersionConflict；no visible candidate | reload latest and overwrite、two new history rows |
| late older source | cursor fence + expected binding rejects | no report/audit/relay/stored residue | current rollback、old row private historical |
| duplicate after later replacement | idempotency points to original immutable bundle | original historical stored report replay；no current binding required | substitute new current report、declare missing because historical |
| retention vs replay/query | pin/fence establishes commit-before/after complete view | full bundle or typed tombstone/unavailable | dangling stored result、all-zero false absence |
| commit unknown vs retry | original identity inspection first | committed/absent/indeterminate only | new identity blind retry、guess duplicate |

Step 13需定义deterministic barriers/failpoints覆盖每种ordering，不得用sleep证明并发。`DuplicateReplayed`只作为
本次entry disposition存在，原stored job status/run/times/items不可变。若未来需要“成功提交historical但不成为current”
语义，必须重开Step 6并新增独立typed outcome；当前不能把CAS loser解释成该分支。

##### 16.10.13.8 Step 14 Config / External Binding

Step 14与正式`04`必须重写当前historical的`I016=true, I014=false -> report still saved`组合。current对象契约
固定：只要启用会生成新reconciliation report的materialization job，就必须同时装配finding relay append完整组合；
配置只能整体启停，不能按运行结果决定丢event。

| config/binding concern | required current relation | invalid composition / runtime handling |
|---|---|---|
| reconciliation materialization enablement | job registry + explicit scope input + source reader + report store + replay store + audit + relay append完整组合 | 任一缺失startup fail-fast；不得注册report-only job |
| outbound feature relation | materialization enabled蕴含reconciliation finding event append capability启用 | `I016=true, I014=false` partial composition失效；具体key改写由正式`04`完成 |
| relay append dependencies | relay store、canonical encoder/verifier、schema version、closed route、validated publisher/target binding、same-generation retry policy完整 | missing/disabled/unbound阻断装配；runtime append unavailable -> `FindingRelayUnavailable` whole rollback |
| publisher health | validated binding存在即可先append Pending | temporary delivery unavailable由relay lifecycle处理，不阻断既有report query，不删除relay truth |
| canonical scope digest | selected writer/verifier、algorithm identity和fixtures正式绑定 | `BLK-SBX-CANONICAL-001`关闭前不得用fallback hash激活writer |
| current binding CAS | core exact `Version` revision/compatibility固定 | `BLK-SBX-VERSION-001`关闭前不得以cursor/time/usize替代 |
| cadence / batch | cadence只决定何时调用；batch只限制内部bounded read且不得改变scope成员/顺序 | I085/I083/page token进入scope/digest/current key均拒绝 |
| retention | report/history/tombstone、audit、relay、stored result、idempotency的可读/replay窗口满足§16.10.10.5 pin关系 | 任一dependent先过期、删除后all-zero、无限retention猜测均拒绝 |
| query registration | exact historical/current report reader不依赖publisher瞬时健康 | publisher down不能让已提交report不可读或触发query repair |

runtime builder顺序至少为：strict config validation -> store/UoW capabilities -> canonical verifier -> protocol encoder/schema ->
route/publisher target binding -> retry policy generation match -> source/query/job services -> schedule registration。任何partial
candidate不可见。Step 14只登记opaque binding identity，不把topic、endpoint、credential、provider SDK或payload body带入
contracts/domain。具体raw key、默认值、产品、TTL和profile资格必须在正式`04`重验，本节不伪造。

##### 16.10.13.9 Step 15 Observability / Audit

| observation point | allowlisted semantic fields | business audit behavior | forbidden data / side effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| exact query completion | operation、surface outcome、report status class、current/historical class、gap/integrity kind | append 0；只读matching report audit ref | report/finding ref、scope digest、cursor、reason、existence-sensitive selector |
| materialization completion | Committed/DuplicateReplayed/conflict/relay-unavailable/commit-unknown、report status class、has-findings bool | only Committed group含exactly-one matching business audit | raw scope、idempotency key/fingerprint、refs、payload、SQL |
| relay append gate | zero/nonzero finding class、append prerequisite category、Pending append outcome | relay/audit按同UoW规则；hook failure不改commit | finding count作高基数label、route/topic、encoded bytes、post-commit补event |
| publisher delivery | canonical relay outcome/attempt class | 不新增report audit、不反写report | provider response/header/body、credential、report mutation |
| commit-unknown inspection | committed/absent/indeterminate class | no business audit or repair from inspector | candidate/ref bodies、blind retry |
| retention/tombstone | policy outcome class、pin violation kind | formal retention audit由owner定义；query不写 | deleted key、scope/ref、把all-zero报never existed |

metrics只允许低基数finite enum/status/error category；exact refs、digest、cursor、reason、actor/request identity不能作为
metric label或普通log字段。diagnostic hook失败不得改变query/materialization/relay结果，也不能触发retry。Step 15必须
区分“append能力缺失”和“publisher暂时不可投递”，避免把两者聚合成同一Unavailable并诱导report-only或rollback。

##### 16.10.13.10 Step 16 Test Cuts

以下是后续Step 16必须逐项具名的最小切口，不是测试代码、执行结果、run_id、evidence alias或验收结论。

###### 16.10.13.10.1 Contracts / factory / rehydration cuts

| reconciliation | exact report ref query、same-snapshot source、immutable current/history、whole-group writer和stored replay闭合 | scope/latest query、CAS loser history、duplicate返回current binding |
| Sandbox scope redline | 只拥有运行隔离truth及其安全控制、只读/审计/传播关系 | tools semantic execution、runtime agent loop、member lifecycle orchestration |

`SandboxReconciliationReport`继续被归类为审计、对账和异常记录面，而不是主体执行能力。它不能创建execution
environment identity、应用resource limits、建立filesystem/network/process/workspace boundary、决定launch、
采集artifact正文、推进cleanup/reaper，或把finding提升为accepted owner truth。
